name: 高中核心词
description: 高中英语参考词汇表（来源：github.com/mahavivo/english-wordlists，释义由 NPEE/CET4/COCA 交叉匹配），按 COCA 词频排序

words.meaning: art.这(那)个;这(那)些(指特定的人或物)
words.example:
Please would you pass the salt.  请你把盐递给我。
I'll pick you up at the station.  我会开车到火车站接你。
We spent all day at the beach.  我们在海滩上留了一整天。

words.meaning: v.(就)是,等于;(存)在;到达,来到,发生
words.example:
He is rich.  他很富有。
It's cold today.  今天很冷。
I'm Andy.  我叫安迪。

words.meaning: conj.和,与,而且;那么;接连,又
words.example:
We were wet and tired.  我们浑身湿透，精疲力竭。
We kissed and hugged each other.  我们两个亲吻拥抱。
Tidy up your room. And don't forget to make your bed!  整理一下你的房间。还有，别忘了铺床！

words.meaning: prep.…的;在…之中;用…制的;关于…的
words.example:
I've never been north of Edinburgh.  我从未去过爱丁堡以北的地方。UK preposition
She has the face of an angel.  她有一张天使般的面孔。
That man's got the brain of a donkey!  那个男人长了个笨驴脑袋！UK preposition

words.meaning: art.一(个);每一(个);(同类事物中)任一个
words.example:
I've bought a car.  我买了辆汽车。
She's got a boyfriend.  她交了个男朋友。
There was a sudden loud noise.  突然发出一声巨响。

words.meaning: prep.在…里(内,上);用…(表示)ad.进,入
words.example:
Put the milk back in the fridge when you've finished with it.  喝完牛奶后把它放回冰箱。
Is Mark still in bed?  马克还在睡觉吗？
They live in a charming old cottage.  他们住在一间可爱的老屋内。

words.meaning: prep.(表示方向)到;向;(表示间接关系)给.
words.example:
She agreed to help.  她答应帮忙。
I'll have to tell him.  我得告诉他。
Sadly she didn't live to see her grandchildren.  令人伤心的是，她没有活到孙辈出生的那天。

words.meaning: v.有,具有;体会,经受;从事;使;吃,喝
words.example:
I've heard that story before.  我以前听过那个故事。
Diane's already gone.  戴安娜已经走了。
John hasn't phoned.  约翰没有打过电话。

words.meaning: pron.它;[作无人称动词的主语]
words.example:
The company was losing money and it had to make people redundant.  该公司在亏损，所以不得不裁员。
The argument was upsetting for us all - I don't want to talk about it.  那场争论使我们大家都心烦——我不想再谈论了。
Children who stay away from school do it for different reasons.  孩子翘课有各种原因。pronoun

words.meaning: pron.(主格)我
words.example:
Am I invited?  邀请我了吗？
I'm not mistaken, am I?  我没弄错，对吧？
I'd like a coffee, please.  请给我一杯咖啡。pronoun

words.meaning: a./pron.那,那个 ad.那么 conj.[引导从句]
words.example:
I've never liked that cousin of hers.  我从来没喜欢过她的那个表亲。
Who's that? Is that the girl you told me about?  那是谁？是你跟我说起过的那个女孩吗？
How much are those shoes?  那双鞋多少钱？

words.meaning: prep.为了;给;代替;向;支持 conj.因为?
words.example:
There's a phone message for you.  你有一个电话留言。
I'd better buy something for the new baby.  我最好给刚出生的宝宝买些东西。
There's a prize for the fastest three runners in each category.  每个组别跑得最快的前三名将会获得奖品。UK preposition

words.meaning: pron.你;你们;一个人,任何人
words.example:
You look nice.  你看起来不错。
You said I could go with you.  你说过我可以和你一起去。
You're coming tonight, aren't you?  你今晚会过来，对吗?

words.meaning: pron.他;(不论性别的)一个人
words.example:
Don't ask Andrew, he won't know.  不要问安德鲁，他不会知道的。
There's no need to be frightened - he's a very friendly dog.  不必害怕——它是只非常温顺的狗。
The modern traveller can go where he likes.  现代旅行者可以去他想去的任何地方。

words.meaning: prep.跟…一起;用;具有;关于;因;随着
words.example:
He lives with his grandmother.  他和奶奶一起生活。
He's impossible to work with.  没法和他一起工作。
I'm going to France with a couple of friends.  我要和几位朋友一起去法国。

words.meaning: a.连接上 prep.在…上;靠近 ad.向前,继续
words.example:
Look at all the books on your desk!  看看你书桌上这么多书！
Ow, you're standing on my foot!  哎哟，你踩着我的脚了！
Your suitcase is on top of the wardrobe.  你的手提箱在衣柜顶。

words.meaning: aux.v. vt.做,干,办,从事;引起 vi.行动
words.example:
That was a really stupid thing to do.  那么做真是太愚蠢了。
Why were you sent home from school early? What have you done now?  你为甚么放学这么早？你又干了甚么事？
What are you doing over the weekend?  这周末你准备干甚么？

words.meaning: vt.说,讲;说明;比如说 vi.说,发表意见
words.example:
Small children find it difficult to say long words.  小孩子觉得长字不好说。
She said goodbye to all her friends and left.  她跟所有的朋友道别后就离开了。
Ben never forgets to say "Please" and "Thank you".  班从来不忘说“请”和“谢谢”。

words.meaning: pron.这(个) a.这(个);今 ad.这(样)
words.example:
Can you sign this form here for me?  请你在这表上签个名好吗？
These books are too heavy for me to carry.  这些书太重了，我拿不动。
informal We met this girl (= the girl I am going to tell you about) in the hotel.  我们在旅馆里遇到这姑娘。

words.meaning: 商店。(一般人经常用复数they来指一家商店)
words.example:
I've known the Browns for a long time. They're very pleasant people.  我认识布朗一家已经很久了。他们都很友善。
Where are my glasses? They were on the table just now.  我的眼镜哪里去了？刚才还在桌子上。
They (= People who know) say things will be better in the new year.  据说新的一年情况会好转。

words.meaning: prep.[表示价格、速度等]以,达;在..方面
words.example:
We'll meet you at the entrance.  我们会在入口跟你碰头。
That bit at the beginning of the film was brilliant.  电影开头的那一段精彩极了。
She's sitting at the table in the corner.  她坐在角落的一张桌子旁。

words.meaning: conj.但是 prep.除...以外 ad.只,才,仅仅
words.example:
She's very hard-working but not very imaginative.  她工作很努力，但缺乏想像力。
This is not caused by evil, but by simple ignorance.  这并不是恶意而为，只是由于无知。
The play's good, but not that good - I've seen better.  这出戏还可以，但也不是多好——我看过更好的。

words.meaning: pron.我们<主格>
words.example:
Can we all go to the swimming pool this afternoon?  我们今天下午能都去游泳吗？
If you don't hurry up we'll be late.  你不赶快的话我们就要迟到了。
Perhaps we could move on to discuss the next item on the agenda.  或许我们接下来可以讨论议程中的下一项内容。pronoun

words.meaning: pron.[he的所有格/物主代词]他的(所有物)
words.example:
Mark just phoned to say he'd left his coat behind. Do you know if this is his?  马克刚才打电话来说他的外套丢了。你知道这件是不是他的？
formal Did Chris tell you about his winning some money in the lottery?  克里斯告诉你他买彩券中奖了吗？
He got his very own computer for Christmas.  他得到一台属于他自己的电脑作为圣诞礼物。determiner pronoun

words.meaning: prep.从,自从;由于;离;根据,按;去除
words.example:
What time does the flight from Amsterdam arrive?  从阿姆斯特丹飞来的航班甚么时候到达？
The wind is coming from the north.  风从北面吹来。
She sent me a postcard from Majorca.  她从马略卡给我寄来一张明信片。

words.meaning: ad.不,不是,不会;没有
words.example:
He's not fat!  他不胖！
Don't you like her?  你难道不喜欢她吗？
It isn't difficult (= It is easy).  这并不难。

words.meaning: prep.被;凭借;经由;由于ad.在近旁;经过
words.example:
The motorcycle was driven by a tiny bald man.  一个秃顶的小个子男人驾驶着那辆摩托车。
We were amazed by what she told us.  我们对她所说的事感到很惊讶。
I'm reading some short stories (written) by Chekhov.  我在读契诃夫写的一些短篇小说。

words.meaning: pron.(主格)她
words.example:
After India became independent, she chose to be a member of the Commonwealth.  印度独立后，自主选择成为英联邦的成员。
Look at my new car - isn't she beautiful?  看看我的新车——是不是很漂亮？noun countable
Is this kitten a she or a he?  这只小猫是母的还是公的？

words.meaning: conj.或,或者(表示选择);即,大约;否则
words.example:
Is it Tuesday or Wednesday today?  今天是星期二还是星期三？
You can pay now or when you come back to pick up the paint.  你可以现在付款，也可以等你回来取油漆时再付。
Are you listening to me or not ?  你有没有在听我说话？

words.meaning: ad.同样地 conj.由于;像...一样 prep.作为
words.example:
She'll soon be as tall as her mother.  她很快就会和她母亲一样高了。
It's not as good as it used to be.  这个不如以前的好。preposition
She works as a waitress.  她是名待者。

words.meaning: pron.什么 a.多么,何等;什么;尽可能多的
words.example:
What time is it?  几点了？
What books did you buy?  你买了甚么书？
What did you wear?  你穿的是甚么？

words.meaning: v.去,离开;走;放置;变成;运转 n.围棋
words.example:
We went into the house.  我们走进了那座房子。
We don't go to the cinema very often these days.  近来我们不太经常看电影。
Wouldn't it be quicker to go by train?  坐火车去不是更快一些吗？

words.meaning: pron..[they的所有格]他(她、它)们的
words.example:
He gave them their coats.  他把他们的外衣交给了他们。
One of the students has left their book behind.  有个学生遗忘了一本书。UK determiner

words.meaning: aux.v.能;可以 n.罐头;容器 vt.把…装罐
words.example:
You'll need a can of tuna for this recipe.  做这道菜需要一罐鲔鱼。
He spent ten years in the can for armed robbery.  他因持枪抢劫而蹲了十年大牢。noun]kæn/
Corruption is a serious problem, but nobody has yet been willing to open up that can of worms.  腐败是很严重的问题，可是还没有人愿意触及这个难题。noun]kæn/

words.meaning: pron.谁,什么人;…的人;他,她,他们
words.example:
Who did this?  这是谁做的？
Who's she?  她是谁？
Who are all those people?  那些人是谁？

words.meaning: v.获得,得到;使,使得;变得,成为;到达
words.example:
He's gone down to the corner shop to get some milk.  他到那家街角小店买牛奶去了。
We stopped off on the motorway to get some breakfast.  我们在高速公路上，中途停车吃了点早餐。
How much did he get for his car (= How much money did he sell it for) ?  他的汽车卖了多少钱？

words.meaning: conj.(用于连接宾语从句)是否;是不是
words.example:
I'll pay you double if you get the work finished by Friday.  如果你周五前完工，我付你双倍的报酬。
We'll have the party in the garden if the weather's good. If not (= If the weather is not good) , it'll have to be inside.  如果天气好的话，我们将在花园里开派对。如果不好，就只好在室内了。
If anyone rings for me, please tell them I'll be back in the office at 4 o'clock.  要是有人给我打电话，请告诉他们我四点钟回办公室。

words.meaning: aux./v.将;可能;将会;总是,总会;宁愿
words.example:
He said he would see his brother tomorrow.  他说明天要去见他的兄弟。
They knew there would be trouble unless the report was finished by the next day.  他们知道，除非第二天能完成报告，否则就有麻烦了。
We realised it wouldn't be easy to find another secretary.  我们意识到再找一位秘书不会很容易。

words.meaning: pron.[she的宾格]她;[she的所有格]她的
words.example:
If your sister's around, bring her too.  如果你姐姐在，带她一起来。
I'll see if Louisa will bring her guitar to the party.  我要看看路易莎是否会把她的吉他带到派对上。
The boat sank with all her crew.  那艘船和她的船员一起沉了。

words.meaning: a.全部的;非常的 ad.完全地,很 pron.全部
words.example:
All animals have to eat in order to live.  所有动物都必须吃东西才能生存。
She's got four children, all under the age of five.  她有四个孩子，都不到五岁。
The cast all lined up on stage to take their bow.  全体演员都在台上站成一排向观众鞠躬。

words.meaning: pron.(I的所有格)我的
words.example:
It wasn't my fault.  这不是我的错。
formal She was rather surprised at my asking (= that I asked) for the book to be returned.  我要她还书她感到相当惊讶。
It was my own decision.  那是我自己的决定。

words.meaning: n.(产品)来源,制法 vt.制造,做成,准备
words.example:
Shall I make some coffee?  我煮些咖啡好吗？
He'd made a chocolate cake.  他做了一个巧克力蛋糕。
She makes all her own clothes.  她所有的衣服都是自己做的。

words.meaning: ad.在周围;大约 prep.关于;在周围 a.准备
words.example:
What's that book about?  这本书是关于甚么的？
We were talking/laughing about Sophie.  我们正谈论 ／ 嘲笑索菲。
He's always (going) on about what a great job he's got.  他总是喋喋不休地炫耀他的工作有多么好。

words.meaning: vt.知道,了解;认识;识别 vi.知道,了解
words.example:
She knows the name of every kid in the school.  她知道学校里每个孩子的名字。
She knew (= was aware) (that) something was wrong.  她知道出错了。
formal The authorities know him to be (= know that he is) a cocaine dealer.  当局知道他是个海洛因贩子。

words.meaning: aux./v. 将;会;愿意 n.意志;决心;愿望
words.example:
Clare will be five years old next month.  下个月克莱尔就五岁了。
The train leaves at 8.58, so we'll be in Scotland by lunchtime.  火车8：58发车，所以我们中午前就能到苏格兰了。
I'll see him tomorrow./I'll be seeing him tomorrow.  我明天要见他。

words.meaning: ad.向上,...起来;...完;起床 prep.向上
words.example:
Put those books up on the top shelf.  把那些书放到书架顶层。
Pushing the number of unit sales up every quarter can't be continued indefinitely.  单位销售数位每个季度都增长的趋势不可能无限期持续下去。
The water was up to /had come up to the level of the windows.  水已经涨到窗户那么高了。

words.meaning: num.一 pron.一个(只)(表示代替可数的东西)
words.example:
You've got three bags and I've only got one.  你有3个袋子，我只有1个。
She'll be one year old tomorrow.  明天她就一岁了。
Americans drive one third of the 400 million cars on the planet.  这个星球上4亿辆汽车中有1/3是美国人驾驶的。

words.meaning: n.时间,时刻;次,回;时代,时期;倍,乘
words.example:
He wants to spend more time with his family.  他想多花时间陪家人。
Time passes so quickly when you're enjoying yourself.  玩得高兴时，时间过得特别快。
She grew more and more fascinated by the subject as time went on/by.  随着时间推移，她对这学科越来越着迷。

words.meaning: ad.在那儿;往那儿;[作引导词表示""存在""]
words.example:
Put the chair there.  把椅子放在那里。
The museum is closed today. We'll go there tomorrow.  博物馆今天关门了，我们明天再去。
There's that book you were looking for.  你要找的那本书在那里。

words.meaning: n.年,年度,学年 a./ad.每年,一年一次
words.example:
Annette worked in Italy for two years.  安妮特在义大利工作了两年。
We went to Egypt on holiday last year.  我们去年到埃及渡假。
At this time of year the beaches are almost deserted.  一年之中的这个时候，海滩几乎空寂无人。

words.meaning: ad.那么;非常;也;不错 conj.因此;以便
words.example:
The house is so beautiful.  这房子太漂亮了！
Thank you for being so patient.  谢谢你这么耐心。
Don't be so stupid!  不要这么傻了！

words.meaning: v.想,思索;认为,以为;想要;料想,预料
words.example:
What did you think of the film?  你觉得这部电影怎么样？
What do you think about this latest government scheme?  你觉得政府的这个最新计划怎么样？
I'm thinking about buying a new car.  我在考虑买辆新车。

words.meaning: ad./pron.何时;当时 conj.那时;然后;而
words.example:
When are you going?  你甚么时候走？
When's the baby due?  婴儿会在甚么时候出生？
We'll go when you're ready.  你准备好了，我们就出发。

words.meaning: a./pron.哪个,哪些;什么样的;那个,那些
words.example:
Which party would you prefer to go to - Anna's or Ian's ?  你更想去哪个聚会——安娜的还是伊恩的？
Which doctor did you see - Sewards?  你看的是哪一位医生——西沃兹医生吗？
Which time suits you better - 12.30 or one o'clock?  哪个时间你更方便——12点半还是1点？

words.meaning: pron.他们/她们/它们(they的宾格形式)
words.example:
I've lost my keys. I can't find them anywhere.  我丢了锁匙，到处都找不着。
It's them. They've arrived early.  是他们，他们来得早。
When each passenger arrives, we ask them to fill in a form.  每位旅客到达后，我们请他们填表。pronoun]strong form Dem /    /weak form Dəm]

words.meaning: a.几个;一些;有些;某(人或物) pron.一些
words.example:
There's some cake in the kitchen if you'd like it.  想吃蛋糕的话，厨房有一些。
Here's some news you might be interested in.  这里有些消息，或许你会感兴趣。
We've been having some problems with our TV over the last few weeks.  最近几周我们的电视一直有些问题。

words.meaning: pron.[I 的宾格]我
words.example:
Is there one for me?  有我的一份吗？
She gave me some money.  她给了我一些钱。
Could you pass me that book?  你能把那本书递给我吗？

words.meaning: n.人们,人;[the-]人民;一国人民,民族
words.example:
Many people never take any exercise.  许多人从来不做任何运动。
We've invited thirty people to our party.  我们邀请了30个人来参加聚会。
People will think you've gone mad.  人们会以为你疯了。

words.meaning: v.拿取;吃;记录;取得;花费;捕获;认为
words.example:
Has anything been taken (= stolen) ?  丢了甚么东西吗？
Here's your pen, I took it by mistake.  你的笔在这里，我拿错了。
All possessions had been taken from her.  她所有财产都被剥夺了。

words.meaning: ad.出去;离家;突出来 a.外面的,往外去的
words.example:
She opened the window and stuck her head out.  她打开窗户，将头探了出去。
The bag burst and the apples fell out.  袋子裂开了，苹果掉了出来。
He leaned out the window.  他将身子探出窗外。

words.meaning: prep.到...里面,进入;成为(表示变化)
words.example:
Would you put the jar back into the cupboard for me, please?  请帮我把罐子放回碗橱里，好吗？
Shall we go into the garden?  我们去花园好吗？
Stop running around and get into bed!  别乱跑了，快上床！

words.meaning: ad.正好地;刚才;只不过 a.公正的,公平的
words.example:
I'll just finish this, then we can go.  我马上就做完了，然后我们就能走了。
He'd just got into the bath when the phone rang.  他刚进浴室电话就响了。
The children arrived at school just as (= at the same moment as) the bell was ringing.  孩子刚好在铃响时到达学校。

words.meaning: vt.看见;会面;探望;知道,获悉;送行
words.example:
Turn the light on so I can see.  打开灯，这样我才看得到。
See (= Look at) p. 23 for prices and flight details.  票价与航班的具体详情请见第23页。
See over (= Look at the next page) for further information.  更多资讯见下一页。

words.meaning: pron.他(he的宾格形式)
words.example:
If you see Kevin give him my love.  如果你见到凯文，替我向他问好。
What's Terry up to - I haven't seen him for ages.  泰瑞在捣甚么鬼？我好久没见到他了。
Why don't you give him his present?  你为甚么不把他的礼物给他呢？

words.meaning: pron.[you的所有格]你的,你们的
words.example:
Is this your bag?  这是你的袋子吗？
It's not your fault.  这不是你的错。
Your mother is driving me crazy.  你母亲快把我逼疯了。

words.meaning: v.来;出现于,产生;是,成为;开始,终于
words.example:
Are you coming with me?  你跟我来吗？
There's a car coming!  来了辆轿车！
Can you come to my party?  你能来参加我的聚会吗？

words.meaning: v.aux.(口语)(表示许可或请求)可以...,行
words.example:
When I was younger I could stay up all night and not get tired.  我年轻时，一通宵不睡觉都不觉得累。
It was so noisy that we couldn't hear ourselves speak.  太吵了，我们连自己说话都听不见。
You said we could watch television when we've finished our homework.  你说过我们完成功课后可以看电视。

words.meaning: ad.现在,如今,目前;当时,于是,然后
words.example:
She used to be a teacher, but now she works in publishing.  她过去曾是一名教师，但现在从事出版工作。
Many people now own a video recorder.  如今许多人都有录影机。
She's been a vegetarian for ten years now.  她吃素已经十年了。

words.meaning: conj.(用于形容词,副词的比较级之后)比
words.example:
My son is a lot taller than my daughter.  我的儿子比女儿高得多。
You always walk faster than I do!  你总是走得比我快！
You're earlier than usual.  你比平时早。

words.meaning: v.喜欢 prep.象;比如 a.相象的 n.象…一样
words.example:
Do you like fish?  你爱吃鱼吗？
He's very well- liked (= popular) at work.  他在单位里人缘相当好。
I'd like to go to Moscow.  我想去莫斯科。

words.meaning: a.另外的,其他的 n./pron.另一个人(或事)
words.example:
The product has many other time-saving features.  该产品还有许多其他的省时特性。
There is no other work available at the moment.  目前没有其他的工作了。
There is only one other person who could help us.  只有另外一个人可以帮助我们。

words.meaning: ad.1.(表示方法、手段、状态)怎样;如何
words.example:
How do we get to the town from here?  我们怎么从这里去城里？
How did you hear about the concert?  你是怎么知道这场音乐会的？
How does this machine work?  这台机器如何运作？

words.meaning: ad.当时,在那时;然后,于是;那么,因而
words.example:
formal I wanted to live in the city, but my then husband (= the man who was my husband at that time) preferred the country.  我希望住在城里，但我当时的丈夫想住在乡下。
Give it to me next week - I won't have time to read it before/until then.  下周给我吧——我只有到那时才有时间看。
I'll phone you tomorrow - I should have the details by then.  我明天会给你打电话，到那时我应该知道详情了。adverb [before noun] adjective

words.meaning: pron.[it的所有格]它的
words.example:
The dog hurt its paw.  狗的爪子受伤了。
Their house has its own swimming pool.  他们的房子里有游泳池。
The company increased its profits.  公司的利润增加了。

words.meaning: pron.[we的所有格]我们的
words.example:
We bought our house several years ago.  我们的房子是几年前买的。
He walked off and left us on our own.  他拂袖而去，丢下我们不管。
Drugs are one of the greatest threats in our society.  毒品是对我们社会最大的威胁之一。

words.meaning: a.更多的 n.更多的人(或东西) ad.更,更多
words.example:
Would you like some more food?  你想再要些吃的吗？
The doctors can't cope with any more patients.  医生无法收治更多的病人了。
Add some more cream to the sauce.  在酱汁里多加点奶油。

words.meaning: pron.&a.[this的复数]这些;这些人(东西)
words.example: These shoes are too small.  这双鞋太小了。

words.meaning: vt.想要;希望;需要;缺,缺少 n.需要;短缺
words.example:
She wants a word with you.  她想跟你说句话。
He's everything you'd ever want in a man - bright, funny and attractive.  他具备你理想中男人的所有特质——聪明、风趣而又有魅力。
You wait - by next year she'll be wanting a bigger house!  你等着瞧——明年她就会想要一所更大的房子了！    Compare like

words.meaning: n.道路,路程;方法/式,手段;习惯;状态
words.example:
Do you know the way to the train station?  你知道去火车站怎么走吗？
I've only been living in Madrid for a couple of weeks so I don't really know my way around it yet.  我只在马德里住了几个星期，所以还不太认识周围的路。
We'll have to stop for fuel on the way to the airport.  我们将不得不在去机场的路上停下来加油。

words.meaning: vi./n.看,注视 v.好像,显得 n.外表,脸色
words.example:
Look! There's grandma.  看！祖母在那里。
They looked at the picture and laughed.  他们看了看那幅画，笑了起来
Look at all this rubbish on the floor.  瞧瞧地上这些垃圾。

words.meaning: ad.而且(也),此外(还);同样地
words.example:
She's a photographer and also writes books.  她是个摄影师，还是个作家。
I'm cold, and I'm also hungry and tired.  我很冷，而且又饿又累。UK adverb

words.meaning: a.新(近)的;新来的;不熟悉的;没经验的
words.example:
She's very creative and always coming up with new ideas.  她极富创造力，总会想出新主意。
What have they decided to call their new baby?  他们决定给刚出生的婴儿起甚么名字？
What's new in the fashion world?  时尚界有甚么新潮流？

words.meaning: conj.因为,由于
words.example:
"Why did you do it?" "Because Carlos told me to".  “你为甚么做出这事？”“因为卡洛斯叫我去做的。”
We can't go to Julia's party because we're going away that weekend.  我们不能参加朱莉娅的聚会，因为那个周末我们要外出。
Just because I'm lending you my dress for tonight doesn't mean you can borrow it whenever you want to.  我今晚把裙子借给你，但并不意味着你任何时候想借就可以借的。

words.meaning: n.天,一昼夜;白昼,白天;时期,时代
words.example:
January has 31 days.  一月份有31天。
He runs five miles every day.  他每天跑5英里。
It took us almost a day to get here.  我们花了几乎一天的时间才到这里。

words.meaning: vt.用；耗费 n.用
words.example:
This glass has been used - please fetch me a clean one.  这个杯子用过了——请给我拿一个干净的来。
Going on the expedition gives me a chance to use all the training I've had.  出去探险让我有机会把我所接受的训练付诸实践。
The old hospital isn't used anymore.  这家老旧的医院已经没有在用了。

words.meaning: ad.不是,不 a.没有的;不允许 n.不,拒绝
words.example:
There's no butter left.  没有奶油了。
There are no pockets in these trousers.  这些裤子没有裤袋。
That's my kind of holiday - no telephone, no TV and no worries.  那是我的渡假方式——没有电话，没有电视，也没有烦恼。

words.meaning: n.(pl.men)人;人类(单数,不加冠词);男人
words.example:
Steve can solve anything - the man's a genius.  史蒂夫甚么疑难都解决得到——此人是个天才。
The gas company said they would send some men to fix the heating system.  煤气公司说会派人来修暖气。
The man from the BBC wrote some positive things about the film.  英国广播公司的人对影片作了正面的评价。

words.meaning: v.(found,found)找到;发现;发觉;感到
words.example:
I've just found a ten-pound note in my pocket.  我刚在口袋里找到了一张十英镑的钞票。
You'll find the knives and forks in the left-hand drawer.  你会发现刀叉在左手边的抽屉里。
Researchers are hoping to find a cure for the disease.  研究人员希望能找到治愈这种疾病的方法。

words.meaning: ad.在(到,向)这里;这时;在这一点上
words.example:
I've lived here for about two years.  我在这里住了大约两年。
London is only 50 miles from here.  伦敦离这里只有50英哩。
Come here - I've got something to show you.  过来——我给你看些东西。

words.meaning: n.物,东西;事,事情;所有物;局面,情况
words.example:
What's that thing over there?  那边的是甚么东西？
There are some nice things in the shops this summer.  今年夏天商店里有些好东西。
How does this damn thing work?  这鬼东西怎么用？

words.meaning: v.给,授予;供给;献出,让步;捐赠;发表
words.example:
Can you give me a date for another appointment?  我能再和您约时间见面吗？
They never gave me a chance/choice.  他们从来就没给过我机会／选择余地。
Has the director given you permission to do that?  主任允许你那样做吗？

words.meaning: a.许多的,多的 pron.许多人或物,许多
words.example:
Not many people have heard of him.  听说过他的人不多。
There are n't very many weekends between now and Christmas.  现在到圣诞节间没有多少个周末了。
Were there many cars on the road?  路上车多吗？

words.meaning: ad.好,令人满意地;很 int.哎呀,好啦,嗯
words.example:
The documentary presented both sides of the problem very well.  这部纪录片很好地呈现了问题的两个方面。
The concert was well enough advertised but ticket sales were poor.  这场音乐会的宣传做得很不错，但是票房却不好。
Her points were well put (= expressed in a good or clever way).  她的观点表达得很巧妙。

words.meaning: ad.仅仅,只不过 a.唯一的 conj.可是,不过
words.example:
Is this really the only way to do it?  这真的是做这件事唯一的方法吗？
The only thing that matters is that the baby is healthy.  唯一要紧的是婴儿身体健康。
It was the only thing I could do under the circumstances.  在这种情况下，这是我唯一能够做的。

words.meaning: pron./a.[that的复数]那些;那些人(东西)
words.example: Those birds migrate south in winter.  那些鸟冬天南迁。

words.meaning: vt.告诉,讲述;告诫;吩咐,命令;辨/区别
words.example: He gave me a good telling-off for forgetting the meeting.  由于忘了会议，我被他狠狠地训了一顿。 (told, told)

words.meaning: ad.很；完全 a.真的
words.example:
The situation is very serious.  形势非常严峻。
We're very, very sorry about what's happened.  对所发生的事我们感到非常难过。
Think about it very carefully before deciding.  作决定之前要仔细考虑。

words.meaning: ad.甚至(更) a.均匀的;平的;相等的;偶数的
words.example:
Everyone I know likes the smell of bacon - even Mike does and he's a vegetarian.  我认识的所有人都喜欢培根的味道——即使麦克也不例外，他可是个素食主义者呀。
We were all on time - even Chris and he's usually late for everything.  我们都准时到达——就连平时做事一向拖拖拉拉的克利斯都没迟到。
It's a very difficult job - it might even take a year to finish it.  这是项非常艰巨的工作——甚至可能要花一年时间才能完成。

words.meaning: a.后面的 ad.向后 v.倒退;支持 n.背;后面
words.example:
When you take the scissors, remember to put them back.  用完剪刀后，记着要放回原处。
He left a note saying 'Gone out. Back soon'.  他留了字条，上面写著「出去一会儿，马上回来”。
She went to America for two years, but now she's back (= has returned).  她在美国住了两年，现在回来了。

words.meaning: a.(用于否定句、疑问句等)什么,一些;任何的
words.example:
Is there any of that lemon cake left?  柠檬蛋糕有没有剩下一点啊？
There was hardly any food left by the time we got there.  我们到那里的时候，几乎一点吃的都没了。
Are you sure there isn't any way of solving this problem?  你肯定这问题没有任何解决办法了？determiner pronoun

words.meaning: a.好的;善良的;擅长的;乖的 n.好处;利益
words.example:
Did you have a good time at the party?  你在派对上玩得开心吗？
The weather has been really good for the time of year.  就这个季节而言，这段时间的天气真是难得的好。
I've just had some very good news.  我刚得知一些令人特别开心的消息。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)women妇女,成年女子
words.example:
She's a really nice woman.  她真是个非常好的女人。
Women first got the vote in Britain in 1918.  在英国，妇女于1918年首次取得投票权。
She is Ireland's first woman (= female) president.  她是爱尔兰的第一位女总统。

words.meaning: prep./ad.穿过;自始至终;由,以 a.直达的
words.example:
They walked slowly through the woods.  他们缓步穿过树林。
The boy waded through the water to reach his boat.  男孩涉水来到他的船上。
He struggled through the crowd till he reached the front.  他挤过人群来到前面。

words.meaning: n.生命,生存;一生,寿命;生活;生物
words.example:
Life's too short to worry about money!  人生短暂，何必为金钱而烦恼！
I'm not sure I want to spend the rest of my life with him.  我不能肯定自己是否愿意与他共度余生。
Unfortunately, accidents are part of life.  不幸的是，意外事故也是生活的一部分。

words.meaning: n.( [pl.] children)小孩,儿童,儿女
words.example:
As a child I didn't eat vegetables.  我小时候不爱吃蔬菜。
Both her children are now married with children of their own.  她的两个孩子都结了婚，有了自己的孩子。
Jan is married with three young children.  简已婚，有三个孩子。

words.meaning: n.工作(量);作品;[pl.]工厂 v.工作;运转
words.example:
I've got so much work to do.  我有一大堆工作要做。
Carrying heavy loads around all day is hard work.  整天来回运送重物是件苦事。
What time do you start/finish work?  你甚么时间开始／完成工作?

words.meaning: ad.下;由大到小 prep.沿着…而下 a.向下的
words.example:
Is this UKlift/ USelevator going down?  这部电梯是向下开的吗？
Don't look down! You'll get dizzy.  别朝下看！你会头晕的。
The sun's going down and it'll be dark soon.  太阳要落下去了，天很快就要黑了。

words.meaning: aux.v.可能,也许;可以,被允许;祝,愿
words.example:
My mother's birthday is in May.  我母亲的生日是在五月。
There may be other problems that we don't know about.  可能有我们不知道的其他问题。
The cause of the accident may never be discovered.  意外的起因也许永远无法查清。

words.meaning: prep.在...以后;在...后面 adv.以后,后来
words.example:
Shall we go for a walk after breakfast?  我们吃过早餐去散步好吗？
Some people believe in life after death.  一些人相信死后灵魂依然存在。
Her name came after mine on the list.  名单上她的名字排在我后面。

words.meaning: aux.v.应该;万一;可能,该;就;竟然会
words.example:
If you're annoyed with him, you should tell him.  如果你生他的气，就应该告诉他。
You should change trains at Peterborough if you're going to Newcastle.  如果你要去纽卡素，就应该在彼得伯勒换车。
You should be ashamed of yourselves.  你应该为自己感到羞耻。

words.meaning: vt.叫,喊;打电话 vi.叫;访问 n.叫;号召
words.example:
They've called the twins Katherine and Thomas.  他们给双胞胎取名为凯萨琳和汤玛斯。
What's that actor called that we saw in the film last night?  我们昨晚在电影里看到的那个演员叫甚么名字？
His real name is Jonathan, but they've always called him 'Johnny'.  他的真名叫乔纳森，但他们总是叫他“强尼”。

words.meaning: n.世界,地球;…界,领域;世间;全世界
words.example:
Different parts of the world have very different climatic conditions.  世界上不同地区的气候状况大不相同。
Which bridge has the longest span in the world?  世界上哪座桥的跨度最大？
News of the disaster shocked the (whole/entire) world.  关于那场灾难的消息震惊了（整个）世界。

words.meaning: ad.在上方;遍及地 prep.在的上方 a.结束的
words.example:
The sign over the door said "Exit".  门上方的牌子上写著「出口”。
She held the umbrella over both of us.  她给我们两人都撑着伞。
Helicopters dropped leaflets over the city.  直升机在城市上空散发传单。

words.meaning: n.学校,(大学里的)学院;上学,学业;学派
words.example:
They're building a new school in the village.  他们正在村里建一座新学校。
She drives the kids to school every morning.  她每天早上开车送孩子上学。
Is Emily in school today or is she still ill?  艾蜜莉今天上学了吗？还是病还没好？

words.meaning: a.静止的,寂静的 ad.还,仍然;更;安静地
words.example:
I'm still hungry.  我还是很饿。
There is still no news about the hostages.  仍旧没有人质的消息。
Do you still work for the government?  你还在为政府工作吗？

words.meaning: v.尝试,试图;试验,试用;审讯 n.尝试
words.example:
Keep trying and you'll find a job eventually.  不断努力，你最终会找到工作的。
If I don't get into the academy this year, I'll try again next year.  如果今年进不了这所专科学校，我明年还会努力。
I've tried really hard but I can't persuade him to come.  尽管我很努力劝他，但他就是不来。

words.meaning: a.最后的,刚过去的 ad.最后 n.最后 v.持续
words.example:
Our house is the last one on the left before the traffic lights.  我们家是交通信号灯前左侧的最后一家。
The Mets will surely finish the season in last place (= at the lowest rank of their division).  梅茨队本赛季肯定要垫底了。
At the last moment (= as late as possible) he changed his mind.  在最后一刻他改了主意。

words.meaning: vt.问,询问;请求,要求;邀请,约请
words.example:
Can I ask you a favour?/ formalCan I ask a favour of you?  你可以帮我一个忙吗？
She asked a question about Welsh history.  她问了一个关于威尔士历史的问题。
She asked me about Welsh history.  她问我有关威尔士历史的问题。

words.meaning: aux.v./v.需要;必须 n.需要;贫困,困窘
words.example:
Babies need constant care.  婴儿时刻都需要人照顾。
The doctor said I needed an operation.  医生说我需要动手术。
Most people need to feel loved.  大多数人都需要有被爱的感觉。

words.meaning: ad.也,还;太,过于;很,非常
words.example:
I'm too fat.  我太胖了。
There were (far) too many people for such a small room.  这么小的房间人太多了。
It's too difficult (for me) to explain.  这太难了，（我）无法解释。

words.meaning: v.触;认为 vi.摸上去有…感觉;摸索;觉得
words.example:
How would you feel about moving to a different city?  你觉得搬到另一座城市去怎么样？
He's still feeling a bit weak after his operation.  手术后他仍感觉有点虚弱。
My eyes feel really sore.  我的眼睛真的很痛。

words.meaning: n.状态,情况;国,州 v.陈述,说明
words.example:
The building was in a state of disrepair.  这栋大楼年久失修。
She was found wandering in a confused state (of mind).  有人发现她到处游荡，神智恍惚。
Give me the keys - you're in no fit state to drive.  把锁匙给我——你状态不佳，不能开车。

words.meaning: ad.永不,从不,决不;从来没有;不,没有
words.example:
We've never been to Australia.  我们从未去过澳大利亚。
I've never heard anything so ridiculous.  我从没听过如此荒谬的事情。
Let us never forget those who gave their lives for their country.  让我们永远记住那些为国捐躯的人。

words.meaning: vi.变成,开始变得vt.适合,同…相称
words.example:
It was becoming cold, so we lit the fire.  天气越来越冷了，所以我们燃起了火。
After giving up smoking, he became fat and irritable.  戒烟后，他发福了，而且很爱发火。
Margaret Thatcher became Britain's first woman prime minister in 1979.  玛格丽特‧戴卓尔在1979年成为英国第一位女首相。

words.meaning: prep.在…之间,在(两者)之间 ad.在中间
words.example:
The town lies halfway between Rome and Florence.  这城镇位于罗马和佛罗伦斯的中间。
Standing between the two adults was a small child.  站在两个大人之间的是个小孩。
She squeezed between the parked cars and ran out into the road.  她在停泊的车子间挤来挤去，最后跑到马路上。

words.meaning: a.高的,高度的,高级的,高尚的 ad.高高地
words.example:
It's two and a half metres high and one metre wide.  它有两公尺半高，一公尺宽。
The corn grew waist-high (= as high as a person's waist) in the fields.  田里的玉米长到了及腰的高度。adjective
The job demands a high level of concentration.  这项工作需要高度集中精神

words.meaning: ad.确实,实在,真正地,果然
words.example:
He isn't really angry - he's just pretending.  他不是真生气——他只是假装的。
You don't really expect them to refuse, do you?  你实际上并没料到他们会拒绝，是不是？
Thank you, but I really couldn't eat another thing.  多谢，但是我真的甚么也吃不下了。

words.meaning: pron.某事,某物;被视为有意义的事物
words.example:
There's something sharp in my shoe.  我的鞋子里有个尖物。
Something in the cupboard smells odd.  碗柜里甚么东西有股怪味。
We thought there must be something wrong because we hadn't heard from you.  我们失去你的消息，还以为出了甚么事呢。

words.meaning: a.另一个,又,再 pron.另一个,类似的一个
words.example:
I'm going to have another piece of cake.  我要再吃块蛋糕。
We can fit another person in my car.  我车里还可以再坐一个人。
Danny's had yet another car accident.  丹尼又出交通意外了。

words.meaning: a.多的,大量的 ad.十分,非常;到极大程度
words.example:
You haven't said much, Joan - what do you think?  你说得不多，琼——你怎么想？
The children never eat (very) much, but they seem quite healthy.  孩子都吃得不多，但他们看来很健康。
There's not/nothing much to do around here.  这里没太多事可以做。

words.meaning: n.家,家庭成员;氏族,家庭;族,科
words.example:
He hasn't any family.  他无亲无故。
He's American but his family (= relatives in the past) come/comes from Ireland.  他是美国人，但他的祖籍是爱尔兰。
This film is good family entertainment (= something that can be enjoyed by parents and children together).  这部电影是很棒的家庭娱乐片。

words.meaning: a.(用在所有格后面,加强语气)自己的
words.example:
Each neighbourhood in New York has its own characteristics.  纽约的每个居民区都有自己的特点。
I'd like to have my very own apartment.  我想有自己的公寓。
He wanted an apartment of his own.  他想要一套属于自己的公寓。

words.meaning: v.离开;留下,忘带;让,听任;交付n.许可;假期
words.example:
I'll be leaving at five o'clock tomorrow.  我明天早晨五点钟离开。
He left the house by the back door.  他从房子的后门离开了。
She left the group of people she was with and came over to speak to us.  她离开了人群，走过来和我们说话。

words.meaning: vt.放,搁,置;表达;使处于...状态,记下
words.example:
Where have you put the keys?  你把锁匙放在哪了？
Put your clothes in the cupboard.  把你的衣服放在衣橱里。
He put salt into the sugar bowl by mistake.  他把盐误放在糖罐里。

words.meaning: a.年老的;…岁的;长时间的,老的;过去的
words.example:
We're all getting older.  我们都老了。
Now come on, you're old enough to tie your own shoelaces, Carlo.  好，来吧，卡洛尔，你那么大了，该自己系鞋带了。
I'm too old to be out clubbing every night.  我年纪不小了，不能每晚都在夜总会里胡混。

words.meaning: conj.当…的时候;而;虽然;尽管 n.一会儿
words.example:
While I was in Italy I went to see Alessandro.  在义大利的时候，我去看望了亚历山德罗。
While I accept that he's not perfect in many respects, I do actually quite like the man.  虽然我承认他在很多方面不是那么完美，但我实际上还是非常喜欢这个男人。
While I fully understand your point of view, I do also have some sympathy with Michael's.  尽管我能完全理解你的观点，但我在一定程度上也赞同麦克的观点。conjunction

words.meaning: v.表示…的意思 a.卑鄙的;平均的n.平均值
words.example:
What does this word mean?  这个词是甚么意思？
What do you mean by that remark?  你那句话是甚么意思？
She's quite odd though. Do you know what I mean?  可是她有点怪。你明白我指甚么吗？

words.meaning: v.保持,保存,遵守,经营,看守,拘留,维持
words.example:
Do you want this photograph back or can I keep it?  你想要回这张照片，还是我留着它？
Keep medicines in a locked cupboard (= Store them there).  将药存放在上锁的橱柜里。
My uncle kept a little tobacconist's in Gloucester.  我叔叔在格洛斯特开了一家小烟草店。

words.meaning: n.(大中学校的)学生;研究者,学者
words.example:
He was a student at the University of Chicago.  他是芝加哥大学的学生。
When you're a nurse, you get to be a bit of a student of (= to know about) human nature.  当护士的，一定得对人性有一点认识。

words.meaning: ad./conj.为什么;…的理由 int.咳,哎呀
words.example:
Why did you choose to live in London?  你为甚么选择在伦敦生活？
Why wait? Let's leave now.  为甚么要等？我们现在就走吧。
Why should I help him - he never helps me?  我为甚么要帮他——他从来都没帮过我？

words.meaning: v.让,允许,听任;设,假设;出租,租给
words.example:
She wanted to go but her parents wouldn't let her.  她想走，但父母不让。
He decided to let his hair grow long.  他决定把头发留起来。
Let your shoes dry completely before putting them on.  让鞋子干透以后再穿。

words.meaning: a.伟大的;重要的;大量的;很好的;美好的
words.example:
The improvement in water standards over the last 50 years has been very great.  过去50年，水质有了很大的提高。
The great majority of (= Almost all) people would agree.  绝大多数人都会表示赞同。
formal It gives us great pleasure to announce the engagement of our daughter Maria.  我们非常高兴地宣布我们的女儿玛利亚订婚了。

words.meaning: a.相同的 pron.相同的人(或物) ad.同样地
words.example:
My twin sister and I have got the same nose.  我孪生姐姐的鼻子和我的长得一样。
She was wearing exactly the same dress as I was.  她穿的裙子和我的一模一样。
Hilary's the same age as me.  希拉蕊和我同龄。

words.meaning: a.大的;重要的;宽宏大量的;大受欢迎的
words.example:
He's a big man.  他是个身材高大的人。
Could I try these shoes in a bigger size?  这双鞋我能试一双大一点的吗？
They've got a big house in the country.  他们在乡下有一幢大房子。

words.meaning: n.群,组 v.分组
words.example:
I'm meeting a group of friends for dinner tonight.  今晚我要与一班朋友聚餐。
The car was parked near a small group of trees.  汽车停在一片小树林附近。
She showed me another group of pictures, this time of children playing.  她又给我看了另外一组照片，这次是小朋友玩耍的情景。noun

words.meaning: v.(began,begun)开始,着手
words.example:
What time does the concert begin?  音乐会甚么时候开始？
The bridge was begun five years ago and the estimated cost has already doubled.  这座桥五年前开始建造，到现在为止估计成本已经增加了一倍。
The film they want to watch begins at seven.  他们要看的电影在七点开场。

words.meaning: v.好像,似乎
words.example:
He's 16, but he often seems (to be) younger.  他16岁了，但往往看起来小一点。
The children seemed (as if/as though/like they were) tired.  孩子们好像累了。
Things are seldom as/how/what they seem.  事情很少表里一致。

words.meaning: n.国家;农村,乡下
words.example:
Which is the largest country in Europe?  欧洲最大的国家是哪个？
Sri Lanka is my native country, but I've been living in Belgium for the past five years.  斯里兰卡是我的祖国，但最近五年我一直住在比利时。
The climate is cooler in the east of the country.  该国东部气候比较凉爽。

words.meaning: v.帮(援)助;有助于;[呼救]救命n.帮助(手)
words.example:
How can I help you?  我如何才能帮你呢？
My dad said he would help with the costs of (= give part of the cost of) buying a house.  我爸爸说他会资助我们买一栋房子。
Nothing can help her now (= Her situation is too bad for anyone to be able to improve it).  现在没人能帮得了她。

words.meaning: n.谈话;聊天;讲话;演讲 v.说话;交谈
words.example:
We were just talking about Simon's new girlfriend.  我们刚才在谈论赛门的新女友。
My little girl has just started to talk.  我的小女儿刚开始说话。
She talks to her mother on the phone every week.  她每周都跟母亲通电话。

words.meaning: ad.在哪/那里 conj./pron.哪里 conj.然而
words.example:
Where does he live?  他住在哪里？
Where are we going?  我们要去哪里？
Now where did I put my glasses?  我把眼镜放在哪里了？

words.meaning: v./n.(使)转动;(使)旋转;(使)转变 n.机会
words.example:
The Earth turns on its axis once every 24 hours.  地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。
She turned on her toes, holding out her skirt.  她拎起裙摆踮着脚尖旋转。
The wheels started to turn (round).  轮子开始转动了。

words.meaning: n.问题,疑难问题;思考题,讨论题
words.example:
Our main problem is lack of cash.  我们的主要问题是缺乏现金。
I'm having problems with my computer.  我的电脑出了故障。
No one has solved the problem of what to do with radioactive waste.  还没有人能解决如何处理放射性废物这个难题。

words.meaning: a.每一个的,每个的;每隔…的;全部的
words.example:
The police want to interview every employee about the theft.  警方想就窃盗案件与每位员工面谈。
The show will be broadcast every weekday morning between 9 and 10.  这个节目将在星期一至五每日早上九点到十点播出。
We're open every day except Sunday.  除了星期日， 我们每天都开门营业。

words.meaning: v.开始;动身;吃惊;开办,开动 n.开端;惊起
words.example:
When do you start your course/your new job?  你甚么时候开始你的课程／新工作？
We'll be starting (the session) at six o'clock.  我们将在六点钟开始（议程）。
Can you start (= begin a new job) on Monday?  星期一你能开始工作吗？

words.meaning: n.手,人手,雇员;专门业人员;指针 v.交
words.example:
All their toys are made by hand.  他们所有的玩具都是手工制作的。
informal Get your hands off (= Stop touching) my bike!  别碰我的脚踏车！
He can mend anything - he's so good with his hands.  他甚么都会修——他的手可真巧。

words.meaning: aux.v.可能,也许 n.力量,威力,权力
words.example:
Very politely the little boy asked if he might have another piece of cake (= he said "May I have another piece of cake, please?").  小男孩非常礼貌地问可否再吃一块蛋糕。modal verb
Don't go any closer - it might be dangerous/it mightn't be safe.  别再走近了——那可能很危险／不安全。
Driving so fast, he might have had a nasty accident (= it could have happened but it did not).  他开车开得那么快，早就可能出意外。

words.meaning: n.节目,表演 v.上演(戏剧等),放映(电影)
words.example:
On this map, urban areas are shown in grey.  在这张地图上，城区用灰色表示。
You ought to show that rash to your doctor.  你应该让医生看看那些疹子。
These photographs show the effects of the chemical on the trees.  这些照片显示了这种化学品对树木的影响。

words.meaning: n.部分,角色,一方,零件,地区,部,篇v.使分开
words.example:
Part of my steak isn't cooked properly.  我这块牛排有些部分没煮好。
Part of this form seems to be missing.  这份表格有一部分似乎缺失了。
The deadline for applications is being extended, in part because of the postal strike.  申请的最后期限延长了，部分原因是邮局发生了罢工。

words.meaning: prep.对着,逆;反对;违反;紧靠着;对比
words.example:
She spoke against the decision to close the college.  她声言反对关闭学院的决定。
Fifty people voted against the new proposal.  50人投票反对这项新提案。
I'm very much against the idea that it is the woman's job to bring up the child.  对于抚养孩子是女人的职责这个想法，我坚决反对。

words.meaning: n.地方;名次;地位;寓所 v.安排;放置;投(资)
words.example:
Her garden was a cool pleasant place to sit.  坐在她的花园里真是凉爽宜人。
What was the name of that place we drove through on the way to New York?  我们开车去纽约路上经过的那个地方叫甚么名字？
They decided to go to a pizza place.  他们决定去比萨店。

words.meaning: a.这样的;上述的ad.那么pron.这样的人/事物
words.example:
That's such a good film.  那部电影真不错。
It seems like such a long way to drive for just one day.  一天之内要开这么远的路好像不太可能。
Oh Richard, you're such an idiot!  噢，理查，你这个白痴！

words.meaning: ad.再次,另一次;重新;除此,再,更,还
words.example:
Could you spell your name again, please?  请您再拼一次您的名字好吗？
If he does it again I'll have to tell him.  如果他再这么做，我就不能不提醒他了。
Deborah's late again.  黛博拉又迟到了。

words.meaning: a.[表肯定]有些,几个;[表否定]几乎没有的
words.example:
There are a few cakes left over from the party.  派对上剩了一些蛋糕。
We've been having a few problems with the new computer.  我们使用这台新电脑后一直有一些问题。
If you can't fit all the cases in your car, I can take a few in mine.  如果你的车里装不下所有的箱子，可以在我的车里放几个。

words.meaning: n.箱,盒,容器;情况,事实;病例;案件
words.example:
Over a hundred people were injured, in several cases seriously.  一百多人受了伤，有几个伤势严重。
Jobs are hard to find but in his case that's not the problem because he has so much experience.  工作很难找，可对他而言不成问题，因为他经验非常丰富。
The number of new cases of the illness appears to be declining.  这种病症的新发病例数量呈下降趋势。

words.meaning: n.星期,周
words.example:
We go to the cinema about once a week.  我们大约一周去看一次电影。
Will you be going to next week's class?  你下周去上课吗？
It usually takes about four weeks to get the forms processed.  处理这些表格通常需要四周左右的时间。

words.meaning: n.公司;陪伴;宾客;连(队),(一)群,队,伙
words.example:
He works for a software company/a company that makes software.  他在一家软体公司工作。
No smoking is company policy.  禁止吸烟是公司的规定。
It was a long journey and I was grateful for his company.  旅途漫漫，我感谢有他作伴。

words.meaning: n.系统,体系;制度;方法,方式,步聚
words.example:
The system keeps crashing and no one is able to figure out why.  系统老是故障，谁也不知道是甚么原因。
We'll have to work out a proper filing system.  我们必须设计出一套适当的归档方法。
Under our education system, you're supposed to be able to choose the type of schooling that your child receives.  在我们的教育体制下，你应该可以为孩子选择出适当的学校教育。

words.meaning: a./pron.各,各自的,每
words.example:
When you run, each foot leaves the ground before the other comes down.  奔跑时，你的一只脚在另一只脚着地之前就离开了地面。
There are five leaflets - please take one of each.  有五种传单——请每样各拿一份。
Each of the companies supports a local charity.  这些公司都各自资助一个当地的慈善组织。

words.meaning: a.右的,正确的 n.右,权利ad.在右边,正确地
words.example:
You got three answers right and two wrong.  你答对了三道题，错了两道。
Am I right in thinking (= Is it true) that you will be at the conference?  你要去参加会议，是这么回事吧？
You're right to be annoyed - you've been treated very badly.  你生气是理所应当的——一直以来他们对你的态度都很差。

words.meaning: n.节目单；大纲；程序
words.example: She's written a program to find words which frequently occur together.  她设计了一个程式以便找到经常一起出现的词语。

words.meaning: v.听见;审讯;(from)收到..的信/电话;听说
words.example:
She heard a noise outside.  她听到外面一阵嘈杂。
My grandfather is getting old and can't hear very well.  我祖父上了年纪，耳朵听不太清楚。
You'll have to speak up, I can't hear you.  你得说大声点，我听不到你。

words.meaning: n.问题;询问 v.询问;怀疑,对…表示疑问
words.example:
The police asked me questions all day.  员警盘问了我一整天。
Why won't you answer my question?  你为甚么不回答我的问题？
There will be a question -and-answer session (= a period when people can ask questions) at the end of the talk.  演讲结束前有一段问答时间。

words.meaning: prep.在…期间
words.example:
They work during the night and sleep by day.  他们夜里工作，白天睡觉。
There were huge advances in aviation technology during World War Two.  在第二次世界大战期间航空技术有了长足的发展。    Compare whileUK preposition
The programme will be shown on television during the weekend.  这个节目将于周末在电视上播放。

words.meaning: v.玩,做游戏;参加比赛n.游戏;玩耍;剧本
words.example:
The children spent the afternoon playing in the garden.  孩子们下午在花园里玩耍。
My daughter used to play with the kids next door.  我女儿以前常跟隔壁的孩子们玩。verb
Do you want to play cards/football (with us)?  你想（和我们）打牌／踢球吗？

words.meaning: n.政府,内阁;管理,支配;政治,政体
words.example:
The government is/are expected to announce its/their tax proposals today.  预计今天政府会公布税收计划。
The minister has announced that there will be no change in government policy.  部长宣布政府政策将不会有任何改变。
Senior government officials will be attending a meeting tomorrow.  政府高级官员们明天将参加一个会议。

words.meaning: v.奔,跑;流,淌;蔓延,伸展;经营;运转
words.example:
The sheep ran away/off in fright.  羊受惊跑掉了。
Are you running against each other or against the clock?  你们打算怎么跑？是看谁先后，还是用表计时？
The first two races will be run (off) (= will happen) in 20 minutes.  头两个赛跑项目将在20分钟后举行。

words.meaning: a.小的;年幼的;不重要的;小规模(经营)的
words.example:
I'd rather live in a small town than a big city.  我宁愿住在小城镇，也不住在大城市。
Would you like a large or small cola with your burger?  你的汉堡包要配大可乐还是小可乐？
Ella is the smallest girl in her class.  艾拉是她班上个头最小的女孩。

words.meaning: n.数,数字,数量,号码,一群 v.共计,编号
words.example:
She's very good with numbers (= good at adding, subtracting, etc).  她非常擅长数字运算。
They live at number 34 Orchard Street.  他们住在果园街34号。
Please write your credit card number on this form.  请把你的信用卡号写在这张表格上。

words.meaning: ad.离开;在远处;脱开 prep.从,从...离开
words.example:
He drove off at the most incredible speed.  他以令人难以置信的速度开车走了。
Keep the dog on the lead or he'll just run off.  好好牵着狗，不然它就会跑掉的。
Someone's run off with (= taken) my pen.  有人拿走了我的钢笔。

words.meaning: ad.总是,无例外地;永远,始终
words.example:
It's always cold in this room.  这间屋里总是那么冷。
I've always liked him.  我一直都很喜欢他。
I'll always remember you.  我会永远记着你。

words.meaning: v.移动,迁移;活动;感动 n.移动,活动,行动
words.example:
I'm so cold I can't move my fingers.  我太冷了，手指都动不了了。
Will you help me move this table to the back room?  你能帮我把这张桌子搬到后面的房间里吗？
Can we move (= change the time of) the meeting from 2pm to 3.30pm?  我们能将会议时间由下午两点改到三点半吗？

words.meaning: v.活着,生活,居住 a.活的,生动的,直播的
words.example:
He only lived a few days after the accident.  出事后他只活了几天就死了。
Can the right to live ever be denied to any human?  人的生存权可以剥夺吗？
She lived on well into her nineties.  她一直活到了90多岁。verb[lɪv/

words.meaning: n.尖;点;条款;分数,得分;论点 v.(at,to)指
words.example:
I'd like to discuss the first point in your essay.  我想讨论一下你文章中的第一点。
You made some interesting points in your speech.  你发言中有些观点很有趣。
The point is, if you don't claim the money now you might never get it.  重要的是，如果你现在不索取这笔钱的话，你可能就再也得不到了。

words.meaning: vt.相信,认为 vi.相信,信任,信奉
words.example:
Strangely, no one believed us when we told them we'd been visited by a creature from Mars.  奇怪的是，当我们告诉他们曾有火星人来访时，居然没人相信。
She's arriving tomorrow, I believe.  我相信她明天会到的。
He told me she was just a friend, but I don't believe a word of it!  他告诉我，她只是普通朋友而已，但我根本就不信！

words.meaning: v.拿着;保有;托住;举行;继续 n.握住;船舱
words.example:
Can you hold the bag while I open the door?  我开门时，你能帮我拿一下提包吗？
He was holding a gun.  他当时正拿着一把枪。
The little girl held her mother's hand.  这个小女孩抓着妈妈的手。

words.meaning: ad.在今天;现今,在当代 n.今天;现在
words.example:
What's the date today?  今天几号？
He's going to ring you at some point today.  他今天某个时候要给你打电话。
Today is even hotter than yesterday!  今天甚至比昨天还热！

words.meaning: v.拿来,带来;产生,引起;使处于某种状态
words.example:
Can you help me bring in (= take into the house) the shopping?  你能帮我把买的东西拿进屋里吗？
The police brought several men in for questioning (= took them to the police station because they might have been involved in a crime).  警方带了几个人回警局问话。
When they visit us they always bring their dog with them.  他们来看我们时总是把狗带来。 (brought, brought)

words.meaning: v.(偶然)发生;碰巧,恰好
words.example:
No one knows exactly what happened but several people have been hurt.  没人确实了解发生了甚么事，只知道有数人受伤。
Anything could happen in the next half hour.  接下来的半小时内甚么事都可能会发生。
What happened to your jacket? There's a big rip in the sleeve.  你的夹克怎么了？袖子上裂了一条大痕。

words.meaning: a.紧接的,其次的;贴近的 ad.其次;居后
words.example:
Who works in the office next to yours?  谁在你隔壁的办公室工作？
Take the next turning on the right.  在下一个路口右转。
Who do you think will be the next president?  你认为谁会出任下届总统？

words.meaning: prep.无,没有 n.外面,外部
words.example:
I've come out without my umbrella.  我没有带伞就出来了。
You look nice without make-up.  你不化妆显得挺可爱的。
He went without my knowledge.  他没有让我知道就去了。

words.meaning: prep.(指时间)在…以前,在..前面,在..之前
words.example:
You should always wash your hands before meals.  饭前应该洗手。
Before leaving he said goodbye to each of them.  他离开前向每个人告别。
She's always up before dawn.  她总是在天亮前就起床了。

words.meaning: a.大的,广大的,大规模的
words.example:
We need a larger car.  我们需要一辆更大的车。
We didn't expect such a large number of people to attend the concert.  我们没想到会有这么多人来听音乐会。
We've made good progress, but there's still a large amount of work to be done.  我们已经取得了一些进展，但仍有大量的工作要做。

words.meaning: aux.&v.必须;很可能;一定要 n.必须做的事
words.example:
Meat must be cooked thoroughly.  肉必须彻底煮熟。
You mustn't show this letter to anyone else.  你不可以把这封信拿给其他人看。
Luggage must not be left unattended (= it is against the rules).  行李不能无人看管。

words.meaning: ad.回家,在家 n.家;家乡a.家庭的;家乡的
words.example:
The senator has two homes - an apartment in Washington and a house in Colorado.  这位参议员有两个家——一个是位于华盛顿的公寓，另一个是科罗拉多的家。
He was living on the streets for three months, and his home was a cardboard box.  他在大街上住了三个月，他的家就是一个厚纸箱。
Phone me at home after four o'clock.  四点之后打家里的电话找我。

words.meaning: prep.在…下面; 在…以下 ad.在下面;少于
words.example:
Because I'm a bad swimmer, I often go under and swallow a lot of water.  因为不善于游泳，我经常沉到水下，喝了不少水。UK adverb
Thousands of companies went under during the recession.  经济衰退期间，成千上万的公司倒闭了。UK preposition
He hid under the bed.  他躲在床底下。

words.meaning: n.水 vt.浇灌;给…饮水 vi.流泪,加水
words.example:
Can I have a drop of water in my whiskey, please?  请在我的威士卡里加一点水，好吗？
Is the water hot enough for a bath?  这水洗澡够不够热？
The human body is about 50% water.  人体约50%是水。

words.meaning: n.房间,室,空间,地方;余地
words.example:
She's waiting for you in the conference room upstairs.  她正在楼上会议室等你。
She's upstairs in her room (= her private room, where she sleeps).  她在楼上自己房间里。
figurative The whole room (= All the people in the room) turned and looked at her.  整个房间里的人都扭过头来看她。

words.meaning: v.写,书写,写字;写作;写信(给),函告
words.example:
Did you write off for tickets?  你写信索取门票了吗？ (wrote, written or old use writ)
Have you written up that report yet?  你把那篇报道整理成文了吗？ (wrote, written or old use writ)
The cop said he'd have to write me up for not stopping at the red light.  那位员警说，因为我冲红灯，他只得给我开罚单。 (wrote, written or old use writ)

words.meaning: n.母亲
words.example:
[as form of address] Good morning, Mother.  早安，院长。
My mother was 21 when she got married.  我母亲结婚时21岁。
All the mothers and fathers had been invited to the end-of-term concert.  所有的父母都获邀请参加期末音乐会。

words.meaning: n.面积;地区,地域;领域,范围
words.example:
All areas of the country will have some rain tonight.  今晚全国所有地区都将有降雨。
The area of New York to the south of Houston Street is known as Soho.  纽约休斯顿街以南区域被称为苏活区。
Houses in the London area (= in and around London) are very expensive.  伦敦地区的房价很高。

words.meaning: a.民族的,国家的,国立的
words.example:
Britain has more than ten national newspapers.  英国有十多种全国性报纸。
The company's national headquarters is in Rome.  这家公司国内的总部设在罗马。
The children were wearing traditional national costume/dress.  孩子们身穿传统的民族服装。

words.meaning: n.货币,钱
words.example:
We invested the money in a high-interest bank account.  我们将钱存进一个高息银行帐户作投资。
We spent so much money redecorating the house that we didn't have any left over for a holiday.  我们花了太多的钱重新装修房子，没有余钱去渡假了。
You can't pay in English money. You'll have to change some money (= buy some foreign money) at the bank.  你不能以英国货币来付款。你必须在银行先作兑换。

words.meaning: n.故事,传说,小说;(=storey)楼层
words.example:
Will you read/tell me a story, daddy?  爸爸，能读／讲个故事给我听吗？
Martha chose her favourite book of bedtime stories.  玛莎挑了她最喜欢的睡前故事书。
He writes children's stories.  他写童话故事。

words.meaning: a.年轻的,幼小的;没经验的 n.青年人
words.example:
His girlfriend's very young.  他的女朋友非常年轻。
The trees in this part of the forest are still quite young.  森林中的这一片树木还没长大。
Philippa is the youngest person in the family.  菲莉帕是家里最小的。

words.meaning: n.事实,实际
words.example:
No decision will be made till we know all the facts.  了解全部事实前我们不会作任何决定。
I'm not angry that you took my car - it's just the fact that you didn't ask me first.  我生气并不是因为你用了我的车，而是你事先没征求我同意。
He knew for a fact that Natalie was lying.  他肯定纳塔莉在撒谎。

words.meaning: n.月,月份
words.example:
I'll be away for a month from mid-June to mid-July.  我会在6月中旬至7月中旬离开一个月。
February is the shortest month.  二月是最短的月份。
The project will be finished in the next few months (= quite soon).  这项计划将在接下来的几个月内完成。

words.meaning: a.差异的,差异的,不同的
words.example:
She seems to wear something different every day.  她似乎每天都穿不一样的衣服。
He's different now that he's been to college.  他现在上了大学，与以前不一样了。
We're reading a different book this week.  这周我们在读另一本书。

words.meaning: n.许多,大量;签,抽签;命运;场地
words.example:
She eats lots of fruit.  她水果吃得很多。
There were a lot of people there.  那里有很多人。
He does a lot of travelling in his job.  他在工作中要跑很多地方。

words.meaning: vt.学习;研究;细看 vi.读书 n.学习;研究
words.example:
Next term we shall study plants and how they grow.  下个学期我们将学习植物及其生长过程。
She's been studying for her doctorate for three years already.  她攻读博士学位已经有3年了。verb
As a young painter, he studied under Picasso.  那位画家年轻时师从毕加索。verb

words.meaning: n.书,书籍 vt.订(票,座位,房间等),预定
words.example:
She wrote a book on car maintenance.  她写了一本关于汽车保养的书。
At the end of the year, the accountant goes over (= checks) the books.  年终时会计要覆核公司的帐册。
Running a school is much more of a business than it used to be, - by law we have to balance our books.  与以前相比现在管理一所学校更像是在经营一家企业——从法律上讲我们必须保证收支平衡。

words.meaning: n.眼(睛);视力;眼力;监督vt.看,审视
words.example:
He has no sight in his left eye.  他左眼失明。
She's got beautiful green eyes.  她有一对漂亮的碧蓝色的眼睛。
He closed his eyes and went to sleep.  他阖上眼睡了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.工作,职位;零活,一件工作;任务,职责
words.example:
When she left college, she got a job as an editor in a publishing company.  大学毕业后她在一家出版社当编辑。
It's very difficult trying to bring up two children while doing a full-time job.  一边抚育两个孩子一边做全职工作很困难。
He's never managed to hold down (= keep) a steady (= permanent) job.  他从来没能保住一份稳定的工作。

words.meaning: n.词,词语;言语,话;谈话;消息,信息
words.example:
Your essay should be no more than two thousand words long.  你的论文不应超过2000字。
Some words are more difficult to spell than others.  有些词比其他的词难拼写。
What's the word for bikini in French?  法语中的“比基尼”怎么说？

words.meaning: ad.可是,然而,不过 conj.尽管,虽然
words.example:
She hasn't phoned, even though she said she would.  虽然她说过要打电话，可还没打。
They're coming next week, though I don't know which day.  他们下周要来，但我不知道是哪天。
You look as though you've had a bad time!  你看上去好像过得很不好！UK adverb

words.meaning: n.商业,生意;事务,业务,职责
words.example:
My brother's in business.  我哥哥经商。
He's in the frozen food business.  他做冷冻食品生意。
The two brothers established/set up/started up a clothes retailing business.  兄弟俩开了家服装零售商店。

words.meaning: n.旁边,侧面;坡,岸;一边/侧/方 vi.支持
words.example:
The names of ships are usually painted on their sides.  船的名字通常漆在船的侧面。
My room is at the side of the house.  我的房间在这栋房屋的侧面。
Please write on one side of the paper only.  请只在纸的一面书写。

words.meaning: a.仁慈的,友好的,亲切的,和蔼的 n.种类
words.example:
She's a very kind and thoughtful person.  她是个非常宽容体贴的人。
It's really kind of you to help us.  承蒙惠助，不胜感激。
Please be kind to your sister!  请对你的妹妹好些！

words.meaning: n.头;顶部;领导,首脑 v.主管;位于..顶部
words.example:
Put this hat on to keep your head warm.  戴上这顶帽子，给头部保暖。
He banged his head on the car as he was getting in.  他上车时撞了一下头。
She nodded/shook her head (= showed her agreement/disagreement).  她点点／摇摇头表示同意／不同意。

words.meaning: a./ad.远,久远,遥远 ad.到…程度,…得多
words.example:
How far is it from Australia to New Zealand?  从澳大利亚到纽西兰有多远？
Is the station far away ?  火车站远吗？
She doesn't live far from here.  她住处离这里不远。

words.meaning: a.黑(色)的;黑暗的 n.黑(色);黑暗;黑人
words.example:
The future looked black.  未来希望渺茫。
She often dresses in black (= in black clothes).  她经常穿黑色衣服。
The old newsreels were filmed in black and white.  以前的新闻短片是用黑白底片拍制的。

words.meaning: a.长的,长时间的,长期的 ad.长久,长期地
words.example:
I've been waiting a long time.  我已经等了很久了。
It's a long time since I worked there.  我不在那里工作已经很久了。
Apparently the sessions are an hour long.  显然这些会议都长达一个小时。

words.meaning: prep.两者(都),双方(都) adj.两个..(都)
words.example:
Both my parents are teachers.  我的父母都是教师。
They have two grown children, both of whom live abroad.  他们有两个成年子女，两人都住在国外。
She has written two novels, both of which have been made into television series.  她写过两部小说，都被拍成了电视连续剧。

words.meaning: a.小,幼小;不多的 ad./n.不多,几乎没有
words.example:
It came in a little box.  它是装在一个小盒子里送来的。
He gave a little smile.  他微微笑了笑。
It'll only take a little while to clear up the kitchen.  用不了多少时间就能把厨房收拾好。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.房屋;商业机构;[H-]议院 v.给...房子住
words.example:
She lives in a little house UKin / USon Cross Street.  她住在十字街上的一间小房子里。
Try not to wake the whole house when you come in!  你进来的时候不要把全家人都吵醒！
House music first appeared in the late 1980s.  电子音乐最早出现于20世纪80年代晚期。noun]haʊs/

words.meaning: ad.是[用于肯定句前],是的
words.example:
If you'd say yes (= agree) to the request you'd save a lot of trouble.  如果你同意这项要求，会省去很多麻烦。
Yes, can I help you?  来了，能帮您甚么忙吗？
What was I talking about - oh yes, I was telling you what happened at the party.  我刚在说甚么——哦，对了，我正告诉你聚会上发生的事情。adverb (informal yeah) (yep) (yah)

words.meaning: prep.自从 conj.自从;因为,既然 ad.后来
words.example:
Emma went to work in New York a year ago, and we haven't seen her since.  埃玛一年前去纽约工作了，自从那时起我们就没有见过她。
He started working for the company when he left school, and has been there ever since (= and is still there).  他毕业后就开始为这家公司工作，在此之后他一直呆在那里。
I've long since (= long ago) forgotten any Latin I ever learned.  我早就把我学过的那点拉丁文忘光了。adverb

words.meaning: v.供应,供给,准备,预防,规定
words.example:
This booklet provides useful information about local services.  这本小册子提供了有关当地服务机构的有用资讯。
All meals are provided throughout the course.  整个期间都提供三餐。
The author provides no documentary references to support her assertions.  作者没有提供参考文献来支援她自己的论点。

words.meaning: n.服务;公共设施;维修保养;行政部门v.维修
words.example:
There isn't any railway service on Sundays.  星期天火车不运行。
We hope to be operating a normal service as soon as possible.  我们希望能尽快使服务保持正常运作。
We stopped at the services to get petrol.  我们在服务站停下来加油。UK noun

words.meaning: ad.在...周围,到处 prep.在..四周(或附近)
words.example:
We sat around the table.  我们围着桌子坐着。
He put his arm around her.  他用胳膊搂着她。
She had a woollen scarf around her neck.  她脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

words.meaning: n.朋友
words.example:
She's my best/oldest/closest friend - we've known each other since we were five.  她是我最要好／交情最久／最亲密的朋友——我们五岁的时候就认识了。
He's a family friend/friend of the family.  他是全家人的朋友。
This restaurant was recommended to me by a friend of mine.  这间餐厅是我的一个朋友给我推荐的。

words.meaning: a.重要的,重大的;有地位的,有权力的
words.example:
It 's important for children to learn to get on with each other.  孩子必须学会彼此友好相处。
The important thing is to keep the heat low or the sugar will burn.  重要的是热度要低，否则糖就会烧焦。
He's not amazingly handsome, but he's nice and that's more important.  他并不十分英俊，但他人很好，那才是更重要的。    Opposite unimportant

words.meaning: n.父亲;创始人,发明者;(Father)神父
words.example:
[as form of address] Are you giving a sermon, Father?  您要布道吗，神父？
Our Father, who art in heaven...  我们的天父…
My father took me to watch the football every Saturday.  我父亲每周六带我去看足球赛。UK noun countable

words.meaning: vi.坐,坐下;位于;栖息;孵卵 vt.使就坐
words.example:
He came and sat (down) next to me.  他走过来坐在我身边。
The child's father sat her (down) on a chair.  孩子的父亲把她放在椅子上。
Monet's wife sat for him many times.  莫内的妻子多次做他的模特儿。

words.meaning: ad.在远处;离开;渐渐远去;一直;去掉
words.example:
Ms Watson is away on holiday until the end of the week.  沃森女士渡假去了，要到周末才能回来。
Keep/Stay away from him.  离他远点。
Just go away and leave me alone!  走开，别管我！

words.meaning: conj.&prep.直到…为止,在…以前;直到…
words.example:
Hadn't we better wait until Antony's here?  我们是不是最好等到安东尼来？
We didn't eat till past midnight.  直到过了午夜我们才吃东西。
Once he starts a decorating job he won't stop until it's finished.  一旦开始一项装修工作，他就不会半途而废。

words.meaning: n.力,精力;功率,电力;(数学)幂;权力,势力
words.example:
I've no power over him - he does what he wants to.  我管不了他——他想干甚么就干甚么。
Once nicotine has you in its power, it's very difficult to stop smoking.  一旦尼古丁对你起了作用，戒烟就很难了。
She has the power to charm any man she meets.  她有魅力让她遇见的每个男子都神魂颠倒。

words.meaning: n.小时,钟点;时刻;课时,工作时间
words.example:
The exam lasted an hour and a half.  考试持续了一个半小时。
There are 24 hours in a day.  一天有24小时。
How many hours' sleep do you need?  你需要睡多少个小时？

words.meaning: n.游戏,娱乐;比赛;(pl.)运动会 vi.赌博
words.example:
The children played a game of cops and robbers.  孩子们玩官兵捉强盗的游戏
It's games this afternoon.  今天下午上体育课。
Susan is playing golf every day to try to improve her game.  苏珊每天打高尔夫努力提高球技。

words.meaning: ad.常常,经常,通常
words.example:
How often do you wash your hair?  你多久洗一次头发？
It's not often that you meet someone who you're instantly attracted to.  你不会经常遇到一见面就把你吸引住的人。
Christmas is often mild in this country.  在这个国家，圣诞节期间的气候往往很暖和。UK adverb

words.meaning: ad.还,尚,仍然;已经 conj.然而 ad.甚至
words.example:
He hasn't finished yet.  他还没完成。
Of all the songs I've heard tonight, that's the best yet.  在我今晚听到的所有歌中，那首是最好的。
We haven't needed extra staff as yet, but may do in the future.  到目前为止，我们尚不需要增加员工，但将来也许会需要。

words.meaning: n.线;路线,航线;排;线路;界线 v.排队;加衬
words.example:
Sign your name on the dotted line.  请在虚线处签名。
She was very old and her face was covered with lines.  她已非常年迈，脸上布满了皱纹。
My legs felt all wobbly when I stood up and I couldn't walk in a straight line (= walk without moving to the side while moving forward).  我站起来时觉得腿直打颤，走起路来左右摇晃。noun

words.meaning: a.政治的
words.example:
There are two political parties in the US - the Democratic Party and the Republican Party.  美国有两个政党——民主党和共和党。
Education is back at the top of the political agenda (= the matters that the government is considering).  教育问题又回到了政府待议事项的首位。UK adjective
We don't want the immigration issue to become a political football.  我们不想让移民问题成为政治足球。

words.meaning: n.末端,端,梢;目标,目的 v.终止,结束
words.example:
This cable should have a plug at one end and a socket at the other.  这根电缆应该一端有插头，另一端有插座。
We damaged the end of the piano when we moved it.  我们搬钢琴时把钢琴末端部分撞坏了。
Get to the end of the queue and wait your turn like everyone else.  到队伍后面去排队，像别人一样按照顺序等着。

words.meaning: prep.在…之中;在一群(组)之中;于…之间
words.example:
Rescue teams searched among the wreckage for survivors.  救援队在残垣断壁中搜寻幸存者。
Relax, you're amongst friends.  你别紧张，大家都是朋友。
Talk about it among yourselves (= Talk to each other about it without me) for a while.  你们先讨论一会儿。

words.meaning: ad.曾经;永远;在任何时候;究竟
words.example:
Nothing ever happens here in the evenings.  这儿晚上从来没发生过甚么事儿。
Have you ever been to London?  你去过伦敦吗？
If you're ever/If ever you're in Cambridge, do give me a ring.  无论甚么时候你到了剑桥，一定要给我打个电话。

words.meaning: vi.站立;位于;经受 n.台,座;货摊;立场
words.example:
Granny says if she stands (up) for a long time her ankles hurt.  奶奶说她站久了脚踝会痛。
As a sign of politeness you should stand (up) when she comes in.  她进来时你应该站起来以示礼貌
Stand still and be quiet!  站好了，不要出声！

words.meaning: a.坏的;低劣的;不舒服的;腐败的;严重的
words.example:
Our holiday was spoiled by bad weather.  我们的假期全被坏天气给破坏了。
We've just had some very bad news.  我们刚刚收到了一些非常坏的消息。
Watch out - he's in a bad mood (= being unpleasant to everyone).  小心——他的心情不好。

words.meaning: v.丢失,迷路,输掉,亏本,失败,走慢,使沉湎于
words.example:
I've lost my ticket.  我丢了票。
He's always losing his car keys.  他总是丢汽车锁匙。
At least 600 staff will lose their jobs if the firm closes.  如果公司关闭，至少将有600名员工失去工作。

words.meaning: ad.然而,可是,不过,无论如何 conj.无论
words.example:
However hungry I am, I never seem to be able to finish off a whole pizza.  无论有多饿，我似乎都吃不下一整个薄饼。
If Emma likes something she'll buy it however much it costs.  如果艾玛喜欢某个东西，无论多贵她都会买。
I'll see you after the show and give you £20 for the tickets, or however much (= whatever) they cost.  演出结束后我们再见面，我会给你20英镑或者是实际的门票钱。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.成员,会员
words.example:
The lion is a member of the cat family.  狮子是猫科动物。
Representatives of the member states will be meeting next week.  成员国代表将于下周会晤。
Car parking facilities are for members only.  停车设施仅供会员使用。

words.meaning: v.付款,付出代价,给予注意 n.工资,薪金
words.example:
How much did you pay for the tickets?  你买那些票花了多少钱？
Will you pay these cheques into (US usuallydeposit these checks in)my account for me?  替我把这些支票存进帐户里好吗？
Would you prefer to pay with/by cash, cheque or credit card?  你喜欢用现金、支票还是信用卡付款？

words.meaning: n.法律,法规,法学,规律,定律
words.example:
There are laws against drinking in the street.  有法律禁止在街上喝酒。
The laws governing the possession of firearms are being reviewed.  关于持有武器的法律正在审议中。
They led the fight to impose laws on smoking.  他们带头争取对吸烟行为进行法律约束。

words.meaning: n.会,集会 v.遇见;会谈;迎接;满足;符合
words.example:
They met at work.  他们是在工作时认识的。
Would you like to meet my sister?  你愿意认识一下我姐姐吗？
Come and meet (= be introduced to) my friend Laura.  来，认识一下我的朋友萝拉。verb (met, met)

words.meaning: n.汽车,车辆,车;(火车)车厢
words.example:
They don't have a car.  他们没有汽车。
Where did you park your car?  你把车停在哪里了？
It's quicker by car.  开车快一点。

words.meaning: n.城市;都市;市
words.example:
Many of the world's cities have populations of more than 5 million.  世界上许多城市的人口超过500万。
Wellington is the capital city (= centre of government) of New Zealand.  威灵顿是纽西兰首都。
The city of Ely has about 10 000 inhabitants.  伊利市有大约一万居民。UK noun countable

words.meaning: adv.几乎,差不多
words.example:
She's almost thirty.  她差不多快30岁了。
It was almost six o'clock when he left.  他离开时将近六点了。
It'll cost almost as much to repair it as it would to buy a new one.  修理要花的钱差不多都可以买个新的了。

words.meaning: v.包括,包含,计入
words.example:
The bill includes tax and service.  帐单包括税款和服务费。
Tax and service are included in the bill.  税款和服务费包括在帐单中。

words.meaning: v.继续,连续,延伸
words.example:
Do you intend to continue (with) your studies?  你打算继续你的学业吗？
If the rain continues, we'll have to cancel tonight's plans.  如果雨还下个不停，我们只好取消今晚的计划。
Sally Palmer will be continuing as chairperson this autumn.  萨莉‧帕尔默今年秋天将继续担任委员会主席。

words.meaning: n.一套,一副,装置,接受机v.提出,调整,日落
words.example:
He set a vase of flowers on the table.  他把一瓶花放在桌子上。
The campsite is set in the middle of a pine forest.  营地设在松树林的中央。
Our house is set back from the road.  我们的房子离公路有一定的距离。

words.meaning: n.名字(称/声/义) vt.给…取名;列举;提名
words.example:
Please write your full (= complete) name and address on the form.  请在表格上填写全名和地址。
What's the name of that mountain in the distance?  远处那座山叫甚么名字？
We finally agreed on the name Luca for our son.  最终我们一致同意给儿子取名卢卡。

words.meaning: ad.一次,曾经 conj.一(旦)…就… n.一次
words.example:
We have lunch together once a month.  我们每个月一起吃一次午餐。
They all started talking at once.  他们同时开始说起话来。
For once, the bus came on time.  难得一次公车准点到达。

words.meaning: a.白色的;苍白的;白种的 n.白色;白种人
words.example:
He's white-haired now.  他现在头发都已经白了。
He had a black mother and a white father.  他的母亲是黑人，父亲是白人。
In some countries it is traditional for a bride to wear white.  在某些国家的传统中，新娘要穿白色礼服。

words.meaning: a.最小的;最少的 ad.最小;最少
words.example:
This group is the least likely of the four to win.  该组在四个小组当中获胜的可能性最小。
Disaster struck when we least expected it.  在我们最不为意的时候，灾难不期而至。
It was the answer she least wanted to hear.  那是她最不愿听到的回答。

words.meaning: n.总统,校长,会长,主席
words.example:
[as form of address] Thank you, Mr/Madam President.  谢谢您，总统阁下。noun countable
mainly US She's a friend of the president of the bank.  她是银行总裁的朋友。

words.meaning: v.学习,学,学会;(of,about)听到,获悉
words.example:
They learn Russian at school.  他们在学校学俄语。
I've learned a lot about computers since I started work here.  自从到这里工作后我学到了不少电脑知识。
We were told to learn Portia's speech by heart (= be able to say it from memory) for homework.  我们得到告知功课是要熟练背诵鲍西娅的演说。

words.meaning: a.真的,真实的;实际的,现实的
words.example:
Assuring the patient that she has a real and not imaginary problem is the first step.  使病人确信她真的有病，并非杯弓蛇影，这是对她进行治疗的第一步。
There is a very real threat that he will lose his job.  他的确有失去工作的危险。
Wages rose by 2.9% last year, but real earnings still fell by 1.3%.  去年薪金增长了2.9%，但实际收入却仍然下降了1.3%。

words.meaning: n.改变,变化;零钱 v.更换,调换,交换;改变
words.example:
That was twenty years ago and things have changed since then.  20年过去了，情况已经变了。
Nothing changes, does it - I've been away two years and the office still looks exactly the same.  甚么也没有改变，不是吗——我走了两年，办公室看起来仍然是老样子。
People have changed their diets a lot over the past few years.  过去几年里人们的饮食习惯改变了许多。

words.meaning: n.小队,小组 v.协同工作
words.example:
It was a real team effort - everyone contributed something to the success of the project.  这完全是集体努力的结果——每个人都为这个专案计划的成功作出了贡献。verb
They teamed up for a charity performance.  他们集合起来，举行了一场义演。

words.meaning: n.分钟,片刻;(pl.)会议记录 a.微小的
words.example:
It takes me twenty minutes to get to work.  我上班路上要花20分钟。
The train leaves at three minutes to eight, so we'd better get there a few minutes before then.  火车7点57分开出，我们最好提前几分钟到。
Hang on/Wait a minute - I'll just get my bag.  等一下——我去拿我的袋子。

words.meaning: a.几个,若干,数个;各个的,各自的
words.example:
I've seen 'Gone with the Wind' several times.  我已经看过好几遍《乱世佳人》了。
Several people have complained about the scheme.  已经有好几个人抱怨过这项计划了。
Several of my friends are learning English at language schools in Cambridge.  我有几个朋友在剑桥的语言学校学英语。UK adjective [before noun] formal

words.meaning: n.想法,念头;概念,观念;意见,主意
words.example:
I've had an idea - why don't we go to the coast?  我有个主意——我们为甚么不去海滨呢？
If you have any ideas for what I could buy Jack, let me know.  我给杰克买甚么东西好，如果你有甚么主意请告诉我。
That's when I first had the idea of starting (= planned to start) my own business.  那是我首次有了自己创业的想法。

words.meaning: n.小孩,儿童 v.戏弄,取笑
words.example:
He took the kids to the park while I was working.  我工作时，他把孩子们带到公园去了。
He was only 16, just a kid really.  他才16岁，还是个年轻小子。
You should have seen him when they arrived. He was like a kid in a candy store.  你真应该看看他们来的时候他的样子，简直就像个进了糖果店的孩子。

words.meaning: n.身体,本体;主体;尸体;物体;(一)群,批,堆
words.example:
She rubbed sun lotion over her entire body.  她全身都擦了防晒霜。
He had a fat body but rather thin legs and arms.  他身体很胖，但腿和两臂却很瘦。
How is a body supposed to live in these conditions?  人怎么可能住在这种环境里呢？

words.meaning: n.通知,报告;情报,资料,消息;信息
words.example:
Do you have any information about/on train times?  你知道有关火车时刻的资讯吗？
For further information (= if you want to know more) , please contact your local library.  欲知详情，请联络当地图书馆。

words.meaning: n.没有东西;什么也没有;无关紧要的人或事
words.example:
There's nothing in the drawer - I took everything out.  抽屉里甚么也没有——我把所有东西都拿出去了。
Nothing I could say would cheer her up.  无论我说甚么，也没办法令她振作起来。
There's nothing else (= no other thing) we can do to help.  我们帮不上甚么别的忙。

words.meaning: ad.(常和一般过去时的动词连用)以前,…前
words.example:
He left the house over an hour ago.  他一个多小时前离开了这所房子。
The dinosaurs died out 65 million years ago.  恐龙在6500万年前灭绝了。
Long ago] A long time ago, there lived a girl called Cinderella.  很久以前，有个叫灰姑娘的女孩。

words.meaning: v.领导;领先;通向,导致 n.带领,引导;铅
words.example:
I've asked Gemma to lead the discussion.  我已请杰玛带领大家讨论。
Who will be leading the inquiry into the accident?  谁来领导事故的调查工作？verb (led, led)
After thirty minutes the challengers were leading by two goals.  30分钟过后挑战者已经领先两分。

words.meaning: a.社会的;交际的
words.example:
I'm a social drinker - I only drink when I'm with other people.  我是个“应酬型”饮酒者——只在与人相聚时饮酒。
Most British schools organize social events for the students.  大多数英国学校为学生组织社交活动。
I've just become a member of the company's sports and social club.  我刚刚成为公司运动和社交俱乐部的成员。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.懂,理解;获悉,听说;揣测,认为
words.example:
She explained the whole idea again, but I still didn't understand.  她把整个想法又解释了一遍，但我还是不明白。
Is there anyone here who understands Arabic?  这儿有人懂阿拉伯语吗？
My wife doesn't understand me.  我太太不理解我。

words.meaning: conj.是否,会不会,不管,无论
words.example:
She asked me whether I was interested in working for her.  她问我是否有兴趣为她工作。
I'm wondering whether to have the fish or the beef.  我正在考虑是吃鱼还是吃牛肉。
It all depends on whether or not she's got the time.  这完全取决于她是否有时间。

words.meaning: v.观看;看守;(for)窥伺,等待 n.看管;表
words.example:
He spent the entire afternoon watching a cricket match.  他整个下午都在看一场板球比赛。
Bonner watched helplessly as the ball sneaked in at the near post.  邦纳无助地看着球从近端的球门柱旁滚进球门。
She'll pretend that she hasn't seen us - you watch.  她会假装没看见我们的——你看着吧。

words.meaning: ad.共同,一起;合起来,集拢地
words.example:
We used to go to aerobics together.  我们过去常常一起去做有氧运动。
We worked together on a project a couple of years back.  几年前我们一起做过工程。
Could you add these figures together for me?  你能替我把这些数字加在一起吗？

words.meaning: v.跟随,接着;领会;沿着…前进,遵循;结果是
words.example:
She followed me into the kitchen.  她跟着我进了厨房。
The book was delivered yesterday with a note saying the bill for it would follow in a day or two.  这本书昨天送到，附信说书的账单一两天后会寄到。
He had the feeling he was being followed (= someone was going after him to catch him or see where he was going).  他发觉自己被跟踪了。

words.meaning: n.父母,母亲;(pl.)双亲;父母
words.example: I'm going to meet Richard's parents for the first time this weekend.  我这个周末将第一次见理查的父母。

words.meaning: v.停止;塞住;阻止,阻挠;逗留 n.停车站;停止
words.example:
Once I start eating chocolate, I can't stop.  我一开始吃巧克力，就停不了嘴。
Stop it!/Stop that!  住手！
My watch must have stopped.  我的手表一定是停了。

words.meaning: n.脸,面貌;表情;正面 v.面对着;朝,面向
words.example:
She's got a long, thin face.  她长着一张瘦长的脸。
She had a puzzled expression on her face.  她一脸困惑不解。
He had a face like thunder (= He looked very angry).  他怒容满面。

words.meaning: pron.任何东西(事物);无论什么东西(事物)
words.example:
If he eats anything with wheat in it he's very sick.  他吃任何含有小麦的食物，都会很不舒服。
Let me know if anything happens won't you.  发生甚么事就告诉我，好吗？
Is there anything I can do to help?  有甚么地方我可以帮忙的吗？

words.meaning: v.创造,创作;引起,造成,建立
words.example:
Charles Schulz created the characters 'Snoopy' and 'Charlie Brown'.  查尔斯‧舒尔茨创作了漫画人物史诺比和查理‧布朗。
The Bible says that God created the world.  《圣经》上说是上帝创造了世界。
He created a wonderful meal from very few ingredients.  他用很少的几种食物原料做了一顿美餐。

words.meaning: a.公共的,公用的;公开的,公然的n.公众,民众
words.example:
Public opinion (= the opinions of most people) has turned against him.  民意已不再支持他了。
Is it really in the public interest (= useful to people) to publish this information?  公布这件消息真的对大众有利吗？
We need to increase public awareness of the disease.  我们需要增强民众对这种疾病的认识。

words.meaning: ad.已,已经,早已
words.example:
The concert had already begun by the time we arrived.  我们到时，音乐会已经开始了。
I've already told him.  我已经告诉他了。
As I have already mentioned, I doubt that we will able to raise all the money we need.  正如我早就说过的，我怀疑我们是否能够筹集到足够的资金。

words.meaning: v.说话,讲话;演说,发言;(in)说某种语言
words.example:
Would you mind speaking more slowly, please?  请你再说慢点，好吗？
If he tells Julie what I said, I'll never speak to him again.  如果他把我说的话告诉茱莉，我就再也不和他说话。
formal She spoke of her sadness over her father's death.  她谈起了父亲过世带给她的悲伤。

words.meaning: v.朗读;阅读 vt.辨认,观察 vi.读到,获悉
words.example:
He spent a pleasant afternoon reading (the newspaper/a book).  他一下午都在阅读（报纸／书），过得很开心。
It was too dark to read our map and we took a wrong turning.  天太黑看不清地图，所以我们转错了弯。
Can you read music?  你识乐谱吗？

words.meaning: n.水平,水准,等级 v.弄平,铺平 a.水平的
words.example:
The water level in the lake is much higher after heavy rain.  暴雨过后这个湖的水位上升了很多。
Inflation is going to rise 2% from its present level.  通货膨胀率将比目前上涨2%。
Chess requires a very high level of concentration.  下棋需要注意力高度集中。

words.meaning: vt.允许,准许;承认;给予;(for)考虑到
words.example:
You're not allowed to talk during the exam.  考试期间不许交谈。
Her proposals would allow (= make it possible for) more people to stay in full-time education.  她的提议会使更多的人能够继续接受全日制教育。
The loophole has allowed hundreds of drink-drivers to avoid prosecution.  这个法律漏洞让数以百计的酒后驾车者钻了空子，逃避了起诉。

words.meaning: vt.加;增加(进);进一步说/写 vi.(to)增添
words.example:
If you add (= calculate the total of) three and four you get seven.  三加四等于七。
Beat the butter and sugar together and slowly add the eggs.  把奶油和糖搅拌在一起，再慢慢把鸡蛋打进去。
She's added a Picasso to her collection.  她的收藏中增添了一幅毕卡索的画作。

words.meaning: n.办公室,办事处;职务,公职;部,局,处
words.example:
They've got offices in Paris, London and Madrid.  他们在巴黎、伦敦和马德里都设有办事处。UK noun
As chairman of the association, he held office for over twenty years.  他担任该协会的主席一职长达20多年。
The Socialist party have been in office (= governing) [ out of office (= not governing) for almost ten years.  社会党执政／在野已近10年了。

words.meaning: v.花费;消耗,用尽;度过,消磨
words.example:
How much did you spend?  你花了多少钱？
We spent a fortune when we were in New York.  我们在纽约花了一大笔钱。
She spends a lot of money on clothes.  她在衣服上开销很大。

words.meaning: n.门;门口,出入口;门状物;家;通道
words.example:
The door to his bedroom was locked.  他卧室的门上了锁。
We could hear someone knocking at/on the door.  我们能听到有人在敲门。
Could you open/close/shut the door, please?  请把门打开／关上好吗？

words.meaning: n.健康,健康状况;卫生
words.example:
Regular exercise is good for your health.  规律运动对你的身体有好处。
He gave up work because of ill- health.  他因为身体不好而辞去了工作。

words.meaning: n.人,喜欢(或适应)..的人;人物;人称
words.example:
Who was the first person to swim the English Channel?  游过英吉利海峡的第一人是谁？
legal Four persons have been charged with the murder.  四人被控犯有谋杀罪。
She's an extremely kind person.  她是个非常和蔼的人。

words.meaning: n.艺术,美术;技术,技艺;文科,人文科学
words.example:
Can television and pop music really be considered art?  电视和流行音乐真的能被当作艺术吗？
Art and English were my best subjects at school.  在学生时代，我学得最好的科目是美术和英语。
The gallery has an excellent collection of modern art.  这家美术馆藏有一批优秀的现代艺术品。

words.meaning: a.肯定的;一定会…的;有信心的,有把握的
words.example:
I'm sure (that) I left my keys on the table.  我确定我把锁匙放在桌上了。
It now seems sure (that) the election will result in another victory for the government.  现在看来，这次选举无疑又会以政府的胜利而告终。
Simon isn't sure wh ether/if he'll be able to come to the party or not.  西蒙不太确定他能否参加这次聚会。

words.meaning: n.战争(状态);冲突 vi.作战
words.example:
If this country goes to (= starts to fight in a) war we will have to face the fact that many people will die.  如果这个国家参战，我们将不得不面对很多人都要送命的现实。
Britain and France declared war on Germany in 1939 as a result of the invasion of Poland.  因为德国入侵波兰，所以英国和法国于1939年对德宣战。
War broke out between the two countries after a border dispute.  边界纠纷导致两国之间爆发了战争。

words.meaning: n.历史,历史学;来历,经历
words.example:
Annie's decided to write a history of electronic music.  安妮已经决定写一本关于电子音乐历史的书。
Last year's report is ancient history and totally irrelevant to the current situation.  去年的报告已经是老早以前的事了，与当前的情况毫无关系。
Her family has a history of heart problems.  她的家族有心脏病史。

words.meaning: n.聚会,政党,当事人 v.举行(参加)社交聚会
words.example:
Peter has/gives/throws really wild parties.  彼得举办的聚会很疯狂。
The Labour party has/have just elected a new leader.  工党刚选出了一名新领袖。
He was elected as party leader in 2001.  他于2001年当选为该党的领袖。

words.meaning: prep.在…里面,在…以内 ad.在内
words.example:
Two-thirds of Californians live within 15 miles of the coast.  三分之二的加州人居住在离海岸15英里以内的地区。
In 1992 cross-border controls within the EU were dismantled.  1992年，欧盟内部取消了边境通行管制。
For orders within the UK, please enclose £2.50 for post and packing.  英国国内的订货，请附上2.5英镑的邮资及包装费用。

words.meaning: v.生长,成长;渐渐变成;栽培,种植;发展
words.example:
Children grow so quickly.  小朋友长得很快。
This plant grows best in the shade.  这种植物在阴凉处长得最好。
She's grown three centimetres this year.  她今年长高了三厘米。

words.meaning: n.结果,成绩 v.结果,致使,导致,由…而造成
words.example:
The road has been widened, but the result is just more traffic.  道路被拓宽，但结果车流量却更大了。
His broken leg is the direct result of his own carelessness.  他自己的粗心大意直接导致他摔断了腿。
To ensure good/the best results, use Italian tomatoes and fresh basil.  为了保证做好后口味好／最佳，要用义大利番茄和新鲜的罗勒。

words.meaning: n.公开,户外 a.开的,开放的 v.开
words.example:
An open suitcase lay on her bed.  一个打开的手提箱摆在她的床上。
You left the packet open.  你没把包装袋口封上。
Someone had left the window wide (= completely) open.  有人把窗户敞开着。

words.meaning: n.早晨,上午
words.example:
She only works in the mornings.  她只在上午工作。
What's our schedule for this morning?  我们今天上午有甚么安排？
I'd like an appointment for tomorrow morning, please.  请把时间约定在明天上午。

words.meaning: v.走,步行,散步;走遍 n.走,步行,散步
words.example:
He walks two kilometres to work every morning.  他每天早晨步行两公里去上班。
He offered to walk her home/ to the station.  他提出陪她走回家／到车站。
She walks the dog for an hour every afternoon.  她每天下午都遛一小时狗。

words.meaning: n.原因,理性,理智 v.推理,说服,辩论,讨论
words.example:
The reason for the disaster was engine failure, not human error.  这次灾难的原因是引擎故障，而非人为错误。
not standard The reason I walked out was because I was bored.  我走出去是因为我感到很无聊。
She was furious, and with reason (= with good cause).  她很生气，这也有情可原。

words.meaning: a.低,矮;低级的,下层的,卑贱的;低声的
words.example:
a low ceiling.  低矮的天花板
When we went skiing, I only went on the lower slopes.  我们去滑雪的时候，我只在较低的山坡上滑。
The planes fly low across enemy territory.  飞机在敌占区飞得很低。UK adjective adverb

words.meaning: vi.获胜,赢 vt.赢得;在…中获胜 n.胜利
words.example:
Which year was it that Italy won the World Cup?  义大利是哪一年赢得世界杯的？
He won first prize/a bottle of gin in the raffle.  他在抽彩中赢得了头奖／一瓶杜松子酒。
Who's winning?  谁会取胜？

words.meaning: v./n.(into,on)研究,调查
words.example:
They are carrying out/conducting/doing some fascinating research into/on the language of dolphins.  他们正在对海豚的语言展开／进行／做一些很有趣的研究。
His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.  他在疾病预防领域的研究取得了意想不到的成果。noun uncountable UK  ADVANCED
She's researching into possible cures for AIDS.  她正在对一些可能治愈爱滋病的疗法进行研究。

words.meaning: n.少女,姑娘,女孩;女职员
words.example:
Two girls showed us round the classrooms.  两个女孩领着我们参观了课室。
We have two girls.  我们有两个女儿。
My little girl is five.  我小女儿五岁了。

words.meaning: a.早的,早期的,及早的 ad.早,在初期
words.example:
If you finish early you can go home.  如果能提前完成你就可以回家。
If you arrived earlier, you'd have more time.  如果早一点到，你就会有更多的时间。
They scored two goals early (on) in the game.  他们在开赛不久就进了两个球。

words.meaning: n.食物,粮食,养料
words.example:
There was lots of food and drink at the party.  派对上供应了大量的食物和饮品。
I'm allergic to certain foods.  我对某些食物过敏。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.片刻,瞬间,时刻
words.example:
Can you wait a moment?  你能等一下吗？
I'll be ready in just a moment.  我一会儿就准备好。
I'm expecting her to come at any moment (= very soon).  我预计她随时会来。

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]他自己;他本人
words.example:
He'd cut himself shaving.  他刮胡子时刮伤了自己。
Most nights he would cry himself to sleep.  大多数晚上他都是哭着入睡的。
Did you want to talk to the chairman himself, or could his personal assistant help you?  你想和主席本人谈谈，还是让他的私人助理帮助你？

words.meaning: n.空气;(复数)神气 vt.(使)通风;晾干
words.example:
You should put some air in your tyres - they look flat to me.  你该给这些轮胎打气了——它们看上去都像泄了气似的。
The air was filled with the scent of roses.  空气中弥漫着玫瑰的芳香。
Throw your gun down and put your hands in the air.  扔掉枪，举起手来。

words.meaning: n.教师(员),老(导)师
words.example: The teacher wrote on the blackboard.  老师在黑板上写字。
