words.meaning: n.力量,力;势力;(pl.)(总称)军队 v.强迫
words.example:
The force of the wind had brought down a great many trees in the area.  强风刮倒了这一地区的许多树木。
She slapped his face with unexpected force.  她打了他一耳光，出乎意料地用力。
Teachers aren't allowed to use force in controlling their pupils.  老师管教学生时禁止使用体罚。

words.meaning: v.提供,提议,出现 n.出价,提议,意图
words.example:
She was offered a job in Paris.  她在巴黎得到了一份工作。
Can I offer you (= Would you like) a drink?  你要一杯饮料吗？
Dear Lord, we offer up our prayers...  亲爱的主，我们向您祈祷…UK verb

words.meaning: a.(for)足够的 n.足够,充分 ad.足够地
words.example:
Is there enough cake/Are there enough cakes for everyone?  蛋糕够大家分吗？
There are 25 textbooks per class. That should be enough.  每班25本教材，应该够了。
Have you had enough (to eat)?  你（吃）饱了吗？

words.meaning: n.教育,培养,训练
words.example:
As a child he received most of his education at home.  童年时他主要在家中接受教育。
It's a country which places great importance on education.  这是个非常重视教育的国家。
She lectures in education (= the study of education) at the teacher training college.  她在教师培训学院讲授教育学。

words.meaning: prep.横过,越过;在的对面 ad.横过,穿过
words.example:
She walked across the field/road.  她穿过田野／横过马路。
They're building a new bridge across the river.  他们正在河上修建新桥。
When I reached the river, I simply swam across.  到河边后，我便直接游了过去。UK preposition

words.meaning: conj.尽管,虽然...但是
words.example:
She walked home by herself, although she knew that it was dangerous.  她一个人步行回家，尽管她知道那样做很危险。
He decided to go, although I begged him not to.  虽然我苦苦阻拦，他还是决定去。
He's rather shy, although he's not as bad as he used to be.  他很腼腆，但是比以前要好一些了。

words.meaning: v.记住;(to)转达问候,代…致意,代…问好
words.example:
Did you remember to do the shopping?  你没忘去商店买东西吧？
She will be remembered for her courage.  她将因其勇敢而被人们铭记。
We went and had tea in the little café on Primrose Hill - you remember, the one next to the bookshop.  我们去了普里姆罗斯山上的一家小咖啡厅喝茶——你没有忘吧，书店旁边的那间咖啡厅。

words.meaning: n.(pl.feet)脚,足;英尺;底部
words.example:
I've got a blister on my left foot.  我左脚上起了个水泡。
I've been on my feet (= standing) all day and I'm exhausted.  我一整天都没坐过，可把我给累坏了。
He got to/rose to/jumped to his feet (= stood up) when she walked in.  她进来的时候他站了起来／站起身来／一跃而起。

words.meaning: a.第二;次等的,二等的 n.秒 v.赞成,附和
words.example:
Is Brian her first or second child?  布莱恩是她的第一个还是第二个孩子？
This is the second time I've had flu this winter.  这是今年冬天以来我的第二场感冒。
First prize is a fortnight in Barbados and second prize is a weekend in Rome.  头奖是巴巴多斯双环游，二奖是罗马周末游。

words.meaning: n.男孩子,儿子;男性服务员
words.example:
As a young boy, my father used to walk three miles to school.  我爸爸小时候常常要走三英里路去上学。
You've been a very naughty boy!  你真是个调皮的男孩！
Their little boy (= Their young son) is very sick.  他们的小儿子病得很重。

words.meaning: adv.可能;大概;也许
words.example:
Maybe they'll come tomorrow.  或许他们明天会来。
Maybe you were right after all.  或许还是你对。
There were 200, maybe 300, refugees on the boat.  船上约有200或300名难民。

words.meaning: prep.(towards)朝,向;将近;对于;为了
words.example: He walked toward the school gate.  他朝校门走去。

words.meaning: a.有(能力、时间、知识等)做某事,有本事的
words.example:
Will she be able to cope with the work?  她能应付这项工作吗？
He's never been able to admit to his mistakes.  他从来就不会承认自己的错误。
I'm sorry that I wasn't able to phone you yesterday.  对不起，昨天我没能给你打电话。

words.meaning: n.年龄;时代;老年;长时间 v.(使)变老
words.example:
Do you know the age of that building?  你知道那座楼的历史有多久吗？
What age (= How old) is your brother?  你弟弟多大了？
I'd guess she's about my age (= she is about as old as I am).  我猜她和我年龄差不多。

words.meaning: n.政策,方针
words.example:
They believe that the European Community needs a common foreign and security policy.  他们认为欧洲共同体需要采取共同的外交和安全政策。
What is your party's policy on immigration?  你们党对于移民的政策是甚么？UK noun countable
You should check your policy to see if you're covered for flood damage.  你应该查看一下你的保险单看看是否保了洪水险。

words.meaning: pron.每件事,一切;最重要的东西
words.example:
You can't blame him for everything.  你不能甚么事都怪他。
She's obsessed with Elvis Presley and collects anything and everything connected with him.  她迷上了猫王艾维斯‧普里斯莱，只要跟他有关的东西她都要收藏。
Jane's been unfaithful to Jim three times, but he still loves her in spite of everything.  简已经有三次对吉姆不忠的行为了，但尽管如此，他仍然爱她。

words.meaning: n.爱,爱情,喜欢 vt.爱,热爱;爱好,喜欢
words.example:
Last night he told me he loved me.  昨晚他告诉我说他爱我。
I've only ever loved one man.  我只爱过一个男人。
I'm sure he loves his kids.  我确信他爱他的孩子们。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.过程,进程;工序,制作法;工艺 v.加工,处理
words.example:
Increasing the number of women in top management jobs will be a slow process.  增加高级管理职位女性的人数将是一个缓慢的过程。
This decision may delay the process of European unification.  这一决策可能会延后欧洲一体化的进程。
The party has begun the painful (= difficult) process of rethinking its policies and strategy.  该党开始了重新审视其政策和战略的艰难历程。

words.meaning: n.音乐,乐曲,乐谱
words.example:
What sort of music do you listen to?  你听甚么样的音乐？
They play good music (= recordings of music) on this (radio) station.  这家电台播放的音乐很好听。
Shall I put on some music (= play a recording) ?  我放点音乐好吗？

words.meaning: v.考虑,细想;体谅,顾及;认为,把…看作
words.example:
Don't make any decisions before you've considered the matter.  在仔细考虑过这个问题之前别作任何决定。
She's being considered for the job.  目前正在考虑是否由她来做这项工作。
I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.  我想花点时间斟酌斟酌再作决定。UK verb

words.meaning: vi.出现;出场;问世;仿佛;出版,发表
words.example:
He suddenly appeared in the doorway.  他突然出现在门口。
We'd been in the house a month when dark stains started appearing on the wall.  墙上开始出现一些深色的斑迹时，我们在这幢房子里已经住了一个月。
His name appears in the film credits for lighting.  他作为灯光师出现在电影演职人员名单中。

words.meaning: vt.买,买得;向…行贿,收买vi.购买东西
words.example:
Eventually she had saved enough money to buy a small car.  她最终存够了买一辆小汽车的钱。
There are more people buying at this time of the year so prices are high.  这个季节购物的人比较多，所以价格高昂。
The company was set up to buy and sell shares on behalf of investors.  成立该公司为的是代表投资者买卖股票。

words.meaning: ad.或许，大概
words.example:
I'll probably be home by midnight.  我很可能半夜到家。
I'm probably going - it depends on the weather.  我很可能会去——这要看天气怎么样。
He probably didn't even notice.  他很可能都没有觉察到。

words.meaning: a.人的,人类的 n.人
words.example:
The human body is composed of about 60% water.  人体约60%由水组成。
Early human remains were found in the Dordogne region of France.  在法国的多尔多涅地区发现了早期人类的遗迹。
Victory in the war was achieved at the cost of great human suffering.  战争的胜利是以人类的巨大痛苦为代价换来的。

words.meaning: v.(for)等待;(on)侍候 n.等候,等待时间
words.example:
The dentist kept me waiting for ages.  牙医让我等了好久。
The meeting will have to wait until tomorrow, because I'm too busy now.  会议将不得不延后到明天，因为我现在太忙了。
The paperwork can't wait until tomorrow (= is urgent and must be done now).  这些文书工作不能等到明天再做。

words.meaning: v.服务,尽责;招待,侍候;符合,适用
words.example:
Do they serve meals in the bar?  这家酒吧有提供饭菜吗？
Breakfast is served in the restaurant between 7 and 9.  餐厅早上七点到九点供应早餐。
We arrived at the hotel and were served with champagne and canapés.  我们到达旅馆后，旅馆提供了香槟和小饼干。

words.meaning: n.集市,市场;销路,需求(量) v.销售
words.example:
Are you sure there's a market for the product?  你肯定这种产品有市场吗？
We estimate the potential market for the new phones to be around one million people in this country alone.  我们估计，仅在这个国家新型电话的潜在市场就有100万人左右。
The domestic market is still depressed, but demand abroad is picking up.  国内市场仍然低迷，但国外需求正逐步上升。

words.meaning: vi.死,死亡;(草木)枯萎,凋谢;渴望
words.example:
Twelve people died in the accident.  12人在此次事故中丧生。
She died of/from hunger/cancer/a heart attack/her injuries.  她死于饥饿／癌症／心脏病／伤害。
It is a brave person who will die for their beliefs.  愿为信念而死的人称得上是勇敢者。

words.meaning: v.(sent,sent)1.打发;派遣 2.送;寄出
words.example: noun countable  informal    2. He does a brilliant send-up of the President.    他模仿总统模仿得维妙维肖。

words.meaning: v.预期;期望,指望
words.example:
We are expecting a lot of applicants for the job.  我们预计会有很多人来应征这份工作。
The financial performance of the business is fully expected (= almost certain) to improve.  公司的财务状况确定会大有改观。
We were half expecting you not to come back.  我们原本一直以为你不会回来了。

words.meaning: n.感官;感觉;判断力;意义 v.觉得,意识到
words.example:
With her keen sense of smell, she could tell if you were a smoker from the other side of the room.  她嗅觉灵敏，在房间的另一端就能知道你是否抽烟。
My cold is so bad I've lost my sense of smell/taste (= I can't smell/taste anything).  我感冒很严重，闻不到任何气味了／尝不出任何味道了。
Did you get any sense of how they might react?  你预感他们会作何反应？

words.meaning: vt.建造,建筑;建设,建立 vi.增大,增强
words.example:
They're building new houses by the river.  他们正在河边建新房子。
The birds built their nest in the small fir tree.  鸟儿们在小冷杉树上筑巢。
These old houses are built (= made) of stone.  这些老房子是用石头砌的。

words.meaning: vi.逗留;保持vt.停止,延缓n.逗留,停留
words.example:
They need an assistant who is willing to stay for six months.  他们需要一位元愿意留六个月的助手。
Stay until the rain has stopped.  等雨停再走吧。
Can you stay after work to play tennis?  你下班后能留下来打网球吗？

words.meaning: v.跌倒;下降;减弱;坠落;变成,陷于 n.秋季
words.example:
The path's very steep, so be careful you don't fall.  小路很陡，小心别摔倒。
He fell badly and broke his leg.  他重重跌倒，摔断了腿。
Athletes have to learn how to fall without hurting themselves.  运动员必须学会跌倒时怎么避免自己受伤。

words.meaning: int.嗬，哦，唉呀
words.example:
Is that for me? Oh, you're so kind!  那是给我的吗？啊，你真是太好了！
Oh, I've just thought of a problem.  噢，我刚想起一个问题。
Oh, and don't forget to lock the back door.  哦，别忘了锁后门。

words.meaning: n.民族,国家
words.example:
All the nations of the world will be represented at the conference.  会上将有各国代表。
The Germans, as a nation, are often thought to be well organized.  作为一个民族，德国人常常被认为很有组织纪律性。
Practically the whole nation watched the ceremony on television.  几乎全国民众都透过电视观看了庆典。

words.meaning: n.计划,规划;平面图,设计图 v.计划
words.example:
What are your plans for this weekend?  这个周末你有甚么计划？
Events of this type rarely go according to plan.  这类事件很少会按计划发展。noun
The architect showed us the house plans that she had drawn up.  建筑师向我们展示了她画的房屋详图。

words.meaning: n./v.切,割,削;削减,删节 n.切口,伤口
words.example:
I've cut myself/my hand on that glass/ with that knife.  我被那片玻璃／那把小刀割伤了（手）。
Cut the meat up into small pieces.  把肉切成小片。
This knife doesn't cut very well, it's not sharp enough.  这把刀不好切，不够锋利。

words.meaning: n.学院,高等专科学校,大学
words.example:
She's at art college.  她在艺术学院学习。
You have to go to (= study at) college for a lot of years if you want to be a doctor.  如果你想当医生，就必须在大学里学习好多年。
Cambridge has some very fine old colleges (= college buildings).  剑桥大学有一些非常优美古雅的学院大楼。

words.meaning: n.(in)兴趣,重要性;利益v.(in)使发生兴趣
words.example:
I've always had an interest in astronomy.  我一直对天文学感兴趣。
He never seems to show any interest in his children.  他好像从不关心他的子女。
Unfortunately, I lost interest half way through the film.  遗憾的是，这部电影我才看了一半就失去了兴趣。

words.meaning: n.死,死亡;灭亡,毁灭,死因
words.example:
The disease causes thousands of deaths a year.  这种疾病每年导致数千人死亡。
Do you believe in life after death?  你相信死后还有来世吗？
He never got over the death of his daughter.  他一直没有从女儿去世的阴影中走出来。

words.meaning: n.课程,教程;过程,进程;路程,路线;一道菜
words.example:
Tears were coursing down his cheeks.  泪水从他的脸颊滚落。
You could almost hear the blood coursing through her veins as she passed the finishing line.  她冲过终点时你几乎听得到血液在她血管里流动的声音。
figurative A new wave of idealism is coursing through our schools.  一股新的理想主义浪潮正席卷我们的学校。

words.meaning: pron.某人(=somebody)
words.example:
There's someone outside the house.  屋子外面有人。
Someone must have seen what happened.  肯定有人看见了所发生的一切。
Eventually someone in the audience spoke.  观众里终于有人开口说话了。

words.meaning: n./vt.经验;经历;体验;阅历
words.example:
We experienced a lot of difficulty in selling our house.  我们卖房子几经波折。
New companies often experience a loss in their first few years.  新公司在刚起步的几年中经常亏损。
It was the worst pain I'd ever experienced.  那是我这辈子受过最剧烈的痛楚。

words.meaning: prep.在...的背后,(遗留)在..后面;落后于
words.example:
Look behind you!  往后看！
Alex led, and I followed along behind.  亚历斯带头，我紧随其后。
mainly UK As hard as she tried, she always fell behind the other swimmers in the races.  比赛时不管她怎样努力，总是落在其他游泳选手的后面。

words.meaning: v.抵达;(out)伸手,够到 n.能达到的范围
words.example:
We won't reach Miami till five or six o'clock.  我们得五六点钟才能到达迈阿密。
They finally reached the coast after five weeks sailing.  他们经过五个星期的航行终于靠了岸。
News of his accident had only just reached us.  我们刚刚得到他出事的消息。

words.meaning: a.地方的,当地的;局部的
words.example:
Most of the local population depend on fishing for their income.  当地人大多靠捕鱼为生。
Our children all go to the local school.  我们的孩子都在当地的学校上学。
Many local shops will be forced to close if the new supermarket is built.  如果兴建这个新的超级市场，那么许多当地的商店都将被迫关闭。

words.meaning: vt.杀死,消灭;破坏,毁灭;消磨(时间)
words.example:
Her parents were killed in a plane crash.  她的父母死于一次空难。
Smoking can kill.  吸烟会危及生命。
Food must be heated to a high temperature to kill harmful bacteria.  食物必须经高温加热以杀灭有害细菌。verb

words.meaning: v.剩下,余留;留待,尚须;仍然是,依旧是
words.example:
The doctor ordered him to remain in bed for a few days.  医生嘱咐他要继续卧床几天。
Most commentators expect the basic rate of tax to remain at 25%.  大多数评论员预计基本税率会保持在25%。
He remained silent.  他保持沉默。

words.meaning: n.结果;效果;影响;印象 vt.招致;实现;达到
words.example:
The radiation leak has had a disastrous effect on/upon the environment.  核辐射外泄给环境带来了灾难性的影响。
She has a lot of confidence which she uses to good effect (= to her advantage) in interviews.  她很自信，在面试时她充分利用这一点，占尽了优势。
They had to wait ten minutes for the anaesthetic to take effect before they stitched up the cut.  他们不得不等了十分钟，在麻醉药起作用后才缝合伤口。

words.meaning: v.建议,提出;使联想,使想起…;暗示
words.example:
They were wondering where to hold the office party and I suggested the Italian restaurant near the station.  他们在考虑在哪里开办公室聚会，我提议去车站附近的义大利餐馆。
formal Might I suggest a white wine with your salmon, sir?  我建议来一杯白葡萄酒配您的鲑鱼吧，先生？
Liz suggested (that) I try the shop on Mill Road.  莉兹建议我去米尔街的那家店看看。

words.meaning: n.班级,年级;种类,等级,阶级;(一节)课
words.example:
Which class are you in this year?  今年你在哪个班？
She gave the whole class extra homework for a week.  她给全班额外安排了一星期的家庭作业。
My class (= The people in my class) was/were rather noisy this morning.  我的班里今天早上很吵。

words.meaning: n.(over)控制,支配 v.控制,支配
words.example:
If you can't control your dog, put it on a lead!  要是你管不住你的狗，就给它绑上皮带！
You're going to have to learn to control your temper.  你必须学会控制住自己的脾气。
The temperature is controlled by a thermostat.  温度由恒温器控制。

words.meaning: v.举起,提升;增加;饲养;引起;竖起;提出
words.example:
Would all those in favour please raise their hands ?  赞成的人请举手好吗？
He raised the window and leaned out.  他把窗户推上去后探出身子。
Mary Quant was the first fashion designer to raise hemlines.  玛丽．匡特是第一个把裙子裁短的时装设计师。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.小心;关怀,照料 v.(about)关心,介意,计较
words.example:
The standard of care at our local hospital is excellent.  我们当地医院的护理水准很出色。
Mira's going to be very weak for a long time after the operation, so she'll need a lot of care.  手术后，米拉在很长一段时间内会十分虚弱，所以她需要多加照顾。
Nurseries are responsible for the children in their care.  托儿所要对他们照顾的孩子负责。

words.meaning: ad.也许,大概,恐怕
words.example:
He hasn't written to me recently - perhaps he's lost my address.  他最近没写信给我——也许他把我的地址弄丢了。
Perhaps the most important question has not been asked.  或许还没有人提出最重要的问题。
We plan to travel to Europe - to Spain or Italy perhaps.  我们打算去欧洲旅行，也许去西班牙或义大利。

words.meaning: a.迟的,晚的,晚期的;已故的 ad.迟,晚
words.example:
It was late at night.  夜已经很深了。
We talked late into the night.  我们一直谈到深夜。
Is that the time? I'd no idea it was so late.  都这时候了！我不知道都这么晚了。

words.meaning: a.坚硬的;结实的;困难的;难忍的;严厉的
words.example:
There was a heavy frost last night and the ground is still hard.  昨晚霜冻很严重，地面现在仍然很坚硬。
Heating the clay makes it hard.  黏土加热会变硬。    Opposite softUK adjective
There were some really hard questions in the exam.  考试中有一些很难做的题目。

words.meaning: n.田野;运动场;(电或磁)场;领域,范围
words.example:
We drove past fields of ripening wheat.  我们驱车经过快要成熟的麦田。
The cows were all standing in one corner of the field.  乳牛全都站在牧场的一角。
There were loud cheers as the Irish team took the field.  爱尔兰队进场时欢呼声四起。noun

words.meaning: ad.其它,另外,别的;[与or连用]否则
words.example:
Everybody else has (= All the other people have) agreed except for you.  除了你其他人都同意了。
If it doesn't work, try something else (= something different).  如果这个行不通，试试别的。
Let's go before they ask us to visit anyone else (= another person).  趁他们还没有让我们再去拜访别人，我们还是走吧。

words.meaning: v.经/通/穿/度过;传递 n.通行证;考试及格
words.example:
You should only pass a slower vehicle if it is safe to do so.  只有在安全的情况下，你才应该超越较慢的车辆。
If you pass a supermarket, could you get me some milk?  你若是路过超市的话，帮我买些牛奶好吗？
Don't buy goods which have passed their sell-by date.  不要购买过了销售期限的商品。

words.meaning: a.以前的,在前的 pron.前者
words.example:
The house, a former barn, has been attractively converted.  这座房子以前是谷仓，现已改建一新，十分漂亮。
The painting was then restored to its former glory (= returned to its original good condition).  这幅油画又恢复了原先的光彩。
It was a long time after the accident before he seemed like his former self (= behaved in the way he had done before).  事故过后很长时间，他似乎才恢复了先前的样子。UK noun only singular

words.meaning: v.卖,出售
words.example:
We'll be selling the tickets at/for £50 each.  我们每张票将卖50英镑。
The stall sells drinks and snacks.  这个摊位卖饮料和小吃。
These baskets sell well (= a lot of them are bought).  这些篮子卖得很好。 (sold, sold)

words.meaning: a.主要的n.成年人,专业学生,主修课程v.主修
words.example:
All of her major plays have been translated into English.  她的主要剧本都被译成了英文。
Sugar is a major cause of tooth decay.  糖是造成蛀牙的主要原因。
There are two problems with this situation, one major, one minor.  这个情况牵涉到两个问题，一个主要的，一个次要的。

words.meaning: ad.不时,有时,间或
words.example:
Sometimes we take food with us and sometimes we buy food when we're there.  有时我们自己带食物，有时我们在那里买。
Sometimes it's best not to say anything.  有时候，最好是甚么话都别说。

words.meaning: v.需要;(of)要求,命令
words.example:
Please telephone this number if you require any further information.  如需更多资讯请拨此电话号码垂询。
Skiing at 80 miles per hour requires total concentration.  以每小时80英里的速度滑雪需要全神贯注。
You are required by law to stop your car after an accident.  法律规定，发生事故后必须停车。

words.meaning: ad.向前;和...一起,一同 prep.沿着,顺着
words.example:
Cars were parked all along the road.  沿路停满了汽车。UK preposition
Somewhere along this road there's a garage.  顺着这条路走，修车厂就在路边。UK preposition
I've been in this job for thirty years, and I've picked up a good deal of expertise along the way.  我做这份工作已经30年了，在此期间我掌握了大量专业技术。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.发展;开发；生长
words.example:
The programme traced the development of popular music through the ages.  这个节目回顾了各个年代流行音乐的发展历程。
The region suffers from under-/over-development (= having too little/much industry).  该地区苦于发展不足／过度。
Phone me if there are any new developments.  如果有甚么新动态就给我打电话。noun

words.meaning: pron.他(她、它)们自己;他(她、它)们亲自
words.example:
Did they enjoy themselves at the theatre?  他们在戏院里开心吗？
They asked themselves where they had gone wrong.  他们在反省自己哪里出错。
formal They themselves had no knowledge of what was happening.  她们自己对于正在发生的事一无所知。

words.meaning: n./v.报告,汇报;传说,传阅
words.example:
We rang the insurance company to report the theft.  我们打电话将失窃的事情告知保险公司。
The assassination was reported in all the newspapers.  所有报纸都报道了这宗暗杀事件。
The inquiry reports (= will officially make its results known) next week.  调查结果将在下周发布。

words.meaning: n.角色,作用,任务,职责
words.example:
What is his role in this project?  他在这个工程中负责甚么？
Schools play an important role in society.  学校在社会中起着非常重要的作用。
Six people have been put on trial for their role (= involvement) in the anti-government demonstrations.  六人因为参与反政府示威游行而受审。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.努力;成就;艰难的尝试
words.example:
You can't expect to have any friends if you don't make any effort with people.  如果不努力去和人们交往，你就别想有朋友。
In their efforts to reduce crime the government expanded the police force.  为了减少犯罪，政府扩充了警力。
He's jogging round the park every morning in an effort to get fit for the football season.  为了调整好身体状况迎接这个赛季的足球赛，他现在每天早晨都绕着公园慢跑。

words.meaning: v.决定,下决心;解决,裁决
words.example:
They have to decide by next Friday.  他们必须在下周五前作出决定。
He can't decide wh ether to buy it.  他决定不了要不要把它买下来。
The committee decided in favour of (= made a formal judgment to choose) the cheapest option.  委员会决定选用最经济的方案。

words.meaning: n.速率;等级;价格,费用 v.估价;评级,评价
words.example:
Although she's recovering from her illness, her rate of progress is quite slow.  尽管病情正在好转，但她康复的速度仍很慢。
The taxi was going at a tremendous rate.  计程车飞速奔驰。
The drug has a high success/failure rate.  这种药物治疗疾病的成功率／失败率很高。noun countable

words.meaning: a.强壮的,强大的;强烈的,浓的
words.example:
She must be very strong to carry such a weight on her back.  她背着这么重的东西，一定很强健。
It is surely the duty of the stronger members in a society to help those who are weak.  任何社会中，帮助弱者都是强者不可推卸的责任。
My grandmother had a strong influence/effect on my early childhood.  我祖母在我幼年对我影响很大。

words.meaning: a.可能的,做得到的;合理的;可允许的
words.example:
Is it possible to buy tickets in advance?  可以提前订票吗？
We need to send that letter off as soon as possible.  我们必须尽快把那封信寄出去。
They got as far as was humanly possible (= as far as anyone could have) before turning back.  他们折返前已经尽力能走多远就走多远了。    Opposite impossibleUK adjective

words.meaning: n.心(脏);内心,感情;热忱;中心,要点
words.example:
He's got a weak/bad heart (= His heart is not healthy).  他的心脏不太好。
Isabel's heart was beating fast with fright.  伊莎贝尔因为恐惧而心跳加快。UK noun
She has a good heart (= She is a kind person).  她心地善良。

words.meaning: n.药物;麻醉品;毒品;滞销货 v.下麻药;吸毒
words.example:
He takes several drugs for his condition.  为了治病他要吃好几种药。noun countable
She began to suspect that her son was on/taking/doing drugs.  她开始怀疑儿子在吸毒。
She was suspected of being a drug dealer / UK alsodrugs dealer (= someone who sells drugs).  她被怀疑是毒品贩子。

words.meaning: n.领袖，领导人；首领
words.example:
The Russian leader wants to introduce further changes.  俄罗斯领导人希望进一步推行改革。
He's a natural leader.  他天生就是个领导。
She was elected as leader of the campaign group.  她被推举为竞选小组的领导。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.光;灯 v.点燃;照亮 a.轻(快);淡;明亮
words.example:
Light was streaming in through the open door.  光线从敞开的门口倾泻进来。
It's a north-facing room so it doesn't get much light (= brightness from the sun).  房间朝北，所以光线有些不足。
Could you switch/turn the light on/off , please?  请把灯打开／关上好吗？

words.meaning: n.声音;嗓音;发音能力;意见,发言权;语态
words.example:
She has a loud/quiet/soft voice.  她说话声音很大／很轻／很柔。
You could tell from her voice that she wasn't pleased.  你可以从她的声音里听出来她不高兴。
She lowered her voice to a whisper.  她放低声音，轻声耳语。

words.meaning: n.妻子,夫人,太太
words.example: She's his third wife (= She is the third woman he has been married to).  她是他的第3任妻子。

words.meaning: n.全部 a.全体的;全部的;完整的;无缺的
words.example:
There's still a whole month till my birthday.  离我的生日还有整整一个月时间。
After my exercise class, my whole body ached.  体育课之后，我浑身都痛。
The whole town was destroyed by the earthquake.  地震摧毁了整个城镇。

words.meaning: n.警察,警察机关 a.警察的 v.管辖
words.example:
The police are investigating fraud allegations against him.  警方在调查对他的欺诈指控。
There should be more police patrolling the area on foot.  这一地区应该增加警力步行巡逻。verb transitive
The march will be heavily policed by an anti-riot unit.  防暴员警将对示威游行进行严密警戒。

words.meaning: n.精神,理智,意见,记忆力v.注意,介意,反对
words.example:
Her mind was full of what had happened the night before, and she just wasn't concentrating.  她脑海里满是前一天晚上所发生的事情，根本无法集中精神。
Of course I'm telling the truth - you've got such a suspicious mind!  我当然是在说实话——你太疑神疑鬼了！
I'm not quite clear in my mind about what I'm doing.  我没太意识到自己在做甚么。

words.meaning: v.拉,拖 n.拉,拖;拉力,牵引力
words.example:
Could you help me move this bookcase over there? You pull and I'll push.  你能帮我把这个书柜移到那边去吗？你拉我推。
He pulled the chair away from the desk.  他把椅子从书桌旁拉开。
He pulled the heavy box across the floor to the door.  他把地上那个沉重的箱子一直拖到门口。

words.meaning: v./n.返回,回来;归还,送还;回答
words.example:
Odysseus returned home/returned to his home after many years of travelling.  离家多年后奥德修斯返回了故土。
She left South Africa at the age of 15 and has never returned.  她15岁时离开了南非，再也没有回去过。
Within a week, the situation had returned to normal.  不到一个星期，局势就恢复正常了。

words.meaning: a.自由的;免费的;免税的;空闲的 vt.释放
words.example:
I'll give you a key then you're free to come and go as you please.  我会给你一把锁匙，这样你就可以自由进出了。
Please feel free to interrupt me if you don't understand anything.  如果有甚么不明白的地方，可以随时打断我。
The agreement gives companies free access to the markets of member countries.  该协定使各家公司可以自由进入成员国市场。

words.meaning: n.价格,价钱;代价 v.标价
words.example:
The price of oil has risen sharply.  油价急遽上涨。
House prices have been falling.  房价一直在下跌。
We thought they were asking a very high/low price.  我们认为他们要价很高／低。

words.meaning: n.决定,决心;决议;决策
words.example:
She has had to make some very difficult decisions.  她必须作出一些非常艰难的决定。
The company will reach/come to/make a decision shortly.  公司很快便会作出决定。
Let me have a/your decision (= Tell me what you have decided) by next week.  下周前告诉我你的决定。

words.meaning: v.解释,说明
words.example:
If there's anything you don't understand, I'll be happy to explain.  如果你有甚么不明白的地方，我很乐意为你讲解。
The teacher explained the rules to the children.  老师向小朋友说明规则。
He explained how the machine worked.  他解释了这部机器的操作原理。

words.meaning: n.儿子;孩子(长者对年青或年幼男子的称呼)
words.example:
This is our son Raja.  这是我们的儿子拉贾。
We have two sons and three daughters.  我们有两个儿子和三个女儿。
Come on, son, we haven't got all day.  快点，孩子，我们没有那么多时间。

words.meaning: n.希望,期望;希望的人或事 v.希望,期望
words.example:
I'm hoping for an interview next week.  我盼望着下星期有一次面试。
We have to hope and pray (that) the operation will go well.  我们只能祈祷手术顺利。
It's good news, I hope.  我希望是好消息。

words.meaning: v.发展,开发,研制;显现,显影;发育,生长
words.example:
It became clear that he wasn't developing like all the other little boys.  显然他没有像其他小男孩那样正常生长发育。
The fear is that these minor clashes may develop into all-out confrontation.  人们担心这些小小的冲突可能会演变成全面的对抗。
Over time, their acquaintance developed into a lasting friendship.  随着时间的推移，他们的泛泛之交变成了巩固的友谊。

words.meaning: n.看；视力；风景
words.example:
Do you have any views about/on what we should do now?  对于我们现在该做甚么你有甚么看法？
In my view, her criticisms were completely justified.  在我看来，她的批评完全在理。
Many people have/hold/share/take the view that children should not be smacked.  很多人都认为不应该扇孩子耳光。

words.meaning: n.关系,联系
words.example:
Scientists have established the relationship between lung cancer and smoking.  科学家们已经证明了肺癌和吸烟之间的联系。noun countable
He has a very good relationship with his uncle.  他和他叔叔的感情很深。
Have you had any serious relationships in the past year?  过去一年中你有没有正经八百地同谁谈过恋爱？

words.meaning: v.运送,搬运;传送,传播;领,带
words.example:
Would you like me to carry your bag for you?  要我帮你背背包吗？
She carried her tired child upstairs to bed.  她将疲惫的孩子抱上楼去睡觉。
These books are too heavy for me to carry.  这些书太重了，我搬不动。

words.meaning: n.市镇;市民;城市商业区,闹市区
words.example:
He was born in the small town of Castleford, in Yorkshire.  他出生于约克郡的卡斯尔福德小镇。
We stayed in the best hotel in town.  我们住在镇上最好的饭店。
I'm going into/to town at lunchtime to do some shopping.  午饭时我要到市区去买些东西。

words.meaning: n.路,道路,途径
words.example:
We live on a busy/quiet road.  我们住在一条繁忙／僻静的公路边。
Be careful when you cross a main road.  横过大马路时要小心。
There's a sweet shop on the other side of the road.  在马路对面有一间糖果店。

words.meaning: v.开(车);驱;驱动,把(钉,桩)打入 n.驾驶
words.example:
I'm learning to drive.  我在学开车。
She drives a red sports car.  她开一辆红色跑车。
They're driving to Scotland on Tuesday.  星期二他们要开车去苏格兰。

words.meaning: n.手臂,扶手,臂状物 v.武装;配备 n.武器
words.example:
My arms ache from carrying this bag.  提这个袋子累得我胳膊疼。
She put/threw her arms round me, and gave me a hug.  她伸出双臂拥抱我。
He took/held her in his arms (= held her closely).  他把她搂进怀中。

words.meaning: a.真实,不假的;忠实,可靠的;正确无误的
words.example:
The allegations, if true, could lead to her resignation.  这些指控如果属实的话，可能会导致她辞职。
Her story is only partly true.  她的描述只有部分是真实的。
Would it be true to say that you've never liked Jim?  可以说你从来就没有喜欢过吉姆，对吗？

words.meaning: a.联邦的;联邦制的;联合的;同盟的
words.example: the federal government  联邦政府

words.meaning: vt.打破;中止;违反 vi.破(裂) n.休息时间
words.example:
The dish fell to the floor and broke.  碟子掉到地上摔碎了。
Charles is always breaking things.  查尔斯老是打碎东西。
She fell and broke her arm (= broke the bone in her arm).  她摔断了胳膊。

words.meaning: n.差别,差异,分歧
words.example:
What's the difference between an ape and a monkey?  猿和猴有甚么区别？
Is there any significant difference in quality between these two items?  这两件东西在质量方面有显著的差别吗？
Exercise can make a big difference to your state of health.  运动会极大地改善你的健康状况。

words.meaning: vt.感谢int.[-s]谢谢n.[pl.]感谢(意)
words.example:
He thanked me for taking him home.  他感谢我送他回家。verb transitive
You have John to thank for this problem.  出现这个问题你该怪约翰。verb transitive
I'll thank you to leave my private papers alone.  请你不要动我的私人文件。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.收到,接到;遭受,受到;接待,接见
words.example:
Did you receive my letter?  你收到我的信了吗？
They received a visit from the police.  警方到他们家去过了。
She died after receiving a blow to the head.  她头部受击致死。

words.meaning: n.价值；价格 vt.评价
words.example:
She had already sold everything of value that she possessed.  她已经把自己所有值钱的东西都卖了。
What is the value of the prize?  那个奖项有多少奖金？
The value of the pound fell against other European currencies yesterday.  昨天英镑对其他欧洲货币的比价下挫。

words.meaning: a.国际的,世界(性)的,跨国的
words.example: Six rugby internationals (= players) were charged with taking drugs to improve their performance.  六名英式橄榄球运动员被指控为提升表现而服用禁药。

words.meaning: n.建筑(物),房屋,大楼 [同]structure
words.example:
The once-empty site was now covered with buildings.  一度空荡荡的地方现在布满了建筑物。
He started off in the building trade before opening his own restaurant.  在开餐馆以前他做建筑生意起家。

words.meaning: n.行动,动作;作用;运转;行为;战斗
words.example:
This problem calls for swift/prompt action from the government.  这个问题需要政府马上采取行动。
We must take action (= do something) to deal with the problem before it spreads to other areas.  在这个问题蔓延到其他地区之前我们一定要采取行动将其解决。
So what's the plan of action (= What are we going to do) ?  那么行动计划是甚么？

words.meaning: a.(of)满的,充满的 a./ad.完全,充分
words.example:
This cup is very full so be careful with it.  这个杯子太满了，要当心。
My plate was already full.  我的碟子已经满了。
Don't talk with your mouth full!  嘴里尽是吃的东西时就别说话！

words.meaning: n.样式,型;模范;模型,原型;模特 v.模仿
words.example:
The educational system was a model for those of many other countries.  这种教育体制是许多其他国家学习的榜样。
The council plans to build a model town on the site.  市政会计划在这个地点建设一个示范镇。
Some groups want to set up an Islamic state on the Iranian model.  一些团体想按伊朗的模式建立一个伊斯兰国家。

words.meaning: v.参加,加入;联合,连接;和…在一起
words.example:
Join the two pieces together using strong glue.  用强力胶把这两片黏起来。
The island is joined to the mainland by a road bridge.  一座公路桥将小岛和大陆连接起来。
If you join (up)the dots on the paper, you'll get a picture.  如果你将纸上的小点连起来，就会变成一幅画。

words.meaning: n.季,季节,时节
words.example:
How long does the dry/hurricane/monsoon season last?  旱／飓风／季风季要持续多久？
The British football season begins in August and ends in May.  英国足球赛季始于八月，止于五月。
Air fares are more expensive during the holiday season.  机票在度假旺季比较贵。

words.meaning: n.社会;社团,协会,社;社交界,上流社会
words.example:
These changes strike at the heart of British/American/modern society.  这些变化冲击了英国／美国／现代社会的核心。
There's a danger that we will end up blaming innocent children for society's problems.  我们最后有可能会把社会问题怪罪到无辜的孩子头上。
We must also consider the needs of the younger/older members of society.  我们必须考虑到社会上年轻人／老年人的需求。

words.meaning: n.税(款),负担 v.对…征税,使负重担
words.example:
They're putting up the tax on cigarettes.  他们要提高烟草税。
Tax cuts (= reductions in taxes) are always popular.  减税总是受欢迎的。
What do you earn before/after tax (= before/after you have paid tax on the money you earn) ?  你的税前／税后收入是多少？verb transitive

words.meaning: n.指导者,主任,导演
words.example: She has become the director of the new information centre.  她成了新的资讯中心的主任。

words.meaning: n.位置;职位;姿势,姿态;见解,立场,形势
words.example:
Well, I've found our position on the map if you want to see where we are.  好啦，如果你想知道我们现在所在位置的话，我已经在地图上找到了。
You've moved the furniture around - the sofa is in a different position.  你把家俱移动过了——沙发的位置变了。
The troops took up their battle positions at the front line.  部队进入了前线的战斗阵地。

words.meaning: vi.答应,赞同;适合,一致;商定,约定
words.example:
Ann and I never seem to agree.  安和我好像从来都没有意见一致过。
My father and I don't agree about/on very much.  在很多问题上，父亲和我意见都不一致。
We finally agreed a deal.  最终我们达成了协议。verb

words.meaning: ad.特别,尤其,格外;专门地,主要地
words.example:
She's not especially interested in sport.  她对体育运动不是特别感兴趣。
They invited her to speak especially because of her experience in inner cities.  他们邀请她来发言，主要是因为她有在旧城区生活的经历。 (also specially)

words.meaning: n.记录;最高记录;履历;唱片v.记录;录音
words.example:
Cliff Richard has recorded more number one hit songs than any other British pop star.  在英国流行乐歌星中，克利夫．理查录制的荣登排行榜榜首的歌曲数量最多。
We recorded their wedding on video.  我们给他们的婚礼录了像。
Was the concert live or was it recorded (= made before being broadcast) ?  音乐会是直播还是录播的？verb transitive UK STORE INFORMATION  储存资讯

words.meaning: v.拾,采,摘;挑选,选择 n.镐,鹤嘴锄
words.example:
Pick a card from the pack.  从这副纸牌中挑出一张。
One of my sisters has been picked for the Olympic team.  我的一个姐姐入选了奥运代表队。
The police asked him if he could pick (out) the killer from a series of photos.  员警问他能否从一组照片中认出凶手。

words.meaning: v.穿着,戴着;磨损,用旧 n.穿,戴;磨损
words.example:
Tracey is wearing a simple black dress.  特蕾西身着一袭素净的黑色长裙。
What are you wearing to Caroline's wedding?  卡罗琳的婚礼上你准备穿甚么？
Some musicians don't like to wear rings when they're playing.  有的音乐家不喜欢在演奏时戴戒指。

words.meaning: n.纸;纸制品;报纸;(pl)文件;试卷;论文
words.example:
Dictionaries are usually printed on thin paper.  字典通常用薄纸印刷。
This card is printed on recycled paper (= paper made from used paper).  这张卡片是用再生纸印制的。
Get the idea down on paper (= write it) before you forget it.  把想法写在纸上以免忘了。

words.meaning: a.特殊的,专门的;附加的,额外的
words.example:
The car has a number of special safety features.  这辆汽车配备有一些特别的安全装置。
Is there anything special that you'd like to do today?  今天你有没有甚么特别的事要做？
Passengers should tell the airline in advance if they have any special dietary needs.  乘客如有特殊的饮食需要，须事先向航空公司说明。

words.meaning: n.间隔;空地,余地;空间 v.留间隔,隔开
words.example:
Is there any space for my clothes in that cupboard?  那个衣橱还放得下我的衣服吗？
I've got to make (some) space for Mark's things.  我得为马克挪点地方放他的东西。
When the roads are wet, you've got to leave plenty of space between you and the car in front.  路面湿滑，你必须和前车保持足够的距离。

words.meaning: n.地,地面,土地;场地,场所;理由,根据
words.example:
The ground was frozen hard and was impossible to dig.  土地冻实了，根本挖不动。
We went for a walk around the hospital grounds.  我们在医院的院子里散步走了几圈。noun
She is suing the company on grounds of unfair dismissal.  她正以公司不公正解雇她为由对其提起诉讼。

words.meaning: n.形状,形式;表格 v.组成,构成;形成
words.example:
She formed the clay into a small bowl.  她把陶土捏成了一只小碗。
The lorries formed a barricade across the road.  数辆货车横在路上，形成了路障。
Together they would form the next government.  他们将共同组建下届政府。

words.meaning: n./vt.支撑;支持;赡养;维持 n.支持者;支柱
words.example:
My father supported the Labour Party all his life.  我父亲毕生都拥护工党。
The majority of people in the town strongly support the plans to build a by-pass.  镇上的大部分人都强烈支持修建旁路的计划。
Which team do you support?  你支持哪队？UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.事件,事情
words.example:
This year's Olympic Games will be the biggest ever sporting event.  今年的奥林匹克运动会将是历史上规模最大的体育盛事。
Susannah's party was the social event of the year.  苏珊娜办的派对是当年社交界的一大盛事。
The police are trying to determine the series of events that led up to the murder.  警方正试图顺藤摸瓜，查清引发谋杀的一连串事件。

words.meaning: n.官员,行政官员 a.官方的,官方的,正式的
words.example:
He visited China in his official capacity as America's trade representative.  他以美方贸易代表的身份访问了中国。
Number Ten Downing Street is the British prime minister's official residence.  唐宁街10号是英国首相的官邸。    Opposite unofficial
The official photos of the prime minister's tour of India are in the magazine.  首相印度之行的官方照片刊登在该杂志上。

words.meaning: pron.谁的;哪(个)人的,那些(人)的
words.example:
Whose is this bag?  这是谁的袋子？
Whose bag is this?  这个袋子是谁的？determiner
Cohen, whose contract expires next week, is likely to move to play for a European club.  科恩的合约下周到期，他有可能到一家欧洲球会效力。

words.meaning: n.物质,物体;毛病,麻烦;事情 v.有关系,要紧
words.example:
Could I talk to you about a personal matter?  我能和你谈件私事吗？
Alois denied any knowledge of the matter.  阿洛伊斯否认对此事知情。
Will you phone me back - it's a matter of some importance.  可否回电话给我——有比较重要的事。

words.meaning: pron.(everybody)每人,人人,各人
words.example:
Would everyone who wishes to attend the dinner let me know by Friday afternoon?  想去参加晚宴的人，请在星期五下午前通知我好吗？
Everyone has their own ideas about the best way to bring up children.  对甚么是养育孩子的最好方法，每个人都有自己的看法。
I've received replies from everybody but Jane.  除了简之外，所有人都给了我回覆。

words.meaning: n. 中心，中央；中锋；中心点；vi. 居中，被置于中心；vt. 集中，使聚集在一点；定中心；adj. 中央的，位在正中的；n. (Center)人名；(英)森特
words.example: The mall is in the city center.  商场在市中心。

words.meaning: n.(一)对,双;夫妇; v.连接,结合
words.example:
The doctor said my leg should be better in a couple of days.  医生说我的腿过几天就会好转。
We'll have to wait another couple of hours for the paint to dry.  我们还得再等几个小时油漆才干。
She'll be retiring in a couple more years.  她再过几年就退休了。

words.meaning: n.方案,工程,项目v.投射,放映;设计,规划
words.example:
Her latest project is a film based on the life of a nineteenth-century music hall star.  她最近计划拍摄一部关于某位19世纪歌厅歌星一生的影片。
My next project is decorating the kitchen.  我下一步计划整修厨房。
He's doing a class project on pollution.  他正在做一个有关污染的学校作业。

words.meaning: v.打,击;碰撞 n.击中;成功而风行一时的事物
words.example: The typhoon hit the coast at night.  台风夜里登陆了海岸。

words.meaning: n.基础,底部;根据地 v.(on)把…基于
words.example:
At the base of the cliff was a rocky beach.  悬崖的下面是布满岩石的海滩。
This cream provides an excellent base for your make-up (= a good bottom layer on which other layers can be put).  这种乳霜化妆打底用效果极好。noun
Nice is an excellent base for (= place to stay when) exploring the French Riviera.  尼斯是游览法国海滨渡假胜地的理想去处。

words.meaning: n.活动;活力;能动性;
words.example:
There was a lot of activity in preparation for the Queen's visit.  大家都在为准备迎接女王来访而忙碌。
Ministers are concerned by the low level of economic activity.  各部长都为经济不景气而担忧。
There was a sudden flurry of activity when the director walked in.  经理一走进来，大家马上一片手忙脚乱。UK noun

words.meaning: n.星;恒星;明星 v.用星号标出;扮演主角
words.example:
Stars twinkled above them as they lay on the hill.  他们躺在小山上，头顶上繁星闪烁。UK noun
Kids wanting to be stars come to Hollywood from all over America.  想当明星的年轻人从美国各地来到好莱坞。
How many stars (= symbols showing quality) has this restaurant got?  这家餐厅是几星级的？

words.meaning: n.桌子;餐桌;工作台;表格 vt.搁置;提交讨论
words.example:
There was a really noisy table behind us celebrating someone's birthday.  我们后面的一桌人在给人庆祝生日，吵吵闹闹的。
Could you lay the table for lunch, please?  你来摆餐桌准备吃午饭好吗？noun
They offered him money under the table to change his mind.  他们私下贿赂他，令他改变主意。verb transitive    UK

words.meaning: n.法院,法庭;宫廷,朝廷;院子;球场
words.example:
Protestors gathered outside the court to await the verdict.  抗议者聚集在法庭外等待判决。
He's due to appear in court again on Monday.  他定于周一再次出庭。
Please describe to the court exactly what you saw.  请向法官陈述你看到的真实情况。

words.meaning: v.生产,制造,显示,演出,导致 n.产品
words.example:
France produces a great deal of wine for export.  法国生产大量葡萄酒供出口。
Red blood cells are produced in the bone marrow.  红血球细胞在骨髓内生成。
She works for a company that produces (= makes for sale) electrical goods.  她在一家生产电子产品的公司工作。

words.meaning: vt.吃,喝 vi.吃饭,吃东西
words.example:
Do you eat meat?  你吃肉吗？
When I've got a cold, I don't feel like eating.  我感冒时没有食欲。
We usually eat (= have a meal) at about 7 o'clock.  我们通常在七点前后吃饭。 (ate, eaten)

words.meaning: vt.教,讲授;教导(训)vi.讲课,当教师
words.example:
She taught English to foreign students.  她给外国学生讲授英语。
Ever since she was a child her dream has been to teach school.  从童年时起，去学校教书便一直是她的梦想。 (taught, taught)
Having my car stolen really taught me a lesson - I'll never leave it unlocked again.  我的车被盗的确给了我一个教训——我再也不会不锁车了。

words.meaning: n.油,石油 v.给…加润滑油;涂油,上油
words.example:
Do you paint in oils or watercolours?  你画油画还是水彩画？verb transitive
An aid programme was established to oil the wheels of economic reform in the region.  制定了一项援助计划，使该地区的经济改革得以顺利进行。

words.meaning: n.半,一半 a.一半的,不完全的 ad.一半地
words.example:
Roughly half (of) the class are Spanish and the others are a mixture of nationalities.  班上大约有一半是西班牙人，其余的则来自各个国家。
Cut the apple in half] into halves (= into two equal parts).  把这个苹果切成两半。
My little brother is half as tall as me/half my height.  我弟弟有我一半高。

words.meaning: n.形势,处境,状况;位置,场所;职位,职务
words.example:
Her news put me in a difficult situation.  她的消息让我陷入困境。
I'll worry about it if/when/as the situation arises (= if/when/as it happens).  这种情况发生时，我会担心。
My sister has a good situation as a teacher in the local school.  我姐姐有一份好工作，在当地学校当老师。

words.meaning: a.容易的,不费力的,安逸的,宽裕的
words.example:
Would a ten o'clock appointment be easier for you?  会面定在十点是不是对你更方便一点？
She's very easy to talk to.  她平易近人，跟她很容易谈得来。
The easiest thing to do would be for us to take the train home.  对我们来说，最简单的做法莫过于坐火车回家。

words.meaning: n.成本,费用,代价 v.价值为,花费
words.example:
When you buy a new computer, you usually get software included at no extra cost (= for no additional money).  买电脑时通常免费附送软体。
For many parents, two salaries are essential to cover the cost of (= pay for) school fees.  对许多家长来说，要支付孩子学费双职薪水必不可少。
The supermarket chain announced that it was cutting the cost (= reducing the price) of all its fresh and frozen meat.  这家连锁超市宣布其所有鲜肉和冷冻肉减价销售。

words.meaning: n.工业,产业;勤劳,勤奋
words.example:
The city needs to attract more industry.  这个城市需要吸引更多的工业。
The strike seriously reduced coal deliveries to industry.  罢工使得向工业输送的煤炭量大幅下降。noun
The computer industry has been booming.  电脑行业已经日益蓬勃起来了。

words.meaning: n.体形;轮廓;数字;图形v.描绘;计算;推测
words.example:
Can you read this figure? Is it a three or an eight?  你能认出这个数字吗？是3还是8？
Write the amount in both words and figures.  请用文字和数字两种形式将数目写出来。
He earns a six-figure salary (= an amount of money with six figures).  他的薪水有六位数。

words.meaning: n.街,街道;行车道
words.example:
The streets were strewn with rubbish after the carnival.  狂欢节过后，街上到处是垃圾。
Our daughter lives just across the street from us.  我们的女儿就住在街对面。
Diane's house is UKin / USon Cherrywood Street.  戴安娜的房子在切里伍德街上。

words.meaning: pron.(it的反身代词)它自己,它本身
words.example:
The cat licked itself all over.  猫舔遍自己的身体。
The shop itself (= only the shop and nothing else) started 15 years ago but the mail order side of the business is new.  这家商店15年前就开业了，但邮购业务却是新增的。
The dog managed to drag the box into the room by itself (= without help).  这只狗独自将盒子拖进了房间里。

words.meaning: ad.也(不) pron.两者之一 a.(两者中)任一的
words.example:
They do really good food at that restaurant and it's not very expensive either.  那家餐厅饭菜做得很好，而且价格也不太贵。UK determiner pronoun conjunction
Either candidate would be ideal for the job.  这两个人任何一个都是做这项工作的理想人选。
You can get there by train or bus - either way/in either case it'll take an hour.  去那里你想坐火车和大巴士都行——怎么去都得花一个小时。

words.meaning: n.(datum的复数)资料,数据
words.example:
The data was/were collected by various researchers.  这些资讯是由各类研究人员收集起来的。
Now the data is/are being transferred from magnetic tape to hard disk.  现在这些数据正从磁碟转存到硬碟。

words.meaning: v.覆盖,包括,涉及 n.盖子,套子;(书的)封面
words.example:
The light was so bright that I had to cover my eyes.  灯光太亮，我只好遮住眼睛。
Snow covered the hillsides.  白雪覆盖了山坡。
She covered him (up) with a blanket.  她给他盖上了毯子。

words.meaning: ad.十分,完全;相当,颇;的确,真正
words.example:
I'm quite tired but I can certainly walk a little further.  我有些累，但肯定还能再多走一会儿。
There was quite a lot of traffic today but yesterday was even busier.  今天的交通够塞了，不过昨天更拥挤。
It was quite a difficult job.  那工作实在很难做。

words.meaning: n.画,图片;影片;美景 v.画,描述,想象
words.example:
Atticus drew/painted a picture of my dog.  阿提库斯画了一幅我的狗的画像。
We took a picture of (= photographed) the children on their new bicycles.  我们拍了一张孩子骑新自行车的照片.
We can't get a clear picture.  我们看不到清晰的画面。

words.meaning: a./ad.清晰的(地)vt.清除;使清楚vi.变清澈
words.example:
Can we make the sound any clearer?  我们能把声音再调清晰一点吗？
These books have lovely clear print.  这些书印刷得清晰可人。
Our new television has a very clear picture.  我们的新电视影像十分清晰。

words.meaning: n.练习,实践,实际,业务,惯例,习惯
words.example:
It seemed like a good idea before we started, but in practice it was a disaster.  在我们动手之前这似乎是个好主意，但实际上却是场灾难。
Officially, Robert's in charge, but in practice Hannah runs the office.  据称应该是罗伯特负责办事处的工作，但实际上却是汉娜在管。
How do you intend to put these proposals into practice, Mohamed?  穆罕默德，你打算如何把这些计划付诸实行？noun

words.meaning: n.(一)件/片/篇;碎片v.(together)拼合,拼凑
words.example:
He cut the cake into six pieces.  他把蛋糕切成六块。
This jigsaw puzzle has two pieces missing.  这个拼图玩具少了两块。
The vase lay on the floor in pieces (= broken into small parts).  花瓶碎片散落一地。

words.meaning: n.陆地,土地,国家 v.(使)靠岸(登陆,降落)
words.example:
It is cheaper to drill for oil on land than at sea.  在陆地上钻探石油比在海上更经济。
The treaty has led to a dramatic reduction in the number of land -based missiles in Europe.  该条约的签订导致了欧洲陆基导弹的数量大幅减少。
The military commanders won't deploy their land forces until they're satisfied that the air attacks have done their job.  军队指挥官们将一直等到他们觉得空中打击奏效了之后才会开始部署地面部队。

words.meaning: a.新近的,近来的
words.example:
Is that a recent photo?  那张照片是最近照的吗？
Have you been following recent political events?  你关注最近发生的政治事件了吗？
In recent times/years/months, etc. there has been an increase in the amount of violence on television.  近来／几年／几个月，电视节目中的暴力内容越来越多。

words.meaning: v.描述,形容
words.example:
Could you describe your attacker?  你能描述一下袭击者的样子吗？
He described the painting in detail.  他详细地描述了那幅油画的内容。
She described Gary as shy.  她说加利很害羞。

words.meaning: n.产品,产物;乘积
words.example:
They do a range of skin-care products.  他们生产一系列的护肤品。
The product is so good it sells itself.  这种产品非常好，不需要促销。
I'm trying to cut down on dairy products.  我正设法减少乳制品的食用量。

words.meaning: n.医生;博士 vt.授以博士学位;诊断;修改
words.example:
The doctor prescribed some pills.  医生开了一些药。
You should see a doctor about that cough.  你咳嗽应该找医生看看。
[as form of address] Good morning, Doctor Smith/Doctor.  早上好，史密斯医生／医生。

words.meaning: n.墙,壁,围墙vt.筑墙围住,用墙隔开
words.example:
The walls in this apartment are so thin you can hear just about every word the neighbours say.  这间公寓的墙太薄了，甚至隔壁的人说的每一句话你都可以听见。
The walls look a bit bare - can't we put some pictures up?  这些墙看起来有点光秃秃的——我们能不能挂几幅画呢？
We had to climb over a ten-foot wall to get into the garden.  我们不得不翻过一堵十呎高的墙以进到花园里。

words.meaning: a.有耐心的,能忍耐的 n.病人,患者
words.example:
I'm a patient of Dr Stephens, please could I make an appointment to see her?  我是史蒂芬斯医生的病人，请问我能不能预约一下看病时间？adjective
Dinner will be ready in half an hour - just be patient!  晚餐半小时后就好——耐心点！
Be patient with her - she's very young.  对她耐心点——她年纪还小。    Opposite impatient

words.meaning: n.工人,工作者,工作人员
words.example: Many companies still treat their management staff better than their workers.  很多公司给管理人员的待遇仍然比给工人的要好。

words.meaning: n.新闻,消息;新闻报道,新闻广播
words.example:
That's the best (piece of) news I've heard for a long time!  那是我很长时间以来听到过最好的消息！
We've had no news of them since they left for Australia.  自从他们去了澳大利亚之后，我们一直没有他们的消息。
Have you heard the news about Tina and Tom? They're getting divorced.  你听说天娜和汤姆的事情了吗？他们要离婚了。

words.meaning: n./vt.试验;检验;测验
words.example:
The class are doing/having a spelling test today.  今天班里有一个拼写测验。
She had to take/do/sit an aptitude test before she got the job.  她先接受了能力测试后才得到这份工作。
The doctors have done some tests to try and find out what's wrong with her.  医生做了一些检查，想查出她的问题出在哪里。

words.meaning: n.电影,电影院
words.example:
My favourite movie is 'Casablanca'.  我最喜爱的电影是《北非谍影》。
What's on/showing at the movies this week?  这个星期电影院有甚么电影上映？
Shall we go to the movies tonight?  今晚去看电影好吗？

words.meaning: a.某,某一,某些;(of)一定的,确信的,可靠的
words.example:
You should make certain (that) everyone understands the instructions.  你应该确保大家都能听懂指令。
The police seem certain (that) they will find the people responsible for the attack.  警方似乎确信他们会查出谁须对这次袭击事件负责。
He was quite certain about/of his attacker's identity.  他对袭击他的人的身份十分肯定。

words.meaning: n.北,北方a.北方的,北部 ad.向北方,在北方
words.example:
Go due (= directly) north for two miles.  往北直走两英里。
The garden faces north and doesn't get much sun in winter.  花园朝北，冬天没有多少阳光。

words.meaning: a.个人的,私人的;亲自的;身体的,人身的
words.example:
My personal opinion/view is that the students should be doing more work outside the classroom.  我个人认为学生应该多做一些课外作业。
Her uncle takes a personal interest in her progress.  她叔叔本人很关心她的进步。
She has her own personal secretary/bodyguard/fitness instructor.  她有自己的私人秘书／保镖／健身教练。

words.meaning: n.科学技术;工业技术;应用科学
words.example:
Modern technology is amazing, isn't it?  现代技术很奇妙，是不是？
What this country needs is a long-term policy for investment in science and technology.  这个国家所需要的是科技投入方面的长期政策。

words.meaning: v.捕捉,捕获;赶上;感染;理解,听到
words.example:
We saw the eagle swoop from the sky to catch its prey.  我们看到老鹰从空中猛扑下去抓捕猎物。
Our dog ran past me and out of the house before I could catch it.  我们的狗从我身边跑过，我没抓住，让它跑出了屋子。
He caught hold of my arm.  他一把抓住了我的胳膊。

words.meaning: n.步;台阶,梯级;步骤,措施 v.踏,走,举步
words.example:
She stepped backwards and fell over a chair.  她向后退，撞到并摔倒在椅子上。
They stepped out onto the balcony.  他们走出房间，来到阳台上。
Be careful not to step in the mud.  小心，别踩进泥里。

words.meaning: n.婴儿;年龄最小的人;小动物 a.婴儿似的
words.example:
Sandra had a baby (= gave birth to it) on May 29th.  桑德拉在5月29日生了孩子。
Owen is the baby (= the youngest person) of the family.  奥云是家中年龄最小的。
It didn't hurt that much - don't be such a baby!  不至于那么痛——别像个孩子似的！

words.meaning: n.计算机,电脑;计算者
words.example:
All our customer orders are handled by computer.  我们所有顾客的订单都是用电脑来处理的。
We've put all our records on computer.  我们把自己所有的纪录都输入了电脑。

words.meaning: n.型式,类型;印刷字体;活/铅字 v.打字
words.example:
There were so many different types of bread that I didn't know which to buy.  面包种类繁多，我不知该买哪一种。
What type of clothes does she wear?  她穿甚么类型的衣服？
It was dark so I didn't notice what type of car it was.  天太黑，我没有注意到那是甚么车型。

words.meaning: n.注意,注意力;立正;特别照顾;照料
words.example:
Ladies and gentlemen, could I have your attention, please?  女士们、先生们，请安静。
They're organizing a campaign to draw people's attention to the environmentally harmful effects of using their cars.  他们正在组织一场运动，目的是使人们意识到开车对环境造成的危害。
Wait a moment and I'll give you my full/undivided attention (= I'll listen to and think about only you).  等一下，过一会儿我就可以全神贯注听你说了。

words.meaning: v.拉;画;汲取;引出;(to)挨近 n.平局;拖曳
words.example:
Jonathan can draw brilliantly.  乔纳森的画画得相当棒。
The children drew pictures of their families.  孩子们画了自己的家人。
Draw a line at the bottom of the page.  在本页的底部画一条线 。UK verb (drew, drawn)

words.meaning: n.电影;胶片;薄膜,薄层 vt.把..拍成电影
words.example:
What's your favourite film?  你最喜欢哪部电影？
We took the children to (see) a film.  我们带了孩子去看场电影。
She had a long career in films/film (= the business of making films).  她曾长期从事电影业。

words.meaning: n.树,树状物 vi.爬上树
words.example: We sat under a tree for shade.  我们坐在树下乘凉。

words.meaning: a.红的,红色的 n.红色;红色颜料
words.example:
The dress was bright red.  这件连衣裙是鲜红色的。
Look, you've embarrassed him - he's gone bright red!  瞧，你让他很尴尬——他的脸都红了！
Don't tell him you're a vegetarian - it's like a red rag to a bull.  不要告诉他你是个素食主义者——这会让他极为不快。adjective (redder, reddest)

words.meaning: ad.差不多,几乎
words.example:
It's been nearly three months since my last haircut.  从我上次理发到现在，已经快三个月了。
I've nearly finished that book you lent me.  你借给我的那本书我快要看完了。
She's nearly as tall as her father now.  她现在几乎和她父亲一样高了。

words.meaning: n.(organization)组织,团体,机构
words.example:
The article was about the international aid organizations.  这篇文章是关于国际援助组织的。(UK usually organisation) UK noun
He didn't want to be involved in the organization of/for the conference, although he was willing to attend and speak.  他不想参与大会的组织筹备工作，不过他愿意出席会议并发言。(UK usually organisation) UK noun

words.meaning: v.选择,挑选;甘愿
words.example:
She had to choose between the two men in her life.  面对生命中的两个男人，她不得不从中作出选择。
Danny, come here and choose your ice cream.  丹尼，到这里来挑你喜欢吃的霜淇淋。
He chose a shirt from the many in his wardrobe.  他从衣柜里众多衬衫中选了一件。

words.meaning: n.原因;事业,事件,奋斗目标 v.使产生,引起
words.example:
The police are still trying to establish the cause of the fire.  警方仍在努力调查失火的原因。
She had died of natural causes.  她是自然死亡。
He's never given me any cause for concern.  他从未让我担心过。UK noun

words.meaning: n.毛发,头发;绒毛,毛状物
words.example:
He's got short dark hair.  他的头发短而黑。
I'm going to have/get my hair cut.  我要去理发。
She brushed her long red hair.  她梳理她那长长的红头发。

words.meaning: n.世纪,(一)百年
words.example:
The city centre has scarcely changed in over a century.  一百多年来市中心几乎没有变化。
This sculpture must be centuries old.  这座雕塑一定有好几百年历史了。
Her medical career spanned half a century.  她的从医生涯长达半个世纪。    Compare millennium

words.meaning: n.明显;显著;根据;证据;迹象
words.example:
The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.  警方没有发现任何证据证明这宗谋杀案和恐怖分子有关。
Several experts are to give evidence on the subject.  几位专家将就这个问题提出证据。
There is only circumstantial evidence against her, so she is unlikely to be convicted.  只有间接证据对她不利，所以她不大可能被定罪。

words.meaning: n.窗,窗口
words.example:
Is it all right if I open/close the window?  我打开／关上窗户可以吗？
He caught me staring out of the window.  他看到我正在向窗外凝视。
She's got some wonderful plants in the window (= on a surface at the bottom of the window).  她窗台上摆了些奇妙的植物。

words.meaning: a.困难的,艰难的
words.example:
Many things make it difficult for women to reach the top in US business.  有很多因素使女性难以进入美国商界的上层。
His wife is a very difficult person.  他妻子是个难以接近的人。
Please children, don't be so difficult!  孩子们，不要这样没规矩！

words.meaning: vi.倾听(与介词to并用,方可置宾语)
words.example:
What kind of music do you listen to ?  你听哪一类的音乐？
She does all the talking - I just sit and listen.  她一直在说——我只是坐在那里听。
You haven't listened to a word I've said!  我说的话你一个字都没听！

words.meaning: ad.不久,即刻;快,早
words.example:
She'll soon be here./She'll be here soon.  她很快就到。
It will soon be impossible for foreigners to enter the country.  不久以后，外国人就不能进入这个国家了。
The sooner we leave, the sooner we'll get there.  我们出发得越早，到那里也就越早。

words.meaning: n.文化,文明;修养;耕种;栽培,培育;
words.example:
She's studying modern Japanese language and culture.  她在研究现代日本语言和文化。
You won't find much culture in this sleepy little town, I'm afraid!  在这座死气沉沉的小镇里，恐怕你不会发现多少文化内涵！

words.meaning: n.机会;可能性;偶然性,运气v.碰巧,偶然发生
words.example:
Society has to give prisoners a second chance when they come out of jail.  犯人出狱后社会必须再给他们一次机会。
He left and I missed my chance to say goodbye to him.  他走了，我失去了跟他道别的机会。
I'd go now given half a chance (= If I had the slightest opportunity).  有一丁点的机会我现在就会走。UK noun

words.meaning: n.兄弟;同胞;教友
words.example:
Do you have any brothers and sisters?  你有兄弟姐妹吗？
Johnny is my younger/older/big/baby/little brother.  强尼是我的弟弟／哥哥／大哥／小弟弟。
My brother lives in Washington.  我哥哥住在华盛顿。

words.meaning: n.活力,精力;能,能量
words.example:
Since I started eating more healthily I've got so much more energy.  自从更加注意饮食健康以来，我精力愈发充沛了。
approving Her writing is full of passion and energy (= enthusiasm).  她的文章中充满热情和活力。
I'm going to channel all my energies into getting a better job.  我要全力以赴去找个更好的工作。UK noun

words.meaning: n.时期,时代;学时;周期,一段时间;句点
words.example:
Her work means that she spends long periods away from home.  她的工作意味着她须长时间离家在外。
Unemployment in the first half of 1993 was 2% lower than in the same period the year before.  1993年上半年的失业率比前一年同期低2%。
Fifteen people were killed in/over a period of four days.  在四天内有15人被杀。

words.meaning: n.夏天,夏季 a.夏季的
words.example:
We have breakfast on the balcony in (the) summer.  夏天，我们在阳台上吃早饭。
Last summer they went to Australia, and two summers ago they went to Brazil.  去年夏天他们去了澳大利亚，前年夏天他们去了巴西。
It was a perfect summer's day.  那是一个美妙的夏日。

words.meaning: vt.实现；认识到
words.example:
They didn't realize the danger they were in.  他们没有意识到自己身处危险之中。
As he watched the TV drama, he suddenly realized (that) he'd seen it before.  他在看那部电视剧的时候，忽然意识到以前曾看过。
Lots of money, a luxury house, a fast car - Danny had realized all his ambitions by the age of 25.  钜款、豪宅、跑车——丹尼所有的愿望都在25岁前实现了。

words.meaning: num.百,一百;[pl.]许多 a.一百的;许多
words.example:
We've driven a/one hundred miles in the last two hours.  这两个小时我们已经开了100英哩了。
That dress costs hundreds of pounds.  那条裙子价值数百英镑。
There were hundreds of people at the pool today.  今天游泳池里人很多。

words.meaning: a.(用于物)可利用的;可见到的,接受采访的
words.example:
Is this dress available in a larger size?  这件衣服有更大一号的吗？
Our autumn catalogue is now available from our usual stockists.  秋季商品目录现已推出，请到我们公司定点批发零售商处索取。
There's no money available for an office party this year.  今年没有钱举办办公室派对了。

words.meaning: n.植物,作物;工厂;装置 v.栽种,播种,栽培
words.example:
The industry was accused of having invested little in workers, plant or infrastructure.  工业界被指责在工人、工厂和基础设施方面投入太少。
Two more car-assembly plants were closed by the strike.  又有两家汽车装配厂因罢工而关闭。
The sign by the roadworks said 'Slow - heavy plant crossing'.  道路工程旁边的告示牌上写著「减速——前方有重型施工机械”。

words.meaning: a.很可能的,有希望的 ad.大概,多半
words.example:
Do remind me because I'm likely to forget.  一定要提醒我，因为我可能会忘记。
What's the likely outcome of this whole business?  整宗事件可能会出现甚么结果？
As likely as not, she'll end up in court over this problem.  关于这个问题她最终很可能会诉诸法律。adjective

words.meaning: n.学期;期限,期间;(pl.)条件,条款;术语
words.example:
He received a prison term for drunk driving.  他因酒后驾驶被监禁。
The Government's term of office (= The period in which they have power) expires at the end of the year.  这届政府的任期年底届满。
In Britain, the spring term starts in January and ends just before Easter.  在英国，春季学期从一月份开始，到复活节前夕结束。

words.meaning: a.短的,矮的;(of)缺乏,不足 n.(pl.)短裤
words.example:
Her hair is much shorter than it used to be.  她的头发比过去短多了。
It's only a short walk to the station.  去车站只需走很短一段路程。
I'm quite short but my brother's very tall.  我很矮，可我弟弟很高。

words.meaning: n.信,函件;字母,文字
words.example: the letter D  字母D

words.meaning: n.条件,状况,环境 vt.决定;支配;训练
words.example:
Mum's still got our pram - it's very old, but it's in perfect condition.  妈妈还留着我们的婴儿车——虽然很旧了，但仍然完好。
They left the flat in a terrible condition - there was mess everywhere.  他们把公寓房间弄得一团糟——到处一片狼藉。
The hospital say her condition (= state of health) is improving slowly.  医院说她的健康状况正在慢慢好转。

words.meaning: n.选择(机会),抉择,选择项;入选者 a.精选的
words.example:
If the product doesn't work, you are given the choice of a refund or a replacement.  如果产品不能使用，可选择退款或换货。
It's a difficult choice to make.  这很难抉择。
It's your choice/The choice is yours (= only you can decide).  这由你决定。

words.meaning: a.单人的;单一的,单个的;未婚的,独身的
words.example:
He knocked his opponent down with a single blow.  他仅用一拳就打倒了对手。
Not a single person offered to help her.  没有一个人主动出来帮她。
You haven't been listening to a single word I've been saying.  我说的你连一个字都没听进去。    Compare doubleadjective

words.meaning: v.统治;支配;裁定n.规章,条例;习惯;统治
words.example:
The first/most important rule in life is always to appear confident.  人生的首要法则就是永远要表现得自信。
Before you start your own business you should be familiar with the government's rules and regulations.  在创立自己的公司之前，你应该了解政府的有关条例和规定。
You must follow/obey/observe the rules.  你一定要遵守规则。

words.meaning: n.女儿
words.example: Liz and Phil have a daughter and three sons.  莉兹和菲尔有一个女儿和三个儿子。

words.meaning: n.经营,管理;行政,行政机关,管理部门
words.example:
Teachers complain that more of their time is taken up with administration than with teaching.  教师抱怨他们花在行政工作上的时间超过了教学的时间。
She has little experience in administration (= in organizing a business, etc.).  她没有甚么管理经验。noun
There are strict controls on the administration of drugs.  药品的施用受严格管制。

words.meaning: n.南,南方,南部 a.南方的,南部的
words.example:
The points of the compass are North, South, East and West.  指南针上的四个方位分别是北、南、东、西。
The best beaches are in the south (of the island).  最好的海滩位于（岛的）南部。
We usually spend our holidays in the South of France.  我们通常在法国南部度假。

words.meaning: n.丈夫
words.example:
I've never met Fiona's husband.  我从未见过费欧娜的丈夫。noun countable
Although never married, they lived together as husband and wife for fifty years.  尽管没有结婚，他们却像夫妻一样共同生活了50年。verb transitive formal

words.meaning: n.地板,(楼房)的层
words.example:
The floor was partly covered with a dirty old rug.  部分地板上铺着肮脏的旧地毯。
The bathroom floor needs cleaning.  浴室地面需要清洁。
The children sat playing on the floor.  孩子们正坐在地板上玩。

words.meaning: n.战役;运动
words.example:
The protests were part of their campaign against the proposed building development in the area.  抗议是他们反对拟在该地区进行房地产开发的运动的一部分。
This is the latest act of terrorism in a long-standing and bloody campaign of violence.  这是由来已久的血腥暴力运动中的最新一次恐怖活动。
The endless public appearances are an inevitable part of an election campaign.  没完没了的公开露面是竞选活动不可或缺的组成部分。

words.meaning: n.材料,原料,资料a.物质的,肉体的,实质性的
words.example:
Crude oil is used as the raw (= basic) material for making plastics.  原油是制造塑胶的原料。UK noun
I'm in the process of collecting material for an article that I'm writing.  我正在为所写的一篇文章搜集资料。UK noun
How much material will you need to make the skirt?  做这条裙子你需要多少布料？UK noun

words.meaning: n.人口,(全体)居民
words.example:
Ten per cent of the population lived in poverty.  10%的人口生活在贫困之中。
In 1992 the population of Cairo was approximately 6 500 000.  1992年开罗的人口约为650万。
Throughout the war, there were horrific casualties amongst the civilian populations of both countries.  整个战争期间，两国人民伤亡惨重。

words.meaning: a.医学的,医疗的,医药的;内科的
words.example: The insurance company wanted me to have a medical.  保险公司要我做一次体检。

words.meaning: n.医院
words.example: a general/children's/maternity hospital  综合／儿童／妇产医院

words.meaning: n.教堂;教会,教派;(宗教的)礼拜仪式
words.example:
The town has four churches.  镇上有四座教堂。
All the local churches were represented at the memorial service.  所有的地方教会都派代表参加了这次纪念仪式。
He went on a walking trip with some of his friends from church.  他跟教会的一些朋友去远足了。

words.meaning: v./n.关;结束 a./ad.近的(地);紧密的(地)
words.example:
Could you close the door/window please?  请关上门／窗，好吗？
Close your eyes - I've got a surprise for you.  闭上眼睛——我有个惊喜给你。
The banks had closed (to customers) so I couldn't get any money out.  银行关门了，所以我取不了钱。

words.meaning: v.冒…的危险 n.冒险;风险
words.example:
In this business, the risks and the rewards are high.  这个行业的风险和回报都很高。
There's a high risk of another accident happening in this fog.  这样大的雾，很有可能再次出事故。
The company is quite a good risk (= safe to lend money to).  贷款给这间公司风险很小。

words.meaning: n.火;火灾,失火;炉火 vi.开火 vt.放(枪)
words.example:
Animals are usually afraid of fire.  动物通常都怕火。
The fire was started by children playing with matches.  这场火灾是由小孩玩火柴引起的。
Forty people helped to put out (= stop) the fire.  40个人帮忙扑灭了大火。

words.meaning: n.将来,未来;前途,前景 a.将来的,未来的
words.example:
Sometimes I worry about the future.  有时候我担心未来。
I'm sure at some point in the future I'll want a baby.  我确信在未来的某个时候我会想要一个孩子。
We need to plan for the future.  我们需要计划一下未来。

words.meaning: a.错的 ad.错误地,不正确地 n.错误 v.委屈
words.example:
Three of your answers were wrong.  你的回答中有三个是错的。
That clock is wrong - it's 12.30 not 12.15.  那个时钟不准——是12：30，不是12：15。
Some of his facts are questionable, others are plainly (= completely) wrong.  他提供的事实有些值得怀疑，其他的则完全错误。    Compare right

words.meaning: n. 防卫，防护；防御措施；防守；vt. 谋划抵御
words.example: The team's defense was solid.  这支队的防守很稳固。

words.meaning: pron.(用于疑问句,否定式)任何人
words.example:
Was there anyone you knew at the meeting?  开会的人你有认识的吗？
Has anyone seen my glasses anywhere?  有谁在哪里看到我的眼镜了吗？
Anyone can go - you don't have to be invited.  谁都可以去，用不着邀请。

words.meaning: v./n.增加,增长,增进
words.example:
Incidents of armed robbery have increased over the last few years.  持械抢劫案近几年增多了。
The cost of the project has increased dramatically/significantly since it began.  该专案自开始以来成本就急剧上升。
Gradually increase the temperature to boiling point.  逐步加热至沸点。

words.meaning: n.安全(感),防御(物),保证(人),(pl.)证券
words.example:
The station was closed for two hours because of a security alert.  由于有安全警报，车站关闭了两小时。
Thirty demonstrators were killed in clashes with the security forces over the weekend.  周末，30名示威者在与维安部队的冲突中丧生。
The tighter security measures/precautions include video cameras in the city centre.  加强安全保护措施包括在市中心安装摄影机。

words.meaning: n.银行;岸,堤;vi.存入(经营)银行;信赖
words.example:
High street banks have been accused of exploiting small firms.  大型银行被指责剥削小企业。
By the time we reached the opposite bank, the boat was sinking fast.  当我们到达对岸时，船正在快速地下沉。
These flowers generally grow on river banks and near streams.  这些花通常在河堤上和溪流附近开花。noun countable

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]我自己;我亲自
words.example:
I've bought myself a new coat.  我为自己买了一件新外套。
Yes, I thought to myself, it's time to take a holiday.  是啊，我自己思忖着，是时候去休假了。
My husband and myself were delighted with the gift.  我和丈夫收到这份礼物都很高兴。

words.meaning: n./a.西,西方(的),西部(的) ad.向西
words.example:
The points of the compass are North, South, East and West.  指南针上的方向有北、南、东和西。
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.  太阳从东方升起，在西边落下。
Most of the country will be dry tomorrow, but the west will have some rain.  明天我国大部分地区气候干燥，但西部有雨。

words.meaning: n.(体育)运动 (pl.)运动会 vi.开玩笑;玩耍
words.example:
Football, cricket and hockey are all team sports.  足球、板球和曲棍球都是团队运动。
She used to do/play a lot of sport when she was younger.  她年轻时经常参加体育运动。
Oh, Douglas - be a (good) sport and give me a lift to the station.  噢，道格拉斯——拿出点风度来，顺便载我一程去车站吧。

words.meaning: n.板,木板;全体委员;伙食 v.上船(车,飞机)
words.example:
Cut the vegetables on a UK chopping / US cutting board.  在砧板上切菜。
There was a 'For Sale' board outside the house.  房子外有一块“待售”牌。
The teacher wrote her name up on the board.  老师在黑板上写下了她的名字。

words.meaning: v.(after,for)寻找,探索;试图,企图
words.example:
"Are you actively seeking jobs?" she asked.  “你在积极找工作吗？”她问。
Hundreds of dissidents are seeking refuge/asylum in the US embassy.  数百异议分子到美国大使馆寻求庇护。
Legal advice should be sought before you take any further action.  在采取下一步行动之前，你应该咨询一下律师。

words.meaning: prep.每;经,由
words.example:
The meal will cost $20 per person.  这顿饭每人要花20美元。
The car was travelling at 70 miles per hour (70 mph).  那辆汽车以每小时70英哩的速度行驶着。
There are more cafés per square mile here than anywhere else in the country.  该地区每平方英哩内的咖啡馆要比该国其他任何一个地方都多。

words.meaning: n.主题;学科 a.隶属的;易遭..的 v.使隶属
words.example:
Our subject for discussion is homelessness.  我们讨论的话题是无家可归问题。
She has made a series of documentaries on the subject of family relationships.  她拍摄了一系列以家庭关系为题材的纪录片。
The guest lecturer took as her subject (= decided to speak about) 'punishment and imprisonment in modern society'.  特别讲师演讲的题目是“现代社会的刑罚与监禁”。

words.meaning: n.官员,办事员;工作人员;军官
words.example: a naval officer  海军军官

words.meaning: a.私人的,个人的,秘密的,私下的
words.example:
She has a small office which is used for private discussions.  她有一间小办公室，做密谈之用。
Apparently in interviews he refuses to talk about his private life.  很明显，他在采访中不愿谈论自己的私生活。
Although I support the project in public, my private opinion is that it will fail.  虽然我当众支持这项计划，但我私底下认为它不会成功。

words.meaning: n.休息;剩余部分 v.休息;睡;放,靠,搁
words.example:
The doctor told him that he should rest for a few days.  医生告诉他应该休息几天。
He looked away from the computer screen to rest his eyes.  他把视线从电脑萤幕上移开，让眼睛休息一下。
She promised that she would not rest (= would not stop looking) until the murderer of her son was caught and imprisoned.  她发誓杀害她儿子的凶手不被捕入狱，她就不会善罢甘休。

words.meaning: n.(behaviour)行为,举止;(机器等)运转情况
words.example: Good behavior earns praise.  好的行为赢得表扬。

words.meaning: v.处理;做买卖,经营;分配;对待 n.交易
words.example:
The unions and management have made a two-year pay and productivity deal.  工会和管理层签订了一份为期两年的工资与生产效率协议。
I'll make/do a deal with you - you wash the car and I'll let you use it tonight.  我和你做个交易吧——你把车洗了，今晚就让你用。
She got a good deal (= paid a low price) on her new house.  她买新房子时捡了个大便宜。

words.meaning: n.履行,执行;表演,演出;性能,特性;成绩
words.example:
Some athletes take drugs to improve their performance.  有些运动员为了提升表现而服用药物。
High- performance (= Fast, powerful and easy to control) cars are the most expensive.  性能卓越的汽车价格最高。
This was a very impressive performance by the young player, who scored 12 points within the first 10 minutes.  那位年轻球员的表现十分出色，在开赛10分钟内就得了12分。UK noun

words.meaning: v./n.打(仗),搏斗,斗争,战斗
words.example:
There were children fighting in the playground.  当时操场上有些孩子在打架。
The soldiers fought from house to house.  士兵逐家拼杀。
They fought with (= on the side of) the North against the South.  他们协同北方与南方作战。

words.meaning: vt.扔;使突然陷入;使困惑n.投掷(距离)
words.example:
My friend threw the ball back over the fence.  我朋友把球从围栏上掷了回去。
The coat was thrown over the back of the chair.  大衣丢在椅背上。
The rider was thrown as the horse jumped the fence.  马跳过栅栏时骑手被甩了下来。

words.meaning: n.顶,顶端;首位;顶点 a.最高的;顶上的
words.example:
She waited for me at the top of the stairs.  她在楼梯梯顶位置等我。
There were flags on the tops of many of the buildings.  许多大楼的楼顶都有旗子。
There was a pile of books on top of (= on) the table.  桌上有一堆书。

words.meaning: a.过去的 ad.过 n.过去,昔日 prep.(经)过
words.example:
Three boys went past us on mountain bikes.  三个男孩骑着越野自行车从我们身边经过。
Was that Peter who just jogged past in those bright pink shorts?  那个穿亮粉色短裤、刚从我们身边慢跑过去的人是彼得吗？UK preposition adverb
It's 5/10/a quarter/20/25/half past three.  现在是3点5分／10分／一刻／20分／25分／半。

words.meaning: n.目的,目标;守门员,球门;进球
words.example:
Black kicked/headed the ball into/towards the goal.  布莱克把球踢／顶进／向球门。
Brazil won by three goals to one.  巴西队以三比一获胜。
Only one goal was scored in the entire match.  整场比赛只进了一个球。

words.meaning: n.床,床位;(苗)床,坛;河床,(湖、海的)底
words.example:
He lived in a room with only two chairs, a bed and a table.  他住的房间里，只有两张椅子、一张床和一张桌子。
He likes to have breakfast in bed on a Saturday morning.  星期六早上他喜欢在床上吃早餐。
She didn't get out of bed till lunchtime today.  今天她直到吃午饭时才起床。

words.meaning: n.命令;次序;整齐;定货单;等级 v.定制,订购
words.example:
"Can I take your order now?" said the waiter.  侍者问：“现在可以点菜了吗？”
The shop phoned to say your order has come in.  商店来电说你订的货到了。
The new drilling equipment has been on order for several weeks.  新的钻探设备已经订购有几星期了。

words.meaning: n.作者,作家,著作人;创始人,发起人
words.example:
He is the author of two books on French history.  他是两部法国历史著作的作者。
She's the author of the company's recent success/ of all our troubles.  是她给公司带来了最近的成功／我们所有的麻烦都是她造成的。UK verb transitive    formal
He has authored more than 30 books.  他已经写了30多本书。

words.meaning: v.(with)填满,充满
words.example:
figurative Happy sounds filled the room (= could be heard everywhere in the room).  房间里充满了欢声笑语。
figurative The thought of it fills me with (= makes me feel) dread.  一想到它我心中就充满恐惧。
Before painting, fill (in) all the cracks in the plaster.  粉刷之前先把所有的裂缝用灰泥填满。

words.meaning: v.描述,表示;代表,代理;阐明,说明
words.example:
They chose a famous barrister to represent them in court.  他们选了一位著名律师为他们出庭辩护。
Union officials representing the teachers met the government today.  代表教师的工会干事今天与政府官员会谈。
Women were well/poorly represented at the conference (= there were many/few present).  出席会议的女性很多／少。

words.meaning: n.焦点,(活动,兴趣等的)中心 v.(on)使聚集
words.example:
The main focus of interest at the fashion show was Christian Lacroix's outrageous evening wear.  时装表演上人们兴趣的主要焦点是克里斯琴‧拉克鲁瓦那身奇特的晚装。
The media focus on politicians' private lives inevitably switches the attention away from the real issues.  媒体关注政客们的私生活，这必然将人们的注意力从实际问题上转移开来。UK noun countable (plural focuses or formal foci)
When they first took the bandages off, she/her eyes couldn't focus properly (= she couldn't see clearly).  他们最初把绷带取下时，她的视线一片模糊。UK verb (-s-)

words.meaning: a.外国的,(to)无关的;外来的;异质的
words.example:
Spain was the first foreign country she had visited.  西班牙是她访问过的第一个海外国家。
His work provided him with the opportunity for a lot of foreign travel.  他的工作给他提供了很多出国旅行的机会。
The whole concept of democracy, she claimed, was utterly foreign to the present government.  她声称，民主这一整套概念对于现任政府来说是极其陌生的。

words.meaning: n.滴;落下;微量 v.落下;下降;失落
words.example:
She dropped her keys.  她把锁匙掉了。
I'm always dropping things.  我总是掉东西。
Amanda dropped her sunglasses in/into the fountain.  阿曼达把太阳镜掉进喷水池里了。

words.meaning: n.血液,血;血统,血亲;血气
words.example:
He lost a lot of blood in the accident.  他在事故中大量失血。
They are related by blood.  他们有血缘关系。
She has Russian blood (= one or more of her relatives was Russian).  她有俄罗斯血统。noun uncountable

words.meaning: prep.在…上；在…旁
words.example:
Upon her head she wore a black velvet hat.  她头戴一顶黑色天鹅绒帽子。
You can never place enough emphasis upon the importance of safety.  无论怎样强调安全的重要性都不过分。
Upon your arrival (= As soon as you arrive) , please report to the reception desk.  到达后请即刻到接待处报到。

words.meaning: n.代理(处);代办处;[美](政府的)机关,厅
words.example: She was freed from prison through the agency of her doctor.  在她的医生的推动下，她获释出狱。

words.meaning: v.推;催逼,逼迫 n.推,推力;促进,推进
words.example:
Can you help me move this table? You push and I'll pull.  你能帮我挪一下这张桌子吗？你推我拉。
The window sticks - you have to push hard to open it.  这扇窗户卡住了，开的时候得用力推。
He helped me push my car off the road.  他帮我把车推离了公路。

words.meaning: n.自然界,大自然;性质,本性,天性
words.example:
This new technique of artificially growing cells copies what actually happens in nature.  这种人工培育细胞的新技术是模仿自然界实际发生的现象。
Feeling tired-out is Nature's way of telling you to rest.  感觉疲惫不堪是身体在提醒你该休息了。
Nature gave these tiny creatures the ability to reproduce quickly when food is abundant.  自然赋予这些微生物在食物充足时快速繁殖的能力。

words.meaning: n.(=colour)颜色;颜料;肤色 v.给…着色
words.example: What color is the sky at sunset?  日落时天空是什么颜色？

words.meaning: n.商店,店铺;贮藏,贮备品 v.贮藏,贮备
words.example:
He's got an impressively large store of wine in his cellar.  他的酒窖里储存了数量惊人的葡萄酒。
Food stores are reported to be running dangerously low in the capital.  据报道，首都的食品储量很少，形势危急。
figurative I'm afraid my great store of wit is rather depleted (= I'm not able to be very amusing) this evening.  今天晚上我恐怕是有点黔驴技穷，风趣不起来。

words.meaning: v.减少,缩小;简化,还原
words.example:
Do nuclear weapons really reduce the risk of war?  核武器真的可以减小战争爆发的危险吗？
The plane reduced speed as it approached the airport.  当飞临机场时，飞机减慢了速度。
My weight reduces when I stop eating sugar.  我停止吃糖时体重就会下降。

words.meaning: n.声音v.发声,响a.健全的,完好的;正当的
words.example:
They could hear the sound of a bell tolling in the distance.  他们能听到远处的钟声。
She stood completely still, not making a sound.  她静静地站在那里，一声不吭。
Suddenly we heard a loud knocking sound from the engine.  突然我们听见引擎发出响亮的砰砰声。

words.meaning: n.笔记;按语,注释;钞票,纸币v.记下,摘下
words.example:
He left a note to say he would be home late.  他留下字条说他会晚点回家。
There's a note pinned to the door saying when the shop will open again.  门上钉着一张便条，上面写着商店何时重新开张。
For a further explanation see Note 3.  详细解释参见注释3。

words.meaning: a.晴朗的,美好的,细致的 v./n.罚金,罚款
words.example:
The apartments are very small, which is fine for one person.  这些公寓很小，一个人住正合适。
The world's finest collection of Impressionist paintings is housed in the Musée d'Orsay in Paris.  巴黎奥塞美术馆拥有世界上最棒的印象派画作馆藏。
This building is the finest example of its type.  这栋建筑是同类建筑中最杰出的代表。adjective

words.meaning: a.近的,接近的;亲近的 prep.靠近 ad.接近
words.example:
Is there a train station near here?  这附近有火车站吗？
I'd like to sit near a window, please.  请给我一个靠窗的座位。
Don't come too near me - you might catch my cold.  别离我太近——我会把感冒传染给你的。

words.meaning: n.运动,活动;移动,迁移
words.example:
He made a sudden movement and frightened the bird away.  他突然动了一下，鸟就受惊飞走了。
For a long time after the accident, he had no movement in (= was unable to move) his legs.  出事以后的很长时间里，他的腿都不能动。
Her movements were rather clumsy.  她的动作很笨拙。

words.meaning: n.页,记录,事件,专栏 vt.给...标页码
words.example:
For details on how to enter the competition, see page 134.  关于如何参加比赛的细则，请参见第134页。
The article appeared on the front page of the Guardian.  这篇文章刊登在《卫报》的头版。
Several pages have been torn out of this book.  这本书有好几页被撕掉了。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.进入;参加,加入;写入 vi.进去,进来
words.example:
The police entered (the building) through/by the side door.  员警从侧门进入（这座大楼）。
You will begin to feel sleepy as the drug enters the bloodstream.  药物进入血液后你就会开始感到昏昏欲睡。
Both men have been entered for/in the 100 metres in Paris next month.  两个人都已报名参加下个月在巴黎举行的百米短跑比赛。

words.meaning: v.(with)分配,共用;分担n.一份,份额;股份
words.example:
She's very possessive about her toys and finds it hard to share.  她对自己的玩具占有欲太强，很难跟别人分享。
Bill and I shared an office for years.  比尔和我同在一个办公室里工作了多年。
Will you share your sandwich with me?  你能把你的三明治分给我一点吗？

words.meaning: a.普通的;共同的;一般的;n.公有地
words.example:
It's quite common to see couples who dress alike.  夫妻衣著相似是司空见惯的事情。
The surname 'Smith' is very common in Britain.  “史密斯”是英国很常见的姓氏。
English has some features common to many languages.  英语的一些特点是许多语言所共有的。

words.meaning: a.贫困的;可怜的;贫乏的;贫瘠的;低劣的
words.example:
Most of the world's poorest countries are in Africa.  世界上最穷的国家多数在非洲。
He came from a poor immigrant family.  他来自一个贫穷的移民家庭。    Opposite rich
Unfortunately, Iceland is poor in natural resources.  遗憾的是，冰岛自然资源贫乏。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.正常的;自然界的,天然的,天赋的,固有的
words.example:
People say that breast-feeding is better than bottle-feeding because it's more natural.  人们认为母乳喂养比用奶粉喂养好，因为母乳更为天然。
He died from natural causes (= because he was old or ill).  他是自然死亡。
Floods and earthquakes are natural disasters.  洪水和地震是自然灾害。

words.meaning: n.赛跑;人种,种族;属,种 v.赛跑
words.example:
Do you know who won/lost the race?  你知道比赛谁赢／输了吗？
Let's have a swimming race.  让我们比一比看谁游得快。
They're taking part in a race to the top of Ben Nevis.  他们将参加攀登本尼维斯山的比赛。

words.meaning: v.涉及,关系到 v./n.关心 n.(利害)关系
words.example:
The state of my father's health concerns us greatly.  我父亲的健康状况让我们非常担心。
Matters of pollution and the environment concern us all.  污染和环境的问题与我们所有人都息息相关。
What I have to say to Amy doesn't concern you.  我要跟埃米说的事与你无关。

words.meaning: a.(to)相似的,类似的
words.example:
My father and I have similar views on politics.  我和父亲在政治上观点相似。
Paul is very similar in appearance to his brother.  保罗和他哥哥长得很像。

words.meaning: a.(炎)热的;辣的;急躁的;激动的;热衷的
words.example:
It's too hot in here, can we turn down the heating?  这里面太热了，我们能把暖气关小点吗？
Bake the cake in a hot oven, about 220°C, for 30 minutes.  把蛋糕放进烤炉里，用大约摄氏220度的温度烤30分钟。
The food was piping hot (= very hot).  食物是滚烫的。UK adjective (hotter, hottest)

words.meaning: n.语言,术语,(运用语言的)方式、风格
words.example:
She does research into how children acquire language.  她研究儿童是如何习得语言的。
I'm hopeless at learning languages.  我根本不是学语言的料。
Java and Perl are both important computer programming languages (= systems of writing instructions for computers).  Java 和 Perl 都是重要的电脑程式设计语言。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.死的;无生命的;死气沉沉的 ad.完全地
words.example:
She's been dead for twenty years now.  到现在她已经去世20年了。
The motorcyclist was dead on arrival at the hospital.  那位摩托车骑士被送到医院时已经死亡。
He was shot dead (= killed by shooting) outside his home.  他在家门外被人开抢打死了。

words.meaning: v.升起;起立;上涨;起义 n.上涨,增高;起源
words.example:
The balloon rose gently (up) into the air.  气球慢慢升入空中。
At 6 am we watched the sun rise (= appear and move upwards in the sky).  我们在早晨六点钟观看了日出。
When you put yeast in bread and bake the bread, it rises (= gets bigger).  面粉里加些酵母，烘烤时面包就会发起来。

words.meaning: n.动物,野兽,牲畜 a.动物的,野兽的
words.example:
Both children are real animal lovers.  两个孩子都很喜爱动物。
Surveys show that animal welfare has recently become a major concern for many schoolchildren.  调查显示动物福利近来已成为很多小学生关注的主要问题。
Humans, insects, reptiles, birds and mammals are all animals.  人、昆虫、爬行动物、鸟类和哺乳动物都是动物。noun countable

words.meaning: n.十年
words.example: The city changed a lot in a decade.  十年间这座城市变化很大。

words.meaning: n.文章,论文;条款,条文;物件;冠词
words.example:
There was an interesting article on vegetarianism in the paper yesterday.  昨天报纸上登了一篇关于素食主义的有趣文章。UK noun countable
Guests are advised not to leave any articles of value in their hotel rooms.  建议房客不要将任何贵重物品放在饭店房间里。
An article of clothing was found near the river.  有人在河边发现了一件衣服。

words.meaning: v.发射;掠过,疾驰而过 n.嫩枝,苗,射击
words.example:
If he's not armed, don't shoot.  如果他没带武器，就不要开枪。
The kids were shooting arrows at a target.  孩子们正对着靶射箭。
She was shot three times in the head.  她头部中了三枪。

words.meaning: n.东,东方,东部 a.东方的,东部的
words.example:
The points of the compass are North, South, East and West.  指南针上的四个方位点是北、南、东和西。
Which way is east?  哪边是东啊？
Most of the country, except the east, is rural.  除了东部外，这个国家大部分地区都是农村。

words.meaning: v.救,拯救;储蓄,贮存;节省
words.example:
Wearing seat belts has saved many lives.  系安全带挽救了许多人的生命。
He fell in the river but his friend saved him from drowning.  他掉进河里，不过他的朋友救了他的命。
He had to borrow money to save his business.  他只好借钱挽救自己的企业。

words.meaning: n.艺术家,美术家;(某方面的)能手
words.example:
Monet is one of my favourite artists.  莫内是我最喜欢的画家之一。
He described her as one of the greatest film artists of the 20th century.  他称她为20世纪最伟大的电影艺术家之一。

words.meaning: n.景色,景象,舞台;(戏)一场
words.example:
Juliet dies in Act IV, Scene iii.  茱丽叶死于第四幕第三场。noun
Lowry painted street scenes.  劳里描绘街景。
figurative There were scenes of great joy as the hostages were re-united with their families.  当人质与家人团聚时，眼前是一幕幕无比喜悦的场景。noun

words.meaning: a.中心的,中央的,中枢的;主要的
words.example:
Of course, you pay more for premises with a central location (= in or near the centre of a town).  当然，要买位于市中心的房屋就要多付钱。adjective
Community involvement is central to our plan.  社区的参与对我们的计划很重要。adjective

words.meaning: ad.如此;像这样;于是;因此
words.example:
Bend from the waist, thus.  弯腰，就这样。
They planned to reduce staff and thus to cut costs.  他们计划裁员，从而达到降低成本的目的。
We haven't had any problems thus far.  我们至今没有出现任何问题。

words.meaning: n.待遇；治疗，疗法
words.example:
Peter gets special treatment because he knows the boss.  彼得认识老板，所以受到特殊待遇。
The same subject matter gets a very different treatment by Chris Wilson in his latest novel.  在克里斯‧威尔逊最新的小说中，对同样的主题作出了完全不同的处理。noun
Perhaps it's time to try a new course of treatment.  也许该是试试接受新疗程治疗的时候了。

words.meaning: prep.在(或向)...的那边,远于;超出;
words.example:
In the distance, beyond the river, was a small town.  在河对岸的远处有一座小镇。
From the top of the hill we could see our house and the woods beyond.  站在这个小山头，能看到我们的房子和远处的森林。UK preposition adverb
Few people live beyond the age of a hundred.  很少有人活过100岁。

words.meaning: a.快乐的,幸福的;乐意的;令人满意的
words.example:
She looks so happy.  她看起来非常快乐。
