School days are said to be the happiest days of your life.  学生时代据说是一生中最快乐的时光。
Nicky seems a lot happier since she met Steve.  尼基自从认识史蒂夫之后似乎快乐多了。

words.meaning: v.(from)保护,保卫
words.example:
It's important to protect your skin from the harmful effects of the sun.  保护皮肤不受太阳的伤害是很重要的。
Surely the function of the law is to protect everyone's rights.  法律的作用当然是保护每个人的权利。
Of course the company will act to protect its financial interests in the country if war begins.  如果战争爆发，这个公司当然会采取行动保护它在这个国家的经济利益。

words.meaning: vi.躺,平放;处于;位于 v.说谎 n.谎话
words.example:
He lies awake at night, worrying.  晚上他躺在床上焦虑不安，无法入睡。
There's an old pair of shoes of yours lying at/in the bottom of the wardrobe.  衣柜最下面放着一双你的旧鞋子。
The river lies 30km to the south.  那条河在南面30公里处。

words.meaning: n.大小,尺寸,规模;尺码
words.example:
We are concerned about the size of our debt.  我们为自己的钜额债务感到忧心。
Some kinds of trees grow to a huge size.  有些树长得很高大。
What is the size of that window?  那扇窗户尺寸有多大?

words.meaning: n.狗,雄兽 vt.尾随,跟踪
words.example:
We could hear dogs barking in the distance.  我们可以听到远处的狗叫声。UK noun countable
He tried to steal my money, the dirty dog.  这个无赖，他想偷我的钱。
It's a dog-eat-dog world out there.  那是一个竞争残酷的世界。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.严肃的;主要的;严重的,危急的;认真的
words.example:
There were no reports of serious injuries.  没有接到有人重伤的报告。
The new tax regulations have landed some of the smaller companies in serious trouble.  新的纳税规定使一些较小的公司陷入严重的困境。
Drugs have become a serious problem in a lot of schools.  吸毒在许多学校已经成了很严重的问题。

words.meaning: v.发生,出现;存在;想起,想到
words.example:
An accident involving over ten vehicles has occurred in the east-bound lane.  在东向车道上发生了一起涉及十多辆汽车的交通事故。
If any of these symptoms occur while you are taking the medicine, consult your doctor immediately.  服药期间如果产生了这些症状中的任何一种，要立即就医。UK US (-rr-)
Violence of some sort seems to occur in every society.  每个社会似乎都会存在某种形式的暴力。

words.meaning: n. 媒体；媒质（medium的复数）；血管中层；浊塞音；中脉
words.example: The issue has been much discussed in the media.  大众媒体对这件事讨论得很多。

words.meaning: a.(for)准备好的,现成的;甘心的
words.example:
Are you ready to order, Madam?  现在可以点菜了吗，女士？
Okay, Evie, ready when you are (= I am ready to do what we have arranged).  好了，埃薇，我都准备好了，就等你了。
Dinner's ready!  可以吃晚饭了！

words.meaning: n.思想,思考,思维;意图,打算;想法
words.example:
Ask me again tomorrow. I'll have to give it some thought.  明天再问我吧，我还得考虑一下。
She doesn't give any thought to her appearance.  她根本不注意自己的仪表。
Let me have your thoughts on that report by Friday.  星期五之前告诉我你对那份报告的看法吧。

words.meaning: n.表,目录,名单 v.把…编列成表,列入表内
words.example:
I've listed some useful reading material on the handout.  我在发给大家的讲义上列出了一些有用的阅读材料。verb
The tanker is listing badly and liable to sink at any moment.  油轮严重倾斜，随时都可能会沉没。noun
Is your name on the list?  名单上有你的名字吗？

words.meaning: a.简单的;单纯的,直率的;迟钝的,头脑简单的
words.example:
The instructions were written in simple English.  这些说明书是用简单的英文写成的。
It 's simple to find our house.  我们的房子很好找。
We didn't go swimming for the simple reason that the water was too cold.  我们没去游泳纯粹是因为水太冷了。adjective

words.meaning: n.质量,品质,特性
words.example:
The food was of such poor/low quality.  这种食品的品质很差。
Their products are of very high quality.  他们产品的品质很高。
The quality of the picture on our television isn't very good.  我们电视的画面品质不好。

words.meaning: n.压,压力,压迫,强制,紧迫,困苦,困难
words.example:
He put too much pressure on the door handle and it snapped.  他用力过猛，把门的把手弄断了。
You can stop bleeding by applying pressure close to the injured area.  压住伤口边缘可以止血。
The new material allows the company to make gas pipes which withstand higher pressures.  新材料使得公司可以生产出抗压力更强的输气管。

words.meaning: vt.接受,领受;认可,同意 vi.同意,认可
words.example:
Do you accept credit cards?  你们接受信用卡付帐吗？
She was in London to accept an award for her latest novel.  她刚出版的那本小说获奖了，她当时正在伦敦领奖。
The new telephones will accept coins of any denomination.  新型电话机可以投任何面值的硬币。

words.meaning: vt.回答,答复,答案 v.回答,答复,响应
words.example:
The Minister promised to give a written answer to the MP's detailed question.  对于议员提出的那个涉及很多细节的问题，部长答应给予书面答覆。
We've written to him asking him if he's free on that date but we haven't had an answer yet.  我们已经去信问他那天是否有空，但还没有收到回信。
I've just rung him but there was no answer.  我刚给他打过电话，但没人接。

words.meaning: v.识别,鉴别;(with)把…和…看成一样
words.example:
Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.  就连年龄最小的婴儿也能根据声音分辨出自己的母亲。
The gunman in Wednesday's attack has been identified as Lee Giggs, an unemployed truck driver.  周三袭击事件中的枪手已被确认为李‧吉格斯，一个失业的卡车司机。
The research will be used to identify training needs.  该研究将用来确定培训的需求。

words.meaning: n.左面,左方 a.左边的,左面的;在左方的
words.example:
His left eye was heavily bandaged.  他的左眼被严严实实地包扎了起来。
Turn left at the lights.  在红绿灯处左转。    Compare rightnoun
First I'll introduce the speaker sitting on my left.  首先我来介绍一下坐在我左边的发言者。

words.meaning: n.会议,集合,汇合,会见,接见,汇合点
words.example: I have a meeting at three.  我三点有个会。

words.meaning: v.决心,决定;确定,限定
words.example:
The number of staff we can take on will be determined by how much money we're allowed to spend.  我们雇用的人数将取决于可支配资金的多少。
Your health is determined in part by what you eat.  在某种程度上你的健康状况取决于你的饮食。
Eye colour is genetically determined.  眼睛的颜色是由遗传基因决定的。

words.meaning: v.准备,预备
words.example:
Have you prepared for your interview?  你作好面试的准备了吗？
She'll prepare the food ahead of time and freeze it.  她会提前把食物准备好并冷冻起来。
This course aims to prepare students for middle and senior managerial positions.  这门课旨在使学生在将来能够胜任中、高级管理职位。

words.meaning: n.疾病
words.example:
They reported a sudden outbreak of the disease in the south of the country.  他们报告说该国南部地区突然爆发了这种疾病。
The first symptom of the disease is a very high temperature.  这种病的最初症状是高烧。
She has caught/contracted (= begun to have) a lung disease/disease of the lungs.  她患上了肺病。

words.meaning: pron.无论什么 a.无论什么样的
words.example:
We'll go whatever the weather.  无论天气怎样，我们都要去。
Whatever happens, you know that I'll stand by you.  你知道无论发生甚么事情，我都会支持你。
Whatever else may be said of him, Mr Meese is not scared of a fight.  无论别人还说他甚么，米斯先生并不害怕打上一架。

words.meaning: n.成就,成功;成功的事物,有成就的人
words.example:
The success of almost any project depends largely on its manager.  几乎所有专案计划的成功都很大程度地取决于管理者的能力。
I've been trying to persuade her to take on more staff, but so far without success.  我一直在劝她再雇些人，不过到目前为止都没成功。
I'm not having much success in communicating with him at the moment.  目前我还没有联系上他。

words.meaning: vi.辩论,争论 vt.辩论,论证;说服,劝说
words.example:
The children are always arguing.  孩子老是吵个不停。
Kids, will you stop arguing with each other?  孩子们，你们别再吵嘴了好不好？
They were arguing over/about which film to go and see.  他们正在争论去看哪部电影。UK verb

words.meaning: n.杯子;奖杯,优胜杯;(一)杯,一杯的容量
words.example:
Sheila won this cup in the school squash championship.  这奖杯是希拉参加学校的壁球锦标赛获得的。
The Davis Cup is an important championship.  戴维斯杯是一项重大的网球锦标赛。noun
Thanks for inviting me, but ballet isn't really my cup of tea.  谢谢你邀请我，不过我不大喜欢看芭蕾。verb transitive (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.总数,数量;数额 v.共计;等同,接近(to)
words.example:
They didn't deliver the right amount of sand.  他们运来的沙子数量不对。
Small amounts of land were used for keeping animals.  少量的土地用于饲养动物。
He paid regular amounts of money to a charity.  他定期向一家慈善机构捐钱。

words.meaning: n.能力;本领;才能,才干;专门技能,天资
words.example:
There's no doubting her ability.  她的能力毋庸置疑。
She's a woman of considerable abilities.  她是个非常有才干的女性。

words.meaning: n.全体职工;杠,棒;参谋部 v.配备工作人员
words.example:
There is a good relationship between staff and pupils at the school.  学校里教职员工和学生的关系很融洽。
The staff are not very happy about the latest pay increase.  员工们对最近一次加薪不太满意。
There are over a hundred staff in the company.  公司有100多名员工。

words.meaning: v.(recognise)认出,承认,公认,赏识,表扬
words.example:
Doctors are trained to recognize the symptoms of different diseases.  医生受过训练可以辨识出不同疾病的症状。(UK usually recognise) ['rek.əg.naɪz]
The international community has refused to recognize (= officially accept the existence of) the newly independent nation state.  国际社会拒绝承认这个新独立的国家。
You must recognize the seriousness of the problems we are facing.  你必须认识到我们现在面临的问题有多严重。

words.meaning: v.指出,指示;表明,暗示
words.example:
Exploratory investigations have indicated large amounts of oil below the sea bed.  勘测调查显示海床下有大量的石油。
The gauge indicates a temperature below freezing point.  测量器显示温度在冰点以下。verb
specialized Antihistamine is indicated for this patient as a treatment for her allergies.  该病人患过敏症，建议用抗组织胺来治疗。

words.meaning: n.性格,品质,特性;人物,角色;字符,(汉)字
words.example:
Politeness is traditionally part of the British character.  待人礼貌客气向来是英国人性格的一部分。
It would be very out of character (= not typical) of her to lie.  撒谎可不符合她的个性。
One of the joys of being a parent is watching the child's character develop.  为人父母的一大乐趣就是观察孩子的性格发展。

words.meaning: n.生长,增长,发展
words.example:
Plant growth is most noticeable in spring and early summer.  在春天和初夏之时， 植物的生长最为明显。
The government is trying to limit population growth.  政府正在努力控制人口增长。
The rapid growth of opposition to the plan has surprised the council.  反对这一计划的势力突然激增，让政务委员会惊诧不已。

words.meaning: n.丧失,遗失;损失,损耗,亏损;失败
words.example:
Many parents feel a sense of loss when their children leave home.  孩子们离家后许多父母都会有失落感。
He suffered a gradual loss of memory.  他的记忆力越来越差了。
There will be substantial job losses if the factory closes down.  如果工厂关闭，大批工人将会失业。

words.meaning: n.程度;度数;学位;等级
words.example:
This job demands a high degree of skill.  这项工作对技术的要求很高。
There isn't the slightest degree of doubt that he's innocent.  毫无疑问，他是无辜的。
The number of terrorist attacks has increased to a terrifying degree.  恐怖袭击的次数已经到了骇人的程度。

words.meaning: n.惊奇,惊异;奇迹,奇事 v.(at)诧异;想知道
words.example:
He's starting to wonder wh ether he did the right thing in accepting this job.  他现在开始怀疑自己接受这份工作是否正确。
The sight of the Grand Canyon stretching out before them filled them with wonder.  大峡谷展现在眼前的景象，令他们惊叹万分。
The boys gazed in wonder at the shiny red Ferrari.  男孩子们惊讶地盯着那辆闪亮的红色法拉利跑车。

words.meaning: v./n.攻击,抨击;着手,开始 n.(病)发作
words.example:
He was attacked and seriously injured by a gang of youths.  他被一帮年轻人打成重伤。
Army forces have been attacking the town since dawn.  从拂晓开始，军队就对这个城市展开了进攻。
Most wild animals won't attack unless they are provoked.  大多数野生动物若非被激怒，是不会主动攻击的。    Compare defendverb

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]她自己;她亲自,她本人
words.example:
She kept telling herself that nothing was wrong.  她不断告诉自己一切都没有问题。
My mother would worry herself to death if she knew what I was doing.  如果我母亲知道我在做甚么，她一定会担心死的。
She decorated the cake herself.  她亲自装饰蛋糕。

words.meaning: n.电视；电视机
words.example:
Could you turn the television down?  你把电视声音调小点好吗？
It's one of the few television programmes that I always make a point of watching.  这是我一直坚持看的少数几个电视节目之一。
Is there anything interesting on television tonight?  今晚有甚么好看的电视节目吗？

words.meaning: n.盒,箱;包厢 v.把…装箱;拳击,打耳光
words.example:
He ate a whole box of chocolates.  他吃了整整一盒巧克力。
If you would like more information, mark this box.  如果你需要更多的资料，请在这个方框内打钩。
Their new house is just a box (= very small).  他们的新房子非常小。

words.meaning: n.(television)电视;电视机
words.example:
We ate in front of (= while watching) the TV.  我们边吃饭边看电视。
What's on TV tonight?  今晚有甚么电视节目？
You watch too much TV!  你电视看得太多！

words.meaning: n.训练,培养
words.example:
New staff have/receive a week's training in how to use the computers.  新员工要接受为期一周的电脑操作训练。
His experience as a teacher was good training for parenthood.  他做老师的经历为他为人父母打下了良好基础。noun uncountable

words.meaning: ad.相当,很a.漂亮的,俊俏的,标致的
words.example:
The house has four bedrooms, so it's pretty big.  这栋房子有四间卧房，因此非常大。
I'm pretty sure it was her.  我相当肯定是她。
I've got a pretty good idea of how to get there.  我很清楚那里该怎么去。

words.meaning: n.贸易,商业;职业,行业 v.经商,交易
words.example:
The country's trade in manufactured goods has expanded in the last ten years.  该国的工业品贸易在最近十年里扩大了规模。
Seventy per cent of the country's trade is with Europe.  该国70%的贸易是和欧洲做的。
The two countries have signed a trade agreement for one year only.  这两个国家签署了一项为期仅一年的贸易协定。

words.meaning: pron.(everyone)每人,人人
words.example: Everybody likes the new teacher.  大家都喜欢新老师。

words.meaning: a.物质的;肉体的,身体的;自然科学的,物理的
words.example:
I'm not a very physical sort of person (= I don't enjoy physical activities).  我不是那种喜欢体育活动的人。
The referee stepped in because the game had started to get a bit physical.  因为比赛开始变得有些粗暴了，所以裁判进行了干涉。
There was obviously a great physical attraction between them.  他们之间明显有很强的肉体吸引力。adjective

words.meaning: v.放,搁;下(蛋);铺设,敷设;设置,布置
words.example:
She laid the baby on the bed.  她把婴儿放在了床上。
He laid the tray down on the table.  他把托盘放在桌子上。
She laid aside her book and went to answer the phone.  她把书放在一边去接电话。

words.meaning: a.一般的,普通的;总的,大体的 n.将军
words.example:
The general feeling at the meeting was that a vote should be taken.  所有与会者都感到应该投票表决。
There is general concern about rising crime rates.  人们普遍对犯罪率上升感到担忧。
My general impression of the place was good.  我对这个地方的总的印象很好。

words.meaning: n.感情;心情;知觉;同情
words.example:
I've got this strange feeling in my stomach.  我的胃里有种怪怪的感觉。
My toes were so cold that I'd lost all feeling in them.  我的脚趾冻得完全失去知觉了。noun
The feeling of loneliness suddenly overwhelmed him.  一种孤独感突然涌上他的心头。

words.meaning: n.标准,规则 a.标准的
words.example:
This essay is not of an acceptable standard - do it again.  这篇文章未达标准——重新写。
This piece of work is below standard/is not up to standard.  这工作做得不合要求。
We have very high safety standards in this laboratory.  我们这个实验室有很高的安全标准。

words.meaning: n.账单;招贴,广告;(人员,职称等的)表;钞票
words.example:
They sent us a bill for the work they had done.  他们寄给我们索取工资的帐单。
She ran up (= caused herself to have) a huge phone bill talking to her boyfriend for hours.  由于与男友在电话聊天数小时，她的电话费大增。
They asked the waitress for the bill.  他们叫女侍者把帐单拿来。

words.meaning: n.消息,信息,通讯,启示,教训,广告词,预言
words.example:
If I'm not there when you phone, leave a message.  如果你打电话时我不在，就留个口信。
The film's message is that rich and poor are alike.  这部电影旨在告诉人们富人和穷人是相似的。
We need to get the message across that too much sun is dangerous.  我们需要让人们明白过多的日晒是危险的。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.失败,不及格;衰退,减弱
words.example:
She moved to London in the hope of finding work as a model, but failed.  她搬到伦敦，希望找份模特儿的工作，但没找到。
This method of growing tomatoes never fails.  这种种植番茄的方法屡试不爽。
He failed in his attempt to break the record.  他未能打破纪录。

words.meaning: ad.向外面 n.外部 a.外部的 prep.在…外
words.example:
It was a lovely day outside.  外面的天气真好。
Since it's such a nice day shall we eat/sit/go outside?  既然天气这么好，我们到外面吃饭／坐坐／走走好吗？
The company has called in outside experts.  公司已外请专家。

words.meaning: vi.到达;(时间、事件)到来,发生;达到
words.example:
What time will your train arrive?  你坐的火车甚么时候到？
It was dark by the time we arrived at the station.  我们到站时，天都已经黑了。
We arrived in Prague later that day.  我们在那天晚些时候到达布拉格。

words.meaning: n.(pl.analyses)分析;分解
words.example:
Chemical analysis revealed a high content of copper.  化学分析结果显示出极高的铜含量。
In the final analysis, the only people who will benefit are property owners.  归根究柢，唯一受益的群体将是房产业主。

words.meaning: n.利益,好处,恩惠 v.有益于;(from,by)受益
words.example:
The discovery of oil brought many benefits to the town.  石油的发现给该镇带来很多利益。
One of the many benefits of foreign travel is learning how to cope with the unexpected.  学会如何应付突发事件是海外旅游的众多益处之一。
He's had the benefit of an expensive education and yet he continues to work as a waiter.  他接受过昂贵的教育，但却继续当一名侍者。

words.meaning: n.性别,性
words.example:
What sex is your cat?  你的猫是公的还是母的？
Some tests enable you to find out the sex of your baby before it's born.  有些检查能让你在婴儿出生之前知道其性别。
It's illegal to discriminate against people on the basis of (their) sex.  性别歧视是违法的。

words.meaning: ad.(also forwards)向前 a.向前的 v.转交
words.example: Step forward to shake hands.  上前握手。

words.meaning: n.律师
words.example: Her dream is to be a lawyer.  她的梦想是当律师。

words.meaning: a.出席的,现在的 n.现在,礼物 v.赠送,提出
words.example:
They gave me theatre tickets as a present.  他们送给我戏票作为礼物。noun]ˈprez.ənt/
That's all for the present.  暂时就讲这些。
The play is set in the present.  这出戏以当代为背景。

words.meaning: n.章节,部分;地区,部门,科;截面,剖面
words.example:
Does the restaurant have a non-smoking section?  这个餐馆有禁烟区吗？
The poorest sections of the community have much worse health.  该社区最穷的居民健康状况糟糕得多。
He was charged under section 17 of the Firearms Act (= according to that part of the law).  他被控违反了《枪械法》第17款。noun

words.meaning: n.玻璃;玻璃杯;镜子;(pl.)眼镜
words.example:
It's a huge window made from a single pane of glass.  这扇巨大的窗户是由一整块玻璃造的。
The museum has a fine collection of valuable glass.  这个博物馆收藏了一批珍贵的玻璃制品。
In cool climates you have to grow tropical plants under glass.  在气候凉爽的地带，必须把热带植物种在玻璃温室中。UK noun

words.meaning: n.技能,技巧,手艺;熟练
words.example: Ruth had/possessed great writing skills.  露丝写作技巧纯熟。

words.meaning: n.姐,妹;护士长;修女,女教士
words.example:
Sophie and Emily are sisters.  苏菲和艾蜜莉是姐妹。
Emily is Sophie's younger/little/older/big sister.  艾蜜莉是苏菲的妹妹／姐姐。
Lynn's such a good friend - she's like a sister to me.  琳恩真是一个好朋友——她就像我的姐妹一样。

words.meaning: n.教授
words.example: Professor Stephen Hawking  斯蒂芬•霍金教授

words.meaning: n.运转,开动,操作,手术,运算,经营
words.example:
There are several reactors of the type in operation (= working) at the moment.  目前有几个这样的反应堆在工作。
We expect the new scheme for assessing claims to come into operation (= start working) early next year.  我们预计明年初施行核定索赔的新方案。
Less profitable business operations will have difficulty in finding financial support.  盈利较少的企业会很难得到财政资助。

words.meaning: n.罪行,犯罪
words.example:
He has admitted committing several crimes, including two murders.  他供认犯过好几宗案件，包括两宗谋杀。
The defendant is accused of/charged with a range of crimes, from theft to murder.  被告被控犯下了多种罪行，小到偷窃，大到谋杀。
Bombing civilians is a crime against humanity (= a cruel crime against many people).  轰炸平民是反人类的罪行。

words.meaning: n.舞台,戏剧;阶段,时期
words.example:
The project is in its final stages and should be completed by August.  这个企划案已进入最后阶段，应于八月份前完成。
They did the last stage of their journey on foot.  他们徒步走完了旅途的最后一段路。
Our marriage is going through a difficult stage at the moment.  目前我们的婚姻正走到难关。

words.meaning: adj. 好的；不错的；adv. 行；很好；int. 好；可以；vt. 对…表示同意；n. 同意
words.example:
You need to add a bit more vinegar, OK?  你需要多加点醋，明白吗？
I'll see you at six-thirty, okay?  我们6点30分见面，好吗？(also okay) UK exclamation
Okay, let's go.  好，我们走吧。

words.meaning: vt.(to,with)比较;(to)把…比作vi.相比
words.example:
If you compare house prices in the two areas, it's quite amazing how different they are.  如果比较一下两个地段的房价，你会惊讶地发现两者差别竟如此之大。
That seems expensive - have you compared prices in other shops?  那好像很贵——你有没有比较一下其他店里的价格？
Compare some recent work with your older stuff and you'll see how much you've improved.  把你近来的作品与以前的对照一下，你就会知道你的进步有多大。

words.meaning: n.权力,权威;权威人士;(pl.)官方,当局
words.example:
The United Nations has used/exerted/exercised its authority to restore peace in the area.  联合国行使其权力以恢复该地区的和平。
We need to get the support of someone in authority (= an important or high-ranking person).  我们需要得到一个有实权的人的支持。
They've been acting illegally and without authority (= permission) from the council.  他们的行动都是非法的，而且没有得到市政委员会的授权。

words.meaning: n.小姐 v. 思念,未击中,错过,漏掉,逃脱
words.example:
Dr White will see you now, Miss Carter.  卡特小姐，怀特医生现在就见你。
Excuse me, Miss, could you tell me the way to the station?  对不起，小姐，你能告诉我去车站怎么走吗？
Can I go to the toilet, Miss?  我能去厕所吗，老师？

words.meaning: v.设计;构思;绘制;图案;企图 n.设计,图样
words.example:
Who designed this building/dress/furniture?  是谁设计这座建筑物／这款裙子／这套家俱？
This range of clothing is specially designed for shorter women.  这系列服装是专为身材较矮的女性设计的。verb
This dictionary is designed for advanced learners of English.  本词典是为高级英语学习者编写的。

words.meaning: n.种类,类别 v.分类,整理
words.example:
We both like the same sort of music.  我们俩喜欢同一类音乐。
I'm going to have a salad of some sort.  我想吃某种沙拉。
What sort of shoes will I need?  我需要甚么样的鞋子呢？

words.meaning: v.表演;举动;起作用 n.行为,法令;一幕
words.example:
She acted without thinking.  她不加思索就采取了行动。
The anaesthetic acted (= had an effect) quickly.  麻醉剂很快起了作用。
Who is acting for/on behalf of (= who is representing) the defendant?  谁是被告的代理律师？

words.meaning: n.知识,学识;知道,了解
words.example:
Her knowledge of English grammar is very extensive.  她的英语文法知识很广博。
He has a limited knowledge of French.  他对法语所知有限。
The details of the scandal are now common knowledge (= familiar to most people).  丑闻的详情现在众所周知。

words.meaning: n.枪,炮,手枪
words.example:
The British police do not carry guns.  英国员警不佩带枪支。
You could hear the noise of guns firing in the distance.  你可以听到远处的枪声。
At the gun, the runners sprinted away down the track.  信号枪一响，运动员们便沿着跑道飞奔起来。

words.meaning: n.车站;所,站,局;身份,地位 v.安置,驻扎
words.example:
Our office is near the station.  我们的办事处在火车站附近。
We looked on our map to find the nearest UKunderground/tube / USsubway/metro station.  我们在地图上找最近的地铁站。
The reception is not very good - try to tune in to another station.  接收效果不太好——换个频道（台）试试。noun countable

words.meaning: a.蓝色的;青灰色的;沮丧的,阴郁的 n.蓝色
words.example:
Her hands were blue with cold (= slightly blue because of the cold).  她的手冻得发青。adjective
His humour is a bit too blue for my tastes.  他的幽默对我来说有点儿太下流了。adjective
He's been a bit blue since he failed his exams.  自从考试不及格后，他就一直有些闷闷不乐。

words.meaning: vt.讨论,商议
words.example:
The police want to discuss these recent racist attacks with local people.  警方希望与当地人讨论近期发生的种族主义袭击事件。
The later chapters discuss the effects on the environment.  后面的几章阐述了对环境产生的影响。verb transitive

words.meaning: ad.确实,实在;真正地,多么
words.example:
Indeed, it could be the worst environmental disaster in Western Europe this century.  这确实可能是本世纪西欧最严重的环境灾难。
Evidence suggests that errors may indeed be occurring.  证据显示可能确实出错了。
We live in strange times indeed.  我们确实生活在不可思议的时代。

words.meaning: n.真实,真相;真实性;真理
words.example:
There would seem to be some truth in what she says.  她说的话似乎有些真实。
There is no truth in the reports of his resignation.  有关他辞职的那些报道毫不可信。
You cannot question the truth of his alibi.  你无法怀疑他不在现场的申辩。

words.meaning: n.歌唱,(虫、鸟等)鸣声;歌曲,歌词
words.example:
He was so happy he wanted to burst/break into song (= start singing).  他太高兴了，真想放声歌唱。
She bought the bed for a song at an auction.  她在一次拍卖会上以非常便宜的价格买下了这张床。
Because the shop's closing down, most of the stock is going for a song (= being sold very cheaply).  这家商店要关门了，所以大多数存货都廉价出售。UK noun

words.meaning: n.例子,实例;模范,榜样
words.example:
Could you give me an example of the improvements you have mentioned?  你可不可以举个例子说明一下你刚刚提到的那些进展情况？
This painting is a marvellous example of her work.  这幅画充分表现了她的作品风格。
Study the examples first of all, then attempt the exercises on the next page.  首先仔细研究一下例题，然后试做下一页的练习题。

words.meaning: vt.检查；制止 n.检查
words.example:
You should always check your oil, water and tyres before taking your car on a long trip.  你每次开车长途旅行前都应当检查一下油箱、水箱和轮胎。
Customs stopped us and checked (= searched) our bags for alcohol and cigarettes.  海关人员要求我们停下，检查我们的随身行李里有没有烟酒。
After I'd finished the exam, I checked my answers for mistakes.  我做完考卷后检查答案有没有错误。

words.meaning: n.环境,外界
words.example:
Certain chemicals have been banned because of their damaging effect on the environment.  一些化学品因对环境有破坏作用已被禁止使用。
We're not doing enough to protect the environment from pollution.  我们在防治污染保护环境方面做得还不够。UK noun
The office is quite bright and airy - it's a pleasant working environment.  办公室明亮、通风，工作环境不错。

words.meaning: n.腿,腿部;支柱;(旅程的)一段,一站
words.example:
My legs were tired after so much walking.  走了这么远的路，我的腿有些累了。
He broke his leg skiing.  他滑雪时摔断了腿。
The horse broke its front leg in the fall.  这匹马摔断了前腿。

words.meaning: a.黑暗的,深(色)的;隐秘的;n.无光,黑暗
words.example:
It was too dark to see properly.  光线太暗，看不清楚。
What time does it get dark in the summer?  夏季时的天色甚么时候变暗？
Our bedroom was very dark until we put a larger window in.  我们的睡房原来很暗，后来装了一个大一点的窗户才好些。

words.meaning: a.各种各样的，不同的
words.example:
We had various problems on our journey, including a puncture.  我们在旅途中遇到了各种各样的问题，包括轮胎被扎破了。
The author gave various reasons for having written the book.  作者给出了写那本书的各种理由。
Girardo was out of action with various injuries for most of last season.  上个赛季大多数时间吉拉多都因为各种伤病而不能上场。

words.meaning: ad.相当,有一点儿;宁愿,宁可
words.example:
It's rather cold today, isn't it?  今天相当冷，是不是？
That's rather a difficult book - here's an easier one for you.  那本书有点难——这本对你来说容易些。
The train was rather too crowded for a comfortable journey.  这趟列车上相当拥挤，旅途不太舒服。

words.meaning: v.笑;(on)讥笑 n.笑,笑声
words.example:
They laughed at her jokes.  听了她讲的笑话他们都笑了。
She's so funny - she really makes me laugh.  她太有意思了——真让我笑死了。
It's very rare that a book is so good you actually laugh out loud.  一本能让你笑出声来的好书真是不多见。

words.meaning: v./n.猜测,推测;以为;猜想[同]surmise
words.example:
On the last question, she guessed right/wrong.  最后一道题目她猜对／错了。
She asked me to guess her age.  她让我猜她的年龄。
She guessed the answer first time.  她第一次就猜中了答案。

words.meaning: v.证明,证实;检验;考验;鉴定;结果是,表明是
words.example:
The operation proved a complete success.  这场手术结果是大成功。
The dispute over the song rights proved impossible to resolve.  结果是，有关歌曲版权的争论根本无法解决。
Under the present system, you're innocent until proven guilty.  在现行制度下，在被证明有罪之前你是清白的。

words.meaning: v.悬挂,垂吊;吊死,绞死
words.example:
Long creepers hung (down) from the trees.  长藤从树上垂下来。
The curtains hung in thick folds.  窗帘打着密密的摺子垂着。
Hang your coat and hat (up) on the rack over there.  把你的大衣和帽子挂在那边的架子上。

words.meaning: a.完全的,全部的,完整的
words.example:
Between them they ate an entire cake.  他们两个吃了整整一个蛋糕。
He'd spent the entire journey asleep.  他整个旅程都在睡觉。
They got an entire set of silver cutlery as a wedding present.  他们收到了一件结婚礼物，是一整套银质餐具。

words.meaning: n.岩石,石块 v.摇,摇动
words.example:
Mountains and cliffs are formed from rock.  山和悬崖都是由岩石构成的。
The boat struck a rock outside the bay and sank.  船在海湾外撞上了一块礁石，沉没了。
The demonstrators were hurling rocks at the police.  示威者向员警投掷石块。

words.meaning: v.忘记,遗忘
words.example:
I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name.  对不起，我忘了你的名字。
Let me write down that date before I forget it.  在我忘记它之前，让我把日期写下来吧。
I'm sorry, I was forgetting (= I had forgotten) (that) you would be away in August.  抱歉，我忘了你八月不在。

words.meaning: v.移动,脱掉,调动,免职
words.example:
The men came to remove the rubbish from the backyard.  这些人来清除后院的垃圾。
This detergent will remove even old stains.  这种洗涤剂就连以前的顽渍也能除去。
It got so hot that he removed his tie and jacket.  天气太热了，他解下领带，脱掉外套。

words.meaning: n.经理,管理人
words.example: a bank manager  银行经理

words.meaning: vt.享受…的乐趣;欣赏;喜爱
words.example:
Come on, why aren't you dancing? Enjoy yourselves!  快过来，你们怎么不跳舞啊？痛痛快快地跳吧！
Here are your drinks. Enjoy!  这是您的饮料。请慢用！
Even though he's 86, he enjoys excellent health.  虽然都86岁高龄了，他身体依然很健康。

words.meaning: n.网状物;广播网,电视网;网络
words.example:
Massive investment is needed to modernise the country's telephone network.  全国电话网路实现现代化需要巨额投资。
We could reduce our costs by developing a more efficient distribution network.  我们可以透过发展更为高效的分销系统来降低成本。
Our computer system consists of about twenty personal computers networked to a powerful file-server.  我们的电脑系统由大约20台个人电脑组成，这些电脑与一台功能强大的档服务器连网。UK verb

words.meaning: a.法律的,法定的;合法的,正当的
words.example: Is abortion legal in your country?  堕胎在你们国家是否合法？    Opposite illegaladjective

words.meaning: a.宗教的,信教的,虔诚的
words.example: He's deeply religious and goes to church twice a week.  他非常虔诚，每周都去教堂做两次礼拜。

words.meaning: a.冷的,寒冷的;冷淡的 n.冷,寒冷;伤风
words.example:
My feet are so cold.  我的双脚冰冷。
It's freezing cold today.  今天冷极了。
You'll feel cold if you don't wear a coat.  如果不穿外套你会觉得冷的。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.最终的,决定性的 n.结局;决赛;期末考试
words.example:
The game is in its final stages.  比赛到了最后阶段。
In the final analysis, it is the drug companies that are going to profit from this policy.  归根结底，从这项政策中获益的将是那些制药公司。
It's no use begging me - I'm not coming and that's final.  求我也没有用——我已经决定了，我不会来。noun

words.meaning: a.主要的,总的 n.总管道;干线
words.example:
The main thing is not to worry.  最重要的是不要忧虑。
One of the main reasons I came to England was to study the language.  我到英格兰的主要原因之一是学习语言。
You'll find the main points of my proposal in the report.  你们可以在这份报告中看到我计划的要点。

words.meaning: n.科学;学科
words.example:
Space travel is one of the marvels/wonders of modern science.  太空漫游是现代科学的一大奇迹。
Economics is not an exact science.  经济学并不是一门精密科学。

words.meaning: a.绿色的;生的;未成熟的 n.绿色;蔬菜;植物
words.example:
He used to be a Liberal, but now he's a Green.  他以前是自由党成员，但是现在加入绿党了。
The Chancellor proposed a crackdown on car and plane emissions, and the introduction of tax incentives to go green.  总理提议打击汽车及飞机的废气排放，并为保护环境设立激励性税收。adjective
Ben's heading off to Spain for the week and I'm green with envy.  本要到西班牙逗留一星期，真令我眼红。adjective

words.meaning: n.记忆,记忆力;回忆;存储(器)
words.example:
After the accident he suffered from loss of memory/memory loss.  意外发生之后，他丧失了记忆力。
She has an excellent memory for names (= She can remember names easily).  她特别善于记名字。UK noun
That tune really brings back memories (= makes me remember past events).  那首乐曲真的使我想起往事。

words.meaning: n.卡片,名片;纸牌;纸片
words.example:
The bank's closed now, but I can get some money out with my (cash) card.  银行现在关门了，不过我可以用我的（自动提款）卡取些钱。
You usually have to show your (membership) card at the door.  通常必须在门口出示你的（会员）卡。
John shuffled (= mixed up) the cards before he dealt them (out)(= gave them to the players).  约翰在发牌前先洗了牌。

words.meaning: a.上述的 ad.在上面,在前文 prep.在..之上,高于
words.example:
There's a mirror above the washbasin.  洗脸盆上方有面镜子。
He waved the letter excitedly above his head.  他兴奋地把信举过头顶挥舞着。
She's rented a room above a shop.  她在一家店铺的楼上租了个房间。

words.meaning: n.座位,底座;所在地,场所 v.使坐下
words.example:
Chairs, stools, sofas and benches are different types of seat.  椅子、凳子、沙发和长凳是不同类型的座椅。
Please have/take a seat (= sit down).  请坐。
My ticket says 22D but there's already someone in (= sitting on) that seat.  我的票是22D，但已经有人占了那个位子。

words.meaning: n.细胞;小房间;蜂房;电池
words.example: the cells of a honeycomb  蜂巢的巢室

words.meaning: a.美好的,令人愉快的;友好的,亲切的
words.example:
Did you have a nice holiday?  你假期过得愉快吗？
Have a nice day/time!  祝你度过愉快的一天／过得愉快！
This milk doesn't smell very nice.  这种牛奶闻起来味道不太好。

words.meaning: n.讯问,审讯;试验;试用;尝试
words.example:
Trial by jury is a fundamental right.  由陪审团审判是一项基本权利。
It was a very complicated trial that went on for months.  该审判非常复杂，历时数月。
She's going on/standing trial for fraud.  她因诈骗而将受审。

words.meaning: n.专家,能手 a.熟练的,有经验的;专门的
words.example:
My mother is an expert at dress-making (= she does it very well).  我妈妈是做裁缝的高手。UK adjective [before noun]
The centre provides expert advice for people with financial problems.  这间中心为大家提供理财方面的专业咨询。
What's your expert opinion ?  作为专家，你有甚么意见？

words.meaning: n.春;跳;泉,源泉;弹簧,发条 v.跳,跳跃
words.example:
Many bulbs bloom in (the) spring.  很多球茎植物春天开花。
Janet's coming over for a couple of weeks next spring.  珍妮特明年春天要来这里待几个星期。noun
The children have jumped on the couch so much that they've ruined the springs.  孩子们老是在沙发上跳来跳去的，把弹簧都跳坏了。

words.meaning: a.坚固的;坚决的,坚定的 n.公司,商号
words.example:
I'd rather sleep on a firm mattress than a soft one.  我宁愿睡硬床垫，也不要软的。
These pears are still too firm to eat.  这些梨还太硬，没法吃。UK adjective
The bridge provided a firm platform for the bungee jumpers.  这座桥为高空弹跳者提供了稳固的平台。

words.meaning: n.收音机;无线电报,无线电话v.无线电通讯
words.example:
She's got some kind of job in radio.  她在广播电台找了份工作。
We sent a message over the radio/by radio.  我们用无线电发了一条资讯。
The children had radio- controlled toy cars for Christmas.  孩子们在圣诞节得到的礼物是无线电遥控玩具车。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: vt.&n.访问，参观
words.example:
We visited a few galleries while we were in Prague.  我们在布拉格时参观了几家画廊。
Will you visit me when I'm in hospital?  我住院你会来看我吗？
When did you last visit the dentist/doctor?  你上一次去看牙医／医生是甚么时候？

words.meaning: vt.防止,避免;逃避,避开
words.example:
The report studiously avoided any mention of the controversial plan.  这份报告有意避而不谈那个有争议的计划。
The plane narrowly avoided disaster when one of the engines cut out on take-off.  飞机起飞时有一个引擎熄火，差点酿成重大事故。
Unnecessary paperwork should be avoided (= prevented) at all costs.  应该尽可能避免不必要的文书工作。

words.meaning: v.想象,设想,料想
words.example:
Imagine Robert Redford when he was young - that's what John looks like.  想像一下劳勃‧瑞福年轻时的样子——那就是约翰的模样。
They hadn't imagined (= expected) (that) it would be so difficult.  他们没想到会这么难。
I've never heard her criticize you - I think you imagine it.  我从来没有听过她批评你——我想你在胡思乱想。

words.meaning: ad.在今晚;在今夜 n.今晚,今夜
words.example:
Tonight will be my first opportunity to meet her.  今晚将是我与她见面的第一次机会。
Tonight's meeting will take place in the main school hall.  今晚的会议将在学校的大礼堂举行。

words.meaning: a.巨大的,庞大的
words.example:
They live in a huge house.  他们住在一栋很大的房子里。
The costs involved in building a spacecraft are huge.  建造一艘太空船的费用很高。
His last three films have all been huge successes.  他最后的三部电影都获得了空前的成功。

words.meaning: n.球(状物);(正式的)舞会vt.把…捏成球状
words.example:
Just try to concentrate on hitting the ball.  尽量集中精神，只想着击球。
The kitten curled itself into a ball (= the shape of a ball).  小猫蜷缩成一团。
Did you go to the Summer Ball last year?  去年你有参加夏日舞会吗？UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.完成;结束;磨光 v.完成;结束;用完;毁掉
words.example:
I'll call you when I've finished my homework.  我做完作业后会给你打电话。
Please place your questionnaire in the box when you've finished.  完成调查问卷后请将其投进箱子里。
She finished (the concert) with a song from her first album.  她以自己第一张专辑中的一首歌作为（音乐会的）结尾。

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]你自己;你亲自
words.example:
Be careful with that knife or you'll cut yourself!  用那把刀要当心，否则你会弄伤自己的！
Did you make the dress yourself?  那件衣服是你自己做的吗？
You can do that yourself.  你可以自己做那件事。UK US US (plural yourselves)

words.meaning: n.理论,原理;学说,见解,看法
words.example:
He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.  他认为那个洞是陨石坠落形成的。
In theory, the journey ought to take three hours, but in practice it usually takes four because of roadworks.  按理说，行程应该只要三小时，但由于道路施工，实际上通常会需要四小时。

words.meaning: v.回答,响应,作出反应
words.example:
He responded by marching off and slamming the door behind him.  他的反应是大步走出房间，狠狠甩上了门。
How did she respond to the news?  她听了这消息有甚么反应？
The police respond to emergencies (= arrive and are ready to deal with emergencies) in just a few minutes.  紧急事件发生时，员警在短短几分钟内就会作出反应。

words.meaning: n.声明,陈述
words.example:
The government is expected to issue a statement about the investigation to the press.  预计政府会就该调查向媒体作出说明。
He produced a signed statement from the prisoner.  他出示了一份犯人签字画押的口供。
He threw paint over the fur coats because he wanted to make a statement about cruelty to animals.  他把颜料洒在毛皮大衣上，想藉此表现人类对动物的残忍。

words.meaning: v.索(价);控告;充电 n.(pl.)费用,代价;电荷
words.example:
How much/What do you charge for a haircut and blow-dry?  剪发和吹风要收多少钱？
The bank charged commission to change my traveller's cheques.  银行兑现我的旅行支票收取了手续费。
The local museum doesn't charge for admission.  当地博物馆不收门票费。

words.meaning: a.流行的,通俗的,大众的;广受欢迎的
words.example:
She's the most popular teacher in school.  她是学校里最受欢迎的老师。
That song was popular with people from my father's generation.  那首歌在我爸爸那一代很流行。
Walking is a popular form of exercise in Britain.  在英国，走路是很流行的运动方式。

words.meaning: a.传统的，惯例的
words.example:
The villagers retain a strong attachment to their traditional values/customs/beliefs.  村民依然固守着传统的价值观／习俗／信仰。
The school uses a combination of modern and traditional methods for teaching reading.  该校采用传统与现代方式相结合的方法教授阅读。
The dancers were wearing traditional Hungarian dress/costume.  舞者身穿传统匈牙利服装。

words.meaning: prep.在...上面;到...上面
words.example:
The sheep were loaded onto trucks.  羊被装上了货车。(also on to) UK preposition
How did we get onto this subject?  我们是怎么谈到这个话题的？
Can we move onto the next item on the agenda?  我们可以进行议程的下一项内容吗？

words.meaning: n.方向,方位;指令,说明
words.example:
"No, go that way," I said, pointing in the opposite direction.  “不对，往那边走，”我一边说一边指著相反的方向。
He was going in the direction of the bedroom.  他正朝着卧室走去。
They drove away in opposite directions.  他们朝相反的方向驶去。

words.meaning: v.包含,容纳;容忍,抑制;可被...除尽
words.example:
How much liquid do you think this bottle contains?  你认为这个瓶可装多少液体？
I've lost a file containing a lot of important documents.  我丢了一个装有大量重要文件的文件夹。
Try to avoid foods which contain a lot of fat.  尽量别吃脂肪含量高的食物。

words.meaning: n.和平;平静,安宁
words.example:
Now that the war is over may there be a lasting peace between our nations.  既然战争已经结束，但愿我们两国之间能永久和平。
Peace lasted in Europe for just over 20 years after 1918 before war broke out again.  1918年后欧洲的和平局面仅仅维持了20年，之后战争再次爆发。
She's very good at keeping (the) peace within the family.  她非常善于维持家庭和睦。

words.meaning: n.痛,痛苦;(pl.)努力,劳苦 vt.使痛苦
words.example:
Her symptoms included abdominal pain and vomiting.  她的症状包括腹痛和呕吐。
Are you in (= suffering from) pain?  你痛吗？
She was in constant pain.  她一直痛个不停。

words.meaning: vi.(以书面形式)申请;请求 vt.应用;实施
words.example:
By the time I saw the job advertised it was already too late to apply.  我看到招聘广告的时候，已经太晚了，错过了应征时机。
Please apply in writing to the address below.  请将书面申请寄到以下地址。
We've applied to a charitable organization for a grant for the project.  我们已经向一个慈善组织提出申请，要求其对这个计划提供资助。

words.meaning: v.测量,分派,权衡 n.尺寸,量度器,措施,办法
words.example:
This machine measures your heart rate.  这台机器可测量你的心率。
He measured the flour into the bowl.  他量好面粉，倒入碗中。
The area, measuring/which measures 5 kilometres by 3 kilometres, has been purchased by the army.  这个长5公里、宽3公里的区域已被军方购买下来。UK verb

words.meaning: a.宽阔的;睁大的;远离的 ad.广阔地;偏差地
words.example:
His eyes were wide (= opened much more than usual) with surprise.  他惊讶得睁大了眼睛。
The rectangle is 5 cm long and 1.9 cm wide.  这个长方形长5厘米，宽1.9厘米。
The swimming pool is 5 metres wide.  这个游泳池有五米宽。

words.meaning: n./v.摇动,摇;颤抖,震动
words.example:
Babies like toys that make a noise when they're shaken.  婴儿喜欢摇晃时能发出声响的玩具。
The explosion shook buildings for miles around.  爆炸震动了好几哩以内的房屋。
She shook her hair loose from its ribbon.  她抖了抖头发，把丝带抖掉。

words.meaning: n.飞行;苍蝇 v飞行;飘杨 a.机敏的
words.example:
The poor bird couldn't fly because it had a broken wing.  这只可怜的鸟飞不起来了，因为它的翅膀断了。
As soon as it saw us, the bird flew away/off.  鸟一看到我们就飞走了。
We flew to Paris.  我们乘飞机去巴黎。

words.meaning: v./n.接见,会见;采访;面试
words.example:
In a television interview last night she denied she had any intention of resigning.  在昨晚的电视采访中，她否认有辞职的打算。
We've had 200 applicants for the job, but we only plan to interview about 20 of them.  有200人申请这份工作，但我们只打算对其中约20名进行面试。
Who's the most famous person you've ever interviewed on TV?  你在电视上采访过的人中谁最有名？

words.meaning: v.经营,管理,处理;设法,对付;操纵,运用
words.example:
Don't worry about us - we'll manage!  别担心我们——我们应付得了的！
Can you manage dinner on Saturday (= Will you be able to come to dinner) ?  你星期六能来吃晚餐吗？
mainly UK I'm afraid I can't manage the time (= I'm too busy) to see you at the moment.  恐怕我现在抽不出时间去见你。

words.meaning: n.椅子;(会议的)主席 vt.当…的主席,主持
words.example:
All questions should be addressed to the chair.  所有的问题都应当向主席提出。UK verb transitive
Would you like to chair tomorrow's meeting?  你愿意主持明天的会议吗？

words.meaning: n.(pl.fish(es))鱼;鱼肉 v.捕鱼;钓鱼
words.example:
Several large fish live in the pond.  池塘里有几条大鱼。
Sanjay caught the biggest fish I've ever seen.  桑杰伊捉到的鱼是我见过最大的。
Don't cry over Pierre - there are plenty more fish in the sea!  别为皮埃尔哭了，天下的好男人多的是！verb

words.meaning: a.特殊的,苛求的,个别的n.详情,细节,特色
words.example:
She wanted a particular type of cactus.  她要某一品种的仙人掌。
He wouldn't take just any book - he had to have this particular one!  他不会随便买书——他要买这本！
What in particular did you like about the last apartment that we saw?  我们最后看的那个公寓你特别喜欢它哪一点？

words.meaning: n.照相机,摄影机
words.example:
Television camera crews broadcast the event all round the world.  电视摄制组向全世界播放了这次事件。
It was said of Marilyn Monroe that the camera loved her (= that she looked very attractive on film and in photographs).  据说连摄像机都钟爱玛丽莲‧梦露。
They were caught on camera as they brutally attacked a man.  他们粗暴打人的场景被拍了下来。

words.meaning: n.政治,政治学;政纲,政见
words.example:
Joe is very active in left-wing politics.  乔在左翼政治中很活跃。
The group is campaigning to get more women into politics.  该组织正发起运动以使更多女性有机会从政。
He is planning to retire from politics next year.  他打算明年退出政坛。

words.meaning: v.履行,执行;表演,演出;完成(事业)
words.example:
Computers can perform a variety of tasks.  电脑能执行多项工作。
The operation will be performed next week.  手术将于下周进行。
Most of the students performed well in the exam.  大多数学生都考得很好。

words.meaning: n.一点,一些;小块,少量;片刻; [计]位,比特
words.example:
Would you like a bit of chocolate?  你想要点巧克力吗？
The glass smashed into little bits.  玻璃杯摔成了小碎片。
There were bits of paper all over the floor.  地板上到处都是碎纸片。

words.meaning: n.重量;负荷,重担;重要性,分量;砝码,秤砣
words.example:
What weight can this lorry safely carry?  这辆货车的安全载重量是多少？
There was a slight decrease in his weight after a week of dieting.  经过一周的节食之后，他的体重略有减轻。
Try not to lift heavy weights.  不要试图举起重物。

words.meaning: v.发现,显示
words.example:
Who discovered America?  谁发现了美洲？
We searched all morning for the missing papers and finally discovered them in a drawer.  我们一上午都在找那些失踪的档，最后终于在一个抽屉里找到了。
Los Angeles is full of beautiful girls working as waitresses, hoping to be discovered by a movie agent.  洛杉矶到处都有当服务员的漂亮女孩，她们希望能够被电影星探发掘。

words.meaning: n.候选人,候补者;报考者
words.example:
There are three candidates standing in the election.  有三位候选人参加竞选。
The English Department is a likely candidate for staff cuts.  英语系很有可能要裁员。
Candidates must write their names on the top page of the exam paper.  考生必须将自己的名字写在试卷首页。

words.meaning: n.生产,产品,作品,(研究)成果,总产量
words.example:
Coke is used in the production of steel.  焦炭用于炼钢。
We saw a quick film showing the various stages in the production of glass.  我们看了一部短片，片中展示玻璃制造过程中的不同阶段。
The company's new model will be going into production early next year.  这家公司的新型号将于明年初开始生产。

words.meaning: v.对待;治疗;论述;款待,请客 n.款待,请客
words.example:
My parents treated us all the same when we were kids.  小时候，父母对我们一视同仁。
He treated his wife very badly.  他对妻子很不好。
It's wrong to treat animals as if they had no feelings.  把动物当成没有感情的东西来对待是错误的。

words.meaning: n.旅行,远足 v.绊倒;失足;犯错
words.example:
The trip from York to Newcastle takes about an hour by train.  乘火车从约克到纽卡斯尔大约要一个小时。
Do you want to go on the school trip to France this year?  今年你想去法国游学吗？
mainly UK We can't afford another trip abroad this year.  今年我们没钱再次去国外旅行。

words.meaning: n.傍晚,黄昏,晚上
words.example:
Thank you for such a lovely evening.  多谢你的款待，让我渡过了一个如此美妙的夜晚。
In the evenings, I like to relax.  每到晚上，我喜欢放松一下。
I'm working late this evening.  今晚我要加班。

words.meaning: vt.影响;(疾病)侵袭;感动 n.情感,感情
words.example:
Both buildings were badly affected by the fire.  两座大楼都被大火严重焚毁。
The divorce affected every aspect of her life.  离婚使她生活的各个方面都受到了影响。
It's a disease which affects mainly older people.  这是一种主要侵扰老年人的疾病。

words.meaning: a.里面的 ad.在里面 n.内部 prep.在…里
words.example:
Did you clean the inside of the car?  你把车内擦干净了吗？
The hotel looked shabby from the street, but it was fine on the inside.  这家饭店从街上看去显得很破旧，但里面很好。
She dabbed perfume on the inside of her wrist.  她在手腕内侧搽了香水。

words.meaning: n.(正式)会议;讨论,商谈
words.example:
They frequently hold conferences at that hotel.  他们常在那家饭店举办会议。
I'm speaking at/attending a conference next week.  我下周要在一个会议上发言／出席一个会议。
Should I book the conference room for the meeting?  我要为会议预订会议室吗？

words.meaning: n.单位,单元;部件,元件;机组,装置
words.example:
The first year of the course is divided into four units.  该课程的第一年分为四个单元。
Each unit of the course book focuses on a different grammar point.  课本的每个单元各有不同的文法重点。
Dr Nussbaum is director of the Civil Liberties Research Unit at King's College, London.  努斯鲍姆博士是伦敦国王学院公民自由研究中心的主任。

words.meaning: n.风格,文体;式样,时式,类型
words.example:
Jones favours a dynamic, hands-on style of management.  琼斯喜欢那种充满活力、事事亲力亲为的管理风格。
His office is very utilitarian in style, with no decoration.  他的办公室在风格上讲究实用，没有任何装饰。
He wouldn't try to mislead you - it's not his style.  他不会有意误导你的——他不是那种人。noun

words.meaning: n.成年人 a.成年的,充分长成的,成熟的
words.example:
An adult under British law is someone over 18 years old.  根据英国法律规定，成年人是指18岁以上人士。
Adults pay an admission charge but children get in free.  成年人买票入内，儿童免费。adjective
She spent most of her adult life in prison.  成年后，她大部分的岁月是在监狱中度过的。

words.meaning: v.烦恼;(about)对…感到烦恼 n.烦恼,焦虑
words.example:
Try not to worry - there's nothing you can do to change the situation.  别发愁了——你没法改变这种局面。
Don't worry, she'll be all right.  别担心，她会没事的。
It's silly worrying about things which are outside your control.  为自己无法掌控的事发愁是很愚蠢的。

words.meaning: n.范围,领域;排列,连续;(山)脉v.排列成行
words.example:
There is a wide / whole range of opinions on this issue.  在这个问题上，存在着很多不同的意见。
We stock the full range of model railway accessories.  我们备有铁路模型玩具的全套零配件。
This jacket is part of our autumn/spring range.  这种外套是我们系列秋／春装中的一款。

words.meaning: v./n.提及,说起
words.example:
I'll mention your ideas to Jacinta.  我会跟哈辛塔说一下你的想法。
Did she mention me in her letter?  她在信中提到我了吗？verb transitive
He's one of the kindest and most intelligent, not to mention handsome, men I know.  他是我所认识的人当中其中一个最友善、最聪明的人，此外他还很英俊。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.深的,深长的;深奥的;强烈的 ad.深入的,迟
words.example:
The hole is so deep you can't see the bottom.  那个洞深不见底。
The water's not deep here - look, I can touch the bottom.  这里的水不深——看，我可以碰到底部。
Drill 20 holes, each 5 cm deep.  钻20个孔，每个孔5厘米深。

words.meaning: n.边,棱;刀口,刃 v.侧身移动,挤进
words.example:
He'd piped fresh cream around the edge of the cake.  他用鲜奶油沿蛋糕边挤花。
They built the church on the edge of the village.  他们把教堂建在村庄边缘。
Careful with that open tin - it's got a very sharp edge.  小心那罐打开的罐头——开口的地方很锋利。noun

words.meaning: a.明确的,具体的;特定的,特有的
words.example:
The virus attacks specific cells in the brain.  这种病毒专门攻击大脑内特定的细胞。
The money is intended to be used for specific purposes.  这笔钱有特定的用途。
formal The disease seems to be specific to (= only found in) certain types of plant.  这种病似乎是某些植物所特有的。

words.meaning: n.烦恼;动乱;疾病;故障;辛苦v.(使)烦恼
words.example:
The form was terribly complicated and I had a lot of trouble with it.  这张表格十分复杂，我填起来很费劲。
Their problems seem to be over for the moment, but there could be more trouble ahead.  他们的问题眼下看起来是完结了，但以后可能会有更多麻烦。
The trouble started/began when my father came to live with us.  父亲来和我们一起住之后，麻烦就开始了。

words.meaning: a.必需的,必要的;必然的 n.必需品
words.example:
He lacks the necessary skills for the job.  他不具备做这项工作所需的技能。
Just do what's necessary and then leave.  做完必要的事情就走吧。
If necessary, we can always change the dates of our trip.  必要的话，我们随时可以改变旅行的日期。

words.meaning: prep.遍及,贯穿 ad.到处,自始至终,彻底
words.example:
People throughout the country are out of work.  全国各地的人们都失去了工作。
He yawned throughout the performance.  演出期间他一直在打哈欠。
The school has been repainted throughout.  学校各处都重新粉刷了一遍。

words.meaning: n.挑战(书);艰巨任务,难题 v.向…挑战
words.example:
Finding a solution to this problem is one of the greatest challenges faced by scientists today.  寻找这个难题的解决办法是当今科学家所面临的最大挑战之一。
You know me - I like a challenge.  你了解我——我喜欢挑战。
It's going to be a difficult job but I'm sure she'll rise to the challenge.  这份工作会很有难度，不过我相信她会知难而上的。noun

words.meaning: n.害怕,恐惧;危险vt.畏惧,害怕,担心
words.example:
Trembling with fear, she handed over the money to the gunman.  她吓得发抖，战战兢兢地把钱递给了持枪歹徒。
Even when the waves grew big, the boy showed no (signs of) fear.  即使是浪大的时候，这个男孩也毫无惧色。
The low profit figures simply confirmed my worst fears.  这么低的利润完全证实了我最担心的事。

words.meaning: n.肩,肩部 v.肩负,承担
words.example:
Then she put her arm round my shoulder and gave me a kiss.  接着她用手臂搂住我的肩，给了我一个吻。
She glanced nervously over her shoulder to make sure no one else was listening.  她不安地回头扫了一眼，以确认没有人在听。
He was about six feet tall with broad shoulders.  他大约六呎高，双肩宽阔。

words.meaning: n.公共机构;协会;学校;研究所;制度;惯例
words.example:
Oxford and Cambridge universities are internationally respected institutions.  牛津和剑桥是国际上备受尊崇的大学。UK noun
figurative Mrs Daly is an institution - she's been with the company 40 years and knows absolutely everyone.  戴利夫人是老资历了——她在公司工作了40年，绝对了解每个人。UK noun
The institution of a Freedom of Information Act has had a significant effect.  《资讯自由法》的制定产生了深远的影响。

words.meaning: n./a.中间(的),当中(的)
words.example:
This is my class photo - I'm the one in the middle.  这是我的全班合照——中间的那个是我。
He was standing in the middle of the road.  他正站在路中央。
The noise woke us up in the middle of the night.  半夜吵闹声吵醒了我们。

words.meaning: n.海,海洋,大量
words.example:
We went swimming in the sea.  我们去海里游泳。
The sea was calm/smooth/choppy/rough when we crossed the Channel.  当我们横渡英吉利海峡时，海上风平浪静／水准如镜／波浪起伏／波涛汹涌。
The refugees were at sea (= in a boat on the sea a long way from land) for forty days before reaching land.  难民在海上航行了40天才到达陆地。

words.meaning: n./v.梦,梦想,幻想
words.example:
It's always been my dream to have flying lessons.  学习飞行一直是我的梦想。
Winning all that money was a dream come true.  赢得了那些钱，梦想终于实现了。
Win the house of your dreams in our fantastic competition!  参加我们超级棒的竞赛，赢得您梦想中的房子！noun countable

words.meaning: n.条,杆,闩;酒吧;栅,障碍(物) v.闩上,阻拦
words.example:
They noticed him going into the hotel bar.  他们看见他走进饭店的酒吧里。
There weren't any free tables, so I sat at the bar.  没有空位了，我只好坐在吧台旁。
Why don't you ask the guy behind the bar (= serving drinks there) ?  你怎么不问一问吧台里的那个职员？UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.美的,美丽的;出色的,完美的
words.example:
She was wearing a beautiful dress.  她穿着一条漂亮的连身裙。
You did a beautiful thing in helping those poor children.  你帮助那些可怜的孩子，真是爱心之举呀。UK adjective
This café is a favourite haunt of the beautiful people.  这间咖啡厅是上层社会时髦人物最爱光顾的地方之一。UK adjective

words.meaning: ad.代替,顶替
words.example:
There's no coffee - would you like a cup of tea instead?  没有咖啡——来杯茶好吗？
You can go instead of me, if you want.  如果你愿意，你可以代替我去。

words.meaning: v.改善,改进,增进;好转,进步
words.example:
He did a lot to improve conditions for factory workers.  他为改善工厂工人的工作条件做了许多工作。
Her health has improved dramatically since she started on this new diet.  自从开始这种新的饮食，她的健康状况大为改善。verb intransitive or transitive
Last time she ran the race in twenty minutes, so she's hoping to improve on that.  上次比赛她跑了20分钟，因此她希望在此基础上再作进步。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.方法,办法
words.example:
Travelling by train is still one of the safest methods of transport.  乘坐火车仍是最安全的交通出行方式之一。
The new teaching methods encourage children to think for themselves.  新的教学方法鼓励孩子独立思考。noun countable

words.meaning: pron.某人,有人 n.重要人物
words.example: Somebody is knocking at the door.  有人在敲门。

words.meaning: n.杂志,期刊
words.example: She has written articles for several women's magazines.  她为几家女性杂志撰稿。

words.meaning: n.旅馆
words.example: We stayed in/at a hotel on the seafront.  我们住在一家滨海饭店。

words.meaning: n.士兵,军人
words.example: Soldiers were patrolling the streets.  士兵们正在街上巡逻。UK verb

words.meaning: v.反射,反映,表现,反省,沉思
words.example:
He saw himself reflected in the water/mirror/shop window.  他在水中／镜子里／商店橱窗玻璃上看到了自己的影像。
The light reflected off the surface of the water.  光在水面上产生反射。verb
The statistics reflect a change in people's spending habits.  这些统计资料显示出人们的消费习惯发生了变化。verb

words.meaning: a.重的,重型的;沉重的,大量的,猛烈的
words.example:
How heavy is that box (= How much does it weigh) ?  那个箱子有多重？adjective
The sun disappeared behind heavy clouds.  太阳消失在厚云的背后。adjective
Then the police arrived and things got really heavy.  然后员警来了，事态变得很严重。adjective

words.meaning: n.袋,提包 v.把…装入袋中;猎杀;占有
words.example:
Don't eat that whole bag of (= the amount the bag contains) sweets at once.  不要一次就把整袋糖吃完。
Silly old bag!  又蠢又丑 的老太婆！noun countable
Come and stay with us - we've got bags of room.  来跟我们一起住吧——我们那边地方很大。

words.meaning: n.热,热度;热烈,激烈 v.(给)加热,(使)变热
words.example:
How do you manage to work in this heat without air conditioning?  在这种高温且没有空调的情况下你是如何得以工作的呢？
She always wore a coat, even in the heat of summer.  她总是穿着外套，甚至在炎热的夏天也不例外。
Cook the meat on a high/low heat (= at a high/low temperature).  用高温／低温来烹调肉。noun

words.meaning: n.结婚,婚姻;结婚仪式
words.example:
They had a long and happy marriage.  他们的婚姻长久而幸福。
She went to live abroad after the break-up of her marriage.  她婚姻破裂后便移居海外了。
She has two daughters by her first marriage.  她和第一任丈夫有两个女儿。

words.meaning: a.坚韧的,棘手的;强健的,吃苦耐劳的;粗暴的
words.example:
These toys are made from tough plastic.  这些玩具是由结实的塑胶制成。
Children's shoes need to be tough.  童鞋必须结实。
You have to be tough to be successful in politics.  要在政界取得成功就必须坚强。

words.meaning: v.唱,演唱;鸡叫
words.example:
The children sang two songs by Schubert at the school concert.  在学校音乐会上，孩子们演唱了舒伯特的两首歌曲。
We were woken early by the sound of the birds singing.  我们很早就被鸟儿的鸣唱声吵醒。
Your grandmother would like you to sing for/to her.  你祖母想叫你唱首歌给她听。

words.meaning: n.表面;外表 a.表面的,肤浅的
words.example:
Tropical rain forests used to cover 10% of the Earth's surface.  以前，地球表面的10%都被热带雨林所覆盖。
The marble has a smooth, shiny surface.  大理石表面光滑亮泽。
Neil Armstrong was the first person to set foot on the surface of the moon.  尼尔‧阿姆斯壮是第一个登上月球的人。

words.meaning: n.目的,意图;用途,效果
words.example:
The purpose of the research is to try and find out more about the causes of the disease.  研究的目的是试图进一步探寻引起这种疾病的原因。
His only purpose in life seems to be to enjoy himself.  他生活的唯一目的似乎就是享受。
Her main/primary purpose in suing the newspaper for libel was to clear her name.  她控告这家报纸诽谤的主要目的是为了澄清她的清白。

words.meaning: v.存在;生存;生活
words.example:
Poverty still exists in this country.  这个国家仍存在贫困现象。verb intransitive
Some species exist in this small area of forest and nowhere else on Earth.  一些物种仅存于这一小片森林中，地球上其他地方都没有。
Few people can exist without water for more than a week.  很少有人能在断水的情况下生存超过一星期。

words.meaning: n.模式,式样;图案,图样 v.仿制,模仿
words.example:
The pattern of family life has been changing over recent years.  近年来家庭生活的模式一直在变化。
In this type of mental illness, the usual pattern is bouts of depression alternating with elation.  这种精神病通常的发病症状是时而萎靡不振，时而兴高采烈。
Many behaviour(al) patterns have been identified in the chimp colony.  黑猩猩群体中的许多行为模式已被识别。UK noun

words.meaning: pron.谁;哪个人(who的宾格)
words.example:
He took out a photo of his son, whom he adores.  他拿出了一张爱子的照片。
There were 500 passengers, of whom 121 drowned.  500名乘客中共有121名溺弊。
To whom do you wish to speak?  你想找谁接电话？ formal

words.meaning: n.皮,皮肤;兽皮,皮毛;外皮,外壳 v.剥皮
words.example:
Babies have soft skins.  婴儿皮肤柔嫩。
Native Americans used to trade skins (= the skins of animals that have been removed from the body, with or without the hair).  印第安人过去曾买卖兽皮。
The bullet pierced the skin of the aircraft.  子弹击穿了飞机的外壳。

words.meaning: n.代理人;代理商;产生作用的人或事物
words.example:
Please contact our agent in Spain for further information.  如需更多资讯，请联络本公司在西班牙的代理。
literary He was the agent of their destruction.  是他导致了他们的毁灭。

words.meaning: n.物主,所有者
words.example:
Are you the owner of this car?  你是这辆车的车主吗？
We still haven't found the dog's owner.  我们还没有找到狗的主人。

words.meaning: n.机器,机械 v.用机器加工
words.example:
Eggs are sorted into different sizes by a machine.  鸡蛋由机器按大小分捡。
If I'm not home when you call, leave a message on the machine (= answering machine).  如果你打电话时我不在家，请在答录机上留言。
Don't forget to put the towels in the machine (= washing machine) before you go out.  出去前别忘了将毛巾放到洗衣机里。

words.meaning: n.气体;煤气;汽油;毒气vt.毒(死);加油
words.example:
Oxygen, hydrogen and nitrogen are all gases.  氧气、氢气和氮气都是气体。
Do you prefer cooking with electricity or gas?  你做饭喜欢用电还是用煤气？
Beer gives me gas.  我一喝啤酒肚子就会胀气。noun (plural gases or gasses)

words.meaning: ad.在前面(头);向(朝)前;提前
words.example:
The road ahead is very busy.  前面路上很拥挤。
Turn left at the traffic lights, and you'll see the hospital straight ahead.  在红绿灯那里左转，正前方就是医院，你一眼就能看见。
Rick walked on ahead of us.  里克走在我们前面。

words.meaning: n.产生,发生;一代(人)
words.example:
The younger generation smoke/smokes less than their parents did.  年轻的一代比他们父母这一代人吸烟要少。
There were at least three generations - grandparents, parents and children - at the wedding.  婚礼上至少有三代人——祖父母、父母和孩子们。
It's our duty to preserve the planet for future generations.  为了子孙后代保护好这个星球的环境是我们的职责。

words.meaning: a.商业的;商务的;可获利的 n.广告节目
words.example: The commercial future of the company looks very promising.  这家公司的商业前景看起来非常光明。

words.meaning: n.住址;致词 v.向...致词;在信封上写姓名
words.example:
She gave an address to the Royal Academy.  她在皇家艺术院作了场演讲。noun countable UK US [ˈæd.res/
He addressed a few introductory remarks to the audience.  他向观众说了几句开场白。
He likes to be addressed as 'Sir' or 'Mr Partridge'.  他喜欢被称为“先生”或“派特里奇先生”。verb transitive /əˈdres/

words.meaning: n.癌
words.example:
He died of liver cancer.  他死于肝癌。
It was a secondary cancer.  这是继发癌症。
Drug abuse is a cancer which is destroying our society.  滥用毒品是正在毁灭我们社会的毒瘤。

words.meaning: n.现实,实际;真实
words.example:
The reality of the situation is that unless we find some new funding soon, the youth centre will have to close.  现实情况是，如果我们不能马上再筹到一些资金，青少年中心就得关门。
He escaped from reality by going to the cinema every afternoon.  他每天下午都去电影院看电影，借此来逃避现实。
He seemed very young, but he was in reality (= in fact) older than all of us.  他看上去很年轻，可实际上他比我们所有人年龄都大。

words.meaning: n.长途公共汽车;教练 vt.训练,指导,培训
words.example:
We're going to the airport by coach.  我们要坐长途汽车去机场。
She coaches students in French, usually for exams.  她辅导学生法语，通常是准备考试的学生。UK noun uncountable adverb US
Even the company's director flies coach most of the time.  即使是公司的主管大多数时候都坐经济舱。

words.meaning: n.院子,场地;码
words.example: The house has a small yard at the back.  这所房子后面有个小院。

words.meaning: n.敲打;(心脏等)跳动 v.打败;(心脏等)跳动
words.example:
Simon always beats me at tennis.  西蒙在打网球时总是赢我。
Holland beat Belgium (by)3-1.  荷兰队以3比1战胜比利时队。
Our team was comfortably/easily/soundly beaten in the first round of the competition.  在第一轮比赛中，我们队被对手轻易地／毫不费力地／彻底打败了。

words.meaning: n.猛烈，激烈；暴力
words.example:
It seems that the attack was a gratuitous/random/mindless act of violence.  看起来这次袭击是一起无端／盲目／肆意的暴力行为。
The recent outbreak/eruption of racial violence in the area is very troubling.  最近发生在该地区的种族暴力事件非常令人担忧。
The report documents the staggering amount of domestic violence against women.  这份报告记述的女性遭受家庭暴力的事件数量惊人。

words.meaning: n.总数,合计 a.总的,全部的 v.合计,总数达
words.example:
At that time of day, cars with only one occupant accounted for almost 80% of the total.  一天中的那个时候，只有一人乘坐的汽车几乎占车辆总数的80%。
We made £700 in total, over three days of trading.  在三天的交易中，我们一共赚了700英镑。UK adjective
Total losses were $800.  总损失为800美元。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.趋向,往往是;照料,看护
words.example:
He carefully tended his sunflower plants.  他精心照料他的向日葵。
The nurse gently tended the patient's cuts and bruises.  护士细心护理病人的伤口和瘀肿。verb
Would you mind waiting? I'm tending to another customer at the moment.  请您等一下好吗？我正在接待另一位顾客。

words.meaning: n.讨论，谈论；论述
words.example: Management are holding/having discussions with the union about possible redundancies.  管理层正在与工会讨论裁员的可能性。

words.meaning: n.手指;指状物;指针
words.example:
He noticed her long delicate fingers.  他注意到她纤细修长的手指。
I'm all fingers and thumbs today. That's the second plate I've dropped this morning.  我今天笨手笨脚的，这已经是我今天早上打碎的第二个碟子了。UK noun countable
It's her exam this morning so cross your fingers.  今天上午她要考试，祝她好运吧。

words.meaning: n.(菜,花)园;公园
words.example: mainly UK The house has a large back garden, and a small front garden.  这座房子后面有个大花园，前面还有个小花园。

words.meaning: n.通知,通告,布告;注意,认识v.注意到,注意
words.example:
Mary waved at the man but he didn't seem to notice.  玛丽朝那个男人挥手，但他似乎没有看到。
She was first noticed by the critics at the age of 12, and went on to become a world-famous violinist.  十二岁时她第一次引起评论家的注意，此后她平步青云，成为了世界知名的小提琴家。UK noun
There was a large notice on the wall saying 'No Parking'.  墙上有一张很大的公告牌写著「禁止停车”。

words.meaning: n.收藏(品),收集(物)
words.example: The museum has a fine collection.  博物馆有很好的收藏。

words.meaning: a.现代的,近代的,新式的
words.example:
We're in the very modern-looking building opposite the station.  我们在车站对面那座非常现代化的大楼里。
approving My grandpa's attitudes are very modern, considering his age.  考虑到我祖父的年龄的话，他的看法相当前卫。UK adjective
What do you think is the role of religion in the modern world ?  你如何看待宗教在现代社会的角色？

words.meaning: n.任务,作业,工作
words.example:
We usually ask interviewees to perform a few simple tasks on the computer just to test their aptitude.  我们通常让接受面试人士在电脑上进行一些简单操作，只想测测他们的能力。
The government now faces the daunting task of restructuring the entire health service.  政府现在面临重新改组整个医疗卫生体系的艰巨任务。UK noun
She took her assistant to task for/over her carelessness.  她责备助手太粗心大意。UK verb transitive usually passive

words.meaning: n.合作者,合伙人,合股人,伙伴,舞伴,配偶
words.example:
He gave up his job as a police officer after his partner was killed.  他在搭档被杀后辞去了警官的工作。
The two companies are partners in a contract to build a new power station.  这两家公司订立合约，共同建造一座新的发电厂。
He's a partner in an insurance company/a law firm.  他是一家保险公司／律师事务所的合伙人。

words.meaning: a.肯定的,积极的,绝对的,无疑的,正的
words.example:
On a more positive note, we're seeing signs that the housing market is picking up.  更乐观地说，我们看到了房地产市场正在好转的迹象。
The past ten years have seen some very positive developments in East-West relations.  在过去的十年里，东西方关系有了一些非常积极的发展。
There was a very positive response to our new design - people seemed very pleased with it.  我们的新设计获得非常积极的回应——看来人们对该产品非常满意。    Opposite negativeUK adjective

words.meaning: a.公民的,市民的;民间的;民用的;有礼貌的
words.example:
Helicopters are mainly used for military rather than civil use.  直升机主要用于军事而非民用。
After ten years of military dictatorship, the country now has a civil government.  经历了十年军事专制统治后，该国现在有了一个文人政府。
We weren't married in church, but we had a civil ceremony in a registry office.  我们没在教堂结婚，不过在婚姻登记处举行了非宗教的仪式。adjective

words.meaning: n.厨房
words.example: We usually eat breakfast in the kitchen.  我们通常在厨房吃早餐。

words.meaning: n.开枪,射击;投篮;弹丸,炮弹,子弹
words.example:
And that was a great shot by Marquez!  那是马奎斯击出的精彩好球！
Graf drove a forehand shot down the line to win the match.  葛拉芙一记正手击球，球正好落在界内，从而赢得了比赛。UK noun
He fired four shots at the car as it drove off.  车驶离时，他向它连开四枪。

words.meaning: n.预算 v.做预算
words.example:
The firm has drawn up a budget for the coming financial year.  公司草拟了下一财政年度的预算方案。
Libraries are finding it increasingly difficult to remain within (their) budget.  图书馆感到想把支出维持在预算之内越来越难。
An extra £20 million has been budgeted for schools this year.  今年学校预算增加了2000万英镑。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: v.希望;但愿;祝 n.愿望,希望;[pl.]祝愿
words.example:
We could go to the cinema or we could go out for dinner - whatever you wish.  我们可以去看电影，也可以出去吃饭——你想怎样都行。
Passengers wishing to take the Kings Cross train should go to platform 9.  去往国王十字车站的乘客请到九号月台乘车。
We wish you every success in the future.  我们祝愿你将来事事成功。

words.meaning: n.上油漆,着色;绘画;油画;画法
words.example:
The walls are covered in oil paintings.  墙上挂满了油画。
We were taught painting and drawing at art college.  我们在美术学院学过绘画和素描。
When we bought the house, we had to do a lot of painting and redecorating.  我们买下这幢房子的时候，不得不好好油漆装修一番。

words.meaning: n.科学家
words.example: a research/nuclear scientist  研究型／核子科学家

words.meaning: a.安全的,牢靠的;谨慎的,可靠的 n.保险箱
words.example:
In some cities you don't feel safe going out alone at night.  在某些城市，夜晚独自外出会觉得不安全。
That ladder doesn't look safe.  那架梯子看起来不安全。
She wished us a safe journey.  她祝我们一路平安。

words.meaning: n.协定;协议;契约;达成协议;同意,一致
words.example:
The whole family was in agreement with her about/on what they should do.  对于他们应该做甚么，全家人都和她意见一致。
If the three parties cannot reach agreement now, there will be a civil war.  如果这三个政党现在不能达成共识，内战将不可避免。
The dispute was settled by an agreement that satisfied both sides.  由于达成了一项双方都满意的协议，争端得到了解决。

words.meaning: n.首都;大写字母;资本 a.主要的,大写字母的
words.example:
Australia's capital city is Canberra.  澳大利亚的首都是坎培拉。
London used to be the financial capital of the world.  伦敦曾是世界金融中心。UK noun
She leaves her capital untouched in the bank and lives off the interest.  她不动用银行里的本金，靠利息生活。

words.meaning: n.口,嘴
words.example:
Open your mouth wide and say "Ah".  张大嘴，说“啊”。
You shouldn't put so much food in your mouth at once.  你不该一次把这么多食物塞入口中。noun]maʊɵ/
Quebec is at the mouth of the St Lawrence River.  魁北克市位于圣劳伦斯河口。noun]maʊɵ/

words.meaning: conj./ad.也不,也没有
words.example:
We can neither change nor improve it.  对此我们既无法改变，也无法加以改善。
Strangely, neither Carlo nor Juan saw what had happened.  奇怪的是，卡洛和胡安都没有看到发生甚么事。

words.meaning: n.牺牲者，受害者
words.example:
The children are the innocent/helpless victims of the fighting.  孩子们是打架斗殴的无辜／无助的受害者。
The new drug might help save the lives of cancer victims.  这种新药也许可以用于挽救癌症病人的生命。
We appear to have been the victims of a cruel practical joke.  我们看来已经成了一个大恶作剧的受害者。

words.meaning: n.报纸
words.example:
Which newspaper do you read regularly?  平常你看甚么报纸？
He wants to work for a newspaper when he leaves school.  他毕业后想到报社工作。
You'd better wrap that mirror up in newspaper before you put it in the car.  你最好用旧报纸把那面镜子包一下再放进车里。UK noun

words.meaning: n.责任,责任心;职责,任务
words.example:
She takes her responsibilities as a nurse very seriously.  身为护士，她对自己的工作极为认真。
Who has responsibility here?  这里谁是负责人？
Jenny, you have responsibility for clearing up the room after the class.  珍妮，你负责课后打扫教室。

words.meaning: n.微笑,笑容 vi.微笑,露出笑容
words.example:
Amy had a big/broad smile on her face.  埃米脸上满是笑容。
She has a nice smile.  她笑得很甜。
He winked and gave me a smile.  他眨了眨眼，对着我笑了一下。

words.meaning: n.得分,分数;二十 v.得(分),记(…的)分数
words.example:
Tennant scored (a goal)in the last minute of the match.  坦南特在比赛的最后一分钟进了一球。
In American football, a touchdown scores (= is worth) six points.  在美式橄榄球中，攻方持球触地就得六分。
She scored 18 out of 20 in the spelling test.  拼写考试满分20分，她得了18分。

words.meaning: a.叙述,说明;账目,账户 vi.说明,解释
words.example:
I've opened an account with a building society.  我在房屋互助协会开了个帐户。
She gave a thrilling account of her life in the jungle.  她把在丛林中生活的经历描述得惊险刺激。
He kept a detailed account of the suspect's movements.  他详细纪录了嫌疑犯的一举一动。

words.meaning: a.有趣的,引人入胜的
words.example:
She's quite an interesting woman.  她是一个很有趣的女人。
She's got some very interesting things to say on the subject.  关于这个主题她有一些很有趣的东西要说。
It is always interesting to hear other people's point of view.  听一听其他人的意见总是很有趣的。

words.meaning: n.听众,观众,读者;见面,会见
words.example:
She lectures to audiences all over the world.  她向世界各地的听众发表演讲。
The secret to public speaking is to get the audience on your side.  当众演讲的秘诀是，一定要让听众支持你的观点。
The audience was/were clearly delighted with the performance.  无疑，观众非常喜欢这场演出。

words.meaning: a.富的,有钱的;富饶的;(in)充足的,丰富的
words.example:
He's the third richest man in Britain.  他是英国的第三大富豪。
They're one of the world's richest nations.  他们国家是世界上最富的国家之一。
He is determined to get rich quickly.  他决心尽快致富。adjective

words.meaning: n.正餐,宴会
words.example:
We were just having (our) dinner.  我们正在吃晚餐。
We had some friends round for dinner on Saturday.  星期六我们请了一些朋友来吃晚饭。
They held a dinner to celebrate his retirement.  他们举行晚宴来庆祝他退休。

words.meaning: n.投票,表决;选票,选票数 v.投票,表决
words.example:
She was too young to vote in the national election.  她的年龄太小，不能在全国大选中投票。
The committee voted on the proposal, and accepted it unanimously.  委员会就这一提议进行投票表决，结果一致通过。
Did you vote for or against the motion?  对这项动议你投了赞成票还是反对票？

words.meaning: a.西方的,西部的
words.example: Western festivals are popular with young people.  西方节日在年轻人中很流行。

words.meaning: v.叙述,讲述;使互相关联
words.example:
Researchers are trying to relate low exam results and/to/with large class sizes.  研究者们正试图证明学生考分低和班级规模大有关系。verb transitive
She related the events of the previous week to the police.  她对警方讲述了上个星期发生的事情。
Chapter nine relates to the effects of inflation on consumers.  第九章的内容是关于通货膨胀对消费者的影响的。

words.meaning: n.旅行 v.旅行;行进,传播
words.example:
After leaving school, she spent a year travelling, mostly in Africa and Asia.  毕业后她花了一年时间旅行，主要在非洲和亚洲。
He travelled over 100 miles to be at the wedding.  他从100多英里外过来参加婚礼。
As a young man he had travelled (= been to many parts of) the world.  他年轻时周游过世界。

words.meaning: v./n.争论,辩论
words.example:
Education is the current focus of public debate.  教育是目前大众谈论的焦点。
How we proceed from here is a matter for debate.  我们还需要讨论下一步该怎样做。
Over the year we have had several debates about future policy.  一年来，我们就未来的政策进行了几次讨论。verb

words.meaning: v.(from)预防,防止,阻止,制止,妨碍
words.example: Label your suitcases to prevent confusion.  在你的手提箱上贴上标签以防搞混。

words.meaning: n.公民;市民,居民
words.example:
The interests of British citizens living abroad are protected by the British Embassy.  侨居国外的英国公民的利益受英国大使馆的保护。
He applied to become an American citizen.  他申请成为美国公民。
The citizens of Moscow woke up this morning to find they had a new government.  今天早上，莫斯科市民一觉醒来发现他们有了一个新政府。

words.meaning: n.多数,大多数,成年,法定年龄
words.example:
The majority of the employees have university degrees.  大部分员工都有大学文凭。
In Britain women are in the/a majority.  在英国，妇女占多数。    Compare minority
The Socialists won by a narrow/large majority.  社会党党员获得的票数稍微／远远超出对手，在选举中获胜。UK noun

words.meaning: pron.没有任何人(东西);都不 ad.一点也不
words.example:
None of my children has/have blonde hair.  我的孩子们的头发都不是金色。
"I'd like some more cheese." "I'm sorry there's none left".  “我想再来点儿起司。”“很抱歉，已经没有了。”
She went to the shop to get some oranges but they had none.  她去商店买橘子，但是都卖完了。pronoun

words.meaning: a.前面的,前部的 n.正面;前线,战线 v.面对
words.example:
The National Front is an extremely right-wing political party in Britain.  民族阵线是英国极端右翼政党组织。
The Animal Liberation Front has claimed responsibility for releasing the monkeys from the laboratory.  动物解放阵线宣称是他们将那些猴子从实验室放走的。
The front of the museum is very impressive.  博物馆的正面极为壮观。

words.meaning: a.出生的,产生的;天生的,十足的
words.example:
She was born in 1950.  她生于1950年。
We saw a lamb being born.  我们看到小羔羊降生。
Diana was born into an aristocratic family.  戴安娜生于贵族之家。

words.meaning: vt.承认,供认;准许…进入,准许...加入
words.example:
He admitted his guilt/mistake.  他承认有罪／犯了错误。
At first he denied stealing the money but he later admitted (to) it.  初时他否认偷了钱，但是后来就承认了。
After several attempts to untie the knot, I admitted defeat and cut through it with a knife.  我试了几次都没有把这个结解开，最后认输了，就用刀子把它割开了。verb (-tt-)

words.meaning: a.年长的;地位较高的 n.(大学)四年级学生
words.example:
Senior pupils are expected to set an example to the younger children.  高年级的学生应该给低年级的学生树立榜样。    Compare junior
Hello, may I speak to Ken Griffey senior, please?  喂，请问老肯‧格里菲在吗？UK adjective
She's senior to me, so I have to do what she tells me.  她是我的上级，所以我得听她的。    Compare juniorUK noun

words.meaning: vt.假装;假定,设想;承担;呈现,采取
words.example:
Let's assume (that) they're coming and make plans on that basis.  我们还是假定他们会来，并以此来作出计划。
We mustn't assume the suspects' guilt.  我们千万不能想当然地认为疑犯有罪。UK verb transitive
Moving to a different town, he assumed a false name.  搬家到了另外一个城镇后，他用了个假名字。

words.meaning: n.风;气息 v.转动;缠绕;上发条,;蜿蜒而行
words.example:
There isn't enough wind to fly a kite.  风不够大，风筝飞不起来。
The weather forecast warned of winds of up to 60-miles-an-hour today.  天气预报警告说，今天有时速高达60英里的强风。
There was a light wind blowing.  微风轻拂。

words.meaning: n.钥匙;答案;关键;键 a.主要的,关键的
words.example:
The song changes key halfway through.  歌曲在中间部分调子变了。
Hard work is the key to success.  勤奋是成功的关键。adjective
She was a key figure in the international art world.  她是国际艺术界的重要人物。

words.meaning: a.快的,迅速的;坚固的 ad.紧紧地;迅速地
words.example:
Computers are getting faster all the time.  电脑的速度不断提升。
The fast train (= one that stops at fewer stations and travels quickly) to London takes less than an hour.  到伦敦的快车需时不到一小时。
It's not a relaxing film - it's pretty fast and furious.  这不是一部轻松的电影——它节奏很快，扣人心弦。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.单独的,孤独的 ad.单独地,独自地;仅仅
words.example:
He likes being alone in the house.  他喜欢自己一个人呆在家里。
She decided to climb the mountain alone.  她决定独自去爬那座山。
Do you like living alone?  你喜欢独居吗？

words.meaning: n.顾客,主顾
words.example: Mrs. Wilson is one of our regular customers.  威尔逊太太是我们的一位老主顾。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.(from)受痛苦,患病;受损失;遭受;忍受
words.example:
She suffers terribly in the winter when it's cold and her joints get stiff.  冬天天气寒冷，她的关节会变得僵硬，这让她非常难受。
She's been suffering from (= been ill with) cancer for two years.  她患癌症已经两年了。
Johnny suffers from (= is often ill with) asthma.  约翰尼患有哮喘。

words.meaning: n.演说,讲话;言语,语言
words.example:
Children usually develop speech in the second year of life.  儿童通常在一岁以后开始学习说话。
People who suffer a stroke may experience a loss of speech.  中风患者可能会丧失说话能力。
His speech was slurred and I thought he was drunk.  他说话含混不清，我想他是喝醉了。

words.meaning: a.圆满的;顺利的;成功的
words.example:
My second attempt at making flaky pastry was a bit more successful.  我第二次尝试做千层酥时就做得好一些了。
This year's harvest was one of the most successful since the record crop of 1985.  今年的收成是自1985年创纪录的大丰收以来最好的一年。    Opposite unsuccessful
She runs a very successful computer business.  她的电脑公司生意非常兴隆。

words.meaning: a.南方的,南部的
words.example: a southern route  南方的一条路线

words.meaning: a.新鲜的,无经验的
words.example:
The original orders were cancelled and I was given fresh instructions.  原来的命令撤销了，我又接到了新的指令。
Fresh evidence has emerged that casts doubts on the men's conviction.  出现了新的证据，对这些人的定罪出现了疑点。
We need to take a fresh look at the problem.  我们需要重新看待该问题。

words.meaning: n.森林
words.example: The children got lost in the forest.  孩子们在森林里迷了路。

words.meaning: a.电视的 n.电视
words.example:
Ed came over last night to watch the video of the football match that I'd recorded.  埃德昨天晚上过来看我录的足球比赛录影了。
We had a video made of our wedding.  我们的婚礼录了像。
'Spiderman' is now available on video.  《蜘蛛侠》的录影带现在已经在出售了。

words.meaning: v./n.改革,改造,改良
words.example:
Who will reform Britain's unfair electoral system?  谁将改革英国不公正的选举制度呢？
For years I was an alcoholic, but I reformed when the doctors gave me six months to live.  我酗酒多年，但当医生预计我只能再活六个月时，我就改过自新了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Some reforms of/to the system will be necessary.  有必要对该制度进行一些改革。

words.meaning: n.进入;接入;到达;享用权;入口 vi.存取
words.example:
The only access to the village is by boat.  到那个村子去的唯一方法是乘船。
The main access to (= entrance to) the building is at the side.  大楼的主入口在侧面。
The tax inspector had/gained complete access to the company files.  税务稽查员拥有／获得了查看公司所有档的权利。

words.meaning: n.餐馆,饭店
words.example: The restaurant is always crowded.  这家餐厅总是很挤。

words.meaning: n.法官;裁判员;鉴定人 vt.审判;评论,裁判
words.example:
She's such a bad judge of character.  她很不善于鉴赏别人的品格。
So far, he seems to be handling the job well, but it's really too soon to judge.  到目前为止，他的工作看起来做得还不错，但现在下结论还言之过早。
The meeting was judged (to have been) a success.  人们认为会议很成功。

words.meaning: v.出版,刊印;公布,发布
words.example:
She's just had an article published in their weekend supplement.  她刚在他们周末版的增刊上发表了一篇文章。
The Government publishes figures every six months showing how many people are unemployed.  政府每半年公布一次失业人数。
The names of the winners of the competition will be published in June.  竞赛优胜者名单将于六月份公布。

words.meaning: n.关系,联系;亲属,亲戚
words.example:
Relations between him and his new wife are rather strained.  他和新娶的妻子之间的关系很紧张。
formal Britain enjoys friendly relations with Canada.  英国和加拿大的关系非常友好。
The relation between the original book and this new film is very faint.  原著和这出新电影之间没太多联系。

words.meaning: n.鸟,雀;女人;嘘声
words.example:
Most birds lay eggs in the spring.  大多数鸟类都在春天产卵。
Penguins and ostriches are flightless birds (= they cannot fly).  企鹅和鸵鸟都不会飞行。
We watched a flock of birds fly over the field.  我们看着一群鸟飞过田野。

words.meaning: n.意见,看法,主张
words.example:
What's your opinion about/on the matter?  你对这件事有甚么看法？
People tend to have strong opinions on capital punishment.  人们往往对死刑抱有过激的看法。
He didn't express/give an opinion on the matter.  他没有就此事发表意见。

words.meaning: v./n.信用,信任 n.信用贷款,赊欠;名誉,名望
words.example:
She got no credit for solving the problem.  她没有因为解决了这一问题而得到任何赞许。
Her boss took credit for it/ took (all) the credit instead.  她的老板反倒为此赢得了声誉／把一切全归功于自己。
To her (great) credit, she admitted she was wrong.  她承认自己错了，这（很）值得称赞。

words.meaning: n.角,街角;偏僻处; vt.将…逼入困境;
words.example:
You drive round corners too fast - just slow down a bit!  你转弯时开得太快——稍微放慢一点！
There's a postbox on the corner (= the place where the street crosses another).  街角处有个邮筒。
Click the icon in the bottom right-hand corner of the screen.  点击萤幕右下方的图示。

words.meaning: n.译文；说法；改写本
words.example:
The official version of events is that the police were attacked and were just trying to defend themselves.  事件的官方说法是员警受到了攻击，他们只是想自卫。
You can make a reduced fat version of the cheesecake by using cottage cheese instead of cream cheese.  你可以用茅屋起司代替奶油起司来制作低脂肪的起司蛋糕。
An English-language version of the book is planned for the autumn.  那本书的英语版本计划在秋天推出。

words.meaning: v.(at)盯,凝视
words.example:
Don't stare at people like that, it's rude.  不要那样盯着人看，很不礼貌。
Chuck sat quietly for hours staring into the distance, thinking of what might have been.  查克静静地坐了几个钟头，凝视着远方，寻思着事情本来可能会有的另一番发展。
During the press conference, each boxer tried to stare the other down / UK alsoout (= force the other to look away by continual staring).  记者招待会上两位拳击手都瞪大双眼直视对方，想把对方压倒。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.(neighbourhood)邻居;四邻,街道
words.example: It's a friendly neighborhood.  这是个友好的街区。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)部队,军队;(一)群/队 v.群集,集合
words.example:
Traditionally, United Nations troops have been deployed only in a peacekeeping role.  传统上，联合国部队的部署只用于维和目的。
The major powers have said they will not send in ground troops (= soldiers who fight on land).  一些大国声称不准备派遣地面部队。
In 1988, about 220 000 American troops were stationed in Western Europe.  1988年大约有22万美国军队驻扎在西欧。

words.meaning: n.收入,收益,所得
words.example:
Average incomes have risen by 4.5% over the past year.  人均收入比去年上升了4.5%。
More help is needed for people on low incomes.  低收入人士需要更多的帮助。

words.meaning: n.伤痛,伤害 v.刺痛,伤害;伤…的感情
words.example:
Tell me where it hurts.  告诉我哪里痛。
My head hurts.  我的头很痛。
She says that her ear hurts her.  她说她的耳朵很痛。

words.meaning: ad.立即；直接地
words.example:
We really ought to leave immediately.  我们真的应该马上就走。
The purpose of the meeting wasn't immediately obvious.  会议的目的并不十分明确。
Milton Street is on the left, immediately after the bank.  密尔顿大街在左边，一过银行就是。

words.meaning: n.跑道,小路;轨迹,轮迹 v.跟踪,追踪
words.example:
The house is at the end of a dirt/an unmade track.  房子在一条泥土路／尚未铺好的小路的尽头。
Passengers are requested not to walk across the tracks.  乘客不得穿越铁轨。noun
The runners are now on their final lap of the track.  赛跑选手正在跑最后一圈。

words.meaning: a.基本的,基础的
words.example:
He only has a basic command of English (= He only knows the most important and simple words and expressions).  他只会说很基本的英语。
The basic (= most important) problem is that they don't talk to each other enough.  根本问题在于他们彼此不怎么说话。
It's the most basic model (= it only has the most simple features).  它只是个最基本的模型。

words.meaning: n./vi.罢工 vt.打,击;攻击;给…深刻印象
words.example:
Democratization has brought workers the right to strike and join a trade union.  民主化赋予工人罢工和加入工会的权利。
We're striking for a reduction in the working week and improved safety standards.  我们举行罢工，要求减少每周工作时间并提高安全标准。verb
I've got a life insurance policy that will look after my family if disaster strikes.  我有人寿保险，这样即使灾难降临，我的家人也会有保障。

words.meaning: n.天空;[pl.]天色;气候
words.example:
Can you see those birds high up in the sky?  你能看到高空的那些鸟吗?
We looked up at/into the sky at the sound of the plane.  我们听到飞机的声音后抬头仰望天空。
For weeks we had cloudless blue skies.  有好几周我们这里的天空都是晴朗无云，一片湛蓝。

words.meaning: n.自由,自主,免除,特权
words.example:
Children are allowed much more freedom these days.  现在孩子们的自由大得多了。
Everyone should be allowed freedom of choice (= the ability to make their own choices).  每个人都应享有自由选择的权利。
Freedom of speech and freedom of thought (= The ability to say and think whatever you want) were both denied under the dictatorship.  在独裁统治下，言论和思想的自由都被剥夺了。

words.meaning: n.飞机;平面,水平面
words.example:
We'll be boarding the plane in about 20 minutes.  大约20分钟后我们就要登机。
He hates travelling by plane.  他不喜欢坐飞机旅行。
The poet's treatment of the subject lifts it to a mystical plane.  诗人对该题材的处理使其提升到一个玄妙的境界。

words.meaning: pron.谁也不,无人 n.小人物
words.example:
Is there nobody here who can answer my question?  这儿没有人能够回答我的问题吗？
Nobody agreed with me.  没人同意我的看法。UK noun countable
He's just some nobody trying to get noticed by the press.  他只不过是个想引起媒体注意的无名之辈。

words.meaning: vt.实现,完成;达到,得到vi.达到预期目的
words.example:
The government's training policy, he claimed, was achieving its objectives.  他称政府制定的培训方针即将达到预期目标。
She finally achieved her ambition to visit South America.  她终于实现了去南美洲旅游的梦想。
I've been working all day, but I feel as if I've achieved nothing.  我干了整整一天，但觉得好像甚么都没有做成。

words.meaning: n.物体;客体,对象;目标;宾语 v.(to)反对
words.example:
Look, there's a strange object in the sky!  看，天上有个奇怪的东西！noun UK GRAMMAR  文法
In the sentence 'I like ice cream', 'ice cream' is the object of the verb 'like'.  在句子 I like ice cream 中，ice cream 是动词 like 的受词。
The object of their expedition was to discover the source of the River Nile.  他们探险的目的是找到尼罗河的源头。

words.meaning: n.态度,看法(to, toward, about);姿势
words.example:
It's often very difficult to change people's attitudes.  人们对事情的看法通常是很难改变的。
He has a very bad attitude to/towards work.  他的工作态度极差。
He seems to have undergone a change in/of attitude recently, and has become much more co-operative.  他的态度近来好像转变了，变得合作多了。

words.meaning: n.(labour)工作,劳动;劳力 v.劳动,苦干
words.example: Hard labor builds character.  辛勤劳动塑造品格。

words.meaning: v.参考,查询;提到,引用,涉及;提交,上呈
words.example:
In her autobiography she occasionally refers to her unhappy schooldays.  在其自传中，她偶尔提及了她不幸的学生时代。
He always refers to the house as his "refuge".  他总是把这座房子称为他的“避难所”。
The new salary scale only refers to company managers and directors.  新的工资级别标准只适用于公司经理和主管人员。UK US (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.概念,观念,设想
words.example:
The very concept of free speech is unknown to them.  他们没有言论自由的概念。
It is very difficult to define the concept of beauty.  很难给美这个概念下一个定义。
Kleenbrite is a whole new concept in toothpaste!  Kleenbrite 是牙膏生产领域的一个全新概念！

words.meaning: a.强大的,有力的,有权的
words.example:
The President is more powerful than the Prime Minister.  总统比总理权力更大。
She's the most powerful person in the organization.  她是该组织中最有影响力的人。UK adjective
She's an extremely powerful runner.  她是个非常矫健的赛跑选手。

words.meaning: a.完善的;完全的;(语法)完成的 v.使完美
words.example:
What is your idea of perfect happiness?  你认为完美的幸福是怎么样的？
