This church is a perfect example of medieval architecture.  这座教堂是中世纪建筑的完美典范。
You have a perfect English accent.  你有一口道地的英格兰口音。

words.meaning: ad.因此,所以 conj.因此
words.example: We were unable to get funding and therefore had to abandon the project.  我们无法筹到资金，因此不得不放弃计划。

words.meaning: n.行为,品行 v.引导;管理;指挥(乐队);传导
words.example:
We are conducting a survey to find out what our customers think of their local bus service.  我们正在进行一项调查，了解顾客对当地公共交通服务系统的看法。
The experiments were conducted by scientists in New York.  这些实验是纽约的科学家做的。
How you choose to conduct your private life is your own business!  你选择怎么过你的私生活是你自己的事！verb[kənˈdʌkt/

words.meaning: v.正式宣布;发表;通告;广播(电台节目)
words.example:
They announced the death of their mother in the local paper.  他们在一家当地报纸上刊登了他们母亲去世的讣告。
She announced the winner of the competition to an excited audience.  她向激动的观众宣布了比赛的获胜者。
The first few leaves in the gutter announced the beginning of autumn.  排水沟中最先落下的几片叶子标志着秋天的来临。

words.meaning: n.会话,谈话
words.example:
She had a strange conversation with the bloke who's moved in upstairs.  她跟搬到楼上的那个家伙进行了一次奇怪的交谈。
It's impossible to hold/carry on a conversation with all this noise going on!  周围这么吵根本无法谈话！
Because of television, many people have lost the art of conversation (= talking to each other).  由于电视的缘故，许多人变得不善于与他人交谈了。

words.meaning: v.检查,调查;对…进行考试
words.example:
Forensic scientists are examining the wreckage for clues about the cause of the explosion.  法医科学家正在对残骸进行检查，希望能发现与爆炸原因有关的线索。
The council is to examine ways of reducing traffic in the city centre.  市政委员会将研究减少市中心交通流量的方法。
The research examined the effects of alcohol on long-term memory.  这项研究探讨了酒精对长期记忆的影响。

words.meaning: v.触,碰,摸;感动;涉及 n.触动,碰到;少许
words.example:
That paint is wet - don't touch (it).  那块油漆未干——别碰（它）。
He touched the girl on the arm to get her attention.  他碰了碰女孩的胳膊来引起她的注意。
The child touched the worm with (= using, in his hand) a twig.  小孩用小树枝碰了碰虫子。

words.meaning: v.请;使愉快,使满意;喜欢,愿意
words.example:
Could I have two cups of coffee and a tea, please?  给我来两杯咖啡、一杯茶好吗？
Please remember to close the windows before you leave.  您离开前请记住关上窗户。
Please, David, put the knife down.  求求你，大卫，把刀放下。

words.meaning: vt.出席,参加;照顾,护理 vi.注意;侍奉
words.example:
Over two hundred people attended the funeral.  二百多人参加了葬礼。
The meeting is on the fifth and we're hoping everyone will attend.  会议将在5号举行，我们希望大家都能出席。
Which school do your children attend?  你们的孩子在哪间学校就读？

words.meaning: n.多样化；种类；变种
words.example:
When preparing meals, you need to think about variety and taste as well as nutritional value.  做饭时，你既需要考虑饭菜的营养价值，又需要考虑饭菜的花样和味道。
Sexual reproduction serves to create genetic variety.  有性繁殖可以使基因多样化。
Work on the production line is monotonous and lacks variety.  在生产线上工作很单调，缺乏变化。UK noun

words.meaning: v.(slept,slept)睡 n.睡眠
words.example:
You'll find that your baby usually goes to sleep after a feed.  你会发现你的孩子通常吃饱后就睡了。
You must be tired after all that driving - why don't you have a little sleep?  开了那么长时间的车你一定累了——为甚么不小睡一会儿？
He fell into a deep sleep.  他睡得很沉了。noun

words.meaning: a.核心的,中心的;原子核的,核能的
words.example: How many nations have a nuclear capability (= have nuclear weapons) ?  有多少国家拥有核武器？UK adjective

words.meaning: v.压;压榨;紧迫,催促 n.报刊,通讯社;压榨机
words.example:
Press the button to start the machine.  按下按钮，启动机器。
He pressed his face against the window.  他把脸贴在窗户上。
Can you press a bit harder on my shoulders, please?  你按压我的肩膀时能再用力一点吗？

words.meaning: n.战斗,斗争;抵触,冲突 v.(with)抵触,冲突
words.example:
There was a lot of conflict between him and his father.  他和父亲之间存在着许多分歧。
It was an unpopular policy and caused a number of conflicts within the party.  这项政策不得人心，在党内引起了一些分歧。
His outspoken views would frequently bring him into conflict with the president.  他对自己的看法总是直言不讳，这常常使他和总统发生争执。

words.meaning: n.精神;志气;(pl.)情绪,心情;(pl.)酒精
words.example:
The players have a very strong team spirit (= loyalty to each other).  队员们有很强的团队精神。
As rock musicians in the 1960s, they were very much part of the spirit of the age/times.  作为20世纪60年代的摇滚音乐家，他们在很大程度上代表了当时的时代精神。
We acted in a spirit of cooperation.  我们遵循合作精神行事。

words.meaning: vt.取代,替换,代替,把...放回原处
words.example:
The factory replaced most of its workers with robots.  这间工厂用机器人取代了大多数工人。
Tourism has replaced agriculture as the nation's main industry.  旅游业取代了农业成为这个国家的主要产业。
The librarian replaced the books correctly on the shelves.  图书管理员把书一本不差地放回了原处。

words.meaning: v.鼓励,怂恿
words.example:
transitive + to infinitive We were encouraged to learn foreign languages at school.  在校时，学校鼓励我们学习外语。
The council is encouraging the development of the property for both employment and recreation.  市政委员会鼓励开发该项房地产的目的在于促进就业和增加娱乐设施。
They've always encouraged me in everything I've wanted to do.  不论我想做甚么，他们总是会鼓励我。

words.meaning: n.争论(吵),辩论;理由;论证
words.example:
The children had an argument about/over what game to play.  那群孩子为了玩哪个游戏吵了起来。
He got into an argument with Jeff in the pub last night.  昨晚他和杰夫在酒馆里起了争执。
Now that we've heard all the arguments for and against the proposal, shall we vote on it?  支持和反对这项提议的所有理由我们都已经听过了，是否可以对此进行表决了？

words.meaning: n.野营,营地;帐篷,阵营 v.设营,宿营
words.example:
We pitched/set up camp (= put up our tents) by the lakeside.  我们在湖边扎了营。
The pro-abortion camp are fighting to decriminalize abortion.  支持堕胎的阵营正在力争使堕胎合法化。
The party is divided into two distinct camps over the legislation.  该党在这项立法上很鲜明地分为两大阵营。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.(大)脑,骨髓;(pl.)脑力,智能
words.example:
Doctors tried desperately to reduce the swelling in her brain.  医生想尽一切办法缩小她脑部的肿块。
The accident left him with permanent brain damage.  事故给他造成了永久大脑损伤。
His wife died from a brain tumour.  他妻子死于脑瘤。

words.meaning: n.下午,午后
words.example:
It was a sunny afternoon.  那是一个阳光明媚的下午。
She works three afternoons a week at the library.  她每周在图书馆工作三个下午。
It was on a Saturday afternoon.  那是在一个星期六的下午。

words.meaning: abbr. 调幅；v. 是；n. (Am)人名；(柬)安
words.example:
You're listening to Radio Gold, broadcasting 24 hours a day on 909 AM.  您正在收听的是黄金广播电台，每天24小时调幅909播出。noun
Am I included?  包括我吗？

words.meaning: n.周末
words.example:
Have you got anything planned for the weekend?  你周末有甚么安排吗？
This/Next weekend we're going to see some friends.  本／下周末我们要去拜访一些朋友。
How much would a weekend for two in Amsterdam cost?  两个人去阿姆斯特丹度周末要花多少钱？

words.meaning: n.一打,十二个
words.example:
This recipe makes three dozen cookies.  这份配料能做三打曲奇饼。
Could you get me half a dozen (= six) eggs when you go to the shop?  你去商店时给我捎半打鸡蛋好吗？
informal I've spoken to him dozens of (= many) times, but I still don't know his name!  虽然我和他说过很多次话，但我连他的名字都还不知道！

words.meaning: n.可能,可能性;可能的事,希望
words.example:
It's not likely to happen but I wouldn't rule out the possibility.  这件事不太可能发生，但我不会排除有这种可能性。
The forecast said that there's a possibility of snow tonight.  天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。
Is there any possibility (that) you could pick me up from the station?  你有可能去车站接我吗？    Opposite impossibility

words.meaning: n.保险,保险费,保险业
words.example:
I'll need to take out extra car insurance for another driver.  我必须为另一名驾驶者购买汽车保险。
The insurance doesn't cover you for (= include) household items.  这份保险没有包括你的家居物品。    Compare assurance

words.meaning: n.部,局,处,科,部门;系,学部
words.example:
The accounts department is/are having a Christmas party this week.  本周财政部将举办圣诞晚会。
Wasn't buying the tickets your department, Kev?  基夫，你不是负责买票吗？UK US  (written abbreviation dept)
He's a bit lacking in the brain department.  他的脑筋转得有点慢。

words.meaning: n.战役,战斗;斗争 v.战斗,斗争,搏斗
words.example:
Her only brother was killed in battle (= while fighting).  她唯一的哥哥在战斗中牺牲了。
The aid agency continues the battle against ignorance and superstition.  该援助机构持续对抗愚昧和迷信。
The battle for women's rights still goes on.  争取妇女权利的斗争还在继续进行。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.日期,年代 v.注明…的日期 n./v.约会
words.example:
What's the date (today)?/What date is it?/What's today's date?  今天是几号？
Today's date is (Friday) the 24th of June/June the 24th (1994).  今天是（1994年）6月24日（星期五）。
What is your date of birth ?  你的出生日期是哪一天？

words.meaning: a.非洲的 n.非洲人
words.example: African history/music  非洲历史／音乐

words.meaning: a.对不起,抱歉的;难过,悔恨的;使人伤心
words.example:
I'm just sorry about all the trouble I've caused her.  我为给她带来的所有麻烦而感到抱歉。
He'd really upset her and he didn't seem at all sorry.  他确实惹恼了她，但他似乎一点也不感到愧疚。
He sounded very sorry for himself on the telephone.  他在电话里听起来一肚子怨气。

words.meaning: a.完全的,圆满的 v.完成,结束,使完满
words.example:
Complete the sentence with one of the adjectives provided.  从所给形容词中选择一个使句子变得完整。
He only needs two more cards to complete the set.  他只需再有两张牌就凑成一副了。
All she needed to complete her happiness was a baby.  只需再有个孩子她的生活就幸福美满了。

words.meaning: n.扇子,风扇;(影,球等)迷 v.扇,扇动,激起
words.example:
More than 15, 000 Liverpool fans attended Saturday's game.  超过15 000名利物浦队球迷周六到现场观看了比赛。
He's a big fan of country music.  他是个超级乡村音乐迷。
I'm pleased to meet you - I'm a great fan of your work.  很高兴见到您——我非常喜欢您的作品。noun countable

words.meaning: n.棍,棒,手杖 v.刺,戳,扎;粘贴
words.example:
The old man was carrying a load of sticks.  那个老人抱着一捆树枝。
Police said that the child had been beaten with a stick.  警方说那个孩子被人用木棍打了。
Find some dry sticks and we'll make a campfire.  找些干树枝，我们来生营火。

words.meaning: n.洞,孔
words.example:
We dug a hole and planted the tree.  我们挖了个洞栽种那棵树。
My jumper's got a hole in it.  我的套头衫上破了个洞。
Drill a hole through the back of the cupboard and pass the wires through.  在壁橱后面钻个洞，把电线穿过去。

words.meaning: n.地位,身份;情形,状况
words.example:
The association works to promote the status of retired people as useful members of the community.  这个协会旨在提高退休人员的地位，使其成为社会中有用的成员。
There has been an increase in applications for refugee status.  越来越多的人申请难民身份。
The success of her book has given her unexpected celebrity status.  她的书的成功给她带来意想不到的名气。

words.meaning: a.正常的,普通的;正规的,标准的
words.example:
Lively behaviour is normal for a four-year-old child.  四岁的孩子好动是正常的。
It 's normal for couples to argue now and then.  夫妻之间偶尔发生口角是很平常的。
They were selling the goods at half the normal cost.  他们正半价销售那些商品。

words.meaning: n.船舶,舰艇 v.装运,航运,运送;发货
words.example:
They boarded (= went on to) a ship that was sailing (= leaving) the next day.  他们登上了一艘隔天启航的船。noun countable
We ship books out to New York every month.  我们每个月都有书运往纽约。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition
The children were shipped off to their grandparents' house for the holidays.  孩子们被送到祖父母家度假。

words.meaning: n.石,石头;岩石,矿石;(水果的)核、子
words.example:
They cut enormous blocks of stone out of the hillside.  他们从山上开采出大量石材。
Some demonstrators were arrested for throwing stones at the police.  一些示威者因向员警投掷石块被逮捕。
She has put on/lost a stone (= is a stone heavier/lighter).  她重／轻了1英石。UK noun

words.meaning: n.(综合)大学
words.example:
Which university did you go to /were you at (= did you study at) ?  你曾就读哪所大学？
She teaches at the University of Connecticut.  她任教于康乃迪克大学。

words.meaning: vt.介绍;引进,传入;提出(议案等)
words.example:
The smaller 10 pence coin was introduced in 1992.  比较小的10便士硬币是在1992年开始流通的。
Such unpopular legislation is unlikely to be introduced before the next election.  如此不受欢迎的法规不可能在下次选举之前推行。
specialized The tube which carries the laser is introduced into the abdomen through a small cut in the skin.  传送雷射的导管透过皮肤上的小切口插入腹部。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.企图,试图 n.努力,尝试,企图
words.example:
He attempted a joke, but no one laughed.  他开了个玩笑，试图调和气氛，但没有一个人笑。
There's no point in even attempting an explanation - he'll never listen.  试图去解释是毫无意义的——他根本不会听。noun countable
He made no attempt to be sociable.  他不合群，也不试图去改变这一点。

words.meaning: n.公园,停车场,运动场 v.停放(汽车等),寄放
words.example:
We watched the joggers in the park.  我们在公园里看别人慢跑。
Where have you parked?  你把车停在哪里了？
Just park your car in the driveway.  就把车停在车道上吧。

words.meaning: n.斑点;地点 v.认出,认清,发现;玷污,弄脏
words.example:
He had a spot of grease on his tie.  他的领带上有一小块油渍。
Teenagers often suffer a lot from spots.  青少年常常深受粉刺的困扰。
Shall we stop for a spot of lunch?  我们停下来吃点午饭好吗？

words.meaning: n./v.缺乏,不足
words.example:
Her only problem is lack of confidence.  她唯一的问题是缺乏自信。
Lack of sleep had made him irritable.  睡眠不足令他烦躁易怒。
If he fails it won't be for/through lack of effort (= he has certainly tried).  他若失败了，那肯定不是因为他努力不够。

words.meaning: n.冰;冰冻甜食 vt.冰冻,使成冰
words.example:
The pond was covered in ice all winter.  这个池塘整个冬天都结着冰。
Would you like ice in your juice?  你的果汁里要加冰块吗？
I've put a couple of bottles of champagne on ice (= in a container of ice to get cold).  我已经把几瓶香槟冰镇起来了。

words.meaning: n.小船,艇
words.example:
We took turns to row the boat up the river.  我们轮流划艇船逆流而上。
Are you travelling by boat or by air?  你要乘船还是乘飞机旅行？
I'm taking the boat from Dover to Calais.  我要乘从多佛开往加来的船。

words.meaning: v.(drank,drunk)喝,饮 n.饮料;喝酒
words.example:
Would you like a drink of water/tea/juice?  你想喝点水／茶／果汁吗？
They'd had no food or drink for two days.  他们已经两天没吃没喝了。noun countable or uncountable
Have we got time for a quick drink?  我们有没有时间喝杯小酒？

words.meaning: n.太阳;恒星;美国Sun公司
words.example:
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.  太阳东升西落。
The sun's rays are at their most powerful at midday.  正午时分阳光最强烈。
Shall we go and sit out in the sun?  我们到外面阳光下坐坐好吗?

words.meaning: n.距离,间隔,远方,路程
words.example:
What's the distance between Madrid and Barcelona/ from Madrid to Barcelona?  马德里和巴赛隆那相距有多远？
He travels quite a distance (= a long way) to work every day.  他每天上班的路途很远。
Does she live within walking distance of her parents?  从她的住处到父母家可以走着去吗？

words.meaning: n.木材,木头,木料;(pl.)森林,林地
words.example:
He gathered some wood to build a fire.  他捡了些木头生了一堆火。
She fixed a couple of planks of wood to the wall for shelves.  她将一些木板固定在墙上当作架子。
Mahogany is a hard wood and pine is a soft wood.  红木是硬木，松木是软木。

words.meaning: n.柄,把手,拉手 v.处理,对待,操纵;触,抚养
words.example:
She turned the handle and slowly opened the door.  她转动把手，慢慢地打开门。noun countable
That's some handle to go through life with!  一辈子取那样一个名字也够奇怪的！verb
Some people are brilliant with computers, but have no idea how to handle (= behave with) other people.  有些人在电脑方面很出色，却不会与人打交道。

words.meaning: n.卡车,载重汽车
words.example:
The road was completely blocked by an overturned truck.  道路完全被翻倒的货车堵住了。
Hundreds of refugees were herded into cattle trucks for the gruelling ten-hour journey.  成百上千的难民被赶进运牛的货车里，开始了十小时令人筋疲力尽的行程。noun
Most of the aid is being trucked into the city, although some is arriving by boat.  大部分援助物资用货车运到这座城市，有一小部分是用船运送的。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition mainly US

words.meaning: n.山
words.example:
The Matterhorn is one of the biggest mountains in Europe.  马特洪峰是欧洲最雄伟的山峰之一。
The Rockies are a mountain chain/range in the western USA.  洛矶山脉绵亘于美国西部。
I'd love to go mountain -climbing.  我想去爬山。

words.meaning: n.传统; 惯例; 传说
words.example:
Fireworks have long been an American tradition on the Fourth of July.  七月四日国庆日放烟火是美国人长期以来的传统。
Switzerland has a long tradition of neutrality.  保持中立是瑞士长期以来的传统。
We decided to break with tradition (= not behave as usual) this year and go away for Christmas.  今年我们决定打破传统，外出度圣诞节。

words.meaning: n.冬季,冬天
words.example:
Last winter we went skiing.  去年冬天我们去滑雪了。
It's been a surprisingly mild winter.  今年冬天暖和得出奇。
Birds migrate so that they can winter in a warmer country.  鸟类定期迁徙，这样它们就可以在更暖和的地方过冬。

words.meaning: n.乡村，村庄
words.example:
Many people come from the outlying/surrounding villages to work in the town.  很多人从周围的乡村来到这座城里工作。
The village is/are campaigning for a by-pass to be built.  全体村民正在积极呼吁，要求修建一条旁道。

words.meaning: v.拒绝,谢绝 n.废物,垃圾
words.example:
He asked me to give him another loan, but I refused.  他让我再借给他一笔钱，我没答应。
He's in trouble but he's refused all (my offers of) help.  他遇到了麻烦，但是却对（我提出的）帮助一概拒绝。

words.meaning: v.滚动;使摇摆;卷,卷起 n.卷,卷形物;名单
words.example:
The vase rolled off the edge of the table and smashed.  花瓶从桌边滚落下来摔得粉碎。
The dog rolled over onto its back.  那只狗翻了个身四爪朝天躺着。
The piano's on wheels, so we can roll it into the room.  钢琴装有轮子，所以我们可以把它推进屋里来。

words.meaning: n.通讯,传达;(pl.)通讯系统;交通(工具)
words.example:
Television is an increasingly important means of communication.  电视是一种日益重要的传播工具。
We are in direct communication with Moscow.  我们与莫斯科有直接的联系。
With an hour's walk to the nearest telephone, communication is difficult.  到最近的电话亭要走一个小时，通讯极为不便。

words.meaning: n.屏幕,屏风;帘 v.掩蔽,包庇;筛选
words.example:
Our television has a 19-inch screen.  我们的电视萤幕是19吋的。
Coming to your screens (= cinemas) shortly, the amazing adventures of 'Robin Hood'.  请马上来电影院欣赏“罗宾汉”的神奇冒险吧。
Her ambition is to write for the screen (= for television and films).  她的理想是给电影、电视写剧本。

words.meaning: v.获得;增加;表等走快 n.增进,增加;收益
words.example:
The Nationalist Party have gained a lot of support in the south of the country.  南非国民党已在南部地区获得很多人的支持。
What do you hope to gain from the course?  你希望从这门课程中学到些甚么？
Alternative medicine has only just started to gain respectability in our society.  另类疗法在社会上只是刚刚开始被认可。

words.meaning: v.隐藏,躲藏;隐瞒 n.皮革,兽皮
words.example:
She used to hide her diary under her pillow.  她过去常把自己的日记藏在枕头下。
He tries to hide his bald patch by sweeping his hair over to one side.  他试图把头发梳向一边来掩盖他头顶上的秃块。
She tried to hide her disappointment at not getting the promotion.  她试图掩饰自己对没有得到擢升的失望。

words.meaning: n.金,黄金;金币;金黄色 a.金的,金制的
words.example: He's running so well, surely he'll take the gold.  他跑得很出色，肯定能拿金牌UK adjective

words.meaning: n.俱乐部,夜总会;社团;棍棒,球棒
words.example:
I've just joined the local golf/squash/tennis club.  我刚参加了当地的高尔夫球／壁球／网球俱乐部。
Visitors must be accompanied by club members.  来访者必须有会员陪同。
The Orioles are an exciting club this year.  黄鹂队今年的表现令人振奋。

words.meaning: n.农场,饲养场 v.种田,经营农牧业
words.example:
The Stamfords have farmed this land for over a hundred years.  斯坦福德家族已在这片土地上耕作逾100年了。UK verb transitive
Magazines often farm out articles to freelance journalists.  杂志社常把文章外包给自由撰稿人。UK verb transitive
Almost since birth, their baby has been farmed out to nannies and nurseries.  他们的孩子几乎是一出生就交托给保姆和托儿所照顾。

words.meaning: a.潜在的,可能的 n.潜能,潜力
words.example:
Many potential customers are waiting for a fall in prices before buying.  很多潜在的顾客都在等着降价再购买。
The accident is a grim reminder of the potential dangers involved in North Sea oil production.  该意外残酷地提醒人们生产北海石油可能会出现的危险。UK noun uncountable
The region has enormous potential for economic development.  该地区经济发展潜力无穷。

words.meaning: a.欧洲的 n.欧洲人
words.example: a European city  一个欧洲城市

words.meaning: a.(of)独立的,自主的
words.example:
They all made the same comment, quite independent of each other (= without deciding together to do so).  他们都不约而同作出了相同的评论。
Belize became fully independent from Britain in 1981.  贝里斯于1981年脱离英国完全独立。
Tibet, once an independent country, is now part of China.  西藏曾经是一个独立国家，现在却是中国的一部分。adjective

words.meaning: n.地区,行政区;美国各州的众议院选区
words.example: South Cambridgeshire District Council  剑桥郡南区议会

words.meaning: n.形状,外形;情况,状态;种类v.成型,塑造
words.example:
Clay can be moulded into almost any shape.  黏土可以塑成几乎任何形状。
These bricks are all different shapes.  这些砖块形状都不同。
Kim's birthday cake was in the shape of a train.  吉姆的生日蛋糕是火车形状的。

words.meaning: n.人群;一群,一伙 v.聚集,群集;挤满,拥挤
words.example:
She goes about with a friendly crowd.  她常和一群朋友结伴外出。
Think for yourself, don't just follow the crowd.  要独立思考，不要只是人云亦云。verb transitive informal
Hordes of commuters crowded into the train.  一群群通勤的乘客涌进了火车。verb transitive informal

words.meaning: n.基督教徒 a.基督教徒的
words.example: a Christian charity/organization  基督教慈善团体／机构

words.meaning: v.表达,表示 a.特快的,快速的 n.快车,快运
words.example:
Her eyes expressed deep sadness.  她眼神中流露出深切的悲伤。
Words can't express how happy I am.  言语无法形容我的快乐。
These figures are expressed as a percentage of the total.  这些数字是用总数的百分比来表示的。

words.meaning: n.[英]房间,套间;[美]公寓
words.example:
I'll give you the keys to my apartment.  我会把我公寓的锁匙给你。
They have six holiday/luxury apartments for sale.  他们有六套渡假／豪华公寓套房出售。
The Royal Apartments are open to the public.  皇室套间向公众开放。

words.meaning: a.愿意的,乐意的,心甘情愿的
words.example:
If you're willing to fly at night, you can get a much cheaper ticket.  如果你愿意夜里乘飞机，那就能买到更便宜的机票。
You said you needed a volunteer - well, I'm willing.  你说过你需要一名志愿者——我愿意。
Apparently John and Gabriel are willing for us to use their garden.  很明显，约翰和加布里埃尔愿意让我们使用他们的花园。

words.meaning: n.力,力量;实力;长处,优点;人力;兵力
words.example:
She had the strength and stamina to take the lead and win the gold medal.  她有领先并夺金的体力和耐力。
Admitting you've made a mistake is a sign of strength, not weakness.  自己承认犯错所显现的是坚强，而不是软弱。
He showed great strength of character when he refused to accept the bribes.  他拒绝接受贿赂，表现出崇高的人格。

words.meaning: n.马;跳马,鞍马 v.骑马
words.example:
He spends all his money on the horses.  他把所有的钱都花在赌马上了。UK noun
He was horsing around in the kitchen and broke my favourite bowl.  他在厨房里捣乱，打碎了我最喜欢的碗。

words.meaning: n.目标,对象,靶子
words.example:
Any major airport or station is potentially a terrorist target.  所有大机场和火车站都可能是恐怖分子的目标。UK noun
The target audience for the TV series are young people aged 13 to 18.  这部电视连续剧的观众对像是13岁至18岁的年轻人。
Recently she has been the target of a series of obscene phone calls.  最近她受到接连不断的下流电话骚扰。UK noun

words.meaning: n.监狱
words.example:
Conditions in the prison are said to be appalling.  听说监狱里的条件糟透了。
He's spent a lot of time in prison.  他坐了很长时间的牢。
She went to/was sent to prison for six months.  她入狱六个月。

words.meaning: v./n.骑,乘
words.example:
The hunters came riding by/past on their horses.  猎人们骑马飞驰而过。
He rides well/badly (= He can ride horses well/badly).  他骑术很好／差。
mainly US We rode the train from Sydney to Perth.  我们坐火车从雪梨到柏斯。

words.meaning: v./n.保卫,守卫,提防 n.哨兵,警卫,看守
words.example:
There are guards posted (= standing and watching) at every entrance.  每个入口处都设了卫兵。
Armed guards are posted around the site.  现场周围设了武装警卫。
The frontier is patrolled by border guards.  边境警卫队沿国境巡逻。

words.meaning: n./v.要求,请求,需要(量) v.查问
words.example:
The car workers' union is demanding a 7% pay rise this year.  汽车工会要求今年加薪7%。
He has always demanded the highest standards of behaviour from his children.  他总是以最高的行为准则来要求自己的孩子。
This is a very difficult piece of music to play - it demands a lot of concentration.  这段乐曲很难演奏——需要注意力高度集中。

words.meaning: n.报告人,通讯员;记者,报导者
words.example: The reporter interviewed the winner.  记者采访了获胜者。

words.meaning: v.交付,递送;发表,表达;释放;接生
words.example:
Mail is delivered to our office twice a day.  邮差每天给我们办公室投递两次邮件。
The shop is delivering our new bed on Thursday.  该店将于周二把我们的新床送来。UK verb
The priest delivered a passionate sermon/speech against war.  牧师发表了一篇充满激情的反战布道词／演讲。

words.meaning: n.正文,文本;原文;教科书
words.example:
The book has 100 pages of closely printed text.  这本书有100页印得密密麻麻的文字。
I'll send you a text as soon as I have any news.  我得到任何消息，就立即发一个讯息给你。
Can we see the full text of your speech before Tuesday?  我们能在周二前看到你演讲的全文吗？

words.meaning: n.工具,用具;方法,手段
words.example:
For the modern sales executive, a Blackberry is one of the tools of the trade.  对现代的业务经理来说，黑莓手机是商务工具之一。noun countable
The President was widely regarded as the tool of the military.  该国人民普遍认为现任总统为军方的工具。noun countable

words.meaning: a.野性的,野生的;野蛮的;狂热的;荒芜的
words.example:
The audience burst into wild applause.  观众爆发出热烈的掌声。
When I told him what I'd done, he went wild (= became very angry).  当我告诉他我的所作所为时，他暴跳如雷。
The children were wild with excitement (= were extremely excited).  孩子们欣喜若狂。

words.meaning: n.车辆，机动车
words.example:
Road vehicles include cars, buses and trucks.  道路交通工具包括汽车、公车和卡车。
Tractors are farm vehicles.  拖拉机是农用车辆。
The number of thefts of motor vehicles rose by a third last year.  去年机动车失窃案数量上升了三分之一。noun

words.meaning: v.观察,观测,注意到,监视,遵守,评述,说
words.example:
The role of scientists is to observe and describe the world, not to try to control it.  科学家的任务是观察和描述这个世界，而不是试图控制它。
Children learn by observing adults.  儿童透过观察成年人来学习。UK verb transitive
Jack observed a look of anxiety on his brother's face.  杰克注意到了他哥哥脸上焦急的神情。

words.meaning: n.飞翔,飞行;航班;航程;逃跑;楼梯的一段
words.example:
I'll never forget my first flight.  我永远也不会忘记第一次乘飞机的经历。
How was your flight?  空中旅行感觉如何？
All flights to New York today are delayed because of bad weather.  因天气不好，今天飞往纽约的所有航班都延误了。

words.meaning: n.平均,平均数 a.平均的;普通的 v.平均
words.example:
The average of the three numbers 7, 12 and 20 is 13, because the total of 7, 12 and 20 is 39, and 39 divided by 3 is 13.  7、12和20这三个数的平均数是13，因为7、12和20的和是39，而39除以3是13。
Prices have risen by an average of 4% over the past year.  物价与去年相比平均上涨4%。
My income's rather variable, but I earn £73 a day on average.  我的收入很不稳定，但是平均每天赚73英镑。UK noun

words.meaning: n.优点,长处,有利条件;利益,好处
words.example:
The advantage of booking tickets in advance is that you get better seats.  提前订票的好处就是可以得到比较好的座位。
Despite the twin advantages of wealth and beauty, she did not have a happy life.  尽管拥有财富和美貌的双重优势，她的生活并不幸福。
For a goalkeeper, it 's a great advantage to have big hands.  对守门员来说，长一双大手是很大的优势。

words.meaning: a.快的;灵敏的,伶俐的;敏锐的 ad.快,迅速地
words.example:
It's a quick journey.  这次行程很短。
He scored three goals in quick succession (= happening one after the other in a short time).  他在短时间内连进三球。
Could I have a quick word (= speak to you for a short time) ?  我可以简短地跟您说几句话吗？

words.meaning: v.赚得,挣得,获得
words.example:
How much do you earn, if you don't mind me asking?  如果你不介意的话，能告诉我你赚多少钱吗？
You can't expect to earn a living (= be paid enough money to live on) from your painting.  你不能指望靠画画来维持生计。
It's been a tough six months and I feel I've earned a few weeks off.  这半年可真是够辛苦的，我觉得我也该休息几周了。

words.meaning: n.磅;英镑 v.(连续)猛击,(猛烈)敲打,捣碎
words.example:
There are one hundred pence in a pound.  1英镑等于100便士。
They stole jewellery valued at £50 000 (= 50 000 pounds).  他们偷了价值五万英镑的珠宝。
"Have you got any change?" "Sorry, I've only got a five-pound note.  “你有零钱吗？”“抱歉，我只有一张五英镑的纸钞。”

words.meaning: n.基础,根据
words.example:
This document will form the basis for our discussion.  这份文件将是我们讨论的基础。
Their proposals have no proven scientific basis.  他们的提议没有确凿的科学根据。
Decisions were often made on the basis of (= using) incorrect information.  决定常常是根据错误的讯息作出的。 (plural bases)

words.meaning: a.明亮的,辉煌的;聪明的;欢快的,美好的
words.example:
The rooms were bright and airy.  这些房间都明亮通风。
The lights are too bright in here - they're hurting my eyes.  这里的灯太亮，把我的眼睛刺痛了。
When she looked up her eyes were bright with tears.  她抬头望时眼睛里闪烁着泪光。

words.meaning: v.操作,运转,开动,起作用,动手术
words.example:
How do you operate the remote control unit?  你是怎么操作这个遥控器的？
Does the company operate a pension scheme?  这家公司实行退休金制度吗？
For several years she operated a dating agency from her basement flat.  有好几年她在她的半地下室公寓里经营一个婚姻介绍所。

words.meaning: n.客人,宾客,旅客
words.example:
We have guests (US houseguests)staying this weekend.  有客人到家来和我们一起度周末。
Is he on the guest list ?  他在不在宾客名单上？
He is a paying guest (= He pays for the use of a room in someone's home).  他是个寄宿房客。

words.meaning: v.(to)贡献,捐助,捐献;投稿
words.example:
Aren't you going to contribute towards Jack's leaving present?  你不打算凑一份钱给杰克买送别礼物吗？
Come to the meeting if you feel you have something to contribute.  要是你觉得有甚么要讲的就来开会吧。
Her family have contributed £50,000 to the fund.  她家给这项基金捐了五万英镑。

words.meaning: a.极小的,微小的
words.example: a tiny flower  极小的花

words.meaning: n.大块木(石)料;街区;障碍物 v.阻塞,拦阻
words.example:
The museum is just six blocks away.  博物馆离这儿只有六条街。
My friend and I live on the same block.  我和我的朋友住在同一个街区。
He lives just round the block.  他就住在前面刚拐过去弯的地方。UK noun

words.meaning: n.保护，警戒
words.example:
Their flimsy tent gave/offered little protection against the severe storm.  他们薄薄的帐篷几乎无法抵挡狂风暴雨的袭击。
Round-the-clock police protection is given to all senior politicians.  对所有的高层政界人士都采取了24小时的警力保护。
New legislation still does not offer adequate protection for many endangered species.  新的法律还是没有给许多濒临灭绝的物种提供充分保护。

words.meaning: v.安定,安顿;停息;定居;解决,调停
words.example:
Good, that's all settled - you send out the invitations for the party, and I'll organize the food.  好，那就这么决定了——你发送派对的请帖，我来准备吃的。
I'd like to get this matter settled once and for all (= reach a final decision on it).  我想把这件事了结了。
The details of the contract have not yet been settled.  合约的细节问题仍然没有谈妥。

words.meaning: v.(on,with)喂养,饲养;(with)向…供给
words.example:
Let's feed the kids first and have our dinner after.  我们先喂饱孩子，然后再吃饭吧。
If you feed your dog on cakes and biscuits, it's not surprising he's so fat.  如果你是用蛋糕和饼干喂狗，它长这么肥就不奇怪了。
The kids love feeding bread to the ducks.  那些孩子喜欢给鸭子喂面包。

words.meaning: v.收集,搜集;领取,接走;收(税等);聚集,堆积
words.example:
After the party I collected (up) twenty bottles from various parts of the house.  聚会后我从房屋各处一共收拾了20个瓶子。
We're collecting (money) for the homeless.  我们在为无家可归者筹款。
These china ornaments just collect dust.  这些瓷器摆在那里只会招灰尘。

words.meaning: n.书名,标题;头衔,称号
words.example:
The title of Evelyn Waugh's first novel was 'Decline and Fall'.  伊芙琳‧沃的第一部小说名为《衰落与瓦解》。
And this next record is the title track on the album 'The Red Shoes' (= the piece of music and the record are both called 'The Red Shoes').  下一首歌的歌名就是与专辑同名的《红鞋子》。
Last year we published over a hundred new titles.  去年我们出版了100多种新书。UK noun

words.meaning: n.(功)课;[pl.]课程;教训
words.example:
How can we make science lessons more interesting?  我们怎样才能把理科课程讲得更有趣一些呢?
She has never had/taken any acting lessons.  她从未上过表演课。
He gives French lessons.  他教法语课。

words.meaning: n.信任,信用;信仰,信条
words.example:
She has no faith in modern medicine.  她对现代医学没有信心。
You'll cope - I have great faith in you.  你应付得了——我对你很有信心。
After the trial, his family said they had lost all faith in the judicial system.  审判之后，他的家人说，他们对司法体系已完全失去信心。

words.meaning: n.河流
words.example:
We sailed slowly down the river.  我们顺流而下缓缓航行。
We sailed up river.  我们逆流而行。
Rivers of sweat ran down his back.  他汗流浃背。

words.meaning: v.促进,发扬;提升,提拔;增进,助长
words.example:
Advertising companies are always having to think up new ways to promote products.  广告公司总是得想出新办法来促销。
The Institute is intended to promote an understanding of the politics and culture of the Arab world.  该协会旨在促进人们对阿拉伯世界政治文化的了解。
Greenpeace works to promote awareness of the dangers that threaten our planet today.  绿色和平组织致力于促使人们更了解当前威胁地球的危机。

words.meaning: v.数,计算;算入;看作,认为 n.计数,总数
words.example:
Let's count out loud (= speak the words) from one to ten.  我们来大声地从一数到十。
The teachers counted the students as they got on to the coach.  学生们上车时老师点了一下人数。
Count your money carefully to make sure it's all there.  好好数数你的钱，看看它们有没有丢。

words.meaning: conj.除非 prep.除…外
words.example:
You can't get a job unless you've got experience (= you can only get a job if you have experience).  除非有工作经验，否则你找不到工作。
Unless you call me to say you're not coming, I'll see you at the theatre (= I will see you there if you do not call to say you are not coming).  除非你打电话说你不来了，否则我就在剧院等你。

words.meaning: v.结婚,嫁,娶
words.example:
Men tend to marry later than women.  男性成婚往往晚于女性。
Paul married Lucy four years ago.  保罗四年前和露西结婚了。
They don't have any plans to marry at present.  他们目前没打算结婚。

words.meaning: n.明天;来日,未来 ad.在明天,在明日
words.example:
I've arranged to see Rachel tomorrow night.  我已经安排好明天晚上去看雷切尔。
Oh, leave it till tomorrow.  哦，把它留到明天吧。
Is John coming to tomorrow's meeting?  约翰来参加明天的会议吗？

words.meaning: n.技巧,手艺,技能;技术,工艺
words.example:
We have developed a new technique for detecting errors in the manufacturing process.  我们开发了一项新技术，用于检测生产流程中的错误。
She's a wonderfully creative dancer but she doesn't have the technique of a truly great performer.  她是个很有创造力的舞蹈演员，但她缺乏一个真正伟大的舞蹈家的技巧。

words.meaning: n.小路,小径;路线,轨道
words.example:
This is the path to the cliffs.  这条路通向悬崖。
It will be several days before snowploughs clear a path (through) to the village.  要过几天铲雪机才能清出一条通向该村的小路。
They followed the path until they came to a gate.  他们沿着这条路走到了一个大门口。

words.meaning: n.耳,耳朵;听力,听觉;穗
words.example:
The hearing in my left ear's not so good.  我左耳听力不是太好。
She leant over and whispered something in his ear.  她俯过身去，贴着他的耳朵小声说了些甚么。
I'm all ears - tell us what they had to say.  我洗耳恭听——快告诉我们他们是怎么说的。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.商店,店铺;工厂,车间 v.买东西
words.example:
His latest novel will be in the shops by Christmas.  他的最新小说将在圣诞节前上市。UK noun countable
He runs an auto-tyre repair shop.  他开了一家汽车轮胎修理厂。UK noun countable
She set up shop back in 1965 with a very small restaurant in the Kings Road.  1965年她以国王路上一家很小的餐馆为起点开创了自己的事业。UK verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.人们;民族;亲属 a.民间的
words.example:
Ordinary folk can't afford cars like that.  普通人买不起那样的轿车。
All right, folks, dinner's ready!  好啦，伙计们，晚餐准备好了！
I'm going home to see my folks.  我要回家看看我的父母。UK noun

words.meaning: n.原理,原则;主义,信念
words.example:
The country is run on socialist principles.  这个国家推行社会主义制度。
The machine works according to the principle of electromagnetic conduction.  这台机器根据电磁传导原理运行。
The organization works on the principle that all members have the same rights.  该组织运作的原则是所有的成员都享有同等的权利。

words.meaning: v.幸免于,幸存;比…长命
words.example:
The baby was born with a heart problem and only survived for a few hours.  这个婴儿生下来就有心脏病，只活了几个小时。
These plants cannot survive in very cold conditions.  这些植物无法在非常寒冷的条件下生存。
None of Shakespeare's plays survives in its original manuscript form.  莎士比亚的戏剧手稿都没有保存下来。

words.meaning: v.升起,举起,消散 n.电梯,上升,免费搭车
words.example:
Could you help me lift this table, please?  你能帮我抬一下桌子吗？
Could you lift your chair a bit - I've got my bag caught under it.  你能把椅子稍微抬一下吗——我的袋子被压住了。
She lifted the cigarette (up) to her lips.  她把香烟举到唇边。

words.meaning: n.边界,国界;边(沿) v.交界,与…接壤;接近
words.example:
Were you stopped at the border?  你在边界被拦住了吗？
The train crosses the border between France and Spain.  火车穿过法国和西班牙之间的边界。
The two countries have had frequent border disputes.  两国经常发生边界纠纷。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.竞争,比赛;角逐,较量;[总称]竞争者
words.example:
Competition for jobs is intense.  求职的竞争非常激烈。
There's a lot of competition between computer companies.  电脑公司间的竞争很激烈。
The two companies are in competition with each other.  两家公司互相竞争。

words.meaning: v./n.跳跃,跳动,跳过;暴涨,猛增
words.example:
The children were jumping up and down with excitement.  孩子都兴奋地跳来跳去。
She ran across the grass and jumped into the water.  她跑过草地，跳入水中。
He had to jump out of an upstairs window to escape.  为了逃命，他不得不从楼上的窗户跳出去。

words.meaning: v.聚集,聚拢;推测,推断
words.example:
We gathered blackberries from the hedgerow.  我们从树篱上采摘黑莓。
She gathered up the newspapers that were scattered around the floor.  她把散落在地板上的报纸收拾起来。
We gathered our things together and left quickly.  我们收拾好自己的东西赶快离开了。

words.meaning: n.界限,限度,范围 v.(to)限制,限定
words.example:
Is there a limit on the amount of money you can claim?  你能索赔到的金额有上限吗？
There's a limit to the number of times I can stop what I'm doing just so I can help him!  我可以停下手里的工作帮他的忙，但不能帮个没完，总要有个限度！
We set a time limit of thirty minutes for the test.  我们把测验的时间限定为30分钟。

words.meaning: a.(病的)发作,痉挛 v./a.n.合适,试穿,安装
words.example:
That jacket fits you perfectly.  那件外套你穿着很合身。
The dress fits like a glove (= very well).  这件连衣裙非常合身。
Our new sofa doesn't fit through the door.  我们的新沙发通不过这道门。

words.meaning: n.&v.叫,喊,哭;(鸟兽)叫,啼,鸣,嗥
words.example:
"There, there, don't cry," she said.  “好啦，好啦，别哭了，”她说道。
We all laughed until we cried.  我们都大笑起来，直到笑出了眼泪。
She cried bitter tears when she got the letter.  收到来信，她流下了痛苦的泪水。

words.meaning: n.设备,器材,装置;才能
words.example: office/camping/kitchen equipment  办公设备／野营用具／厨房用具

words.meaning: n.价值 a.值…的,价值…的,值得…的
words.example:
Our house is worth £200 000.  我们的房子价值约20万英镑。
Heroin worth about $5 million was seized.  缴获价值约500万美元的海洛因。
She must be worth at least half a million.  她肯定拥有价值至少50万的财产。

words.meaning: vt.联想;交往;联合;n.伙伴;a.联合的
words.example:
Most people associate this brand with good quality.  大多数人把这个品牌和优良品质联系在一起。verb transitive UK   Phrasal Verbs   associate sth with sth
The cancer risks associated with smoking have been well documented.  抽烟有引发癌症的危险，这两者的关联是有详尽的文献为证的。verb transitive UK   Phrasal Verbs   associate with sb

words.meaning: a.温暖的,热心的,热情的 v.(使)变暖
words.example:
Are you warm enough or do you want the fire on?  你暖不暖和，要不要生火？
I've got my hands in my pockets to keep them warm.  我把手放在口袋里保暖。
Those gloves look nice and warm.  那些手套看起来又漂亮又暖和。

words.meaning: n.样子, 外表, 面貌, (问题等的)方面
words.example:
Which aspects of the job do you most enjoy?  你最喜欢这份工作的哪些方面？
His illness affects almost every aspect of his life.  他的疾病几乎影响到他生活的各方面。
That's the most worrying aspect of the situation.  这是局势最令人担心的一面。

words.meaning: vi.(on)坚持要求,坚决主张,坚持
words.example:
Please go first - I insist!  请先走——我坚持这样！
She insisted on seeing her lawyer.  她坚持要见她的律师。

words.meaning: n.失败,不及格;失败者;故障,失灵;未能
words.example:
The meeting was a complete/total failure.  这次会议是彻头彻尾的失败。
I'm a bit of a failure at making (= I cannot make) cakes.  我做蛋糕做得比较失败。
Their attempt to climb the Eiger ended in failure.  他们攀登艾格峰的尝试以失败告终。

words.meaning: a.每年的,一年生的 n.年刊;一年生植物
words.example: Companies publish annual reports to inform the public about the previous year's activities.  公司发布年度报告，告知公众上一年的具体业务。noun countable

words.meaning: n.圣诞节
words.example:
We're going to my mother's for Christmas.  我们要去我母亲家过圣诞节。
Happy Christmas!  圣诞快乐！
We had a lovely Christmas.  我们过了一个愉快的圣诞节。

words.meaning: n.注释,评论,意见 v.(on)注释,评论
words.example:
He made negative comments to the press.  他向报界作了些负面的评论。
She was asked about the pay increase but made no comment (= did not give an opinion).  有人问她关于加薪的事，但她拒绝评论。
My mum always comments on what I'm wearing.  我妈妈总是对我的衣着指指点点。

words.meaning: n.[pl.]事务;事情(件);(个人的)事
words.example:
She organizes her financial affairs very efficiently.  她把自己的财务管理得井井有条、又快又好。
He's always meddling in (= trying to influence) other people's affairs.  他总想插手别人的事情。
What I do in my spare time is my affair (= only involves me).  我在闲暇时间做甚么，这是我自己的事。

words.meaning: n.程序,手续,步骤
words.example:
The company has new procedures for dealing with complaints.  公司采取了新的处理投诉事宜的程式。
You must follow correct procedure at all times.  你必须随时按照正确的步骤操作。UK noun
It's a routine/standard surgical procedure.  这是一个普通的外科手术。UK noun

words.meaning: a.有规律的;整齐的,匀称的,正规的,正式的
words.example: Regular practice makes progress.  规律练习带来进步。

words.meaning: v./n.伸开,伸展;散布,传播
words.example:
The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.  风很大，火势迅速蔓延开来。
It started off as cancer of the liver but it spread to other areas of the body.  开始的时候是肝癌，后来扩散到了身体的其他部位。
The redundancies are spread across the clothing, banking and building industries.  裁员风气席卷了服装业、银行业和建筑业。

words.meaning: n.主席,议长,会长,董事长
words.example: The chairman announced the results.  主席宣布了结果。

words.meaning: n.棒球
words.example:
Jake never played baseball like the other kids.  杰克不像别的孩子，他从不打棒球。
He had a baseball and a couple of bats in his sports bag.  他的运动袋里有一个棒球和几支球棒。

words.meaning: a.软的;温柔的;细嫩的,光滑的;不含酒精的
words.example:
Soft tissue , such as flesh, allows X-rays through.  X光能穿透肌肉等软组织。
Look at you! You need more exercise. You're going/getting soft.  看看你！你需要多加锻炼，你的身体越来越虚弱了。UK adjective
She thinks I'm too soft on the kids when they misbehave.  她认为孩子们不守规矩的时候我的态度过于软弱。

words.meaning: v.不理,不顾,忽视
words.example:
She can be really irritating but I try to ignore her.  她有时会特别烦人，不过我尽量不去理会她。
Safety regulations are being ignored by company managers in the drive to increase profits.  为了增加利润，公司经理都对安全章程熟视无睹。
How can the government ignore the wishes of the majority?  政府怎么能不顾大多数人的意愿呢？

words.meaning: n.蛋; 卵; 卵形物
words.example:
How do you like your eggs - fried or boiled?  鸡蛋你想怎样吃？是吃煎的还是煮的？
The cuckoo lays her egg in another bird's nest.  杜鹃将卵产在其他鸟的巢里。
After fourteen days the eggs hatch.  14天后，卵孵化了。

words.meaning: n.信任,相信,信念;信仰,信条
words.example:
All non-violent religious and political beliefs should be respected equally.  对所有非暴力的宗教和政治信仰，应予以同等尊重。
His belief in God gave him hope during difficult times.  他对上帝的信奉使他在困境中看到了希望。
Recent revelations about corruption have shaken many people's belief in (= caused people to have doubts about) the police.  不久前腐败事件的曝光动摇了许多人对警方的信任。

words.meaning: pron.(否定句)任何人;(肯定句)随便哪个人
words.example: Anybody can enter the contest.  任何人都可以参加比赛。

words.meaning: v./n.谋杀,凶杀
words.example:
Two sisters have been charged with (= officially accused of) murder.  两姐妹被控谋杀。
There were three murders in the town last year.  去年镇上发生了三件谋杀案。
The three were convicted of (= proved guilty of) murder.  三人被判犯有谋杀罪。

words.meaning: n.礼品,赠品;天赋,才能
words.example:
The guests all arrived bearing (= bringing) gifts.  客人们都带着礼物到了。
That goal was a gift!  那入球不费吹灰之力！
He has a gift for languages.  他有语言天赋。noun

words.meaning: n.宗教,信仰
words.example:
Football is a religion for these people.  这些人对足球入了迷。noun
He suddenly got religion when he went to college.  他念大学时，突然变得很虔诚。    US

words.meaning: v.回顾,复习 n.回顾,复习;评论
words.example:
The committee is reviewing the current arrangement/situation.  委员会正在审查目前的安排／研究当前的形势。
Let's review (= talk about) what has happened so far.  我们谈谈到目前为止发生的事情吧。
He reviewed (= thought about) his options before making a final decision.  他在最后作出决定之前，对各种选择进行了斟酌权衡。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.编辑,编者
words.example:
She's a senior editor in the reference department of a publishing company.  她是出版社工具书室的资深编辑。
Who is the current editor of the Times?  《泰晤士报》的现任主编是谁？

words.meaning: n.咖啡(色)
words.example:
Would you get some coffee when you go shopping?  你去买东西时买点咖啡好吗？
If I drink too much coffee, I can't sleep.  要是咖啡喝得太多，我会睡不着觉。
Can I get you a coffee (= cup of coffee) ?  我给你来杯咖啡吧？

words.meaning: n.公文,文献
words.example:
They are charged with using forged documents.  他们被控使用伪造的档。
I'll send you the document by email.  我会用电子邮件把文件发给你。verb transitive UK US [ˈdɑː.kjʊ-/
His interest in cricket has been well- documented (= recorded and written about) by the media.  他对板球的兴趣在媒体的报道中都有详细的记载。

words.meaning: n.速度,快 v.迅速,前进,急行;加速,使加速
words.example:
He was travelling at a speed of 90 mph.  他以每小时90哩的速度行进。
The car has a top speed of 155 miles per hour.  这辆汽车的最高时速是155哩。
You should lower / reduce your speed as you approach a junction.  接近交叉路口时应该放慢速度。

words.meaning: n.十字(架);苦难 a.交叉的;发怒的 v.穿过
words.example:
It's not a good place to cross the road.  这里不适宜穿越马路。
Look both ways before you cross over (= cross the road).  过马路前先要左右看看。
Cross the bridge and turn right at the first set of traffic lights.  过桥后在第一个红绿灯处右拐。

words.meaning: n.(on)影响,感化;势力,权势 v.影响,感化
words.example:
Helen's a bad/good influence on him.  海伦对他有不良／好的影响。
He has a huge amount of influence over the city council.  他对市政委员会有着巨大的影响。
Christopher hoped to exert his influence to make them change their minds.  克里斯多夫希望利用自己的影响力迫使他们改变主意。

words.meaning: ad.不管怎么说,无论如何;不论以何种方式
words.example:
Of course I don't mind taking you home - I'm going that way anyway.  我当然可以把你送回家——反正我也是顺路。
Her parents were opposed to her giving up her course, but she did it anyway.  她父母反对她放弃学业，但她还是没有听。
What was he doing with so much of the company's money in his personal account anyway?  他把那么多的公司资金存在他个人帐户里到底是在搞甚么名堂？

words.meaning: v.把…交托给,提交;犯(错误),干(坏事)
words.example:
He was sent to prison for a crime that he didn't commit.  他蒙冤入狱。
The government must commit itself to improving health care.  政府必须致力改善医疗保健服务。
Once we have committed to this course of action there is no going back.  一旦我们承诺采取这个行动，就没有回头路。

words.meaning: n.女性;女人;雌兽 a.女性的;雌的;柔弱的
words.example:
She was voted the best female vocalist.  她当选最佳女歌手。
Female lions do not have manes.  母狮没有鬃毛。
The kitten was actually a female, not a male.  这只小猫的确是母的，不是公的。

words.meaning: n.青年;年轻人
words.example:
The first volume is the author's account of his misspent youth in the bars of Dublin.  第一卷是作者对他在都柏林酒吧里虚度青春的叙述。
He looks like a man who's found the secret to eternal youth (= staying young).  他看上去似乎掌握了永葆青春的秘诀。
You may not have played tennis as often as him, but at least you've got youth on your side (= you are young).  你可能没像他那样经常打网球，但至少你有年轻的优势。noun

words.meaning: n.波浪;(挥手)示意;飘扬 v.(挥手)示意,致意
words.example:
She was so annoyed she wouldn't even wave us goodbye /wave goodbye to us.  她极为愤怒，甚至不愿向我们挥手道别。
She waves her hands about/around a lot when she's talking.  她说话时手总在比划着。
You'll have to wait till the policeman waves this line of traffic on.  你要一直等到员警挥手示意这队车辆继续前行。

words.meaning: adj.害怕的,恐惧的;犯愁的,不乐意的
words.example:
He was/felt suddenly afraid.  他突然害怕起来／感到恐惧。
I've always been afraid of flying/heights/spiders.  我一直都怕坐飞机／惧高／怕蜘蛛。
She was afraid for her children (= feared that they might be hurt).  她很担心孩子的安全。

words.meaning: n.四分之一;季;一刻钟;(pl.)方向;(pl.)住处
words.example:
He cut the orange into quarters.  他把橘子切成了4块。
Under a quarter of people questioned said that they were happily married.  不到1/4的受访者表示他们的婚姻很幸福。
My house is situated a mile and three-quarters from here.  我的房子距离这里1.75英里。

words.meaning: n.背景,经历;幕后
words.example:
The little figure that you can just see in the background of the photograph is me.  相片里后面那个刚好能看到的小个子就是我。
If you listen carefully to this piece of music, you can hear a flute in the background.  如果你仔细听这首歌曲，就可以听到伴奏的笛声。
We couldn't hear what they were saying on the tape - there was too much background noise.  我们听不清他们在录音带里说甚么——背景噪声太大了。    Compare the foreground

words.meaning: a.本地的,本国的;天生的 n.本地人,本国人
words.example:
She returned to live and work in her native Japan.  她回到她的出生地日本生活和工作。
She's a native Californian.  她是土生土长的加州人。
Henderson Island in the Pacific has more than 55 species of native flowering plants.  太平洋的亨德森岛上有超过55种土生的开花植物。

words.meaning: a.宽的,广阔的;广大的;宽宏的,豁达的
words.example:
We walked down a broad avenue lined with trees.  我们走在林荫大道上。
He flashed a broad grin at us.  他冲我们咧嘴笑了笑。
My brother is very broad- shouldered.  我兄弟肩膀很宽。    Compare narrow

words.meaning: a.惊人的,奇妙的;极好的
words.example:
He's a wonderful cook.  他是个非常出色的厨师。
We had a wonderful time in Italy last summer.  去年夏天，我们在义大利玩得非常尽兴。UK adjective

words.meaning: ad.两次,两倍
words.example:
I've already asked him twice.  我已经问过他两次了。
The post comes twice daily (= two times every day).  邮件每天来两次。
There are twice as many houses in this area as there used to be.  这个地区的房屋数量是从前的两倍。

words.meaning: v.合适,适合;相配,适应 n.一套西服;诉讼
words.example:
All the businessmen were wearing pinstripe suits.  所有商人都穿着细条纹套装。
She wore a dark blue suit.  她穿着一套深蓝色的衣服。
He brought / mainly USfiled a $12 million libel suit against the newspaper, claiming his professional reputation had been damaged by the paper's stories.  他对这家报纸提出名誉侵权诉讼，称其报导损害了自己的职业声誉，要求索赔1200万美元。

words.meaning: vi.吹,吹气,打气;吹奏;爆炸;n.打,打击
words.example:
The wind was blowing harder every minute.  风越来越大。
The letter blew away and I had to run after it.  信被风吹走了，我不得不去追。
Ann blew a few notes on the trumpet.  安用喇叭吹了几个音符。

words.meaning: n.建造,构造;建筑物,结构;释义,解释
words.example:
She works in construction/in the construction industry.  她从事建筑行业。
The bridge is a marvellous work of engineering and construction.  这座桥梁是工程学和建筑业的杰作。
This website is currently under construction (= being created).  该网站目前正在创建中。

words.meaning: n.智力,聪明;理解力;情报,消息,报导
words.example:
It's the intelligence of her writing that impresses me.  是她作品中表现出的智慧让我印象深刻。noun
They received intelligence (reports) that the factory was a target for the bombing.  他们接到情报说这家工厂是轰炸目标。

words.meaning: v.破坏,摧毁,消灭
words.example:
Most of the old part of the city was destroyed by bombs during the war.  该城的大部分老城区都在战争中被炸毁了。
The accident seemed to have completely/totally destroyed his confidence.  这场事故似乎已彻底击垮了他的信心。

words.meaning: n.厨师 v.烹调,烧煮;纂改(账目),捏造
words.example:
Let the fish cook for half an hour before you add the wine.  先把鱼煮半个小时再加入酒。verb
Jean's new band was really cooking at the party last night.  琼的新乐队在昨晚聚会上的演出确实很棒。verb
Just tell her we can't - that'll cook her goose.  只要告诉她我们不能——那她就没戏了。verb

words.meaning: n.(connexion)联系,连接;亲戚,社会关系
words.example:
The connection between smoking and heart disease is well known.  吸烟和心脏病之间的联系已为人们所熟知。
They're sisters, are they? I knew their surname was the same, but I never made (= thought of) the connection.  她们是姐妹，是不是？我知道她们同姓，可从没想过她们是一家。
They want to talk to you in connection with an unpaid tax bill.  他们想和你谈谈一张未付税单的事。noun

words.meaning: v.燃烧,烧着;烧毁;灼伤 n.烧伤,灼伤
words.example:
He was badly burnt in the blaze.  他在大火中严重烧伤。
She burnt his old love letters.  她烧掉了他的旧日情书。
The brandy burned (= felt too hot on) my throat.  白兰地喝下去后我感到喉咙里火辣辣的。

words.meaning: n.鞋
words.example:
He put on/took off his new pair of shoes.  他穿上／脱下他那双新鞋。
Hurry and do up/lace up your shoes.  快点把鞋带系好。
If I were in your shoes, I think I'd write to her rather than try to explain over the phone.  如果我是你，我想我会给她写信而不是在电话里向她解释。noun countable

words.meaning: n.等级,级别;年级;分数 v.分等,分级
words.example:
He's suffering from some kind of low -grade (= slight) infection, which he can't seem to get rid of.  他感染程度较轻，但好像就是无法痊愈。
There's some really high -grade (= high quality) musicianship on this recording.  这张唱片表现出高超的音乐技能。
Bill has been UK on / US at the same grade (= his job has been of the same level of importance, or he has had the same level of pay) for several years now.  比尔那个职位已经做了好几年了。

words.meaning: n.委员会,全体委员
words.example:
She sits on/is on the school's development committee.  她是学校发展委员会的成员。
The local council have just set up a committee to study recycling.  当地市政会刚刚成立了一个研究资源再利用问题的委员会。

words.meaning: n.错误,过失,误解 v.弄错;(for)把…误认为
words.example:
I'm not blaming you - we all make mistakes.  我不是在责备你——我们都会犯错。
This letter's full of spelling mistakes.  这封信满是拼写错误。
I've discovered a few mistakes in your calculations.  我在你的计算中发现了几个错误。

words.meaning: n.衣服(虽为复数,亦不可数)
words.example:
She usually wears smart/casual clothes.  她通常穿着很入时／随意。
I'm just putting my clothes on.  我正打算把衣服穿上。
Take your clothes off and get in the bath.  脱下衣服进浴缸。

words.meaning: a.安静的,平静的 n.安静 v.使安静,平静
words.example:
She spoke in a quiet voice so as not to wake him.  她轻声说话，以免吵醒他。
It's so quiet without the kids here.  孩子们不在，这里真安静。
Please be quiet (= stop talking) !  请安静！

words.meaning: n.服装,童装,女装 v.穿衣,打扮
words.example:
The queen, in full ceremonial dress, presided over the ceremony.  女王身着礼服盛装主持仪式。verb
My husband dresses the children while I make breakfast.  我做早饭时丈夫给孩子们穿衣服。
He left very early and had to dress in the dark.  他很早出门，所以只好摸黑穿衣服。

words.meaning: v.允许,答应;有…可能n.承诺;希望,出息
words.example:
I'll have a look for some while I'm at the shops but I'm not promising anything.  我逛街的时候找找，但不敢保证能买到。
Can I have that book back when you've finished because I've promised it (= I have said I will give it) to Sara.  那本书你看完后能还给我吗，因为我答应莎拉要给她了。
I've promised myself a long bath when I get through all this work.  做完所有这些工作后我要好好洗个澡。

words.meaning: a.知道的,意识到的;
words.example:
Were you aware of the risks at the time?  你当时意识到危险了吗？
She was well (= very) aware that he was married.  她很清楚他已结了婚。

words.meaning: n.(neighbour)邻居
words.example: My neighbor plays the piano.  我邻居弹钢琴。

words.meaning: n.功能,作用;(pl.)职务;函数 v.起作用
words.example:
The function of the veins is to carry blood to the heart.  静脉的功能是将血液输送回心脏。
I'm not quite sure what my function is within the company.  我拿不太准自己在公司里有甚么职责。
As a mayor, he has a lot of official functions to attend.  作为市长，他要参加很多官方活动。

words.meaning: n.骨(骼)
words.example:
The child was so thin that you could see her bones.  这孩子瘦得可怜，都能看见她的骨头。
There's still a lot of meat left on the bone - shall I slice some off for you?  骨头上还有许多肉——要我替你切一些下来吗？
He never does any exercise - he's bone idle.  他从不锻炼身体——他懒极了。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: adj.活跃的,敏捷的,积极的;在活动中的
words.example:
You've got to try to keep active as you grow older.  年纪大了，应该尽量保持身心活跃。
Enemy forces remain active in the mountainous areas around the city.  敌军在城市周围的山区仍活动猖獗。
She's very active in (= involved in) local politics.  她积极参与当地的政治活动。

words.meaning: a.主要的,首要的 n.首领,领袖
words.example:
The chief problem we have in the area now is the spread of disease.  目前我们在这个地区面临的首要问题是疾病的蔓延。
The weather was our chief reason for coming here.  天气是我们来这里的主要原因。adjective [before noun]
[as form of address] UK humorous Can you sign this form for me, chief?  长官，您能给我在这张表上签字吗？noun countable

words.meaning: v.联合;结合;化合 n.集团;联合企业
words.example:
None of us has much money so let's combine what we've got.  我们谁都没多少钱，因此就把我们所有的钱凑在一起吧。
Sickness, combined with (= together with) terrible weather, contrived to ruin the trip.  疾病，加上恶劣的天气，毁掉了这次旅行。
The two countries combined against their common enemy.  两国联合起来对抗共同的敌人。

words.meaning: n.葡萄酒,果酒
words.example:
Shall we have a bottle/glass of wine with dinner?  我们晚餐喝一瓶／杯葡萄酒好吗？
Would you like to see the wine list , sir?  先生，您要不要看一下酒单？verb
The survey concludes that most women like to be wined and dined on the first few dates.  调查得出结论：大多数女性在最初的几次约会喜欢去餐馆大吃大喝。

words.meaning: prep.在…下面,在…以下 ad.在下面,向下
words.example:
From the top of the skyscraper the cars below us looked like insects.  从摩天大楼顶上往下看，下面的汽车小得像昆虫一样。
The author's name was printed below the title.  作者的名字登在标题之下。
For further information on this subject, see below (= lower on the page or later in the book).  关于这一点的详细说明，请看下文。

words.meaning: a.凉的;冷静的 n.凉快 ad.冷静地 v.使变凉
words.example:
It was a lovely cool evening.  那是个凉爽的夜晚。
How do you manage to look so cool in this hot weather?  这么热的天你怎么看上去会这么凉快？
It 's a bit cool in here, isn't it? I think I'll close the window.  这里有点凉，是不是？我想关上窗户。adjective

words.meaning: n.公共汽车,总线,信息通路
words.example:
You should take the bus] go by bus (= travel by bus) if you want to see the sights.  如果你想看风景，应该乘公车去。
Demonstrators were bussed in from all parts of the country to attend the protest rally.  示威者乘车从全国各地来参加抗议集会。

words.meaning: a.危险的,不安全的
words.example: It's dangerous to swim alone.  独自游泳很危险。

words.meaning: v.(of)提醒,使想起
words.example:
Could you remind Paul about dinner on Saturday?  你能否提醒一下保罗周六晚宴的事？
Your hair and eyes remind me of your mother.  看到你的头发和眼睛就使我想起了你妈妈。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.道德(上)的,精神上的 n.寓意,教育意义
words.example:
It's her moral obligation to tell the police what she knows.  她把所知道的事告诉警方是道义上的责任。
It is not part of a novelist's job to make a moral judgment.  小说家并不需要作道德上的批判。
She was the only politician to condemn the proposed law on moral grounds (= for moral reasons).  她是唯一一个从道德角度，对提议施行的法律作出谴责的政治家。

words.meaning: n.种类,部属,类目;范畴,类型
words.example: There are three categories of accommodation - standard, executive and deluxe.  有三种住宿标准——标准房、商务房和豪华房。

words.meaning: n.胜利，战胜
words.example:
The Redskins opened the season by scoring a resounding/stunning/impressive 25-3 victory against/over Detroit.  赛季首场比赛红人队便以25比3 的惊人比分大胜底特律队。
Grant won/achieved/gained a comfortable/easy victory against/over Cooper in yesterday's match.  昨天的比赛中格兰特轻松战胜库珀。
This result is a triumphant victory for democracy.  这个结果是民主的胜利。

words.meaning: a.学院的,学术性的;大学的;理论的
words.example: academic subjects/qualifications/books  学科／学历／学术书籍

words.meaning: n.[the～]国际互联网,因特网
words.example: The Internet connects billions of people.  互联网连接着数十亿人。

words.meaning: a.健康的,健壮的;有益健康的,卫生的
words.example:
She's a normal healthy child.  她是个正常健康的孩子。
He looks healthy enough.  他看起来相当健康。
The walk had given her a healthy glow.  散步使她面色健康红润。

words.meaning: n.内服药,医药;医术;医学,内科学
words.example:
She is a doctor, but is unable to practise medicine (= work as a doctor) in her own country.  她是位医生，却不能在自己的国家行医。noun
Take two spoonfuls of medicine at mealtimes.  进餐时服药两调羹。
She knows quite a lot about herbal medicines.  她的草药知识丰富。noun

words.meaning: n.旅游,旅行;巡回演出/比赛 v.旅游
words.example:
We went on a guided tour of / UK alsoround the cathedral/museum/factory.  我们在导游的带领下参观了大教堂／博物馆／工厂。
They've just come back from a tour of / UK alsoround Devon and Cornwall.  他们刚从德文郡和康沃尔郡旅行回来。
Tour operators (= companies which arrange holidays for people) have reported a drop in bookings.  旅行社称预订旅游的人数减少了。

words.meaning: v.(on)取决于,依靠,信赖,相信
words.example:
Whether or not we go to Spain for our holiday depends on the cost.  我们去不去西班牙渡假取决于需要花上多少钱。
You can always depend on Michael in a crisis.  遇到危机的时候你总是可以相信麦克。
humorous You can depend on Jane to be late (= she is always late).  简总是迟到。

words.meaning: n.(photograph)照片
words.example: She took a lot of photos of the kids.  她拍了很多孩子的照片。

words.meaning: a./ad.径直的(地) v.管理,指导;(at,to)指向
words.example:
Is there a direct train to Edinburgh?  有到爱丁堡的直达列车吗？
She decided to take direct control of the project.  她决定直接管理这个企划案。
He denied that he had any direct involvement in the deal.  他否认自己与这笔交易有任何直接关系。

words.meaning: n.教室,课堂
words.example:
Students learning computer studies spend two days each week in a computer lab and four days in the classroom.  学习电脑的学生每周有两天在电脑室上课，四天在教室上课。
There are also no promotions within the school, so that teachers remain in the classroom throughout their careers.  学校里也没有晋升制度，所以老师在整个教学生涯中都要授课。

words.meaning: n.公正,公平;审判,司法
words.example:
There's no justice in the world when people can be made to suffer like that.  如果人们被迫遭受这样的痛苦，那么世上就没有公平正义可言了。
The winner has been disqualified for cheating, so justice has been done (= a fair situation has been achieved).  获胜者因舞弊而被取消了资格，正义得以伸张。    Opposite injusticenoun
the justice system in this country consists of a series of law courts at different levels.  这个国家的司法体系由各级法庭组成。

words.meaning: v.(in)参与,参加;分享,分担;含有,带有
words.example: She never participates in any of our discussions, does she?  她从不参加我们的任何讨论，不是吗？UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.每日的 ad.每日,天天 n.日报
words.example:
Take the tablets twice daily.  药片日服两次。
Exercise has become part of my daily routine.  锻炼已经成为我日常生活的一部分。
We back up our computer files at work on a daily basis.  我们每天工作时都要把电脑文件进行备份。

words.meaning: a.公平的,合理的;相当的 n.集市,交易会
words.example:
Why should I have to do all the cleaning? It's not fair!  为甚么我要做所有的打扫工作？这不公平！
It's not fair on Joe (= It is not right) to make him do all the work!  所有的工作都由乔做，这对他不公平！
It's not fair that she's allowed to go and I'm not!  允许她去，却不许我去，这不公平！

words.meaning: n.一对,一双;一副;夫妇 v.配对,成对
words.example:
He packed two pairs of trousers and four shirts.  他把两条裤子和四件衬衫放进包里。
I'd like you to do this exercise in pairs (= in groups of two).  我希望你们两人一组来做这个练习。
They seem a very happy pair.  他们像是很幸福的一对。

words.meaning: a.著名的
words.example: Marie Curie is famous for her contribution to science.  玛丽‧居里以其对科学的贡献而享有盛名。

words.meaning: n.练习,习题;训练,锻练 v.训练,锻练;行使
words.example:
Swimming is my favourite form of exercise.  我最喜欢的运动是游泳。
You really should take more exercise.  你真的应该多做运动。
Ships from eight navies will be taking part in an exercise in the Pacific to improve their efficiency in combat.  来自8个国家的海军军舰将参加在太平洋举行的军事演习，以提高其作战效率。

words.meaning: n.膝,膝盖
words.example:
The baby was crawling around on its hands and knees.  婴儿用手和膝盖着地爬来爬去。
He got/went down on his knees (= got into a position where his knees were on the ground) in front of the altar.  他在圣坛前跪下。
She took the child and sat it on her knee (= on the part of the leg above the knee when sitting down).  她抱起孩子放在自己的膝盖上。

words.meaning: n.花;精华,精粹,精英;盛时 vi.开花
words.example:
The flower of the nation's youth were killed in the war.  该国的青年精英都死于这场战争。UK noun countable
Our roses are usually in flower from April to November.  我们的玫瑰通常在4月到11月开花。UK noun countable
He died in the very flower of his youth.  他去世时风华正茂。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.带(子);录音带,磁带 v.录音;系,捆
words.example:
I've got that film on tape (= recorded) if you want to borrow it.  我已经把那部电影录了下来，你可以借去看。
If you give me a blank tape (= one with nothing on it) I'll record it for you.  如果你给我一张空白带，我就帮你录。noun countable or uncountable
She taped a note to the door.  她把一张字条贴在门上。verb transitive

words.meaning: n./v.雇用,租借
words.example:
How much would it cost to hire a car for a fortnight?  租一辆车两个礼拜要多少钱？
You could always hire a dress for the ball if you can't afford to buy one.  如果你买不起舞会礼服，起码可以租一套。
How much do you charge for hiring out a bicycle for a week?  租一辆脚踏车一个星期需要多少钱？

words.meaning: a.熟悉的;通晓的;亲近的 n.熟客;密友
words.example:
There were one or two familiar faces (= people I knew).  那里有一两张熟悉的面孔。
The house looked strangely familiar, though she knew she'd never been there before.  尽管她知道自己以前从未到过那里，那座房子看上去却有一种奇怪的熟悉感。
The street was familiar to me.  这条街我很熟悉。

words.meaning: a.适当的,恰当的,特有的 vt.拨给,挪用,盗用
words.example:
Is this film appropriate for small children?  这部电影适合幼童观看吗？
Is this an appropriate occasion to discuss finance?  这个场合适合讨论财政问题吗？
Please complete the appropriate parts of this form (= the parts that are right or necessary for your particular situation) and return it as soon as possible.  请正确填写表中相应部分并尽快交回。    Opposite inappropriateverb transitive UK US     formal

words.meaning: v.(with,to)供给,供应,补足 n.供应,供应量
words.example:
Electrical power is supplied by underground cables.  电力是由地下电缆输送的。
Three people have been arrested for supplying arms to the terrorists.  有三个人因为向恐怖分子提供武器而被捕。
The company has supplied the royal family (= provided them with something they need) for years.  该公司多年来一直为皇室供货。

words.meaning: n.男演员;演员,行动者
words.example: "Who's your favourite actor?" "Robert de Niro."  “你最喜欢的演员是谁？”“劳勃‧狄尼洛。”

words.meaning: n.出生,诞生;出身,血统;起源;出现
words.example:
It was a difficult birth.  那是一次难产。
He weighed eight pounds at birth.  他出生时体重八磅。
More men are present at the births of their children these days.  现在更多父亲在孩子出生时也在场。

words.meaning: v./n.(for)搜索,寻找,探查
words.example:
The police searched the woods for the missing boy.  员警在树林中搜寻失踪的孩子。
She searched his face for some sign of forgiveness, but it remained expressionless.  她仔细端详他的脸，想看出些许表示原谅的神情，但他脸上仍然毫无表情。
He searched (in/through) his pockets for some change.  他翻遍口袋想找些零钱。

words.meaning: n.领带;联系,关系,纽带;束缚 v.扎,系,捆
words.example:
Could you tie this piece of string for me?  你能帮我把这个绳子打个结吗？
This skirt ties at the waist.  这条连衣裙是在腰间系带的。
She tied the ribbon tightly in a bow/knot.  她把丝带打成一个紧紧的蝴蝶结。

words.meaning: a.东方的,东部的
words.example:
The eastern part of the country is very mountainous.  这个国家的东部地区多山。
Until about 1991, the Eastern bloc was the Soviet Union and the communist countries of Eastern Europe.  直到1991年左右，东方集团是指苏联和东欧的共产主义国家。
Buddhism and other Eastern (= Asian) religions fascinate me.  佛教和其他东方宗教让我着迷。

words.meaning: a.最初的,初级的;首要的,主要的,基本的
words.example:
The Red Cross's primary concern is to preserve and protect human life.  红十字会最关心的是维护人的生命安全。
The primary responsibility lies with those who break the law.  主要的责任在于那些违法者。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.&ad.昨天;前不久
words.example:
He rang yesterday while you were out.  昨天你外出时他打电话来了。
Nobody's interested in yesterday's pop-stars.  没人对过气明星感兴趣。
These songs are a part of all our yesterdays.  这些歌曲是我们所有往事的一部分。

words.meaning: n.圆,圆周;集团;周期,循环 v.环绕,旋转
words.example:
Coloured paper was cut into circles, squares and triangles.  彩纸被剪成了圆形、正方形和三角形。
We sat in a circle.  我们围坐成一圈。UK noun
The subject was never discussed outside the family circle.  这个话题只在家庭成员间讨论。

words.meaning: v./n.进步,进展;前进
words.example:
Technological progress has been so rapid over the last few years.  在最近几年中，科技进步如此迅猛。
I'm not making much progress with my Spanish.  我的西班牙语没多大进步。
The doctor said that she was making good progress (= getting better after a medical operation or illness).  医生说她的情况正在好转。

words.meaning: n.底(部);基础,根基;海底,湖底,河床
words.example:
The government claims that the recession is bottoming out.  政府宣称经济衰退即将走出低谷。noun UK LOWEST PART  底部
He stood at the bottom of the stairs and called up to me.  他站在楼梯的最下面抬头叫我。
Extra information will be found at the bottom of the page.  补充资料见这一页的最底部。

words.meaning: n.岛,岛屿;(道路上的)交通安全岛
words.example: They live on the large Japanese island of Hokkaido.  他们住在日本的主要岛屿北海道。

words.meaning: v./n.(for)交换,兑换;交流,交易;交换台
words.example:
They were given food and shelter in exchange for work.  他们帮人工作以换取食宿。
She proposes an exchange of contracts at two o'clock.  她提议两点钟办理房屋产权过户手续。
Several people were killed during the exchange of gunfire.  交火中有几个人丧生。

words.meaning: a.清洁的,干净的v.除去..污垢,把...弄干净
words.example:
Make sure your hands are clean before you have your dinner.  饭前一定要把手洗干净。
Hospitals need to be kept spotlessly (= extremely) clean.  医院必须保持一尘不染，干干净净。adjective
The judge took the defendant's clean record (= the absence of previous involvement in crime) into account when passing sentence.  法官在宣判时考虑到被告没有前科。

words.meaning: n.画室;播音室;(电影)制片厂
words.example: The artist has a bright studio.  画家有间明亮的画室。

words.meaning: n.列车;行列,系列,一串 v.训练,培养
words.example:
Did you come by train?  你是乘火车来的吗？
She caught/took the train to Edinburgh.  她赶上了去爱丁堡的火车／她乘火车去爱丁堡。
Hurry up, or we'll miss (= arrive too late for) the train.  快点，不然我们就赶不上火车了。noun

words.meaning: n.女士,夫人
words.example:
There's a young lady here to see you.  这里有位年轻的女士要见你。
Mind your language - there are ladies present!  你说话注意点——有女士在场！
Say "thank you" to the lady, children.  孩子们，对这位女士说“谢谢。”

words.meaning: n.同事,同僚
words.example: We're entertaining some colleagues of Ben's tonight.  今晚我们要招待本的几位同事。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.申请,请求,申请书;应用,实施,实用性
words.example:
Free information will be sent out on application to (= if you ask) the central office.  请来函至总部索取免费资料。
I've sent off applications for four different jobs.  我投寄申请四份不同工作的求职信。
Have you filled in the application form for your passport yet?  你填写护照申请表了吗？

words.meaning: n.颈脖
words.example:
He had the thickest neck I'd ever seen.  我从没见过他那么粗的脖子。
She wore a gold chain around her neck.  她脖子上戴着一条金链子。
This sweater's too tight at the neck.  这件毛衣的领口太紧了。

words.meaning: v./n.损害,毁坏 n.(pl.)损害赔偿费
words.example:
Many buildings were badly damaged during the war.  许多建筑物在战争中严重受损。
It was a scandal which damaged a lot of reputations.  这是一宗使人名誉扫地的丑闻。noun
Strong winds had caused serious damage to the roof.  强风使屋顶严重受损。

words.meaning: n.(常pl.)塑料,塑料制品 a.可塑的,塑性的
words.example:
He put a sheet of plastic over the broken window.  他在打破的窗户上盖了一块塑胶片。
Those flowers aren't real - they're made of plastic.  那些花不是真的——是塑胶做成的。
The company has moved into plastics.  公司已转而投身塑胶制造业。

words.meaning: a.(身材)高的,高大的;夸大的,离谱的
words.example:
He's six feet tall.  他身高六英尺。
She's much taller than me.  她比我高得多。UK adjective
Getting the essay done on time will be a tall order.  按时完成论文是件很难的事。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.金属板,片;盘子,盆子;板,钢板v.镀,电镀
words.example:
There's still lots of food on your plate.  你的盘子里还有很多食物。
Stephen ate three plates of spaghetti.  史蒂芬吃了三盘义大利面条。noun
Thick bony plates protected the dinosaur against attack.  厚厚的骨质鳞甲帮助恐龙抵御攻击。

words.meaning: v.恨,憎恨;不愿,不喜欢 n.恨,憎恶
words.example:
Kelly hates her teacher.  凯莉厌恶她的老师。
She hated the cold dark days of winter.  她不喜欢冬天寒冷阴暗的日子。
I'd hate (= would not like) you to think I didn't appreciate what you'd done.  我不愿让你认为我不欣赏你做的事。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: ad.另样,用别的方法;在其他方面conj.要不然
words.example:
I'd better write it down, otherwise I'll forget it.  我最好把它写下来，否则我会忘掉。
Phone home, otherwise your parents will start to worry.  给家里打个电话，不然你父母会开始担心的。UK adverb
The police believe he is the thief, but all the evidence suggests otherwise (= that he is not).  警方认为他就是小偷，但所有的证据都显示他不是。

words.meaning: n./a.男性(的),雄性(的)
words.example:
What percentage of the adult male population is unemployed?  成年男性中的失业比例是多少？
The male parts of the flower are the stamens and the anthers.  花的雄性部分是雄蕊和花药。
The male of the species is less aggressive.  这个物种的雄性攻击性较弱。

words.meaning: a.活着的;存在的;活跃的;(to)敏感的
words.example:
He must be ninety if he's still alive.  如果他还在世的话，他肯定有90岁了。
Doctors kept him alive on a life-support machine.  医生使用维生系统来维持他的生命。
She's alive and well and living in New Zealand.  她生活得很好，目前住在纽西兰。

words.meaning: n.表达;表情;声调;腔调;榨出;措词;式;符号
words.example:
He wrote her a poem as an expression of his love.  他写了一首诗给她以表达爱慕之情。
We've received a lot of expressions of support for our campaign.  我们收到很多来信表示支持我们的运动。
Freedom of expression is a basic human right.  言论自由是基本的人权。

words.meaning: n.足球
words.example:
He's playing football.  他在踢足球。
Are you coming to the football match ?  你来看足球比赛吗？
I'm not a big football fan.  我算不上一个狂热的足球迷。

words.meaning: vt.想要,打算,企图
words.example:
Somehow I offended him, which wasn't what I'd intended.  我不知怎的得罪了他，但这不是我的初衷。
The course is intended for intermediate-level students.  这门课是为中等程度的学生开设的。
It was intended as a compliment, honestly!  真的，这本来是一句恭维话！

words.meaning: n.鸡肉;鸡,小鸡,小鸟
words.example:
We're having roast/fried chicken for dinner.  晚饭我们吃烤鸡／炸鸡。noun
Jump, you chicken!  跳呀，你这胆小鬼！noun
Why won't you jump? Are you chicken?  你干吗不跳？害怕了？verb

words.meaning: n.军队,陆军,军;大群,大批
words.example:
When did you join the army?  你甚么时候从军的？
He has decided on a career in the British Army.  他已经决定投身英国军队。
The army was/were called out to enforce the curfew.  出动了军队以实行宵禁。

words.meaning: vt.滥用;虐待,辱骂;诋毁 n.滥用;恶习;弊端
words.example:
She is continually abusing her position/authority by getting other people to do things for her.  她不断滥用职权／权力让别人替她做事。
Several of the children had been sexually/physically/emotionally abused.  几个儿童受到了性虐待／肉体折磨／精神上的伤害。verb transitive /əˈbjuːz/
The crowd started abusing him after he failed to save a goal.  他没有守住球门，丢了一分，观众开始对他破口大骂。noun]əˈbjuːs/

words.meaning: n.(theatre)戏院;戏剧;阶梯教室
words.example: The theater was full last night.  昨晚剧场满座。

words.meaning: v.关,关闭
words.example:
Please shut the gate.  请关上大门。
I've got a surprise for you! Shut your eyes tightly and hold out your hand.  我要给你一个惊喜！紧紧闭上眼睛，伸出你的手。
Mary shut her book and put it down on the table.  玛丽阖上书，把它放在桌子上。

words.meaning: n.地图,图 vt.在地图上标示出,绘制地图
words.example:
We need a large-scale map showing all the footpaths that we can walk along.  我们需要一张大比例尺地图，上面要标出所有能走的小路。
I'm hopeless at map reading (= understanding maps).  我一点也看不懂地图。
He bought a map showing the population distribution of Scotland.  他买了一张苏格兰人口分布图。

words.meaning: a.额外的,附加的 n.附加物,额外的东西
words.example:
If you need any extra help, just call me.  如果还需要其他的帮助，尽管打电话给我。
Recently he's been working an extra two hours a day.  最近他每日都加班两小时。
The price includes travel and accommodation but meals are extra (= there is an additional charge for meals).  这个价格包括旅费和住宿费，但是餐费要另计。adjective

words.meaning: n.(一届)会议,一段时间
words.example:
The parliamentary session is due to end on May 27th.  议会会议将于5月27日结束。
The UN Security Council met in emergency session to discuss the crisis.  联合国安理会举行了紧急会议讨论该危机。noun
The 21-year-old runner twisted his ankle in a training session last Friday.  这位21岁的跑者上周五在训练时扭伤了脚踝。

words.meaning: n.危险;威胁;危险事物
words.example:
Danger! Keep out!  危险！别进来！
He drove so fast that I really felt my life was in danger.  他的车开得太快了，当时我真的觉得自己会有生命危险。
The doctors say he is now out of danger (= is not expected to die although he has been extremely ill).  医生们说他已经渡过危险期。

words.meaning: int.欢迎 a.受欢迎的 vt./n.欢迎;迎接
words.example:
The new appointment has been widely welcomed.  这个新任命受到广泛欢迎。verb transitive
The visitors to the College were warmly welcomed by the Warden.  该大学的访问者受到学校理事的热烈欢迎。
Browning stood at the door, welcoming newcomers with a large smile and a pat on the arm.  布朗宁站在门口，面带灿烂笑容迎接新来的人，还会拍拍他们的胳膊。

words.meaning: n.文学,文学作品,文献,图书资料,印刷品
words.example:
'Wuthering Heights' is a classic of English literature.  《咆哮山庄》是一部经典的英国文学作品。UK noun uncountable
It's important to keep up-to-date with the literature in your field.  跟踪阅读最新的专业文献非常重要。
There is very little literature on the disease.  关于这种疾病的文献资料很少。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.雨;雨天;下雨 vi.下雨 vt.使大量落下
words.example:
Rain is forecast for tomorrow.  预报明天会下雨。
Come inside out of the rain.  进屋来，别在雨里淋着。
We had heavy/light rain all day.  我们这里倾盆大雨／毛毛细雨整整下了一天。

words.meaning: v./n.愿望,欲望,要求
words.example:
There is a strong desire for peace among the people.  人民极盼和平。
He needed to satisfy his desire for revenge.  他需要满足自己复仇的愿望。
Several people have expressed a desire to see the report.  有几个人表示想要看看这份报告。UK noun

words.meaning: n. 评定；估价
words.example:
Would you say that is a fair assessment of the situation?  你认为那是对形势的合理评估吗？
Both their assessments of production costs were hopelessly inaccurate.  他们两者对生产成本所作的估算都非常不准确。

words.meaning: n.伤害,损害
words.example:
Several train passengers received/sustained serious injuries in the crash.  在这次撞车事故中火车上几名乘客受重伤。
Injuries to the spine are common amongst these workers.  脊椎受伤在这些工人中是很普遍的。
They were lucky to escape (without) injury.  他们很幸运，没有受伤。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n./v.尊敬,尊重 n.敬意,问候,关系,方面
words.example:
She is a formidable figure who commands a great deal of respect (= who is greatly admired by others).  她是个令人敬畏的人，赢得了大家的无限敬重。
New teachers have to earn/gain the respect of their students.  新教师必须要赢得学生的尊重。
You really should treat your parents with more respect.  你待你父母真应该多几分尊重。

words.meaning: a.北方的,北部的
words.example: northern Europe  北欧

words.meaning: v.点(头),点头招呼 n.点头招呼;打盹,瞌睡
words.example:
Many people in the audience nodded in agreement.  许多听众点头表示赞同。
When I suggested a walk, Elena nodded enthusiastically.  当我提议去散步时，埃琳娜使劲地点头。
She looked up and nodded for me to come in.  她抬起头，点头示意要我进来。    Compare shakeUK US  (-dd-)

words.meaning: n.油漆,颜料 v.油漆;涂,涂漆;画;描绘,描述
words.example:
This wall needs another coat of paint.  这面墙需要再刷一层漆。
Caution! Wet paint.  小心，油漆未干！
There were so many paints (= types of paint) to choose from that I couldn't decide which to buy.  有这么多种油漆可供选择，我很难决定买哪一种。

words.meaning: n.燃料 vt.给…加燃料
words.example:
Wood, coal, oil, petrol and gas are all different kinds of fuel.  木材、煤炭、石油、汽油和煤气是不同种类的燃料。
Plutonium is a fuel used to produce nuclear energy.  钸是一种用来产生核能量的燃料。
The new exhaust system, it is claimed, will lower fuel consumption.  据称新的排气装置会降低燃料的消耗。

words.meaning: n.叶子;(书刊的)一页,一张;金属薄片
words.example:
He was sweeping up leaves in his garden.  他在自己的花园里扫树叶。
The trees are in leaf early this year.  今年树木的叶子长得早。
The bushes are just coming into leaf.  灌木刚刚长出叶子。noun countable (plural leaves)

words.meaning: a.干(旱)的;干渴的;枯燥 vt.使干燥,晒干
words.example:
These plants grow well in dry soil/a dry climate.  这些植物适宜在干旱的土壤里／气候条件下生长。
This cake's a bit dry - I think I overcooked it.  这个蛋糕有点干——估计是给我烤过头了。
By this time all the wells had run dry.  到这个时候所有的井都已经干枯了。

words.meaning: n.教授;指导;(pl.)用法说明(书),操作指南
words.example:
The police who broke into the house were only acting on/under instructions.  员警破门而入只是奉命行事。
The cooking instructions say bake it for half an hour.  烹调说明书上说烘烤半个小时。
You obviously didn't read the instructions properly.  你显然没有好好看说明书。

words.meaning: n.水池,游泳池;合资经营v.合伙经营,联营
words.example:
We looked for crabs in the rock pools along the seashore.  我们在海边岩石的水坑里找螃蟹。
Patrick crashed a Ford that he'd borrowed from the car pool at work.  派翠克把他从公司车队借的一辆福特汽车撞坏了。
As unemployment rises, the pool of cheap labour increases.  随着失业率的上升，廉价劳力的数量也在增加。noun

words.meaning: v./n.攀登,爬
words.example:
The plane climbed quickly to a height of 30 000 feet.  飞机迅速爬升到三万英尺的高度。
As it leaves the village, the road climbs steeply up the mountain.  出了村庄，这条路沿着山坡陡然向上。
The sun climbed higher in the sky.  太阳升得更高了。

words.meaning: a.甜的;可爱的,美好的 n.(常pl.)糖果;甜食
words.example:
The pineapple was sweet and juicy.  这个凤梨甜而多汁。
Do you want your pancakes sweet or savoury?  您的煎饼是要甜的还是咸的?adjective
She was enjoying the sweet smell of success.  她沉浸在成功的喜悦中。

words.meaning: n.盐,盐,类 v.腌,盐渍
words.example:
Can you pass the salt please?  请把盐递过来好吗？
Add a pinch of (= small amount of) salt to the sauce.  往酱汁里加点盐。UK noun
Potassium nitrate and potassium chloride are potassium salts.  硝酸钾、氯化钾都是钾盐。UK noun

words.meaning: v.(使)膨胀,(使)扩张;张开,展开
words.example:
The air in the balloon expands when heated.  气球里的空气受热后膨胀。
They expanded their retail operations during the 1980s.  20世纪80年代他们扩大了零售业务。verb intransitive or transitive
She mentioned a few ideas, but she didn't expand on them.  她提到了几个想法，但并没有进行详细说明。

words.meaning: n.重要,重要性
words.example:
The health report stresses the importance of fresh food in a diet.  健康报告强调了饮食中新鲜食物的重要性。
She attaches a lot of importance to personal possessions.  她非常重视个人财产。

words.meaning: n.金属,金属制品
words.example:
Metal, paper and glass can be recycled.  金属、纸张和玻璃都可以再利用。
Silver, gold and platinum are precious metals.  银、金和铂都是贵重金属。
The wooden beam is reinforced with a metal plate.  木梁用金属板加固了。

words.meaning: a.多脂肪的,肥胖的;丰厚的n.脂肪,肥肉
words.example:
Like most women, she thinks she's fat.  与大多数女性一样，她觉得自己很胖。
He eats all the time but he never gets fat.  他总是在吃，但从来不长胖。
He lifted a fat volume down from the shelf.  他从架子上取下一册厚厚的书。

words.meaning: n.票,入场券;票签;(交通违章)罚款传票
words.example: She's standing on an education ticket.  她支持一条有关教育的竞选主张。

words.meaning: n.软件
words.example: He's written a piece of software which calculates your tax returns for you.  他编写了一个能计算你退税额度的软体。    Compare hardwareUK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.不见,消失
words.example:
The search was called off for the sailors who disappeared in the storm.  搜寻在风暴中失踪水手的行动被取消了。
This is a way of life that is fast disappearing.  这种生活方式正在迅速消失。
The sun disappeared behind a cloud.  太阳躲到了云彩的后面。

words.meaning: a.奇怪的,奇异的;陌生的,生疏的;外地的
words.example:
He's got some very strange ideas about women!  他对女性有一些非常古怪的看法！
You say the strangest things sometimes.  有时候你说的话非常奇怪。
It 's strange that tourists almost never visit this village.  不可思议的是，游客几乎从来不到这个村子来。

words.meaning: n.嘴唇
words.example:
She kissed me on the lips.  她吻了我的嘴唇。
He licked his lips.  他舔了舔嘴唇。noun
That's enough of your lip, young lady!  请尊重些，小姐！noun

words.meaning: n.读书,读物,(仪表等的)读数,阅读
words.example:
Reading and tennis are my favourite pastimes.  我最喜欢的业余爱好就是读书和打网球。
The diaries make good (bedtime) reading (= are good to read (in bed at night)).  （睡前在床上）读一读这些日记是很好的消遣。
These books are compulsory/required reading for students of architecture.  这些是主修建筑学的学生的必读书目。

words.meaning: adj. 城市的；住在都市的；n. (Urban)人名；(西)乌尔万；(斯洛伐)乌尔班；(德、俄、罗、匈、塞、波、捷、瑞典、意)乌尔班；(英)厄本；(法)于尔邦
words.example: urban development  城市发展

words.meaning: a.精神的,思想的,心理的,智力的,脑力的
words.example:
His physical and mental health had got worse.  他的身心健康进一步恶化。
Many people suffer from some form of mental illness during their lives.  许多人一生中都会患上某种精神疾病。
She had a mental picture (= a picture in her mind) of how the house would look when they finished decorating it.  她脑海中已经有房子装修好以后的样子。    Compare physical    UK slang

words.meaning: n.午餐,(美)便餐
words.example:
What's for lunch?  午饭吃甚么？
I'm sorry, Joanna isn't here at the moment, she's (gone) out to/gone to lunch.  对不起，乔安娜现在不在，她吃午饭去了。
We must do lunch sometime (= have lunch together).  我们找天一定要一起吃个午饭。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: ad.某地,在某处;在附近,前后,大约
words.example:
He was last heard of living somewhere on the south coast.  最后一次听到关于他的消息时，说他住在南海岸的某地。
You must have put their letter somewhere!  你一定把他们的信放在甚么地方了！
Can we go somewhere else to talk - it's very noisy here.  我们能否另外找个地方谈——这里太吵了。

words.meaning: n.农民,农场主
words.example: a dairy/sheep farmer  乳牛场／牧羊场场主

words.meaning: n.糖,食糖 vt.加糖于
words.example:
How many sugars (= spoonfuls or lumps of sugar) do you take in your tea?  你的茶要加几匙糖？
Glucose and lactose are sugars.  葡萄糖和乳糖都是糖类。
Hi, sugar, did you have a good day at school?  嗨，宝贝，你今天在学校过得好吗？UK noun

words.meaning: n.行星
words.example:
Might there be intelligent life on other planets?  其他星球上有可能存在智慧生物吗？noun countable
Some days that girl seems as if she's on another planet.  那个女孩有时候看来很怪异。

words.meaning: n.(favourite)最喜欢的人或物 a.喜爱的
words.example: What's your favorite subject?  你最喜欢哪门课？

words.meaning: v.勘探,探测;探究,探索
words.example:
The best way to explore the countryside is on foot.  在农村考察，步行是最好的方法了。
The children have gone exploring in the woods.  孩子们去树林里观察大自然了。
Let's explore this issue/idea more fully.  让我们进一步探讨一下这个问题／计划。

words.meaning: v.获得,得到
words.example:
First editions of these books are now almost impossible to obtain.  这些书的第一版现在已几乎弄不到了。
In the second experiment they obtained a very clear result.  第二次试验他们获得了明确的结果。
Sugar is obtained by crushing and processing sugar cane.  蔗糖是透过对甘蔗进行压榨和加工获得的。 formal

words.meaning: n.敌人,仇敌,反对者;敌人,敌军,敌国
words.example:
He's made a few enemies in this company.  他在公司中和几个人结了怨。
Max stole Lee's girlfriend and they've been enemies ever since.  马克斯抢走了李的女朋友，从那以后他们就成了死对头。
The enemy had succeeded in stopping our supplies from getting through.  敌人成功切断了我军的补给线。

words.meaning: a.复杂的;合成的,综合的 n.联合体
words.example:
The company has a complex organizational structure.  公司组织结构非常复杂。
It's a very complex issue to which there is no straightforward answer.  这个问题错综复杂，没有简单直接的答案。
The film's plot was so complex that I couldn't follow it.  这部电影的情节太复杂，我看不懂。noun countable UK BUILDING  建筑物

words.meaning: vt.包围,环绕 n.环绕物
words.example:
Snow-capped mountains surround the city.  白头积雪的群山环绕着这座城市。
Gwen sat at her desk, surrounded by books and papers.  格温坐在桌前，周围堆满了书和报纸。
Mystery still surrounds the exact circumstances of Stalin's death.  史达林去世的确切情况仍是迷雾重重。

words.meaning: n.运动员,体育家,身强力壮的人
words.example:
He became a professional athlete at the age of 16.  16岁时他成了一名职业运动员。
She has the build of an athlete.  她有一副运动员的体格。

words.meaning: vt.邀请,招待
words.example:
We're invited to Lola's party.  我们受邀参加洛拉的晚会。
Candidates who are successful in the written test will be invited for an interview.  通过笔试的候选人将获邀参加面试。
Offers in the region of £1 000 000 are invited for the property.  这块地产征求100万英镑左右的出价。

words.meaning: v.重复,重说,重做 n.重复
words.example:
Would you mind repeating what you just said?  您能重复一遍刚才您讲的话吗？
Please don't repeat what I've just told you to anyone else.  请不要把我刚才对你所说的话告诉任何人。
The test must be repeated several times.  这个试验一定要重复做数次。

words.meaning: n.灵魂,心灵;精神,精力;人
words.example:
She suffered greatly while she was alive, so let us hope her soul is now at peace.  她生前受过很多苦，所以我们希望现在她的灵魂能得到安息。UK noun
If you can't enjoy this music you've got no soul.  如果你不能欣赏这种音乐，说明你缺乏真挚的情感。
For me her paintings somehow lack soul.  在我看来，她的绘画作品有些缺乏真情实感。UK noun

words.meaning: a.科学上的
words.example:
The project has attracted considerable criticism from the scientific community (= from scientists).  这个企划案招致科学界广泛的批评。
We will have to adopt a more scientific approach in the future.  我们将来得采用更审慎而有系统的方法。

words.meaning: a.不可能的;难以忍受的,很难对付的
words.example:
