It was impossible to sleep because of the noise.  噪音太大，无法入睡。
It seems impossible that I could have walked by without noticing her.  我似乎不太可能走过而没有注意到她。
He made it impossible for me to say no.  他使我无法说不。

words.meaning: n.意思,意义,含义;重要性,价值
words.example:
The word 'flight' has two different meanings: a plane journey, and the act of running away.  flight 一词有两个不同的意思：航程和逃跑。
The meaning of his gesture was clear.  他手势的含义很清楚。
His novels often have (a) hidden meaning.  他的小说常有隐含意义。noun

words.meaning: n. 妈妈；n. (Mom)人名；(柬)蒙
words.example: [as form of address] Aw, Mom, why can't I go?  哦，妈妈，为甚么我不能去？

words.meaning: n.工具,仪器,器械;乐器
words.example:
Which instrument do you play ?  你演奏哪一种乐器？noun countable
The man's injuries had obviously been caused by a blunt instrument.  这人的伤口显然是由钝器所致。
The lightning had damaged the plane's instruments, and they weren't giving any readings.  闪电击毁了飞机的仪表，上面甚么资料都显示不出来。

words.meaning: v.预言,预测,预告
words.example: It's still not possible to accurately predict the occurrence of earthquakes.  现在仍无法准确预报地震的发生。

words.meaning: n.天气,气象
words.example:
The weather in the hills can change very quickly, so take suitable clothing.  山里的天气瞬息万变，所以要带上合适的衣服。
We're going to have a picnic, weather permitting (= if the weather is good enough).  如果天气好的话，我们打算去野餐。UK noun uncountable
I'm feeling a bit under the weather - I think I've caught a cold.  我觉得有点不舒服——可能是感冒了。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n. 承诺，保证；委托；承担义务；献身
words.example:
She is known chiefly for her commitment to nuclear disarmament.  她主要以全力支持核裁军运动而闻名。
I'd like to thank the staff for having shown such commitment.  我要对全体员工作出的巨大奉献表示感谢。
Try the product out in the comfort of your own home with absolutely no commitment to buy!  可在家随意试用本产品且根本无须购买！

words.meaning: a.极度的,最重要的;至高的,最高的
words.example:
The present constitution gives supreme authority to the presidency.  现行宪法赋予总统至高无上的权力。
From 1960 to 1970, Ayatollah Mohsen al-Hakim reigned supreme among the Shi'ites of Iraq, Iran and elsewhere.  自1960年至1970年，阿亚图拉‧穆赫辛‧哈基姆是伊拉克、伊朗及其他地方什叶派的最高领袖。adjective
She was awarded a medal for showing supreme bravery.  她因为表现非常英勇而获得一枚奖章。

words.meaning: n.熊 v.忍受,容忍;负担;结果实,生子女
words.example:
The strain must have been enormous but she bore it well.  当时压力一定很大，但她承受得了。
Tell me now! I can't bear the suspense !  现在告诉我吧！ 我等不及了！
It's your decision - you must bear the responsibility if things go wrong.  是你作出的决定——如果出了差错，你必须承担责任。

words.meaning: n.衣袋 a.袖珍的,小型的 v.把…装入袋内
words.example:
She thrust her hands deep in/into her pockets.  她把双手深深插进口袋里。
He took some coins from/out of his pocket.  他从口袋里掏出几枚硬币。
Sarah put her maps in the outside pocket of her rucksack.  莎拉把地图放在帆布背包外面的口袋里。

words.meaning: a.薄的,细的;稀薄的,淡的;瘦的 v.变薄;变稀
words.example:
Did you notice how thin her wrists were?  你注意到她的手腕有多细吗？
Thin, hungry dogs roamed the streets.  瘦瘦的饿狗们在街上遛来遛去。    Opposite fat.
He eats like a horse and yet he's as thin as a rake.  他像猪一样吃得多，却骨瘦如柴。 (thinner, thinnest)

words.meaning: n.温度,体温;热度,发烧
words.example:
Preheat the oven to a temperature of 200 degrees Celsius.  把炉子预热到摄氏200度。
There has been a sudden rise in temperature over the past few days (= The weather has become warmer).  最近几天气温突然上升了。
The doctor examined him and took his temperature (= measured it).  医生给他做检查，并量了他的体温。

words.meaning: v.使诧异,使惊异;奇袭 n.诧异,惊异;奇袭
words.example:
Don't tell Anne we've arranged a party for her - I want it to be a surprise.  不要告诉安妮我们为她安排了一个派对——我想给她一个惊喜。
It was a lovely/nasty, etc. surprise to get home and find the letter.  回到家就意外看到这封信，真是太好了／糟糕透了等等。
Last night's heavy snow came as a complete surprise.  昨晚的那场大雪下得太突然了。

words.meaning: n.结果,后果,影响;重要性
words.example:
Not making a will can have serious consequences for the people you might wish to benefit.  不立遗嘱可能会给你所希望受益的人带来严重后果。
Scientists think it unlikely that any species will actually become extinct as a consequence of the oil spill.  科学家们认为实际上不太可能会有甚么物种因为石油泄漏而灭绝。
Well, if you insist on eating so much, you'll have to suffer/take (= accept and deal with) the consequences!  好吧，要是你坚持吃这么多，你会自食其果的！

words.meaning: n.呼吸,气息
words.example:
Her breath smelled of garlic.  她的嘴里有大蒜味。
She was dizzy and short of breath (= unable to breathe in enough air).  她头昏眼花，上气不接下气。
He burst into the room, red-faced and out of breath (= unable to breathe comfortably because of tiredness or excitement).  他冲进房间，满脸通红，气喘吁吁。

words.meaning: n.视力;望见,瞥见;视域;眼界;情景,奇观
words.example:
If your sight is poor, you should not drive a car.  视力不佳就不应该开车。
The old woman has lost her sight (= has become blind).  那位老妇人失明了。
The flowers at the annual flower show were a beautiful sight.  年度花卉展上的鲜花是一道美丽的风景。

words.meaning: v.称,(使)平衡 n.天平;平衡,均衡;差额,余款
words.example:
The toddler wobbled and lost his balance (= started to fall sideways).  那个刚学走路的小孩摇摇晃晃的，走了几步就失去平衡。
She had to hold onto the railings to keep her balance (= to stop herself from falling).  她必须扶着围栏才能保持平衡。
New tax measures are designed to redress the balance (= make the situation more equal) between rich and poor.  新的税收措施旨在透过重新分配，使贫富差距趋于合理。

words.meaning: vt.采用,采取(态度等);选定;收养
words.example:
They've adopted a baby girl.  他们领养了一个女婴。
She had the child adopted (= She gave her baby to someone else to look after).  她把自己的孩子送给别人抚养。
They have no children of their own, but they're hoping to adopt.  他们没有亲生子女，但是他们希望能领养。    Compare fosterUK verb

words.meaning: n.少数,少数派,少数民族
words.example:
It's only a tiny minority of people who are causing the problem.  惹麻烦的只是极少数的人。
Children with single parents at my school were very much in the minority (= there were very few).  在我的学校里单亲孩子只占极少数。
This section of the bookstore caters for minority interests (= subjects that interest only a few people).  书店的这个专柜主要满足少数读者的兴趣。    Opposite majorityUK noun

words.meaning: a.直的;整齐的,端正的 ad.直接;正直,直率
words.example:
She's got straight blonde hair.  她有一头金色直发。
Skirts this summer are long and straight.  今夏的裙装流行长长的直筒裙。
Can't you see it? - it's straight ahead (of you)!  难道你看不见吗？——就在（你）正前面！

words.meaning: vt.连接;与…联系,接通(电话) vi.连接
words.example:
Can I connect my printer to your computer?  我能把我的印表机连接到你的电脑上吗？
Where does the cooker connect (up) to the electricity?  这电锅在哪里连接电源？
Has the telephone/electricity/gas been connected (= switched on or joined to the main supply) in your new place yet?  你们的新居接通了电话／电／煤气了吗？verb

words.meaning: v.(to)属于,附属,隶属;应归入(类别,范畴等)
words.example:
This table belongs in the sitting-room.  这张桌子应该放在客厅里。
Where do these spoons belong?  这些匙应放在哪里？
These papers belong with the others.  这些报纸应该和其他的放在一起。

words.meaning: n.援助,救护;助手,辅助物 vi.援助,救援
words.example:
He gets about with the aid of a walking stick.  他拄着拐杖到处走动。
She went to the aid of a man trapped in his car.  她去帮助一个困在车中的男子。
The Vatican has agreed to donate $80 000 in humanitarian/emergency aid to countries affected by the war.  罗马教廷已经同意向饱受战祸的国家捐赠八万美元的人道援助金／紧急援助金。

words.meaning: n.劝告,忠告,(医生等的)意见
words.example:
Steven gave me some good advice.  斯蒂芬给了我一些好建议。
Can I give you a piece of advice?  你想听听我的建议吗？
We went to Paris on Sarah's advice.  我们听从萨拉的建议去了巴黎。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.照/相片
words.example: My parents took a lot of photographs of us when we were small.  我们小的时候，父母拍了很多我们的照片。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.空的;空洞的 v.倒空,使成为空的
words.example:
Shall I take the empty bottles for recycling?  我把这些空瓶子拿去回收吧？
The train was empty (= There were no passengers) by the time it reached London.  火车到达伦敦的时候，车内已经没有乘客了。adjective
They're just empty promises.  这些承诺只不过是些空头支票。adjective

words.meaning: n.(长篇)小说 a.新奇的,新颖的
words.example:
Have you read any of Jane Austen's novels?  你读过简．奥斯汀的小说吗？
His latest novel is selling really well.  他的最新小说非常畅销。UK adjective
Keeping a sheep in the garden is a novel way of keeping the grass short!  在花园里养只羊来阻止草长高，这办法可真新奇！

words.meaning: ad.以某种方式,用某种方法;不知怎么地
words.example: It won't be easy, but we'll get across the river somehow.  过河不是件容易的事，但我们总会有办法的。

words.meaning: v.(organise)组织,编组
words.example:
They organized a meeting between the teachers and students.  他们组织了一次师生会议。
The books were organized on the shelves according to their size.  书按大小摆放在书架上。
informal My mother is always trying to organize me (= make me do things in the way she likes).  我母亲总是想要我按她喜欢的方式行事。(UK usually organise) UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.胸膛,乳房
words.example:
When a woman becomes pregnant her breasts tend to grow larger.  女性怀孕后，乳房会增大。
Do you think she's had breast implants ?  你觉得她做过隆胸手术吗？noun
He put a silk hanky in his breast pocket (= a pocket on the top front part of a shirt or coat).  他将一条丝绸手帕放入上衣口袋。noun

words.meaning: vt.承认;接受;告知(信件等的)收到;答谢
words.example:
You must acknowledge the truth of her argument.  你必须承认，她的论点是事实。
Historians generally acknowledge her as a genius in her field.  历史学家公认她在该领域中是天才。
They refused to acknowledge (= to recognize officially) the new government.  他们拒绝承认新政府。

words.meaning: n.题目,主题;主旋律,基调
words.example: The theme of loss runs through most of his novels.  失落这一主题贯穿了他的大多数小说作品。noun countable

words.meaning: n.暴风雨,暴风雪;激动,爆发 v.猛攻,直捣
words.example:
They're still clearing up the storm damage.  他们还在清理风暴留下的残局。UK noun
There was a storm of protest when the new tax was announced.  宣布新税目后，引发了抗议风潮。UK noun
Her performance has taken the London critics by storm.  她的表演完全征服了伦敦评论界。UK noun

words.meaning: n.联合,团结;联盟,联邦;协会,社团;和谐
words.example:
Meanwhile the debate on European political and monetary union continues.  同时，有关欧洲政治和货币联盟的争论还在继续。
formal or old use She believes that the union (= marriage) of man and woman in holy matrimony is for ever.  她相信男女之间的结合永远是神圣的。noun

words.meaning: n.书桌,办公桌,服务台
words.example:
She sat at her desk writing letters.  她坐在书桌前写信。
He had a pile of papers on his desk.  他的办公桌上有一叠文件。
The report arrived on/landed on/reached my desk (= I received it) this morning.  这份报告是今天早上送到我的桌上的。noun countable

words.meaning: n.水果,果实;成果,效果
words.example:
Apricots are the one fruit I don't like.  水果中只有杏子是我不爱吃的。
Oranges, apples, pears and bananas are all types of fruit.  柳橙、苹果、梨和香蕉都是水果。
Would you like some fruit for dessert?  餐后甜点你想要些水果吗？

words.meaning: a.花费的,昂贵的
words.example:
Rolls Royces are very expensive.  劳斯莱斯汽车价格昂贵。
Big houses are expensive to maintain.  大房子的维修费很高。
She has expensive tastes (= she likes things that cost a lot of money).  她喜欢昂贵的东西。

words.meaning: a.黄的,黄色的 n.黄色
words.example:
It was early autumn and the leaves were turning yellow.  正值初秋时节，树叶开始转黄。
You should wear more yellow - it suits you.  你应该多穿些黄色的衣服——那适合你。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.结论,推论;结尾;缔结,议定
words.example:
In conclusion, I would like to thank our guest speaker.  最后，我要感谢我们的演讲嘉宾。noun
Did you come to/reach/draw any conclusions at the meeting this morning?  今天上午的会议上你们有没有得出甚么结论？

words.meaning: n.阴影,影子,荫;暗处,阴暗
words.example:
The children were playing, jumping on each other's shadows.  孩子们正在嬉戏，跳来跳去踩彼此的影子。
Jamie followed his mother around all day like a shadow.  杰米像影子一样整天跟着他母亲。
The sun shone through the leaves, casting/throwing shadows on the lawn.  阳光透过树叶，在草地上投下阴影。

words.meaning: n./v.斗争,奋斗,努力
words.example:
I've been struggling to understand this article all afternoon.  我琢磨了整整一个下午，想弄懂这篇文章的意思。
Fish struggle for survival when the water level drops in the lake.  湖水水位下降时，鱼会拼命挣扎求生。
He struggled along the rough road holding his son.  他抱着儿子在崎岖不平的路上艰难行进。

words.meaning: v.结束,终止;断定,下结论;缔结,议定
words.example:
She concluded the speech by reminding us of our responsibility.  她在演讲结束时提醒我们所承担的责任。
Before I conclude, I'd like to thank you all for coming.  在结束发言前，我想感谢诸位的光临。
The concert concluded with a rousing chorus.  音乐会以激动人心的大合唱结束。

words.meaning: n.舞(蹈);舞曲,舞会 v.跳舞;跳动
words.example:
We danced all night.  我们跳了一夜的舞。
We went dancing at a nightclub.  我们去夜总会跳舞。
What sort of music do you like dancing to ?  你喜欢伴着哪种歌曲跳舞？

words.meaning: n.规则,规章;调节,校准;调整
words.example:
The correct procedure is laid down in the rules and regulations.  正确的程式在规章条例中有规定。
It's regulation to wear suits at the office.  按规定在办公室要穿西装。

words.meaning: n.生物,生命,存在;
words.example: Strange beings from outer space are still a popular subject for sci-fi films.  外星人仍是不少科幻电影流行的主题。

words.meaning: n.戒指;环;铃声;(打)电话 v.按(铃),敲(钟)
words.example:
The game involved throwing metal rings over a stick.  这个游戏的玩法是扔金属环套在一根棍子上。
The children sat in a ring around the teacher.  孩子们围着老师坐成一圈。
He bought her a diamond/emerald/etc. ring (= a ring with a jewel fixed to it).  他为她买了一只钻石／祖母绿戒指。

words.meaning: n.痕迹;记号;分数 v.标记,打分,使有特色
words.example:
The car has enjoyed modest success since its launch, but the Mark 2 version is expected to be far more popular.  这款汽车自推出以来受欢迎程度一直都不很高，不过预计2型车将会受欢迎得多。
Cook at Mark 5 for 20 minutes.  调到5号刻度，煮20分钟。
There were dirty marks on her trousers where she had wiped her hands.  她裤子上抹过手的地方留下了污渍。

words.meaning: n.出现,露面;外表;(在会议等)作短暂露面
words.example:
It was his first appearance on television/television appearance as president.  这是他就任总统以来首次在电视上亮相。
She will be making a public appearance, signing copies of her latest novel.  她将公开亮相，为自己刚刚出版的小说签名售书。
This was the defendant's third court appearance for the same offence.  这是被告因为同一宗罪行第三次出庭受审。

words.meaning: n.包装,包裹,箱,包装费,标准部件,成套设备
words.example:
The postman has just delivered a package for you.  邮差刚刚送来一个包裹给你。
The package was wrapped in plain brown paper.  包裹用普通的牛皮纸包着。
The computer comes with a software package.  电脑附带一套套装软体。

words.meaning: n.困难,困境,难题
words.example:
We finished the job, but only with great difficulty.  我们非常艰难地完成了工作。
The difficulty of the task excited them.  这项任务之艰钜让他们感到非常刺激。
People with asthma have difficulty in breathing.  哮喘患者呼吸有困难。

words.meaning: n.桥;桥牌;鼻梁 vt.架桥;渡过
words.example:
We drove across/over the bridge.  我们开车驶过大桥。
Voluntary work can provide a bridge between staying at home and working full-time.  志愿工作是由在家待业过度到全职工作的桥梁。noun
The blow caught him right on the bridge of his nose.  那一拳正好打在他的鼻梁上。noun

words.meaning: v.推荐,介绍;劝告,建议
words.example:
She has been recommended for promotion.  已经有人推荐给她升职。
The headmistress agreed to recommend the teachers' proposals to the school governors.  女校长同意把这位老师的建议提请学校董事们考虑。
The city has much/little to recommend it (= It has a lot of/few pleasant qualities).  这个城市可圈可点的地方很多／几乎没有。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.明显的,显而易见的
words.example:
They have a small child so for obvious reasons they need money.  他们有个年幼的孩子，所以显然很需要钱。
Am I stating the obvious (= saying what everyone already knows) ?  我说的大家早就知道了吗？
There is no obvious solution.  还没有合情合理的解决办法。

words.meaning: n.(electronic mail)电子信函,电子邮件
words.example: I got an e-mail from my pen pal.  我收到了笔友的电子邮件。

words.meaning: adj. 思考的；思想的；有理性的；好思考的；n. 思考；思想；想法；意见；见解；v. 思考（think的现在分词）
words.example:
I'll have to do some thinking about how best to arrange the books.  我得想一想怎样摆放这些书最好。
What's the thinking behind the decision to combine the two departments?  决定合并这两个部门是出于甚么考虑？
The book discusses the impact of Christian thinking on western society.  这本书探讨了基督教思想对西方社会的影响。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.倾向,趋势 vi.伸向,倾向
words.example:
Surveys show a trend away from home-ownership and towards rented accommodation.  调查显示，出现了一种从私人拥有住房转向租赁住房的趋势。
There's been a downward/upward trend in sales in the last few years.  过去几年，销售额一直呈下降／上升趋势。
Whatever the latest fashion trend, you can be sure Nicki will be wearing it.  不管是甚么样的流行款式，尼基肯定会穿。

words.meaning: n.访问者；游客
words.example: Ben, you've got some visitors to see you.  本，有人来看你了。

words.meaning: a.舒适的,舒服的;感到舒适的,安逸的
words.example:
Are you comfortable or shall I turn the heat down?  你觉得舒服吗？还是要我把暖气调低点？
Do sit down and make your self comfortable.  请坐，别拘束。
I'm not comfortable with the idea of leaving her on her own.  要把她一个人留下来，我可不放心。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.利润,收益 v.(by,from)得利,获益;有利于
words.example:
She makes a big profit from selling waste material to textile companies.  她将废弃材料卖给纺织公司，从中赚取大笔利润。
Company profits are down on last year's figures.  从去年的统计数字看，公司的利润下降了。
You don't expect to make much profit within the first couple of years of setting up a company.  你不要指望在创立公司的头几年里会赚取很多利润。

words.meaning: a.生气的,愤怒的;(天气)风雨交加的
words.example:
He's really angry at/with me for upsetting Sophie.  因为我惹了索菲，他很生我的气。
It made me really angry.  这让我很恼火。adjective
On her leg was an angry sore.  她腿上长了一个疮，又红又肿。

words.meaning: n.全体船员,全体乘务员
words.example:
The aircraft has/carries a crew of seven.  这架飞机上有七名机组人员。
Apart from the 10 officers, a crew of 90 looks after the 300 passengers.  除了这10位高级船员，还有90名船员为300名乘客服务。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.意外遭遇,事故;意外(因素)
words.example:
Josh had an accident and spilled water all over his work.  乔希不小心把作业上洒得都是水。
She was injured in a car/road accident (= when one car hit another).  她在一宗车祸／交通意外中受伤了。
Even a six-year-old can have an accident at night sometimes.  即使是六岁大的孩子，晚上有时也可能会尿床。noun countable

words.meaning: n.膳食,一餐
words.example: You must come round for a meal sometime.  你有空一定要过来吃顿饭。noun

words.meaning: n.听,倾听;听力;审讯
words.example: He's getting old and his hearing isn't very good.  他年纪大了，听力也不好了。

words.meaning: n.交通,交通量
words.example:
There was heavy/a lot of traffic on the roads this morning.  今晨道路上车流量很大。
We got stuck in traffic for several hours.  我们碰上交通阻塞，被堵了好几个小时。
New measures have been introduced to try and ease traffic congestion in the city.  这个城市已经采取了新措施，试图缓解交通挤塞。

words.meaning: v.(to)更喜欢,宁愿
words.example:
Do you prefer hot or cold weather?  你喜欢热天还是冷天？
formal I'd prefer you not to smoke (= I would like it better if you did not smoke) , please.  我希望你别抽烟。UK US (-rr-)
The police have decided not to prefer charges against them because of insufficient evidence.  由于证据不足，警方决定不对他们提出诉讼。UK US (-rr-)

words.meaning: ad.真正地；忠实地
words.example:
At this time of year the river is a truly beautiful sight.  每年的这个时候，这条河的景色确实很美。
She was a truly great actress.  她确实是一名很了不起的演员。
This is a truly remarkable achievement.  这是一项真正令人惊叹的成就。

words.meaning: n.地球;陆地;泥土,土壤;尘世,人间
words.example:
The Earth takes approximately 365 1 4 days to go round the Sun.  地球围绕太阳运转一周大约需要365又1/4天
The Circus has been described as the greatest show on Earth (= in the world).  这个马戏团被誉为是全世界最棒的。UK noun
The ploughed earth looked rich and dark and fertile.  耕过的土地看起来黑油油的，非常肥沃。UK noun

words.meaning: n.胸腔,胸膛;箱,柜
words.example:
He was shot in the chest at point blank range.  他被近距离射中胸部。
He folded his arms across his chest.  他双臂交叉放在胸前。
His shirt was open to the waist revealing a very hairy chest.  他的衬衫敞开到腰部，露出毛茸茸的胸膛。

words.meaning: a.厚的,粗的,稠的,浓的 ad.厚,浓,密
words.example: The dictionary is very thick.  这本词典很厚。

words.meaning: n.现金,现款 v.兑现,付(或收)现款
words.example:
Do you have any cash on you?  你身上有现金吗？
Will you pay by credit card or in cash?  你是刷信用卡还是付现金？
He says he wants cash in advance before he'll do the job.  他说他要先拿到预付现金才肯工作。

words.meaning: n.博物馆,展览馆
words.example: a museum of modern art  现代艺术博物馆

words.meaning: n.美,美丽;美人,美丽的事物
words.example:
This is an area of outstanding natural beauty.  这个地方的风景优美，浑然天成。
The piece of music he played had a haunting beauty.  他演奏的这首乐曲优美动听，教人久久不能忘怀。
She was a great beauty (= a beautiful woman) when she was young.  她年轻时是个大美人。

words.meaning: n.紧急情况,突然事件,非常时刻
words.example:
How would disabled people escape in an emergency?  如果发生紧急情况，伤残人士如何逃离？
Is the emergency exit suitable for wheelchairs?  安全出口适合轮椅通行吗？
The pilot of the aircraft was forced to make an emergency landing on Lake Geneva.  这架飞机的驾驶员不得不在日内瓦湖面上紧急迫降。

words.meaning: a.唯一的,独一无二的
words.example:
Each person's genetic code is unique except in the case of identical twins.  每个人的遗传密码都是独一无二的，同卵双胞胎除外。
I'd recognise your handwriting anywhere - it's unique.  无论在哪里，我都能认出你的笔迹——它太与众不同了。
Do not miss this unique opportunity to buy all six pans at half the recommended price.  购买全部六个平底锅只需半价——不要错过这难得的机会。

words.meaning: v.连接,联系 n.环节,链环
words.example: This link leads to the article.  这个链接通向那篇文章。

words.meaning: n.压力;重要性;应力;重音vt.强调,重读
words.example:
People under a lot of stress may experience headaches, minor pains and sleeping difficulties.  压力大的人可能会出现头痛、轻微疼痛和睡眠障碍。
Yoga is a very effective technique for combating stress.  练瑜伽是舒缓压力非常有效的方法。
The meaning of a sentence often depends on stress and intonation.  句子的意思常常取决于重音和语调。

words.meaning: n.容量,内容,(pl.)目录 a.(with)满足的
words.example:
He seems fairly content with (his) life.  他好像对生活相当满足。
Not content with having upset my parents, he then insulted my sister!  他惹得我父母生气还不够，又欺辱我姐姐！noun UK SUBJECT  主题
It's a very stylish and beautiful film, but it lacks content.  这出电影很新潮而且画面美丽，但内容空洞。

words.meaning: v.选择,挑选 a.精选的,选择的
words.example:
There was a choice of four prizes, and the winner could select one of them.  有四种奖品可供选择，获胜者可以从中挑选一个。
How do you select people for promotion?  你如何选拔晋升者?
formal The supermarket's policy is to select out (= choose) the best fruit and discard the rest.  这家超市的原则就是挑选最好的水果，其余的就丢掉。adjective

words.meaning: n.根,根部;根本,根源 v.(使)生根,(使)扎根
words.example:
We must get to the root of (= discover the cause of) this problem.  我们一定要探本溯源，查出造成这个问题的原因。
What is/lies at the root of the problem is their lack of interest.  这一问题的根本原因是他们缺乏兴趣。
The high crime rate has its roots in unemployment and poverty.  高犯罪率的根源在于失业和贫穷。

words.meaning: n.鼻子;(飞机,船等的)前端,突出部分
words.example:
I've got a sore throat and a runny nose (= liquid coming out of the nose).  我喉咙痛，还流鼻涕。
Come on now, stop crying - blow your nose on my hankie.  好了，别哭了——用我的手帕擤擤鼻涕。
The symbol was painted on each side of the plane's nose.  飞机机头两侧都绘有这标志。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.宣布,宣告,声明;断言,宣称
words.example:
America declared war on Japan in 1941 (= announced officially that it was at war).  美国在1941对日本宣战。
figurative The government have declared war on (= publicly announced their opposition to) the drug dealers.  政府已对贩毒者宣战。
The country declared independence in 1952 (= announced that it was no longer under the control of another country).  该国于1952年宣布独立。

words.meaning: vt.为...表示感激,感谢;欣赏,赏识,评价
words.example:
There's no point buying him expensive wines - he doesn't appreciate them.  给他买名贵的酒没有用——他不懂品酒。
We appreciate the need for immediate action.  我们充分意识到了马上采取行动的必要性。
We really appreciate all the help you gave us last weekend.  上周末得到你们的大力帮助，我们非常感谢。

words.meaning: a.实际的;现实的,真实的,目前的
words.example:
We had estimated about 300 visitors, but the actual number was much higher.  我们估计大约会有300名来宾，可实际人数要多得多。
The exams are in July, but the actual results (= the results themselves) don't appear until September.  考试是在七月份，但是真正成绩要到九月份才公布。

words.meaning: n.瓶(子) v.装瓶
words.example:
Plastic bottles are lighter than glass ones.  塑胶瓶比玻璃瓶轻。
Give the baby her bottle when she wakes up.  婴儿醒来时用奶瓶给她喂奶。
Most medical experts believe that breast-feeding is better than bottle -feeding.  大多数医疗专家认为，母乳喂养比人工喂养好。UK noun

words.meaning: ad.几乎不,简直不;仅仅
words.example:
The party had hardly started when she left.  她离开的时候派对才刚刚开始。
He hardly ate anything/He ate hardly anything.  他几乎甚么都没吃。
We hardly ever (= almost never) go to concerts.  我们几乎从不去听音乐会。

words.meaning: n.锉刀;文件,档案 v.锉
words.example:
You'll find it in the files under 'C'.  你会在标着C字母的资料夹里找到它。
We keep your records on file for five years.  我们把你的纪录归档保存五年。noun
The police have opened a file on local burglaries.  警方已为当地的入室行窃案设立了档案。noun

words.meaning: a.有病的,患病的;恶心的,想吐的
words.example:
My father has been off sick (= not working because of illness) for a long time.  因为生病，我父亲已经很久没有去上班了。
Anyone who could hurt a child like that must be sick (= mentally ill).  那样伤害孩子的人，脑子一定有毛病。
The old woman fell/took/was taken sick (= became ill) while she was away and had to come home.  那个老妇人出门在外时生病了，不得不回家。

words.meaning: n.结果,成果
words.example: It's too early to predict the outcome of the meeting.  现在预言会议的结果还言之尚早。

words.meaning: n.广告
words.example: in 1215 AD/AD 1215  在西元1215年

words.meaning: v.防守,保卫;为…辩护,为…答辩
words.example:
How can we defend our homeland if we don't have an army?  如果没有军队，我们怎能保护我们的家园？
White blood cells help defend the body against infection.  白细胞有助于保护身体免受感染。
They are fighting to defend their beliefs/interests/rights.  他们在为为捍卫自己的信仰／利益／权利而战。

words.meaning: n.义务,责任;职务;税
words.example:
The duty of the agency is to act in the best interests of the child.  这个机构的责任就是为孩子谋取最大利益。
You have a duty to yourself to take a holiday now and then.  偶尔你该给自己放个假。
He only went to see her out of duty (= because he thought he should).  他去看她只是出于义务。

words.meaning: n.被单;(一)张,(一)片,薄片;大片
words.example:
I've put clean sheets on the bed.  我已经给床铺上了干净的床单。
They fixed a polythene/plastic sheet over the broken window.  他们在破损的窗户上补上了一块聚乙烯／塑胶纸。
The application form was a single sheet of paper.  申请表是单张纸的。

words.meaning: aux.应该(使用时,之后应接to,再接动词原形)
words.example:
We ought not/oughtn't to have agreed without knowing what it would cost.  不知道它的费用，我们本不应该同意的。
He ought to be home by seven o'clock.  七时前他应该到家了。
They ought to have arrived at lunchtime but the flight was delayed.  他们本该在午饭时到达，可是航班延误了。

words.meaning: a.天主教的 n.天主教徒
words.example:
Is he (a) Catholic?  他是天主教徒吗？
As a young person he had more catholic tastes than he does now.  他年轻的时候兴趣比现在要广泛得多。

words.meaning: n.组成部分,成分,元件 a.组成的,合成的
words.example:
The factory supplies electrical components for cars.  这家工厂供应汽车电器零件。
The course has four main components: business law, finance, computing and management skills.  这门课由四大部分组成：商业法、金融、电脑操作和管理技巧。
Fresh fruit and vegetables are an essential component of a healthy diet.  新鲜水果和蔬菜是健康饮食的一个基本要素。

words.meaning: v.使混合;混淆
words.example:
Oil and water don't mix. Even if you shake them together they separate into two layers.  油与水不相融。即使你将其混在一起摇晃，它们也会分为两层。
Radioactive material was mixed in/up (with) the effluent.  放射性物质被混入废水中。
Mix the eggs into the flour.  在面粉里加入鸡蛋混和。

words.meaning: a.慢的,不活跃的 v.(down)(使)放慢,减速
words.example:
She's a very slow eater.  她吃饭很慢。
We're making slow but steady progress with the decorating.  我们的装修进度缓慢但很顺利。
The government was very slow to react to the problem.  政府对这一问题反应迟缓。

words.meaning: n.地区,区域 v.分区,划分地带
words.example:
He was charged with driving 75 mph in a 55 mph zone.  他被指控在限速55英里的区域内驾车时速达到75英里。
This stretch of coast has been designated a danger zone.  这段海岸已被划定为危险地带。
The UN Security Council has established a no-fly zone (= one into which aircraft are not permitted to fly).  联合国安全理事会设定了一处禁飞区。

words.meaning: v.醒来,唤醒;使觉醒,激发,引起
words.example:
Did you wake at all during the night?  夜里你一点都没醒吗？
Please wake me early tomorrow.  明天请早点叫醒我。
Jane's hand on my shoulder woke me out of/from a bad dream.  简的手放在我肩上，把我从噩梦中摇醒。verb intransitive or transitive (woke or waked, woken or waked or US ALSO woke)    (also wake up) US ALSO

words.meaning: n.机场,航空站,航空港
words.example: an international airport  国际机场

words.meaning: n./a.褐色(的),棕色(的)
words.example:
Both my parents have curly brown hair.  我的父母都有一头棕色的鬈发。verb intransitive or transitive
Lightly brown the onion before adding the tomatoes.  加番茄之前先把洋葱炒至略呈褐色。
Allow the meat to brown before adding the vegetables.  把肉炒成褐色再加蔬菜。

words.meaning: n.衬衫
words.example:
You've spilled something down your shirt front.  你把甚么东西洒在衬衫前襟上了。
Keep your shirt on! Your car isn't badly damaged!  别生气！你的车受损不严重！UK noun countable
I'd put my shirt on the President being re-elected.  我肯定总统会再次当选。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.飞行员;领港员 v.驾驶(飞机等);领航,引水
words.example:
If you'd seen the pilot, you'd know why they decided not to make a complete series of programmes!  如果你看了试播节目的话，就会明白他们为甚么决定不制作整套节目了。noun countable
If the UKpilot scheme / USpilot program is successful many more homes will be offered the new television service.  如果试验计划成功，会有越来越多的家庭享受到新的电视服务。verb
She piloted the aircraft to safety after one of the engines failed.  其中一个引擎发生故障后，她把飞机驾驶到安全的地方。verb

words.meaning: vt.警告 vi.发出警告
words.example:
There were signs warning of fog as soon as we got onto the motorway.  我们一上高速公路，就看到有“大雾”的警示牌。
This particular curry is extremely hot - be warned!  这种特别的咖哩食品极辣——小心食用！
Put that ball down and come over here, Laura - I'm warning you (= I will punish you if you do not) !  放下那个球到这里来，萝拉——我是在警告你！

words.meaning: n.猫;猫科动物;
words.example:
As kids we used to fight like cat and dog.  小时候，我们总是吵吵闹闹的。noun countable
What's the matter? Has the cat got your tongue?  你怎么了？为甚么不吭声？noun countable
They haven't a cat in hell's chance of getting over the mountain in weather like this.  天气如此，他们根本不可能翻越这座山。noun countable

words.meaning: n.贡献;捐款,捐献物;投稿
words.example:
All contributions (= presents of money) , no matter how small, will be much appreciated.  所有捐款，无论多少，我们都深表感谢。
All contributions (= articles to be printed) for the school magazine must be received by August 1st.  投给校刊的所有稿件截止到8月1日。
This invention made a major contribution to road safety.  这项发明对道路安全作出了卓越贡献。

words.meaning: pron.[反身代词]我们自己;我们亲自
words.example:
We promised ourselves a good holiday this year.  我们给自己许下诺言，今年要好好度个假。
Will we be able to do it ourselves or will we need help?  我们自己能做呢，还是需要有人帮忙？
It's a big garden, but we do all the gardening (by) ourselves (= without other people's help).  花园很大，但所有的园艺工作都由我们自己做。

words.meaning: n.领路人;指南,导游 v.领路;指导;支配;管理
words.example:
We hired a guide to take us up into the mountains.  我们雇了一个向导带我们进入山区。
Let your conscience be your guide.  凭你的良心办事。verb
Our lawyer guided us through the more complicated questions on the form.  我们的律师指导我们答完表格中较为复杂的问题。verb

words.meaning: n.情况，条件；境遇
words.example:
Obviously we can't deal with the problem until we know all the circumstances.  显然，我们只有在了解全部情况后才能处理这个问题。
She died in suspicious circumstances.  她死得很蹊跷。
We oppose capital punishment in/under any circumstances.  无论在甚么情况下，我们都不赞成死刑。

words.meaning: n.雪,下雪 vi.下雪;如雪一般地落下
words.example:
Outside the snow began to fall.  外面开始下雪了。
Let's go and play in the snow!  我们一起去玩雪吧！
Her hair was jet-black, her lips ruby-red and her skin as white as snow.  她头发乌黑，嘴唇红润如宝石，肌肤洁白如雪。

words.meaning: n.政治家,政客
words.example: a distinguished/disgraced politician  著名／失势的政治家

words.meaning: v.偷,窃取;偷偷地做,巧取
words.example:
She admitted stealing the money from her employers.  她承认偷了雇主的钱。
The number of cars which are stolen every year has risen.  每年失窃车辆的数量都在上升。
They were so poor they had to steal in order to eat.  他们非常穷，为了填饱肚子只得去行窃。verb intransitive or transitive (stole, stolen)

words.meaning: v.滑,滑倒;滑掉;溜走n.疏忽,小错,口误,笔误
words.example:
She slipped on the ice.  她在冰上滑倒了。
Careful you don't slip - there's water on the floor.  小心别滑倒了——地板上有水。
The razor slipped while he was shaving and he cut himself.  他刮胡子时刮须刀一滑，把自己划伤了。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.百分数,百分率,百分比
words.example:
What percentage of women return to work after having a baby?  生完小孩后继续工作的女性占多大比例？
Interest rates have risen by two percentage points.  利率上升了两个百分点。UK noun
There's no percentage in working such long hours.  这样加班超时地工作可没有甚么好处。

words.meaning: n.(食用)肉类
words.example: It was a nicely written article and quite amusing but there wasn't much meat to it.  这是篇文笔优美又饶有趣味的文章，但没甚么实质内容。noun

words.meaning: a.滑稽的,可笑的
words.example:
Do you know any funny jokes?  你知道甚么有趣的笑话吗？
I've never found Charlie Chaplin very funny.  我从来都不觉得查理‧卓别林很滑稽。
It's a really funny film.  这真是场滑稽的电影。

words.meaning: a.两者都不 pron.两者都不 ad.也不
words.example:
We've got two TVs, but neither works properly.  我们有两台电视，但没有一台是好的。
Neither of my parents likes my boyfriend.  我父母都不喜欢我的男朋友。
Neither one of us is particularly interested in gardening.  我们两个都不太喜欢园艺。

words.meaning: n.泥土,土地,土壤 v.弄脏,(使)变脏
words.example:
It was the first time we had set foot on foreign/French/American soil (= gone to a foreign country/France/America).  那是我们第一次踏上异国／法国／美国的土地。
The government is trying to encourage a return to the soil.  政府试图鼓励人们重新务农。verb transitive formal
These were top lawyers, the kind who wouldn't normally soil their hands with police work or criminal law.  这些是顶级律师，他们一般不会插手警务和触犯刑法。

words.meaning: a.正确的,恰当的,端正的 v.改正,纠正,矫正
words.example:
It 's not correct to describe them as 'students'.  把他们说成学生不确切。
He's very correct in his dress/speech/manner, isn't he?  他穿着／谈吐／举止很得体，是不是？verb transitive
Students said it was helpful if the teacher corrected their pronunciation.  学生们说老师纠正他们的发音错误会对他们很有帮助。

words.meaning: v.责备;怪,把…归咎于 n.责任,过错;责备
words.example:
Don't blame me (= It is not my fault) if you miss the bus!  如果你没赶上车可别怪我！
Hugh blames his mother for his lack of confidence.  晓治把自己缺乏自信心归咎于他的母亲。
Hugh blames his lack of confidence on his mother.  晓治把自己缺乏自信心归咎于他的母亲。

words.meaning: a.(to)应支付的;(车,船等)预定应到达的
words.example:
What time is the next bus due?  下一班公车甚么时候来？
The next meeting is due to be held in three months' time.  下次会议预计将在三个月后召开。
Their first baby is due in January.  他们的第一个孩子预产期在一月份。

words.meaning: n.篮球,篮球运动
words.example: Our team won the basketball game.  我们队赢了篮球赛。

words.meaning: n.高尔夫球
words.example: We often play a round (= game) of golf at the weekend.  我们经常在周末打一场高尔夫球。

words.meaning: a.疯狂的,古怪的,蠢的;(about)狂热的
words.example:
It's a crazy idea.  这是个荒唐的想法。
You're crazy to buy a house without seeing it.  看都没看就买下一所房子，你真荒唐。
The constant noise drove me crazy (= made me become angry).  吵声不断简直要把我逼疯了。adjective

words.meaning: n.链(条);(pl.)镣铐;一连串 v.用链条拴住
words.example:
She has built up a chain of 180 bookshops across the country.  她在全国各地开了180家连锁书店。
We witnessed a remarkable chain of events in eastern Europe in 1989.  我们目睹了1989年发生在东欧的一连串不寻常事件。noun
The gates were locked with a padlock and a heavy steel chain.  大门被一把挂锁和一根沉重的钢链锁着。

words.meaning: n.(树)条,分支;分店;(学科)分科,部门;支流
words.example:
Immunology is a branch of biological science.  免疫学是生物科学的一个分支。
One branch of their family (= One group of relatives) emigrated to Brazil.  他们家族的一支移居到了巴西。
In the US, the president is part of the executive branch of the government.  在美国，总统是政府行政分支的一部分。

words.meaning: n.(痛苦等)减轻,解除;援救,救济
words.example:
After the exam, I felt an incredible sense of relief.  考试过后，我感到轻松无比。
Pop stars have raised millions of pounds for famine relief in Africa.  流行歌星们已经筹集了数百万英镑的善款救济非洲饥民。noun
Coins have pictures on them in relief.  硬币上面有浮雕图案。

words.meaning: n.用户，使用者
words.example: Unemployed people are the main users of this advice centre.  失业人员是这个咨询中心的主要客户。

words.meaning: n. 爸爸；爹爹；n. (Dad)人名；(孟、巴基、阿富)达德；(泰)达
words.example:
It was lovely to see your mum and dad at the school concert last night.  很高兴昨天晚上在学校音乐会上见到你爸妈。
[as form of address] Can you give me a lift back from the cinema tonight, Dad?  爸，今天晚上能不能顺便开车把我从戏院送回家？

words.meaning: n./v.踢
words.example:
He was accused of kicking a man in the face.  他被控踢到他人的脸。
She felt the baby kicking inside her.  她感觉到腹中的胎儿在踢她。
When I realized what I'd done I could have kicked myself.  当我意识到自已的所作所为，不禁懊恼不已。

words.meaning: n.方式;举止;(pl.)风度,礼貌;规矩;风俗
words.example:
She stared at me in an accusing manner.  她以责备的目光注视着我。
He was elected in the normal manner.  他依正常程式当选。
It was the manner of her death that stuck in the public's mind.  她的死亡方式使公众很受触动。

words.meaning: a.古代的,古老的,古式的
words.example:
People have lived in this valley since ancient times.  人们自古就居住在这个山谷里。
History, ancient and modern , has taught these people an intense distrust of their neighbours.  古今历史向这些人灌输了对其邻国极度不信任的思想。
He's got an ancient computer.  他有一台老掉牙的电脑。

words.meaning: n.寂静,沉默 v.使沉默,使安静
words.example:
Silence reigned (= There was complete silence) in the church.  教堂里一片寂静。noun
The soldiers listened in silence as their captain gave the orders.  指挥官下达命令时，士兵们静静地听着。
"Silence (= Stop talking) " shouted the teacher.  “安静！”老师喊道。

words.meaning: a.金黄色的;贵重的,极好的
words.example: He's got a place at university which gives him a golden opportunity to do research in the subject which interests him.  他在大学里获得了一个职位，这为他研究自己感兴趣的课题提供了绝佳的机会。

words.meaning: n.费(会费,学费等);酬金
words.example: We couldn't pay the lawyer's fee.  我们付不起律师费。

words.meaning: vi.过去常常
words.example:
She used to live in Glasgow.  她曾在格拉斯哥住过。
She used to love cats but one attacked her and she doesn't like them anymore.  她过去很喜欢猫，但自从被一只猫袭击过后，就再也不喜欢猫了。
You don't come and see me like you used to.  你们不像过去那样经常来看我了。

words.meaning: n.碗(状物),钵
words.example:
She eats a bowl (= the contents of a bowl) of cereal every morning.  她每天早上吃一碗麦片。
Sift the flour and baking powder into a mixing bowl.  将面粉和发酵粉筛进搅拌碗里。
The toilet bowl was cracked and stained, and the walls were covered in mould.  抽水马桶破裂了，污迹斑斑，四周墙上到处都是霉点。

words.meaning: a.相等的;胜任的n.相等的事务;对手v.等于
words.example:
All people are equal, deserving the same rights as each other.  所有人都是平等的，享有同等的权利。
They've got a long way to go before they achieve equal pay/status for men and women.  要实现男女同工同酬／地位平等，他们仍有很长的路要走。
One litre is equal to 1.76 imperial pints.  1升等于1.76 英制品脱。

words.meaning: a.(of)典型的,有代表性的
words.example:
This sort of hot and spicy food is very typical of the food in the south of the country.  这种辛辣食品是该国南部具代表性的食物。
Typical symptoms would include severe headaches, vomiting and dizziness.  典型的症状包括剧烈的头痛、呕吐和眩晕。
It's just typical of Ian to spend all that money on the equipment and then lose interest half way through the course.  伊恩就是这种人，先把所有钱花在买装备上，中途又失去兴趣。

words.meaning: prep.除…之外 v.除外;反对
words.example: Everyone was late except Lily.  除了莉莉，所有人都迟到了。

words.meaning: a.保守的,守旧的 n.保守主义者
words.example:
Did you vote Conservative at the last election?  上次选举你投的是保守党的票吗？
Older people tend to be quite conservative and a bit suspicious of any supposed advances.  上年纪的人往往很保守，对任何所谓的进步都有些怀疑。    Compare liberal
He's a very conservative dresser - he always looks like he's wearing his father's clothes!  他穿着十分保守——看上去总像是穿着他父亲的衣服！UK adjective

words.meaning: n.主人;旅店老板;节目主持人;一大群,许多
words.example:
We thanked our hosts for the lovely evening.  我们感谢主人家让我们渡过了一个愉快的夜晚。
The local language school is advertising for host families (= families with whom people stay when they are visiting another country).  当地的语言学校正在招募能接待外国访客的家庭。UK noun
Our host for tonight's show is Terry Wogan.  我们今晚节目的主持人是泰瑞‧沃根。UK noun

words.meaning: n.礼堂,会堂,办公大楼,门厅
words.example:
I'm playing in a concert at the village/church hall.  我将在村里的礼堂／教堂大厅所举行的音乐会参与演奏。UK noun countable
I've left my bags in the hall.  我把书包掉在大厅里了。

words.meaning: vt.信任;盼望;委托 n.(in)信任,依赖;委托
words.example:
My sister warned me not to trust him.  我姐姐告诫我不要相信他。
Trust me - I know about these things.  相信我——我了解这些东西。
Trust your instincts and do what you think is right.  相信你的直觉，做你认为正确的事情。

words.meaning: n.海洋
words.example:
These mysterious creatures live at the bottom of the ocean.  这些神秘的生物居住在海底。
We've got oceans of time.  我们的时间很多。

words.meaning: n.(一)排,(一)行;吵嚷 v.划(船等),荡桨
words.example:
We had seats in the front/back row of the theatre.  我们坐在剧场前／后排。
She's been voted Best Actress three years in a row.  她已经连续三年当选为最佳女演员。
They've gone for a row to the island.  他们划船去那个岛了。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.担负得起(损失、费用、后果等),买得起
words.example:
Few people are able to afford cars like that.  很少人买得起那样的车。
She couldn't afford the time off work to see him.  她工作太忙，抽不出时间去看他。
The hut afforded little protection from the elements.  这间棚屋几乎不能遮风挡雨。

words.meaning: n.其时,其间 ad.当时,与此同时
words.example: Carl's starting college in September. Meanwhile, he's travelling around Europe.  卡尔九月将开始大学生活。此间他正在环游欧洲。

words.meaning: n.分,分割;部门,科,处;除法;分界线
words.example:
Norwich are currently top of Division one.  诺里奇队目前在第一组中居于首位。noun
Disagreements about defence cuts have opened up deep divisions within the military.  在削减国防开支问题上的看法不一导致军方内部出现了严重的分歧。
Division within the party will limit its chances at the election.  内讧将会降低该党在选举中获胜的机会。

words.meaning: v.使更坚固,使更坚定;(进一步)证实;确认
words.example:
Flights should be confirmed 48 hours before departure.  应该在起飞前48小时确认航班。
I've accepted the job over the phone, but I haven't confirmed in writing yet.  我已在电话中接受了这份工作，但还没有书面确认。UK verb
The leader's speech was impressive and confirmed her faith in the party.  这位领导人的讲话令人难忘，坚定了她对该党的信心。UK verb

words.meaning: v.(使)固定;修理;安装;决定;注视 n.困境
words.example:
They couldn't fix my old computer, so I bought a new one.  他们修不好我的旧电脑了，所以我买了台新的。verb
Shall we fix a time for our next meeting?  我们确定一下下次会议的时间吧？
We fixed the bookcase to the wall.  我们把书架固定在墙上。verb

words.meaning: vi.呼吁,恳求;申诉 n.呼吁;申诉;吸引力
words.example:
They're launching (= starting) an appeal to raise money for famine victims.  他们正在呼吁社会为饥民捐款。
The case went to the court of appeal/the appeal court.  案件被提交到上诉法院。
He won his appeal and the sentence was halved.  他上诉获胜，刑期减半。

words.meaning: n.镜子;反映,反射 v.反映,反射
words.example:
She was looking at her reflection in the mirror.  她正看着自己在镜中的影像。UK noun
The movie is a mirror of daily life in wartime Britain.  这部电影真实地反映了英国人在战时的日常生活。UK verb transitive
Our newspaper aims to mirror the opinions of ordinary people.  我们的报纸旨在反映普通民众的意见。

words.meaning: n.(pl.teeth)牙齿;齿状物;
words.example:
Brush/Clean your teeth thoroughly morning and night.  早晚要好好刷牙。
This committee can make recommendations but it has no real teeth.  这个委员会可以提出建议，但没有实权。 (plural teeth)
We fought tooth and nail to get the route of the new road changed.  我们奋力抗争，争取改变新修道路的路线。 (plural teeth)

words.meaning: a.漂亮的;聪明的;巧妙的 v.剧痛,刺疼
words.example:
Guy looks very smart in his new suit, doesn't he?  盖伊穿上新西装显得精神十足，不是吗？
She works in a very smart new office overlooking the River Cam.  她在一间非常漂亮的新办公室里工作，从那里可以俯瞰康河。
We went to a very smart party on New Year's Eve.  除夕我们去参加了一个非常时尚的派对。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.长,长度;一段,一节,程度,范围
words.example:
The boat is ten metres in length.  这条船长十米。
The length of the bay is approximately 200 miles.  海湾的长度约为200英里。
She planted rose bushes (along) the length of the garden (= the whole distance along it).  她把花园的四周都种上了玫瑰花丛。

words.meaning: v.(on)依赖,依靠;信赖,信任
words.example: British weather can never be relied on - it's always changing.  英国的天气向来靠不住——它总是变幻无常。

words.meaning: n.话题,主题,题目
words.example: Our discussion ranged over various topics, such as acid rain and the hole in the ozone layer.  我们的讨论涉及各种话题，例如酸雨和臭氧层空洞。

words.meaning: n.电话,电话机 v.打电话
words.example: Answer the telephone, please.  请接一下电话。

words.meaning: vt.引起的注意(或兴趣等),吸引;引起;激起
words.example:
These flowers are brightly coloured in order to attract butterflies.  这些花朵都有着鲜艳的色彩以便能够吸引蝴蝶。
The circus is attracting huge crowds/audiences.  马戏团吸引了大批的观众。
Magnets attract iron filings.  磁铁吸铁屑。

words.meaning: n. 卧室；adj. 两性关系的；城郊住宅区的
words.example:
Our home has three bedrooms.  我们家有三间卧房。adjective [before noun]
My dad was embarrassed by the bedroom scenes in the play.  剧中的性爱场面令我爸爸感到尴尬。
He has bedroom eyes (= looks as if he is interested in sex).  他有一双色迷迷的眼睛。

words.meaning: a.秘密的,机密的 n.秘密
words.example:
Why did you have to go and tell Bob about my illness? You just can't keep a secret, can you?  你为甚么一定要跑去把我生病的事告诉鲍勃？你就是不能保守秘密，是吗？
Aren't you going to let me in on (= tell me) the secret?  难道你不打算告诉我这个秘密？
There's no secret (= everyone knows) about his homosexuality.  他是同性恋，这已不是秘密了。

words.meaning: n.债,债务
words.example:
He managed to pay off his debts in two years.  他设法在两年内还清债务。
The firm ran up huge debts.  公司很快就负债累累。
They are in debt to (= owe money to) the bank.  他们欠银行的钱。

words.meaning: a.稀有的,难得的,珍奇的;稀薄的,稀疏的
words.example:
The museum is full of rare and precious treasures.  这所博物馆里收藏的满是奇珍异宝。
a rare occasion/opportunity/visit/treat, etc.  难得的时机／机会／探访／款待等
It's very rare to find someone who combines such qualities.  同时具有这些素质的人非常罕见。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.罐,槽,箱;坦克 vt.储于槽中
words.example: a water tank  水箱

words.meaning: n.护士,保姆 v.护理,看护
words.example:
He worked as a nurse in a psychiatric hospital.  他在精神病院当护士。
Nurse Millard will be with you shortly.  米勒德护士很快会来照顾你。
[as form of address] Thank you, Nurse.  谢谢你，护士。

words.meaning: ad.在旁边,到一边 n.旁白;离题的话
words.example:
Stand aside, please, and let these people pass.  请往边上站一站，让这些人过去。
He pulled the curtain aside.  他把窗帘拉开。
I've forgotten my cheque book, so could you put this book aside (= keep this book) for me and I'll come back later on.  我忘了带支票簿，麻烦你把这本书替我留一下，我稍后再来买。

words.meaning: ad.无论哪里;(用于否定、疑问等)任何地方
words.example: I've been sorting out my study all day, but it's such a mess I don't feel I'm getting anywhere.  我一整天都在整理书房，但是里面太乱了，我觉得忙来忙去还是没甚么头绪。

words.meaning: n.结合(物),粘结(剂),联结;公债,债券,契约
words.example:
There has been a close bond between them ever since she saved him from drowning.  他溺水被她救了以后他们之间一直来往密切。
In societies with strong family bonds (= relationships) , people tend to live longer.  在家庭关系牢固的社会中，人们的寿命往往更长。UK noun
They have entered into a solemn bond.  他们已经缔结了一项正式契约。

words.meaning: n.愉快,快乐;乐事,乐趣
words.example:
His visits gave his grandparents such pleasure.  他来探望爷爷奶奶，这让他们非常开心。
Why do so many boys take pleasure in torturing insects and small animals.  为甚么有这么多的男孩子喜欢以虐待昆虫和小动物为乐？
He wrote an article on the pleasures and pains of camping.  他写了一篇关于露营甘苦的文章。

words.meaning: n.男主人;师傅;硕士 v.精通,控制 a.主要的
words.example:
With careful training, a dog will obey its master completely.  经过精心训练的狗会完全服从主人的命令。
He was a master of disguise.  他是个伪装大师。
This painting is clearly the work of a master.  这幅画显然是名家的作品。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(for)需要,需要的东西,要求
words.example: Students who fail to meet the requirements (of the course) will fail.  达不到（本门课程）要求的学生将不能及格。

words.meaning: n.玩笑,娱乐;有趣的人(或事物)
words.example:
Have fun (= Enjoy yourself) !  玩个痛快！
Having fun (= Are you enjoying yourself) ?  玩得痛快吗？
She's great fun to be with.  跟她在一起你会觉得很有意思。

words.meaning: n.预期,期望,指望
words.example:
The holiday lived up to all our expectations (= was as good as we were expecting).  假期过得一点也没有令我们失望。
We did so well - beyond all (= better than) our expectations.  我们做得非常好——远远超出我们的预期。
Considering the injuries he's had there can be little expectation of him winning the race.  考虑到他的伤势，他赢这场比赛的希望不大。

words.meaning: n.翅,翅膀;翼,机翼;派别 vt.装以翼
words.example:
She walked in the hills, letting her thoughts take wing.  她走在山坡上，任思绪自由飞扬。
The president is on the left/right wing of the Democratic party.  总统属于民主党左翼／右翼。noun countable
The maternity ward will be in the new wing of the hospital.  产科病房将设在医院新建的一侧。

words.meaning: a.(from)分离的,分开的
words.example:
The art department and the main college are in two separate buildings.  艺术系和主要的学院在两座独立的大楼中。
Three youths have been shot and killed in separate incidents this month.  这个月有三名年轻人在不同的事件中被枪杀。adjective UK go your (own) separate ways
In 1983 the group disbanded and went their separate ways.  1983年乐队解散，成员各奔东西。verb UK  ESSENTIAL  intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: v.灌注, 倾泻, 涌入, 流, 倾盆大雨
words.example:
Pour the honey into the bowl and mix it thoroughly with the other ingredients.  把蜂蜜倒进碗里，让它和其他原料充分混合。
Would you like to pour (= pour a drink into a glass or cup) while I open some bags of nuts?  我开几袋坚果，你倒饮料好吗？UK verb
The bus was pouring out thick black exhaust fumes.  公共汽车在排出大量浑浊的黑色废气。

words.meaning: n. 判断；裁判；判决书；辨别力
words.example:
I'm going to reserve judgment (on the decision) (= not say whether I think it is good or bad) for the time being.  我将暂时（对这项决定）保留看法。
It proved difficult to come to/form/make a judgment about how well the school was performing.  事实证明要判断这所学校的运作情形是很难的。
In my judgment, we should let the solicitor deal with this.  在我看来，我们该让律师处理此事。(also judgement) ['dʒʌdʒ.mənt]

words.meaning: n.啤酒
words.example:
He asked for a pint of beer.  他要了一品脱啤酒。
This beer is brewed in Mexico.  这种啤酒是在墨西哥酿制的。
After a hard day's work I enjoy a beer or two.  我喜欢在辛苦工作了一整天后，喝一两杯啤酒。

words.meaning: n.提及,涉及;参考,参考书目;证明书(人)
words.example:
Knowing what had happened, I avoided making any reference to (= mentioning) weddings.  因为我知道发生了甚么，所以就避开不谈婚礼的事情。
formal I am writing with/in reference to (= in connection with) your letter of 15 March.  现就3月15日贵函致覆。UK noun
In all future letters on this subject, please use/quote our reference JW/155/C/1991.  今后有关此事项的所有信件都请标明我方信函编号UK noun

words.meaning: n.(pl.)眼泪 vt.撕裂;使…分裂 vi.破裂
words.example:
You have to be very careful with books this old because the paper tends to tear very easily.  对这么旧的书你得格外小心，因为它的纸张很容易撕破。
He went tearing along the road after the bus.  他在路上飞奔追赶公车。UK verb (tore, torn)
She's been tearing her hair out over the final chapter of her novel for the last month.  一个月来，她绞尽脑汁构思小说的最后一章。UK verb (tore, torn)

words.meaning: n./v.怀疑,疑虑
words.example:
I'm having doubts about his ability to do the job.  我对他是否能胜任此项工作还有一些疑问。
If there's any doubt about the rocket's engines, we ought to cancel the launch.  如果对火箭引擎还存有任何疑虑，我们都应该取消此次发射。
The prosecution has to establish his guilt UK beyond (reasonable) doubt] US beyond a (reasonable) doubt.  此次起诉必须证明他所犯的罪行证据确凿。

words.meaning: n.部长,大臣
words.example:
formal The priest ministers to his flock (= the people who go to his church).  牧师对他的教徒给予关爱。
humorous I spent most of the morning ministering to my sick husband.  我上午的大部分时间都在照顾生病的丈夫。

words.meaning: n.英雄,勇士;男主角,男主人公
words.example: The hero in the film never gives up.  电影里的英雄从不放弃。

words.meaning: n.云(状物);遮暗物,阴影;一大群
words.example:
Do you think those are rain clouds on the horizon?  你看天边那些云是雨云吗？
The sky was a perfect blue - not a cloud in sight.  天空一片湛蓝——万里无云。
There was so much cloud, we couldn't see anything.  云层太厚，我们甚么也看不见。

words.meaning: n.获胜者，优胜者
words.example:
There'll be a prize for the winner.  获胜者将会得到奖品。
The winner of this match will play Violente in the semi-finals.  本场比赛的优胜者将与维奥兰特队在半决赛相遇。
And to find out who are the lucky winners of our competition, Samantha is going to draw some names out of the bag.  看看谁是我们竞赛中幸运的获胜者，萨曼莎将从袋子中抽出一些名字。

words.meaning: n.种子 v.播种;结实,结籽
words.example:
Sow the seeds (= put them in the ground) about 3 cm deep.  把这些种子种进约三厘米深的地方。
The chemical will stop all seeds from sprouting (= starting to grow).  这种化学制品可制止种子发芽。
The farmers grow these crops for seed (= for planting to grow more crops, rather than for eating).  农民种这些作物是为了育种。

words.meaning: n.胡椒粉,胡椒;辣椒
words.example:
Peppers are usually cooked with other vegetables or eaten raw in salads.  甜椒通常与其他蔬菜一同烹调，或放在沙拉里生吃。
Red peppers are ideal for roasting in the oven.  红椒很适合用烤箱烘烤来吃。UK verb
The city's walls were peppered with bullets.  城墙被子弹打得满目疮痍。

words.meaning: a.忙,忙碌的;热闹的,繁忙的;(电话)占线
words.example:
Mum was busy in the kitchen.  妈妈在厨房里忙着呢。
The kids are busy with their homework.  孩子们在忙着做家课。
She's busy writing out the wedding invitations.  她在忙着写婚礼请柬。

words.meaning: n.抄本,摹本;(一)本 vt.抄写;考试中抄袭
words.example:
They've copied the basic design from the Japanese model and added a few of their own refinements.  他们仿照日本模型的基本设计，又加上了一些自己的改良。
Patricia's going to copy her novel onto disk and send it to me.  帕特里夏打算把她的小说复制到磁片上寄给我。
He tends to copy his brother in the way he dresses.  他常常仿效哥哥的穿着。

words.meaning: n.尖端;末端;小费 n./v.轻击;倾斜;给小费
words.example:
The table tipped and all our drinks fell on the floor.  桌子翻了，结果我们的所有饮料都掉在地上。
If you put too many books on one end of the shelf, it'll tip up.  如果你在书架的一头放太多书，书架就会翻掉。
Don't tip your chair back like that, you'll fall.  不要那样向后仰椅子，你会翻倒的。

words.meaning: a.便宜的;低劣的,不值钱的
words.example:
Food is usually cheaper in supermarkets.  超市里的食物通常比较便宜。
Children and the elderly are entitled to cheap train tickets.  儿童和老人可以使用廉价火车票。
The scheme is simple and cheap to operate.  这个计划实施起来简单又省钱。

words.meaning: n.目的;瞄准 vi.(at)目的在于 vt.把…瞄准
words.example:
My main aim in life is to be a good husband and father.  我人生的主要目标是做一个好丈夫和好爸爸。
Our short-term aim is to deal with our current financial difficulties, but our long-term aim is to improve the company's profitability.  我们的短期目标是解决当前的财政困难，但长远目标是提高公司的盈利。
The leaflet has been produced with the aim of increasing public awareness of the disease.  印发该传单的目的是为了提高公众对这种疾病的认识。noun

words.meaning: n.福利;幸福;福利事业
words.example:
This national fund pays for welfare benefits such as unemployment and sickness pay.  此项国家基金提供多项福利救济，例如失业和医疗等。
The police are very concerned for the welfare of the missing child.  警方非常担心失踪儿童的安危。
These organizations have fought very hard for the rights and welfare of immigrants.  这些机构竭力为移民争取权利和福利。

words.meaning: n.植物；蔬菜
words.example:
The potato is the most popular vegetable in Britain.  在英国，马铃薯是最受欢迎的蔬菜。
In the winter we tend to eat more root vegetables, such as carrots and parsnips.  冬天我们往往会吃更多根茎蔬菜，比如胡萝卜和欧洲萝卜。
Raw vegetables contain more potassium than cooked ones.  生的蔬菜中所含的钾元素比煮熟后的要多。

words.meaning: a.灰色的 n.灰色
words.example: He has gray hair now.  他现在头发花白了。

words.meaning: n.碟子,盘子,菜肴
words.example:
Have you done/washed the dishes?  你洗完餐具没有？noun
He's gorgeous - what a dish!  他太棒了——非常性感！verb
She agreed to dish the dirt on her ex-husband for a fee of fifty thousand pounds.  她同意接受五万英镑揭前夫的短。verb

words.meaning: n.海滩,湖滩,河滩
words.example:
We spent the day on the beach.  我们在海滩渡过了一整天。
The boat had been beached near the rocks.  船已经被拖到了礁石附近。

words.meaning: ad.到处,各处,无论何处
words.example:
His children go everywhere with him.  他去哪里，他的孩子就跟到哪里。
Everywhere looks so grey and depressing in winter.  冬天，处处都灰蒙蒙，令人感到压抑。
Reasonable people everywhere will be outraged by this atrocity.  无论在哪里，任何一个讲道理的人都会对这种暴行感到愤怒。

words.meaning: n.开,开放,开始,空缺,机会 a.开始的,开幕的
words.example:
The children crawled through an opening in the fence.  孩子们从篱笆上的一个缺口里爬了过去。UK noun
The official opening of the new school will take place next month.  这所新学校将于下月正式启用。UK noun
The opening of the novel is amazing.  这部小说开篇惊人。

words.meaning: v.分,划分,分开;分配;(by)除
words.example:
At the end of the lecture, I'd like all the students to divide into small discussion groups.  讲座结束后，我想让所有学生分成几个讨论小组。
After World War Two, Germany was divided into two separate countries.  第二次世界大战之后，德国被分成了两个独立的国家。
There's a narrow alley which divides our house from the one next door.  一条窄窄的小巷将我们的房子和邻居的隔开了。

words.meaning: a.最初的,开头的;词首的 n.词首大写字母
words.example:
My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.  我最初的惊讶很快变成了兴奋。
Initial reports say that seven people have died, though this has not yet been confirmed.  最初的报道说有七人丧生，但这个消息还未得到证实。noun countable usually plural
He wrote his initials, P.M.R., at the bottom of the page.  他在页尾写上了他名字的首字母P.M.R.。

words.meaning: a.很糟的;可怕的,骇人的;极度的,厉害的
words.example:
The weather was terrible.  天气糟透了。
We have just received some terrible news.  我们刚刚收到一些可怕的消息。adjective
This project is a terrible waste of money.  这个专案计划特别浪费钱财。

words.meaning: v.反对,使对立,使对抗,使相对
words.example:
The proposed new examination system has been vigorously opposed by teachers.  实行新考试制度的提议遭到教师们的强烈反对。
Most of the local residents opposed the closing of their hospital.  当地大多数居民反对关闭他们的医院。

words.meaning: a.现代的,当代的;同时代的
words.example:
Although it was written hundreds of years ago, it still has a contemporary (= modern) feel to it.  尽管它写于几百年前，但读来仍具现代感。UK adjective
Almost all of the contemporary accounts of the event have been lost.  几乎所有关于这一事件的同时期的记载都遗失了。
Most of the writers he was contemporary with were interested in the same subjects.  和他同时代的大多数作家都对同样的题材感兴趣。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.同盟,联盟;联合会,社团
words.example:
Who do you think will win the league championship this year?  你认为谁会获得今年的联赛冠军？
Liverpool were top of the Football League that year.  利物浦队是那一年的足球联赛冠军。
They are currently bottom of the league.  他们目前在联赛中垫底。noun countable

words.meaning: n.罪犯,刑事犯 a.犯罪的,刑事的
words.example:
It's criminal to charge so much for a book.  一本书要这么高的价钱，真是太不应该了。
The way we waste this planet's resources is criminal.  我们这样浪费地球的资源简直就是犯罪。

words.meaning: a.小心的,仔细的;细致的,精心的
words.example:
Be careful with the glasses.  小心玻璃杯。
Be careful wh ere you put that hot pan.  要注意把热锅放在合适的地方。
Be careful to look both ways when you cross the road.  过马路时要注意向两边看。

words.meaning: a.上面的；地位较高的
words.example:
The office block's upper floors were being repainted.  办公楼的上面几层在重新油漆。
If the infection is not checked it will probably spread to the upper body.  如果感染不控制住，很有可能扩散到上身。    Opposite lowerUK noun countable
These shoes have leather uppers and synthetic soles.  这些鞋子的鞋帮是皮质的，鞋底是合成材质的。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.(使)冲;奔n.冲,急速行进 a.(交通)繁忙的
words.example:
Whenever I see him, he seems to be rushing (about/around).  我甚么时候见到他，他都是匆匆忙忙的。
When she turned it upside down the water rushed out.  她把它底朝上翻转过来时，水一下倾泻出来。
You can't rush a job like this.  你不应该这样粗粗地赶活。

words.meaning: a.疲劳的;厌倦的
words.example:
My legs are tired.  我的腿酸了。
She spoke in a tired voice.  她说话有气无力的。UK adjective
It's always the same tired old faces at these meetings.  在这些会上总是些不变的令人生厌的老面孔。

words.meaning: n./v.雇用;用,使用
words.example:
How many people does your company employ?  你们公司雇有多少员工？
Can't we employ someone as an assistant to help with all this paperwork?  我们不可以雇一位助理来协助处理这些文书工作吗？
More people are now employed in service industries than in manufacturing.  现在服务业的就业人数多于制造业。verb

words.meaning: n.假日,节日,假期,休假
words.example:
Have you decided where you're going for your holiday(s) this year?  你决定今年到哪里渡假了吗？
Patricia is on holiday next week.  派翠夏下星期休假。
How many days' holiday do you get with your new job?  你的新工作有几天假期？

words.meaning: a.巨大的；大量的
words.example:
The amount of detail the book contains is vast.  该书所包含的细节内容非常丰富。
The people who have taken our advice have saved themselves vast amounts/sums of money.  那些听从了我们建议的人省了一大笔钱。
The vast majority of pupils attend state-funded schools.  绝大部分学生就读于州立学校。

words.meaning: n. 流产，堕胎，小产；流产的胎儿；（计划等）失败，夭折
words.example:
She decided to have/get an abortion.  她决定做人工流产。
Abortion is restricted in some American states.  美国一些州禁止堕胎。    Compare miscarriage ; stillbirthUK noun
This project is a complete abortion.  这个企划案彻底失败了。

words.meaning: ad.分离,离开,隔开 a.分离的,分隔的
words.example:
Stand with your feet wide apart.  两腿叉开站立，双脚间距要大。
How far apart should the speakers be?  两个喇叭应相距多远？
We were asked to stand in two lines three metres apart.  要求我们站成间距为三米的两排。

words.meaning: n.目击者,证人;证据,证明 v.目击,目睹;作证
words.example:
Police are appealing for witnesses to the accident to come forward.  警方呼吁那场事故的目击者站出来。
According to (eye) witnesses, the robbery was carried out by two teenage boys.  据目击者说，抢劫案是两个十几岁的少年犯的。
She was witness to the tragic event.  她目睹了这悲剧。

words.meaning: n.火柴;比赛,竞赛;对手,配偶 v.匹配,相称
words.example:
We won/lost the match.  我们赢／输掉了比赛。
Liverpool have a match with (= against) Blackburn next week.  利物浦队下周将与布莱克本队对赛。
You should always strike a match away from you.  擦火柴时应该离身体远一些。

words.meaning: n.代表,代理人 a.(of)典型的,有代表性的
words.example:
The firm has two representatives in every European city.  这间公司在每个欧洲城市设有两名销售代表。
Are your views/opinions representative of all the workers here?  你的观点／意见可以代表这里所有工人的想法吗？

words.meaning: prep.在…下边,在…之下 ad.在下方
words.example:
Jeremy hid the letter beneath a pile of papers.  杰瑞米把信藏在一叠文件下面。
We huddled together for warmth beneath the blankets.  我们裹着毛毯，挤成一堆取暖。
After weeks at sea, it was wonderful to feel firm ground beneath our feet once more.  在海上呆了数星期后，双脚再次接触坚实土地的感觉真棒。

words.meaning: prep.在...旁边,在...附近;和...相比
words.example:
Come and sit here beside me.  过来坐在我身边。
Our school was built right beside a river.  我们的学校就建在河边。
Those books seem rather dull beside this one.  与这本书相比，那些书似乎都很枯燥。

words.meaning: n.事件,事变
words.example: Despite fears of violence, the demonstration passed off without incident.  尽管担心发生暴力事件，示威活动还是平静地结束了。

words.meaning: a.(of)自豪的;引以自豪的;妄自尊大的
words.example:
You must be very proud of your son.  你一定为你的儿子感到非常自豪。
We're particularly proud of our company's environmental record.  我们为我们公司在环保方面的良好记录感到特别自豪。
When she received her prize I think I was the proudest parent on the face of the Earth.  她领奖时，我感到我是世界上最自豪的父母。

words.meaning: v.流,流动 n.流量,流速
words.example:
Lava from the volcano was flowing down the hillside.  火山岩浆顺着山坡往下流。
Many short rivers flow into the Pacific Ocean.  许多小河汇入太平洋。
The river flows through three counties before flowing into the sea just south of here.  这条河流在汇入此处正南边的大海之前流经了三个郡县。

words.meaning: v.浪费 a.无用的;荒芜的 n.浪费;废物
words.example:
That meeting achieved absolutely nothing - it was a complete waste of time.  那次会议根本没有取得甚么成果——纯粹是浪费时间。
She's been unemployed for two years and it's such a waste of her talents.  她已经失业两年了，这纯粹是浪费她的才华。
My mother couldn't bear waste - she always made us eat everything on our plates.  我母亲不能容忍浪费——她总是让我们吃光自己碟子里的所有东西。

words.meaning: adv.仅仅,只不过
words.example: The medicine won't cure her - it merely stops the pain.  这种药不能治愈她的病——只能止痛罢了。

words.meaning: n.大量,众多;团,块;(pl.)群众,民众;质量
words.example:
Thousands of troops have massed along the border in preparation for an invasion.  数千大军已经集结在边境上，准备入侵。adjective [before noun]
Opposition groups plan to stage mass demonstrations all over the country.  反对派计划在全国发起大规模游行示威。noun
The explosion reduced the church to a mass of rubble.  爆炸使教堂变成一堆瓦砾。

words.meaning: n.实验;试验 v.(on)进行实验;做试验
words.example:
Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.  有些人认为应该禁止拿动物做实验。
I've bought a different kind of coffee this week as an experiment (= in order to see what it is like).  这个星期我买了不同牌子的咖啡来尝试。
We can only find the best solution by experiment.  我们只能摸石头过河，寻找最好的解决办法。verb intransitive /ɪkˈsper.ɪ.ment/

words.meaning: n.炸弹 v.投弹于,轰炸
words.example:
The terrorists had planted a bomb near the police station.  恐怖分子在警察局附近设置了一枚炸弹。
During the Second World War, the British dropped a huge number of bombs on Dresden.  二战期间，英国在德累斯顿城投下了大量炸弹。
The US was the first country to have the bomb.  美国是第一个拥有原子弹的国家。UK noun

words.meaning: n.工程师
words.example:
The engineer is coming to repair our phone tomorrow morning.  技工明天上午来修我们的电话。
Left-wing groups engineered a coup against the military government.  左翼集团密谋策划了一场反军政府的政变。
I'm trying to engineer a meeting between them.  我正在尽力谋划，好让他们见面。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.轮,车轮
words.example:
He lost control of his car when a front/rear wheel hit a stone as he approached the first bend.  在快到第一个转弯处时，他的汽车前／后轮碰到了一块石头，失去了控制。
My suitcase is on wheels so that makes life a little easier.  我的旅行箱装有轮子，所以用起来省力一些。
Do you think you could take the wheel (= drive) for a couple of hours?  你能不能来开几个小时车？

words.meaning: v.下降,衰落;拒绝 n.下降;斜面,倾斜,衰落
words.example:
His interest in the project declined after his wife died.  妻子死后，他对该企划案的兴趣逐渐淡薄了。
The party's popularity has declined in the opinion polls.  民意调查显示该党的支持率已经下滑。
formal The land declines sharply away from the house.  地势从房屋那边开始大幅度向下倾斜。verb

words.meaning: prep. 朝，向；对于；有助于
words.example:
She stood up and walked towards him.  她站起身来，向他走去。
She kept glancing towards the telephone.  她不停瞄着电话那头。
The country seems to be drifting towards war.  这个国家似乎正慢慢走向战争。

words.meaning: v.(to)使暴露,受到;使曝光
words.example:
The plaster on the walls has been removed to expose the original bricks underneath.  墙上的灰泥已经抹去，露出了里面的墙砖。
He damaged his leg so badly in the accident that the bone was exposed.  他的脚在车祸中受了重伤，骨头都露了出来。
This photograph was under-/over- exposed (= too little/too much light was allowed to reach the film).  这张照片曝光不足／过度。

words.meaning: abbr. 获得性免疫缺乏综合征；艾滋病（Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome）
words.example:
In Britain, AIDS tests are now performed on all people who offer to become blood donors.  在英国，现在所有志愿捐血的人都要进行爱滋病病毒检测。
Don had full-blown AIDS for over a year before he died.  唐在确诊患了晚期爱滋病一年后死去。    Compare HIV

words.meaning: a.狭窄的,狭的,狭隘的
words.example:
The little village has very narrow streets.  小村子里的街道很窄。UK adjective
They are unable to see beyond the narrow world of the theatre.  他们看不到狭小的戏剧界以外的天地。
It was regarded as a very narrow interpretation of the law.  这被认为是对法律非常狭隘的诠释。

words.meaning: n.乳脂,(鲜)奶油;奶油色
words.example:
Do you like cream in your coffee?  你的咖啡要加鲜奶油吗？
Put some sun cream on to protect your face.  抹点防晒霜保护脸部。
The cream of this year's graduates have gone abroad for jobs.  今年的优秀毕业生都出国谋职去了。

words.meaning: n.秘书,书记;部长,大臣
words.example:
My secretary will phone you to arrange a meeting.  我的秘书会打电话给你安排会议。UK noun countable
The company secretary has written to all the shareholders to apologise for the mistake.  公司的文书已就这个错误向所有股东写信致歉了。

words.meaning: n.大门;入口;观众人数,门票收入
words.example:
The lift won't move if the safety gate isn't shut properly.  如果防护门没有关好，电梯不会开动。
All passengers for flight LH103 please proceed to gate 16.  搭乘 LH103号班机的乘客请前往16号登机口登机。noun countable
Gates at football matches were lower than average last season.  上个赛季观看足球比赛的人数低于平均水准。

words.meaning: a.固体的;结实的,稳固的,可靠的 n.固体
words.example:
The lecture hall was packed solid (with students).  演讲大厅里挤满了（学生）。
Liquid and solid waste is collected in the tank.  液体和固体废弃物集中在箱罐里。
Freeze the mixture for about 3 hours or so until solid.  把混合物冷冻三小时左右，直到其变成固体。

words.meaning: n.小山,山岗,高地;[pl.]丘陵(地带)
words.example:
Hills are not as high as mountains.  丘陵不像山脉那样高大。
Their house is on the top of a hill.  他们的房子在小山顶上。
In the summer, the shepherds move their sheep up into the hills (= an area where there are hills).  夏天，牧羊人把羊群赶到丘陵地带放牧。

words.meaning: n.喧闹声,噪声,吵嚷声
words.example:
The noise out in the street was deafening.  外面街道上的喧闹声震耳欲聋。
Using a single chip reduces (the) noise on the output signal by 90%.  使用单晶片可使对输出信号的干扰降低90%。noun
He made all the right noises about my audition but I couldn't tell if he was genuinely impressed.  他不停说我的试唱好，但我判断不出他是否真的这样觉得。noun

words.meaning: n.草,草地
words.example: Dan grassed on them to the local police.  丹向当地警方告发了他们。UK verb

words.meaning: n.帽子(一般指有边的帽子)
words.example:
This is me with my manager's hat on talking.  我这是以经理的身份在讲话。noun countable
Hats off to Connie for finding such a splendid venue for a party!  感谢康妮找到了这个理想的派对场地！noun countable
So Emma actually manages to juggle two small children and a full-time job, does she? Well, I take my hat off to her.  这么说艾玛在照顾好两个小孩子的同时还做着一份全职工作，是吗？我可真佩服她。noun countable

words.meaning: vi.成功;继承,接替 vt.接替;继…之后
words.example:
She's been trying to pass her driving test for six years and she's finally succeeded.  六年来，她一直努力想通过驾照考试，终于得偿所愿。
You need to be pretty tough to succeed in the property world.  要想在地产界出人头地，你必须要坚忍不拔。
The campaign has certainly succeeded in raising public awareness of the issue.  毫无疑问，这项活动成功唤起大众对这问题的关注。

words.meaning: vt.庆祝;颂扬,赞美vi.庆祝,过节
words.example:
We always celebrate our wedding anniversary by going out to dinner.  每年的结婚纪念日我们都出去吃饭庆祝。
If this plan works, we'll celebrate in style (= in a special way).  要是这个计划奏效，我们就隆重地庆贺一下。verb
His work celebrates the energy and enthusiasm of the young.  他的作品赞颂年轻人的活力和热情。verb

words.meaning: n.完成；成就/绩
words.example:
An Olympic silver medal is a remarkable achievement for one so young.  对于如此年轻的选手而言，夺得奥运会银牌是个了不起的成就。
The Tale of Genji has been described as the greatest achievement of Japanese literature.  《源氏物语》一直被称作是日本文学最伟大的成就。
It gives you a sense of achievement if you actually make it to the end of a very long book.  如果你能真正读完一本厚书，就会有一种成就感。

words.meaning: vt.控告,指责 vi.指控,指责
words.example:
He's been accused of robbery/murder.  他被指控犯有抢劫／谋杀罪。
Are you accusing me of lying ?  你是在指责我撒谎吗？
The surgeon was accused of negligence.  这名外科医生被控怠忽职守。

words.meaning: a.有用的，有益的
words.example:
Do the exercises serve any useful purpose?  这些练习有甚么用处吗？adjective
You should keep that paint - it might come in useful one day.  你应该留着那些油漆——说不定哪天会派上用场。adjective
Now you're here you might as well make yourself useful - there's a lot of clearing up to do.  既然你来了，那就别闲着——有很多清理工作要做。adjective

words.meaning: v.拒绝,抵制,丢弃,排斥,退掉 n.落选者
words.example:
The appeal was rejected by the High Court.  上诉被最高法院驳回。
Coin-operated machines in England reject Irish money.  英格兰的投币机不接受爱尔兰钱币。
The prime minister rejected the suggestion that it was time for him to resign.  首相拒绝了他该辞职的建议。

words.meaning: n.才能,天资;人才
words.example:
Her talent for music showed at an early age.  她小时候就表现出了音乐天赋。
His artistic talents were wasted in his boring job.  他的艺术天分被枯燥乏味的工作消磨殆尽。noun
There was plenty of talent at the party last night.  昨晚的派对上有许多佳丽。

words.meaning: v.品尝;(of)有…味道;体验 n.滋味;味觉
words.example:
Olives are perhaps an acquired taste (= you only like them after you have become familiar with their taste).  橄榄的味道可能要慢慢习惯才会喜欢。
Have a taste of the sauce and tell me if it needs salt.  尝尝酱汁，看看是否需要加盐。noun
I've never really cared much for flash new cars - old vintage cars are more to my taste (= what I like).  我一向不怎么喜欢豪华的新款车——倒是更喜欢老式汽车。

words.meaning: a.(of)特有的,独特的 n.特征,特性
words.example:
Unfortunately a big nose is a family characteristic.  不幸的是，大鼻子是家族特征。
Sentimentality seems a characteristic of all the writers of that period.  多愁善感似乎是那个时期所有作家的特征。
The male bird displays (= has) several characteristics which distinguish him from the female.  雄鸟有几个有别于雌鸟的特征。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.牛奶;(植物流出的)白色乳液 v.挤奶
words.example:
Breast/Mother's milk is the best nourishment for a baby.  母乳是婴儿最好的营养品。
She's full of the milk of human kindness.  她本性仁慈善良。verb
Milking a cow by hand is a skilled process.  挤牛奶是一项需要专门技术的工作。

words.meaning: n.逃跑,逃脱 v.逃跑;避开,避免
words.example:
Two prisoners have escaped.  两个犯人逃走了。
She was lucky to escape serious injury.  她真是万幸，逃过一劫，没有受重伤。
He narrowly (= only just) escaped a fine.  他差一点被罚款。

words.meaning: v.投,扔,掷,抛;铸造;投票;n.演员表
words.example:
He was often cast as the villain.  他经常演反面角色。
In her latest film she was cast against type (= played a different character than the one she usually played or might be expected to play).  在最近拍的电影中，她改变了戏路。
figurative They like to cast the opposing political party as (= to say that they are) the party of high taxes.  他们喜欢把敌对政党说成是征收高额税收的政党。

words.meaning: n.句子;判决,宣判 v.宣判,判决
words.example:
He's very impatient and always interrupts me mid-sentence.  他很不耐烦，总是在我说到一半的时候就打断我。
Your conclusion is good, but the final sentence is too long and complicated.  你的结论没错，但最后一句话太长太复杂。noun countable
He got a heavy/light sentence (= He was severely/not severely punished).  他被判以重刑／轻判。

words.meaning: a.不平常的,与众不同的
words.example: "Do you like the new settee?" "Very much, it's most unusual."  “你喜欢这新的沙发吗？”“非常喜欢，它太特别了。”

words.meaning: v.(of)使信服,使确信
words.example: He managed to convince the jury of his innocence.  他使陪审团相信他是无辜的。

words.meaning: n.高,高度;(常pl.)高地,高处
words.example:
The sheer height of New York's skyscrapers is so impressive.  纽约的摩天大楼光高度就气势非凡。
She's about average height (= neither short nor tall).  她大约中等个子。
The bullet entered the body at chest height.  子弹从胸部的高度进入身体

words.meaning: n.内科医生
words.example: See a physician if the fever continues.  发烧不退要看内科医生。

words.meaning: vt.(为征税)评估(财产、收入);征税;评价
words.example:
The insurers will need to assess the flood damage.  保险公司需要对洪水造成的损失进行评估。
They assessed the cost of the flood damage at £1500.  他们估计洪水造成的损失为1500英镑。
Examinations are not the only means of assessing a student's ability.  考试并不是评定学生能力的唯一手段。

words.meaning: n.丰富,大量
words.example:
Don't grab at the balloons, children - there are plenty for everyone.  孩子们，别抢气球——气球还很多，每人都有。
We've got plenty of time before we need to leave for the airport.  去机场前我们有的是时间。
They've always had plenty of money.  他们总是有很多钱。

words.meaning: n.加,加法;附加部分,增加(物)
words.example:
Twice a week the children are tested in basic mathematical skills such as addition (= calculating the total of different numbers put together) and subtraction.  孩子每周要参加两次加减法等基础数学能力的测试。
In addition to his flat in London, he has a villa in Italy and a castle in Scotland.  除了在伦敦拥有一层公寓外，他在义大利还有一座乡间别墅，在苏格兰有一座城堡。
humorous I hear you're expecting a small addition to the family (= you are going to have a baby) !  我听说你家里要添一名小成员了！

words.meaning: a.锋利的;轮廓分明的;急转的ad.(指时刻)正
words.example:
a knife with a sharp edge/blade.  刀刃锋利的刀子
The point of this pencil isn't sharp enough.  这支铅笔的头还不够尖。
She nudged me with a sharp elbow, to tell me to be quiet.  她狠狠地用手肘捅了我一下，要我安静点。

words.meaning: v.(of)赞成,赞许,同意;批准,审议,通过
words.example:
She doesn't approve of my friends.  她不喜欢我的朋友。
He doesn't approve of smoking.  他反对抽烟。
We had to wait months for the council to approve our plans to extend the house.  我们要等几个月，直到政务委员会批准我们扩建房屋的计划。

words.meaning: n.解释,说明
words.example:
Could you give me a quick explanation of how it works?  你可以向我简要说明一下它的运作原理吗？
What was her explanation for why she was late?  她是如何解释她迟到的原因的？
He said, by way of explanation, that he hadn't seen the traffic light change to red.  他解释说他没有看到红灯亮起。

words.meaning: a.快乐的,愉快的,色彩鲜艳的 n.同性恋
words.example:
Mark knew he was gay by the time he was fourteen.  马克到14岁时知道了自己是同性恋。
We had a gay old time down at the dance hall.  我们在下面舞厅玩得开心极了。
The streets were gay and full of people.  大街上色彩缤纷，熙熙攘攘。adjective

words.meaning: a.适合的;合乎体统的;固有的;有礼貌的
words.example:
This is Sara's first proper job - she usually does temporary work just for the money.  这是莎拉的第一份正式工作——她通常只是为了赚钱而打零工。
If you're going to walk those sort of distances you need proper walking boots.  如果你要走那么远的路，就需要一双合脚的健步鞋。
I've had sandwiches but I haven't eaten a proper meal.  我吃了三明治，但还没有好好吃一顿饭。

words.meaning: a.(of)有罪的,内疚的
words.example:
She must have done something wrong, because she's looking so guilty.  她一定是做错甚么事了，因为她一脸愧疚。
You've got a guilty conscience - that's why you can't sleep.  你问心有愧——所以会睡不着觉。UK adjective
The jury has to decide whether a person is guilty or innocent of a crime.  陪审团必须就一个人是否有罪作出裁决。

words.meaning: v.获得;学到(知识等);养成(习惯)
words.example:
He acquired the firm in 1978.  他于1978年收购了这家公司。
During this period he acquired a reputation for being a womanizer.  这期间他得了个玩弄女性的名声。UK verb transitive
Olives are an acquired taste.  橄榄这种东西吃得多就爱吃了。

words.meaning: vi.比赛;竞争;对抗
words.example:
It's difficult for a small supermarket to compete against/with the big supermarkets.  小超市很难与大超市竞争。
Both girls compete for their father's attention.  两个女孩在父亲面前争宠。
figurative Turn the music down - I'm not competing against/with that noise (= I can't/won't try to speak louder than that music) !  把音乐调小声一点——我可不想跟那噪音较量！

words.meaning: a.技术(性)的,工艺的;专门性的,专业性的
words.example:
Personally, I found some parts of the book a little too technical to follow.  我个人认为，书中有些部分过于专业化，一般人不易看懂。
In her performance as the Snow Queen she showed great technical brilliance.  她演冰雪女王时表现出了高超的演技。

words.meaning: prep.加上 a.正的,加的 n.加号,正号
words.example:
What is six plus four?  6加4等于几？
The rent will be £75 a week, plus (= added to the cost of) gas and electricity.  加上煤气和电费，每周租金为75英镑。preposition conjunction
There will be two adults travelling, plus three children.  旅行时将有两个大人，外加三个小孩。

words.meaning: a.虚弱的,软弱的;不够标准的;淡薄的,稀的
words.example:
It's not surprising you feel weak if you haven't eaten properly for days.  如果你好几天都吃得不好的话，觉得虚弱无力是不足为奇的。
The electromagnetic field strength becomes weaker as you move further away from high voltage cables.  当你远离高压线时，电磁场强度就会变弱。
He was a weak king surrounded by corrupt advisers.  他是个软弱无能的国王，身边都是些腐败的顾问。

words.meaning: a.不合法的,非法的
words.example:
Prostitution is illegal in some countries.  卖淫在某些国家是不合法的。
It is illegal to drive a car that is not taxed and insured.  驾驶未上税、未上保险的汽车是违法的。
Cocaine, LSD and heroin are all illegal drugs/substances.  古柯碱、迷幻药和海洛因都是非法毒品。

words.meaning: interj.(hey)嗨!喂!
words.example:
Hi, there!  喂，那里的
Hi, how're you doing?  嗨，你好吗？

words.meaning: n.二选一;供选择的东西;取舍 a.二选一的
words.example:
There must be an alternative to people sleeping on the streets.  一定要想办法解决街头露宿者的问题。
I'm afraid I have no alternative but to ask you to leave (= that is what I have to do).  恐怕我别无选择，只有让你离开。UK adjective
The opposition parties have so far failed to set out an alternative strategy.  反对党到目前为止还没有提出其他的策略。

words.meaning: n.信号,暗号 v.发信号,用信号通知
words.example:
When she gave (them) the signal, they all cheered.  她发出信号后，他们都欢呼起来。
The signal for a race to start is often the firing of a gun.  赛跑常以发令枪响作为开始的信号。
The poor result is a clear signal of his deteriorating confidence.  糟糕的结果清楚地显示他信心日渐不足。

words.meaning: n.(pl.curricula)课程,(学校等的)全部课程
words.example: the school curriculum  学校课程

words.meaning: n.(honour)尊敬,敬意;荣誉,光荣 v.尊敬
words.example: It's an honor to represent our school.  代表我校是荣幸。

words.meaning: n.乘客,旅客
words.example: The two passenger trains involved in the accident had both come from south-west London.  这次意外中的两列客运火车都是从伦敦西南部开出的。

words.meaning: n.协作; 援助; 帮助
words.example:
The company needs more financial assistance from the Government.  这间公司需要政府提供更多的财政援助。
Can I be of any assistance, madam (= Can I help) ?  小姐，我可以帮上甚么忙吗？
Teachers can't give pupils any assistance in exams.  考试中老师不能以任何形式帮助学生。

words.meaning: adv.(for ever)永远;总是
words.example:
She's forever telling him she's going to leave him but she never actually does.  她老是跟他说要离开他，但实际上从未那样做过。
We'd better walk a bit quicker - it's going to take forever if we go at this pace.  我们最好走快一点——如果以这个速度走下去，我们要走很久。

words.meaning: v.(as)把…看作为;考虑n.(pl.)敬重,问候
words.example:
Local people regard this idea of a motorway through their village with horror.  当地居民对修建横穿他们村庄的高速公路这一计划感到惶惶不可终日。
Her parents always regarded her as the cleverest of their children.  她父母一贯把她看作是所有子女中最聪明的。
The bird regarded me with suspicion as I walked up to its nest.  我走向鸟巢的时候，那只鸟怀疑地注视着我。

words.meaning: n.联盟,协会,社团;交往,联合;联想
words.example:
The British Medical Association is/are campaigning for a complete ban on tobacco advertising.  英国医学协会正发起一项全面禁止烟草广告的运动。UK noun
This event was organized in association with the Sports Council.  这场赛事由体育委员会协办。
The south of France has positive associations for me as I used to holiday there as a child.  法国南部总能给我一种美好的联想，因为我童年时代常去那里渡假。

words.meaning: v.敲,敲打,碰撞 n.敲,击
words.example:
She knocked on the window to attract his attention.  她敲窗想引起他的注意。
There's someone knocking on/at the door.  有人在敲门。
Please knock before entering.  进来前请先敲门。

words.meaning: n.(laboratory)实验室
words.example: a science lab  科学实验室

words.meaning: a.精神(上)的,心灵的
words.example: Traditional ways of life fulfilled both economic and spiritual needs.  传统的生活方式满足了经济和精神的双重需求。noun countable (also negro spiritual)

words.meaning: a.音乐的;有音乐才能的 n.音乐片
words.example:
Mozart's musical compositions include symphonies and operas.  莫劄特的音乐创作包括交响乐和歌剧。
The family all play instruments - they're all very musical.  这家人都会演奏乐器——他们都很喜欢音乐。noun countable

words.meaning: n.记者,新闻工作者
words.example: a freelance political journalist  政论文章自由撰稿人

words.meaning: n.祈祷,祷告,祷文
words.example:
She always says her prayers (= prays) before she goes to sleep.  她睡前总要念祷文。
We thought he'd been killed, but our prayers were answered when he arrived home unexpectedly.  我们以为他已经死了，但我们的祷告实现了，他出人意料地回家了。
The prisoners find their only solace in prayer.  犯人们从祈祷中寻求仅有的慰藉。UK noun

words.meaning: v.猜想;怀疑;察觉 a.可疑的 n.嫌疑犯
words.example:
So far, the police do not suspect foul play.  目前，员警没有怀疑是谋杀案件。
No one knows who killed her, but the police suspect her husband.  没有人知道谁杀了她，但是警方认为她丈夫有嫌疑。
The police suspect him of carrying out two bomb attacks.  警方怀疑他发动两宗爆炸案。

words.meaning: n.学者
words.example:
Dr Miles was a distinguished scholar of Russian history.  迈尔斯博士是一位研究俄国历史的著名学者。
David's never been much of a scholar.  戴维从来不是一个善于学习的人。

words.meaning: n.气候;风气,社会思潮
words.example:
The Mediterranean climate is good for growing citrus fruits and grapes.  地中海气候适宜柑橘属水果和葡萄的生长。
When we retire, we're going to move to a warmer climate.  我们打算退休后搬到气候比较暖和的地方去。noun
Terrorism creates a climate of fear.  恐怖主义制造了一种恐惧气氛。

words.meaning: n.干酪,乳酪
words.example:
Would you like a slice/piece of cheese with your bread?  你想要块起司配面包吃吗？
You need 250g of grated cheese for this recipe.  按照这张食谱，你需要250克磨碎的起司。
So he's fed up because he's got to get up early one morning in seven, is he? Well hard cheese!  “因为那天早上七点就要起床，他烦透了，是不是？”“嗯，真倒楣！”noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.幼年,童年
words.example:
She had an unhappy childhood.  她的童年很不幸。
Childhood is not always a happy time.  童年并不总是快乐的时光。    Compare boyhood ; girlhood

words.meaning: n.先生,长官;[S -用于姓名前]…爵士
words.example:
Would you like to see the menu, sir?  您要看看菜单吗，先生?
I'm not going to ride the subway, no sir!  我不会去乘地铁，绝对不会！

words.meaning: v.许可,允许 n.许可证,执照
words.example:
The regulations do not permit much flexibility.  这些规章不允许有太大的弹性空间。
As it was such a special occasion, she permitted herself a small glass of champagne.  鉴于场合特殊，她破例喝了一小杯香槟。
formal The law permits of no other interpretation.  法律不容许有其他解释。

words.meaning: n.香烟，纸烟，卷烟
words.example: She lit a cigarette.  她点燃一支香烟。

words.meaning: n.面包
words.example:
This bread is fresh/stale.  这面包是新鲜的／变味了。
Do you bake your own bread?  你自己烤面包吗？noun uncountable
He earns his daily bread as a tourist guide.  他靠做导游谋生。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.大学毕业生,研究生 v.大学毕业a.毕了业的
words.example:
Chris is a physics graduate.  克里斯是物理专业的毕业生。
Lorna graduated from the University of London.  洛娜毕业于伦敦大学。
Tom has just graduated with first-class honours in psychology.  汤姆刚刚大学毕业，获得心理学一级荣誉学位。

words.meaning: v./n.请求,要求
words.example:
They received hundreds of requests for more information.  数以百计的人要求他们提供更多的资讯。
The clause was added to the contract at Carlos's request (= because Carlos asked for this).  这一条款是在卡洛斯的要求下添加到合同中的。
An application form will be sent to you on request (= if you ask).  申请表格承索即寄。    Compare order

words.meaning: v./n.尖声叫,喊叫着说出,(风)呼啸
words.example:
Through the smoke, the rescuers could hear people screaming for help.  透过烟雾，救援者可以听见人们在喊救命。
He was screaming in/with pain and begging for anaesthetic.  他痛得直叫，哀求用麻醉药。
They screamed with laughter at her jokes.  听了她的笑话，他们大笑了起来。

words.meaning: n.宇宙,万物
words.example:
Is there intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?  宇宙中其他地方存在有智慧的生命吗？
Scientists have speculated about the possibility of parallel universes.  有科学家思考过平行世界存在的可能性。
The characters in his novels inhabit a bleak and hopeless universe.  他小说中的人物生活在一个悲凄无望的世界里。

words.meaning: a.卓越的,极好的
words.example:
The food was excellent.  这食物非常美味。
Her car is in excellent condition.  她的汽车车况非常好。
The fall in interest rates is excellent news for borrowers.  对于借贷人来讲，利率降低是个好消息。

words.meaning: a.幸运的,侥幸的
words.example:
The lucky winner will be able to choose from three different holidays.  幸运的获胜者可以从三种不同的假日方案中选择一种。
He's lucky that he wasn't fired.  他很幸运，没有被解雇。
