It sounds as if you had a lucky escape (= by good chance you were able to avoid something dangerous or unpleasant).  听起来好像你是侥幸逃脱啊。

words.meaning: v.拖,拖曳
words.example:
Pick the chair up instead of dragging it behind you!  把椅子拿起来，不要在地上拖！
She dragged the canoe down to the water.  她把独木舟拉到水边。
She had to drag her child away from the toy shop.  她不得不把孩子从玩具店硬拉出来。

words.meaning: n.(飞机)航线 a.(飞机)航线的
words.example: What airline did you fly?  你乘坐哪家航空公司的飞机？

words.meaning: n.图书馆;藏书室;藏书,丛书,文库
words.example: a public/university library  公共／大学图书馆

words.meaning: n.议事日程,记事册
words.example:
There were several important items on the agenda.  会议议程中有几项重要的议题。
The question of security is high on the agenda for this afternoon's meeting.  今天下午的议程中，安全问题是首要议题。
Women's rights have been put back on the agenda (= are being discussed publicly again).  妇女权益的问题再次得到广泛关注。

words.meaning: v.收回;(from)恢复,痊愈;重新获得
words.example:
It took her a long while to recover (= become completely well again) from/after her heart operation.  她心脏动手术后很长时间身体才复原。
He never really recovered from the shock of his wife dying (= He was never happy after his wife died).  他再也没有从丧妻之痛中真正恢复过来。
She went into a coma and died without recovering consciousness.  她陷入昏迷后再也没有醒过来。

words.meaning: n.工厂
words.example: a car/shoe/textile factory  汽车／制鞋／纺织厂

words.meaning: n.屋顶,顶
words.example:
The house has a sloping/flat/tiled/thatched/etc. roof.  这间房子是斜顶／平顶／瓦顶／茅草等屋顶。
Put the luggage on the roof of the car.  把行李放在车顶上。
The roof (= upper surface) of the cave is 50 metres up.  洞顶距地面有50米高。

words.meaning: a.不能的，不会的
words.example: We were unable to contact him at the time.  我们当时无法和他取得联系。

words.meaning: n.花费,消费,消耗
words.example:
Buying a bigger car has proved to be well worth the expense.  事实证明，买辆大一点的车还是值得的。
We've just had a new garage built at great expense.  我们刚用了很多钱盖一座新车库。
We went on holiday at my father's expense (= he paid for it).  我们去度了假，一切费用由我父亲支付。

words.meaning: n.饮食,食物
words.example:
Diet varies between different countries in the world.  世界各国的饮食各不相同。
Rice is the staple diet (= most important food) of many people in China.  在中国大米是很多人的主食。
The children seem to exist on a diet of burgers and chips.  孩子们好像离不开汉堡包和炸薯条。

words.meaning: n.逮捕,扣留 vt.逮捕,扣留;阻止;吸引
words.example:
He was arrested when customs officers found drugs in his bag.  海关人员在他的手提包里发现了毒品，把他拘捕了。
The police arrested her for drinking and driving.  她因酒后驾车被警方拘捕。verb transitive
The treatment has so far done little to arrest the spread of the cancer.  这种疗法到目前为止几乎没有抑制癌细胞的扩散。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.洗;洗的衣物 vt.冲刷,洗;冲出 vi.洗澡
words.example:
These sheets need washing.  这些床单需要洗洗。
I'll wash the bottle out (= clean its inside) and use it again.  我要把瓶子洗干净再用。
I'd like to wash before dinner.  吃饭前我要洗洗手。

words.meaning: n.时间表,进度表 v.安排,预定
words.example:
Everything went according to schedule (= as planned).  一切按照排程进行。
We expect the building work to be completed ahead of schedule.  我们希望建筑工程能提前竣工。
The meeting has been scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.  会议安排在明天下午。

words.meaning: a.悲哀的,忧愁的
words.example:
I've just received some very sad news.  我刚刚得到一些令人伤心的消息。
She gave a rather sad smile.  她露出一丝苦笑。
I'm so sad (that) you can't come.  你不能来，我很遗憾。

words.meaning: a.简短的,简洁的 v.简短介绍,简要汇报
words.example:
His acceptance speech was mercifully brief.  幸而他的提名演讲很简短。
It'll only be a brief visit because we really haven't much time.  我们的时间真的不多，所以只能作短暂的参观游览。
After a brief spell/stint in the army, he started working as a teacher.  在军队呆了短暂的一段时间以后，他当起了教师。

words.meaning: v.贴出;公告;投寄 n.(支)柱;邮政,邮寄;职位
words.example:
I'd been away for a few days so I had a lot of post waiting for me.  我离开了几天，所以有好多邮件等着我处理。
Unless it's marked 'private', my secretary usually opens my post.  除非写有“亲启”，否则通常由我的秘书来拆我的邮件。
Has the post come/arrived yet?  邮件到了吗？

words.meaning: v.买,购买 n.购买的物品
words.example:
Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.  门票必须提前两周购买。
Except under clearly defined circumstances, it is illegal in Britain for a company to purchase its own shares.  在英国，除非是在明确规定的情况下，否则一间公司购买自己的股票是违法的。
She purchased her first house with the money.  她用这笔钱买了她的第一栋房子。UK US  formal

words.meaning: n.钢
words.example: steel girders/rods/struts  钢梁／条／柱

words.meaning: v.大声叫,喊,呼出 n.呼喊,叫
words.example:
There's no need to shout, I can hear perfectly well.  没有必要大声喊叫，我完全听得见。
Dad really shouted at me when I broke the window.  我打碎了窗户后，父亲对着我大吼大叫。
He shouted abuse at the judge after being sentenced to five years imprisonment.  被宣判五年监禁之后，他大声辱骂法官。

words.meaning: a.看的；看得见的
words.example: visual stimulus/impact/abilities  视觉刺激／冲击／视力

words.meaning: a.猛烈的；狂暴的
words.example:
He shouts a lot but I don't think he's ever been physically violent towards her.  他常大吼大叫，但我认为他不曾对她使用暴力。
There was a violent clash/confrontation between rival supporters after the match.  那次比赛后两队的支持者发生了暴力冲突。
The more violent scenes in the film were cut when it was shown on television.  这部电影在电视上播放时剪掉了一些更为暴力的镜头。

words.meaning: a.寂静,沉默的
words.example:
The empty house was completely silent.  那栋空房子一片寂静。
literary It was four o'clock in the morning and London was as silent as the grave (= completely silent).  凌晨四点，伦敦如坟墓一样沉寂，十分安静。adjective
She whispered a silent prayer that her wounded brother would not die.  她默默地祷告，希望她受伤的兄弟不会死去。

words.meaning: v.料想,猜想;假定;conj.假使...结果会怎样
words.example:
He found it a lot more difficult to get a job than he supposed it would be.  他发现找工作比他想像的要难多了。
It is widely supposed (that) the minister will be forced to resign.  很多人都猜测首相会被迫辞职。
Her new book is supposed to be (= generally people think it is) very good.  大多数人都认为她的新书写得很好。

words.meaning: n.自行车 vi.骑自行车
words.example:
It would be better for the environment if more people used bikes rather than cars.  如果更多的人踏脚踏车，而不是开汽车，将会对环境更有益。
My youngest child is learning to ride a bike.  我最小的孩子正在学骑脚踏车。
Should we bike to the park, or walk?  我们骑脚踏车去公园，还是走路去？

words.meaning: n.茶(叶);午后茶点
words.example:
I'd love a cup of tea, please.  请给我来一杯茶。
Tea and biscuits will be provided at 11 o'clock.  11点会提供茶点。
How do you like your tea - strong or weak ?  你喜欢喝甚么样的茶——浓的还是淡的？

words.meaning: n.解决,决定,调停;居留区,住宅区
words.example:
It now seems unlikely that it will be possible to negotiate/reach a peaceful settlement of the conflict.  现在看来和平解决这一冲突是不可能的。
As part of their divorce settlement, Geoff agreed to let Polly keep the house.  作为离婚协议的一部分，杰夫同意房子归波莉所有。
They reached an out-of-court settlement.  他们达成了庭外和解。

words.meaning: n.描写,形容;种类
words.example:
Write a description of your favourite seaside resort.  描述一下你最喜欢的海滨胜地。
She has given the police a very detailed/full description of the robber.  她向员警详细描述了抢劫者的相貌。
Your essay contains too much description, and not enough discussion of the issues.  你的文章描述性内容太多，而对问题的讨论不足。

words.meaning: v.(使)滑动 n.滑坡,滑道;滑,滑动;幻灯片
words.example:
When I was little I used to like sliding on the polished floor in my socks.  小时候我喜欢穿着短袜在光亮的地板上滑行。
We've got one of those doors in the kitchen that slides open.  我们厨房的门中有一扇装的是那种滑动开关的。
He slid the letter into his pocket while no one was looking.  趁没人看见，他把信塞进了口袋。

words.meaning: n.婚礼
words.example:
Do you know the date of Caroline and Matthew's wedding?  你知道卡罗琳和马修的婚礼哪天举行吗？
It was their twenty-fifth wedding anniversary last week.  上周是他们结婚25周年纪念。

words.meaning: v.(of,about)通知,告诉,报告;告发,告密
words.example:
The name of the dead man will not be released until his relatives have been informed.  在通知死者亲属之前，不会公布死者的姓名。
Why wasn't I informed about this earlier?  为甚么不早点将这件事通知我？
Walters was not properly informed of the reasons for her arrest.  沃尔特斯并未按规定被告知其被捕的原因。

words.meaning: vt.离弃,丢弃;遗弃,抛弃;放弃
words.example:
We had to abandon the car.  我们不得不弃车而去。
By the time the rebel troops arrived, the village had already been abandoned.  当叛军杀到时，村民已经撤离了村庄。
As a baby he'd been abandoned by his mother.  他在繦褓之中就被母亲遗弃了。

words.meaning: n.湖泊,湖水
words.example:
We used to go boating on that lake.  我们过去常去那个湖里划船。
Overproduction caused butter mountains and wine lakes.  生产过剩导致奶油堆积如山、葡萄酒汇流成河。

words.meaning: vt.改变,变换;变压;转化;改造,改造
words.example: The reorganization will transform the British entertainment industry.  这次重组将使英国的娱乐业大为改观。

words.meaning: n.(紧张)状态;拉(绷)紧;张力,拉力
words.example:
You could feel the tension in the room as we waited for our exam results.  我们等待考试结果出来的时候，你可以感觉到屋里的紧张气氛。
There are growing tensions betweeen the two countries.  两国间的关系日益紧张。noun

words.meaning: vt.打扰,麻烦 vi.担心,烦恼 n.烦恼,焦急
words.example:
You could have phoned us but you just didn't bother.  你本可以给我们打电话的，可你就是懒得打。
You won't get any credit for doing it, so why bother?  你做这件事不会受到任何赞扬的，为甚么还要做呢？
Most evenings I can't be bothered cooking.  大多数晚上我都懒得做饭。UK verb

words.meaning: v.(in)在于,存在于;(of)由…组成,由…构成
words.example:
The beauty of air travel consists in its speed and ease.  乘飞机旅行的好处在于快捷、舒适。
The team consists of four Europeans and two Americans.  该队由四个欧洲人和两个美国人组成。
It's a simple dish to prepare, consisting mainly of rice and vegetables.  这道菜很容易做，主料是米饭和蔬菜。

words.meaning: n.酒精,乙醇;含酒精的饮料
words.example: Most wines contain between 10% and 15% alcohol.  大多数的葡萄酒酒精含量都在10%到15%之间。

words.meaning: v.(使)弯曲;屈从,屈服 n.弯曲(处),曲折处
words.example:
Now, bend forward/over and touch your toes!  现在，向前弯腰触摸脚趾。
Make sure you bend your knees when you're picking up heavy objects.  提重物时一定要屈膝。
The road bends to the left after the first set of traffic lights.  过了第一个交通灯号后，道路弯向左侧。

words.meaning: n.沙漠,不毛之地 v.抛弃,遗弃;擅离,开小差
words.example:
They were lost in the desert for nine days.  他们在沙漠里迷路已经有9天了。
We had to cross a large area of arid, featureless desert.  我们必须穿越一大片干燥荒芜的沙漠。
This town is a cultural/intellectual desert.  这个城镇是一片文化沙漠。verb UK RUN AWAY  跑掉

words.meaning: aux.v.(我,我们)将要,会;必须,应该
words.example:
If you do that one more time, I shall be very cross.  如果你再那么做，我就要生气了。
Shall we be able to get this finished today, do you think?  你认为我们今天能完成这项工作吗？
I'm afraid I shall not/shan't be able to come to your party.  恐怕我不能参加你的派对了。

words.meaning: n.错误,过失
words.example:
He admitted that he'd made an error.  他承认犯了一个错误。
The letter contains a number of typing errors.  信中有一些打字错误。
Human error has been blamed for the air crash.  飞机坠毁被归咎于人为失误。

words.meaning: a.两倍的；双的
words.example:
Go through the double doors and turn left.  穿过那道对开门，然后向左转。
The word 'cool' has a double 'o' in the middle.  单词 cool 的中间有两个字母 o。
Everything he says has a double meaning (= has two possible meanings).  他说的每句话都有双重含义。

words.meaning: n.沙;(pl.)沙滩,沙地
words.example:
The children played all day in/on the sand.  孩子们玩了一整天沙子。
Mix one part sand to three parts cement.  将一份沙和三份水泥混合。
Sand the door (down) thoroughly before starting to paint.  粉刷之前要把门用砂纸彻底磨光。

words.meaning: n.印刷,印刷品,字体 v.印刷,出版;洗印
words.example:
The title is in bold print.  标题是粗体字。
This novel is available in large print for readers with poor eyesight.  这本小说有大字本，以满足视力差的读者的需要。
The book was rushed into print (= was produced and published) as quickly as possible.  这本书很快就印了出来。

words.meaning: v.保护,维持;保存,保藏
words.example:
We want to preserve the character of the town while improving the facilities.  我们想在改善市镇设施的同时保存其特色。
The agreement preserved our right to limit trade in endangered species.  这项协定保留了我们限制濒危物种贸易的权利。
Putting varnish on wood is a way of preserving it.  在木料上涂清漆是保护木料的一种方法。

words.meaning: n.通过,经过;通路,走廊;(一)段落,(一)节
words.example:
The bathroom's on the right at the end of the passage.  浴室在走廊尽头的右边。
Several passages from the book were printed in a national newspaper before it was published.  该书出版前，书中有几段文字被刊载在一份全国性的报纸上。noun
The gunman then took a hostage and demanded a plane and safe passage to an unspecified destination.  持枪歹徒随后劫持了一名人质，要求派飞机把他安全送到某个未指明的目的地。

words.meaning: n.存在,实在;生存,生活(方式)
words.example:
Many people question the existence of God.  很多人怀疑上帝是否真的存在。
Modern cosmology believes the Universe to have come into existence about fifteen billion years ago.  现代宇宙论认为，宇宙大约在150亿年前就已经形成了。
The theatre company that they started is still in existence today.  他们创办的剧团直到今日仍在演出。

words.meaning: n.(同一表演者的)集锦密纹唱片;集邮册,相册
words.example:
Have you heard their new album?  你听过他们的新专辑吗？noun countable
We've put the best wedding photos into an album.  我们已经把婚礼上拍得最好的照片放进了相册。

words.meaning: v.安排,筹划;整理,使有条理,排列,布置
words.example:
I'm trying to arrange my work so that I can have a couple of days off next week.  我正设法把工作安排好，以便下周能够休息一两天。
The meeting has been arranged for Wednesday.  会议已经安排在周三了。
I've already arranged with him to meet at the cinema.  我已和他约好了在电影院见面。

words.meaning: n.大气(层);空气;气氛,环境;大气压
words.example:
These factories are releasing toxic gases into the atmosphere.  这些工厂向大气中排放有毒气体。
The atmosphere in the room was so stuffy I could hardly breathe.  房间里空气污浊，我都快喘不过气来了。
There's a very relaxed atmosphere in our office.  我们办公室的气氛非常轻松。

words.meaning: v./n.(to)回答,答复,以…作答
words.example:
She replied to the threats by going to the police.  她受到威胁后便去报了警。
Newport took an early lead before Bridgend replied with three tries in 14 minutes.  开球不久纽波特队便率先进球，之后布里真德队大举反攻，14分钟内先后三次试图破门。noun countable or uncountable
There were very few replies to our advertisement.  我们的广告没有得到甚么回应。

words.meaning: n.自行车;周期,循环 v.骑自行车;循环
words.example: It's one in a cycle of plays that are being performed on successive evenings.  这几部连台戏连续几晚都在上演，这只是其中一部。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.对面的,相对的,相反的 n.对立面
words.example:
You'd never know they're sisters - they're completely opposite to each other in every way.  你怎样也不会知道她们是姐妹——她们各方面都全然不同。
Police attempts to calm the violence had the opposite effect.  警方试图平息暴力活动，却适得其反。UK adjective
My brother and I live on opposite sides of London.  我哥哥和我住在伦敦两个方向相反的区。

words.meaning: n.锁 v.锁,锁上
words.example:
Thieves got in by smashing the lock off the door.  盗贼砸坏门锁闯了进去。
She's a lock for promotion this year.  她今年肯定会晋升的。UK noun
There is a lock of Napoleon's hair in the display cabinet.  在展柜中有一缕拿破仑的鬈发。

words.meaning: v.应受,值得
words.example:
After all that hard work, you deserve a holiday.  辛劳过后，你该放假了。
Chris deserves our special thanks for all his efforts.  我们应该特别感谢克里斯所付出的心血。
She deserves a medal for putting up with that husband of hers.  她能够忍受那样的丈夫真不容易。UK verb transitive not continuous

words.meaning: a.(in)前后一致的;(with)一致,符合
words.example:
There has been a consistent improvement in her attitude.  她的态度一直在改进。
Her work is sometimes good, but the problem is she's not consistent.  她工作有时不错，问题是她不能始终如一。    Opposite inconsistentadjective
What the witness said in court was not consistent with the statement he made to the police.  证人在法庭上的证供和他对警方的陈述不一致。

words.meaning: n.发现;被发现的事物
words.example:
Leonardo made many scientific discoveries.  李奥纳多有许多科学发现。
The discovery of a body in the undergrowth started a murder enquiry.  在灌木丛中发现的尸体引发了一场凶杀案调查。

words.meaning: n.小河,溪流;流,一股,一串 v.流出,涌
words.example:
There's a lovely stream that flows through their garden.  有一条美丽的小溪流过他们的花园。
She stopped rowing and let the boat float with the stream.  她不再划，任由小船顺流漂荡。noun countable
There has been a steady stream of phone calls from worried customers.  不断有忧心忡忡的顾客打电话来。

words.meaning: n.出售,上市;贱卖,廉价出售;销售额
words.example:
The sale of cigarettes/alcohol is forbidden.  禁止出售香烟／酒。
The building company get 10% commission on each house sale.  建筑公司每卖出一栋房子能获得10%的佣金。
They'll drop the price rather than lose the sale.  他们将下调价格而不是停止销售。

words.meaning: n.罐,壶
words.example:
Fill a large pot with salted water and bring it to the boil.  用一个大壶装满盐水并煮开。
There's plenty of cupboard space in the kitchen for all your pots and pans.  厨房的碗橱有足够的空间放你的盆盆罐罐。
Most lilies grow well in pots.  大多数百合花在盆中都生长良好。

words.meaning: a.盛大的,豪华的;重大的,主要的
words.example:
She has all kinds of grand ideas.  她脑子里都是些经天纬地的想法。
His job has a grand title, but he's little more than a clerk.  他的工作听起来名堂很大，可他不过是个职员。adjective
The Palace of Versailles is very grand.  凡尔赛宫非常宏伟。

words.meaning: pron.(I的物主代词)我的(东西)n.矿 v.采矿
words.example:
Your son is the same age as mine.  你儿子的年纪和我儿子一样大。
She's an old friend of mine.  她是我的一个老朋友。noun countable
My grandfather used to work in/ UKdown the mines.  我祖父以前在矿井里工作。noun countable

words.meaning: int.英(美)喂,你好(用来打招呼或引起注意)
words.example:
Hello, Paul. I haven't seen you for ages.  “你好，保罗。好久不见了。”
And a big hello (= welcome) to all the parents who've come to see the show.  非常欢迎所有来看演出的家长。
Hello, this is very strange - I know that man.  嘿，这可真奇怪——我认识那个人。

words.meaning: n.故事,传说
words.example:
He told some fascinating tales about his life in India.  他讲了他在印度生活的一些奇闻轶事。
She told me/invented/concocted a tale about missing the bus to explain her lateness.  为了解释迟到的原因，她向我讲了／编造了一通没赶上公车的鬼话。noun countable

words.meaning: n.刀,餐刀 v.用刀切,用匕首刺
words.example:
He drew/pulled a knife and stabbed her.  他拔出刀，刺中了她。noun countable (plural knives)
More and more women are choosing to go under the knife to improve their appearance.  越来越多的女性选择接受外科手术来改善容貌。noun countable (plural knives)
The knives are out for the former president.  对前总统大有剑拔弩张之势。noun countable (plural knives)

words.meaning: a.种的,种族的
words.example:
He had a vision of a society living in racial harmony.  他梦想在一个社会中各种族能和谐共处。
They are members of a racial minority.  他们属于一个少数民族。

words.meaning: n.笑话,玩笑 v.说笑话,开玩笑
words.example:
Did I tell you the joke about the chicken crossing the road?  我跟你讲过小鸡过马路的笑话吗？
She spent the evening cracking (= telling) jokes and telling funny stories.  她整个晚上都在说笑话，讲有趣的故事。
She tied his shoelaces together for a joke.  她跟他开玩笑，把他的鞋带系在一起。

words.meaning: n.上衣,外套;表皮;层,覆盖物 v.涂(盖)上
words.example:
Do your coat up, Joe, or you'll freeze.  扣好外套，乔，不然你会冻坏的。
We need a coat hook on the back of this door.  我们需要在这扇门后装一个衣钩。
I'll give the walls a quick coat of paint.  我要给墙快速上一层漆。

words.meaning: n.(疾病的)症状;(不好事情的)征兆,表征
words.example:
He's complaining of all the usual flu symptoms - a high temperature, headache and so on.  他抱怨所有常见的感冒症状——高烧、头痛等，都出现在他身上。
He's been HIV-positive for six years, but just recently he's started to develop the symptoms of AIDS.  他 HIV 病毒检测呈阳性反应已有六年了，但直到最近才开始出现爱滋病的征状。
It's her feeling that the recent outbreaks of violence are a symptom of the dissatisfaction that is currently affecting our society.  她觉得最近爆发的暴力事件，显示了目前不满的情绪正在影响我们的社会。

words.meaning: n.马铃薯,土豆
words.example: boiled/roasted/fried potatoes  煮／烤／炸马铃薯

words.meaning: vt.推进；催促 n.冲动
words.example:
The two of them seem unable to control their sexual urges.  他们两个似乎欲火焚身。
Police urged continued vigilance in the fight against crime.  警方呼吁继续保持警惕打击犯罪。
The dogs are urged into fighting more fiercely by loud shouts from the crowd.  人群里发出的高声叫喊使这些狗咬斗得更凶了。

words.meaning: n.灰尘,尘土 v.拂,掸
words.example:
The furniture was covered in dust and cobwebs.  家俱上落满了灰尘和蜘蛛网。
We thought we'd let the dust settle before discussing the other matter.  我们认为应该在形势明朗之后再讨论另一个问题。noun uncountable
Every promise they have made has turned to dust.  他们的承诺都一文不值。verb

words.meaning: v.呼吸,吸入
words.example:
It's so airless in here - I can hardly breathe.  这里太闷了——我几乎不能呼吸。
The instructor told us to breathe in deeply and then breathe out slowly.  教练让我们深吸气，然后慢慢吐气。
I'm sorry if I'm breathing (= blowing out air containing) garlic fumes all over you!  如果我口里的大蒜味儿薰着你了，我很抱歉！verb

words.meaning: v.选举,推选;选择,作出选择
words.example:
The Government is elected for a five-year term of office.  政府由选举产生，执政期为五年。
She elected to take early retirement instead of moving to the new location.  她不想前往新的工作地点，就选择了提前退休。plural noun

words.meaning: n.短上衣,茄克衫
words.example: The keys are in my jacket pocket.  锁匙在我的夹克口袋里。noun countable

words.meaning: a.高兴的,快活的;乐意的,情愿的
words.example:
We were glad about her success.  我们都为她的成功感到高兴。
I'm glad (that) you came.  你来了，我真的很高兴。
I'm glad to know the parcel arrived safely.  得知包裹安全寄到，我感到非常欣慰。

words.meaning: a.普通的,平凡的,平常的;平庸的
words.example:
Readers of the magazine said they wanted more stories about ordinary people and fewer stories about the rich and famous.  这本杂志的读者说，他们希望多刊登一些普通人的故事，少一些关于富人和名人的事情。
Her last concert appearance in Britain was no ordinary (= a very special) performance.  她在伦敦的最后一场音乐会不同凡响。
If we hadn't seen the TV programme, we would have carried on giving money to the charity in the ordinary way.  要是我们没有看这个电视节目，我们还会像往常那样给该慈善组织捐钱的。

words.meaning: v.捆扎,打包;塞满,挤满n.包裹,背包,一群/副
words.example:
We're leaving early tomorrow morning, so you'd better pack (= put clothes and other possessions into a bag or bags) tonight.  我们明天一大早就要出发，所以你最好今晚就收拾行李。
She packed a small suitcase for the weekend.  她收拾好一小箱行李准备度周末。
He just packed his bags and walked out on his wife and children.  他收拾了行李就抛下妻儿离家出走了。

words.meaning: n.铁,铁制品,烙铁,熨斗 v.熨(衣),熨平
words.example:
Iron rusts easily.  铁易生锈。
Liver is a particularly rich source of dietary iron.  肝脏中含有特别丰富的饮食铁质。
He'll probably use a 2 or 3 iron for the shot.  他这一击很可能要用2号或3号铁头球杆。UK noun

words.meaning: a.实际的,实用的
words.example:
Qualifications are important but practical experience is always an advantage.  资历固然重要，但实际经验总是个优势。
The service offers young people practical advice on finding a job.  这项服务为年轻人提供就业方面的实用建议。
What's the use of theoretical knowledge that has no practical application ?  理论知识如果没有实际应用又有甚么用呢？

words.meaning: n./v.自愿(者,兵);自愿(提供)
words.example:
The Health clinic is relying on volunteers to run the office and answer the telephones.  这家健康门诊依靠志愿者来负责办公室的日常工作和接听电话。
Since it would be a highly dangerous mission, the Lieutenant asked for volunteers.  由于那项任务非常危险，所以中尉请大家自告奋勇。
It's a volunteer army with no paid professionals.  这是一支志愿军，没有领军饷的职业军人。    Compare conscriptUK verb

words.meaning: n.独立,自主
words.example:
Mexico gained its independence from Spain in l821.  墨西哥于1821年脱离西班牙独立。
It's important that parents should allow their children some independence.  父母让子女在一定程度上独立非常重要。

words.meaning: adj. 令人惊异的；v. 使吃惊（amaze的ing形式）
words.example:
This stain remover really works - it's amazing!  这种去污剂很有效——真想不到！
The new theatre is going to cost an amazing (= very large) amount of money.  建造新剧院将耗资惊人。
It 's amazing to think that the managing director is only 23.  总经理年仅23岁，想想真让人惊叹。

words.meaning: n.前进,预付 vi.前进,进展 vt.促进,推进
words.example:
The fire advanced steadily through the forest.  大火在森林中不断蔓延。
The troops advanced on the city (= approached it, ready to attack).  军队向该城推进。
We have advanced greatly in our knowledge of the universe.  在认识宇宙方面，我们已经取得长足的进步。

words.meaning: n.震动;电击,触电;休克v.(使)震动/震惊
words.example:
Her mother's death came as a great shock - it was so unexpected.  她母亲的去世让人倍感震惊——简直太出乎意料了。
It was such a loud crash - it gave me/I got quite a shock.  轰隆一声巨响就撞上了——真把我吓了一跳。
It was a shock to see her looking so ill.  看到她病得如此厉害，真让人震惊。

words.meaning: vt.鼓舞,激起;使产生灵感
words.example:
His confident leadership inspired his followers.  他那自信的领导风采激励着他的追随者。
She inspires great loyalty among her followers.  她激起了追随者强烈的忠诚感。
The captain's heroic effort inspired them with determination.  船长的英勇行为激发了他们的决心。

words.meaning: vt.调节;整顿,调整 vi.适应(to);使调节
words.example:
If the chair is too high you can adjust it to suit you.  如果椅子太高了，你可以把它调到适合你的高度。
As a teacher you have to adjust your methods to suit the needs of slower children.  作为一名老师，你必须调整教学方法来适应那些学得较慢的孩子的需要。
She adjusted her skirt, took a deep breath and walked into the room.  她整理一下裙子，深吸一口气，走进了房间。verb

words.meaning: v.退休,引退;退却,撤退;就寝
words.example:
Since retiring from the company, she has done voluntary work for a charity.  从公司退休后，她就一直在为一间慈善机构做志愿工作。
He is due to retire as chief executive next year.  明年他就该从总裁职位上退下来了。
She retired from the competition after pulling a leg muscle.  她因腿部肌肉拉伤退出了比赛。

words.meaning: n./v.吻,接吻
words.example:
There was a young couple on the sofa, kissing passionately.  沙发上一对年轻人正在热吻。
She kissed him on the mouth.  她吻了一下他的嘴唇。
The breeze/sun kissed her bare shoulders.  微风轻拂／阳光洒照她裸露的肩膀。

words.meaning: n.病,疾病
words.example:
He died at home after a long illness.  久病之后他在家里死去。
She had five days off work due to illness.  她因病请了五天假。

words.meaning: n.便帽,军帽;盖,罩,套 v.覆盖于…顶端
words.example:
Davis has 17 Scottish caps (= has played for Scotland 17 times).  戴维斯17次代表苏格兰参赛。
The team contains five international caps.  这支队伍里有五位国际体育比赛选手。noun countable
The camera has a lens cap to protect the lens surface.  相机有镜头盖保护镜头表面。

words.meaning: n.习惯,习性,脾性
words.example:
I'm trying not to get into (= start) the habit of always having biscuits with my coffee.  我尽量避免养成喝咖啡时总是吃饼干的习惯。
His eating habits are extraordinary.  他的饮食习惯很不寻常。
I'm trying to get him to break (= end intentionally) the habit of switching on the TV when he comes home at night.  我设法让他改掉晚上一回家就打开电视的习惯。

words.meaning: n.(水果等)汁,液
words.example:
Fry the meat first to seal in the juices.  先把肉煎一煎锁住肉汁。noun
My cousin Gianni's got all the juice in this neighborhood.  我的堂哥吉安尼在这一带很有影响力。noun
This early in the morning it's hard to get the creative juices flowing (= to start thinking of good ideas).  这么一大早很难想出甚么好点子。

words.meaning: conj.无论何时,随时;每当
words.example:
Whenever I go there they seem to be in bed.  每次我去那里，他们似乎都在睡觉。
Do it in a spare moment at the weekend or whenever - it really doesn't matter.  在周末或其他别的甚么空闲时间做都行——真的没关系。
I'm talking about last July or whenever it was you got back from India.  我正在谈论你从印度回来的时间，去年七月还是其他甚么时候。UK adverb

words.meaning: v.系,贴,装,连接;使成为一部分;使依恋
words.example:
Use this cable to attach the printer to the computer.  用这条数据线连接列印机和电脑。
In Britain, packets of cigarettes come with a government health warning attached to them (= on them).  在英国，香烟的包装盒上都印有政府的健康警告。
slightly formal I attach (= am sending, usually with a letter) a copy of our latest report.  兹附上我们的最新报告一份。    Compare detachverb transitive

words.meaning: n.灾难,大祸;彻底的失败
words.example:
An inquiry was ordered into the recent rail disaster (= a serious train accident).  有关方面下令调查最近这次铁路灾难事故。
It would be a disaster for me if I lost my job.  对我而言，如果丢了工作那将是一场灾难。
This is one of the worst natural disasters ever to befall the area.  这是该地区所经历的最严重的自然灾害之一。

words.meaning: n. 停车；adj. 停车的；v. 停车（park的ing形式）；n. (Parking)人名；(英)帕金
words.example:
He was fined for illegal parking.  他因违规停车被罚款。
Parking fines are given for parking offences/violations.  违规停车要受到罚款。

words.meaning: n.老板,上司 vt.指挥,控制,发号施令
words.example:
She was the boss of a large international company.  她是一家大型跨国公司的老板。
informal Who's the boss (= the person who makes all the important decisions) in your house?  你们家谁做主？UK noun countable
It was a boss party.  那个派对棒极了。

words.meaning: a.基础的,基本的 n.(pl.)基本原则,基本原理
words.example:
We need to make fundamental changes to the way in which we treat our environment.  我们需要从根本上改变对待环境的态度。
It's one of the fundamental differences between men and women.  这是男女之间的基本差别之一。
The school is based on the fundamental principle that each child should develop its full potential.  这所学校的基本原则是充分发挥每个孩子的最大潜力。

words.meaning: n.进入,入口;通道;记载,条目
words.example:
The actress's entry into the world of politics surprised most people.  这位女演员进入了政界，这使得大多数人都感到诧异。
She made her entry to the ceremony surrounded by a group of photographers.  她在一群摄影师的簇拥下走进典礼仪式现场。
The burglars gained entry by a top window.  窃贼是从屋顶的天窗进入室内的。

words.meaning: n.君主,国王
words.example:
The lion is often called the king of the jungle.  狮子经常被称为丛林之王。
He's the new king of pop music.  他是新的流行音乐天王。noun countable
That diamond necklace must have cost a king's ransom.  那条钻石项链一定价值不菲。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: v.估价,评价;求…的值
words.example: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.  如不能对使用的研究方法有更多了解，就无法对其结果作出评价。

words.meaning: n.符号,标志;象征
words.example:
The wheel in the Indian flag is a symbol of peace.  印度国旗上的轮子象征和平。    Compare emblem
Water, a symbol of life, recurs as an image throughout her poems.  水作为生命的一种象征，在她的诗歌中反覆出现。
The symbol for oxygen is O 2.  氧的化学元素符号是 O2。

words.meaning: v.实现(计划等);达到(目的);完成(任务)
words.example:
The students accomplished the task in less than ten minutes.  学生不到十分钟就完成了任务。
She accomplished such a lot during her visit.  她在访问期间取得了丰硕的成果。

words.meaning: n.靴;(汽车后部的)行李箱;[the-]解雇
words.example:
She got the boot for stealing money from the till.  她因为从收银机里偷钱而被解雇了。
Williams has been given the boot from the team.  威廉斯已经被开除出队了。noun
He gave the ball a good boot.  他猛地踢了球一脚。noun

words.meaning: n.班长;监听器,监视器 v.监控,监测
words.example:
United Nations monitors were not allowed to enter the area.  联合国核查员没有获准进入这个地区。UK noun countable
Doctors watched the old man's heartbeat on a monitor.  医生透过萤幕监测着这个老翁的心跳。UK noun countable
The new findings suggest that women ought to monitor their cholesterol levels.  新发现显示女性应当注意她们的胆固醇浓度。

words.meaning: a.亚洲的 n.亚洲人
words.example: Asian countries hold a summit every year.  亚洲国家每年举行峰会。

words.meaning: n.招待,款待;表演文娱节目
words.example:
There's not much in the way of entertainment in this town - just the cinema and a couple of pubs.  这个城镇没多少娱乐活动——也就只有这家影院和几家酒馆。
formal This season's entertainments include five new plays and several concerts of Chinese and Indian music.  这一季的演出节目包括五部新剧和几场中国和印度音乐的音乐会。

words.meaning: n.豆;菜豆,蚕豆
words.example: Coffee beans are the bean-like seeds of the coffee tree.  咖啡豆是咖啡树结的豆形种子。noun countable

words.meaning: n.人,动物;生物
words.example:
Rain forests are filled with amazing creatures.  雨林中满是奇异的生灵。
Don't all living creatures have certain rights?  难道不是一切生物都具有某些权利吗？
Blue whales are the largest creatures ever to have lived.  蓝鲸是有生命以来最大的动物。

words.meaning: a.数字的;数位的;手指的 n.数字
words.example: digital data  数字信息

words.meaning: n.整理,排列;安排
words.example:
They'd made all the arrangements for the party.  他们为聚会作好了一切准备。
What are your current child-care arrangements?  目前你的孩子怎么照顾？
I'm sure we can come to an arrangement (= reach an agreement).  我确信我们之间可以达成协议。

words.meaning: v.(on)集中,专心;浓缩 n.浓缩物
words.example:
Come on, concentrate! We haven't got all day to do this.  快点，集中精神！我们可没有一整天时间来做这件事。
I'm going to concentrate on my writing for a while.  我要专心写作一会儿。
The company is concentrating (its resources) on developing new products.  公司正在集中力量开发新产品。verb UK COME TOGETHER  聚集

words.meaning: a.通常的；平常的
words.example:
There was more rainfall than usual this summer in the mountain areas.  山区今年夏天的降雨量比往年多。
You'll find the cutlery in its usual place.  你可以在平常放食具的地方找到刀叉食具。
Terry was, as usual, slow to respond.  泰瑞一向反应迟钝。

words.meaning: n.愤怒,气愤 vt.使发怒,激怒 vi.发怒
words.example:
There is a danger that anger at the new law may turn into anti-government feeling.  存在着一种危险，即对于新颁布的法律的怨愤可能会转化成反政府情绪。
The people showed no surprise or anger at their treatment.  人们对他们的遭遇没有表现出任何意外和愤怒。
He found it hard to contain (= control) his anger.  他感到怒不可遏。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: ad.近似地，大约
words.example: The job will take approximately three weeks, and cost approximately £1000.  这项工作大概需时三周，费用为1000英镑左右。

words.meaning: n.导弹,发射物
words.example:
Missile attacks on the capital resumed at dawn.  针对首都的导弹袭击在黎明时又重新开始了。
Stones, bottles and other missiles were thrown at the police.  石块、瓶子和其他投掷物纷纷扔向员警。

words.meaning: n.金属线,电线;电报,电信 v.发电报(给)
words.example:
Someone had cut the telephone wires.  有人切断了电话线。
Don't touch those wires whatever you do.  无论如何都别碰那些导线。
During the war he spent three years behind the wire (= in prison).  战争期间他蹲了三年监狱。UK noun

words.meaning: a.圆的prep.围绕ad.在周围v.绕行n.(一)回合
words.example:
The Moon goes round the Earth.  月球围绕地球转。
We ran round (the outside of the house) to the back, looking for the dog.  我们跑到房子后面去找狗。
The idea has been going round and round in my head all day (= I can't stop thinking about it).  这个想法一整天都萦绕在我心头。

words.meaning: a.神圣的,圣洁的
words.example: Holy cow! How did you get that black eye?  天哪！你的眼睛怎么瘀血了？

words.meaning: a.双的,成对的,孪生的 n.孪生子,双生子
words.example:
My sister has twin sons.  我姐姐有对双胞胎儿子。
The two countries are often regarded as economic twins.  这两个国家经常被认为经济情况很相似。adjective [before noun]
Cambridge is twinned with Heidelberg.  剑桥和海德堡结成了姊妹城。

words.meaning: n./v.命令,指挥,控制 n.掌握,运用能力
words.example:
You will run forward at (= when you hear) my command.  听到我的命令你们就向前冲。
When I give the command, fire!  我一下命令就开火！
He hated being in the army because he had to obey commands.  他讨厌当兵，因为当兵必须服从命令。

words.meaning: n.早餐 v.(给某人)吃早餐
words.example:
What do you want for breakfast?  你早餐想吃甚么?
Jane never eats breakfast.  简从来不吃早餐。
She arrived shortly after breakfast.  她早餐后不久就到了。

words.meaning: n.运气;好运,侥幸
words.example:
It was just luck that I asked for a job at the right time.  真是机缘巧合，我刚好在合适的时机开口说想找份工作。
Then I met this gorgeous woman and I couldn't believe my luck.  后来我碰到了这个出色的女人，我不敢相信自己的运气有这么好。
She wears a charm that she thinks brings her good luck.  她戴了一个她认为会给自己带来好运的护身符。

words.meaning: a.固定的,持续的,忠实的 n.常数,恒量
words.example:
He's in constant trouble with the police.  他与警方麻烦不断。
We've kept up a fairly constant speed.  我们保持了比较平稳的速度。
The fridge keeps food at a constant temperature.  冰箱在恒温下保存食物。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.诊所
words.example:
Bring your baby to the clinic and we'll take a look at her.  把你的宝宝带到诊所来，我们帮她检查一下。
Antenatal clinics provide care for pregnant women.  产前检查诊所为孕妇提供医疗服务。noun countable
Dr Clark holds a clinic on Tuesday mornings.  克拉克医生每周二上午门诊。    UK

words.meaning: n.气味;嗅觉 v.嗅,闻到;散发(…的)气味
words.example:
My hands smell UKof / USlike onions.  我手上有洋葱味。
That cake smells good.  那蛋糕闻起来不错。
There's something in the fridge that smells mouldy.  冰箱里有东西闻起来发霉了。

words.meaning: a.神经的;神经过敏的,紧张不安的
words.example:
Do you feel/get nervous during exams?  考试时，你感到紧张吗？
She's always been nervous around dogs.  她一直很怕狗。
He had/was of a nervous disposition.  他是个神经质的人。

words.meaning: n.旅游者,观光客;巡回比赛的运动员
words.example:
Millions of tourists visit Rome every year.  每年有数百万游客来到罗马。
Hordes (= very large groups) of tourists flock to the Mediterranean each year.  每年都有潮水般的游客涌向地中海。
Disneyworld is one of Florida's major tourist attractions.  迪士尼乐园是佛罗里达州的主要旅游景点之一。

words.meaning: v.埋(葬),安葬;埋藏,遮盖
words.example:
His father is buried in the cemetery on the hill.  他的父亲葬在山上的墓地里。
The dog trotted off to bury its bone.  那只狗颠儿颠儿地跑到一边去埋它的骨头。
If an avalanche strikes, skiers can be buried alive by snow.  如果发生雪崩，滑雪者可能会被雪活埋。

words.meaning: v.请求,恳求;祈祷,祈求
words.example:
She knelt and prayed silently.  她跪下默默祈祷。
Let us pray for the victims of this terrible disaster.  让我们为这次可怕灾难的受害者祈祷吧。
formal You must pray (= ask for) God's forgiveness for what you have done.  你必须祈求上帝宽恕你的所作所为。

words.meaning: n.西红柿
words.example: Tomato and egg is a classic dish.  番茄炒蛋是经典菜。

words.meaning: n.黄油,奶油 v.涂黄油于…上
words.example:
We were served scones with butter and jam.  我们吃的是涂有奶油和果酱的烤饼。
Have some bread and butter (= bread spread with butter).  吃些奶油面包片吧。
Tommy looked as if butter wouldn't melt in his mouth.  汤美装出一副老实相。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.浴室;盥洗室,卫生间
words.example:
Where's the bathroom?  厕所在哪里？UK noun countable
Wait a moment, - I just need to go to the bathroom.  等一下，我要去厕所。

words.meaning: a.电子的
words.example: an electronic keyboard/game  电子键盘／游戏

words.meaning: n.旅行,旅程 v.旅行
words.example:
It's a two-hour train journey from York to London.  从约克到伦敦乘火车需要两个小时。
We broke our journey (= stopped for a short time) in Edinburgh before travelling on to Inverness the next day.  我们在爱丁堡稍作停留，第二天继续踏上旅途去印威内斯。
Did you have a good journey?  你的旅途愉快吗？

words.meaning: n.名誉,名声,声望
words.example:
The company has a worldwide reputation for quality.  这间公司的产品质量誉满全球。
She has the reputation of being a good doctor.  作为一名优秀的医生，她很有声望。
His reputation was destroyed when he was caught stealing some money.  他偷钱时被当场抓住，这使他名声扫地。

words.meaning: n.混合;混合物,混合剂
words.example:
The mixture of flour, water and yeast is then left in a warm place for four hours.  然后将面粉、水和酵母的混合物放在暖和的地方发酵四小时。
Their latest CD is a mixture of new and old songs.  他们最新的唱片中收录了新歌和老歌。

words.meaning: n.塔 v.高耸
words.example:
There's a clock on the church tower.  教堂塔楼上有一座钟。
He works in an office tower in downtown San Francisco.  他在旧金山市中心的一座高层办公大楼里工作。
Polly was a tower of strength to me when I was ill.  我生病时，波莉就是我的精神支柱。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n.烟,烟尘;吸烟,抽烟 v.抽(烟);冒烟,冒气
words.example:
The fire produced a pall (= large mass) of smoke visible twenty miles away.  大火产生的大团烟雾在20哩之外都能看见。
Plumes of smoke billowed from the chimney.  滚滚浓烟从烟囱里冒出来。
She leaned back thoughtfully and blew a puff of (= a small amount of) smoke into the air.  她若有所思地向后靠去，吐出了一口烟。

words.meaning: a.纯的,纯洁的;纯理论的,抽象的;完全的
words.example:
The mountain air was wonderfully pure.  山上的空气极为纯净。
Tap water is never chemically pure.  自来水绝对不是化学上的纯水。    Opposite impureUK adjective
It was pure coincidence/chance that we met.  我们见面纯属巧合。

words.meaning: v.(at,over)扫视 n.匆匆看,一瞥,一眼
words.example:
She glanced around/round the room to see who was there.  她扫视了一眼房间，看看谁在里面。
He glanced up from his book as I passed.  我走过的时候，正埋头读书的他抬头瞥了我一眼。
Could you glance over/through this letter and see if it's alright?  你能不能看一下这封信，看看写得好不好？UK verb

words.meaning: n.尺寸,尺度;维(数),度(数)
words.example:
Please specify the dimensions (= the height, length and width) of the room.  请明确说明房间的大小。
His personality has several dimensions.  他是个有多重性格的人。
These weapons add a new dimension to modern warfare.  这些武器为现代战争增添了一个新的特点。

words.meaning: n.玩具 vi.(with)漫不经心地考虑;摆弄
words.example:
Put your toys away now - it's time for bed.  现在把玩具收拾好——该睡觉了。
Leave daddy's camera alone - it isn't a toy!  别碰爸爸的照相机——它不是玩具！
His latest toy is a mobile phone.  他的新玩意是一部手机。

words.meaning: n.囚犯
words.example:
Prisoners climbed onto the prison roof to protest at the conditions inside the prison.  犯人们爬上监狱屋顶对监狱里的条件环境表示抗议。
Of 10 000 troops, 7000 were killed, wounded or taken prisoner.  1万人的军队中，有7000人阵亡、受伤或被俘。
The pilot and several passengers were held prisoner by the gunmen for 57 hours.  飞行员和几名乘客被持枪歹徒扣押了57个小时。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.人,家伙;伙伴,同事 a.同样的,同事的
words.example:
She introduced me to some of her fellow students.  她把我介绍给她的几位同班同学。
Our fellow travellers were mostly Spanish-speaking tourists.  和我们同行的旅伴大多是讲西班牙语的游客。UK noun countable
He seemed like a decent sort of a fellow.  他似乎是个正派的人。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.光滑的;顺利的;柔和的 v.(over)掩饰
words.example:
This custard is deliciously smooth and creamy.  这种蛋塔细腻润滑、香浓可口。
Mix together the butter and sugar until smooth.  把奶油和糖混合调匀。
The road ahead was flat and smooth.  前面的路平坦光滑。

words.meaning: a.附近的 ad.在附近 prep.在…附近
words.example:
If there's a cafe nearby, we could stop for a snack.  如果附近有小餐馆的话，我们可以停下来吃点东西。
We stopped at some nearby shops to buy some food.  我们顺路在附近的一些商店里买了些食物。

words.meaning: n.全体人员,全体职员;人事(部门)
words.example:
The new director is likely to make major changes in personnel.  新主管可能会在人事上做出大变动。
Personnel will help you find a flat to rent.  人事部会帮你租一个公寓。
For more information about the job, please contact the personnel manager.  如欲了解这份工作的详情，请联络人事部经理。

words.meaning: n. 教育家；教育工作者；教师
words.example: The educator devoted her life to teaching.  这位教育家毕生献身教育。

words.meaning: a.相对的,比较的,有关系的 n.亲戚,关系词
words.example:
All her close/distant relatives came to the wedding.  她所有的近亲／远亲都来参加她的婚礼了。UK adjective formal
We weighed up the relative advantages of driving there or going by train.  我们权衡了一下，看看开车去那里和乘火车去哪种方式更有利。
Since I got a job, I've been living in relative comfort (= more comfort than before).  自从我有了工作，日子过得就相对舒适一些了。UK adjective formal

words.meaning: n. 外来移民；移居
words.example:
There are strict limits on immigration (into the country).  （该国）对入境移民有着严格的限制。
After you've been through immigration (control) , you can go and get your luggage.  通过移民局入境检查之后，你就可以去取行李了。

words.meaning: n.(皮)带,腰带;地带
words.example:
She fastened her belt tightly around her waist.  她把腰带束紧。
He had eaten so much that he had to undo his belt a couple of notches.  他吃得太多，不得不把腰带放松几个扣。noun
Basic computer skills are a good thing to have under your belt.  掌握基本的电脑使用技巧对你有好处，将来说不定有用。verb

words.meaning: n.生日;(成方)纪念日
words.example:
Happy birthday!  生日快乐！
Are you going to Ellen's birthday party next week?  下周你会参加爱伦的生日派对吗？
It's her 21st birthday.  这是她21岁的生日。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.海岸,海滨
words.example:
Rimini is a thriving holiday resort on the east coast of Italy.  里米尼是义大利东岸一个繁华的渡假胜地。
The accident happened three miles off the coast (= in the sea three miles from land).  意外发生在距离海岸三英里的海域。
We spent a week by/on the coast (= by the sea).  我们在海滨渡过了一个星期。

words.meaning: v.陪伴,陪同;伴随,和...一起发生,伴奏
words.example:
The course books are accompanied by four cassettes.  这些课本配有四盒录音带。
Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.  忧郁症几乎总是和失眠分不开。
The salmon was accompanied by (= served with) a fresh green salad.  那道鲑鱼菜佐以新鲜的蔬菜沙拉。

words.meaning: n.银;银器;银币 v.镀银
words.example:
We gave Alison and Tom a dish made of solid silver as a wedding present.  我们送给爱丽森和汤姆一个纯银盘子作为结婚礼物。
Cleaning the silver (= silver objects) is a dirty job.  擦洗银器是一件很讨厌的事。
Shall we use the silver (= utensils made of silver) for dinner tonight?  今天晚餐要用银餐具吗?

words.meaning: n.十几岁的青少年
words.example: The magazine is aimed at teenagers and young adults.  这份杂志的读者对像是青少年和二十来岁的成年人。

words.meaning: n.旗
words.example:
Flags of all the participating countries are flying outside the stadium.  所有参赛国家的国旗都挂在体育场外。
Flags were flapping/fluttering in the breeze.  旗子在和风中飘扬。
The guard waved his flag and the train pulled away from the station.  护卫挥旗示意，火车从车站驶离。noun countable

words.meaning: v.耳语;私下说,偷偷告诉 n.耳语;传闻
words.example:
Sheleaned over and whispered something in his ear.  她俯身对他耳语了些甚么。
What are you twogirls whispering about?  你们两个女孩子在窃窃私语些甚么？
It's rude towhisper!  窃窃私语是不礼貌的！UK verb

words.meaning: n.绅士,先生
words.example:
Ladies and gentlemen, the show is about to begin.  各位先生女士，演出就要开始了。
Excuse me, this gentleman has a question for you.  对不起，这位先生要问你个问题。
He was a perfect gentleman.  他是个极有修养的君子。

words.meaning: n.谷物,庄稼,玉米
words.example: Everyone says it's a great movie, but I think it's just corn.  人人都说这是部好电影，但我觉得无非又是老一套。

words.meaning: n.(加the)月球,月亮;卫星
words.example:
What time does the moon rise/set (= appear/disappear in the sky) ?  月亮何时升起／落下？
There's no moon (= You cannot see the moon) tonight.  今晚没有月亮。
Jupiter has at least sixteen moons.  木星至少有16颗卫星。noun

words.meaning: a./n.年少的/者,三年级的/学生,下级(的)
words.example:
Lewis has just moved up to the juniors.  路易士刚上小学。UK noun
Saturday morning sessions are for juniors only.  周六早上的课节只为大学三年级学生而设。
My brother is five years my junior.  我弟弟比我小五岁。

words.meaning: n.咽喉,嗓子
words.example:
He cleared his throat (= coughed so he could speak more clearly) and started speaking.  他清了清嗓子，然后开始讲话。UK noun countable
Those two are always at each other's throats.  那两人总是吵个没完。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.薪金,薪水
words.example:
His net monthly salary is £1500.  他每月薪资净领1500英镑。
She's on quite a good/decent salary in her present job.  她目前的工作薪水相当丰厚。
He took a drop in (= accepted a lower) salary when he changed jobs.  换工作时，他接受了较低的薪水。

words.meaning: v.摇摆,摇荡,回转,旋转 n.秋千;摇摆,摆动
words.example:
He walked briskly along the path swinging his rolled-up umbrella.  他摇着收起的伞，步履轻快地走在路上。
The door swung open.  门开了。
His mood swings between elation and despair.  他情绪多变，一下子兴高采烈，一下子又伤心绝望。verb (swung, swung)

words.meaning: n.作物,庄稼;(谷类等的)一熟收成;一批,大量
words.example:
The main crops grown for export are coffee and rice.  主要的出口作物是咖啡和大米。
The judges will select the best from this year's crop of first novels.  评委们将从今年的一批处女作小说中选出最出色的一部。UK noun
She's had a very short crop.  她留着很短的平头。UK noun

words.meaning: v.挖,掘
words.example:
Digging (in) the garden is good exercise.  在花园里挖土是一种很好的锻炼。
The tunnel was dug with the aid of heavy machinery.  在重型机械的帮助下，隧道挖通了。
The dog was digging a hole to hide its bone in.  狗正在刨坑以便把骨头藏起来。verb (digging, dug, dug)

words.meaning: a.永久的,持久的
words.example:
She is looking for a permanent place to stay.  她正在寻找一个固定的住所。
Are you looking for a temporary or a permanent job?  你是想找一份临时的还是固定的工作？
The disease can cause permanent damage to the brain.  这种疾病可能导致大脑永久性损伤。

words.meaning: n.现象,稀有现象,珍品,奇迹,杰出人才
words.example:
Gravity is a natural phenomenon.  重力是一种自然现象。
Do you believe in the paranormal and other psychic phenomena?  你相信超自然及其他通灵现象吗？
There's evidence to suggest that child abuse is not just a recent phenomenon.  有证据显示虐待儿童并不是近来才有的现象。UK US  (plural phenomena)

words.meaning: n.挂念,焦虑,焦急,忧虑;渴望,热望
words.example:
Children normally feel a lot of anxiety about their first day at school.  第一天上学，孩子通常都会感到非常不安。
That explains his anxiety over his health.  那就是他担心自己健康的原因。
Her son is a source of considerable anxiety.  她的儿子总让她很放心不下。

words.meaning: a.不同的,不相似的 prep.不象,和…不同
words.example:
Dan's actually quite nice, unlike his father.  丹可不像他父亲，他实际上人很不错。
Unlike you, I'm not a great dancer.  我可不像你，我不太会跳舞。preposition
It's unlike you to be quiet - is something wrong?  这么安静可不是你的风格——出甚么事了吗？

words.meaning: a.湿的,潮湿的;有雨的,多雨的 v.弄湿,沾湿
words.example:
My bike got wet in the rain.  我的脚踏车在雨中淋湿了。
informal You poor thing - you're all (= very) wet.  你这个可怜的家伙——全身都淋湿了。
The paint's still wet.  油漆还未亁。

words.meaning: v.抵抗,反抗;抗,忍得住,抵制
words.example:
The soldiers resisted (the enemy attacks) for two days.  （面对敌人的进攻）士兵们抵抗了两天。
The party leader resisted demands for his resignation.  该党领导人拒不答应他辞职的要求。
He tried to run away from the police and was charged with resisting arrest.  警方逮捕他时，他企图逃跑，结果被控拒捕。

words.meaning: vt.协助,帮助,促进 vi.帮忙,参加
words.example:
The army arrived to assist in the search.  军队赶到协助搜寻。
You will be expected to assist the editor with the selection of illustrations for the book.  希望你能帮助编辑为此书挑选插图。

words.meaning: n.展览会;陈列,展览
words.example:
The photographs will be on exhibition until the end of the month.  这些照片将一直展出到月底。
There's a new exhibition of sculpture on at the city gallery.  市立美术馆正在举行一场新的雕塑作品展。
The athlete's third, and winning, jump was an exhibition of skill and strength.  这个运动员的第三次试跳，也是获胜的那一跳，充分展示了他的技巧和体能。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: v.建设,建造,构造;创立
words.example:
The walls are constructed of concrete.  墙是用混凝土建成的。
His reputation as an eccentric is largely a media construct.  他行为古怪的名声多半源于媒体的杜撰。

words.meaning: n.平底锅,盘子,面板
words.example:
Heat the milk in a small pan.  用小平底锅把牛奶煮热。
This dishwasher even washes pots and pans (= different types of pan).  这个洗碗机还能洗各种锅罐。
We don't want to see our business go down the pan.  我们不想看到自己的生意完蛋。verb (-nn-)

words.meaning: n.会诊医师,顾问医生;顾问
words.example: a management/financial/computer consultant  管理／财务／电脑顾问

words.meaning: n.需要考虑的事,理由;考虑,思考;体谅,照顾
words.example:
After some consideration, we've decided to sell the house.  一番斟酌之后，我们决定卖掉房子。
The whole matter needs (to be given) careful consideration.  整件事需要仔细考虑。noun
It may be fairly cheap to buy, but you've got to take into consideration the money you'll spend on repairs.  买它可能很便宜，但你得考虑你要花多少修理费。

words.meaning: a.(from,against)安全的,放心的v.得到;防护
words.example:
That ladder doesn't look very secure to me.  那梯子我看不太稳固。
Check that all windows and doors are secure.  检查一下，看门窗是否都关紧了。
figurative Her promotion has made her position in the company more secure.  她的升职使她在公司的地位更加稳固。

words.meaning: n.粉红色 a.粉红色的
words.example:
Have you been in the sun? Your nose is a bit pink.  你晒太阳了吗？你的鼻子有点发红。adjective
She's very fond of pink.  她很喜欢粉红色。noun

words.meaning: n.诗
words.example: The poet recited some of her recent poems.  诗人朗诵了她最近写的几首诗。

words.meaning: n.祖母,外祖母
words.example: My grandmother can read English.  我奶奶能看懂英文。

words.meaning: n.事业,企(事)业单位;事业心,进取心
words.example:
Don't forget this is a commercial enterprise - we're here to make money.  不要忘记这是一个商业组织——我们到这儿来是为了赚钱的。
Those were the years of private enterprise (= businesses being run privately, rather than by the government) , when lots of small businesses were started.  那是一个私人企业的时代，许多小公司就是那时创建的。
Her latest enterprise (= plan) is to climb Mount Everest.  她最新的雄心壮志是攀登圣母峰。UK noun

words.meaning: n.(favour)好感;喜爱;关切v.赞成,支持,偏爱
words.example: Do me a favor and close the door.  帮我关下门。

words.meaning: n.胃,胃口;肚子,腹部vt.承受,忍受
words.example:
He was punched in the stomach.  他的肚子挨了一拳。
The doctor asked him to lie down on his stomach.  医生要他俯卧。
The sight of blood always churns/turns my stomach (= makes me feel as if I am going to vomit).  看见血总会令我反胃。

words.meaning: a.表面上的,貌似真实的;显然的,明明白白的
words.example:
Her unhappiness was apparent to everyone.  谁都看得出她很不开心。
There are one or two apparent discrepancies between the two reports.  这两份报告看上去有一两处出入。
She has this apparent innocence which, I suspect, she uses to her advantage.  她貌似天真，但我认为，这只是对她有利的伪装。

words.meaning: v.称…重量,称;重达;考虑,权衡
words.example:
Yesterday a satellite weighing 15 tonnes was successfully placed in orbit.  昨天一颗重15公吨的卫星被成功送入了轨道。
Your luggage must be weighed before it is put on the aircraft.  你的行李在送上飞机之前必须要称重。verb
Easy access to a railway network weighed heavily with us when we chose a site for the new factory.  我们选择新工厂的厂址时，能否离铁路网比较近，对我们非常重要。verb

words.meaning: a.(to)敏感的,易受伤害的;灵敏的
words.example:
Her reply showed that she was very sensitive to criticism.  她的回答显示她对批评很敏感。
He was very sensitive about his scar and thought everyone was staring at him.  他对自己的伤疤很敏感，以为每个人都在盯着他看。
Sex education and birth control are sensitive issues.  性教育和计划生育都是敏感的话题。

words.meaning: n.建议,意见;细微的迹象;暗示,联想
words.example: She made some very helpful suggestions but her boss rejected them all.  她提了些很有帮助的建议，但被她的老板全部否定了。

words.meaning: n.邮件 v.邮寄
words.example:
She spent the morning reading and answering her mail.  她花了一个上午处理信件。
All of our customers will be contacted by mail.  我们利用邮件方式联络所有的客户。
The book came in yesterday's mail.  书是昨天寄达的。

words.meaning: n.烹饪法,食谱;诀窍,方法
words.example:
For real South Asian food, just follow these recipes.  要做地道的印度饭菜，只需遵照这些食谱即可。
Do you know a good recipe for wholemeal bread?  你知不知道怎样做很棒的全麦面包？noun countable
All those children unsupervised sounds to me like a recipe for disaster.  那些孩子全都没人看管，在我听来这会出大乱子。

words.meaning: a.合理的,有道理的;通情达理的;适度的
words.example:
If you tell him what happened, I'm sure he'll understand - he's a reasonable man.  如果你把发生的事情说给他听，我相信他肯定会理解的——他是个通情达理的人。
He went free because the jury decided there was a reasonable doubt about his guilt.  他没有被判罪，因为陪审团认定指控他犯罪的证据不足。
We had a reasonable journey.  我们去了一次不错的旅行。

words.meaning: n.准备,预备;制剂,制备品
words.example:
The teacher didn't seem to have done much preparation for the class.  看来这位教师这堂课准备得不是太充分。
The team blamed injuries and lack of preparation for their failure to win.  这支球队把他们未能获胜归咎于受伤和准备不充分。
Yasmin assisted in the preparation of this article.  亚斯明帮忙做了一些这篇文章的准备工作。

words.meaning: n.音乐会,演奏会;一齐,一致
words.example:
She was appearing in concert at Carnegie Hall.  她参加了在卡内基音乐厅的演出。    formal
If the member countries would act in concert, the problem might be solved more easily.  如果成员国行动一致，这个问题可能会更容易解决。

words.meaning: a.侵略的,好斗的,有进取心的,敢作敢为的
words.example:
Men tend to be more aggressive than women.  男性往往比女性更具有攻击性。
If I criticize him, he gets aggressive and starts shouting.  如果我批评他，他就会寻衅大吵大闹。
Both players both won their first-round matches in aggressive style.  两名选手都以全力以赴、志在必得的打法赢得了第一轮比赛。

words.meaning: a.谬误的,虚伪的,伪造的,假的
words.example:
Modern office buildings have false floors, under which computer and telephone wires can be laid.  现代办公楼都设有假地板，下面铺设电脑和电话线路。UK adjective
She was charged with giving false evidence in court.  她被控在法庭上作伪证。
When she was stopped by the police for speeding, she gave them a false name and address.  因超速驾驶被员警截停时，她报上假的姓名和地址。

words.meaning: n.意图,意向,目的
words.example:
I've no intention of changing my plans just to fit in with his.  我不打算改变自己的计划来迁就他。
He's full of good intentions, but he never does anything about them!  他有很多好的打算，但从未有过实际行动！

words.meaning: n.海峡,水道;信道,波道;路线,途径
words.example:
She switched/turned to another channel to watch the football.  她换到另一个频道看足球比赛。noun countable
There are drainage/irrigation channels all over this flat agricultural land.  在这片平坦的农田上遍布着排水／灌溉渠。
The boats all have to pass through this narrow channel.  所有船只都必须通过这条狭窄的航道。

words.meaning: a.末端的,尽头的;极度的 n.极端;最大程度
words.example:
In extreme cases , the disease can lead to blindness.  这种疾病最严重可导致失明。adjective
He has rather extreme views.  他的观点很偏激。
He's on the extreme right-wing of the party.  他属于这个政党的极右翼势力。adjective

words.meaning: n.管,软管;电子管,显像管;地铁
words.example:
Gases produced in the reaction pass through this tube and can then be collected.  反应中产生的气体透过这个管子就可以收集起来。
What's on the tube this weekend?  这个周末有甚么电视节目？UK noun
If business doesn't pick up soon, the company will go down the tubes.  如果生意近期没有起色的话，公司将会倒闭。UK noun

words.meaning: v.离开,退出;停止,放弃,辞职
words.example:
Would you quit your job if you inherited lots of money?  假如继承了一大笔钱，你会辞掉工作吗？
Quit wasting my time!  别浪费我的时间！
Press Q to quit the program.  请按Q结束程式。

words.meaning: n.缺乏,不存在;缺席,不在场;缺席的时间
words.example:
She has had repeated absences from work this year.  今年她屡次旷工。noun
He drew attention to the absence of concrete evidence against the defendant.  他使大家注意到，并不存在可以证明被告有罪的确凿证据。
In the absence of (= because there were not) more suitable candidates, we decided to offer the job to Mr Conway.  由于没有更为合适的人选，我们决定把这个工作机会给康韦先生。noun

words.meaning: a.诚实的,正直的,老实的
words.example:
She's completely honest.  她很诚实。
I'd like you to give me an honest answer/your honest opinion.  我希望你给我一个诚实的回答／坦诚的意见。
He had an honest face (= He looked like he could be trusted).  他看起来忠厚可信。

words.meaning: n.步,步伐,步调,速度 v.踱步,用步测
words.example:
When she thought she heard someone following her, she quickened her pace.  她觉得听见有人在尾随她，便加快了脚步。
Could you slow down a bit - I can't keep pace with (= walk or run as fast as) you.  您能走慢一点吗——我跟不上您。
For many years this company has set the pace (= has been the most successful company) in the communications industry.  多年来该公司在电讯业一直处于领导地位。

words.meaning: n.说话者,发言者;说某种语言者;扬声器
words.example:
He served for eight years as Speaker of the House of Representatives.  他做了八年的众议院议长。
[as form of address] Mr Speaker, my honourable friend has failed to consider the consequences of his proposal.  议长阁下，我尊敬的朋友没有考虑到他提案的后果。
Please join with me in thanking our guest speaker tonight.  请大家和我一起向今晚的特别演讲人表示感谢。

words.meaning: n.印象,感想;盖印,压痕
words.example:
What was your impression of Charlotte's husband?  你对夏洛特的丈夫印象如何？
He was under the mistaken (= false) impression (that) you were married.  他误以为你结婚了。noun
It makes/gives/creates a very bad impression if you're late for an interview.  面试如果迟到会给人留下很坏的印象。

words.meaning: n.文章,短文
words.example:
For homework I want you to write an essay on endangered species.  我想让你们写一篇关于濒危物种的文章作为作业。verb transitive /eˈseɪ/    old-fashioned
The procedure was first essayed in 1923.  1923年有人首次尝试这种做法。

words.meaning: n.饼,糕,蛋糕;扁平的块状物
words.example:
Would you like a piece of/a slice of/some cake?  你想来块／片／点蛋糕吗？
He made/baked a delicious cake.  他做／烤了个美味的蛋糕。
You can't have your cake and eat it - if you want more local services, you can't expect to pay less tax.  你不能二者兼得——想获得更多的地方服务就不能指望少付税金。noun

words.meaning: v.商订;谈判,洽谈,交涉
words.example:
The government has refused to negotiate with the strikers.  政府拒绝与罢工者谈判。
I'm negotiating for a new contract.  我正在为签订一份新合同进行协商。
I've managed to negotiate (= get by discussion) a five per cent pay increase with my boss.  透过与老板协商，我的薪水将提高5%。UK verb

words.meaning: a.流行的n.(发出)砰的一声 v.突然出现
words.example:
What do you want to listen to - jazz, classical or pop?  你想听甚么——爵士乐、古典音乐还是流行音乐？
The song reached No. 32 in the pop charts.  这首歌升到了流行音乐排行榜的第32位。
She wants to be a pop singer/star like Madonna.  她想成为一名像玛丹娜那样的流行歌手／歌星。UK noun

words.meaning: n.专家
words.example:
She's a specialist in modern French literature.  她是现代法国文学专家。
She's a specialist in childhood illnesses.  她是小儿科专家。
I've asked to be referred to a specialist about my back pain.  我已经要求转诊，让专科医生来治我的背痛。

words.meaning: n.起源,由来;出身,来历
words.example:
It's a book about the origin of the universe.  这是一本关于宇宙起源的书。
Her unhappy childhood was the origin of her problems later in life.  她不幸的童年导致她后来生活中的诸多问题。
The story has obscure origins (= No one knows how it started).  这个故事的起源已不可考。

words.meaning: n.批准,通过;赞成,同意
words.example:
He showed his approval by smiling broadly.  他持赞成的态度，这从他开心的微笑就看得出来。
Alan is someone who always needs the approval of other people.  艾伦这个人做甚么事都希望得到别人的赞许。
Sam always tried hard to win his father's approval.  萨姆总是尽一切努力去赢得父亲的赞赏。

words.meaning: vt.忠告,劝告,建议;通知,告知
words.example:
His doctor advised him against smoking.  他的医生劝他戒烟。
I'd strongly advise against making a sudden decision.  我会极力奉劝不要草率作出决定。
She advises the President (= gives information and suggests types of action) on African policy.  她是总统的非洲政策顾问。

words.meaning: a.惯例的,常规的
words.example: disapproving I find his art rather dull and conventional.  我觉得他的艺术作品乏味俗套。    Opposite unconventional

words.meaning: n.深,深度,深奥,深刻
words.example:
There are very few fish at depths (= distances below the surface) below 3000 metres.  水下3000米处很少有鱼。
The river froze to a depth of over a metre.  河面冰层厚度超过一米。
The ship sank slowly to the depths of the ocean.  那艘船慢慢沉入大洋深处。noun

words.meaning: n.财富,财产;大量
words.example:
During a successful business career, she accumulated a great amount of wealth.  在成功的经商生涯中，她积累了巨额财富。noun
Jim has a wealth of teaching experience.  吉姆有丰富的教学经验。
Russia has a wealth of coal and timber.  俄罗斯有丰富的煤炭和木材资源。

words.meaning: n. 残疾；无能；无资格；不利条件
words.example:
She is deaf, but refuses to let her disability prevent her from doing what she wants to do.  虽然她的耳朵听不见声音，但她却并没有让这一残疾妨碍她去做自己想做的事情。
Trying to change attitudes to disability is an uphill struggle.  改变对待残疾的态度是一项艰苦的工作。    Compare inability

words.meaning: n.洋葱
words.example: Fry the onion and garlic for about two minutes.  把洋葱和大蒜炒大约两分钟。

words.meaning: a.平坦的,扁平的,平淡的 n.一套房间;平面
words.example:
An ice rink needs to be completely flat.  溜冰场地必须十分平坦。
Roll out the pastry on a flat surface.  在平的面板上把油酥面团擀薄。
Much of the countryside in East Anglia is very flat.  英吉利亚东部的许多乡村都地势平坦。adjective (flatter, flattest)

words.meaning: n.商标,标记,牌子 v.使铭记;打火印,打烙印
words.example:
This isn't my usual brand of deodorant.  这不是我通常用的那个牌子的除臭剂。
When I go to a supermarket I usually buy own (US store / Australian generic)brands (= the cheaper products with the shop's own name on them).  我去超市时常常购买超市的自家品牌产品。
Do you like his brand of humour?  你喜欢他那种幽默吗？noun countable

words.meaning: a.发疯的;狂热的,着迷的;恼火的,生气的
words.example:
Do I look like some mad old woman in this hat?  我戴上这顶帽子看上去像个疯老太婆吗？
He must be mad spending all that money on a coat.  他一定是疯了，花那么多钱买一件外套。
Some of the things she does are completely mad.  她做的一些事情极其愚蠢。

words.meaning: vt.授予,给予;判定 n.奖,奖金;仲裁
words.example:
Carlos was awarded first prize in the essay competition.  卡洛斯获颁短文写作比赛第一名。
The jury awarded libel damages of £100 000.  陪审团作出裁定，判给受害人名誉损害赔偿金十万英镑。
They have authorized awards of £900 to each of the victims.  他们判给每一位受害者900英镑赔偿金。

words.meaning: n. 标准，条件（criterion的复数）
words.example: What are the criteria for selection?  选拔的标准是什么？

words.meaning: prep.经过；通过
words.example:
The London-Addis flight goes via Rome.  从伦敦到阿迪斯的航班要途经罗马。
Reports are coming in via satellite.  报道透过卫星传送进来。

words.meaning: v.出现,发生;(from)由…引起,由…产生
words.example:
Should the opportunity arise, I'd love to go to China.  要是有机会的话，我很想去中国。
Could you work on Saturday, should the need arise (= if it were to be necessary) ?  万一有需要，你可以在星期六工作吗？
Are there any matters arising from (= caused by) the last meeting?  上次会议有没有引出甚么问题？ (arose, arisen)

words.meaning: n.公路,大路
words.example: They travelled the highways and byways of Britain.  他们游遍了英国的大街小巷。

words.meaning: n.例行公事,常规 a.常规的,例行的
words.example:
There's no set/fixed routine at work - every day is different.  工作内容不固定——每天都不同。
He checks under the car for bombs as a matter of routine.  他只要开车就先习惯性地检查车下是否被安了炸弹。
He went into his usual 'I'm the head of the family' routine (= usual way of speaking).  他又故态复萌，重弹“我是一家之主”的老调子。

words.meaning: n.(常pl.)工资,报酬 vt.进行,开展
words.example:
He gets/earns/is paid a good wage, because he works for a fair employer.  他的薪水很不错，因为他的老板奖惩公平。
The smaller shops pay very low wages.  小一点的商店支付的工资都很低。    Compare income ; salaryverb transitive slightly formal
Surely the President needs Congress' permission to wage war on another country?  想必总统须得到国会的许可才能对他国发动战争吧？

words.meaning: n.短语,词语,习语
words.example:
We are governed, in Lord Hailsham's famous phrase, by an 'elective dictatorship'.  引用一下海尔什勋爵的名言，我们被“选举出来的独裁者”统治着。
The declaration was carefully/cleverly/tactfully, etc. phrased.  宣言措辞谨慎／巧妙／圆滑等。

words.meaning: n.(fibre)纤维;构造;纤维制品
words.example: Vegetables are full of fiber.  蔬菜富含纤维。

words.meaning: n.开关;转换;鞭子 v.转变,转换;抽打
words.example:
Can you flip the switch?  你能打开那个开关吗？
She started studying English at college, but switched to Business Studies in her second year.  她刚上大学时是学英语，但二年级的时候改学商了。
In 1971, Britain switched over (= changed completely) to a decimal currency.  1971年，英国改用十进制货币。

words.meaning: n.市镇自治机关;法人;公司,企业
words.example: She didn't want to work for a big corporation where everything was so impersonal.  她不想在大公司工作，那里一点人情味都没有。UK noun countable [+ sing/pl verb]

words.meaning: a.值钱的；有价值的
words.example:
These antiques are extremely valuable.  这些古董非常值钱。
This is losing valuable business for the company.  这是在使公司损失价值不菲的生意。    Opposite worthless.adjective
He was able to provide the police with some valuable information.  他能给警方提供一些重要资讯。

words.meaning: n.假定,设想;采取;承担;推测;假装
words.example:
People tend to make assumptions about you when you have a disability.  如果你有残疾，人们往往就会对你妄加假设。
These calculations are based on the assumption that prices will continue to rise.  这些计算是基于价格会继续上升这一假定之上的。noun
The revolutionaries' assumption of power took the army by surprise.  革命者突然夺取政权，使军队措手不及。

words.meaning: n.栅栏,屏障;障碍(物) vt.把…关入栅栏
words.example:
Barriers have been erected all along the route the Pope will take.  在罗马教皇将要经过的路上，沿途都设置了路障。
The mountains acted as a natural barrier to the spread of the disease.  群山成为了阻止这疾病扩散的天然屏障。
Passengers are requested to show their tickets at the barrier.  乘客需要在剪票口出示车票。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(pl.)杰作,名著 a.第一流的,不朽的
words.example:
Have you ever read Fielding's classic novel 'Tom Jones'?  你有没有读过菲尔丁的经典小说《汤姆‧琼斯》？
Another classic goal there from Corley!  科利又踢进一个漂亮球！
Then she fell over backwards into the flowerbed - it was absolutely classic!  然后她仰面倒进了花坛——真是太滑稽了！

words.meaning: a.化学的 n.(pl.)化学制品,化学药品
words.example:
The government has pledged to reduce the amount of chemicals used in food production.  政府承诺减少食品生产中化学制品的用量。
Each year, factories release millions of tonnes of toxic (= poisonous) chemicals into the atmosphere.  每年，工厂将数百万吨的有毒化学物品排放到大气中。adjective
The chemical industry produces such things as petrochemicals, drugs, paint and rubber.  化学工业生产诸如石化产品、药品、涂料、橡胶之类的东西。

words.meaning: n.假期，休假
words.example:
We're taking a vacation in June.  我们六月份要去渡假。
They went to Europe on vacation.  他们去欧洲渡假了。
I've still got some vacation left before the end of the year.  我到年底之前还剩了一些假期。

words.meaning: n.辩护者,拥护者,鼓吹者 vt.拥护,提倡
words.example:
He advocates the return of capital punishment.  他主张恢复死刑。noun countable /ˈæd.və.kət/
He's a strong advocate of state ownership of the railways.  他极力支持铁路国有。

words.meaning: n.草稿,草案,草图 v.起草,草拟
words.example:
This is only a rough draft - the finished article will have pictures as well.  这只是一个粗略的草稿——定稿后的文章中还会有一些图片。
She asked me to check the (first) draft of her proposal.  她请我检查一下她的（第一稿）提案草稿。UK noun
He avoided the draft because of a foot injury.  他因脚伤而躲过了服兵役。UK noun

words.meaning: a.非常的;格外的;意外的;离奇的;临时的
words.example:
He told the extraordinary story of his escape.  他讲述了他离奇的逃亡经历。
Her voice had an extraordinary hypnotic quality.  她的声音有一种奇怪的催眠效果。

words.meaning: n.天,天空,天堂;(Heaven)上帝,神
words.example:
We stared up at the heavens trying to see the comet.  我们仰望天空想看到彗星。noun
Just as we got to the park, the heavens opened.  我们刚到公园，天就突然下起了大雨。

words.meaning: a.粗糙的;粗略的,大致的;粗野的,粗暴的
words.example:
It was a rough mountain road, full of stones and huge holes.  那是一条崎岖的山道，满是石头和巨大的坑洼。
My hands get very rough in the cold.  天一冷我的手就变得特别粗糙。
The builder did a rough sketch of how the new stairs would look.  建筑工人画了张新楼梯草图。

words.meaning: vi.大叫;呼喊 vt.叫着说 n.叫声;喊声
words.example:
Our neighbours were yelling (obscenities) at each other this morning.  今天早晨我们的邻居在互相破口大骂。
The child yelled out in pain.  孩子痛得大叫起来。

words.meaning: a.怀孕的,孕育的,充满的,意味深长的
words.example:
She's five and a half months pregnant.  她怀孕有五个半月了。
My mother stopped smoking when she became pregnant.  我母亲自从怀孕后就不吸烟了。
He believes that men who get (= make) young girls pregnant should be severely punished.  他认为让少女怀孕的男人应受严惩。

words.meaning: a.远的;遥远的;疏远的;不亲近的
words.example:
She could hear the distant sound of fireworks exploding.  她能听到远处放烟花的声音。
At some point in the distant future I would like to have my own house.  将来我要拥有自己的房子。
They plan to have children in the not-too-distant future.  他们打算在不远的将来要孩子。adjective

words.meaning: n.卫星,人造卫星;附属物
words.example:
The World Cup was transmitted around the world by satellite.  世界杯透过卫星向全球转播。
The moon is the satellite of the Earth.  月球是地球的卫星。UK noun countable

words.meaning: adv. 亲自地；当面；个别地；就自己而言
words.example:
Personally (speaking), I think the show is going to be a great success.  在我个人看来，我认为演出会获得巨大成功。
He believes that parents should be made personally responsible for their children's behaviour.  他认为父母本身应对孩子的行为负责。
These figures should be correct because I've checked them personally.  这些数字应该是正确的，因为我已经亲自核对过了。

words.meaning: n.钟 vt.记录(时间、速度等),为…计时
words.example:
We have an antique clock on our mantelpiece.  我们家的壁炉架上有一个古老的钟。
The town-hall clock says (= shows that the time is) 9 o'clock.  市政厅的大钟显示时间为九点。
The clock began to strike twelve.  时钟敲响12点。

words.meaning: n.巧克力(糖),赭色
words.example: a bar of chocolate  一条巧克力

words.meaning: n.天花板;(规定价格、工资等的)最高限额
words.example: They have imposed/set a ceiling on pay rises.  他们给工资的增加幅度订定了上限。

words.meaning: v.扫,打扫;席卷,冲光;扫过,掠过
words.example:
Everyone looked up as she swept into the room.  她冲进房间时，每个人都抬头看她。
The fire swept (= spread quickly) through the house.  火势迅速在房子里蔓延开来。
The National Party swept into power (= easily won the election) with a majority of almost 200.  民族党以近200票的领先优势顺利当选。

words.meaning: a.普遍的,全体的,通用的;宇宙的,世界的
words.example:
Food, like sex, is a subject of almost universal interest.  像性一样，食物几乎也是人们普遍感兴趣的话题。
The new reforms have not met with universal approval within the government.  新的改革措施在政府内部还没有得到一致赞同。

words.meaning: v.旋转;纺纱;织网,吐丝 n.旋转;自转
words.example:
The Earth spins on its axis.  地球绕地轴旋转。
The roulette players silently watched the wheel spin around/round.  玩转盘游戏的玩家们默不作声地注视着轮盘旋转。
He was killed when his car hit a tree and spun off the road.  他的车撞到树上后甩出路面，他因此而丧生。

words.meaning: n.纽扣,按钮(开关) v.扣紧;扣上纽扣
words.example:
He inserted the cassette and pressed the 'play' button.  他插入卡式带，按下“播放”按钮。UK noun countable
You can't expect to get everything you need at the push of a button.  你不能指望轻易地得到自己需要的一切。UK noun countable
She was right on the button when she said I'd regret moving out.  她说得太对了，我的确后悔搬了出去。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.钟,铃
words.example:
The church bells rang out to welcome in the New Year.  教堂的钟声响起，迎接新年的到来。
That software has all the usual functions plus the latest bells and whistles.  除了常用的功能，这软体还具备一些新颖的附加功能。noun countable
Give me a bell sometime next week, won't you?  下星期给我电话好吗？noun countable

words.meaning: n.军衔,社会阶层;排 v.分等级,把…分类
words.example:
He has just been promoted to the rank of captain.  他刚被提升为上尉。
Ministers of Cabinet rank receive a higher salary than other ministers.  进入内阁的部长比其他部长的薪金高。
Having a large income is one of the advantages of rank (= high position).  职位级别高的好处之一就是收入高。

words.meaning: n. 黑暗；模糊；无知；阴郁
words.example: The room fell into darkness.  房间陷入了黑暗。

words.meaning: n.服装,被褥
words.example:
Protective clothing must be worn.  必须穿上防护服。
You can only take three articles/items of clothing into the changing room.  你只能带三件衣服进试衣间。

words.meaning: a.极好的,超级的
words.example: The Natural History Museum is a super place for kids.  自然历史博物馆是孩子们的超级好去处。

words.meaning: n.篱笆;围栏;剑术 v.用篱笆瓦围住;击剑
words.example:
She would need to fence in the field if she was to keep a horse there.  如果她打算在那里养一匹马，就必须用栅栏把那块地围起来。verb intransitive
The hill had been fenced off to stop animals grazing on it.  已经用栅栏把那座山隔开，以防止动物吃那里的草。

words.meaning: n.幸存,生存;幸存者,残存物
words.example:
The doctors told my wife I had a 50/50 chance of survival.  医生告诉我妻子，我有50%生存机会。
His main concern is to ensure his own political survival.  他主要关心的还是保住自己的政治前途。
England are fighting for survival (= trying not to be defeated) in the match.  这场比赛中，英格兰队为继续存活而战。

words.meaning: n.(一)簇,束,捆,串
words.example:
mainly US informal The reorganization will give us a whole bunch (= a lot) of problems.  重组将会给我们带来许多问题。
They're a bunch of hooligans.  他们是一帮流氓。
Your friends are a nice bunch.  你的一帮朋友都很好。

words.meaning: vt.建立;创立;创办;使有根据;铸造;熔制
words.example:
York was founded by the Romans in the year 71 AD.  约克是西元71年由古罗马人兴建的。
She left a large sum of money in her will to found a wildlife sanctuary.  她在遗嘱里留下了一大笔钱用来创建野生动物保护区。
We are planning a dinner to celebrate the fiftieth anniversary of the founding of the company.  我们正筹划一个晚宴，庆祝公司成立50周年。verb

words.meaning: n.担子,重担,负担 vt.给予负担或麻烦
words.example:
The little donkey struggled under its heavy burden.  小毛驴驮着重物艰难前行。
My elderly mother worries that she's a burden to me.  我年迈的母亲担心她成为我的拖累。
Buying a house often places a large financial burden on young couples.  买房子往往会让年轻夫妇背上沉重的经济负担。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.反应,起作用;(against)反对,起反作用
words.example:
She slapped him and called him names, but he didn't react.  她打他并辱骂他，但他不予回应。
The judge reacted angrily to the suggestion that it hadn't been a fair trial.  有人说审判不公正，法官对此很愤怒。
Many people react (badly) to (= are made ill by) penicillin.  有些人对青霉素（严重）过敏。

words.meaning: n.家具
words.example:
They have a lot of antique furniture.  他们有很多古董家具。
The only piece/item of furniture he has in his bedroom is a bed.  他卧室里唯一的家俱就是一张床。
We've just bought some new garden furniture (= tables, chairs, etc. for use in the garden).  我们刚刚买了些花园里用的新家俱。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.弦,线,细绳;(一串),(一行) v.缚,捆
words.example:
When you pull the strings, the puppet's arms and legs move.  你扯动细绳，木偶的手脚就会动。
What do you think of the recent string of political scandals?  你怎么看最近一连串的政治丑闻？
He had a string of top-twenty hits during the eighties.  在20世纪80年代，他创作了一系列打入排行榜前20名的热门作品。noun

words.meaning: n.典礼,仪式;礼节,礼仪
words.example: She arrived at the airport without the pomp and ceremony that usually accompanies important politicians.  她抵达了机场，没有通常与重要政界人士相伴的盛况和礼仪。

words.meaning: v.传达,传送;交流;通讯,通话
words.example:
We can now communicate instantly with people on the other side of the world.  我们现在可以与生活在地球另一端的人进行即时交流。
Unable to speak a word of the language, he communicated with (= using) his hands.  那种语言他一窍不通，只好用手势来沟通。
Has the news been communicated to the staff yet?  消息传达给员工了吗？

words.meaning: n.面颊,脸
words.example:
The tears ran down her cheeks.  泪水顺着她的脸颊滑下。
He embraced her, kissing her on both cheeks.  他拥抱她，亲吻她的双颊。noun
He told me off for being late when he arrived half an hour after me. What a cheek!  他比我晚到半小时居然还责备我迟到。真是厚颜无耻！

words.meaning: vi.有分歧；不一致
words.example:
I'm afraid I have to disagree with you (on that issue).  （关于那个问题）恐怕我不能同意你的看法。
Spicy food disagrees with me.  辛辣食物我吃了不舒服。

words.meaning: n.织物,薄绢,纸巾;(动,植物的)组织
words.example:
His face is covered with scar tissue where he was badly burned.  他脸上严重烧伤的地方满是疤痕。noun
She handed me a tissue just as I sneezed.  我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张面纸。
He used a piece of tissue to clean his sunglasses.  他用一张面纸擦太阳镜。    Compare handkerchief

words.meaning: n.陌生人,生客;外地人,外国人
words.example:
My mother always warned me not to talk to strangers.  我母亲总是告诫我不要和陌生人讲话。
I'd never met anyone at the party before - they were complete strangers.  我以前从未见过聚会上的人——他们全是陌生人。
Do you know the way to St Peter's church or are you a stranger here too?  你知道怎么去圣彼得教堂吗？你也是外地人吗？UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.被打碎的，骨折的
words.example:
He attacked the man with a broken bottle.  他用一个破酒瓶袭击了那人。
My watch is broken.  我的表坏了。
Careful - there's broken glass on the floor.  小心，地板上有碎玻璃。

words.meaning: n.苹果,苹果树
words.example:
His youngest daughter was the apple of his eye.  他的小女儿是他的心肝宝贝。noun countable or uncountable
Their house is always in apple-pie order.  他们家总是收拾得井井有条。

words.meaning: a.电的,导电的,电动的
words.example: an electric blanket/car/kettle/light  电热毡／电动汽车／电水壶／电灯adjective

words.meaning: a.文学上的,文学的;精通文学的,从事写作的
words.example: a literary critic  文学评论家

words.meaning: n. [病毒] 病毒；恶毒；毒害；n. (Virus)人名；(西)比鲁斯
words.example: Evidence suggested that the AIDS virus was spreading very quickly among the heterosexual community.  有证据表明爱滋病病毒正在异性恋群体中迅速传播。

words.meaning: a.愚蠢的,迟钝的
words.example:
She was really stupid to quit her job like that.  她就那样辞掉了工作，简直是愚蠢透顶。
Whose stupid idea was it to travel at night?  晚上赶路是谁的馊主意？
He now thinks that retiring early was a stupid thing to do.  他现在认为提早退休是件愚蠢的事。

words.meaning: n.运气;命运;财产;财富
words.example:
She inherited a fortune from her grandmother.  她从祖母那里继承了一大笔财产。
He lost a fortune gambling.  他赌博输了一大笔钱。
You can make a fortune out of junk if you call it 'antiques'.  把破烂叫做“古董”，就可以从中发一笔财。

words.meaning: a.帮助的,辅助的 n.助手,助教;辅助物
words.example: an administrative/office assistant  行政／办公室助理

words.meaning: v.战胜,克服
words.example:
Juventus overcame Ajax in a thrilling match.  尤文图斯队在这场扣人心弦的比赛中，战胜了阿贾克斯队。
Eventually she managed to overcome her shyness in class.  她终于克服了上课时的羞怯。
Twenty thousand demonstrators sang "We shall overcome" as they marched through Washington today.  今天，两万名示威者高唱著「我们会胜利”在华盛顿街头游行。UK US (overcame, overcome)

words.meaning: v.占,占用;占据,占领;使忙碌,使从事
words.example:
The bathroom's occupied - I think John's in there.  浴室有人——我想是约翰在里面。
The rest of the time was occupied with writing a report.  剩下的时间用来写了份报告。
The house hasn't been occupied (= lived in) by anyone for a few months.  这幢房子已经有几个月没人住了。

words.meaning: n. 统计；统计学；[统计] 统计资料
words.example: Statistics show prices are falling.  统计数据显示物价在下降。

words.meaning: n.买东西，购物
words.example:
The store is open for late night shopping on Wednesdays.  每个星期三，该百货商店晚间都营业到很晚。
I'm going shopping this afternoon.  我今天下午要去购物。
My granddaughter does my weekly shopping for me.  我孙女替我买每周要用的东西。

words.meaning: n.堂(或表)兄弟,堂(或表)姐妹
words.example:
My brother's wife and I both had babies around the same time, so the cousins are very close in age.  我嫂子和我差不多同时生了孩子，因此这对表兄妹年纪相若。
Many of our distant cousins, whom we hadn't seen for years, came to my sister's wedding.  我们家许多多年未见的远房亲戚赶来参加姐姐的婚礼。
We Americans owe a great deal to our European cousins.  我们美国人得到欧洲兄弟的许多帮助。

words.meaning: v./n.擦,揩,抹
words.example:
Have you got a cloth that I can wipe the floor with?  你有没有找到我可以用来擦地板的布？
I'll just get a sponge and wipe the crumbs off the table.  我这随便找块海绵把桌子上的碎屑擦掉。
Don't wipe your nose on your sleeve!  别用袖子擦鼻子！

words.meaning: a.盲的,瞎的;盲目的 vt.使失明 n.百叶窗
words.example:
She's been blind since birth.  她天生失明。
He started to go (= become) blind in his sixties.  他在60多岁时失明了。adjective
He was blind with fury (= so angry that he could not behave reasonably).  他暴跳如雷，丧失了理智。

words.meaning: n.港口
words.example: We had a good view of all the ships coming into/leaving port.  所有进／出港的轮船我们都看得很清楚。UK noun

words.meaning: n.电,电流;电学
words.example: The electricity has been turned off.  电已被断掉了。

words.meaning: n.发言人
words.example: a government spokesperson  政府发言人

words.meaning: a.后者的;后一半的,接近终了的 n.后者
words.example:
Building of the new library should begin in the latter part of next year.  新图书馆的建设应该在明年下半年开工。
In the latter stages of the fight he began to tire.  到那场拳击赛的后半段他开始支援不住了。UK noun only singular
She offered me more money or a car and I chose the latter.  她提出给我更多的钱或者一辆汽车，我选择了后者。    Compare the former    not standard

words.meaning: n.奴隶,苦工 v.做苦工,拼命地干
words.example:
Black slaves used to work on the cotton plantations of the southern United States.  黑奴以前通常在美国南部的棉花种植园工作。
I'm tired of being treated like a slave!  我讨厌被当作奴隶对待！noun countable
She's a slave to fashion.  她是个拼命赶时髦的人。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition informal

words.meaning: v.翻译,解释;转化,
words.example:
We were asked to translate a list of sentences.  我们被要求翻译一组句子。
She works for the EU, translating from English into French.  她在欧盟工作，担任英译法翻译。    Compare interpret
So how does this theory translate into practical policy?  那么如何将这个理论应用于制定现实可行的政策呢？

words.meaning: a.正确无误的;准确的,精确的
words.example:
The figures they have used are just not accurate.  他们引用的数字太不准确。
Her novel is an accurate reflection of life in post-war Spain.  她的小说是战后西班牙生活的真实写照。
We hope to become more accurate in predicting earthquakes.  我们希望能更准确地预测地震。    Opposite inaccurate

words.meaning: n.恐怖;可怕的人(事)
words.example:
They fled from the city in terror.  他们惊恐万分地逃离该市。
There was sheer/abject terror in her eyes when he came back into the room.  当他回到屋里时，她双眼充满了恐惧。
Lots of people have a terror of spiders.  许多人害怕蜘蛛。

words.meaning: adj. 奥林匹斯山的，奥林匹亚的；奥林匹克的
words.example: the International Olympic Committee  国际奥委会

words.meaning: n.污物,污垢
words.example:
His coat was covered with dirt.  他的外套上满是泥土。
After I'd finished gardening, there was dirt from the flower beds all over the path.  我做完园艺工作后，小路上撒满了花坛里的浮土。
Journalists are always digging for (= trying to discover) dirt.  记者总想挖到丑闻。

words.meaning: n.稻,米
words.example: Do you prefer brown rice or white rice?  你喜欢吃糙米还是精米？

words.meaning: a.紧的;紧身的,装紧的;密封的 ad.紧紧地
words.example:
This lid is on very tight.  这盖子盖得很紧。
The people stood talking in tight groups.  大家一群群地紧挨着站在那里说话。
Hold on tight when we go round this corner.  我们转弯时大家都要抓牢扶好。

words.meaning: n.图表;航海图;航行图 vt.绘图表,制图表
words.example:
There is a chart on the classroom wall showing the relative heights of all the children.  教室墙上有一张图表，显示出所有孩子的相对身高。
The sales chart shows a distinct decline in the past few months.  销售图显示在过去几个月里销售量明显下降。
It's been number one in the charts for six weeks.  它占据排行榜之首已达六周之久。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.太阳的,日光的
words.example: solar radiation  太阳辐射

words.meaning: n.正方形;广场a.正方形的v.使成方形
words.example:
First draw a square.  首先画一个正方形。
It's a square-shaped room.  这是个正方形的房间。
When cooled, cut the chocolate brownies into squares.  冷却之后，将巧克力蛋糕切成四方块。

words.meaning: n.冠军,得胜者;拥护者,斗士
words.example:
She is the world champion for the third year in succession.  她第三次蝉联世界冠军。
The defending champion will play his first match of the tournament tomorrow.  卫冕冠军将在明天参加锦标赛的第一场比赛。
Who are the reigning European football champions?  谁是目前的欧洲足球冠军？noun countable

words.meaning: n.望远镜 v.缩短,压缩
words.example: We had to telescope five visits into two days.  我们只得把五个拜访压缩在两天之内完成。

words.meaning: n.革命;旋转,转数
words.example:
The French Revolution changed France from a monarchy to a republic.  法国大革命使法国由君主政体变成共和政体。
The country seems to be heading towards revolution.  这个国家似乎正在走向革命。noun
Penicillin produced a revolution in medicine.  青霉素的发现引起了医学上的一次革命。noun

words.meaning: a.友好的,友谊的
words.example:
Our neighbours have always been very friendly to/towards us.  我们的邻居们一直对我们很友好。
I'm on quite friendly terms with my daughter's teacher.  我和我女儿的老师关系处得很不错。
Are you friendly with (= a friend of) Graham?  你跟格雷厄姆是朋友吗？    Opposite unfriendly

words.meaning: n. 锦标赛，联赛；比赛
words.example: They were defeated in the first round of the tournament.  他们在锦标赛的第一轮就被打败了。

words.meaning: n.虚构,编造;小说
words.example:
The book is a work of fiction and not intended as a historical account.  这本书是一部小说作品而并非史实陈述。
When he's telling you something, you never know what's fact and what's fiction.  他向你叙事时，你永远都不知道哪些是事实，哪些是杜撰的。

words.meaning: n.色拉,凉拌菜
words.example:
Toss (= Mix) the salad with a vinaigrette dressing.  用油醋酱调味料拌沙拉。
Serve the risotto with a mixed salad.  用什锦沙拉配义大利炖饭。

words.meaning: n.保证,保证书 v.保证,担保
words.example:
The system costs £99.95 including postage, packing and a 12-month guarantee.  包括邮资、包装费用，该系统价格共计99.95英镑，保用12个月。
The video recorder comes with/has a two-year guarantee.  这台录像机保修期为两年。
The shop said they would replace the television as it was still under guarantee.  商店说会给我们退换那台电视机，因为它还没有过包退期。

words.meaning: a.(of)清白的,无罪的;无害的;单纯的,无知的
words.example:
He firmly believes that she is innocent of the crime.  他坚信她是清白的。
She has such an innocent face that I find it hard to believe anything bad of her.  她一脸天真无邪，我很难把她往坏的方面想。
It was an innocent remark, I didn't mean to hurt his feelings.  那句话没有恶意，我并不想伤害他的感情。    Compare guilty

words.meaning: n.分界线,边界
words.example:
The Ural mountains mark the boundary between Europe and Asia.  乌拉尔山脉是欧洲和亚洲的分界线。
Residents are opposed to the prison being built within the city boundary.  居民们反对把监狱建在市区。
Electronic publishing is blurring the boundaries between dictionaries and encyclopedias.  电子出版使得字典与百科全书的界限变模糊了。

words.meaning: v./n.中止,暂停
words.example:
There will be a brief pause in the proceedings while the piano is moved into place.  在将钢琴搬过去放好之前，活动将暂停一会儿。
After a long, awkward pause someone asked a question.  在长得令人尴尬的停顿过后，有人问了个问题。
She spoke for three quarters of an hour without so much as a pause.  她一连说了45分钟，连停都没停一下。

words.meaning: a.远的,遥远的,疏远的,偏僻的,细微的
words.example:
It happened in the remote past , so no one worries about it any more.  这件事发生在很久很久以前了，所以没有人再为此担心了。
They take little interest in a conflict far from their homes and remote from their everyday problems.  这是一场远在他们家乡千里之外的冲突，和他们每天遇到的问题也毫不沾边，他们对其不怎么感兴趣。
The chances of a visit by Martians to the Earth are remote.  火星人访问地球的可能性微乎其微。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.满足,满意;乐事,愉快
words.example:
She looked at the finished painting with satisfaction.  她满意地看着完成的画作。
She derived/obtained great satisfaction from/out of helping other people.  她帮助别人，从中获得无比的满足。
For me, job satisfaction is more important than the money.  对我来说，从工作中得到的满足比钱更重要。
