words.meaning: n.长凳,条凳;(工作)台,座
words.example:
He was injured, and spent the last few weeks of the season on the bench.  他受了伤，只能在该赛季最后数星期的比赛中在场外观战。
Kindly address your remarks to the bench, Mr Smith.  史密斯先生，请你对法官说话温和一点。
There was jeering from the Labour benches.  工党的议员席上有人发出嘲笑声。

words.meaning: a.未煮过的,生的;未加工过的,未经训练的
words.example:
raw fish.  生鱼UK adjective
Oil is an important raw material which can be processed into many different products, including plastics.  石油是一种重要的原料，可以加工成包括塑胶在内的许多种产品。
They claimed that raw sewage was being pumped into the sea.  他们断言，下水道的污水未经处理就被直接排入了大海。

words.meaning: v.收回,撤消;缩回,退出;提取(钱)
words.example:
This credit card allows you to withdraw up to £200 a day from cash dispensers.  这张信用卡允许你每天从自动提款机中提取200英镑。
The UN has withdrawn its troops from the country.  联合国已从该国撤军。
Eleven million bottles of water had to be withdrawn from sale due to a health scare.  因为害怕危害健康，有1100万瓶水不得不停止销售。

words.meaning: n.柱,杆;地极,磁极,电极
words.example:
Most weather satellites are stationed over the Equator or travel over the poles.  大部分气象卫星定位于赤道上空或绕地球两极飞行。UK noun countable
These two men might be thought to represent the opposite poles of economic ideology.  这两个人可能被认为是两种极端的经济思想体系的代表。UK noun countable
My sister and I are poles apart in personality.  我和妹妹在性格上截然相反。

words.meaning: n. 对话；意见交换；vi. 对话；vt. 用对话表达
words.example:
The play contained some very snappy/witty dialogue.  这出戏里有一些非常俏皮／风趣的对白。
Act Two begins with a short dialogue between father and son.  第二幕以父子间的简短对白开场。
The rebel leaders stated that they are willing to enter into dialogue with the government.  叛军首领发表声明说他们愿意与政府进行对话。

words.meaning: n.自豪;自满;引以自豪的东西 v.使自豪
words.example:
She felt a great sense of pride as she watched him accept the award.  看着他接过那个奖她感到非常自豪。
He felt such pride walking his little daughter down the street.  他陪着小女儿在街上走，感到非常自豪。
If you don't take professional pride in your work, you're probably in the wrong job.  如果你对自己的工作没有职业自豪感，那可能是入错了行。noun

words.meaning: v.免职,解雇,开除,解散
words.example:
Let's not just dismiss the idea before we've even thought about it.  我们还是别不假思索就把这种想法排除在外。
Just dismiss those thoughts from your mind - they're crazy and not worth thinking about.  别去管那些想法了——那些想法太离谱，不值得考虑。verb
He has been dismissed from his job for incompetence.  他因无法胜任工作而被解职。verb

words.meaning: n.飞机,飞船,飞行器
words.example: military aircraft  军用飞机UK US  (plural aircraft)

words.meaning: v.使结冰,使凝固
words.example:
Water freezes to ice at a temperature of 0°C.  水在摄氏零度结冰。
The ground had frozen hard/solid.  地面已经冻得硬邦邦的了。
When the lake freezes (over) (= turns into ice on the surface) , we can go skating on it.  湖面结冰后，我们可以在上面滑冰。

words.meaning: n.平台,台;站台,月台;政纲,党纲
words.example:
The train for Cambridge will depart from platform 9.  往剑桥的火车将从9号月台开出。
Speaker after speaker mounted/took the platform to denounce the policy.  演讲者一个接一个走上讲台谴责这项政策。
This brilliant young violinist has appeared on concert platforms all round the world.  这名才华横溢的年轻小提琴手曾在世界各地的音乐会舞台上演出。

words.meaning: n.财政,金融 v.为…提供资金
words.example:
You need to speak to someone in the finance department.  你需要和财务部的人谈一谈。
The finance committee controls the school's budget.  财务委员会掌管着学校的预算。
We keep a tight control on the organization's finances.  我们严格控制该组织的资金。

words.meaning: v.(使)下沉,下落 n.水槽,水池
words.example:
The Titanic was a passenger ship which sank (to the bottom of the ocean) in 1912.  铁达尼号是1912年沉没（海底）的一艘客轮。
The legs of the garden chair sank into the soft ground.  休闲椅的脚陷入松软的土中。
Enemy aircraft sank two battleships.  敌机击沉了两艘军舰。

words.meaning: a.吸引人的,引人注意的;漂亮的,迷人的
words.example:
Spending 12 hours on a plane isn't a very attractive (= pleasant) prospect.  连坐12个小时的飞机，可不是甚么令人向往的事。
We need to make the club attractive to a wider range of people.  我们要让这个俱乐部吸引更广的人群。

words.meaning: a.多种多样的,(from)不同的
words.example:
Students from countries as diverse as Colombia and Lithuania use Cambridge textbooks.  来自哥伦比亚、立陶宛等不同国家的学生都在使用剑桥的课本。
New York is a very culturally/ethnically diverse city.  纽约是一个在文化／种族方面十分多元化的城市。

words.meaning: a.有关的,中肯的,相应的,实质性的
words.example:
Education should be relevant to the child's needs.  教育应和孩子的需要挂钩。
For further information, please refer to the relevant leaflet.  欲知详情，请参阅有关广告单张。
The point is highly relevant to this discussion.  这一点和这次讨论的议题密切相关。

words.meaning: n.欢乐,喜悦;乐事,乐趣
words.example:
They were filled with joy when their first child was born.  第一个孩子出生时，他们满心欢喜。
She wept for joy when she was told that her husband was still alive.  当她获悉丈夫还活着时，她喜极而泣。
Listening to music is one of his greatest joys.  听音乐是他最大的乐趣之一。

words.meaning: ad.部分地,不完全地,在一定程度上
words.example:
His attractiveness is partly due to his self-confidence.  他的魅力部分源于他的自信。
The house is partly owned by her father.  她父亲拥有这幢房子的部分产权。

words.meaning: n.柜台;计数器 a./ad.相反(的) v.反对,反击
words.example:
There was nobody behind/on the counter when I went into the bank, and I had to wait to be served.  我进银行时柜枱后没人，我只得等候有人出来服务。
You will find sausages on the meat counter/rolls on the bread counter.  你会在肉柜枱找到香肠／在面包柜枱找到面包卷。
We stacked the dirty plates on the kitchen counter.  我们把脏碟子堆放在厨房的料理枱上。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v./n.碰撞,坠落,摔坏 n.失败,瓦解;爆裂声
words.example:
We skidded on the ice and crashed (into another car).  我们在冰上打滑撞了（另一辆）车。
The plane crashed into a mountainside.  飞机撞到了山坡上。
Her brother borrowed her motorbike and crashed it.  她弟弟借用她的摩托车，结果给撞坏了。verb

words.meaning: v.占有,拥有
words.example: In the past the root of this plant was thought to possess magical powers.  过去这种植物的根被认为具有神奇的力量。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.塞子;水龙头; n./v.轻打,轻敲; vt.开发
words.example:
The branches tapped against the window.  树枝轻轻敲打着窗户。
Someone tapped me on the shoulder.  有人轻轻拍我的肩膀。verb (-pp-)
For more than a century, Eastern cities have expanded their water supplies by tapping ever more remote sources.  一个多世纪以来，东部的城市透过开发更偏远地区的水源，扩大了水的供应。

words.meaning: vi.游泳;游;漂浮;眩晕;充溢 vt.游过 n.游泳
words.example:
We spent the day on the beach but it was too cold to go swimming.  我们一整天都在海滩上，但天气太冷，不能游泳。
Her ambition is to swim (across) the English Channel.  她的目标是游泳横渡英吉利海峡。
The salad was swimming in oil.  沙拉里面的油太多了。verb (swimming, swam, swum)

words.meaning: v.(使)疲倦,(使)厌倦 n.(=tyre)轮胎,车胎
words.example:
She's been leading throughout the race, but it now looks as if she's tiring.  她在整个赛跑中一路领先，但现在看上去似乎累了。
Even doing the garden tires me these days.  最近，我连在花园里整理花草都会感到累。verb intransitive or transitive UK   Phrasal Verbs   tire of sth/sb  ADVANCED
This is the kind of toy that children will soon tire of.  这种玩具小孩会很快玩腻的。

words.meaning: n.过失,过错;缺点,毛病
words.example:
It's not my fault she didn't come!  她没来不是我的错！
She believes it was the doctor's fault that Peter died.  她认为彼得的死医生需要负责。
The fault was/lay with the organizers, who failed to make the necessary arrangements for dealing with so many people.  是组织者的过错，他们没有做好必要的安排来接待这么多人。

words.meaning: a.(宽)松的;不精确的;自由的,散漫的
words.example:
There were some loose wires hanging out of the wall.  墙上搭着几根没有接好的电线。
The nails in the bridge had worked them selves loose.  桥上的钉子已经松动了。
The prisoners were so thin that their skin hung loose.  囚犯们瘦得很厉害，身上的皮肤都松垮垮地垂着。

words.meaning: ad.立刻,不久;不耐烦地,简慢地
words.example:
We will shortly be arriving in King's Cross Station.  我们马上就要到国王十字车站了。
Shortly after you left, a man came into the office looking for you.  你离开后不久就有一名男子来到办公室找你。

words.meaning: v.(使)松驰,放松
words.example:
After work she relaxed with a cup of tea and the newspaper.  下班后，她喝杯茶读着报纸放松放松。
He relaxed his grip on my arm (= He began to hold it less tightly).  他紧抓着我手臂的手不再那么用力了。verb
Two weeks after the police relaxed security at the airports, there was a bomb attack.  警方放松了对机场采取的安全措施两周后就发生了一起炸弹袭击事件。verb

words.meaning: n.(pl.)楼梯
words.example:
Go up the stairs and her office is on the right.  上楼后，她的办公室在右手边。
The top stair creaked as she went upstairs and the noise woke up her mother.  她上楼时最上面一级楼梯咯吱一响，吵醒了她母亲。
He climbed the wooden stair and knocked on his grandfather's door.  他爬上木楼梯，敲了敲祖父的房门。UK noun

words.meaning: n.冒险,冒险活动,奇遇 vt.大胆进行
words.example:
She had some exciting adventures in Egypt.  她在埃及经历了一些很刺激的奇遇。
We got lost on the Metro - it was quite an adventure.  我们在地铁里迷路了，还真是挺惊险的。
Sam won't come - he's got no sense of adventure (= he does not enjoy dangerous or exciting situations).  萨姆不会来的，他不喜欢冒险。

words.meaning: n.(of,in)确信的,自信的
words.example:
Be a bit more confident in yourself!  你应该再自信一点！
They don't sound confident about the future of the industry.  他们听起来对该行业的未来信心不足。
I'm confident of his skills as a manager.  作为经理他相当老练，我对此很有信心。

words.meaning: a.出乎意料的,突然的
words.example:
Drop the gun, put your hands in the air, and don't make any sudden movements.  把枪放下，手举起来，别轻举妄动。
He had a sudden heart attack while he was on holiday.  他度假时心脏病突然发作。
First they announce their engagement and then they tell me Angie's pregnant - it's all a bit sudden really.  他们先是宣布订婚，接着告诉我安吉怀孕了——一切都有点太突然。adjective

words.meaning: a.弄脏的;下流的 v.弄脏,玷污
words.example:
Her face was dirty and tear-stained.  她的脸很脏，还留有泪痕。UK adjective
She played a dirty trick on me by telling me Diane was having a party when she wasn't.  她捉弄我说戴安娜要开一个派对，而实际上并没有这回事。
The airline admitted being involved in a dirty tricks campaign to win customers from their rival.  那家航空公司承认参与了从竞争对手那里抢夺客户的不光彩行为。

words.meaning: n.舌;语言
words.example:
She is a prolific writer with critical views and a sharp (= severe and critical) tongue.  她是一个多产的作家，观点尖锐，语言犀利。noun
It's one language that I have real difficulty getting my tongue round.  这是一种我很难正确发音的语言。noun
An old man was staring at her so she stuck her tongue out at him.  一个老头正盯着她看，于是她朝他吐了吐舌头。noun

words.meaning: n.(licence)许可证,执照 v.准许,认可
words.example: A driver's license is required.  需要驾照。

words.meaning: n.掩蔽处;掩蔽,保护 v.掩蔽,躲避,庇护
words.example:
They opened a shelter to provide temporary housing for the city's homeless.  他们开设了一个收容所，为该市的无家可归者提供临时的住宿。
The trees gave/provided some shelter from the rain.  这些树遮了一些雨。
We took shelter for the night in an abandoned house.  我们在一栋废弃的房子里躲了一夜。UK verb

words.meaning: n.入口,门口;进入;入学,入会
words.example:
There are two entrances - one at the front and one round the back.  入口有两个，一个在前面，另一个在后面。    Compare exit
He makes a spectacular entrance in act two draped in a gold sheet.  在第二幕，他身披金袍上场，光彩炫目。
The management reserve the right to refuse entrance.  管理部门保留拒绝他人入内的权利。UK verb transitive literary

words.meaning: ad.适当地；彻底地
words.example:
It's still not working properly.  它还是不能正常运转。
I'm not properly dressed for this sort of weather.  我的穿着不适合这样的天气。
Come on, Evie, speak properly - you're not a baby any more!  来，埃薇，好好说话——你已经不是小孩子了！UK adverb

words.meaning: v.褪色;衰减,消失n.淡入(出)n.乏味(平淡)的
words.example:
If you hang your clothes out in the bright sun, they will fade.  衣服挂在光线强的地方晾晒会褪色。
My suntan is already fading.  我晒黑的肤色已经开始变浅了。
They arrived home just as the light was fading (= as it was going dark).  夕阳西下时，他们到家了。

words.meaning: n.网,网状物 v.用网捕,使落网 a.纯净的
words.example: The butterfly got caught in the net.  蝴蝶被网住了。

words.meaning: n.丧葬,葬礼
words.example:
The funeral will be held next Friday.  葬礼将在下周五举行。
Over 300 mourners attended the funeral.  300多名哀悼者参加了葬礼。

words.meaning: n.职业,专业,表白,宣布
words.example:
He left the teaching profession in 1965 to set up his own business.  他1965年离开教师岗位自己创业。
The report notes that forty per cent of lawyers entering the profession are women.  这份报告指出，执业律师中有40%是女性。
Teaching as a profession is very underpaid.  教书作为一种职业，酬劳其实过低。

words.meaning: v.压榨,挤 n.榨取,勒索
words.example:
Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.  把柠檬对切，将汁挤到碗里。
As she waited to go into the exam, he squeezed her hand (= pressed it affectionately with his hand) and wished her good luck.  在她等待应考时，他捏了捏她的手，祝她好运。
Once he had finished cleaning the floor, he squeezed the cloth out.  他擦完地板之后，把抹布拧干。

words.meaning: n.面具,面罩;假面具,伪装 v. 掩饰,化装
words.example:
The bank robbers wore masks throughout the raid.  劫匪抢劫银行时一直戴着面罩。UK noun countable
The newspaper revealed the sordid truth behind his mask of respectability.  报纸揭露了他体面外表下龌龊肮脏的真实嘴脸。UK noun countable
I've put some flowers in there to mask the smell.  我在那里放了一些花来掩盖那种气味。

words.meaning: n. 展示；描述，陈述；介绍；赠送
words.example:
The speaker gave an interesting presentation on urban transport.  演讲者针对城市交通发表了有趣的谈话。
The presentation of prizes and certificates will take place in the main hall.  奖品和证书的颁发仪式将在大厅举行。noun
Presentation is important if you want people to buy your products.  如果想要人们购买你的产品，包装非常重要。

words.meaning: a./ad.不管…的,不顾…的,不注意的
words.example:
The plan for a new office tower went ahead regardless of local opposition.  尽管遭到当地居民的反对，新建高层办公大楼的计划还是付诸实施了。
She knew it was dangerous to visit him except at night, but she set out regardless (of the risk).  虽然她知道除了晚上别的时候去看他都很危险，可她还是（不顾危险）动身去了。
This job is open to all, regardless of previous experience.  这份工作任何人都可以应聘，不管其以前的工作经历如何。

words.meaning: v.装(货),装载 n.装载(量),负荷(量);(一)担
words.example:
The maximum load for this elevator is eight persons.  这部电梯的最大载客量为八人。
One truck involved in the accident was carrying a heavy load of coal.  事故中的一辆货车上装了大量煤炭。
I've got a load of work to get through before tomorrow.  明天之前我要完成很多工作。

words.meaning: a.稳定的,安定的 n.马厩,马棚
words.example:
If the foundations of the house aren't stable, collapse is possible.  如果房子的地基不稳，就有可能倒塌。
After several part-time jobs, he's now got a stable job in a bank.  做了几份兼职工作之后，他目前在银行找到了一份稳定的工作。
The hospital said she was in a stable condition (= not likely to get worse) following the operation.  院方说她手术之后情况稳定。

words.meaning: n.(to)介绍;传入,引进;导言,导论,绪论
words.example:
The introduction of new working practices has dramatically improved productivity.  采用新的工作方法已经显著提高了生产率。
Within a few years of their introduction, CDs were outselling vinyl records.  雷射唱片在推出几年后，销量就超过了黑胶唱片。
specialized The introduction of the tube into the artery is a very delicate procedure.  将导管插入动脉是一个非常精细的手术。noun

words.meaning: v.假装,假托,借口,(在演戏中)装扮
words.example:
The children pretended (that) they were dinosaurs.  孩子们装扮成恐龙。
She's not really hurt - she's only pretending.  她并不是真的受了伤——她只是在装。
Of course I was angry - I can't pretend otherwise.  我当然生气了——怎么可能会是假装的。

words.meaning: n.鹿
words.example: a herd of deer  一群鹿

words.meaning: v.裂开,劈开;分裂,分离 n.分化,分裂,裂口
words.example:
The prize was split between Susan and Kate.  这笔奖金被苏珊和凯特平分了。
Split the aubergines in half and cover with breadcrumbs.  把茄子切成两半，裹上面包屑。
The teacher split the children (up) into three groups.  老师把孩子们分成三组。

words.meaning: vt. 违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎
words.example:
They were charged with violating federal law.  他们被控违犯了联邦法律。
It seems that the planes deliberately violated the cease-fire agreement.  那些飞机似乎是故意违反停火协议。
The doctor has been accused of violating professional ethics.  那名医生被控违反了职业道德。

words.meaning: n.污染
words.example: The manifesto includes tough measures to tackle road congestion and environmental pollution.  宣言包括了解决道路堵塞和环境污染的强硬措施。

words.meaning: a.稳定的,不变的;坚定的v.(使)稳固/稳定
words.example:
The procession moved through the streets at a steady pace.  队伍稳步穿过街道。
Orders for new ships are rising, after several years of steady decline.  新船的订单数量经过几年的持续下降之后开始增加了。
Over the last 10 years he has produced a steady flow/stream/trickle of articles and papers.  过去十年，他连续发表了一系列文章和论文。

words.meaning: a.生命的；有生命力的
words.example:
She had found out some information of vital importance.  她已经查出了一些极为重要的资讯。
The kidney plays a vital role/part in the removal of waste products from the blood.  肾脏对于排除血液中的废物起着至关重要的作用。
He had never felt so vital and full of life.  他从来没有像现在一样感到如此精神焕发，充满活力。

words.meaning: n.区别,差别;级别;特性;声望;显赫
words.example:
There's a clear distinction between the dialects spoken in the two regions.  这两个地区的方言有着明显的不同。
This company makes no distinction between the sexes.  这间公司男女平等。noun
She has the distinction of being one of the few people to have an honorary degree conferred on her by the university this year.  今年，只有几个人被授予了大学荣誉学位，她有幸成为其中之一。

words.meaning: ad.任何地方都不,没有地方
words.example:
These young people have nowhere (else) to go.  这些年轻人无处可去。
Nowhere does the article mention the names of the people involved.  这篇文章中并未提及相关人员的名字。
The horse I bet on finished nowhere.  我下注的那匹马没有获胜。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.诗人
words.example: The poet lived a quiet life.  诗人过着安静的生活。

words.meaning: n.舒适,安逸;安慰,慰问 v.安慰,使舒适
words.example:
She evidently dresses for comfort.  显然，她穿着讲究舒适。
It's a little too hot for comfort.  热得有点不舒服。
Now you can watch the latest films in the comfort of your own room.  现在你可以在自己的房间里舒舒服服地观看最新影片。

words.meaning: vt.使适应,使适合;改编;改写 vi.适应
words.example:
Many software companies have adapted popular programs to the new operating system.  许多软体公司已经改编了常用的程式以适应新的作业系统。
The recipe here is a pork roast adapted from Caroline O'Neill's book 'Louisiana Kitchen'.  这道菜是根据卡洛琳•奥尼尔《路易斯安那厨房》一书中烤猪肉的做法改进而来的。
The play had been adapted for (= changed to make it suitable for) children.  这个剧本已被改编成儿童剧。

words.meaning: n.蜜,蜂蜜
words.example: Hi, honey, I'm home!  嗨，亲爱的，我回来了！

words.meaning: a.苍白的,灰白的;浅的,暗淡的
words.example:
You're looking pale - do you feel ill?  你看起来脸色苍白——你病了吗？
She has a naturally pale complexion and dark hair.  她天生肤色白晰，头发乌黑。    See beyond the pale
She wore a pale blue hat.  她戴着一顶浅蓝色的帽子。

words.meaning: n.音乐家,乐师
words.example: The concert features dancers, singers and musicians of all nationalities.  这场音乐会云集了各国的舞蹈家、歌唱家和音乐家。

words.meaning: n.意义,含义;重要性,重要的
words.example:
The discovery of the new drug is of great significance for/to people suffering from heart problems.  这种新药的发现对心脏病患者来说具有重要意义。noun uncountable
Do you think that look he gave you had any significance?  你觉得他看你的那一眼有甚么特殊含意吗？

words.meaning: n.贮藏(量),保管;库房
words.example: We've had to build some cupboards to give us more storage space.  我们不得不做了些壁橱来增加储藏空间。

words.meaning: v.逃走;逃避
words.example:
She fled (from) the room in tears.  她哭着跑出房间。
In order to escape capture, he fled to the mountains.  为了免遭俘虏，他逃到了山里。
It is likely that the suspects have fled the country by now.  很有可能几名嫌疑犯现在已经逃到了国外。

words.meaning: n.皮革,皮革制品
words.example: a leather coat/belt/handbag  皮衣／带／包

words.meaning: v.分发;分配;分布;配(电);(over)散布
words.example:
The books will be distributed free to local schools.  这些书将免费发放给当地学校。
Several people were arrested for distributing racist leaflets/pamphlets (to the spectators).  有数人因为（向观众）散发宣扬种族主义的小册子而被捕。
The company aims eventually to distribute (= supply for sale) its products throughout the European Union.  公司计划最终让产品行销欧盟国家。

words.meaning: n.进化,演变,发展,进展
words.example: Darwin's theory of evolution  达尔文的进化论

words.meaning: a.有病的;坏的;恶意的 ad.坏地;不利地
words.example:
He's been ill with meningitis.  他得了脑膜炎。
Sophia fell ill] was taken ill (= became ill) while on holiday.  索菲娅在休假时生病了。
He is critically (= very badly) ill in hospital.  他在住院，病得很重。adjective

words.meaning: n.架子,搁板
words.example:
One wall had shelves from floor to ceiling, crammed with books.  一面墙是高及天花板的书架，上面塞满了书。
It's often cheaper if you buy wallpaper off the shelf, rather than having to order it.  如果你买现成的壁纸，通常会比订购的要便宜。
It's important to apply research in a practical way and not leave it on the shelf.  重要的是，要把研究运用于实际当中，而不是束之高阁。    mainly UK informal

words.meaning: n.祖父；外祖父
words.example: My grandfather built this house.  这房子是我爷爷盖的。

words.meaning: n.智慧,明智;名言,格言
words.example:
One certainly hopes to gain a little wisdom as one grows older.  人们当然希望自己随着年龄的增长而获取一些智慧。
He's got a weekly radio programme in which he dispenses wisdom (= gives his opinions) on a variety of subjects.  他每周有个广播节目，就各种话题发表他的看法。
Did we ever stop to question the wisdom of going to war?  我们有否曾经停下来想一想参战是否明智？

words.meaning: n.蒜,大蒜粉
words.example: For this recipe you need four cloves (= single pieces) of garlic, crushed.  按照这个烹饪法，你需要四瓣大蒜，并捣碎。

words.meaning: n.幻想,空想;空想的产物,幻想作品
words.example:
Steve's favourite fantasy was to own a big house and a flashy car.  史蒂夫最爱幻想拥有一座大房子和一辆豪华轿车。
She retreated into a fantasy world , where she could be anything she wanted.  她遁入了幻想世界，在那里她想要成为甚么都可以。

words.meaning: n.秘密计划;情节 v.标绘,绘制;密谋,策划
words.example:
The film has a very simple plot.  这部电影情节很简单。
The plots of his books are basically all the same.  他的书情节基本上都一样。UK noun countable
The plot was discovered before it was carried out.  这项阴谋还未得逞就暴露了。

words.meaning: n.构架;框架;结构;组织;机构
words.example: a legal framework for resolving disputes  解决争端的法律体系

words.meaning: n.姿势,姿态,手势 v.做手势
words.example:
The prisoner raised his fist in a gesture of defiance as he was led out of the courtroom.  犯人被带出法庭时，举起拳头以示抗议。
She made a rude gesture at the other driver.  她对另一个司机做了个粗鲁的手势。UK noun countable
The Government donated £500 000 as a gesture of goodwill.  该政府捐助了50万英镑以示友善。

words.meaning: n.心理,心理学,心理状态
words.example: She studied psychology at Harvard.  她在哈佛大学攻读心理学。

words.meaning: n. 章;回,篇
words.example:
Read Chapter 10 before class tomorrow.  明天上课前阅读第十章。UK noun countable
The period before the revolution is an interesting chapter in British history.  革命前的那段时期是英国历史上一段有趣的时期。
That chapter of my life closed when I had a serious riding accident.  骑马出了一次严重的意外后，我生命中的那一篇章就结束了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v./n.离婚,分离
words.example:
The last I heard they were getting a divorce.  上次我听说他们正在办理离婚手续。
Divorce is on the increase.  离婚呈上升趋势。
Ellie wants a divorce.  埃莉想离婚。

words.meaning: v.欠(债等),应向…付出,归功于,得感谢
words.example:
We still owe $1000 on our car (= We still need to pay $1000 before we own our car).  我们的车还欠1000美元未付清。
He owes his life to the staff at the hospital.  他能保住命全亏了这家医院的医护人员。
Thanks for the help, Bill - I owe you one.  谢谢你的帮助，比尔——我欠你个人情。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.管子,导管;烟斗;笛
words.example:
Hot water is piped to all apartments from the central boiler room.  热水从中央锅炉房经管道输送到每个公寓套房。
figurative Music is piped throughout the hotel complex.  音乐声在整栋饭店大楼里回荡。verb
Will you please pipe down, you two? I'm trying to read!  你们两个能安静下来吗？我在看书呢！verb

words.meaning: adj. 运动的，运动员的；体格健壮的
words.example:
She looks very athletic.  她看上去很健壮。
This college has a long tradition of athletic excellence.  这间大学在田径运动方面历来成绩骄人。

words.meaning: a.轻微的,微小的;纤细的,瘦弱的
words.example:
I've got a slight headache.  我头有点痛。
Like most long-distance runners she is very slight.  和大多数长跑运动员一样，她十分苗条。verb transitive

words.meaning: n. 数学（等于mathematics）；n. (Math)人名；(德)马特；(柬)马；(英)马思
words.example: Math is my strongest subject.  数学是我最强的科目。

words.meaning: n.荫,阴影;遮光物,罩 v.遮蔽,遮光
words.example:
The sun was hot, and there were no trees to offer us shade.  太阳火辣辣的，没有树让我们遮阳。
The children played in/under the shade of a large beach umbrella.  孩子们在一把大沙滩遮阳伞下的阴凉处玩耍。
The lamps all had matching purple shades.  这些灯都有与之相配的紫色灯罩。

words.meaning: n.尾巴;尾部;跟踪者 vt.尾随,跟踪
words.example:
The dog wagged its tail excitedly.  那只狗兴奋地摇着尾巴。noun countable
That driver's been on my tail for miles.  那人驾车紧跟在我后面有好几英里了。noun countable
You've just got to get off your tail and start looking for a job.  你应该收心了，开始找份工作吧。noun countable

words.meaning: n.角,角度 v.钓鱼;(采用各种方法)取得
words.example:
The interior angles of a square are right angles or angles of 90 degrees.  正方形的内角是直角，即90度角。
The boat settled into the mud at a 35 degree angle.  船身呈35度角倾斜着陷入烂泥中。
The boat settled into the mud at an angle of 35 degrees.  船身呈35度角倾斜着陷入烂泥中。

words.meaning: v.(from)与…不同;(with)与…意见不同
words.example:
The twins look alike, but they differ in temperament.  这对双胞胎长得相像，但性格却不同。
His views differ considerably from those of his parents.  他的观点与其父母大相径庭。
The findings of the various studies differ significantly/markedly/radically.  各项研究的结果之间相差极大／明显／巨大。

words.meaning: n.习惯,风俗,惯例;(pl.)海关,关税
words.example:
He left the house at nine exactly, as is his custom.  他九点准时离开了家，这是他的习惯。noun
Most of our custom comes from tourists nowadays.  如今我们大部分生意来自游客。
If we don't give good service, people will take their custom elsewhere.  如果我们不能提供良好的服务，人们就会光顾别处。noun

words.meaning: n.汤
words.example:
Would you like a bowl of soup?  你要不要来碗汤？noun countable or uncountable
New circuit boards can be used to soup up existing machines.  新电路板可用来提高现有机器的性能。    souped-up    /ˌsuːptˈʌp]

words.meaning: n. 庆典，庆祝会；庆祝；颂扬
words.example:
There were lively New Year celebrations all over town.  全城到处是喜迎新年的活动。
Such good news calls for (= deserves) a celebration!  这样的好消息可喜可贺！
Let's buy some champagne in celebration of her safe arrival.  我们买点香槟酒庆祝她平安到达吧。

words.meaning: n.作品,作文,乐曲;作曲;结构,组成,成分
words.example:
This concerto is one of her earlier/later compositions.  这首协奏曲是她早期／后期的作品之一。
At music school I studied piano and composition.  我在音乐学校学习钢琴和作曲。

words.meaning: v.满意,使满意,使相信,说服
words.example:
They have 31 flavours of ice-cream - enough to satisfy everyone!  他们有31种口味的霜淇淋——足以满足所有人！
Come on, satisfy my curiosity (= tell me what I want to know) , what happened last night?  来，满足一下我的好奇心，昨天晚上发生了甚么事？
She satisfies all the requirements for the job.  她符合这项工作的所有要求。

words.meaning: n.堆,大量,大数目 v.(up)堆,叠,堆积
words.example:
informal I've got piles/a pile (= a lot) of things to do today.  我今天有一大堆事情要做。noun
They've got a great big Victorian pile somewhere out in the country.  他们在乡下的某个地方有一幢宏伟的维多利亚式房子。noun
He made a pile selling computers and retired by the time he was forty.  他卖电脑发了财，40岁的时候就退休了。verb

words.meaning: n.碳
words.example: Reduce your carbon footprint.  减少你的碳足迹。

words.meaning: vt.消耗;吃完,喝光;(with)使着迷;烧毁
words.example:
Our high living standards cause our present population to consume 25 percent of the world's oil.  我们的高生活水准致使我们目前的人口要消耗世界石油的25%。
He consumes vast quantities of chips with every meal.  他每一餐都要吃掉大量的薯条。UK verb transitive
He was consumed with jealousy.  他心里满是嫉妒。

words.meaning: n.烟草,烟叶
words.example: Twenty-eight per cent of people asked thought that the advertising of tobacco (= tobacco and products made from it, such as cigarettes) and alcohol should be banned.  受访者中有28%的人认为应该禁止烟草和酒类广告。

words.meaning: ad.此外;并且 prep.于…之外;除…以外
words.example:
Do you play any other sports besides football and basketball?  除了足球和篮球外，你还参与别的体育活动吗？
She won't mind your being late - besides, it's hardly your fault.  她不会因为你迟到而耿耿于怀——何况这并不是你的错。adverb preposition

words.meaning: a.富有的,丰裕的,充分的 n.富人,有钱人
words.example:
He's a very wealthy man.  他是个非常富有的人。
With their natural resources they are potentially a very wealthy country.  他们那里自然资源丰富，将来可能会成为一个非常富有的国家。plural noun

words.meaning: n.雪橇 v.滑雪
words.example:
He skied down the hill.  他滑雪下山。
Shall we go skiing?  我们去滑雪吧？

words.meaning: n.约会,约定;任命,委派;委任的职位
words.example:
I'd like to make an appointment with Doctor Evans, please.  劳驾，我要预约埃文斯医生的门诊。
She had to cancel her dental appointment.  她不得不取消去看牙医的预约。
If he didn't have a secretary to remind him, he wouldn't keep (= remember to be present at) any of his appointments.  如果没有秘书提醒，他会把所有的约会通通忘掉。

words.meaning: n.(for,to)偏爱,喜爱;优惠;优先选择
words.example:
Her preference is for comfortable rather than stylish clothes.  她更注重衣服的舒适性，而非时髦的款式。
Choosing furniture is largely a matter of personal preference.  挑选家俱主要是个人喜好的问题。
It would be wrong to discriminate against a candidate because of their sexual preference (= the sex of the people they are sexually attracted to).  出于应聘者的性倾向而对他们有所歧视是错误的。

words.meaning: n.计量器，计，表
words.example:
The electricity meter is under the stairs.  电表在楼梯下面。
You'll need some change for the parking meter.  你需要些零钱来付计时停车费。
The man from the gas board came to read the meter (= see how much gas had been used).  煤气公司的人来抄煤气表了。

words.meaning: a.快,急速的 n.(pl.)急流,湍滩
words.example:
The 1990s were a period of rapid change/growth.  20世纪90年代是一个迅猛突变／发展的时期。
His response to the accusation was rapid.  他对这种指责马上作出了回应。

words.meaning: n.允许进入;承认;入场费,入会费,入场券
words.example:
Her silence was taken as an admission of guilt/defeat.  她的沉默被认为是承认自己有罪／失败。
By/On his own admission (= as he has said) he has achieved little since he took over the company.  据他自己说，自从接手公司以来，他几乎一事无成。noun
Admission to the exhibition will be by invitation only.  只有持请帖者才可进入展览会场。

words.meaning: n. 猎人；猎犬；搜寻者
words.example: Animals in the cat family are hunters.  猫科动物都以狩猎动物维生。

words.meaning: v.教育,培养,训练
words.example:
The form says he was educated in Africa.  表格上显示他在非洲接受教育。
How much does it cost to educate a child privately?  让一个孩子接受私立教育要花费多少钱？
The government say they are trying to do more to educate the public about the consequences of drug abuse.  政府称他们正在加紧努力向大众进行宣传教育，帮助大家了解滥用毒品的恶果。

words.meaning: a.疼痛的,使痛苦的,费力[心]的,棘手的
words.example:
The old photograph brought back painful memories.  这张老照片唤起了痛苦的回忆。
It was painful to listen to his pathetic excuses.  听他那些牵强的借口实在让人觉得难受。

words.meaning: n.友谊,友好
words.example:
Their friendship goes back to when they were at school together.  他们的友谊可追溯到学生时代。
Did you form any close/lasting friendships while you were at college?  你上大学时是否与人建立了亲密／持久的友谊？

words.meaning: v.计算,推算;计划,打算
words.example:
The cost of the damage caused by the recent storms has been calculated as/at over £5 million.  据计算，近期风暴造成的损失超过了500万英镑。
The new tax system would be calculated on the value of property owned by an individual.  新税制将按照个人财产价值计算税额。
We're calculating on about 30 guests.  我们预期约有30名客人。

words.meaning: v.(of)使摆脱,使去掉
words.example:
That cream got rid of my skin rash.  那种药膏治好了我身上的皮疹。
Have you managed to get rid of your old Volvo yet?  你处理掉你的旧富豪车了吗？
We got rid of our unwelcome guests by saying we had to go to bed.  我们说必须要上床睡觉了，这才把那一帮不受欢迎的客人打发走。verb (ridding, rid or ridded, rid or ridded)

words.meaning: n.趋势,趋向;倾向
words.example: There is a tendency for unemployment to rise in the summer.  夏季的失业率有上升趋势。

words.meaning: n.制服,军服 a.相同的,一律的
words.example:
Photographs show him wearing the scruffy T-shirt and jeans that were the student's uniform of the time.  照片上的他穿着当时的校服，就是那种脏兮兮的T恤和牛仔裤。UK adjective
As in so many offices that you see, the walls and furniture are a uniform grey.  和你看到的很多办公室一样，墙壁和家俱一律都是灰色的。
Small businesses are demanding that they receive uniform treatment from the banks.  小企业要求银行给予它们一视同仁的待遇。

words.meaning: n.奖学金;学问,学识
words.example:
He got/won a scholarship to Eton.  他获得了伊顿公学的奖学金。
Paula went to the Royal College of Music on a scholarship.  宝拉靠奖学金进到皇家音乐学院。

words.meaning: n.保留,保留意见;预定,预订
words.example:
I'd like to make a table reservation for two people for 9 o'clock.  我要预订九点两人用餐的桌位。
Please confirm your reservation in writing by Friday.  请在星期五前对您的预订予以书面确认。
The family lives on a Native American reservation.  这家人住在一个美洲土著居民居留地上。

words.meaning: abbr. 个人电脑（Personal Computer）；巡逻车（Patrol Car）
words.example: The price of PCs has been tumbling recently.  最近，个人电脑的价格在持续下跌。noun countable

words.meaning: a.(to)有帮助的,有益的,有用的
words.example:
She's such a pleasant, helpful child!  她可真是个讨人喜欢又乐于助人的孩子！
I'm sorry, I was only trying to be helpful.  真抱歉，我只是想帮忙。
He made several helpful suggestions.  他提了几个很有帮助的建议。adjective

words.meaning: v.(on)印,盖印;留下印象,引人注目
words.example:
Your mother was clearly not impressed by our behaviour in the restaurant.  你妈妈对我们在餐厅的行为显然没有好印象。
He tried to impress me with his extensive knowledge of wine.  他想以自己在葡萄酒方面的渊博知识让我对他刮目相看。
formal I'm afraid the new theatre fails to impress.  恐怕这座新戏院不会受到瞩目。verb intransitive or transitive [not continuous]

words.meaning: n.脚后跟,踵,鞋跟
words.example:
For Walter, disaster followed hard on the heels of his initial success.  对华尔特来说，最初的成功之后，紧接就是惨败。noun countable
She ran down the steps with a group of journalists hard on her heels.  她跑下台阶，身后紧跟着一群记者。noun countable
When they saw the soldiers coming, they took to their heels.  当看见士兵过来时，他们拔腿就跑。noun countable

words.meaning: v.像,类似
words.example:
You resemble your mother very closely.  你长得很像你妈妈。
After the earthquake, the city resembled a battlefield.  地震过后，这座城市看上去就像战场一般。

words.meaning: n.诡计,骗局;恶作剧;窍门 vt.欺骗,哄骗
words.example:
She played a really nasty trick on me - she put syrup in my shampoo bottle!  她对我做了一个很讨厌的恶作剧——把糖浆放进我装洗发精的瓶子里。
My niece was showing me all the tricks that she's learned to do with her new magic set.  我侄女给我表演了她学过的用她那套新魔术道具所能变出的所有戏法。
It's a bit of trick photography - she's meant to look like she's walking on water.  这有点特技摄影的样子——她想要看上去像在水上行走一般。

words.meaning: n.帐篷
words.example: The tent leaked when it rained.  下雨时帐篷漏水了。

words.meaning: n.考试；检/细查
words.example: The evidence is still under examination (= being examined).  仍然在对那些证据进行调查。

words.meaning: v.加强,巩固
words.example:
They have been strengthening their border defences in preparation for war.  他们一直在为备战而强化边防。
His battle against cancer has strengthened his belief in God.  他跟癌症的斗争坚定了他对上帝的信仰。
The accident strengthens the case for better safety measures at fairgrounds.  这宗事故充分显示露天游乐场的安全防护需要加强。

words.meaning: n.母牛,奶牛
words.example:
You stupid cow!  你这个蠢婆娘！noun
It's been a cow of a day.  真是令人难受的一天。noun
The protesters refused to be cowed into submission by the army.  抗议者拒绝向军队低头。

words.meaning: a.睡觉,睡着(用作表语)
words.example:
I'm surprised to see you awake - ten minutes ago you were fast/sound (= completely) asleep.  真奇怪，你怎么醒了——十分钟前你还睡得很甜呢。
I've only just got up and I'm still half asleep (= not completely awake).  我刚起床，还没完全醒呢。

words.meaning: n.网球
words.example: Tennis is played with a racket.  网球要用球拍打。

words.meaning: n.菜单
words.example:
The waiter brought the menu and the wine list.  侍者拿来了菜单和酒单。
What's on the menu today?  今天菜单上有甚么菜？noun countable
Select the 'Edit' menu and then choose 'Copy'.  选择“编辑”功能表，再选择“复制”。

words.meaning: a.引起争论的,有争议的
words.example: The book was very controversial.  这本书很有争议。

words.meaning: a.不顾一切的,铤而走险的;绝望的,危急的
words.example:
The situation is desperate - we have no food, very little water and no medical supplies.  形势非常严峻——我们没有食物和药物，只有很少的水。
The earthquake survivors are in desperate need of help.  地震幸存者极需帮助。
He has a desperate desire to succeed.  他非常渴望成功。

words.meaning: n.(humour)幽默,诙谐
words.example: She has a great sense of humor.  她很有幽默感。

words.meaning: a.大声的,响亮的;吵闹的,喧嚣的
words.example:
Could you speak a little louder, please?  请你说话大声一点，好吗？adjective adverb
The message from management came through loud and clear: things would have to change.  管理层发出的资讯非常明确：必须进行变革。adjective disapproving
You shouldn't wear anything too loud to a job interview.  你去参加求职面试时不要穿得太花哨。

words.meaning: n.手套
words.example:
She gloved her hands to protect them from the chemicals.  她戴上手套防止受化学品的伤害。
He gloved the ball, turned and threw in one motion.  他的接球、转身、投掷，动作一气呵成。

words.meaning: n. 摄影师；照相师
words.example: a fashion/press/amateur photographer  时装／新闻／业余摄影师

words.meaning: n.直升(飞)机
words.example: The injured were ferried to hospital by helicopter.  伤者被直升机送往医院。

words.meaning: a.谦虚的,有节制的
words.example:
They live in a fairly modest house, considering their wealth.  就他们拥有的财富而言，他们的住所不大。
There has been a modest improvement/recovery in housing conditions for the poor.  穷人的居住条件有了些许改善。
The party made modest gains in the elections, but nothing like the huge gains that were predicted.  这个党派在选举中取得了一定成绩，但和人们预计的巨大收获相差甚远。

words.meaning: v./n.耽搁,延迟
words.example:
My plane was delayed by an hour.  我乘坐的飞机延误了一个小时。
Could we delay the meeting a few days?  我们可以把会议延后几天吗？
If you delay now, the opportunity might be lost.  现在你如果不赶快行动就会失去机会。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: adj. 农业的；农艺的
words.example:
The world's supply of agricultural land is shrinking fast.  世界农业用地面积正在迅速减少。
She's studying agricultural science.  她正在学习农业科学。
The country's economy is mainly agricultural (= based on farming).  农业是这个国家的经济支柱。

words.meaning: v.(使)爆炸,(使)爆发
words.example:
He was driving so fast that his car tyre exploded.  他的车开得太快导致爆胎。    Compare implodeUK verb
The children exploded into giggles (= suddenly started laughing uncontrollably).  孩子们突然咯咯地笑起来。UK verb
The population has exploded in the last ten years.  在过去十年中，人口激增。UK verb

words.meaning: n.罚，惩罚，处罚
words.example:
Many people think that the death penalty is too severe a punishment for any crime.  许多人认为对于无论何种罪行来说，死刑都过于严厉了。
formal It was always our father who administered/meted out punishments.  予以／给予惩罚的人一直是我们的父亲。
Drink-driving is one case where severe punishment seems to work as a deterrent.  酒后驾车是证明严惩似乎能起威慑作用的一个例子。noun

words.meaning: n.一把;少数;一小撮
words.example:
He pulled out a handful of coins from his pocket.  他从口袋里掏出一把硬币。noun
She invited loads of friends to her party, but only a handful of them turned up.  她请了很多朋友参加她的派对，但只有少数几个到场。noun
Her older son is fine but the little one is a bit of a handful.  她的大儿子很乖，但小儿子有点难管。

words.meaning: a.好奇的, 求知的, 古怪的, 爱挑剔的
words.example:
Babies are curious about everything around them.  婴儿对周围的一切都很好奇。
There was a curious -looking man standing outside.  外面站着个长相古怪的男人。
It's curious (that) Billy hasn't phoned when he promised he would.  比利说他会打电话来，可是还没打过来，真蹊跷。

words.meaning: ad.在城市的商业区 n./a.城市商业区(的)
words.example: downtown Los Angeles  洛杉矶市中心

words.meaning: vt.吸收(水、光、蒸汽等);使全神贯注;吞并/兼并
words.example:
Plants absorb carbon dioxide.  植物吸收二氧化碳。
In cold climates, houses need to have walls that will absorb heat.  在气候寒冷的地方，房屋的墙壁必须能吸收热量。
Towels absorb moisture.  毛巾吸收水汽。

words.meaning: n. 调整，调节；调节器
words.example:
She made a few minor adjustments to the focus of her camera.  她稍微调了调照相机的焦距。noun countable or uncountable
He has so far failed to make the adjustment from school to work.  他到现在还没有适应从学生生活到工作的变化。

words.meaning: n. 纳税人；所收租金只够支付地产税的建筑物
words.example: Taxpayer money funded the project.  这项目用的是纳税人的钱。

words.meaning: a.(for)渴望的,热切的
words.example: They crowded round the spokesperson, eager for any news.  他们把发言人围了个水泄不通，渴望能得到点消息。

words.meaning: n. 动机；积极性；推动
words.example:
He's a bright enough student - he just lacks motivation.  他是个很聪明的学生，只是不够积极。
There seems to be a lack of motivation among the staff.  员工似乎都缺乏干劲。UK noun
What was the motivation for the attack?  这次袭击的动机是甚么？

words.meaning: n.限制，限定，约束
words.example:
At the turn of the century, Congress imposed/placed a height restriction of 13 storeys on all buildings in Washington.  在世纪之交，国会对华盛顿的建筑实行了不得超过13层的高度限制。
The president urged other countries to lift the trade restrictions.  总统敦促其他国家取消贸易限制。

words.meaning: n.实验室，研究室
words.example: Laboratory tests suggest that the new drug may be used to treat cancer.  实验室测试显示这种新药可用于治疗癌症。

words.meaning: n.棉花;棉线,棉纱;棉制品
words.example:
She looked pretty in a simple cotton dress.  她穿着朴素的棉布连衣裙，看上去很漂亮。
I'd only just cottoned on to the fact that they were having a relationship.  我那时才明白他们在谈恋爱。

words.meaning: n.发动机,电动机
words.example:
The pump is powered by a small electric motor.  这个泵是由一个小马达提供动力的。
Our washing machine needs a new motor.  我们的洗衣机需要换个新马达。
mainly US I've had a new motor (= engine) put in my car.  我请人在我的车里安装了一个新引擎。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.看漏,忽略;俯瞰,眺望;宽容,放任
words.example:
Our hotel room overlooked the harbour.  从我们饭店的房间可眺望港口。
The house is surrounded by trees, so it's not overlooked at all (= it cannot be seen from any other buildings).  这栋房子四周绿树环绕，所以从其他建筑处根本看不到它。verb transitive UK NOT NOTICE  没注意
No one will be overlooked in the selection of the team.  在组队时不会忽略任何人。verb transitive UK FORGIVE  原谅

words.meaning: n.飘浮;漂流物 v.浮动;漂浮;传播;动摇
words.example:
An empty bottle will float.  空瓶子能浮起来。
You can float very easily in/on the Dead Sea because it's so salty.  因为死海含盐量很高，人可以轻松浮在水面上。UK verb
We spent a lazy afternoon floating down/along the river.  我们沿河漂流而下，懒洋洋的渡过了一个下午。

words.meaning: n.喷气发动机,喷气式飞机;喷口 v.喷出,喷射
words.example:
I'm jetting off to New Zealand next week.  我下周要搭飞机到纽西兰。noun
We flew to New York by jet.  我们搭喷射机到了纽约。
She turned on the hose and a jet of water sprayed across the garden.  她打开水管，一股水流向花园喷洒而去。

words.meaning: n.柑,桔,橙
words.example: The setting sun filled the sky with a deep orange glow.  落日的余晖将天空染成了橙红色。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.暂时的,临时的
words.example: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.  停火只能暂时解决危机。

words.meaning: v./n.咬,叮 n.一口
words.example:
He bit into the apple.  他咬了一口苹果。
An insect bit me on the arm.  有一只小虫子叮了我的手臂。
He bites his fingernails.  他咬指甲。

words.meaning: n.版,版本,版次
words.example:
The regional editions of the paper contain specific information for that area.  该报地方版刊登一些针对当地读者的内容。
This morning's edition of 'Women's Hour' is at the earlier time of a quarter to ten.  今天上午的《妇女时光》节目将提前到九点四十五分播出
She collects first editions of nineteenth century authors.  她收藏19世纪作家著作的初版本。

words.meaning: n.(山)谷，溪谷；流域
words.example: There was snow on the hill tops but not in the valley.  山顶上有雪，但山谷里没有。

words.meaning: pron.[you的物主代词]你(们)的(所有物)
words.example:
Is this pen yours?  这支钢笔是你的吗？
Unfortunately my legs aren't as long as yours.  可惜我的腿不如你的长。
I've got something of yours (= that belongs to you).  我有一些你的东西。

words.meaning: n.松树
words.example:
Pine is a softwood.  松木是一种软木。verb intransitive
Carter died in 1904 after an accident and Leno pined away and died in London six months later.  1904年卡特死于非命，莱诺日渐憔悴，六个月后死于伦敦。verb intransitive
He's still pining for his ex-girlfriend.  他还在苦苦思念着他的前女友。

words.meaning: a.光辉的,灿烂的;卓越的,有才华的
words.example:
She's got a brilliant sense of humour.  他极富幽默感。
Oh, brilliant! My parcel's arrived.  噢，太棒了！我的包裹到了。adjective
Her mother was a brilliant scientist.  她母亲是一位才华横溢的科学家。

words.meaning: a.绝对的,完全的;确实的,肯定的
words.example:
There was no absolute proof of fraud.  没有确凿的证据能证明是诈骗行为。
He's an absolute idiot!  他是个十足的白痴！
That's absolute rubbish!  那完全是一派胡言！adjective

words.meaning: n.(餐馆等的)厨师长,厨师
words.example:
He is one of the top chefs in Britain.  他是英国的顶级厨师之一。
She is head- chef at the Waldorf-Astoria.  她是华道夫－阿斯多里亚餐厅的首席厨师。

words.meaning: n. 歧视；区别，辨别；识别力
words.example: Until 1986 most companies would not even allow women to take the examinations, but such blatant discrimination is now disappearing.  直至1986年大多数公司甚至还不允许女性参加这种考试，但目前这种明目张胆的歧视做法正在消失。noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.迅速发展,兴旺;发出隆隆声
words.example:
This year has seen a boom in book sales.  今年图书销售激增。
The insurance business suffered from a vicious cycle of boom and bust.  保险业经历了繁荣和萧条的恶性循环。
The cannons boomed (out) in the night.  大炮在晚上隆隆作响。

words.meaning: n./v.登记,注册 v.(仪表等)指示,(邮件)挂号
words.example:
Within two weeks of arrival all foreigners had to register with the local police.  所有外国人在到达后两周内必须在当地警察局登记。
Students have to register for the new course by the end of April.  选修这门新课程的学生必须在四月底之前注册。UK verb
The Geiger counter registered a dangerous level of radioactivity.  盖氏计算器显示辐射强度达到了危险级别。

words.meaning: vt.任命,委派;指定,约定(时间、地点等)
words.example:
We've appointed three new teachers this year.  我们今年已经任用了三名新教师。
He's just been appointed (as) director of the publishing division.  他刚刚被任命为出版部主任。

words.meaning: n.上帝(小写god泛指所有的“神,神像”)
words.example:
Do you believe in God?  你信上帝吗？UK noun [S not after the]
My God, what a mess!  我的天哪，这么乱！
Oh my God, I've never seen anything like it!  我的天哪，我从没有见过那样的事情！UK noun [S not after the]

words.meaning: n.柠檬
words.example:
For this recipe you need the juice of two lemons.  按照这份食谱，你需要两个柠檬的果汁。
Would you like a slice of lemon in your tea?  你的茶里要放一片柠檬吗？
Only one of his inventions turned out to be a lemon.  在他的几项发明中只有一项没有获得成功。

words.meaning: a.饥饿的,渴望的
words.example:
By four o'clock I felt/was really hungry.  到四点钟的时候我觉得肚子非常饿。
Digging the garden is hungry work (= makes you feel hunger).  在园里挖土真是一件令人容易饥饿的活动。
The children are always hungry (= want something to eat) when they get home from school.  孩子们放学回家时总是饥肠辘辘。

words.meaning: v.漫步,徘徊;迷路,迷失方向;离题
words.example:
We spent the morning wandering around the old part of the city.  我们整个上午都在老城区闲逛。
She was found several hours later, wandering the streets , lost.  几个小时后她被找到了，正在街上徘徊，迷路了。
He was here a moment ago but he's wandered off somewhere.  他刚才还在这里，现在已经闲逛到别的甚么地方去了。UK verb

words.meaning: v.(to)使服从,屈服;(to)呈送,提交
words.example:
You must submit your application before January 1st.  申请须于1月1日前提交。
The developers submitted building plans to the council for approval.  开发商向市政会提交待批准的建筑规划。
In conclusion, I submit that the proposal will not work without some major changes.  最后，我认为这项提案必须进行重大修改方能实施。 (-tt-)

words.meaning: n.坚果;螺母,螺帽
words.example:
Sprinkle some roasted chopped nuts on top.  往表面撒些烤过的碎果仁。noun
Nuts and bolts are used to hold pieces of machinery together.  螺帽和螺栓用来把机器零件装拼在一起。noun
What kind of nut would leave a car on a railway track?  哪个疯子会把车停在铁轨上？

words.meaning: n.延长;扩大;范围;大小;尺寸;电话分机
words.example:
Martin Luther King, Jr, campaigned for the extension of civil rights to (= for them to include) black people.  小马丁‧路德‧金发起了为黑人争取公民权利的运动。
The extension (= increasing) of police powers in the province has been heavily criticized.  在该省增加警力的做法遭到严厉的抨击。
His report contained serious criticisms of the finance director, and, by extension (= therefore) , of the entire board of management.  他的报告对财务总监进行了严厉批评，进而又扩及到整个管理委员会。

words.meaning: n.电池(组);(器具等的)一组,一套;炮兵连
words.example:
This alarm clock takes two medium-sized batteries.  这个闹钟需要装上两枚中号电池。
In the kitchen an impressive battery of stainless steel utensils hangs on the wall.  厨房的墙上挂着一套不锈钢厨具，非常显眼。UK noun
The shore battery opened fire.  岸边的炮阵开火了。UK noun

words.meaning: n.到达,到来;到达者,到达物
words.example:
Hundreds gathered to await the boxer's arrival at the airport.  数百人聚集在机场等候拳击手的到来。
On arrival at the police station, they were taken to an interview room.  一到警察局，他们就被带到一间问讯室。
We regret the late arrival of Flight 237.  237航班延误，我们对此表示歉意。

words.meaning: n.火焰,火苗;热情;光辉 v.发火焰,燃烧
words.example:
The flames grew larger as the fire spread.  火势蔓延，火焰越来越高。
The car flipped over and burst into flames (= started burning immediately).  汽车翻了，顿时起火烧了起来。
When the fire engine arrived the house was already in flames (= burning).  消防车赶到时，房屋已是一片火海。noun

words.meaning: n.创伤,伤口 v.伤,伤害
words.example:
He died from multiple stab wounds to the neck and upper body.  他死于颈部和上半身的多处刺伤。noun countable
She refuses to talk about the incident, saying it would only reopen old wounds (= make her remember unhappy past experiences).  她拒绝谈起那场事故，说那样只会揭开旧伤疤。verb transitive usually passive
Flying glass wounded her in the face and neck.  飞溅的玻璃刮伤她的脸和颈部。

words.meaning: n.阵雨;沐浴;(一)阵/大批v.下阵雨,倾注
words.example:
The shower is broken - you'll have to have a bath.  淋浴器坏了——你得用浴缸洗澡了。
Many British homes have a shower attachment fixed to the bath taps.  英国的许多家庭都在浴缸龙头上安装了淋浴器。
Have I got time to (UK)have/(US)take a shower before we go out?  我们出去之前我还有时间冲个澡吗?

words.meaning: n.肉,肌肉
words.example:
The thorn went deep into the flesh of my hand.  刺深深扎进了我的手。
The flesh of the fruit is white.  这种水果的果肉是白色的。
Vegetarians don't eat animal flesh (= meat).  素食者不吃肉。

words.meaning: n.车库,飞机库;修车厂
words.example:
Did you put the car in the garage?  你把车停到车库里了吗？
The car's still at the garage getting fixed.  车还在汽车修理厂维修呢。
If your car is garaged, you get much cheaper insurance.  如果你把车停放在车库里，你买汽车保险时就能省很多钱。

words.meaning: n.操作人员,(电话)接线员
words.example: He has shown himself to be a canny operator in wage negotiations.  他在薪酬谈判过程中表现得精明老练。

words.meaning: vt.借,借入;(思想、文字等)采用,抄袭
words.example:
Could I borrow your bike from (not standard off)you until next week?  我能借你的脚踏车用到下周吗？
She used to borrow money and not bother to pay it back.  她过去常借钱不还。
He borrowed a novel from the library.  他从图书馆里借了一本小说。

words.meaning: n.喜剧;喜剧性事件
words.example:
His latest film is described as a 'romantic comedy'.  他的最新影片被描述为一部“浪漫喜剧”。
The vicar's forgetting his lines in the middle of the speech provided some good comedy.  牧师讲到一半忘了词这件事提供了很不错的笑料。

words.meaning: n.平民 a.平民的;民用的
words.example: The bomb killed four soldiers and three civilians.  炸弹炸死四名士兵及三名平民。

words.meaning: a.每星期的,一周的ad.每周一次 n.周刊,周报
words.example: The fire alarm has a weekly test/is tested weekly.  每周都要对火警系统进行检测。noun countable

words.meaning: n.谷物,谷类;颗粒,细粒
words.example:
Grain (= the crop from food plants like grasses) is one of the main exports of the American Midwest.  谷物是美国中西部地区主要的出口商品。
There wasn't a grain of truth in anything she said.  她无论说甚么都没有半句实话在里面。
Anyone with a grain of common sense would have known what to do.  稍微有一点常识的人都会知道应该做甚么。noun

words.meaning: n.刷(子),毛刷;画笔 v.刷,擦,掸,拂;掠过
words.example:
You'll need a stiff brush to scrape off the rust.  你需要用硬刷子把锈迹刷掉。
These shoes need a good brush.  这些鞋子需要好好刷一下。
Don't forget to give your hair a brush before you go out.  出门前别忘了梳一下头发。noun

words.meaning: v.(to)奉献,致力
words.example:
He left government to devote more time to his family.  为了能有更多时间陪伴家人，他离开了政府部门。
She has devoted all her energies/life to the care of homeless people.  她为照料无家可归者倾注了全部心血／奉献了一生。
Over half his speech was devoted to the issue of unemployment.  他那篇演讲用了一半多的篇幅讨论失业问题。

words.meaning: n.省;领域,范围,本分
words.example:
Renaissance art is not really his province - he specializes in the modern period.  文艺复兴时期的艺术并不是他的研究领域——他的专业是现代艺术。
Marketing is within the province of the sales department.  市场行销属于销售部的职责范围。

words.meaning: v.抓住,逮住;夺取,占领;没收,查封
words.example:
He seized the chance/opportunity of a free flight with both hands (= with eagerness or enthusiasm).  他急切地紧抓住搭乘免费航班的机会。
The rebels have seized ten soldiers to use as hostages.  叛乱者俘获了十名士兵作为人质。
Political instability helped the army to seize power.  政治动荡使军队攫取了权力。

words.meaning: n.允许,同意
words.example:
Official permission has been granted for more building near the river.  在这条河附近建造更多房子的做法已获得官方许可。
The authorities have refused permission for the demonstration to take place.  官方拒绝批准游行示威。
Planning permission was refused for the hypermarket after a three-week inquiry.  经过三周的调查，兴建特大型超市的规划被否决了。

words.meaning: a.有智慧的,聪明的
words.example:
Looking at the weather, I think we made a wise decision not to go to the coast this weekend.  看看天气，我觉得我们决定本周末不去海滨是很明智的。
Was it Thomas More who said that the wise man learns from the experience of others?  是托马斯‧莫尔说过聪明人会吸取别人的经验教训吗？
I've read the instructions twice and I'm still none the wiser.  我已经读过两遍说明书，可还是不明白。adjective

words.meaning: n.女演员
words.example:
She's the highest-paid actress in Hollywood.  她是好莱坞片酬最高的女演员。noun countable
It slides right into the hole, as the actress said to the bishop.  “它不偏不倚地滑进洞里，”这话很暧昧。

words.meaning: n.酸,酸性物质a.酸的,酸味的;尖刻的
words.example:
When she spoke her tone was acid.  她说话时，语气尖酸刻薄。noun
Vinegar is an acid.  醋是一种酸。noun

words.meaning: adj. 有天赋的；有才华的；v. 给予（gift的过去分词）
words.example: Schools often fail to cater for the needs of gifted children.  学校常常不能满足资优学生的发展要求。

words.meaning: n.(pl.media)媒体,方法,媒介,介质 a.中等的
words.example:
Would you like your steak rare, medium, or well-done?  你的牛排要嫩的、半熟的还是熟透的？noun countable
They told the story through the medium of dance.  他们用舞蹈的形式来讲述这个故事。noun countable

words.meaning: v.(from)区别,辨别;辨认出;使杰出
words.example:
He's colour-blind and can't distinguish (the difference) between red and green easily.  他是色盲，很难分清红色和绿色（的不同）。
It's important to distinguish between business and pleasure.  分清哪是正事、哪是娱乐非常重要。
It's not the beauty so much as the range of his voice that distinguishes him from other tenors.  他与其他男高音大不相同，并非因为他那华美的声音，而是他宽广的音域。

words.meaning: n.海滨,湖滨
words.example:
You can walk for miles along the shore.  你可以沿着海岸走上好几哩。
The boat was about a mile from/off (the) shore when the engine suddenly died.  船离岸边还有一哩左右时引擎突然熄火了。
We waited until we were on shore before repairing the sails.  我们等到上了岸才开始修帆。

words.meaning: n.肺
words.example: lung cancer  肺癌noun countable

words.meaning: n.筐,篮,篓
words.example:
We picked lots of strawberries, but we'd eaten half the basket by the time we got home.  我们摘了很的草莓，但在到家时已经吃掉了半筐。UK noun countable
There are 4 items in your basket.  你的线上购物篮中有四件商品。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.丑陋的,难看的;丑恶的,讨厌的
words.example:
Yesterday in town I saw the ugliest baby I've ever seen in my life.  昨天在城里我看见了有生以来见过的最丑的婴儿。
He was a really unpleasant man and as ugly as sin (= very ugly).  他是一个非常讨厌的人，而且丑得要命。adjective
There were ugly scenes outside the stadium.  体育场外发生了暴力事件。

words.meaning: adj. 担心的
words.example:
She was sitting behind her desk with a worried expression/look on her face.  她坐在桌子后面，神色焦急。
They don't seem particularly worried about the situation.  他们看起来对这种局面并不十分担心。
You had me worried (= You made me feel anxious) for a moment back there - I thought you wouldn't be able to stop in time.  你刚才让我担心了一阵——我以为你不能及时停下来。

words.meaning: n.粉末,药粉;火药,炸药
words.example:
You'll get more flavour from the spices if you grind them into a powder.  你把香料磨成粉的话味道会更香浓。
You can buy milk in powder form.  你可以买奶粉。
Dust the face lightly with powder.  在脸上轻扑些粉。

words.meaning: v.说服,劝说;(of)使相信
words.example:
If she doesn't want to go, nothing you can say will persuade her.  如果她不想去，你是说甚么也劝不动她的。
Using a bunch of bananas, the zoo-keeper persuaded the monkey back into its cage.  动物园管理员用一串香蕉诱使猴子回到笼子里。
formal The first priority is to persuade the management of the urgency of this matter.  当务之急是要让管理阶层了解到事情的紧迫性。

words.meaning: n. 饼干；小甜点
words.example: She's a smart/tough cookie.  她是个聪明／顽强的人。noun countable

words.meaning: n.搬运人;载体
words.example: There are an estimated 1.5 million HIV carriers in the country.  据估计，这个国家有150万 HIV 病毒带原者。

words.meaning: a.时常发生的,频繁的
words.example:
The most frequent cause of death is heart attack.  最常见的死因是心脏病发作。
The attacks were increasingly frequent and serious.  攻击变得越来越频繁，越来越猛烈。verb transitive UK US     formal

words.meaning: v.取缔,查禁;(from)禁止 n.禁止,禁令
words.example:
The film was banned (= the government prevented it from being shown) in several countries.  有几个国家都禁止播放这部电影。
There should be a ban on talking loudly in cinemas.  戏院里应该禁止大声交谈。

words.meaning: a.极度的,极坏的;威严的,可怕的
words.example:
He suffered awful injuries in the crash.  他在车祸中受了重伤。
We had awful weather.  我们碰上了糟糕的天气。
She's got an awful boss.  她的老板极难相处。

words.meaning: vt.钦佩,赞赏,羡慕;称赞,夸奖
words.example: We stood for a few moments, admiring the view.  我们驻足了一会儿，欣赏美丽的景色。

words.meaning: n.爱畜,宠儿 a.宠爱的,表示亲昵的
words.example:
They have several pets - a dog, two rabbits and a guinea pig.  他们有好几只宠物：一只狗、两只兔子和一只天竺鼠。
The other children hated her because she was the teacher's pet.  别的孩子都讨厌她，因为她是老师的宠儿。
He's always sending me flowers - he's a real pet!  他总是送花给我——他真讨人喜欢！

words.meaning: a.分布广泛的,普遍的
words.example:
There are reports of widespread flooding in northern France.  有报道说法国北部到处洪水泛滥。
Malnutrition in the region is widespread - affecting up to 78% of children under five years old.  这个地区营养不良的现象十分普遍——五岁以下的儿童中78%营养不良。
The campaign has received widespread support.  这场运动得到广泛支持。

words.meaning: a.可爱的,好看的;令人愉快的,美好的
words.example:
We had a lovely time with them.  我们和他们在一起渡过了一段快乐的时光。adjective
She has lovely eyes.  她的眼睛很漂亮。
You look lovely in that dress.  你穿那条裙子很好看。

words.meaning: n.识别,鉴别;证件;认同
words.example:
Most of the bodies were badly burned, making identification almost impossible.  大部分尸体都严重烧焦，几乎无法辨认。
We were asked to show some identification before the security guards would let us in.  保安人员要我们出示身分证明文件才让我们进去。

words.meaning: adj.每日的,日常的
words.example: Death was an everyday occurrence during the Civil War.  在内战期间，死亡是很普遍的事。adjective

words.meaning: n.大字标题,新闻标题
words.example:
The news of his death was splashed in headlines across all the newspapers.  所有报纸均以显著的标题刊登了他死亡的消息。
The story was headlined 'Killer dogs on the loose'.  这篇报道的标题是：“杀人恶犬肆意逞凶”。
The band's headlining appearance at the Reading Festival could be their last.  这支乐队在雷丁音乐节上担纲演出，但这可能是他们的最后一次表演了。

words.meaning: adj.充足的,足够的;适当的,胜任的
words.example:
Have we got adequate food for twenty guests?  我们的食物够招待20位客人吗？
It's not by any means a brilliant salary but it's adequate for our needs.  薪资一点也谈不上优厚，但足以满足我们的需要了。
The council's provision for the elderly is barely adequate (= is not enough).  地方议会给长者提供的保障不足。

words.meaning: n.钢琴
words.example:
We're buying a new piano.  我们准备买一架新钢琴。
mainly US or specialized She used to play piano in a jazz band.  她以前在一支爵士乐队演奏钢琴。
The music was written for piano.  这首乐曲是为钢琴谱写的。

words.meaning: n.食品杂货店
words.example: We buy grocery on Saturdays.  我们周六买杂货。

words.meaning: n.毯子(可数);厚厚一层(可数) vt.铺上一层
words.example:
The ground was covered by a thick blanket of snow.  地上覆盖着一层厚厚的雪。adjective [before noun]
'Man', as a blanket term for both men and women, is now considered sexist.  man 用作一个广义词来指代男人和女人，现在被认为有性别歧视色彩。verb transitive often passive literary
Outside the fields were blanketed in fog.  外面，田野被浓雾笼罩着。

words.meaning: n.(pl.mice)鼠,耗子
words.example: a field mouse  田鼠

words.meaning: n.绳,索
words.example:
The middleweight boxing champion had his opponent up against the ropes.  那个中量级拳击冠军将对手逼到了拳击台的护栏上。UK noun
Lynn spent an afternoon showing the new girl the ropes.  林恩花了一下午的时间教那个新来的年轻女职员入门。UK verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition
I'll rope my horse to your car and pull you out of the ditch.  我把我的马套在你的汽车上把你从沟里拉出来。

words.meaning: a.具体的,实质性的n.混凝土v.用混凝土修筑
words.example:
Why did you concrete over that nice garden?  你为甚么把那个漂亮的花园铺上混凝土？UK adjective
They think she killed her husband, but they've no concrete evidence.  他们认为她杀死了自己的丈夫，但是他们没有确凿的证据。
We've got a general idea of what we want, but nothing concrete at the moment.  我们对需要甚么有个大致的想法，可是具体的东西目前还没有想好。

words.meaning: n.药方,处方
words.example:
These drugs are only available on prescription (= with a prescription from a doctor).  这些药只能凭处方购买。
Prescription charges (= the standard amount of money you pay for any medicine prescribed by a doctor) are rising in June.  六月份处方药费在上涨。noun
So what is his prescription for success?  那么他认为成功的诀窍是甚么？

words.meaning: n.砖块,砖;v.用砖围砌,用砖填补
words.example:
The chimney was made of bricks.  烟囱是用砖砌的。
We lived in a Victorian terrace of red -brick houses.  我们住在维多利亚式的红砖房连排屋中。
He was so embarrassed - his face went brick -red (= a dark red).  他尴尬极了，脸涨得紫红紫红的。

words.meaning: n.(意见等的)一致,一致同意,共识
words.example:
The general consensus in the office is that he's useless at his job.  办公室成员一致认为他在工作中碌碌无为。
Could we reach a consensus on this matter? Let's take a vote.  我们能在这件事上达成共识吗？我们来表决吧。

words.meaning: n.漆工,画家
words.example: The painter covered the wall with blue.  画家把墙刷成了蓝色。

words.meaning: n.馅饼
words.example:
Would you like some more pork pie?  你想再要点猪肉馅饼吗？
Their plans to set up their own business are just pie in the sky.  他们自行创业的计划只不过是空想罢了。

words.meaning: n.勇气,胆量
words.example:
They showed great courage when they found out about their baby's disability.  发现自己的婴儿身有残疾时，他们表现出了巨大的勇气。
It took me ages to summon/pluck up the courage to ask for a promotion.  过了很久我才鼓足勇气要求升职。
Although many of his policies were unpopular, he had the courage of his convictions to see them through.  尽管他的许多政策不受欢迎，但他仍然有勇气按照自己的信念去贯彻。

words.meaning: v.(at)诅咒,骂人;宣誓,发誓
words.example:
She had a good seat at the President's swearing-in ceremony.  她在总统宣誓就职仪式上占了个好座位。UK US  (swore, sworn)
After years of addiction, he swore off drugs completely.  上瘾几年后，他发誓彻底戒毒。

words.meaning: n.击败,战胜,失败 v.击败,战胜;使失败
words.example:
Napoleon was defeated by the Duke of Wellington at the battle of Waterloo.  拿破伦在滑铁卢战役中被威灵顿公爵击败。
If we can defeat the Italian team, we'll be through to the final.  如果我们能打败义大利队，我们将晋身决赛。
The proposal to change the rules was narrowly (= only just) defeated by 201 votes to 196.  变更规则的提案仅以196票对201票的微弱劣势未获通过。

words.meaning: n.薄片,切片;一份;部分切(片)
words.example:
Would you like another slice of ham/beef?  要不要再来一片火腿／牛肉?
We agreed before we did the deal that we'd both take an equal slice of the profit.  成交前，我们说定双方各拿利润的一半。
The film presents us with a fascinating slice of history.  这部电影向我们展示了一个非常有趣的历史片段。

words.meaning: n.占领,占据;占用;职业,工作
words.example:
In the space marked 'occupation' she wrote 'police officer'.  在“职业”一栏里她写了“员警”。UK noun
It seems to me his favourite occupation is eating.  在我看来，他最喜爱的消遣就是吃。UK noun

words.meaning: a.昂贵的;亲爱的;珍贵的 int.呵!哎呀!
words.example:
She was a very dear friend.  她是一位非常亲密的朋友。
He was very dear to me.  他跟我非常亲近。
This place is very dear to me - we came here on our honeymoon.  这个地方对我来讲非常亲切——我们曾到这里度过蜜月。

words.meaning: n.煤,煤块
words.example:
How much coal was mined here?  这里出了多少煤？
Exporting pine to Scandinavia seems a bit like carrying coals to Newcastle.  往斯堪的纳维亚出口松木似乎有点多此一举。UK noun countable or uncountable
He was hauled over the coals for coming in late for work.  他因为上班迟到而受到训斥。

words.meaning: a.神圣的;宗教的;庄严的
words.example:
This area is sacred to the Apaches.  对阿帕契人而言，这一个地区是神圣的。
His daily routine is absolutely sacred to him.  对他而言，每天的日常安排绝对是不容改变的。
humorous The cricketers wore blue, not their usual white - is nothing sacred?  板球队员们身穿蓝色队服，不是他们常穿的白色——难道这也是可以改的吗？

words.meaning: a.确切的,正确的,精确的
words.example:
The exact distance is 1.838 metres.  精确距离是1.838公尺。
The exact time of the accident was 2.43 pm.  事件发生的正确时间是下午两点四十三分。
The exact location of the factory has yet to be decided.  这工厂的正确位置还未定案。

words.meaning: n.伯父,叔父,舅父,姑父,姨父
words.example:
I've got several uncles and aunts.  我有几个叔叔和姑姑。
We invited my Uncle Steve round.  我们邀请了我的叔叔史蒂夫过来。
[as form of address] Did you bring me a present, Uncle Jack?  你给我带礼物了吗，杰克叔叔？

words.meaning: n.首领,队长;船长;上尉 v.做…的首领,指挥
words.example:
This is your captain speaking. We expect to be landing at London Heathrow in an hour's time.  我是机长。我们预计一小时后在伦敦希斯洛机场降落。
It's unusual to have a goalkeeper as (the) captain of a football team.  让守门员当足球队的队长是很少见的。
He captained the England cricket team for 5 years.  他曾担任英格兰板球队的队长五年。

words.meaning: n.叹息,叹息声 v.叹息,叹气
words.example:
She sighed deeply and sat down.  她深叹一口气，坐了下来。
He leaned back in his seat with a sigh.  他向后靠在座位上长出了一口气。
"Ah, you're here, " she said and heaved/let out/gave a sigh of relief.  “啊，你在这里，”她说道，如释重负地松了口气。

words.meaning: v.敢,胆敢
words.example:
Do you dare (to) tell him the news?  你敢告诉他这个消息吗？
Dare you tell him the news?  你敢告诉他这个消息吗？
I'd never dare (to) talk to my mother the way Ben talks to his.  我永远也不敢像宾对他母亲讲话那样跟我母亲说话。

words.meaning: n.长廊,画廊,美术馆
words.example: the National Portrait Gallery  国家肖像画廊

words.meaning: n.足球
words.example: My brother plays soccer after school.  我弟弟放学后踢足球。

words.meaning: n.大腿,(跑道的)一圈,一段路程,工作阶段
words.example:
Come and sit on my lap and I'll read you a story.  过来坐在我的腿上，我念故事给你听。noun
He recorded the fastest lap in last weekend's Hungarian Grand Prix.  在上周的匈牙利大奖赛中他创造了最快单圈成绩纪录。
After a strong start, she was passed by several runners in/on the final/last lap and finished ninth.  她在起跑阶段很有优势，但在最后一圈时被几名选手超出，最终获得了第九名。

words.meaning: n.容器;集装箱
words.example: an airtight container  密封容器

words.meaning: n.善；美德；优点
words.example:
Patience is a virtue.  耐心是一种美德。    Compare viceUK noun
It always looks odd to see an actress on TV extolling (= praising) the virtues of washing-up liquid.  看见女演员在电视上吹捧洗涤剂的种种优点总是让人感觉怪怪的。
Would there be any virtue in taking an earlier train?  乘坐早一班的火车有甚么好处呢？UK noun

words.meaning: ad.到国外,在国外;在传播,在流传
words.example:
He's currently abroad on business.  目前他在国外出差。
We always go abroad in the summer.  我们夏天总是到国外去。adverb [after verb]
Not a soul was abroad that morning.  那天上午，户外空无一人。adverb [after verb]

words.meaning: n.玫瑰,蔷薇
words.example:
She sent him a bunch of red roses.  她送了他一束红玫瑰。UK noun countable
Being in a relationship is not all roses, you know.  你知道，谈恋爱可并非总是柔情蜜意，也有不如意的事。UK noun countable
The houses were painted various shades of rose.  房屋被粉刷成了色泽深浅不同的粉红色。UK adjective noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.减少,减小;减少量 v.减少,变少,降低
words.example:
Our share of the market has decreased sharply this year.  今年我们的市场份额急剧下降。
We have decreased our involvement in children's books.  我们减少了在儿童读物方面的投入。    Opposite increasenoun countable or uncountable /ˈdiː.kriːs/
There has been a steady decrease in the number of visitors.  访客数量逐渐减少。

words.meaning: n.栏杆,围栏;(pl.)铁路;铁轨;横杆,栏杆
words.example:
Environmentalists argue that more goods should be transported by rail.  环保主义者们主张应该充分利用铁路来运输货物。
Will spectators please stay behind the rail?  观众们请站在栏杆后面好吗？
Hold onto the rail so that you don't fall.  抓牢扶手，这样就不会摔倒了。

words.meaning: n.周年,周年纪念日
words.example:
We always celebrate our wedding anniversary with dinner in an expensive restaurant.  我们总是去豪华饭店就餐来庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。
Tomorrow is the thirtieth anniversary of the revolution.  明天是革命30周年纪念日。

words.meaning: n.混乱,混杂,脏乱 v.弄脏,弄乱,搞糟
words.example:
He makes a terrible mess when he's cooking.  他做饭时总是把周围弄得乱七八糟。
Jem's house is always in a mess.  杰姆的房子总是又脏又乱。
Go and clear up that mess in the kitchen.  去把厨房里乱七八糟的东西清理干净。

words.meaning: n.青少年 a.青春期的,青少年的
words.example: an adolescent boy  青春期的男孩

words.meaning: v.照耀,发光;擦亮 n.光泽,光
words.example:
Is that light shining in your eyes?  那光晃眼吗？
The sun shone all afternoon.  整个下午阳光灿烂。
He polished the brass till it shone.  他把黄铜器皿擦得闪闪发光。

words.meaning: vt.弄翻，打翻，倾覆
words.example:
It still upsets him when he thinks about the accident.  一想起那次事故他仍很恼火。
Any mechanical problems would upset our plans of driving across the desert.  哪怕是很小的机械故障都有可能搅乱我们驾车穿越沙漠的计划。verb transitive /ʌpˈset/
Our dog upset the picnic table, spilling food everywhere.  狗撞翻了野餐桌，把我们的食物弄得到处都是。verb transitive /ʌpˈset/

words.meaning: n.(about,on)评语,意见 v.(on)评论;注意到
words.example:
All his friends remarked on the change in him since his marriage.  他所有的朋友都说起他结婚后的变化。UK noun countable
Her remarks on the employment question led to a heated discussion.  她对就业问题的评论引发了热烈的讨论。
The children made rude remarks about the old man.  孩子们粗言恶语地谈论那个老人。

words.meaning: v.辞去,辞职,使听从(于),使顺从
words.example:
He resigned from the company in order to take a more challenging job.  他从这家公司辞职以便能够从事更有挑战性的工作。
She resigned as director.  她辞去了董事职务。
She resigned the directorship.  她辞去了董事职务。

words.meaning: n.(for)报酬,赏金 v.(for)酬劳;酬谢
words.example:
There's a reward for whoever finishes first.  无论谁先完成都会得到一份奖赏。
The rewards of motherhood outweigh the anguish.  做母亲得到的回报大于经受的痛苦。
The police offered a reward for any information about the robbery.  警方悬赏征求有关劫案的任何线索。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.和蔼的,文雅的,有礼貌的
words.example:
He's very gentle with his kids.  他对孩子们很温和。
You can actually accomplish a lot more by gentle persuasion.  和声细语耐心说服实际上会收效更大。
The path has a gentle slope/gradient.  这条小路上有个平缓的斜坡／有点平缓的坡度。

words.meaning: n.器官;机构,机关;风琴
words.example:
Electronic organs are much smaller and cheaper than pipe organs.  电风琴比管风琴小得多，也便宜得多。UK noun
The newspaper Pravda was the official organ of the Communist Party in the Soviet Union.  《真理报》曾是苏联共产党的官方报纸。

words.meaning: v.发明,创造;捏造,虚构
words.example:
The first safety razor was invented by company founder King C. Gillette in 1903.  第一把安全剃刀由公司创办人金恩‧坎普‧吉列于1903年发明。verb transitive
But I didn't invent the story - everything I told you is true.  但我没有胡编——我告诉你的都是真的。

words.meaning: n.笑,笑声
words.example:
She roared with laughter (= laughed very loudly).  她放声大笑起来。
As we approached the hall we could hear the sound of laughter.  我们快走到大厅时可以听到里面传出的笑声。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.西北方,西北部a.西北的ad.向西北,在西北
words.example: The wind comes from the northwest.  风从西北来。

words.meaning: n.收受者，收件人
words.example:
She picked up the receiver and dialled his number.  她拿起电话拨了他的号码。
The company went bankrupt and was put into the hands of the receivers.  公司破产了，由破产管理人接管。

words.meaning: n.昆虫
words.example:
Ants, beetles, butterflies and flies are all insects.  蚂蚁、甲虫、蝴蝶和苍蝇都是昆虫。
I've got some sort of insect bite on my leg.  我腿上被小虫咬了一口。

words.meaning: v.中断,遮断,阻碍;打断(话),打扰
words.example:
She tried to explain what had happened but he kept interrupting her.  她试图解释所发生的事情，但他不停地打断她。
We had to interrupt our trip when we heard John's mother was ill.  听说约翰的母亲病了，我们不得不中止旅行。

words.meaning: n.魔术,魔(魅)力,巫术 a.有魔力的,魔术的
words.example:
The group are known for their belief in witchcraft and magic.  这个组织以相信巫术和魔法而出名。
As if by magic] Like magic, the car changes into a boat when it hits the water.  汽车一碰到水就像变魔法般的变成了船。
He's a comedian who also does magic.  他是个喜剧演员，但也表演魔术。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.优良的,卓越的;上级的 n.上级;长者;高手
words.example:
This is clearly the work of a superior artist.  这显然是一位优秀艺术家的作品。
She was chosen for the job because she was the superior candidate.  因为她比其他应征者更出色，所以她被选中做这份工作。
For all babies, breastfeeding is far superior to bottlefeeding.  对所有的婴儿来说，喂母乳都比喂奶瓶好得多。

words.meaning: n.外科医生
words.example: The surgeon saved his life.  外科医生救了他的命。

words.meaning: n.物理(学)
words.example: nuclear physics  核子物理学

words.meaning: n.牛仔裤(又称blue jeans, dungarees等)
words.example: jeans and a T-shirt  牛仔裤和T恤

words.meaning: v./n.打猎,猎取;(for)搜索;寻找
words.example:
Some animals hunt at night.  有些动物在夜间猎食。
When lion cubs are young, the mother stays with them while the father hunts for food.  在幼狮的小时候，母狮会守在它身旁，而雄狮去觅食。
Jack and Charlie like to hunt/go hunting (= chase and kill animals for sport) at weekends.  杰克和查理喜欢在周末去打猎。

words.meaning: n.药丸
words.example:
My mother takes three or four pills a day.  我妈妈每天吃三至四颗药。
Jamie's always had trouble swallowing pills.  杰米吞药时总是很费劲。
Are you on the pill?  你在服避孕药吗？noun countable

words.meaning: n.雕刻(术),雕塑(术);雕刻作品
words.example:
Tom teaches sculpture at the local art school.  汤姆在当地艺术学校教雕塑。
The museum has several life-sized sculptures of people and animals.  博物馆里陈列着几个实物大小的人和动物雕塑。

words.meaning: n.面粉
words.example: Grease and flour the tins thoroughly.  细细地给烤盘涂一层油脂并撒满面粉。

words.meaning: a.(有)苦(味)的;痛苦的,厉害的
words.example:
She'd suffered terribly over the years but it hadn't made her bitter.  多年来她受尽了苦，但她并不怨恨。
Failing the final exams was a bitter disappointment for me.  期末考试不及格令我非常痛苦。
She learnt through bitter experience that he was not to be trusted.  她从痛苦的经历中意识到他不可信。

words.meaning: a.赤裸的,空的;稀少的,仅有的 v.露出,暴露
words.example:
Don't walk around outside in your bare feet.  别赤脚在外面到处走。
There's no carpet in the room, just bare floorboards.  房间里地板裸露，没有铺上地毯。
There isn't much time, so I'll just give you the bare facts/details.  时间不多了，我只能给你提供一些最基本的事实／细节。

words.meaning: v.租,租赁 n.租金
words.example:
Rents here are ridiculously high/low.  这里的房租高／低得出奇。
There was a large rent in his parachute.  他的降落伞上裂了个大口子。verb
My Dad has a cottage which he rents (out) to tourists.  我爸爸有一处乡间小屋，他把它出租给游客们。

words.meaning: n. （基督教的）主教；（国际象棋的）象
words.example: the Bishop of Durham  达拉谟主教

words.meaning: n.泵 v.用(泵)抽(水);打气,泵送
words.example:
Our latest machine can pump a hundred gallons a minute.  我们最新的机器每分钟能抽100加仑的液体。
The new wine is pumped into storage tanks.  新酿的酒被抽送到储藏罐里。
The heart pumps blood through the arteries/ round the body.  心脏透过动脉输送血液／将血液输送到全身。verb

words.meaning: n.糖果,vt.用糖煮
words.example: a candy bar  条形糖

words.meaning: adj. 高兴的；喜欢的；乐意做某事；v. 满意；愿意（please的过去分词形式）
words.example:
Are you pleased about John's promotion?  约翰升职了，你开心吗？
We're so pleased that you're able to come to the wedding.  你能来参加婚礼，我们太开心了。
I'm really pleased with your work this term.  我对你本学期的表现非常满意。

words.meaning: n.奖章,勋章,纪念章
words.example:
He was awarded a medal for bravery.  他因表现英勇而获授勋章。
She won three Olympic gold medals.  她获得了三块奥运金牌。verb intransitive (-ll- or -l-)
She's medalled in both the heptathlon and the long jump.  她在七项全能和跳远两个项目中都获得了奖牌。

words.meaning: vt.请求,乞求 vi.恳请,行乞
words.example:
They begged for mercy.  他们乞求饶恕。
There are more and more homeless people begging on the streets these days.  近来越来越多无家可归的人在街上行乞。
She had to beg for money and food for her children.  她不得不为孩子们乞讨金钱和食物。

words.meaning: n.发起人,主力者,保证人 v.发起,主办
words.example:
The team is sponsored by JVC, so the players wear the letters JVC on their shirts.  该队是由JVC公司赞助的，所以队员们的衬衫上都有JVC几个字母。
Eva said she was doing a ten-mile walk for charity and asked if I'd sponsor her for £1 a mile.  伊娃说她打算步行十哩募集慈善捐款，问我愿不愿意一哩赞助她一英镑。

words.meaning: v./n.输出,出口 n.出口商品
words.example:
French cheeses are exported to many different countries.  法国的起司出口到很多国家。
Our clothes sell so well in this country that we have no need to export.  我们生产的服装在本国销路很好，所以没有必要出口。    Compare import
American culture has been exported all over the world.  美国文化已经传到世界各地。

words.meaning: n.午夜，子夜，夜半
words.example:
There's a great film on TV at midnight.  午夜时分电视上会播一部好电影。
It was after midnight when we got home.  我们到家时已过午夜。

words.meaning: a.明显的,明白的
words.example:
The full extent of the damage only became evident the following morning.  直到第二日早上，人们才全面了解到破坏程度有多严重。
From the smell it was evident that the drains had been blocked for several days.  散发出的气味证明下水道显然已经被堵塞好几天了。
Harry's courage during his illness was evident to everyone.  生病期间哈利表现出的勇气大家有目共睹。

words.meaning: v.致敬,敬意,迎接;扑(鼻),入(耳),触(目)
words.example:
He greeted me at the door.  他在门口迎接我。
The unions have greeted the decision with delight/anger.  工会听到这个决定非常高兴／愤怒。
As we walked into the house, we were greeted by a wonderful smell of baking.  我们一进屋，一股烘烤食物的香味扑鼻而来。

words.meaning: n.三月(略作 Mar.)
words.example:
My birthday is on the eleventh of March/March the eleventh/ mainly USMarch eleventh.  我的生日是3月11日。
He retired last March/is retiring next March.  他在刚过去的／将在下一个三月退休。
The meeting will be one day in/during March.  会议将在三月份的某一天召开。

words.meaning: n.蛇
words.example:
He's terrified of being bitten by a snake.  他很害怕被蛇咬。
The river snakes through some of the most spectacular countryside in France.  这条河蜿蜒穿过法国一些最美丽的乡村地区。
The queue for tickets snaked all the way around the block.  买票的队伍弯弯曲曲地一路排到了与这条街交叉的另一条街上。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: v.原谅,宽恕,免除 n.借口,辩解
words.example:
Please excuse me for arriving late - the bus was delayed.  我来迟了，请原谅——因为公车延误了。
Nothing can excuse that sort of behaviour.  无论如何那种行为都是不可原谅的。
No amount of financial recompense can excuse the way in which the company carried out its policy.  这间公司竟如此执行制度，这种行为无论赔多少钱都不能宽恕。

words.meaning: n.虚弱，软弱；弱点
words.example:
Any change of policy will be interpreted as a sign of weakness.  政策上的任何改变都会被当作是软弱的表现。
There are definite weaknesses in their security arrangements.  他们在安全部署上肯定有漏洞。
His main weakness as a manager is his inability to delegate.  作为经理，他的主要弱点在于不会授权下属办事。

words.meaning: n.猪,猪肉;猪一般的人(指肮脏,贪吃的人)
words.example:
The meat produced from a pig is called pork, bacon or ham.  从猪身上取得的食用肉品有鲜猪肉、熏咸肉和火腿。
He was an absolute pig to her.  对她来说他讨厌至极。
He's a real pig of a man.  他这人真讨厌。

words.meaning: n. 短袖圆领汗衫
words.example: She was wearing jeans and a T-shirt.  她穿着牛仔裤和T恤。

words.meaning: n.失业,失业人数
words.example: Unemployment has fallen/risen again for the third consecutive month.  失业人数连续第三个月上升／下降。

words.meaning: n.(=civilisation)文明,文化
words.example:
Some people think that nuclear war would mean the end of civilization.  有人认为核战争将意味著文明的终结。
Cuzco was the centre of one of the world's most famous civilizations, that of the Incas.  库斯科是世界上最著名的文明之一，即印加文明的中心。
How does it feel to be back in civilization after all those weeks in a tent?  在帐篷里住了这么多星期，重返舒适的文明世界，感觉如何？noun (ALSO UK usually civilisation)

words.meaning: v.折叠;合拢;抱住 n.褶,褶痕;羊栏;信徒
words.example:
He had a neatly folded handkerchief in his jacket pocket.  他的上衣口袋里有一方叠得整整齐齐的手帕。
Will you help me to fold (up)the sheets?  你能帮我把床单叠起来吗？
She folded her baby in a blanket.  她把婴儿裹在一块毯子里。

words.meaning: n./a.闪光(的) v.发闪光,闪亮;闪现
words.example:
Stop flashing that light in my eyes!  别拿那个手电筒晃我的眼睛了！
The lightning flashed and distant thunder rolled.  电光闪过，远处雷声隆隆。
You'd better slow down, that car was flashing (its lights) at you.  你最好减速，那辆车正朝你闪车灯呢。

words.meaning: a.可靠的,可信赖的,确实的
words.example:
Is your watch reliable?  你的表准吗？
Gideon is very reliable - if he says he'll do something, he'll do it.  吉迪恩为人很可靠——他说到做到。    Opposite unreliable

words.meaning: n.牛肉
words.example:
The spaghetti sauce is made with UK minced / US ground beef.  这种意粉的调味汁是用牛肉碎做成的。
People in England often have roast beef and Yorkshire pudding for lunch on Sundays.  英国人在星期天的午餐，通常是吃烤牛肉和约克郡布丁。
He is a beef cattle farmer.  他专门饲养菜牛。noun

words.meaning: n.建筑,建筑学;建筑式样或风格,建筑物
words.example: to study architecture  学习建筑学

words.meaning: v.使混乱,混淆
words.example:
You're confusing him! Tell him slowly and one thing at a time.  你把他搞糊涂了！慢慢跟他讲，一次说一件事。
Stop confusing the issue (= making the problem unnecessarily difficult) !  别再把事情越搞越乱！
You're confusing me with my sister, - she's the one studying drama.  你把我当成我姐姐了——她才是学戏剧的那个。

words.meaning: n.飞机
words.example: The airplane flew above the clouds.  飞机飞在云层之上。

words.meaning: n.鸭,鸭肉 v.迅速俯身;快速低头;躲避
words.example:
[as form of address] Come and sit beside me, duck.  过来坐我边上，乖乖。noun
He took to fatherhood like a duck to water.  他天生就是个好父亲。verb
Duck your head or you'll bang it on the doorframe.  请低头以免撞到门框。

words.meaning: n./v.演讲,讲课
words.example:
We went to a lecture on Italian art.  我们去参加了一个关于义大利艺术的讲座。
Who's giving the lecture this afternoon?  今天下午的讲座由谁来讲？    Compare seminar
My dad gave me a lecture on the evils of alcohol last night.  昨天晚上爸爸教训了我一顿，给我讲了酒的危害。UK verb

words.meaning: n.海湾,(港)湾
words.example:
We sailed into a beautiful, secluded bay.  我们驶进了一个美丽、僻静的海湾 。
Visitors must park their cars in the marked bays.  来访者必须把车停在划定的区域内。
Exercise can help keep fat at bay.  锻炼身体有助于防止变胖。noun countable

words.meaning: n.三明治,夹肉面包 v.夹入,挤进
words.example: On the train I was sandwiched between two very large men.  在火车上，我被两个壮汉夹在中间。verb

words.meaning: n.大衣箱,皮箱;(汽车后部)行李箱;树干,躯干
words.example:
He's got a thick trunk.  他的躯干很结实。noun
Her husband's dismembered body was later discovered in the trunk of her car.  她丈夫被肢解的尸体后来在她汽车的行李箱中找到了。

words.meaning: n.燕子;吞咽vt.吞,咽;轻信;忍受;vi.咽口水
words.example:
My throat is so sore that it really hurts when I swallow.  我的喉咙很痛，吞咽起来很难受。
He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.  他把一颗葡萄放进嘴里，整个吞了下去。
An increasing amount of the countryside is being swallowed (up) by the town.  越来越多的乡村被城镇吞并。

words.meaning: n.陷阱,圈套 vt.诱捕;使中圈套 vi.设圈套
words.example:
The fox got its foot caught in a trap.  狐狸的一只脚被夹子夹住了。
The undercover agents went to the rendezvous knowing that it might be a trap.  尽管知道这可能是个圈套，这些秘密特工还是去了会面地点。
She's too clever to fall into the trap of doing any unpaid work.  她这人很聪明，决不会上当去做任何没有报酬的工作。noun

words.meaning: n.(一块)布,织物,衣料
words.example: a piece/length of cloth  一块布料

words.meaning: vt.借给,贷(款)
words.example:
She doesn't like lending her books.  她不喜欢把书借给别人。
The bank refuses to lend to students.  银行拒绝向学生们发放贷款。
formal These events lend support to the view that the law is inadequate.  这些事件进一步证明了法律还不健全的观点。 (lent, lent)

words.meaning: a.明白的;朴素的;坦率;平凡 n.平原,旷野
words.example:
She wore a plain black dress.  她穿着一件朴素的黑色连身裙。
We've chosen a plain carpet (= one without a pattern) and patterned curtains.  我们挑了一张没有图案的地毯和带图案的窗帘。
He prefers plain food - nothing too fancy.  他喜欢清淡简单的食物——不喜欢太花巧讲究的。

words.meaning: n.同伴,共事者;伴侣
words.example:
The dog has been her constant companion these past ten years.  在过去的这十年里，这只狗一直与她形影不离。
I've still got one of the candlesticks but I've lost its companion.  我还拥有一个烛台，却把另一个配对的弄丢了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.指甲,爪;钉 v.将…钉牢,钉住
words.example:
Hammer a nail into the wall and we'll hang the mirror from it.  在墙上钉个钉子，我们要把镜子挂在上面。noun countable
Stop biting your nails!  别再咬指甲了！
Each successive revelation of incompetence is another nail in the chairman's coffin.  接二连三地显露出不称职，是导致董事长下台的一道道催命符。

words.meaning: a.(with)严格的,严厉的;严谨的,精确的
words.example:
My parents were very strict with me when I was young.  小时候父母对我要求非常严格。
Stricter controls on air pollution would help to reduce acid rain.  加强控制空气污染将会有助于减少酸雨。
We follow very strict guidelines on the use and storage of personal details on computers.  对于电脑上个人资料的使用和储存，我们遵循极为严格的规定。

words.meaning: n.鼠
words.example:
Rats carry disease.  老鼠传播疾病。
He ratted on us.  他出卖了我们。
They ratted on the deal.  他们不守信用，谈好的交易出尔反尔。

words.meaning: n.洞,穴
words.example:
Because of the explosion, the roof of the building caved in, trapping several people.  由于发生爆炸，建筑物的顶部坍塌，几个人被困在里面。
At first, they refused to sign the agreement, but they caved in when they heard another firm was being approached.  起先，他们不肯在协议上签字，但听说我们正跟另一家公司接洽就答应了。

words.meaning: n./a.西南(的),西南部(的)
words.example:
There will be rain in the Southwest.  西南部将会有雨。 (written abbreviation SW)
They moved southwest in an attempt to find better land.  他们搬到了西南部，希望能找到更好的土地。

words.meaning: n.药草,(调味用的)香草,草本植物
words.example: Basil, oregano, thyme and rosemary are all herbs.  罗勒、牛至、百里香和迷迭香都是香草。

words.meaning: n.洪水,水灾 v.淹没,发大水,泛滥
words.example: The flood ruined the harvest.  洪水毁了收成。

words.meaning: n.钢笔,圆珠笔,作家,围栏 vt.写,关入栏中
words.example:
Don't write in (= using a) pen, or you won't be able to rub out any mistakes you make.  不要用钢笔写，否则写错就擦不掉了。noun countable
He served nine years in the state pen.  他在州立监狱服刑九年。noun countable
It's time you put pen to paper and replied to that letter from your mother.  该动笔给你妈妈回信了。verb transitive (-nn-)    formal

words.meaning: n.所有(权),所有制
words.example:
Do you have any proof of ownership of/for this car?  你有证据能证明你是这辆车的车主吗？
Rates of home ownership have remained relatively constant.  拥有住房者的比率一直保持在相对稳定的水准。

words.meaning: v.请教,向...咨询,找...商量;查阅,查看
words.example:
If the symptoms get worse, consult your doctor.  如果症状恶化就要去就医。
I'm not quite sure how to get there - I'd better consult a map.  我不是很清楚怎么去那里——我最好查查地图。
Why didn't you consult me about this?  你怎么没跟我商量这件事？

words.meaning: n.持有,拥有;所有权;所有物;(pl.)财产,财富
words.example:
The possession of large amounts of money does not ensure happiness.  拥有大量金钱并不能保证一定会幸福。
formal I have in my possession a letter which may be of interest to you.  我有一封信，也许你会感兴趣。
formal He was found in possession of explosives.  他被发现私藏爆炸物。

words.meaning: v.原谅,饶恕
words.example:
I've never found it easy to forgive and forget (= to behave as if something wrong had never happened).  我觉得不念旧恶殊为不易。
Forgive me for asking, but how much did you pay for your bag?  请原谅我问一下，你的袋子花了多少钱？

words.meaning: n.建筑物的底部,地下室,地窖
words.example: Our kitchenware department is in the basement.  我们的厨具部门设在地下室。

words.meaning: n.最大值,极限 a.最大的,最高的
words.example:
The bomb was designed to cause the maximum amount of damage.  设计这种炸弹是为了造成最大程度的破坏。noun countable usually singular (plural maxima or maximums)
The temperature will reach a maximum of 27°C today.  今天最高气温将达摄氏27度。    Compare minimum

words.meaning: n.细菌
