words.example: Wash your hands to kill bacteria.  洗手以杀灭细菌。

words.meaning: n.调查表,问卷
words.example: Visitors to the country have been asked to fill in a detailed questionnaire.  访问该国的游客被要求填写一份详细的调查表。

words.meaning: n.泥,泥浆 v.弄脏,使沾污泥
words.example:
The vehicles got bogged down in the heavy mud.  车辆深陷淤泥，动弹不得。
Modern houses have replaced the one-room mud huts with grass roofs that had been home to generations of peasants.  新式住房取代了农民世代居住的单间草顶土屋。
These mud flats (= level ground near the sea) are a site of special scientific interest.  这片淤泥滩有特殊的科研价值。noun uncountable

words.meaning: vi.匆忙 vt.催促;急运(派) n.急(匆)忙
words.example:
Hurry or you'll be late.  快点，否则你会迟到的。
Don't hurry your food (= Don't eat it too quickly).  吃东西不要太急。
After spending her lunch hour shopping, she hurried back (= returned quickly) to work.  利用午饭时间买完东西后，她匆忙赶回去工作。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.特权,优惠,特许 v.给予优惠,给予特权
words.example:
Healthcare should be a right, not a privilege.  医疗保健应该是权利，而非特权。
Senior management enjoy certain privileges, such as company cars and private healthcare.  高级管理阶层享受公司配车和私人医疗保健等特权。
It was a real privilege to meet her.  见到她真是莫大的荣幸。

words.meaning: n.庙宇,神殿,寺;太阳穴
words.example: The temple sits on a hilltop.  寺庙坐落在山顶。

words.meaning: v.&n.吸,舐;吸收(取)
words.example:
She was sitting on the grass sucking lemonade through a straw.  她坐在草地上，用吸管吸着柠檬汁。
They used to give you sweets to suck on (UK alsoat)in aeroplanes to stop your ears from going pop.  以前搭飞机时，他们会提供糖果供吮食，以防止耳鸣。
The waves came crashing over my head and I could feel myself being sucked under by the currents.  海浪袭来，打在我的头顶上，我能感觉到自己被水流吞噬。

words.meaning: v./n.广播(节目)
words.example:
Radio Caroline used to broadcast from a boat in the North Sea.  加罗林电台过去在北海的一艘船上广播。
The tennis championship is broadcast live to several different countries.  网球锦标赛向几个国家现场直播。
figurative I'm leaving but please don't broadcast (= tell everyone) the fact.  我要走了，但请不要到处说。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.随机的,随意的 n.随机,随意
words.example:
We asked a random sample/selection of people what they thought.  我们随机挑选一些人，问了他们的想法。
The winning entry will be the first correct answer drawn at random.  从所有给出正确答案的参赛者中，随意抽出的第一个将获得大奖。

words.meaning: n.腕,腕关节
words.example: He broke his wrist in the game.  他在比赛中摔断了手腕。

words.meaning: n.窗帘,门帘;幕(布);结束; vt遮掩
words.example:
Heavy curtains blocked out the sunlight.  厚厚的窗帘挡住了阳光。
They could see nothing through the curtain of rain/smoke.  透过密密的雨帘／浓浓的烟雾，他们甚么也看不到。
It'll be curtains for him, if he doesn't do what I tell him!  要是他不按我说的办，他就完了！UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.池塘
words.example: a duck pond  养鸭塘

words.meaning: n.牛;牲口,家畜
words.example: beef/dairy cattle  肉／乳牛

words.meaning: n.最小值,最低限度 a.最小的,最低的
words.example:
Wage increases are being kept to a minimum because of the recession.  由于经济衰退，工资增长的幅度被保持在最低水准。
She hoped that her fiftieth birthday would pass with the minimum of fuss.  她希望她的50岁生日能尽量安安静静地度过。
We need a minimum of ten people to play this game.  玩这个游戏我们至少需要十个人。    Opposite maximum (written abbreviation min.)

words.meaning: n.裙子;边缘,郊区
words.example:
Take the road which skirts (round) the village, not the one which goes through it.  沿村边的那条路走，不要走穿过村庄的那条路。
Though the government has promised to deal with drug abuse, it has been accused of skirting round the issue.  虽然政府承诺要解决毒品滥用问题，但还是被指责在闪躲回避。

words.meaning: n.(databank)数据库
words.example: We're linked to the on-line database at our head office.  我们连接到总部的线上资料库。

words.meaning: a.不舒服的；不自在的
words.example:
I've eaten so much, I'm really quite uncomfortable.  我吃了这么多，实在感觉很不舒服。
These shoes are really uncomfortable.  这双鞋子穿在脚上实在难受。

words.meaning: n.调子,曲调;和谐,协调 vt.调音,调节,调整
words.example:
He was humming a tune as he dried the dishes.  他边哼着调子，边擦干碗碟。
That's a very catchy (= easy to remember and pleasant) tune.  那是一首很容易上口的曲子。
I'm afraid the piano is out of tune.  恐怕这架钢琴走调了。UK noun

words.meaning: n./v.伤害,损害,危害
words.example:
Both deny conspiring to cause actual bodily harm.  两人都否认蓄意造成人身伤害。
Missing a meal once in a while never did anyone any harm.  偶尔少吃一顿饭对身体无害。
You could always ask Jim if they need any more staff in his office - (there's) no harm in asking (= no one will be annoyed and you might benefit).  你可以随时问问吉姆他们办公室里还需不需要人——问问看没坏处。

words.meaning: n.放/发射；辐射能
words.example: Many servicemen suffered radiation sickness after the early atomic tests.  很多军人在早期的原子弹试爆后患上了辐射病。

words.meaning: a.和平的,平静的,安宁的,爱好和平的
words.example: She hoped the different ethnic groups in the area could live together in peaceful co-existence.  她希望该地区不同的种族群体能和平共处。adjective

words.meaning: n.吉他 vi.弹吉他
words.example: He sat on the grass, strumming his guitar.  他坐在草地上弹着吉他。

words.meaning: v.举止,举动,表现;运转,开动
words.example:
She always behaves well/badly when her aunts come to visit.  每当她姨妈来作客时，她总是表现很好／很差。
Whenever there was a full moon he would start behaving strangely.  每当月圆之时他就怪怪的。

words.meaning: a.(to,for)感激的;感谢的
words.example:
I'm so grateful (to you) for all that you've done.  你为我做了这一切，我（对你）真是感激不尽。
If you could get that report finished by Thursday I'd be very grateful.  如果你能在星期四之前完成那份报告，我将感激不尽。
After the earthquake we felt grateful to be alive.  地震后，我们大难不死，真是应该感谢上苍。

words.meaning: n.毛巾 vt.用毛巾擦或擦干
words.example:
She came downstairs after her shower, wrapped in a towel.  她淋浴后裹着毛巾走下楼来。
The school provides paper towels for the children to dry their hands on.  学校给孩子提供纸巾擦亁手。noun countable
Three of the original five candidates for the Democratic presidential nomination have now thrown in the towel.  原来竞争民主党总统候选人提名资格的五人中，有三位已经放弃了。verb transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)

words.meaning: n.奖赏,奖金,奖品 v.珍视,珍惜
words.example:
The critics' prize for best film was won by Marc Abbott for 'Belly Laugh'.  马克•阿博特的《捧腹大笑》被评论家们评为最佳影片。
The first (= main) prize is a weekend for two in Bruges.  头奖是布鲁日双人周末游。
The prize money for literary competitions can be as high as £40 000.  文学创作竞赛的奖金可能高达四万英镑。

words.meaning: n.球拍,球棒,短棒;蝙蝠
words.example:
You can't expect to be accepted in a new town right/straight off the bat.  你不能期望刚到一个新的城镇，就立刻被人们接受。verb (-tt-)
She smiled and batted her eyelashes at him.  她微笑着，向他眨了眨眼睛。verb (-tt-)
He batted the ball high into the air.  他发了一个高球。

words.meaning: n.惊恐;警报(器) vt.惊动,惊吓;向…报警
words.example:
If there's any trouble, raise/sound the alarm by pulling the emergency cord.  如果出现任何问题，拉紧急警报索报警。
The first two bomb alerts were false alarms, but the third was for real.  前两次炸弹警报是一场虚惊，但是第三次是真的。
Villagers have reacted with alarm to news of a proposed new road.  听说有修新路的计划，村民都十分恐慌。UK noun

words.meaning: n.节日;音乐节;戏剧节 a.节日的;快乐的
words.example: The Brighton Festival is held every year around May time.  布莱顿艺术节每年五月份左右举行。

words.meaning: n.汗 v.(使)出汗
words.example:
It was so hot when we arrived in Tripoli that we started to sweat as soon as we got off the plane.  我们到达的黎波里时天气太热，我们一下飞机就开始出汗。
The prisoners were sweating with fear.  囚犯们吓得直冒汗。
informal I was so afraid, I was sweating like a pig (= sweating a lot).  我害怕极了，浑身冒汗。

words.meaning: a.外部的,外面的,外层的
words.example: outer London  外伦敦

words.meaning: a.醉酒的;(喻)陶醉的 n.酗酒者,醉汉
words.example:
I'd had a couple of glasses of wine but I certainly wasn't drunk.  我是喝了几杯酒，但肯定没喝醉。
Andy staggered in last night drunk as a lord.  昨晚安迪回来时摇摇晃晃，喝得酩酊大醉。noun

words.meaning: n.分离，分开/居
words.example:
During the war many couples had to endure long periods of separation (= not being together).  战争期间，很多夫妇不得不忍受长期分离之苦。
After many years the government finally abandoned its apartheid system of racial separation.  多年之后，政府最终废除了种族隔离制度。
Couples may agree to divorce each other after a separation.  分居之后，夫妻双方可能同意离婚。

words.meaning: v.统治,管理;决定,支配
words.example:
The country is now being governed by the Labour Party.  这个国家现在由工党执政。
They accused the government of being unfit to govern.  他们指责这届政府施政无能。UK verb
Prices of goods are governed by the cost of the raw materials, as well as by the cost of production and distribution.  商品的价格不但取决于生产和行销成本，而且取决于原材料的价格。

words.meaning: n./a.东南(的),东南部(的)
words.example:
We live in the southeast.  我们住在东南部。
The Southeast is already overpopulated.  东南地区已经是人口过密了。 (written abbreviation SE)
The mountains are/lie southeast of the city.  群山位于城市的东南方。 (written abbreviation SE)

words.meaning: conj.无论在哪里 ad.无论在哪里,究竟在哪里
words.example:
We can go wherever you like.  你想去哪里，我们就去哪里。
Wherever I go I always seem to bump into him.  无论去哪里，我似乎总是能碰见他。
All across Europe, wherever you look, marriage is in decline and divorce rates are soaring.  整个欧洲，无论在甚么地方，结婚率都在下降，而离婚率却在猛升。

words.meaning: v.赞扬,歌颂;表扬 n.称赞,赞美;赞美的话
words.example:
He should be praised for his honesty.  他应该因为诚实而获得表扬。
My parents always praised me when I did well at school.  我在学校里表现好时父母总是夸奖我。
He was highly praised for his research on heart disease.  他因在心脏病方面的研究而受到高度赞扬。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.损害,损伤,伤害
words.example:
She fell and injured her shoulder.  她摔伤了肩膀。
He was badly injured in the crash.  他在车祸中受重伤。
He claimed that working too hard was injuring his health.  他声称工作过度损害了他的健康。

words.meaning: a.无止境的
words.example:
We used to have endless arguments about politics.  我们过去老是对政治问题争论不休。
He seems to think that I have an endless supply of money.  他好像觉得我的钱永远花不完似的。
The possibilities are endless.  有无数种可能。

words.meaning: n.混乱,紊乱
words.example:
Snow and ice have caused chaos on the roads.  冰雪造成道路交通秩序混乱。
Ever since our secretary walked out, the office has been in a state of total/utter chaos.  自从我们的秘书离开后，办公室就陷入了极度混乱中。
We muddled up the name labels and chaos ensued (= resulted).  我们弄乱了姓名标签，结果一片混乱。

words.meaning: n.(出版物的)开本,版式,格式 vt.设计;安排
words.example: The meeting will have the usual format - introductory session, group work and then a time for reporting back.  这次会议将采取常规模式——情况介绍，分组讨论，然后是反馈汇报。

words.meaning: n.流传,流通;通货,货币
words.example:
His ideas enjoyed wide currency during the last century.  他的思想在上个世纪广为流传。
Many informal expressions are gaining currency in serious newspapers.  许多非正式表达方法正在为严肃报刊所接受。

words.meaning: n.火鸡(肉)
words.example:
His last film was a complete turkey.  他上一部电影完全是一部失败之作。
What did you do that for, you turkey?  为甚么要那样做，你这个傻瓜？

words.meaning: n.储备(物),储备金;缄默 v.保留,储备;预定
words.example:
These seats are reserved for the elderly and women with babies.  这些座位是专留给老人和抱小孩的妇女的。
She keeps a little money in reserve (= for use if and when needed).  她留下了一些钱以备不时之需。
The librarian has put the book on reserve for me (= will keep it for me when it becomes available).  图书管理员已经替我预约了这本书。

words.meaning: n. 天文学家
words.example: The astronomer discovered a new star.  天文学家发现了一颗新星。

words.meaning: vi.道歉，谢罪，认错
words.example:
Trains may be subject to delay on the northern line - we apologize for any inconvenience caused.  北线列车可能会延误，如果给您造成任何不便，我们在此谨致歉意。
She apologized profusely for having to leave at 3.30 p.m.  她必须在下午三点半离开，对此她再三表示歉意。

words.meaning: n.妥协,折衷vi.妥协vt.危及,放弃(原则等)
words.example:
It is hoped that a compromise will be reached in today's talks.  希望今天的会谈能达成妥协。
In a compromise between management and unions, a 4% pay rise was agreed in return for an increase in productivity.  资方与工会达成和解，同意以加薪4%来作为提高生产力的回报。
The government has said that there will be no compromise with terrorists.  政府声称不会对恐怖分子让步。UK verb

words.meaning: a.令人恐惧的,可怕的;极讨厌的,糟透的
words.example:
He's got a horrible cold.  他得了重感冒。
What's that horrible smell?  是甚么气味这么难闻？
That was a horrible thing to say!  说那种话真是可恶！

words.meaning: v.运送,搬运,转运;传达,传播
words.example:
His poetry conveys a great sense of religious devotion.  他的诗歌表达了献身宗教的强烈感情。
If you see James, do convey my apologies (to him).  要是你见到詹姆斯，一定要转达我（对他）的歉意。
You don't want to convey the impression that we're not interested.  你不想给人留下我们不感兴趣的印象吧。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.捻;拧;扭曲;蜿蜒曲折而行 n.拧;歪曲;曲折
words.example:
The path twists and turns for over a mile.  这条小路弯弯曲曲，长达一英里多。
She sat there nervously twisting the ring around on her finger.  她紧张地坐在那里，不停转着手指上的戒指。
She twisted her head (round) so she could see what was happening.  她扭过头来，想看看发生了甚么事。

words.meaning: n.叉,耙;叉形物;餐叉
words.example:
a knife and fork.  一副刀叉UK noun countable
a garden fork.  园艺用叉UK noun countable
When you reach a fork in the road take the right-hand path.  到了岔路口走右边那条路。UK verb

words.meaning: n.圆盘，唱片；磁盘
words.example: Insert the disk to install.  插入磁盘进行安装。

words.meaning: n.羞耻,耻辱;可耻的人(或事物) v.使羞愧
words.example:
He said he felt no shame for what he had done.  他说他并不为自己的所作所为感到羞愧。
The children hung/bowed their heads in shame.  孩子们羞愧地低下了头。
The shame of the scandal was so great that he shot himself a few weeks later.  这件丑闻让他无地自容，所以几个星期后他开枪自杀了。

words.meaning: n. 人行道
words.example: Kids drew on the sidewalk with chalk.  孩子们用粉笔在人行道上画画。

words.meaning: n. 奥林匹克运动会
words.example: The Olympics are held every four years.  奥运会每四年举办一次。

words.meaning: n.签名,署名,签字
words.example: Sign at the bottom for your signature.  在下方签名。

words.meaning: a.令人愉快的 vt.使高兴 vi.满意;喜欢
words.example:
Harold did his best to be pleasant to the old man.  哈乐德竭力和颜悦色地对待那位老人。
It was pleasant to sit down after standing for hours.  站了好几个小时后，能坐下来真让人感到舒坦。

words.meaning: n.养老金,抚恤金
words.example:
They find it hard to live on their state pension.  他们觉得靠政府的养老金很难生活下去。
He won't be able to draw (= receive) his pension until he's 65.  他要等到65岁以后才能领取养老金。verb
Workers in the company are being pensioned off at 50.  该公司的工人到50岁时就要领养老金退休。verb

words.meaning: a.理论(上)的
words.example: theoretical physics  理论物理

words.meaning: n.前额;(任何事物的)前部
words.example: She's got a high forehead.  她额头很高。

words.meaning: vt. 重建；改造，重新组装；复原；vi. 重建
words.example:
The cathedral was completely rebuilt in 1425 after it had been destroyed by fire.  这座大教堂毁于火灾，于1425年得以全面重建。
Before the election, the party claimed it would rebuild the country's economy.  在大选前，这个政党声称它会重振经济。
Many people have difficulty in rebuilding their lives when they come out of prison.  很多人在出狱后很难重新过正常的生活。

words.meaning: n./vi.(球)弹起,弹回;弹起,跳起;n.弹力
words.example:
The ball bounced off the post and into the net.  球击中门柱弹进了球网。
She bounced the ball quickly.  她快速地拍球。
Her bag bounced (= moved up and down) against her side as she walked.  她走起路来身旁的袋子一颠一颠的。

words.meaning: a.电的,电学的
words.example: electrical equipment/goods/devices  电气设备／电器产品／电气装置

words.meaning: n.钩,吊钩,钩状物 v.钩住
words.example:
She told him she needed the money for her baby and he fell for it hook, line and sinker.  她告诉他，她需要这笔钱给她的孩子用，他便完全相信了。noun countable
This product has really got its hooks into the American market.  这种产品已经主导了美国市场。noun countable
John's agreed to go to the meeting in my place so that gets/lets me off the hook.  约翰答应帮我去开会，这样我就能脱身了。verb

words.meaning: n.侦探
words.example: a private detective  私家侦探

words.meaning: n. 旅行者；旅客；旅行推销员（等于traveller）
words.example: The traveler wrote in his journal.  旅行者在日记里写着。

words.meaning: n.滴答声;vi.发出滴答声
words.example:
If you want to open a file, click twice on the icon for it.  如果你想开启一个档案，按两下该档案图示。
When you have selected the file you want, click the 'Open' box.  选中了你想要的档案，用滑鼠点击“开启”方框。verb
The door clicked shut behind her.  门在她身后哢嗒一声关上了。

words.meaning: n.出口,通道
words.example:
He saw Emma arrive and made a quick exit.  他见到艾玛匆匆而来又匆匆离去。
She made her exit from the stage to rapturous applause.  在观众热烈的掌声中，她退场走下舞台。    Compare entrancenoun countable
Come off the motorway at the Duxford exit.  从达克斯福德出口驶出高速公路。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.吸引；吸引力；引力
words.example:
Life in London has so many attractions - nightclubs, good restaurants and so on.  伦敦的生活有很多诱人之处——夜总会、高级餐厅等都令人迷恋。
The opportunity to travel is one of the main attractions of this job.  能有机会去不同的地方是这份工作富有吸引力的一大因素。
Skiing holds no attraction for me.  滑雪对我来说没有吸引力。

words.meaning: vt.奉献;献身于
words.example:
He has dedicated his life to scientific research.  他把自己的一生都奉献给科学研究工作。
The book is dedicated to the author's husband.  该书为作者的丈夫而作。verb transitive
The church was dedicated on 1st March 1805 to the local Saint Jude.  教堂于1805年3月1日落成以纪念当地的圣裘德。

words.meaning: ad.完全,总之,全部地;总共;总而言之
words.example:
That'll be £52.50 altogether, please.  一共是52.5英镑。
The government ought to abolish the tax altogether.  政府应该彻底取消这一税收。
She wrote less and less often, and eventually she stopped altogether.  她动笔的次数越来越少，最后完全停笔了。

words.meaning: v.(雕)刻
words.example:
This totem pole is carved from/out of a single tree trunk.  这根图腾柱是由一整根树干雕刻而成的。
He carved her name on a tree.  他将她的名字刻在树上。
Some of the tunnels in the cliff are natural, some were carved out (= cut into the rock) by soldiers for defensive purposes.  峭壁中的一些隧道是天然形成的，一些是士兵在石头上开凿出来用于防御的。

words.meaning: n.针,指针,针状物
words.example:
Here, your eyes are better than mine - could you thread (= put thread through) this needle for me?  来，你的眼睛比我好——帮我把线穿进这根针，好吗？
The needle on a compass always points to magnetic north.  指南针的指针总是指向磁北极。noun countable
It sounds like the needle on your record player needs to be replaced.  听上去像是唱机的唱针该换了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.肚子,腹部;(像肚子一样)鼓起的部分,膛
words.example:
He fell asleep with a full belly and a happy heart.  他吃饱喝足后，心满意足地睡着了。
Now six months pregnant, Gina's belly had begun to swell.  吉娜已有六个月身孕，肚子开始鼓起来了。
The belly of the aircraft was painted red.  机身底部漆成红色。noun countable

words.meaning: n.惊恐,恐慌v.惊吓,受惊
words.example:
Sudden noises scare her.  突然的响声把她吓了一跳。
She's very brave - she doesn't scare easily.  她很勇敢——她不会那么容易害怕的。
He scared me out of my wits (= made me extremely frightened) when he was driving so fast.  他开得那么快，把我吓得半死。

words.meaning: n.足踝,踝关节
words.example: Her ankle was badly swollen.  她的脚踝肿得厉害。

words.meaning: v./n.营救,援救
words.example:
The lifeboat rescued the sailors from the sinking boat.  救生艇将水手们从正在下沉的船上救起。
The government has refused to rescue the company from bankruptcy.  政府已经拒绝援助这间濒于破产的公司。noun countable or uncountable
Lifeboats carry out many rescues every month.  救生艇每月都会执行很多救援任务。

words.meaning: a.温和的,轻微的,味淡的,不含有害物质的的
words.example:
She can't accept even mild criticism of her work.  即使别人对她的作品略有微词，她也不能接受。
He has suffered a mild heart attack - nothing too serious.  他只是轻微的心脏病发作，并不太严重。adjective
We've had a mild winter this year.  我们今年过了个暖冬。adjective

words.meaning: n.玩偶,玩具娃娃
words.example: I'm not going to doll myself up just to go to the shops.  我不会就为了去趟商店而特意打扮一番。    dolled up

words.meaning: n.中午,正午
words.example:
We used to ski before noon then take a long lunch.  我们过去经常在中午之前滑雪，然后悠闲地吃午餐。
By noon, we had had ten phone calls.  到中午，我们已经接了十个电话。

words.meaning: a.精确的,准确的
words.example:
The bunker's precise location is a closely guarded secret.  掩体的确切位置严格保密。
He caught me at the precise moment that I fainted.  他正好在我晕倒的那一刻抓住了我。
There was a good turnout for the meeting - twelve of us to be precise.  出席会议的人不少——确切地说有我们12个人。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.焦虑的,担心的;急于(得到的),渴望的
words.example:
My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.  如果我们说好回家却没有回去，我母亲总会有些担心。
The drought has made farmers anxious about the harvest.  这场旱灾使农民因担心收成而焦虑不安。adjective
Developing countries which are anxious for hard currency can rarely afford to protect the environment.  急于获得强势货币的发展中国家很难顾及环保问题。

words.meaning: n.自由,自由权;特权
words.example:
For most citizens, liberty means the freedom to practise their religious or political beliefs.  对大多数公民而言，自由意味着可以不受限制地信奉自己的宗教或政治信仰。
Hundreds of political prisoners are to be given their liberty (= released from prison).  数百名政治犯将获得自由。
Of the ten men who escaped this morning from Dartmoor Prison, only two are still at liberty (= free or not yet caught).  今晨从达特摩尔监狱逃跑的十人当中，目前只有两人依然在逃。

words.meaning: n海报,张贴的大幅广告
words.example:
The children put up posters on the classroom walls.  孩子们在教室的墙上张贴了海报。
We noticed a poster advertising a circus.  我们看到一张马戏演出的海报。

words.meaning: n.氧,氧气
words.example: Trees produce oxygen.  树木产生氧气。

words.meaning: a.漂亮的,英俊的;慷慨的,数量可观的
words.example:
She's dreaming she'll be whisked off her feet by a tall, dark handsome stranger.  她梦想自己被一位高大黝黑的英俊陌生男子迷得神魂颠倒。
They made a handsome profit on their house.  他们利用自己的房子赚了一大笔钱。

words.meaning: n. 商人
words.example: He was a successful businessman before becoming a writer.  在成为作家之前，他是一位成功的实业家。noun countable

words.meaning: pron.[she的物主代词]她的(所有物)
words.example: Nicky and I both have red hair but hers is lighter than mine.  尼基和我的头发都是红色，但她的颜色稍浅一些。

words.meaning: n.爵士乐
words.example:
They sell televisions and radios and all that jazz.  他们经销电视、收音机之类的商品。verb
Jazz the dress up with some bright accessories.  用些鲜艳的饰物为连身裙增色。
He jazzed up the food with a spicy sauce.  他用辣酱使食物更美味。

words.meaning: n.歌剧
words.example:
'Carmen' is my favourite opera.  《卡门》是我最喜爱的歌剧。
I've never been a huge fan of opera.  我对歌剧一向不是很着迷。
He goes to the opera (= to see an opera) whenever he can.  他一有机会就去看歌剧。

words.meaning: n.取得,学到,养成(习惯);获得的东西
words.example:
The acquisition of huge amounts of data has helped our research enormously.  我们获得的大量数据对我们的研究有莫大的帮助。
The museum has been heavily criticized over its acquisition of the four-million-dollar sculpture.  该博物馆因为购置了一件价值400万美元的雕塑而备受批评。

words.meaning: v./n.热烈拥抱,紧抱
words.example:
Have you hugged your child today?  你今天拥抱过你的孩子没有？
They hugged each other when they met at the station.  他们在车站碰面时互相拥抱。
Emily hugged her teddy bear tightly to her chest.  艾蜜莉把她的泰迪熊紧紧抱在胸前。

words.meaning: n. 野生动植物；adj. 野生动植物的
words.example: a documentary on Peruvian wildlife  关于秘鲁野生生物的纪录片

words.meaning: v.惩罚,处罚
words.example:
Those responsible for these crimes must be brought to court and punished.  那些该为罪行负责的人必须被送上法庭接受惩罚。
He punished the class by giving them extra work.  他给这班学生多派了些作业作为对他们的惩罚。
The oil company was found guilty on ten counts of pollution, and was punished with a $250 million fine.  这家石油公司被判犯了十项污染环境的罪状，被罚款2.5亿美元。

words.meaning: n.离开,起程
words.example:
There are several departures (= buses, trains, ships or aircraft leaving) for Paris every day.  每天都有几班次去巴黎。
Our departure was delayed because of bad weather.  由于天气不好，我们的出发时间延后了。
Everyone in the office was surprised by Graham's sudden departure.  格雷厄姆的突然离职让办公室里的每个人都感到非常意外。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.引导,指导
words.example: I've always looked to my father for guidance in these matters.  在这些问题上我总是依靠父亲指点迷津。

words.meaning: n.幸福，幸运；快乐
words.example:
It was only later in life that she found happiness and peace of mind.  她直到了晚年才找到幸福和内心的平静。
formal Will you join me in wishing the bride and groom every happiness?  你愿意和我一起祝福新娘新郎幸福美满吗？

words.meaning: n.塑像,雕像
words.example: They planned to put up/erect a statue to the President.  他们计划为总统设一尊雕像。

words.meaning: n.修理,修补 v.补救,纠正;修理
words.example:
The garage said the car was so old it wasn't worth repairing.  修车厂的人说这辆车太旧，不值得修了。
Is it too late to repair the damage we have done to our planet?  现在采取措施挽回我们对地球所造成的破坏已为时太晚了吗？UK verb transitive
After dinner, we repaired to the lounge for coffee.  晚餐后，我们一起去了酒吧雅间喝咖啡。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n. 健身房；体育；体育馆
words.example: Class 3 do gym on a Wednesday afternoon.  第三班在星期三的下午上体操课。

words.meaning: a.口头的
words.example: When do you have your Spanish oral (= exam in spoken Spanish) ?  你们甚么时候进行西班牙语口试？

words.meaning: n.职员,办事员;店员
words.example:
The (desk) clerk checked us in and gave us our key.  （服务台的）接待员给我们办理了入住手续，然后给了我们锁匙。
Take your purchases to the (sales) clerk, and he will wrap them for you.  把你买的东西交给售货员，他会帮你包好。UK verb intransitive
Debbie has a summer job clerking in an office.  戴比暑期在一间办公室当文书。

words.meaning: n.信封,信皮;封套
words.example: The prices were very roughly calculated - it looked as though he'd done them on the back of an envelope.  计算出来的价格不很精确——看起来似乎他只是粗略算了一下。

words.meaning: n.目的地,终点
words.example:
We arrived at our destination tired and hungry.  我们到达目的地时又累又饿。
His letter never reached its destination.  他的信没有被送到收信人处。
The Caribbean is a popular tourist / UK holiday / US vacation destination.  加勒比海是人们喜爱的旅游／渡假胜地。

words.meaning: n.拳头 vt.用拳头打;紧握
words.example:
She clenched her fists.  她紧握双拳。
Protestors were shaking their fists at the soldiers.  抗议者向士兵们挥舞着拳头。

words.meaning: a.宽宏大量的,慷慨的
words.example:
She's been very generous with her time.  她不吝投入大量时间。
There's a generous (= kinder than deserved) review of the book in today's newspaper.  今天的报纸刊登了一篇书评，对该书赞赏有加。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.沐浴,洗澡;浴室(池,盆) v.(给…)洗澡
words.example:
mainly UK Susannah has a long hot bath every evening.  苏珊娜每天晚上都要美美地泡个热水澡。
mainly US I took a bath this morning.  今天早上我洗了个澡。
I'll run you a bath while you take off those wet clothes.  你把湿衣服脱掉，我帮你给浴缸放水。

words.meaning: n.日光，阳光
words.example:
The morning/afternoon/evening sunlight shone through the curtains.  早上／下午／傍晚的阳光透过窗帘照进来。
The lake sparkled in the bright sunlight.  在明亮的阳光下，湖面波光粼粼。

words.meaning: a.紫的 n.紫色
words.example:
Despite occasional patches of purple prose , the book is mostly clear and incisive.  这本书尽管偶尔有几段词藻华丽的文句，但总体来讲文风简洁明了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Purple is my favourite colour.  我喜欢的颜色是紫色。
The evening sky was full of purples and reds.  傍晚的天空布满紫色和红色的云彩。

words.meaning: v.取消,把…作废;删去,划掉
words.example:
They've had to cancel tomorrow's football match because of the bad weather.  因为天气太糟，他们不得不取消了明天的足球比赛。
The 7.10 train to London has been cancelled.  7点10分开往伦敦的火车被取消了。
This month's pay cheque will cancel out his debt, but it won't give him any extra money.  这个月的工资支票将抵消他的债务，可那样他就一点钱都不剩了。

words.meaning: v.犹豫,踌躇;含糊,支吾
words.example:
She hesitated slightly before answering the inspector's question.  在回答调查员的问题之前，她稍稍犹豫了一下。
"Do you love me?" she asked. He hesitated and then said, "I'm not sure".  ｢你爱我吗？｣她问道。他犹豫了一下，然后说：｢我不确定。｣

words.meaning: n.蜡烛
words.example: Shall I light a candle?  我点支蜡烛好吗？

words.meaning: n. 受难；苦楚；adj. 受苦的；患病的；v. 受苦；蒙受（suffer的ing形式）
words.example: The war will cause widespread human suffering.  战争会给很多人带来苦难。

words.meaning: n.灯
words.example: an electric/oil/gas lamp  电／油／煤气灯

words.meaning: n.垃圾
words.example:
He talks a lot of garbage about education.  他废话连篇地大谈自己对教育的看法。UK noun uncountable
The meals are pretty poor but then they never use fresh ingredients - garbage in, garbage out.  这饭真难吃，因为他们从来不用新鲜材料——也难怪，垃圾进，垃圾出。

words.meaning: n.仆人
words.example: Public servants should be incorruptible.  公务员应该做到清正廉洁。

words.meaning: a.优雅的;端庄的;雅致的
words.example: an elegant woman  举止优雅的女性

words.meaning: n.接待,招待会;接收,接受,接收效果
words.example:
The President gave a reception for the visiting heads of state.  总统举行招待会款待来访的外国元首。
Her first book got a wonderful/warm/frosty reception from the critics.  评论家对她的第一本书反应很好／热烈／冷淡。
The new hospital was ready for the reception of its first patients.  新医院已经可以用了，准备收治第一批病人。

words.meaning: a.偶然的,碰巧的;临时的,非正式的
words.example:
The psychologist's attitude seemed far too casual, even brutal.  那个心理学家的态度似乎太过冷淡了，甚至有些冷酷。
Security around the conference hotel seemed almost casual.  举行会议的饭店周围的安全措施似乎不太严格。
Although close to tears, she tried to make her voice sound casual.  尽管都快掉眼泪了，可她还是尽力使自己的声音听起来满不在乎。adjective

words.meaning: n.重力,引力;严肃,庄重
words.example: the laws of gravity  万有引力定律UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n. 演出者；执行者；演奏者
words.example:
He's a brilliant performer.  他是个出色的演员。UK noun countable
The British boat was the star performer in the race.  英国赛船在比赛中表现非凡。

words.meaning: n.丝,绸
words.example: a silk dress  丝绸连衣裙

words.meaning: a.陡峭的;险峻的;急剧升降的vt.浸泡,沉浸
words.example:
It's a steep climb to the top of the mountain, but the view is worth it.  爬上山顶的路非常陡，不过风景非常好，值得一爬。
The castle is set on a steep hill/hillside.  城堡坐落在陡峭的山／山坡上。
There has been a steep increase/rise in prices.  物价飞涨。adjective

words.meaning: a.动力的,电动的;有生气的
words.example:
She's young and dynamic and will be a great addition to the team.  她年轻活泼，会给团队增添不少活力。
We need a dynamic expansion of trade with other countries.  我们需要大力发展与其他国家的贸易。adjective

words.meaning: n.厕所,盥洗室
words.example:
Don't forget to flush the toilet.  别忘了冲马桶。
Excuse me, Miss Lewis, I need/want (to go to) the toilet.  对不起，刘易斯小姐，我要去一下洗手间。
The toilet seat was cracked and there was no paper.  马桶座圈裂了，也没有卫生纸。

words.meaning: adj. 失望的，沮丧的；受挫折的
words.example:
We were deeply disappointed at/about the result.  我们对这个结果深感失望。
His parents were bitterly disappointed in/with him.  父母对他非常失望。
If you're expecting Dad to let you borrow his car, you're going to be sorely disappointed.  如果你指望爸爸能把汽车借给你，那你会失望透顶的。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.珍贵的,贵重的
words.example:
Clean water is a precious commodity in many parts of the world.  在世界上很多地方洁净的水是昂贵的商品。
You're so precious to me.  你对我来说就是珍宝。adjective
He's so precious about his work that he never gets anything done.  他对自己的工作太讲究了，反而甚么都做不成。

words.meaning: v.禁止,不准;阻止
words.example:
Motor vehicles are prohibited from driving in the town centre.  机动车辆禁止在市中心行驶。
The government introduced a law prohibiting tobacco advertisements on TV.  政府颁布了一项法律： 禁止在电视上播放烟草广告。
Parking is strictly prohibited between these gates.  这些大门之间严禁停车。

words.meaning: a.突出的,显著的,杰出的
words.example:
It's an area of outstanding natural beauty.  这地区自然风景极为优美。adjective
There are still a couple of problems outstanding.  还有几个问题未解决。

words.meaning: a.孤独的,寂寞的;荒凉的,人迹稀少的
words.example: She gets lonely now that all the kids have left home.  现在孩子们都离开了家，她感到有些孤独。

words.meaning: a.人工的,人造的,人为的;虚伪的,做作的
words.example: Their cheerfulness seemed rather strained and artificial.  他们的高兴表情看上去非常造作虚伪。

words.meaning: n.黎明,拂晓 v.破晓;开始现出
words.example:
We woke at dawn.  天一亮我们就醒了。
We left as dawn was breaking (= starting).  我们离开时天将破晓。
We left at the break of dawn.  我们是在天刚破晓时离开的。

words.meaning: a.抽象的 n.摘要,文摘,梗概vt.提取;摘录要点
words.example:
Truth and beauty are abstract concepts.  真和美都是抽象的概念。
This debate is becoming too abstract - let's have some hard facts!  这场辩论变得太空洞了——拿出一些具体的事实根据来吧！
So far we've only discussed the question in the abstract (= without referring to any real examples).  目前我们只是笼统地讨论过这个问题。adjective

words.meaning: a.傻的,糊涂的,愚蠢的
words.example:
Don't do that, you silly boy!  不要那么做，你这个傻小子！
It was silly of you to go out in the sun without a hat.  你不戴帽子就顶着太阳出门真是太傻了。
You're being a silly billy, now stop it.  你在做傻事啊，快停下来。

words.meaning: n.枕头
words.example: Do you prefer a feather pillow or a foam pillow?  你喜欢羽绒枕头还是海绵枕头？

words.meaning: n.大陆,洲
words.example: the North American continent  北美大陆

words.meaning: n.封铅,封条;印,图章;海豹 v.封,密封
words.example:
Clean the seal on/around the fridge door regularly so that it remains airtight.  定期清洁冰箱门上的密封条，可以使它保持密闭。
The lawyer stamped the certificate with her seal.  律师在证书上盖上了她的印章。noun countable
The Government has given the proposal its seal of approval.  政府已经批准了这项提案。noun countable

words.meaning: n.环行,周线,巡回;电路,线路
words.example:
They first met each other on the tennis circuit (= while at different tennis competitions).  他们在网球巡回赛上首次交锋。
He was a familiar figure on the lecture circuit.  他是巡回讲学中的座上常客。
The judge had served for many years on the Northeast Circuit.  这位法官多年来效力于东北部巡回法庭。

words.meaning: v.细看,审视;浏览;扫描 n.扫描
words.example:
She anxiously scanned the faces of the men leaving the train.  她急切地盯着一张张走下火车的人的脸。
Doug scanned the horizon for any sign of the boat.  道格注视着海平面，搜寻着那只船。
Scan the newspaper article quickly and make a note of the main points.  把报上的那篇文章快速浏览一遍，记下要点。

words.meaning: n.傻子,笨蛋vt.欺骗,愚弄vi.干蠢事
words.example:
[as form of address] You fool, you've missed your chance!  你这个傻瓜，你错过机会了！
He's a fool if he thinks she still loves him.  如果他以为她还爱着自己，那他就是个傻瓜。
He's fool enough to think she still loves him.  他可够蠢的，以为她还爱着自己。

words.meaning: n.最后期限
words.example:
There's no way I can meet that deadline.  我根本无法在那个期限内完成。
We're working to a tight deadline (= We do not have much time to finish the work).  我们的工作期限很紧。
I'm afraid you've missed the deadline - the deadline for applications was May 30th.  恐怕你已经错过了规定的期限——申请的截止日期是5月30日。

words.meaning: v.承担,担任;许诺,保证;着手,从事
words.example: Students are required to undertake simple experiments.  要求学生们做些简单的实验。UK US (undertook, undertaken)

words.meaning: a.荒谬的,可笑的
words.example:
Do I look ridiculous in this hat?  我戴这顶帽子看着很可笑吗？
Don't be so ridiculous! I can't possibly afford to go on holiday.  别那么傻了！我才不可能有那么多钱去渡假呢。
It's ridiculous to expect a two-year-old to be able to read!  指望一个两岁的孩子会读书真是太荒唐了！

words.meaning: a.自动(装置)的;无意识的;n.自动机械
words.example:
Over time, driving just becomes automatic.  时间长了，开车也就成了一个机械的过程。
My automatic response was to pull my hand away.  我不自觉的反应就是把手抽回。UK adjective
Citizenship is automatic for children born in this country.  婴儿出生在这个国家，就自然而然地成为这个国家的公民。

words.meaning: n.金钢石,钻石;菱形
words.example:
The tiara was set with diamonds and rubies.  头饰上镶嵌着钻石和红宝石。
He had worked in the diamond mines of South Africa.  他曾在南非的钻石矿上干活。
Shall I wear the diamonds or the pearls with this dress?  我到底是戴钻石还是珍珠来配这件礼服好呢？noun

words.meaning: v./n.进口,输入,(pl.)进口商品;要旨,含意
words.example:
We import a large number of cars from Japan.  我们从日本进口大量的汽车。    Compare export
The fashion for wearing baseball hats was imported directly from the States.  戴棒球帽的潮流是直接从美国传进来的。
Whether it is to be a 'working' visit or an 'official' visit is of little/no import.  是“工作访问”还是“正式访问”，这并不重要。

words.meaning: a.年长的,资格老的 n.长辈
words.example:
You should listen to the advice of your elders.  你应该听长辈的建议。
They consulted the village elders.  他们向村里的长辈们咨询了意见。
formal She is my elder by three years (= three years older than me).  她比我年长三岁。

words.meaning: n.量,数量;大量
words.example:
Police found a large/small quantity of drugs in his possession.  警方发现他携带大/少量的毒品。
We consumed vast quantities of food and drink that night.  那天晚上我们大吃大喝了一顿。
The (sheer)quantity (= large amount) of equipment needed for the trip is staggering.  这次旅行所需的装备数实在多得惊人。

words.meaning: n.纪念碑,纪念馆,遗迹,不朽的业绩
words.example:
In the square in front of the hotel stands a monument to all the people killed in the war.  在那家饭店前的广场上矗立着纪念所有战争死难者的纪念碑。
Parts of the Berlin wall are being allowed to stand as historic monuments.  当局允许把柏林围墙的一部分保留下来，作为历史遗迹。UK noun countable
The annual arts festival is a monument to her vision and hard work.  一年一度的艺术节展示了她的广阔视野和勤奋创作的成果。

words.meaning: v.祝愿;命令,吩咐;报价,投标 n.出众,投标
words.example:
She knew she couldn't afford it, so she didn't bid.  她知道买不起，所以没有出价。
The communications group has shown an interest in bidding for the company.  该通讯集团有意出价竞买这间公司。
The department is trying to ensure fairer competition among firms bidding for government contracts.  该部门正努力确保竞标政府合约的公司之间能更公平地竞争。

words.meaning: n.牺牲,牺牲品;祭品 v.(for,to)牺牲,献出
words.example:
Many women sacrifice interesting careers for their family.  许多女性为了家庭牺牲了自己感兴趣的工作。verb
Service and quality have been sacrificed on the altar of profit.  为了利润牺牲了服务和品质。noun countable or uncountable
We had to make sacrifices in order to pay for our children's education.  为了支付孩子们的教育费用，我们不得不作出牺牲。

words.meaning: n.邀请,招待;请柬
words.example:
Thanks for the invitation to your birthday party.  谢谢你邀请我参加你的生日聚会。
I'm happy to accept your invitation.  我很高兴接受你们的邀请。
The first day of the exhibition will be by invitation (only) (= only those who have been invited can come).  展览会的第一天只有持请柬者可以入场。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.准确(性);精确;准确度
words.example: We can predict changes with a surprising degree of accuracy.  我们可以出奇准确地预测变化。

words.meaning: n.财宝,财富;珍品 v.珍爱,珍惜
words.example:
Stories about pirates often include a search for buried treasure.  海盗故事中经常包括搜寻宝藏。
When they opened up the tomb they found treasure beyond their wildest dreams.  他们挖开坟墓，发现了做梦也想像不到的珍宝。
The museum houses many priceless treasures.  这家博物馆收藏了许多价值连城的珍品。UK noun

words.meaning: n.产量,输出(量)
words.example: Last year British manufacturing output fell by 14%.  去年英国制造业的产量下降了14%。

words.meaning: n.颌,颚
words.example:
He has a strong/square jaw.  他有着结实的／方下巴。
The lion opened its jaws and roared.  狮子张开大嘴咆哮了起来。
His foot was caught in the jaws of the trap.  他的脚被夹在捕兽夹的钳口里。UK noun

words.meaning: n.火箭
words.example:
They launched a rocket to the planet Venus.  他们向金星发射了一枚火箭。
The rebels were firing anti-tank rockets.  叛军在发射反坦克火箭弹。
Her Mum gave her a rocket for tearing her new jeans.  她把新买的牛仔裤被弄破了，挨了她妈一顿臭骂。UK verb intransitive often + adverb or preposition (also skyrocket) informal

words.meaning: vt.损赠(金钱等);赠予
words.example:
An anonymous businesswoman donated one million dollars to the charity.  一位女商人匿名向该慈善机构捐赠了100万美元。
Please donate generously.  请您慷慨解囊。
The appeal for people to donate blood was very successful.  这个献血号召非常有效。

words.meaning: v./n.鞠躬,点头 n.弓(形);蝴蝶结
words.example:
They bowed to the Queen.  他们向女王鞠躬。
We bowed our heads in prayer.  我们俯首祷告。
He bowed down (= very low) before (= in front of) the king and begged for mercy.  他向国王深深鞠躬乞求宽恕。    Compare curtsyverb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: pron.[we的物主代词]我们的(所有物)
words.example:
Which table is ours?  哪张桌子是我们的？
He's a cousin of ours.  他是我们的一个表兄。
Ours is the red car parked over there.  我们的车是停在那边红色那辆。

words.meaning: n.(举止,态度等的)庄严,端庄;尊贵,高贵
words.example:
He is a man of dignity and calm determination.  他是个沉稳、冷静而果断的人。
She has a quiet dignity about her.  她身上有一种恬静端庄的气质。
He longs for a society in which the dignity of all people is recognized.  他渴望看到一个人人都有尊严的社会。

words.meaning: n.地毯
words.example:
We've just had a new carpet fitted/laid in our bedroom.  我们刚在卧室里铺了块新地毯。
Our lawn is a carpet of daisies.  我们的草坪上开满了雏菊。UK noun
We need to carpet the stairs.  我们需要在楼梯铺上地毯。

words.meaning: n.剑,刀;武力
words.example:
Thousands of innocents were put to the sword.  数千名无辜者被杀。UK noun countable
Government threats to cut the budget by 50% are hanging over the Opera House like a sword of Damocles.  政府威胁说要将预算削减50%，这就好像是一把悬在歌剧院上方的达摩克利斯剑。

words.meaning: n.光荣,荣誉
words.example:
Glory be to God!  荣耀属于上帝！
He dedicated his poetry to the glory of God.  他把自己的诗作敬献给无上荣耀的上帝。
He revelled in the glory of scoring three goals in the final 8 minutes.  比赛的最后八分钟，他连进三球，这种荣耀令他陶醉不已。

words.meaning: n.鼓;圆桶
words.example:
They danced to the beat of the drums (= sound of the drums being hit).  他们随着鼓声翩翩起舞。noun countable
Labour are banging the drum for a united Europe.  工党正极力鼓吹建立一个统一的欧洲。verb intransitive or transitive (-mm-)
She drummed her fingers impatiently on the table.  她不耐烦地用手指敲打桌子。

words.meaning: n.女王,皇后,王后
words.example:
How long did Queen Victoria reign ?  维多利亚女王在位多久？
The Queen is meeting the Prime Minister today.  今天女王要接见首相。
She's the reigning queen of crime writers.  她是当今首屈一指的犯罪小说作家。

words.meaning: n.(进退两难的)窘境,困境
words.example:
The President is clearly in a dilemma about/over how to tackle the crisis.  对于如何化解危机总统明显处于两难境地。
She faces the dilemma of disobeying her father or losing the man she loves.  她面临着要么违抗父亲要么失去心上人的两难境地。

words.meaning: n.东北 a.东北方的 ad.向东北,在东北
words.example: The northeast gets heavy snow.  东北地区雪很大。

words.meaning: a.浅的,浅薄的 n.浅滩,浅处
words.example:
The stream was quite shallow so we were able to walk across it.  小溪很浅，所以我们可以涉水过去。
She told her children to stay in the shallow end (of the swimming pool).  她叫孩子们留在（游泳池的）浅水区。
Fry the onions in a shallow pan.  用浅平底锅把洋葱煎一下。

words.meaning: n.帆,航行 v.航行
words.example:
The boat sailed along/down the coast.  那艘船沿着海岸航行。
As the battleship sailed by/past, everyone on deck waved.  战舰驶过时，甲板上所有的人都挥手致意。
The ship was sailing to China.  这艘船开往中国。

words.meaning: n.商人,零售商
words.example: With exports rising and unemployment falling, the merchants of gloom are having to revise their opinions of the economy.  随着出口产品的增加和失业率的下降，悲观派将不得不改变他们对经济的看法。

words.meaning: n.体育场
words.example: Thousands of football fans packed into the stadium to watch the match.  成千上万的足球迷涌进体育场观看比赛。

words.meaning: n.冰箱，冷藏库
words.example: The food is in the refrigerator.  食物在冰箱里。

words.meaning: n.窝,巢 v.筑巢
words.example:
Cuckoos are famous for laying their eggs in the nests of other birds.  杜鹃以在其他鸟的窝巢里下蛋而闻名。
The alligators build their nests out of grass near the water's edge.  短吻鳄在水边用草给自己搭窝。
The diplomats have been sent home because their embassy has become a nest of spies and espionage.  外交官被遣送回国，因为他们的大使馆已经沦为间谍窝。noun countable

words.meaning: n.祖宗,祖先;原型,先驱
words.example:
There were portraits of his ancestors on the walls of the room.  房间墙壁上挂着他祖先的画像。    Compare descendant
This wooden instrument is the ancestor of the modern metal flute.  这种木制乐器是现在金属长笛的雏形。

words.meaning: v.谴责,指责;判刑,宣告有罪
words.example:
The terrorist action has been condemned as an act of barbarism and cowardice.  人们谴责这一恐怖行径是野蛮和懦弱的行为。
The film was condemned for its sexism.  这出电影被指责带有性别歧视。verb transitive
She was condemned to death and executed two weeks later.  她被宣判死刑，两星期后被处决。

words.meaning: n.水汽,蒸汽,水蒸气 v.蒸发;蒸;用蒸汽开动
words.example:
Steam rose from the simmering stew.  火上的炖肉咕嘟咕嘟冒着热气。
The pump is driven by steam.  这个泵是由蒸汽驱动的。noun uncountable
After the first three months, the fundraising project really started to pick up steam.  最初的三个月后，筹款活动开始变得如火如荼。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.口音,腔调;重音(符号)vt.重读
words.example:
He's got a strong French/Scottish accent.  他说话带有很重的法国／苏格兰口音。
She's French but she speaks with an impeccable English accent.  她是法国人，但说话却是地道的英国腔。
He speaks with a broad/heavy/strong/thick Yorkshire accent.  他说话带有很重的约克郡口音。

words.meaning: a.乐观主义的
words.example: She is optimistic about her chances of winning a gold medal.  她对赢得金牌很乐观。

words.meaning: vi.联合,团结;统一,合并vt.使联合
words.example:
If the opposition groups manage to unite, they may command over 55% of the vote.  如果反对派能联合起来，可能会赢得55%以上的选票。
If ever a dance company could unite the differing worlds of rock and ballet, the Joffrey Ballet is it.  如果有哪个歌舞团能把芭蕾和摇滚融合在一起的话，那这个歌舞团就是乔弗利芭蕾舞团。

words.meaning: n.笼,鸟笼;牢房,监狱
words.example: Sam's been prowling about like a caged animal all morning.  萨姆整个上午都像困兽一样走来走去。

words.meaning: v.(with)装备,配备;训练
words.example:
It's going to cost $4 million to equip the hospital.  给这所医院配齐医疗设备将耗资400万美元。
All the police officers were equipped with shields to defend themselves against the rioters.  所有员警都配备了盾牌以便在与暴乱分子的对抗中防身。 (-pp-)
The course aims to equip people with the skills necessary for a job in this technological age.  本课程旨在使人们获得在这个科技时代必备的工作技能。

words.meaning: n. 祖国；故乡
words.example: He returned to his homeland after years abroad.  海外多年后他回到了祖国。

words.meaning: n.狼
words.example:
Wolves hunt in groups known as packs.  狼群集体觅食。
We could hear wolves howling in the distance.  我们能听到远处的狼嗥声。noun (plural wolves)
He had the reputation of being a bit of a wolf.  他因好色而声名狼藉。noun (plural wolves)

words.meaning: n.漫画,幽默画;动画片
words.example: My favorite cartoon airs on Saturday.  我最喜欢的动画片周六播出。

words.meaning: v.祝福,保佑
words.example: "Here, let me help you with your shopping." "Oh, bless you, dear."  “嘿，我来帮你拿买的东西吧。”“哦，上帝保佑你，亲爱的。”

words.meaning: n.姨母,姑母,伯母,婶母,舅母,阿姨
words.example: Auntie Camille  卡米尔姑妈

words.meaning: n.农业,农艺,农耕
words.example:
Agriculture is still largely based on traditional methods in some countries.  一些国家的农业仍然主要依靠传统耕作方式。
The area depends on agriculture for most of its income.  这个地区的大部分收入来自农业。
Seventy percent of the country's population practises subsistence agriculture.  这个国家70%的人口以务农为生。    Compare horticulture

words.meaning: n.奖金,红利
words.example: The company used to give discretionary bonus payments.  公司过去常常会酌情发放一些奖金。

words.meaning: n.轨道 v.(使)沿轨道行
words.example:
The satellite is now in a stable orbit.  卫星目前在稳定的轨道上运行。
Once in space, the spacecraft will go into orbit around the Earth.  一旦进入太空，太空船将进入环绕地球的轨道。UK noun countable or uncountable
Prices have gone into orbit this year.  今年物价大幅攀升。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: v./n.抓住,抓紧;掌握,领会
words.example:
Rosie suddenly grasped my hand.  罗茜突然抓住了我的手。
We must grasp every opportunity to strengthen economic ties with other countries.  我们必须把握住一切机会加强与其他国家的经济联系。UK verb transitive
The Government has acknowledged that homelessness is a problem but it has failed to grasp the scale of the problem.  政府已经承认很多人无家可归是个问题，但还没有意识到问题的严重性。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.耐心,忍耐
words.example:
You have to have such a lot of patience when you're dealing with kids.  和孩子相处需要有这么大的耐心才行。
In the end I lost my patience and shouted at her.  最后我失去了耐性，对她大吼大叫起来。
He's a good teacher, but he doesn't have much patience with the slower pupils.  他是个好老师，但对较迟钝的学生没多大耐心。

words.meaning: a.(天气,海洋等)静的 n.平静 v.(使)平静
words.example:
After a night of fighting, the streets are now calm.  经过一夜的战斗，街上现在平静了。
He has a very calm manner.  他举止沉着镇静。
Now keep calm everyone, the police are on their way.  现在请大家保持安静，员警就要来了。

words.meaning: n.(jewllery)(总称)珠宝
words.example: She inherited her mother's jewelry.  她继承了母亲的珠宝。

words.meaning: ad.(afterwards)以后,后来
words.example: We rested afterward.  之后我们休息了。

words.meaning: v.毁灭;(使)破产 n.毁灭,崩溃;(pl.)废墟
words.example:
Huge modern hotels have ruined this once unspoilt coastline.  庞然大物般的现代旅馆已经完全毁掉了这片曾经如世外桃源般的海岸。
Her injury ruined her chances of winning the race.  她受了伤，毁掉了赢得比赛的机会。
Cheap imported goods are ruining many businesses.  廉价的进口商品使众多公司正走向破产。

words.meaning: ad.在旁边 prep.和...在一起;在...旁边
words.example:
The new pill will be used alongside existing medicines.  这种新药将配合现有药物一起服用。
Most of the staff refused to work alongside the new team.  大多数职员拒绝和这个新团队一起工作。
Britain fought alongside France, Turkey and Sardinia during the Crimean War.  在克里米亚战争中，英国和法国、土耳其以及撒丁尼亚王国并肩作战。

words.meaning: n.灌木(丛)
words.example: The baby was born with a surprising bush of black hair.  令人吃惊的是，这个婴儿生下来就长着浓密的黑发。noun

words.meaning: n.抽屉
words.example: Socks are in the drawer.  袜子在抽屉里。

words.meaning: n.(绵)羊;易受人摆布的人
words.example:
The farmer has several large flocks (= groups) of long-haired sheep.  这位农夫养着好几大群长毛绵羊。
We heard sheep bleating/baaing in the field.  我们听见绵羊在田野里咩咩叫。
The uphill stages of the race will really sort the sheep from the goats.  上坡的几个路段会真正拉开选手们的距离。

words.meaning: v.使泄气,使失去信心
words.example:
The thought of how much work she had to do discouraged her.  一想到还有那么多工作得做她就泄了气。    Opposite encourageUK verb transitive
The authorities have put tanks on the streets to discourage any protest.  当局调动坦克上街去阻止抗议活动。    Opposite encourage

words.meaning: n.出租车,出租马车;驾驶室 vi.乘出租马车
words.example: It'll save time if we go by cab.  我们搭计程车去能节省时间。

words.meaning: n.(examination)考试,测验
words.example: How many pupils are taking the geography exam this term?  这个学期有多少位小学生参加地理考试？

words.meaning: n.生物学
words.example: The book deals with the reproductive biology of the buffalo.  这本书讲述野牛的生殖习性。

words.meaning: a.柔韧的,易弯曲的,灵活的,能变形的
words.example:
My schedule is quite flexible - I could arrange to meet with you any day next week.  我的时间安排很灵活——下周任何一天我都可以安排与你见面。adjective
Rubber is a flexible substance.  橡胶是一种有弹性的物质。
Dancers and gymnasts need to be very flexible (= able to bend their bodies easily).  舞蹈演员和体操运动员的身体必须非常柔韧。

words.meaning: n.网,蜘蛛网
words.example:
We watched a spider spin a web between three tall grass stems.  我们注视着一只蜘蛛在三根高高的草茎之间织了一张网。
figurative Those involved in the fraud created an intricate web of trading companies to hide their activities.  那些参与诈骗的人建立起一个交易公司的复杂网路，试图掩盖他们的活动。

words.meaning: n.共和国,共和政体
words.example: the People's Republic of China  中华人民共和国

words.meaning: n.鲸;庞然大物
words.example:
We had a whale of a time on holiday.  假期里我们玩得非常痛快。noun countable
That's a whale of a story.  那个故事棒极了。
Another thousand dollars would make a whale of a difference.  再有1000美元的话，情况就大不相同了。

words.meaning: n.(aluminium)铝
words.example: The window frames are aluminum.  窗框是铝制的。

words.meaning: n.(政府的)部;牧师
words.example:
He practised a preaching and teaching ministry there for over 40 years.  他在那里当了40多年的传教和教学牧师。
In 1985 he decided to go into/leave the ministry.  他在1985年决定当牧师／辞去牧师职务。

words.meaning: v.教,教授;命令,指示
words.example:
The police have been instructed to patrol the building and surrounding area.  员警奉命在这幢大楼里及周围地区巡逻。
He works in a sports centre instructing people in the use of the gym equipment.  他在体育中心工作，教人们如何使用健身器材。

words.meaning: n.蜂,蜜蜂;忙碌的人
words.example:
My arm swelled up where I was stung by a bee.  我手臂上被蜜蜂螫的地方肿了起来。
Have you tried this ice-cream? It's the bee's knees, it really is.  你吃过这种雪糕吗？这是最好的，真的。noun countable
She never stops talking about dieting - she's got a real bee in her bonnet about it.  她不停地谈论节食——她已完全着魔了。

words.meaning: n.难题,谜,迷惑 v.(使)迷惑,(使)为难
words.example:
Scientists have been trying to solve this puzzle for years.  多年来科学家们一直试图解开这个谜。
The findings of the survey puzzle me - they're not at all what I would have expected.  调查的结果使我感到迷惑——它们根本不像我原本预料的那样。
Management are still puzzling about/over how the accident could have happened.  管理部门仍然对事故发生的原因感到迷惑不解。verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive

words.meaning: n.蘑菇 vt.迅速生长,迅速增加,采蘑菇
words.example:
For this recipe choose mushrooms with large caps (= top parts).  做这道菜要选菌盖大的蘑菇。
Unfortunately some poisonous mushrooms look like edible mushrooms.  遗憾的是，某些有毒蘑菇外表与可食用蘑菇相似。    Compare toadstoolverb intransitive
The number of computers in schools has mushroomed in recent years.  近年来，学校里电脑的数量迅速增长。

words.meaning: v.(使)沸腾,煮(沸)
words.example:
Liquid nitrogen boils at a very low temperature.  液态氮在很低的温度下就会达到沸点。
She scalded herself on some boiling water.  她被开水烫伤了。
If you give water to a small baby to drink, you have to boil it first.  如果你喂婴儿喝水，必须先把水烧开。

words.meaning: n.数学
words.example: She excels in mathematics.  她数学成绩优异。

words.meaning: n.罐坛,广口瓶
words.example:
We often have a jar or two at the pub after work.  我们经常在下班后到酒吧喝一两杯啤酒。UK noun countable
With every jar of the carriage, the children shrieked with excitement.  车厢每剧烈震动一下，孩子就兴奋地尖叫。UK verb (-rr-)
The sudden movement jarred his injured ribs.  突然的一个动作震痛了他受伤的肋骨。UK verb (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.地震
words.example: In 1906 an earthquake destroyed much of San Francisco.  1906年的大地震给旧金山大部分市区带来毁灭性的灾难。

words.meaning: n.猪肉
words.example: a pork chop  猪排

words.meaning: ad.安全地；可靠地
words.example:
We all arrived safely.  我们都安全到达。
Drive safely (= Do not take any risks) !  谨慎驾驶！
Are the children safely fastened into their car seats?  车里的孩子们都系好安全带了吗？

words.meaning: n.正餐后的水果或甜食
words.example:
For dessert there's apple pie, cheesecake or fruit.  甜品有苹果派、起司蛋糕和水果可供选择。
If you make the main course, I'll make a dessert.  如果你做主菜，那我就来做甜品。

words.meaning: n.同情,同情心;赞同,同感;慰问
words.example:
The president has sent a message of sympathy to the relatives of the dead soldiers.  总统已经向阵亡士兵的家属发出吊唁电报。
Of those people questioned, 93% said their sympathies were with the teachers.  接受调查的人当中有93%表示支持教师。
He is known to have right-wing sympathies.  大家都知道他支持右派。

words.meaning: n.(pl.)短袜
words.example:
Put on your shoes and socks.  穿上鞋袜。
The little boy was wearing odd/ US usuallymismatched socks (= socks of different colours).  小男孩穿着两只不成对的袜子。UK noun
I'm going to take you to a restaurant that'll knock your socks off.  我要带你去看一家餐厅去，你准会大吃一惊。UK noun

words.meaning: n.对(成功、权力等)的强烈欲望,野心;雄心
words.example:
She's got a lot of ambition.  她很有抱负。
He has already achieved his main ambition in life - to become wealthy.  他已经实现了他人生最大的志向——发财致富。
She doubts whether she'll ever be able to fulfil her ambition.  究竟是否能够实现自己的理想，她没有把握。

words.meaning: n.翻译;译文,译本
words.example:
The children do one French translation a week.  孩子们每周做一次法语翻译。
The English version is boring - perhaps it has lost something in translation (= is not as good as the original).  英语版读起来枯燥乏味——也许翻译得有点走味。
She reads Proust in translation.  她读的是普鲁斯特作品的译本。

words.meaning: a.无常的；不确定的
words.example:
Bridie was uncertain about meeting him.  布赖迪拿不定主意是否见他。
New arrivals face an uncertain future.  新来的人面临着无法预料的未来。
The political outlook is still uncertain.  政治前景仍难以预料。

words.meaning: v.拼写
words.example:
"How do you spell 'receive'?" "R E C E I V E".  “receive 怎么拼？”“R-E-C-E-I-V-E。”
Shakespeare did not always spell his own name the same way.  莎士比亚并非总是用同样的拼法拼写自己的名字。
Our address is 1520 Main Street, Albuquerque - shall I spell that (out) (= say in the correct order the letters that form the word) for you?  我们的地址是阿尔布开克大街1520号——要我把它拼出来吗？

words.meaning: v.插入,嵌入;登载 n.插入物
words.example: These magazines have too many annoying inserts (= extra loose pages) advertising various products.  这些杂志里令人讨厌的各类产品广告插页太多。

words.meaning: n.电话亭,货摊
words.example: a telephone booth  电话亭

words.meaning: n.头盔,钢盔
words.example: a crash helmet  防撞头盔

words.meaning: n.腰,腰部
words.example:
These trousers are a bit tight around my waist.  这条裤子我穿着腰有点紧。
The skirt had an elasticated waist.  这条裙子的腰部是松紧性的。

words.meaning: n.狮子
words.example: Reputable charities spend the lion's share of donations on aid and a tiny fraction on administration.  声誉好的慈善机构将捐款的大部分都花在援助上，只有极少部分用于管理。

words.meaning: a.王室的,皇家的;第一流的,高贵的
words.example:
The team was given a royal reception/welcome.  球队受到了隆重的欢迎。
The press follow the royals everywhere.  王室成员们到哪里，新闻记者们就跟到哪里。

words.meaning: n./a.恐慌(的),惊慌(的) vt.使惊慌,使害怕
words.example:
Panic spread through the crowd as the bullets started to fly.  子弹开始满天飞，人群惊慌起来。
Carmel was in a panic about her exam.  卡梅尔很害怕考试。
He got in(to)a panic that he would forget his lines on stage.  他慌张起来，怕自己在台上会忘记台词。verb intransitive or transitive (panicking, panicked, panicked)

words.meaning: vt.容忍,默许;对(药物、毒品等)有耐力
words.example: It seems these ants can tolerate temperatures which would kill other species.  看来这些蚂蚁能够忍受可以导致其他物种死亡的高温。

words.meaning: n. 欣赏，鉴别；增值；感谢
words.example:
Max has no appreciation of the finer things in life.  马克斯对生活中高雅点的事物都不懂欣赏。
The crowd cheered in appreciation.  观众喝彩叫好。
Children rarely show any appreciation of/for what their parents do for them.  孩子对父母为自己所做的一切鲜少表现出感激之情。

words.meaning: v.装饰,装璜,布置
words.example:
They decorated the wedding car with ribbons and flowers.  他们用丝带和鲜花装饰婚车。
We're going to decorate the kitchen next week.  我们下周要粉刷厨房。
They were decorated for their part in the rescue.  他们因在此次救援行动中的表现而受到嘉奖。

words.meaning: n.脉搏,脉冲
words.example:
The child's pulse was strong/weak.  那个孩子的脉搏很有力／虚弱。
Exercise increases your pulse rate.  运动能加快你的脉搏。
The data, normally transmitted electronically, can be changed into pulses of light.  这一资料通常是电子传送的，现在可被改为光波脉冲。noun

words.meaning: n.日记,日记簿
words.example:
Don't forget to write/enter the date of the meeting in your diary.  别忘了在日程簿上标出开会的日期。
I've never kept (= written about what has happened to me in) a diary.  我从不写日记。

words.meaning: n.匙,调羹
words.example:
He spooned the mush into the baby's open mouth.  他用杓舀了玉米粥喂到婴儿张开的嘴里。
Spoon a little sauce over the fish.  用调羹舀一点调味汁淋到鱼上。

words.meaning: n. 小巷；小路；小径；n. (Alley)人名；(英)阿利
words.example: Kate loves dancing, so salsa lessons would be right up her alley.  凯特喜欢跳舞，所以萨尔萨舞蹈课正合她的口味。

words.meaning: n.肥皂
words.example:
She bought me a box of prettily coloured soaps.  她买了一箱颜色漂亮的肥皂给我。
Have you soaped yourself all over, Alice?  你全身都涂肥皂了吗，艾丽斯？
Let me soap your back.  我来帮你的后背抹肥皂吧。

words.meaning: n.钉;大头针,别针,徽章 v.(up)钉住,别住
words.example:
I'll keep the trouser patch in place with pins while I sew it on.  在把裤子的补丁缝上去时，我会用别针把它固定好。
If you pull the pin out of a hand-grenade, it'll explode.  拉掉手榴弹上的保险栓它就会爆炸。
Is it a two-pin plug or a three-pin plug?  那是双脚插头还是三脚插头？

words.meaning: n.钱包
words.example:
Having a lot of people out of work places a large drain on the public purse.  大量人口失业使政府的财力消耗很大。UK noun
The players in the golf tournament are competing for a purse of £525 000.  参加本次高尔夫锦标赛的选手正在为52.5万英镑的奖金而展开争夺。UK noun

words.meaning: n.液体 a.液体的,液态的
words.example:
Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.  水银在室温下为液体。adjective
She has very few liquid assets as most of her wealth is tied up in stocks and shares.  她的流动资金很少，大部分财产都投到了证券和股票上。adjective

words.meaning: n.(动物)象
words.example: An elephant never forgets.  大象记忆力极好。

words.meaning: vt.养育;收养;怀抱;鼓励 a.收养的 n.养育者
words.example:
Would you consider fostering (a child) ?  你会考虑代养一个孩子吗？    Compare adoptUK verb
I'm trying to foster an interest in classical music in my children.  我正努力培养我的孩子们对古典音乐的兴趣。
They were discussing the best way to foster democracy and prosperity in the former communist countries.  他们正在讨论促进前共产主义国家民主和繁荣的最佳办法。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.(bike)自行车 vi.骑自行车
words.example:
He got on his bicycle and rode off.  他骑着脚踏车走了。
You should never ride your bicycle without lights at night.  你千万不要在晚上不开车灯骑脚踏车。noun countable

words.meaning: v.欺骗;作弊 n.骗子;欺诈,欺骗行为
words.example:
Anyone caught cheating will be immediately disqualified from the exam.  任何人如被发现作弊将被立即取消考试资格。
He cheats at cards?  他玩牌时作弊吗？
She cheated in the test by copying from the boy in front.  她在测验中作弊，抄袭前座男孩的答案。

words.meaning: n.发热,狂热
words.example:
He's got a headache and a slight fever.  他头痛，还有点发烧。UK noun
The whole country seems to be in the grip of football fever.  全国似乎都陷入了对足球的狂热中。

words.meaning: n.兔子
words.example: He's always rabbiting on about his stamp collection.  他总是没完没了地说他的集邮。

words.meaning: n.硬币,货币 v.铸造(硬币),创造(新词)
words.example:
That machine doesn't take 50p coins.  那台机器不收50便士的硬币。
Allen Ginsberg coined the term "flower power".  艾伦•金斯堡创造了 flower power（权力归花）这个说法。verb

words.meaning: adj. 易接近的；可进入的；可理解的
words.example:
The resort is easily accessible by road, rail and air.  这个旅游胜地交通便利，坐汽车、火车和飞机都可以到达。
The problem with some of these drugs is that they are so very accessible.  此类毒品的问题在于当中一些很容易获取。
Lea Anderson is a choreographer who believes in making dance accessible.  作为一个编舞者，利·安德森认为应该使舞蹈通俗易懂。

words.meaning: ad.在楼上 a.楼上的
words.example: He heard glass breaking and ran upstairs to see what had caused it.  听到玻璃破碎的声音，她跑上楼去看是怎么回事。    Opposite downstairs

words.meaning: n.保存,保护,保守;守恒,不灭
words.example: Energy conservation reduces your fuel bills and helps the environment.  节省能源能减少你的燃油费，而且还有利于环境。

words.meaning: n.炉子,火炉
words.example: The stove is still warm.  炉子还有余温。

words.meaning: a.同样的,相像的ad.一样地;同程度地
words.example:
The children all look very alike.  孩子长得都很像。adverb
The twins even dress alike.  这对双胞胎就连衣着都一样。
My father treated us all alike.  父亲待我们一视同仁。

words.meaning: n. 孙子；孙女；外孙；外孙女
words.example: Her grandchild visits every week.  她孙辈每周都来看她。

words.meaning: n.水坝,水闸
words.example: The Aswan High Dam is on the River Nile in Egypt.  阿斯旺水坝位于埃及境内的尼罗河上。    Compare dykeverb transitive (-mm-)

words.meaning: adj. 周围的，附近的；n. 环境，周围的事物
words.example: The surrounding hills are green.  周围的山丘一片翠绿。

words.meaning: a.专利的,特许的n.专利(权、品)v.批准专利
words.example: "No," he replied, with patent distaste.  “不，”他回答道，语气明显地流露出厌恶感。adjective

words.meaning: a.怕羞的,腼腆的;胆怯的vi.惊退,畏缩
words.example:
He was too shy to ask her to dance with him.  他太害羞了，不敢邀请她跳舞。
She gave a shy smile.  她害羞地笑了一下。
Children are often shy of/with people they don't know.  孩子们和不认识的人在一起时常常会害羞。

words.meaning: adj. 残废的，有缺陷的；v. 使…失去能力（disable的过去分词）
words.example:
The accident left him severely disabled.  那次事故致使他严重残疾。
The library does not have disabled access.  这个图书馆没有残疾人士通道。plural noun
It is often very difficult for the disabled to find jobs.  残疾人士找工作往往很困难。

words.meaning: n.铅笔 vt.用铅笔写
words.example:
He sat with his pencil poised , ready to take notes.  他坐着，手里拿着铅笔准备写笔记。
The pencil's blunt - you'd better sharpen it (= make its point sharp).  铅笔钝了——你最好削一下。
Write your comments in the margin of the report in (= using) pencil.  把你的意见用铅笔写在报告的页边上。

words.meaning: n.国境,边境;尖端,新领域
words.example:
Nepal has frontiers with both India and China.  尼泊尔与中国和印度都接壤。
They lived in a town close to the frontier.  他们居住在一个离边界很近的城镇。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.喷雾,飞沫,浪花,水花 v.喷,喷射
words.example:
Can you feel the spray from the sea/waterfall?  你能感觉到海上的浪花／瀑布溅起的水雾吗？
Farmers use a lot of chemical sprays on crops.  农场主们在农作物上喷了很多化学药剂。noun
All the wedding guests wore sprays of carnations.  所有参加婚礼的来宾都戴着小枝康乃馨。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep]

words.meaning: n.兽,牲畜;凶残的人,举止粗鲁的人
words.example:
The room wasn't fit for man or beast.  这个房间根本就住不了。
He was a beast to her throughout their marriage.  结婚后，他一直对她很粗暴。noun countable

words.meaning: n.笔记本
words.example: She was jotting things down in a little notebook.  她在一个小笔记本上匆匆记了些东西。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.轮廓,略图;大纲,梗概 v.概述,略述
words.example:
She drew the outline of the boat and then coloured it in.  她画了这只船的草图，然后给它着色。
The mountain was visible only in outline as the light faded.  光线暗了下来，只能看见山的轮廓。noun countable
If you read the minutes of the meeting, they'll give you a broad outline of what was discussed.  如果你看了会议记录，就会知道讨论的大概内容。

words.meaning: n.利益
words.example:
On behalf of the entire company, I would like to thank you for all your work.  我代表全公司对你的工作表示感谢。
Unfortunately, George cannot be with us today so I am pleased to accept this award on his behalf.  可惜乔治今天不能出席，因此我很荣幸能替他代领这个奖。
Please don't leave on my behalf.  请不要因为我而离开。

words.meaning: n.鲨鱼
words.example:
The movie 'Jaws' is about a man-eating shark.  电影《大白鲨》讲的是一条食人鲨。UK US  (plural shark or sharks)
People who need a place to live can often find themselves at the mercy of local property sharks.  需要住房的人常常会发现自己被当地那些奸诈的房地产商人所摆布。

words.meaning: a.垂直的，竖式的
words.example:
She looked over the cliff and found she was standing at the edge of a vertical drop.  她从悬崖上向下看，发现自己正站在陡直悬崖的边缘。    Compare horizontalUK noun countable usually singular
In a two-stage operation, the multi-spoked steel structure will be raised to the vertical.  在分成两个步骤的操作中，这个多辐条的钢架将被竖成垂直状态。

words.meaning: a.立即的;紧迫的;(食品)速溶的 n.瞬间,时刻
words.example:
This type of account offers you instant access to your money.  这种帐户允许随时支取存款。
Contrary to expectations, the film was an instant success.  与预期相反，这部电影一上映即获得成功。
In an instant her mood had changed.  顷刻间她的情绪就变了。

words.meaning: a.全世界的,世界范围的 ad.遍及全世界
words.example: An increase in average temperature by only a few degrees could cause environmental problems worldwide.  平均气温仅仅升高几度便可能导致全球性的环境问题。

words.meaning: n.构成,构造,组成(方式),成分;体格;宪法
words.example:
Britain has no written constitution.  英国没有成文宪法。
Under (= As part of) the union constitution, a new committee must be elected each year.  根据工会章程，委员会必须每年改选一次。UK noun countable
He has a very strong constitution.  他体质很强壮。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.先驱,倡导者,开拓者
words.example:
The pioneers went west across North America, cutting down forests and planting new crops.  拓荒者横越北美洲向西部进发，砍伐林木，种植新的农作物。UK verb transitive
It was universities that pioneered these new industries.  是大学开创了这些新兴产业。

words.meaning: n.课本,教科书
words.example:
That was a textbook goal from Taylor.  泰勒那个入球堪称典范。
It was a textbook example of how to deal with the problem.  这是如何处理此问题的一个范例。

words.meaning: v.起皱,收缩;退缩,畏缩
words.example:
Your sweater will shrink if you wash it at too high a temperature.  用温度过高的水洗毛衣，毛衣会缩水。
The company's profits have shrunk from £5.5 million to £1.25 million.  公司利润从550万英镑减少到了125万英镑。
The productivity improvements have shrunk our costs by 25%.  生产率的提高使我们的成本下降了25%。

words.meaning: n.点,圆点 v.在…上打点
words.example:
The full stop at the end of this sentence is a dot.  这个句子末尾的句号是一个小圆点。
Her skirt was blue with white dots.  她的蓝裙子上有一些白色小圆点。
"What's the web address?" "www dot cambridge dot org".  那个网址是甚么? “www.cambridge.org。”

words.meaning: n.小麦
words.example:
Wheat is a staple crop for millions of people across the world.  小麦是一种为全世界亿万人提供主食的农作物。
The first round of interviews really separates the wheat from the chaff.  第一轮面试确实分出了优劣。

words.meaning: a.凶猛的,残忍的;狂热的,强烈的
words.example:
Two men were shot during fierce fighting last weekend.  上周末的激战中两人被枪击。
Fierce winds/seas prevented the race from taking place.  狂风／汹涌的海浪致使比赛无法进行。
Fire fighters had to retreat from the fierce heat.  消防员面对逼人的热浪只好后撤。

words.meaning: n.王国,领域
words.example: The bombs are capable of blasting a whole city to kingdom come.  这些炸弹能将整座城市完全摧毁。noun countable

words.meaning: a.不公平的，不公正的
words.example: an unfair system  不公平的制度

words.meaning: n.折扣;贴现(率) vt.打折扣;不重视
words.example:
They usually give you a discount if you buy multiple copies.  你如果多买几本他们通常会给你打折。
They offer a 10 percent discount on rail travel for students.  他们给乘火车旅行的学生提供10%的折扣。verb[dɪˈskaʊnt/
You shouldn't discount the possibility of him coming back.  你不应该排除他回来的可能性。verb[dɪˈskaʊnt/

words.meaning: n.丛林,生死地带
words.example:
The Yanomami people live in the South American jungle.  亚诺马米人生活在南美丛林中。
Either side of the river is dense, impenetrable jungle.  河的两岸是茂密得难以穿行的丛林。noun
Our garden is a real jungle.  我们的花园真是乱七八糟。

words.meaning: n.飓风
words.example:
The state of Florida was hit by a hurricane that did serious damage.  佛罗里达州遭受了飓风袭击，损失严重。
Hurricane force (= very strong) winds are expected tonight.  预计今晚会有飓风级的强风。

words.meaning: v.分类,分等(级)
words.example:
The books in the library are classified by/according to subject.  图书馆的书是按照学科分类的。
Biologists classify animals and plants into different groups.  生物学家把动物和植物归入不同的类别。

words.meaning: n.大使;特使,(派驻国际组织的)代表
words.example:
Britain's ambassador in Moscow has refused to comment.  英国驻莫斯科大使已拒绝发表评论。
She's a former ambassador to the United States.  她是前任驻美国大使。
Late last night, the French ambassador was summoned to the Foreign Office to discuss the crisis.  昨晚深夜法国大使被外交部召见，商讨危机事宜。

words.meaning: vi.略过,跳过 n.跳跃 vt.故意忽略;略过
words.example:
She watched her little granddaughter skip down the path.  她看着自己的小孙女沿着小路蹦蹦跳跳地往前走。
The lambs were skipping about in the field.  这些小羊在田里蹦来跳去。verb (-pp-)
Sports players often train by skipping.  运动员经常透过跳绳进行训练。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.机器人,自动机械
words.example: The robot can walk and talk.  机器人会走路会说话。

words.meaning: v./n.浸,蘸
words.example:
Dip the fish in the batter, then drop it into the hot oil.  先把鱼在面糊中浸一下，然后再放进热油中。
She dipped her toe into the pool to see how cold it was.  她把脚趾伸到水塘里试试水有多凉。
As you turn the corner, the road dips suddenly.  转过那个街角，路陡然下降。

words.meaning: n.羽毛
words.example:
The bird ruffled its feathers.  这只鸟竖起了羽毛。UK noun countable
It's a real feather in our cap to be representing Britain in this contest.  代表英国参加这次比赛是真正让我们引以自豪的事。UK verb transitive specialized

words.meaning: n.衣领;环状物
words.example:
The bird has grey feathers with a lighter collar.  这种鸟长有灰色羽毛，但颈部的颜色要淡一些。
She was collared by the police at the airport.  她在机场被警方逮捕了。

words.meaning: n.杂草,野草 v.除草,锄草
words.example:
He looks like a real weed in those shorts.  他穿着那条短裤看起来真的很瘦弱。verb intransitive or transitive
I've been weeding (the vegetable garden).  我一直在（菜园子里）除草。verb intransitive or transitive
The first round of interviews only really serves to weed out the very weakest of applicants.  第一轮面试实际上只是要淘汰那些实力最弱的申请者。

words.meaning: n.猴子
words.example:
They ate all the cakes, the monkeys.  他们吃掉了所有的蛋糕，这些捣蛋鬼。
[as form of address] Hey, put that down, you little monkey!  嘿，放下它，你这个小淘气！noun countable
The children were bored and started monkeying around.  孩子都感到厌烦了，开始胡闹。

words.meaning: n.闪电 a.闪电般的,快速的
words.example:
That tree was struck by lightning.  那棵树被闪电击中了。
She changed her clothes with lightning speed (= extremely quickly).  她飞快地换了衣服。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.袖子
words.example:
The sleeves are too long for me.  对我来说，这袖子太长了。
You'd better roll your sleeves up or you'll get them dirty.  你最好卷起袖子，否则会把它们弄脏的。noun countable
Can you put the record back in its sleeve, please?  你能把唱片放回封套里吗?

words.meaning: v.扰乱,妨碍,使不安
words.example:
Please don't disturb Georgina - she's trying to do her homework.  请不要打扰乔治娜——她正在用功做功课。
I'm sorry to disturb you so late, but my car's broken down and I was wondering if I could use your phone.  很抱歉这么晚来打扰你，我的汽车坏了，想借用一下你的电话。
Several England supporters were arrested and charged with disturbing the peace after the match.  几位英格兰队的支持者被捕，他们被指控在赛后扰乱治安。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.灰,灰末;(pl.)骨灰;(pl.)废墟
words.example:
Her ashes were scattered at sea.  她的骨灰撒在大海里去了。
Allied bombing left Dresden in ashes in 1945.  1945年盟军对德累斯顿发动轰炸，将其夷成平地。noun

words.meaning: n.奴隶制度；苦役
words.example:
Slavery still exists in many parts of the world.  在世界上许多地方奴隶制依然存在。
Millions of Africans were sold into slavery.  数百万非洲人曾被贩卖为奴。

words.meaning: a.空白的,空着的;失色的 n.空白;表格
words.example:
Sign your name in the blank space at the bottom of the form.  在表格底部的空白处签名。adjective
Some of the names in the report have been blanked out.  报告中有些名字已经被抹掉了。
There may be traumatic incident in your past that you have blanked out.  过去你可能经历过创伤，而你已经从记忆中抹去了。noun countable

words.meaning: v.(of)治愈,医治;矫正 n.治愈,痊愈;良药
words.example:
At one time the doctors couldn't cure TB/cure people of TB.  曾经有一段时期，医生无法治愈肺结核／肺结核病人。
Finance Ministers meet this week to discuss how to cure inflation.  财政部长们本周将举行会晤讨论如何解决通货膨胀问题。UK verb transitive
There's still no cure for cancer.  还没有能治愈癌症的方法。

words.meaning: n.矿物,矿石 a.矿物的,矿质的
words.example: The speaker emphasized that much of South Africa's importance lay in its mineral wealth.  发言者强调说南非的重要性很大程度上源于其丰富的矿藏。

words.meaning: n./v.饥饿;渴望
words.example:
By about 9 o'clock she started to feel faint from/with hunger.  九点的时候，她开始饿到有点头晕。
All over the world, people die of hunger every day.  世界上每天都有人饿死。UK noun
I've never hungered after power.  我从不渴望权力。

words.meaning: a.多余的,备用的 v.节约,节省;抽出(时间)
words.example:
Have you got a spare pen?  你有多余的笔吗？
We've got a spare room if you want to stay overnight with us.  要是你想在我们这里过夜的话，我们有一个空房间。
Could I have a word with you when you've got a spare moment/minute ?  如果你有时间，我能否和你谈两句？

words.meaning: n.同等;平等;相等;等式;等同性
words.example: equality between the sexes  男女平等

words.meaning: adv. 故意地；谨慎地；慎重地
words.example:
I'm sure he says these things deliberately to annoy me.  我敢肯定他是故意说这些来气我的。
Calmly and deliberately, she poured petrol over the car and set it alight.  她平静而沉稳地把汽油浇在车上，然后点着了火。

words.meaning: v./n.遗憾,懊悔,抱歉
words.example:
The manager expressed deep regret at/for the number of staff reductions.  被裁减的员工人数众多，对此经理深表遗憾。
We think, much to our regret (= and we are very sorry about this) , that we will not be able to visit you next year.  我们觉得，明年可能没法到你们家去做客了，真是遗憾。
We did have an invitation, but we had to send Graham our regrets.  我们确实收到了请柬，但是我们脱不开身，不得不向格雷厄姆致歉辞谢。verb transitive (-tt-)

words.meaning: n.胡萝卜
words.example: Sometimes I just have to resort to the carrot and stick approach with my children.  有时候我只能对我的孩子采取软硬兼施的办法。

words.meaning: v.(使)振奋,(使)高兴 v./n.喝彩,欢呼
words.example:
Everyone cheered as the winners received their medals.  当优胜者接受奖牌时，大家都欢呼起来。
He was cheering for the other side.  他正为另一方喝彩。UK verb intransitive
As the runners went by, we cheered them on.  赛跑者经过时，我们为他们呐喊加油。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: v.咀嚼;思量
words.example:
This meat is difficult to chew.  这肉很难嚼。
You don't chew your food enough - that's why you get indigestion.  你没把食物嚼碎——这就是你患上消化不良的原因。
Would you like some gum to chew?  你想吃口香糖吗？

words.meaning: n.牛排;大块肉(或鱼)片
words.example: Shall we have steak for dinner?  我们晚餐吃牛排好吗？

words.meaning: v.运输,运送,搬运n.运输;运输系统,运载工具
words.example:
The company will arrange transport from the airport.  公司将安排从机场起的运输。
Do you have your own transport (= vehicle) ?  你自己有车吗？
Bicycles are a cheap and efficient form of transport.  脚踏车是一种便宜而高效的交通工具。

words.meaning: n.良心,良知
words.example:
You didn't do anything wrong - you should have a clear conscience (= not feel guilty).  你没做错甚么——你应该觉得问心无愧。
My conscience would really trouble me if I wore a fur coat.  要是我穿件皮草大衣，确实会良心不安。
He's got no conscience at all (= does not feel guilty) about leaving me to do the housework.  他对于把家务丢给我一点都不觉得内疚。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.间隔,间歇;(幕间或工间)休息
words.example:
We see each other at regular intervals - usually about once a month.  我们定期见面——通常大约是每月一次。
There's often a long interval between an author completing a book and it appearing in the shops.  从作者完成一本书到它出现在书店里常常有一段较长的间隔。
There will be two twenty-minute intervals during the opera.  歌剧演出中有两次20分钟的幕间休息。

words.meaning: v.抓,搔,扒 n.抓,搔,抓痕;起跑线
words.example:
We scratched the paintwork trying to get the bed into Martha's room.  我们把床搬进玛莎的房间里时，把漆面给划坏了。
People have been scratching their names on this rock for years.  许多年来人们都在这块岩石上刻写名字。
I'm afraid I scratched some paint off the door as I was getting out of the car.  恐怕我下车时磨掉了车门上的一些漆。

words.meaning: a.醒着的 vt.唤醒,使觉醒 vi.醒来,醒悟到
words.example:
She used to lie awake at night worrying about how to pay the bills.  她过去常常夜里躺在床上合不上眼，发愁怎样付帐单。
Businesses need to be awake to the advantages of European integration.  企业界应意识到欧洲一体化的好处。verb intransitive or transitive (awoke or US ALSO awaked, awoken)    US ALSO    literary
She awoke me at seven.  她七点时叫醒了我。

words.meaning: n.盖
words.example:
Can you get the lid off this jar?  你能把罐子的盖打开吗？
Put a lid on the saucepan.  给平底深锅盖上盖子。
She looked at him from under half-closed lids.  她眯着眼睛看着他。noun countable

words.meaning: n.协调,和谐;融洽
words.example:
It is a simple melody with complex harmonies.  这是一首和声复杂的简单旋律。UK noun
Imagine a society in which everyone lived together in (perfect) harmony.  设想一下有这样一个社会，所有人都和睦地生活在一起。
We must ensure that tourism develops in harmony with the environment.  我们必须确保旅游业与环境和谐发展。

words.meaning: n.山羊
words.example:
Stop acting the goat!  别再做蠢事了！UK noun countable
That sort of attitude really gets my goat.  那种态度实在是让我发火。

words.meaning: n.香蕉
words.example: a bunch of bananas  一串香蕉

words.meaning: n.宫,宫殿
words.example:
The Queen has agreed to open Buckingham Palace to the public.  女王同意对外开放白金汉宫。
An old movie palace is being restored.  一家豪华的老电影院正在修复中。

words.meaning: a.整洁的,干净的,优美的,精致的
words.example:
Your house is always so neat - how do you manage it with three children?  你的房子总是这么整洁——你有三个孩子，是怎么做到的？
She likes everything neat and tidy.  她喜欢一切都井井有条。
You've got such neat handwriting.  你的字写得真工整。

words.meaning: n.超级市场
words.example: The supermarket is two blocks away.  超市在两个街区外。

words.meaning: a.可动的,活动的,运动的
words.example:
You've broken your ankle but you'll be fully mobile (= able to walk as usual) within a couple of months.  你摔断了脚踝，但用不了几个月你就可以行动自如了。UK noun countable
My mobile's 07796 10253.  我的手机号码是07796 10253。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.寡妇
words.example: The widow lived with her son.  寡妇和儿子住在一起。

words.meaning: v.存放;使沉淀;付(保证金) n.存款;沉积物
words.example:
The flood waters fell, depositing mud over the whole area.  洪水退去后，留下的淤泥覆盖了整个地区。
The bus deposited me miles from anywhere.  公车把我扔在一个前不着村后不着店的地方。
The cuckoo deposits (= puts) her eggs in other birds' nests.  布谷鸟把自己的蛋下在其他鸟类的窝里。

words.meaning: n.胡须
words.example:
He's growing a beard.  他在留胡子。
He shaved off his beard but kept his moustache.  他剃了下巴上的胡须，但保留了嘴唇上面的胡子。
With a nervous swallow he bearded the formidable-looking librarian behind the desk.  他紧张地咽了咽口水，鼓起了勇气，看着桌子后面那个凶神恶煞般的图书管理员。UK verb transitive literary

words.meaning: v./n.制动(器),闸,刹车
words.example:
She had no brakes on her bicycle.  她的脚踏车没有煞车器。
The taxi driver suddenly UK applied / US put on his brakes.  计程车司机突然踩了刹车。
informal I slammed on (= quickly used) the brake, but it was too late.  我赶忙踩刹车，可已经来不及了。

words.meaning: v.禁止,不许
words.example:
The law forbids the sale of cigarettes to people under the age of 16.  法律禁止向16岁以下的未成年人出售香烟。
He is forbidden from leaving the country.  他被限制出境。UK US (forbidding, forbade or old use forbad, forbidden)    old use
Heaven forbid (that) his parents should ever find out.  但愿他的父母永远都不会发现。

words.meaning: n.毛,毛皮
words.example:
She stroked the rabbit's soft fur.  她轻抚着兔子身上软软的毛。
Native Americans traded furs with early European settlers.  美洲印第安人与早期的欧洲定居者进行毛皮交易。UK noun
The fur was really flying during that meeting.  那次会议上吵得很厉害。UK noun

words.meaning: a.自愿的,志愿的
words.example:
They chose to take voluntary redundancy.  他们选择自愿离职。
She does voluntary work for the Red Cross two days a week.  她每周志愿为红十字会服务两天。
The hospital has asked various voluntary organizations to help raise money for the new operating theatre.  医院已经请求各种志愿组织为筹建新手术室募集资金。

words.meaning: a.有效的；正当的
words.example:
My way of thinking might be different from yours, but it's equally valid.  我的想法也许和你的不同，但同样站得住脚。    Compare invalid
My passport is valid for another two years.  我的护照还有两年才到期。
Is this contract/ticket/agreement still valid?  这份合同／这张票据／这份协定还有法律效力吗？

words.meaning: n.线,细丝;线索,思路;螺纹 v.穿线,穿过
words.example:
One of the main threads of the film is the development of the relationship between the boy and his uncle.  电影的其中一条主线是男孩和他叔叔之间的关系发展。
Unfortunately my attention wandered for a moment and I lost the thread of (= forgot) what I was saying.  遗憾的是我一时失神，忘了刚才在说甚么。
The sari had gold strands threaded through the material.  这件莎丽的布料间穿上了金线。verb transitive

words.meaning: n. 旅游业；游览
words.example:
Tourism is Venice's main industry.  旅游业是威尼斯的主要产业。
These beautiful old towns have remained relatively untouched by tourism.  相对而言，这些美丽的古城还没有怎么受到旅游业的影响。

words.meaning: n.套间;一套家具;套,组,系列
words.example:
The singer was interviewed in his £1500 a night hotel suite.  这位歌手在每晚1500英镑的饭店套房里接受采访。
They've got a whole suite of offices on the 34th floor.  他们在34层有一整套的办公室。noun countable
We're having a new bathroom/bedroom suite fitted at the weekend.  周末我们要请人在浴室／卧室安装一套新家俱。

words.meaning: n.稻草,麦杆;吸管
words.example:
Why don't you drink your milkshake through a straw?  你为甚么不用吸管喝奶昔？UK noun
She offered to take a pay cut to keep her job, but she was just clutching at straws.  她提出减薪以保住工作，但这只不过是在乱抓救命稻草。UK noun
Losing my job was bad enough, but being evicted from my house was the final straw.  失去工作已经够糟，但被房东赶出门后我彻底崩溃了。

words.meaning: n.球体,地球仪;地球,世界
words.example:
His greatest ambition is to sail round the globe.  他最远大的志向就是驾船环球航行。
She is a superstar all around the globe.  她是一位国际超级巨星。
She spun the globe, and pointed to the Solomon Islands.  她转动地球仪，然后指向所罗门群岛。UK noun

words.meaning: a.易碎的,脆的,易损坏的;虚弱的,脆弱的
words.example:
Be careful with that vase - it's very fragile.  拿那个花瓶要小心——它很容易碎。
The assassination could do serious damage to the fragile peace agreement that was signed last month.  这宗行刺事件可能会对上月签署的脆弱的和平协定造成严重损害。
humorous No breakfast for me, thanks - I'm feeling rather fragile (= ill, upset or tired) after last night's party.  我不吃早餐了，谢谢——昨晚派对后到现在我还觉得很不舒服。

words.meaning: n.化学
words.example:
She studied chemistry and physics at college.  她在大学学的是化学和物理。
There was an immediate sexual chemistry between us the first time we met.  我们两性相吸，初次见面就擦出了火花。

words.meaning: a.(fantastical)奇异的,幻想的,异想天开的
words.example:
You look fantastic in that dress.  你穿着那条连身裙看起来棒极了。
We had a fantastic time.  我们玩得很痛快。
They've won a holiday? How fantastic!  他们赢得了一个假期？太棒了！adjective

words.meaning: n.暖和,温暖;热心,热情
words.example: The warmth of the blanket felt good.  毯子的温暖很舒服。

words.meaning: n.头痛
words.example:
I've got a splitting (= severe) headache.  我头痛得很厉害。noun countable
Finding a babysitter for Saturday evening will be a major headache.  要在星期六晚上找个照顾小孩的人真是件让人头痛的事。

words.meaning: n.警察
words.example: The policeman helped the old man cross.  警察扶老人过了马路。

words.meaning: a.(for)合适的,适宜的
words.example:
The film is suitable for children.  这部电影适宜儿童观看。
My mother doesn't like me wearing short skirts to church - she doesn't think they're suitable.  我妈妈不喜欢我穿着短裙去教堂——她认为这不太合适。    Opposite unsuitable

words.meaning: n. 毕业；毕业典礼；刻度，分度；分等级
words.example: a graduation ceremony  毕业典礼

words.meaning: v.练习;操练;钻孔 n.操练;练习;钻孔(机)
words.example:
In some of these schools, army-style drills are used to instil a sense of discipline.  这些学校中有一些利用军训来培养纪律观念。
What's the drill for getting money after four o'clock?  四点钟以后怎么取钱？verb
Drill three holes in the wall for the screws.  在墙上打三个拧螺丝钉用的小孔。

words.meaning: a.残忍的,残酷的
words.example:
Don't tease him about his weight - it's cruel.  别拿他的体重开玩笑——这样太刻薄了。
Children can be very cruel to each other.  小孩相互之间会很残忍。
His death was a cruel blow.  他的死是个无情的打击。 [krʊəl] (crueller, cruellest or crueler, cruelest)

words.meaning: n.葡萄
words.example: black/white/red/green grapes  紫／白／红／绿葡萄

words.meaning: n.村舍,小屋,别墅
words.example: They live in an idyllic country/thatched cottage, with roses round the door.  他们住在田园诗般的乡村小屋／茅舍，门前玫瑰环绕。

words.meaning: n.粘土,泥土
words.example: The pot is made of local clay.  罐子是本地黏土做的。

words.meaning: n.气球,飞船;a.气球状的 v.乘坐气球;膨胀
words.example:
We tied balloons and streamers to the ceiling ready for the party.  我们把气球和彩带系在天花板上，晚会的布置已准备妥当。
People first flew in a balloon in 1783.  人类于1783年首次乘热气球飞行。
The balloon went up last Friday when the scandal became public.  自上周五丑闻公开以后，局面就变得一片混乱。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.发明,创造,发明物
words.example:
The world changed rapidly after the invention of the telephone.  电话发明后世界的变化日新月异。
All that gossip about Linda was just pure invention.  有关琳达的所有流言都纯属虚构。
Be careful what you believe - her powers of invention (= ability to think of excuses, etc.) are well known.  注意你该信甚么——她编瞎话的本领是出了名的。

words.meaning: n.车费,船费;伙食;乘客 v.过活;进展;经营
words.example:
Train fares are going up again.  火车票又涨价了。
How did you fare in your exams?  你考得怎么样？
Low-paid workers will fare badly/well under this government.  在这届政府执政期间，低收入工人的境况会很糟／很好。

words.meaning: n.(学生的)家庭作业、课外人员
words.example:
You can't watch TV until you've done your homework.  做完功课之后你才能看电视。
It was obvious that she had done her homework and thoroughly prepared for her interview.  很明显她为面试做足了功课，准备很充分。

words.meaning: n.(disk)圆盘,圆面,盘状物
words.example: The dog's name was engraved on a little metal disc attached to its collar.  那条狗的名字刻在一块吊在项圈上的金属小圆盘上。

words.meaning: n.长沙发,沙发
words.example: The sofa faces the TV.  沙发对着电视。

words.meaning: n.毛衣,绒衣,厚运动衫
words.example: Put a sweater on if you're cold.  如果你觉得冷就穿件毛线衫吧。

words.meaning: n.橡皮,橡胶;橡胶制品,胶鞋
words.example:
Tyres are almost always made of rubber.  几乎所有轮胎都是用橡胶制成的。
We played a rubber of bridge.  我们进行了一次三局两胜制的桥牌比赛。UK noun

words.meaning: v.更新,使现代化
words.example:
We'll update you on this news story throughout the day.  我们将全天向您报道该新闻事件的最新进展。noun countable /ˈʌp.deɪt/
Jo's just doing an update on the mailing list.  乔正在更新邮寄名单。
I'll need regular updates on your progress.  我要定期了解你的最新进展。

words.meaning: n.大理石,云石
words.example: a marble floor/statue  大理石地板／雕像UK noun

words.meaning: a.详述的,明确的;坦率的;显然的
