words.example: She was very explicit about (= said very clearly and exactly) what she thought was wrong with the plans.  她明确地指出了计划中她认为有误的地方。

words.meaning: adj. 令人不安的；烦扰的；v. 干扰；打断（disturb的ing形式）
words.example:
The Home Secretary described the latest crime figures as 'disturbing'.  内政部长声称最近的犯罪数目“令人担忧”。
The following programme contains scenes that may be disturbing to some viewers.  以下节目可能会有一些使某些观众感到不适的场景。

words.meaning: n.箭,矢,箭状物;箭头符号
words.example: Robin Hood asked to be buried where his arrow landed.  罗宾汉让人们把他安葬在他的箭落下的位置。    Compare dart

words.meaning: n.收获,收成;成果,后果 v.收获,收割
words.example:
We had a good harvest this year.  今年我们收成不错。
Farmers are reporting a bumper (= very big) harvest this year.  农民说今年的收成非常好。
It won't be long now till harvest (time).  现在离收获时节不远了。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.间谍 v.当间谍,刺探;察觉,发现
words.example:
He was arrested for spying on missile sites.  他因搜集有关飞弹基地的情报而被捕。
We drove around the area where our new house is to spy out the land.  我们开车在新房子的周遭地区绕了一圈，了解一下环境。verb
He was spying on her through the keyhole.  他从锁孔里窥探着她。

words.meaning: a.勇敢的 v.勇敢地面对(危险等)
words.example:
It was a brave decision to quit her job and start her own business.  她辞职自己创业是个大胆的决定。
She was very brave to learn to ski at fifty.  她50岁开始学滑雪可真勇敢。
Of the three organizations criticized, only one was brave enough to face the press.  三家受到批评的机构中，只有一家敢于面对媒体。

words.meaning: n.(大学的)研究班,研讨会
words.example: I'm giving a seminar on the latest developments in genetic engineering next week.  下周我将举行一个有关遗传工程最新进展的研讨会。

words.meaning: a.阳光充足的；快活的
words.example:
We're having the party in the garden, so I'm praying it'll be sunny.  我们要在花园里举行聚会，所以我正祈祷那天会阳光明媚。adjective
She has a very sunny disposition.  她性情非常开朗。

words.meaning: n. 短裤；n. (Shorts)人名；(英)肖茨
words.example: She put on a pair of shorts and a T-shirt.  她穿上短裤和T恤

words.meaning: n./v.肿胀;膨胀;增大;增加;
words.example:
It was obvious she had broken her toe, because it immediately started to swell (up).  她的脚趾显然已经骨折，因为它开始肿胀了。
Twenty-five employees have joined the union in this month alone, swelling its ranks (= increasing its size) to 110.  仅这个月就有25位员工加入工会，使工会的人数增加到110人。
literary His heart/breast swelled with pride (= He felt very proud) as he stood watching his son graduate.  当他站在那里观看儿子的毕业典礼时，心中充满自豪。

words.meaning: n.新娘
words.example:
He returned from New York with his lovely new bride.  他和漂亮的新娘一起从纽约回来了。
The bride and groom posed for pictures outside the church.  新娘和新郎在教堂外摆姿势照相。
As the mother of the bride, I feel obliged to wear something really spectacular.  作为新娘的母亲，我得穿戴得华丽一些。

words.meaning: n.传记;传记文学
words.example: He wrote a biography of Winston Churchill.  他撰写了温斯顿‧丘吉尔的传记。    Compare autobiography ; hagiography

words.meaning: ad.很少,不常
words.example:
Now that we have a baby, we seldom get the chance to go to the cinema.  有了孩子以后，我们很少有机会看电影。
formal Seldom do we receive any apology when mistakes are made.  出错的时候，我们很少收到道歉。

words.meaning: n.外国人
words.example: The foreigner asked for directions.  外国人问了路。

words.meaning: n.便利,方便;(pl.)便利设备
words.example:
Just for convenience, I'm going to live at my mother's place until my new house is ready.  为了方便，我打算在我的新居收拾好之前先住在我母亲那里。
The goods will be delivered at your convenience.  货物随传随到。
Please return the completed form at your earliest convenience.  请将填好的表格尽快交回。noun

words.meaning: n.快乐,高兴 v.(使)高兴,(使)欣喜
words.example:
My sister's little boy is a real delight.  我姐姐的小儿子很讨人喜欢。
The children squealed in delight when they saw all the presents under the Christmas tree.  孩子们看到圣诞树下的各种礼物时兴奋地叫了起来。
He seems to take great delight in (= enjoys) teasing his sister.  他似乎觉得逗他妹妹玩很有趣。

words.meaning: prep.直到,直到…为止,与until意思相同
words.example:
We waited till half past six for you.  我们一直等你到六点半。
Up till 1918, women in Britain were not allowed to vote.  在1918年以前，英国不允许妇女参加选举。
How long is it till your baby is due?  你还有多久生孩子？noun countable mainly UK (US usually register)

words.meaning: n.雾气,雾 v.以雾笼罩,被雾笼罩
words.example:
Thick/Heavy/Dense fog has made driving conditions dangerous.  浓雾使开车颇为危险。
Mists, freezing fogs and snow are common in this area.  薄雾、寒雾和雪在这个地区很常见。
It took several hours for the fog to lift.  几个小时以后雾才散去。UK noun

words.meaning: adj. 无聊的；令人厌烦的；n. 钻孔；v. 钻孔；使厌烦；挖空（bore的ing形式）；n. (Boring)人名；(英、瑞典)博林
words.example:
She finds opera boring.  她觉得歌剧很乏味。
It's boring to sit on the plane with nothing to read.  坐在飞机上没东西可读真是无聊。
The film was so boring I fell asleep.  这部电影非常乏味，我都睡着了。

words.meaning: n.摘要,概要 a.概括的,简略的
words.example: At the end of the news, they often give you a summary of the main news stories.  在新闻结束的时候，他们常常会总结一下主要的新闻内容。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.仓库,货栈
words.example:
The goods have been sitting in a warehouse for months because a strike has prevented distribution.  因为罢工无法发货，货物已经堆在仓库里好几个月了。
We bought both sofas from a big furniture warehouse that's just off the motorway.  这两张沙发都是我们在高速公路旁的一家大型家俱店里买的。

words.meaning: v.使加速,使增速,促进 vi.加快,增加
words.example:
Inflation is likely to accelerate this year, adding further upward pressure on interest rates.  今年通货膨胀可能会加剧，迫使利率持续上升。
They use special chemicals to accelerate the growth of crops.  他们使用特殊的化学品来刺激农作物生长。

words.meaning: n.蝴蝶
words.example: She's such a social butterfly.  她可真是个交际花。UK noun countable

words.meaning: adj. 全国范围的；全国性的；adv. 在全国
words.example: a nationwide network/chain of shops  全国性网路／连锁商店

words.meaning: v.吐(唾沫),吐痰 n.唾液
words.example:
Bob Ewell spat contemptuously right in the lawyer's face.  鲍勃‧尤厄尔轻蔑地朝律师脸上吐了口唾沫。
He spat the meat out in disgust.  他厌恶地把肉吐了出来。
They bought watermelons and ate them as they walked, spitting out the seeds.  他们买了西瓜，边走边吃，一路吐着西瓜籽。

words.meaning: n.洗衣房(店);待洗衣物,所洗衣物
words.example:
I've got to do (= wash) my laundry.  我要把衣服洗了。
It wasn't much of a speech - just a laundry list of accusations against the government.  这不算是演讲，只是在将一连串对政府的控诉罗列出来。

words.meaning: n.道歉,认错,辩解,辩护
words.example:
He's demanding a full apology from the newspaper for making untrue allegations about his personal life.  他要求这家报纸对关于他私生活的不实报导正式道歉。
She complained to the company about its awful service and they sent her a written apology.  就其低劣的服务品质，她向这家公司提出投诉，公司对她作出了书面道歉。
The vice-chair has sent his apologies - he's abroad at present.  副主席寄来了道歉信——他目前在国外，不能出席。

words.meaning: n. 网站（全球资讯网的主机站）
words.example: For more information about other Cambridge publications, visit our website at www.cambridge.org.  欲知剑桥大学出版社其他图书详情，请访问我们的网站 www.cambridge.org。

words.meaning: n.廉价货;交易,契约,合同 v.议价,成交
words.example:
This coat was half-price - a real bargain.  这件大衣是以半价购买的——真便宜。
The airline regularly offers last-minute bookings at bargain prices.  航空公司定期提供最后时刻的廉价订票服务。
The sales had started and the bargain hunters (= people looking for things at a low price) were out in force.  大减价开始了，那些到处搜寻便宜货的人倾巢而出。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.怀疑的 [英]sceptical
words.example: I'm skeptical about the shortcut.  我对这条捷径持怀疑态度。

words.meaning: a.不幸的；可取的
words.example:
She has inherited her father's large nose, which is very unfortunate.  她遗传了父亲的大鼻子，真是太不幸了。
The housing director's remark that 'the homeless could do more to help themselves' was unfortunate to say the least.  住房主任说的那句“无家可归者可以做更多的事来自助”至少是不恰当的。UK noun countable formal or humorous
He was one of the poor unfortunates who invested in the company and now finds himself a few thousand pounds poorer.  他是那些投资于这家公司的可怜倒楣蛋之一，现在已经亏了几千英镑。

words.meaning: n./v.锚;危难时可依靠的人或物;用锚泊船
words.example:
We dropped anchor (= lowered the anchor into the water) and stopped.  我们抛锚停船。
It was time to weigh anchor (= pull up the anchor and sail away).  该是起锚开船的时候了。UK noun countable
She was my anchor when things were difficult for me.  我身处困境时，她就是我的精神支柱。

words.meaning: n.零,零度 num.零
words.example:
The number one million is written with a one and six zeroes (mainly UK alsonoughts).  数字100万要写一个1和六个0。
Heavy rain has reduced visibility almost to zero (= its lowest point).  大雨已使能见度降到最低。
The temperature is expected to drop to ten degrees below zero tonight.  今晚气温预计会降至零下十度。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.背叛,出卖;暴露,流露,泄露
words.example:
He was accused of betraying his country during the war.  他被指控在战争期间背叛了祖国。
She felt betrayed by her mother's lack of support.  她觉得母亲背弃了她，因为母亲没有支持她。
For years they betrayed Britain's secrets to Russia.  他们持续多年向俄国出卖英国的机密情报。

words.meaning: a.聪明的,伶俐的,机敏的,精巧的
words.example:
Judy has never been very clever, but she tries hard.  裘蒂向来不是很聪明，可是她很用功。
Fiona is very clever at physics.  菲奥纳很擅长物理。
Charlie has a clever idea / plan for getting us out of our present difficulties.  查利有个妙计可以使我们摆脱现在的困境。

words.meaning: adj. 挑战的；引起挑战性兴趣的；v. 要求；质疑；反对；向…挑战；盘问（challenge的ing形式）
words.example: This has been a challenging time for us all.  这对我们大家都是一个具有挑战性的时刻。

words.meaning: a.美味的;美妙的;使人愉快的
words.example:
The delicious smell of freshly-made coffee came from the kitchen.  新煮好的咖啡的芳香从厨房里飘了出来。
This wine is delicious.  这种酒味道很好。
I've got some delicious gossip.  我听到了一些有趣的小道消息。

words.meaning: ad.&prep.在船(飞机、车)上;ad.上船(飞机、车)
words.example:
The flight attendant welcomed us aboard.  空服员迎候我们登机。
Welcome aboard flight BA345 to Tokyo.  欢迎乘坐飞往东京的 BA345 航班。
The train's about to leave. All aboard!  火车即将离站，请所有乘客上车！

words.meaning: n.虫,蠕虫
words.example:
The kiwi eats worms, other invertebrates, and berries.  鹬鸵以蠕虫、其他无脊椎动物和浆果为食。
It's distressing enough to find a worm in your apple but finding half of one is worse.  在苹果里发现一条虫子已经够叫人厌恶，如果发现半条就更糟了。
The vet says our dog has worms.  兽医说我们的狗体内有寄生虫。

words.meaning: a.(to)有利的,有益的
words.example: The improvement in sales figures had a beneficial effect /influence on the company as a whole.  销售额的上升使整间公司受益。

words.meaning: a.笨拙的;尴尬的;使用不便的;难处理的
words.example:
It's an awkward corner to drive round, so take it slowly.  这个转弯不好过，开慢一点。
Some of the questions were rather awkward.  有些问题是很难回答的。
It was an awkward ascent, but we reached the top eventually.  那段上坡路很难走，但最后我们还是爬到了山顶。

words.meaning: a.真的,真正的;可靠的,可信的,有根据的
words.example: He was there and saw what happened, so his is the only authentic account.  他在现场，并看到了事情的经过，所以他的叙述是唯一可靠的说法。

words.meaning: n.(thieves)贼;小偷
words.example: The thief snatched her bag.  小偷抢了她的包。

words.meaning: n.秋,秋季;成熟期,渐衰期
words.example: Autumn brings cool breezes.  秋天带来凉风。

words.meaning: a.模糊的，含糊的
words.example:
The patient had complained of vague pains and backache.  患者自述说隐约感到疼痛和背酸。
Through the mist I could just make out a vague figure.  透过雾霭，我只能看到一个模糊的身影。
My aunt is incredibly vague - she can never remember where she's left things.  我的姨妈极其迷糊——她老是记不得自己把东西放在甚么地方。

words.meaning: n.疤,疤痕;创伤 v.使留下伤痕,创伤
words.example:
That burn will leave a nasty scar.  烫伤会留下严重的伤疤。
His early years in the refugee camp left a deep psychological scar.  早年的难民营生活给他留下深深的心理创伤。
Every village bears the scars of war.  每一个村庄都布满了战争留下的疮痍。UK verb transitive often passive (-rr-)

words.meaning: vt.检查,调查,视察
words.example: Teachers inspect homework daily.  老师每天检查作业。

words.meaning: n.水手,海员
words.example: The sailor read the stars.  水手看着星星导航。

words.meaning: n. 悬浮；暂停；停职
words.example:
The suspension of fighting is to take effect at 6 am on Monday.  停战协定于周一早上六点生效。
There have been calls for the drug's immediate suspension, following reports that it has dangerous side effects.  有报导指出，这种药物有危险的副作用后，人们呼吁立即停止使用该药。
The union is protesting about the suspension of a restaurant worker.  工会因一名饭店员工被停职而在进行着抗议。

words.meaning: v.(for)补偿,赔偿
words.example:
Victims of the crash will be compensated for their injuries.  车祸的受害者会得到伤害赔偿。UK verb
Nothing will ever compensate for his lost childhood.  甚么也不能弥补他失去的童年。
His enthusiasm more than compensates for his lack of experience.  他的热情大大弥补了经验的不足。

words.meaning: n.光线,射线
words.example:
Light rays bend as they pass from air to water.  光线从空气射入水中会发生折射。noun
There's still a ray of hope that the missing child will be found alive.  失踪的孩子尚有一丝被活着找到的希望。noun
We love looking after our grandchild. He's a ray of sunshine!  我们喜欢照顾孙儿，他给我们带来了快乐！

words.meaning: v.澄清,阐明
words.example:
Could you clarify the first point please? I don't understand it completely.  请你把第一点再阐释一下，好吗？我一点也不明白。
The position of all shareholders will be clarified next month when we finalize our proposals.  下月我们将计划书定下后，所有股东的立场便清晰明确了。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v./n.闲谈,聊天
words.example: We chatted during the break.  我们休息时聊了天。

words.meaning: n.学生,小学生;瞳孔
words.example:
The school has over 400 pupils.  这所学校有400多名小学生。
There is a very relaxed atmosphere between staff and pupils at the school.  这所学校师生之间的气氛很轻松。
Her school report described her as a very promising pupil.  她在成绩单中被描述成一个非常有前途的学生。

words.meaning: n.病房;行政区;监护;被监护人 vt.挡住
words.example:
The girl was made a ward of court to stop her father taking her out of the country.  这个女孩由法院监护，以防止她的父亲将她带出这个国家。UK verb
In the winter I take vitamin C to ward off colds.  冬天我服用维他命C以预防感冒。
She was given a magic charm to ward off evil spirits.  她被赠予一个魔法护身符，可以驱鬼避邪。

words.meaning: v.(of)抢劫,盗取;非法剥夺
words.example:
The terrorists financed themselves by robbing banks.  恐怖分子靠抢银行来获得资金。
My wallet's gone! I've been robbed!  我的钱包没了！我被偷了！
They robbed the company of £2 million.  他们从这间公司盗取了两百万英镑。

words.meaning: vt.堆积,积累,积聚vi.累积,聚积
words.example:
As people accumulate more wealth, they tend to spend a greater proportion of their incomes.  人们积累了更多财富后，他们的花费占收入的比重也往往会增加。
The company said the debt was accumulated during its acquisition of nine individual businesses.  该公司称其在收购九家个体公司的过程中，债务越积越多。
We've accumulated so much rubbish over the years.  多年来我们已经堆积了这么多的垃圾。

words.meaning: a.单调的;迟钝的,愚笨的;不锋利的
words.example:
She wrote dull, respectable articles for the local newspaper.  她为当地报纸写一些乏味的官样文章。
He's pleasant enough, but deadly dull (= very boring).  他很和善，但太乏味。adjective
We could just see a dull glow given off by the fire's last embers.  我们只能看见炉火的余烬发出的微弱的光。

words.meaning: a.(of)值得…的,配得上…的;有价值的
words.example:
He is unlikely to succeed in getting his bill through Congress, however worthy it is.  无论他的提案多么有价值，他也不可能使其在国会上通过。
Every year she makes a large donation to a worthy cause.  她每年都为一项高尚的事业捐一大笔钱。
Two points in this report are especially worthy of notice.  这份报告中有两点特别值得注意。

words.meaning: n.氢
words.example: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.  氢气是最轻的气体。

words.meaning: n.醋
words.example: Would you like oil and vinegar on your salad?  你要不要在沙拉里加油和醋？

words.meaning: a.给人希望的,抱有希望的
words.example:
He was hopeful about the outcome of the meeting.  他对会议的结果充满希望。
They were hopeful of a successful agreement.  他们对成功达成协议充满希望。
I'm hopeful (that) we can reach a compromise.  我对我们能达成和解充满希望。

words.meaning: n. 不一致；争论；意见不同
words.example:
We had a disagreement about/over the fee for the work.  我们对这项工作的费用有争议。
Literary critics were in total disagreement (about the value of the book).  （关于这本书的价值）文学评论家的看法迥异。

words.meaning: n.爱好,迷恋 v.想象,幻想 a.花式的,奇特的
words.example:
Do you fancy a drink this evening?  你今晚想喝一杯吗？
He could tell she fancied him.  他看得出她喜欢他。
That Dave really fancies himself, doesn't he?  那个戴夫挺自命不凡的，是吧？verb

words.meaning: v./n.潜水,跳水,俯冲
words.example:
Look at those children diving for oysters over there!  看那边那些潜水摸蚝的孩子们！
They ran to the pool, dived in , and swam to the other side.  他们跑到池边，一头栽进水里，然后游到池子的另一侧。
Mark dived off the bridge into the river.  马克从桥上跳进了河里。

words.meaning: vt.公告,公布;为...做广告 vi.登广告
words.example:
We advertised our car (= published a description of it together with the price we wanted for it) in the local newspaper.  我们在当地报纸上登了广告出售我们的轿车。
He advertises his services on the company notice board.  他在公司的布告版上张贴广告来宣传其服务业务。
I'm going to advertise for (= put a notice in the newspaper, local shop, etc., asking for) someone to clean my house.  我打算登广告雇个人来做家庭清洁。

words.meaning: n.爱,喜爱;爱慕之情;感情;疾病,不适
words.example:
He had a deep affection for his aunt.  他非常喜爱他的姑妈。
She felt no affection for the child.  她一点都不疼爱这个孩子。
The former president still holds a place in the nation's affections.  前总统仍深得全国人民的爱戴。

words.meaning: a.成熟的,熟的;成年人的 v.(使)成熟
words.example:
He's very mature for his age.  以他的年纪来说，他已非常成熟。
Upon mature reflection, we find the accused guilty.  经过慎重考虑，我们裁定被告有罪。UK adjective
Mature male gorillas have silver-grey hairs on their backs.  成年雄性大猩猩背部有银灰色毛发。

words.meaning: n.邮票;印;跺脚;标志v.跺脚,顿足;盖章
words.example:
Although this painting clearly bears the stamp of genius, we don't know who painted it.  虽然这幅画明显是天才之作，但我们却不知其出自谁手。
Each manager has left his or her own stamp on the way the company has evolved.  每一位经理都在公司的发展道路上留下了自己的印记。noun
With a stamp of her foot she stormed out.  她一跺脚，冲了出去。verb

words.meaning: n.地理(学)
words.example: It's impossible to work out the geography of this hospital.  没有办法弄清楚这家医院的布局。

words.meaning: n.出租汽车v.[指飞机](使)滑行
words.example: a taxi driver  计程车司机verb intransitive (taxiing, taxied, taxied)

words.meaning: v.漏,泄漏 n.漏洞,漏隙;泄漏,漏出
words.example:
Water was leaking from the pipe.  水正从管子里漏出来。
Oil leaked out of the car.  油从车里漏了出来。
The tin was leaking.  罐漏了。

words.meaning: n.原子;微粒,微量
words.example: figurative He hasn't an atom of sense (= He has no sense) , that boy.  那个孩子啊，一点头脑也没有。

words.meaning: n.结尾,结局
words.example:
People want love stories with happy endings.  人们希望爱情故事的结局是有情人终成眷属。noun countable
To make the plural of 'dog', you add the plural ending '-s'.  要把 dog 这个词变成复数形式，需在其后加表示复数的词尾 s。

words.meaning: n.墨水,油墨
words.example:
Please write in ink, not in pencil.  书写请用墨水笔，不要用铅笔。
The book is printed in three different coloured inks.  这本书是用三色油墨印刷的。noun countable or uncountable
The ink was barely dry on the peace agreement when fighting broke out again.  和平协议才刚签好，战斗又再爆发了。verb transitive specialized

words.meaning: n. 能力，胜任；权限；作证能力；足以过舒适生活的收入
words.example:
Her competence as a teacher is unquestionable.  她的执教能力无可置疑。
He reached a reasonable level of competence in his English.  他的英语能力已达到了一定水准。    Opposite incompetence

words.meaning: n. 适应；改编；改编本，改写本
words.example:
Evolution occurs as a result of adaptation to new environments.  进化是生物适应新环境的结果。
Last year he starred in the film adaptation of Bill Cronshaw's best-selling novel.  去年他主演了那部由比尔‧克朗肖的畅销小说改编的电影。

words.meaning: a.记忆的,纪念的 n.纪念物,纪念碑,纪念馆
words.example:
The statue was erected as a memorial to those who died in the war.  这尊雕像是为纪念战争中死去的人而竖立的。UK adjective [before noun]
Hundreds of people came to Professor Conner's memorial service.  数百人参加了康纳教授的悼念仪式。

words.meaning: a.向后的,倒行的;迟钝的 ad.向后,朝反方向
words.example:
When he was a child, his teachers thought he was backward (= unable to learn as much as most children).  小时候，老师认为他愚笨迟钝。
People still think of it as a backward country/region/area (= one without industry or modern machines).  人们仍然认为这是一个落后的国家／地区。UK adjective
She left without a backward glance.  她头也不回地离去了。

words.meaning: n.食欲,胃口;欲望,性欲;爱好,趣味
words.example:
All that walking has given me an appetite.  走了那么远的路，我胃口大开。
The children all have healthy/good appetites (= they eat a lot).  孩子胃口都很好。
Both viruses cause fever and loss of appetite.  两种病毒都会引起发烧以及食欲不振。noun

words.meaning: vt.使出血,榨取vi.出血,流血
words.example:
Your arm is bleeding.  你的手臂在流血。
He was bleeding heavily.  他在大量失血。
The West is bleeding poorer countries dry through interest payments on their debts.  西方国家透过收取债务利息正在把穷国榨干。

words.meaning: v.窒息,噎住;闷塞,堵塞,阻塞
words.example:
She choked to death on a fish bone.  她被鱼刺鲠住后窒息而死。
Children can choke on peanuts.  小孩子吃花生会噎住的。
Peanuts can choke a small child.  花生会噎住小孩。

words.meaning: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的；adv. 兼职地；用部分时间地
words.example: a part-time job  兼职工作    Compare full-timeUK adverb adjective

words.meaning: n.豌豆
words.example: frozen/dried peas  冷冻／晒干的豌豆

words.meaning: n.战栗,颤抖 v.发抖,颤抖;摇动;焦虑
words.example:
When he came out of the water, he was trembling with cold.  他从水里出来时，冷得直打哆嗦。
Her bottom lip trembled and tears welled up in her eyes.  她的下嘴唇颤抖，泪水也涌上眼眶。
His voice started to tremble and I thought he was going to cry.  他的声音开始颤抖，我以为他要哭了。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.(of)小心的,谨慎的
words.example: He's a cautious driver.  他开车很小心。

words.meaning: n.偏见,成见;损害,侵害 v.使抱偏见,损害
words.example:
Laws against racial prejudice must be strictly enforced.  禁止种族歧视的法律必须严格执行。
He claims that prejudice against homosexuals would cease overnight if all the gay stars in the country were honest about their sexuality.  他主张如果国内所有的同性恋明星都能对自己的性向开诚布公，那么对同性恋者的偏见就会立即消失。
My client accepts the formal apology without prejudice to any further legal action she may decide to take.  我的委托人接受了正式道歉，这不会影响她将来可能会采取的法律手段。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.证(明)书,执照
words.example: She has a Certificate in Drama Education.  她有戏剧教育资格证书。

words.meaning: n.仁慈,怜悯,宽恕
words.example:
She appealed to the judge to have mercy on her husband.  她请求法官宽恕她的丈夫。
The prisoners pleaded for mercy.  囚犯都恳求从轻发落。
The gunmen showed no mercy, killing innocent men and women.  那些枪手毫无怜悯之心，滥杀无辜的男男女女。

words.meaning: (名)同班同学
words.example: My classmate lent me a pen.  同学借了支笔给我。

words.meaning: a.剧烈的;敏锐的;成锐角的;尖的,高音的
words.example:
She felt acute embarrassment/anxiety/concern at his behaviour.  她对他的行为感到极其尴尬／忧虑／担忧。
The problem of poverty is particularly acute in rural areas.  贫穷问题在农村地区尤为严重。

words.meaning: n.合唱队;合唱 v.异口同声地说,随声附和
words.example:
I'll sing the verses and I'd like you all to join in the chorus.  我唱独唱部分，我希望你们都加入合唱。
The choir will be performing the Hallelujah Chorus at the concert.  唱诗班将在音乐会上演唱《哈利路亚大合唱》。
They burst into a chorus of (= they sang the song) Happy Birthday.  他们突然开始齐唱“祝你生日快乐”。UK noun

words.meaning: n.泉水,喷泉,源泉
words.example: The fountain is in the center of the square.  喷泉在广场中央。

words.meaning: a.酸的;发酸的;酸痛的;脾气坏的;刻薄的
words.example:
These plums are a bit sour.  这些李子有点酸。UK adjective
Overnight, it seemed, their relationship had turned sour.  一晚上的时间，他们的关系似乎变糟了。
She gave me a sour look.  她没好气地瞪了我一眼。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.谨慎;注意(事项),警告vt.劝…小心
words.example:
They treated the story of his escape with (some/great/extreme) caution (= thought that it might not be true).  他们对他逃跑的报道有些／相当／极为怀疑。UK noun
As it was her first offence, she was only given a caution.  由于是初犯，所以只给了她一个口头警告。
Just a word of caution - the cheaper models probably aren't worth buying.  只是提醒一句——便宜一点的模型很可能不值得购买。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.(尤指火山)爆发
words.example:
Since the volcano last erupted, many houses have been built in a dangerous position on its slopes.  自从火山上次喷发后，很多房屋建在了火山山坡上的危险地带。verb intransitive
At the end of a hot summer, violence erupted in the inner cities.  一个炎热的夏末，在市中心贫民区突然爆发了暴力事件。
The crowd erupted in applause and cheering.  人群中爆发出掌声和欢呼声。

words.meaning: adj. 落满灰尘的
words.example:
Heaps of dusty books lay on the floor.  一堆堆落满灰尘的书籍摊在地板上。
We drove along the dusty road.  我们在尘土飞扬的道路上行驶。

words.meaning: a.幸运的,侥幸的
words.example: He was fortunate in his choice of assistant.  他很幸运，选择了一位好助手。

words.meaning: n. 突破；突破性进展
words.example: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.  科学家们希望在治愈癌症的研究上取得突破。

words.meaning: a.苗条的;(机会)少的 v.减轻体重,变苗条
words.example:
She's got a lovely slim figure.  她有一副迷人的苗条身材。
figurative They've only a slim chance of winning (= It's unlikely that they will win).  他们获胜的机会微乎其微。verb intransitive (-mm-)    UK
You haven't got much lunch - are you slimming?  你午饭吃得不多——在减肥吗？verb intransitive (-mm-)    UK

words.meaning: vt.达到;完成;获得 vi.达到
words.example:
He has attained the highest grade in his music exams.  他在音乐考试中得了最高分。
We need to identify the best ways of attaining our objectives/goals.  我们需要确定达到目标的最佳方法。
India attained independence in 1947, after decades of struggle.  经过几十年的斗争，印度于1947年获得独立。

words.meaning: n.乡下,农村
words.example:
The countryside around there is lovely.  那周围的乡村很美。

words.example: an after-dinner cigar and brandy  饭后抽支雪茄，喝杯白兰地

words.meaning: n. 二氧化物
words.example: carbon/sulphur dioxide  二氧化碳／硫

words.meaning: v.哭泣,流泪;滴下 n.哭泣
words.example:
People in the street wept with joy when peace was announced.  当宣布和平来临时，街上的人们喜极而泣。
She wept buckets (= cried a lot) when Paul left.  保罗离开时，她大哭了一场。 (wept, wept)
The sore is still weeping a lot so you'll have to change the dressing once a day.  感染处依然流出很多脓，所以你必须每天换一次药。

words.meaning: vt.鼓掌欢迎;赞同 vi.鼓掌欢迎,欢呼
words.example:
You should have heard the audience applaud - the noise was fantastic.  你真应该听听观众的掌声——那才叫掌声雷动。
She was applauded for a full five minutes after her speech.  她演讲结束后，掌声持续了整整五分钟。UK verb
We applaud the family's decision to remain silent over the issue.  我们非常赞赏这一家人对此事保持沉默的决定。

words.meaning: n.立方形,立方体;立方,三次幂
words.example: Cut the cheese into small cubes.  将起司切成小方块。noun countable

words.meaning: n.大使馆;大使及其随员
words.example:
We used to be friendly with some people who worked at the Swedish Embassy.  过去我们和瑞典大使馆的一些官员关系非常友好。
The Ambassador held a reception at the embassy.  大使在大使馆举行了招待会。

words.meaning: adj. 面部的，表面的；脸的，面部用的；n. 美容，美颜；脸部按摩
words.example: Beauty treatments range from an eyelash tint at £8 to a deep cleansing facial costing £58.  美容护理服务价格不一，包括收费8英镑的染睫毛和收费58英镑的面部深层清洁。

words.meaning: n.X射线,X光
words.example:
The X-ray showed a slight irregularity in one lung.  X光照片显示有一叶肺有点不正常。
She had an X-ray to see if any of her ribs were broken.  她作了X光检查，以确定肋骨是否骨折。

words.meaning: a.古式的,过时的　n.有价值的古物,古董
words.example:
You can't give away Granny's old bookcase - it's a valuable antique.  你不能把奶奶的旧书柜送人，那可是件值钱的古董啊。
My mother collects antiques.  我母亲收藏古玩。adjective

words.meaning: v.磨光,擦亮;使优美,润饰 n.擦光剂,上光蜡
words.example:
Polish your shoes regularly to protect the leather.  定期擦拭你的鞋以保护皮革。UK verb transitive
He polished off the whole pie.  他风卷残云般地吃掉了一整块馅饼。
Arsenal polished off Chelsea 5-0 in Saturday's match.  阿森纳队在周六的比赛中以5：0干净俐落地击败了切尔西队。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.溜冰,滑冰 n.冰鞋
words.example:
Get your skates on, or we'll be late.  快点，否则我们会迟到的。verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive
The ice on the river is thick enough to skate on/across/over.  河上的冰够厚，可以在上面滑冰。
Shall we go skating tomorrow?  我们明天去滑冰好吗？verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive

words.meaning: n.行为,行动;功绩,事迹;证书;契据
words.example:
It seems to me that a lot of evil deeds are done in the name of religion.  在我看来，很多坏事都是打着宗教旗帜的。
She's always helping people and doing other good deeds.  她总是帮助别人，经常做好事。noun countable

words.meaning: a.活泼的,活跃的;栩栩如生的,真实的
words.example:
It's hard work teaching a class of lively children.  给一班活泼好动的孩子们当老师很辛苦。
They take a lively interest in their grandchildren.  他们非常喜欢自己的孙辈。
There was some lively discussion at the meeting.  会上讨论得很热烈。

words.meaning: v.剃,刮,刨,削 n.刮脸
words.example:
John has to shave twice a day.  约翰每天得刮两次脸。
Do you shave under your arms?  你刮腋毛吗？
When my dad shaved his beard (off) , he looked ten years younger.  我爸爸刮完胡子后，看起来年轻了十岁。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.学会,研究所;学院 v.设立,设置,制定
words.example: She is threatening to institute legal proceedings against the hospital.  她威胁说要对该医院提出诉讼。

words.meaning: a.晚期的;终点的;期末的 n.终点(站);终端
words.example:
She has terminal cancer.  她患有末期癌症。
He has nothing to do all day and is suffering from terminal boredom.  他终日无所事事，极其无聊。
She claims that the shipbuilding industry is in terminal decline.  她声称造船业已经衰败到极点。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(harbour)海港;避难所 v.隐匿,窝藏
words.example: Ships wait in the harbor.  轮船在港口等候。

words.meaning: a.愚笨的,愚蠢的
words.example:
That was a rather foolish thing to do.  做那样的事可真是蠢。
She was afraid that she would look foolish if she refused.  她怕如果拒绝会使自己看起来像个傻瓜。
It was foolish of them to pay so much.  他们花了这么多钱，真傻。

words.meaning: n.运动场,游戏场
words.example: This area of the coast is the playground of the rich and famous.  海滨的这片区域是富人和名人们的娱乐场。

words.meaning: a.&n.业余(水平)的(运动员、艺术家等)
words.example:

words.meaning: a.原始的,远古的,早期的;粗糙的,简单的
words.example:
Primitive races colonized these islands 2000 years ago.  原始种族2000年前开拓了这些岛屿。
The spiny anteater is a mammal, although a very primitive one.  针鼹属于哺乳动物，尽管是非常原始的一种。
Early settlers had to cope with very primitive living conditions.  早期殖民者不得不克服非常原始的生存条件。

words.meaning: n.阳台;(电影院等的)楼厅,楼座
words.example:

Our seats are in row F of the balcony.  我们的座位在楼座的F排。

words.meaning: n.蚁;蚂蚁
words.example: An ant carries food home.  蚂蚁把食物搬回家。

words.meaning: a.有害的

words.meaning: v./n.再循环,重复利用
words.example: The Japanese recycle more than half their waste paper.  日本人将一半以上的废纸回收利用。

words.meaning: n.巧合;同时发生,共同存在;符合,一致

You chose exactly the same wallpaper as us - what a coincidence!  你选的壁纸跟我们的一模一样——真巧！

words.meaning: vi.(狗等)吠,叫n.吠声,叫声;树皮
words.example:
Don't let her frighten you, her bark is worse than her bite.  别被她吓倒了，她这人口直心快。UK verb
They heard a dog barking outside.  他们听见外面有狗吠声。
The sergeant barked (out) a succession of orders to the new recruits.  中士向那些新兵大声地下了一连串命令。UK verb

words.meaning: v.使害怕,使惊恐
words.example: The idea of parachuting out of a plane terrifies me.  一想到从飞机上跳伞，我就害怕。

words.meaning: n.院子,庭院,天井

words.meaning: v.贿赂,收买 a.腐败的,贪污的

words.meaning: a.平行的,相同的,类似的n.平行线,类似,对比

words.meaning: n. 微波

words.meaning: a.彻底的,完全的;精心的

words.meaning: n.一阵激动(恐惧) v.激动;(使)毛骨悚然

words.meaning: vi.嗅…味道;抽鼻涕;对嗤之以鼻,蔑视

words.meaning: adj. 无聊的；无趣的；烦人的；v. 使厌烦（bore的过去式）；烦扰

words.meaning: a.透明的,透光的;易理解的;明显的

words.meaning: n.复活节

words.meaning: n.节日;宴会

words.meaning: n.管理者;(汽车)售票员;领队,指挥;导体

words.meaning: a.主观(上)的,个人的

words.meaning: n.广告；公告；登广告

words.meaning: n.改正，纠正，修改

words.meaning: n. [印刷] 修正；复习；修订本

words.meaning: n.记录员;录音机

words.meaning: n.少女,处女,女仆

words.meaning: n. 摩托车；机动车；vi. 骑摩托车

words.meaning: adj. 难以置信的；不可信的

words.meaning: n.钟(表)面,刻度盘,拨号盘 v.拨号,打电话

Can you read what it says on the dial?  你能读出仪表盘上的读数吗？

words.meaning: n.林荫路,大街;(比喻)途径,渠道,方法

words.meaning: n. 芥末；芥菜；深黄色；强烈的兴趣；n. (Mustard)人名；(英)马斯塔德

words.meaning: n.(一件)衣服

words.meaning: n.幼儿园

words.meaning: adj. 北极的；极寒的；n. 北极圈；御寒防水套鞋；n. (Arctic)人名；(英)阿克蒂克

words.meaning: n.被子

words.meaning: n.金字塔

words.meaning: n.单身汉;(亦作B-)学士(学位)

words.meaning: n. 装饰，装潢；装饰品；奖章

words.meaning: n. 高速公路

words.meaning: v.(by)乘,使相乘;倍增,增加,繁殖

words.meaning: v.拍手,拍,轻拍 n.拍(手),掌声,霹雳声

words.meaning: a.粗鲁的;猛烈的,残暴的;粗糙的,粗陋的

words.meaning: n. 消遣，娱乐；乐趣

words.meaning: v.取来;接来;引出;售得;吸引 n.取得;拿

words.meaning: a.空的；未被占用的

words.meaning: a.聋的;不愿听的

words.meaning: n.虎;老虎

words.meaning: n.百万富翁

words.meaning: v.哀悼,忧伤

words.meaning: n.烤肉;烤肉用的台架 vt.炙烤(肉等)

words.meaning: n. 译者；翻译器

words.meaning: a.逐渐的,逐步的

words.meaning: ad.现今,现在

words.meaning: n. 目录；（美）大学情况一览；vt. 把…编入目录

words.meaning: n.海军

words.meaning: n./v.不喜欢,厌恶

words.meaning: n. 圣歌；赞美诗；vt. 唱；诵扬；vi. 唱歌；反复地唱歌；n. (Chant)人名；(英)钱特
